text.title: 左膀右臂
text.objectives: 摧毁托奇、ED-210、麦克斯·布拉斯托和研磨者，然后返回菲兹兰克机场向金吉·温纳特复命。
text.description: 好啦，还差最后一步，我们就可以发动攻击了……要击败麦卡佐德，就必须先除掉他手下的副官！$B$B托奇、ED-210、麦克斯·布拉斯托和研磨者分别驻守在西部哨站、北部哨站、中部哨站和南部哨站。$B$B要让它们露面，只需转动哨站的阀门，破坏那里的设施就行啦——你不用理会它们到底要在那里干什么，这不重要。你应该不难找到那些哨站，上面都安置着旋转灯呢。
text.progress: Are Gearmaster Mechazod's lieutenants dealt with?
text.completion: Wow, you survived! I guess all that's left to do now is to deal with Gearmaster Mechazod.
text.completed: Return to Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Lefty Loosey, Righty Tighty
english.objectives: Dismantle Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder, and then report back to Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
english.description: Okay, I think we're ready for the penultimate assault... before you can bring down Mechazod, you're going to have to dismantle his lieutenants first!$B$BYou'll find Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder at the West Point, North Point, Mid Point and South Point stations, respectively.$B$BTo get them to show up, just turn the valves at the stations to mess up whatever they're trying to do out there. You can't miss the places, they all have spinning lights.
english.progress: Are Gearmaster Mechazod's lieutenants dealt with?
english.completion: Wow, you survived! I guess all that's left to do now is to deal with Gearmaster Mechazod.
english.completed: Return to Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 急需帮助的士兵
text.objectives: 无畏要塞外的医师哈索恩要你到斩雷号的货舱里去找到急救物资箱，然后带一份哈索恩的解毒剂回来。
text.description: 嘿，说你呢！快来，我需要你的帮助。如果我们不快一点的话，这个士兵就会被地穴恶魔的毒液给干掉了。$B$B我已经设法减缓了毒液的发作速度，但没有合适的解毒剂，就无法彻底治好他。$B$B我已经预定了新的解毒剂，斩雷号这次去南方的时候应该运回来了一些。请你到它的货舱里去找一箱急救用品。$B$B要快，$C！我们已经无法承受任何非必要的减员了。
text.progress: The anti-venom... do you have it?
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  This man's recovery will be slow, but we won't lose him. What do you say?  You found cultists inside the Stormbreaker?  You'd best notify someone... and bring some evidence.
text.completed: Return to Medic Hawthorn at the Sands of Nasam in Borean Tundra.

english.title: A Soldier in Need
english.objectives: Medic Hawthorn, outside of Valiance Keep, wants you to go inside the Stormbreaker's hold and retrieve Hawthorn's Anti-Venom from a crate of First Aid Supplies.
english.description: You there!  Please, I need your help.  This soldier will succumb to the cryptfiends' venom unless we act immediately.$B$BI've managed to slow down the poison, but without a suitable supply of antidote I cannot counteract it.$B$BI was promised a new shipment of anti-venom in the Stormbreaker's most recent trip from the south.  Go inside its hold and search for a chest of first aid supplies.$B$BHurry, $c!  We can't afford to lose any more men unnecessarily.
english.progress: The anti-venom... do you have it?
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  This man's recovery will be slow, but we won't lose him. What do you say?  You found cultists inside the Stormbreaker?  You'd best notify someone... and bring some evidence.
english.completed: Return to Medic Hawthorn at the Sands of Nasam in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 隐藏的诅咒教徒
text.objectives: 与无畏要塞内的斩雷号战舰上的“左撇子”鲁格塞尔船长谈一谈。
text.description: 这座祭坛上画满了诅咒教派的符号。显然这些狂信徒们已经从主大陆渗透到了诺森德。你最好去通知船长。$B$B他也许在甲板上。
text.completion: Cultists?  Below deck?  I ought to have my whole crew flogged! Listen... why don't we have Admiral Cantlebree take care of this... situation?

english.title: Cultists Among Us
english.objectives: Speak to Captain "Lefty" Lugsail above the Stormbreaker in Valiance Keep.
english.description: This altar bears all the markings of the Cult of the Damned.  It appears fanatics from the mainland have made it into Northrend.  It might be prudent to notify the captain of the ship.$B$BPerhaps he is to be found above deck.
english.completion: Cultists?  Below deck?  I ought to have my whole crew flogged! Listen... why don't we have Admiral Cantlebree take care of this... situation?

text.title: 通知阿洛斯
text.objectives: 与无畏要塞的中心城堡里的阿洛斯将军谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须立刻将此事报告阿洛斯将军。我已经认识这位船长很久了，相信我，他是我见过的最仔细认真的人。$B$B天知道会有多少诅咒教徒通过其它船只偷渡到我们在诺森德的定居点里了。这真是一场灾难。
text.completion: Thank you for your concern, $n.  We were made aware of the situation not too long ago. Counselor Talbot assures me that this was an isolated incident and not a cause for military concern. Our civilian authorities will make sure everyone involved is properly prosecuted.

english.title: Notify Arlos
english.objectives: Speak to General Arlos inside the Inner Hold at Valiance Keep.
english.description: We must notify General Arlos at once.  I've known the captain for a long time and, believe me, he is one of the more careful ones.$B$BWho knows how many cultists have been smuggled into our settlements in Northrend in other ships?  This could be disastrous.
english.completion: Thank you for your concern, $n.  We were made aware of the situation not too long ago. Counselor Talbot assures me that this was an isolated incident and not a cause for military concern. Our civilian authorities will make sure everyone involved is properly prosecuted.

text.title: 圣光的敌人
text.objectives: 先驱者乌尔雷要你到无畏要塞北方的致远郡去寻找诅咒教徒通灵师，并从他们手上夺取诅咒教徒公报。
text.description: 慢点来。我不知道你怎么想，$C，但我多少有点不相信将军的话。我不是很肯定……道听途说总是不如眼见为实。$B$B这里的情况不太妙，我们所有的侦察活动都被否决和推迟了。现在我们必须采取一种更加独立的方式。$B$B如果我们想要了解要塞内的诅咒教徒的情况……就必须从外部开始调查。$B$B情报显示，这里的北方有一小群诅咒教徒，他们正在帮助天灾军团作战。你去看看能不能从他们那里弄到什么线索。
text.progress: You're back, $n.
text.completion: Be discreet, $n.  We cannot look at this evidence in front of prying eyes.
text.completed: Return to Harbinger Vurenn at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Enemies of the Light
english.objectives: Harbinger Vurenn wants you to fight the Cultist Necrolytes near Farshire to the north of Valiance Keep and retrieve the Cultist Communique from them.
english.description: Not so fast there.  I don't know about you, $c, but I was hardly convinced by the general's words.  They rung unsure... as if they were not his own.$B$BSomething's amiss here.  All of our efforts to collaborate have been blocked and delayed.  It is time we took a more independent approach.$B$BIf we're to learn more about the cultists inside the keep... perhaps we should investigate those outside.$B$BIntelligence reports a small group of them aiding the Scourge north of here.  See if they carry any clues.
english.progress: You're back, $n.
english.completion: Be discreet, $n.  We cannot look at this evidence in front of prying eyes.
english.completed: Return to Harbinger Vurenn at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 继续调查
text.objectives: 将诅咒教徒公报交给无畏要塞旅店内的守备官雅拉。
text.description: 我恐怕必须把这事交给我手下的探子了……一些行动更加隐蔽的人。我要你带上这份文件，到旅店去找守备官雅拉。$B$B告诉她是我派你去的，一定要把情况私下告诉她。我们还不清楚有哪些人在为诅咒教派卖命。
text.progress: Harbinger Vurenn sent you?
text.completion: Speak quickly, $c.  What information do you have on the cult?
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Yaala at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Further Investigation
english.objectives: Bring the Cultist Communique to Vindicator Yaala inside the inn in Valiance Keep.
english.description: I'm afraid this is a matter I must delegate to one of my operatives... someone who can work in secret.  Keep the evidence with you and take it to Vindicator Yaala inside the inn.$B$BTell her I sent you and speak of this matter to no one else.  We do not know who might be working for the cult.
english.progress: Harbinger Vurenn sent you?
english.completion: Speak quickly, $c.  What information do you have on the cult?
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Yaala at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 猎杀行动
text.objectives: 守备官雅拉要你前往无畏要塞的三个地点使用驱魔师的透镜，找出并击败诅咒教派的成员。
text.description: 我一直在尽可能地了解这些邪恶的死亡信徒，包括他们的密语。$B$B乌尔雷猜得对，这些诅咒教徒提到他们在无畏要塞的各处都安插了密探：下面的码头上，中心城堡的监狱内和旅店的厨房里。$B$B拿着这只透镜。在这三处地点使用它，所有在近期内使用过诅咒教派通灵术的人身上都会浮现出黑色的光环。在可怕的事情发生之前，一定要除掉那些诅咒教徒。
text.progress: Have you accomplished the task I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  However, I can't shake the feeling that this is not the last we've seen of these death cultists. Darkness has a way of hiding even in plain sight.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Yaala at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Hunt is On
english.objectives: Vindicator Yaala wants you to use the Oculus of the Exorcist in three different locations in Valiance Keep to uncover and defeat Cult of the Damned members.
english.description: I've made it my business to learn as much as possible about the vile death cult, including their secret language.$B$BVurenn was right.  The cultists mention disguised operatives in various locations in Valiance Keep: the lower docks, the jail inside the inner hold and in the inn's kitchen.$B$BTake this oculus.  Use it at those three locations - anyone that has recently used the cult's necromancy will be enshrouded by a dark aura.  Take care of the cultists before something nefarious happens.
english.progress: Have you accomplished the task I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  However, I can't shake the feeling that this is not the last we've seen of these death cultists. Darkness has a way of hiding even in plain sight.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Yaala at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 紧急情况守则：第8章，第2节，第3段
text.objectives: 在菲兹兰克侦察机飞行员的尸体上找到6枚菲兹兰克飞行员徽章，把它们交给滚烫熔池的“尾旋”伊吉·齿钉。
text.description: 无论有没有受伤，身为中队长，我都有责任为那些已经牺牲的飞行员找到并带回他们的徽章。我跟着菲兹兰克已经好多年了，而且我们俩多年以来从没有在这件事上让死去的弟兄们失望过。$B$B但现在，我的伤势确实让我无法亲自在那些残骸中寻找徽章了，或许你能帮我把徽章都收集起来？在你替我收集徽章的同时，我也可以做一些身为中队长该做的其它的事情。
text.progress: Did you get those insignia?
text.completion: Thank you once again, $n. With your help, I may yet be able to complete this mission, disastrous as it's been, and return to Fizzcrank to make my report and properly honor the dead.
text.completed: Return to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle at Scalding Pools in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Emergency Protocol: Section 8.2, Paragraph C
english.objectives: Recover 6 Fizzcrank Pilot Insignia from the bodies of Fizzcrank Recon Pilots and return them to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Scalding Pools.
english.description: Injured or not, as squadron commander, I'm responsible for locating and returning the insignia of all fallen pilots under my command. In all the years I've flown with Fizzcrank, we've never failed to return the signet of a pilot.$B$BMy injuries make it dangerous for me to stray far from the safety of the wreckage, but perhaps you would be willing to help me recover the insignia? In the meantime, I'll make preparations to carry out my final duty as squadron commander.
english.progress: Did you get those insignia?
english.completion: Thank you once again, $n. With your help, I may yet be able to complete this mission, disastrous as it's been, and return to Fizzcrank to make my report and properly honor the dead.
english.completed: Return to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle at Scalding Pools in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 紧急情况守则：第8章，第2节，第4段
text.objectives: “尾旋”伊吉·齿钉要求你将东部残骸、一处南部残骸和一处西北部残骸彻底毁坏。
text.description: 现在，在回去机场进行报告之前，我还剩最后一件事要做了。根据紧急情况守则第8章第2节第4段的要求，我必须尽量彻底摧毁飞行器的残骸，以防我们的高科技流入敌手。$B$B我会把我的火炬借给你……若是你愿意帮我完成这项最后的工作。我可不敢想象这些高科技机械若是落入那些跟部落联系密切的地精手里，一切会变得怎么样。
text.progress: Have you scuttled the wreckage yet?
text.completion: Once again, you have my thanks, $n. Without you, I would not have been able to recover anything useful from this disaster.
text.completed: Return to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle at Scalding Pools in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Emergency Protocol: Section 8.2, Paragraph D
english.objectives: Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle wants you to scuttle the Eastern Wreck, a Southern Wreck, and a Northwestern Wreck.
english.description: There's only one more thing left to do before I can finally return to the airstrip and make my report. Section 8.2, paragraph D of the emergency protocol requires me to scuttle as much of the wreckage as possible, in order to prevent our technology from falling into enemy hands.$B$BI'll give you my torch if you agree to help me complete this last duty. I don't want to think about what the Horde's goblin allies will do if these machines fall into their hands.
english.progress: Have you scuttled the wreckage yet?
english.completion: Once again, you have my thanks, $n. Without you, I would not have been able to recover anything useful from this disaster.
english.completed: Return to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle at Scalding Pools in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 虫临城下
text.objectives: 哈默希尔中士要你到无畏要塞外的纳萨姆沙地去杀死6个地穴爬行者。
text.description: 很好，很好。阿洛斯终于肯把秘密武器拿出来了。$B$B别误会——我的小伙子们一直很努力，但有你这样著名的英雄与他们并肩战斗，一定会让局势向有利于我们的方向发展。我不知道还能阻挡这些亡灵蛛魔多久。$B$B你出去帮我杀掉一些爬虫怎么样？给小伙子们做个榜样。
text.progress: You're back. Hopefully you've put a dent in the enemy's numbers.
text.completion: Nice job, $n.  Show the lads how it's done.  The only good creeper's a dead creeper!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Siege
english.objectives: Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to kill 6 Crypt Crawlers in the Sands of Nasam outside of Valiance Keep.
english.description: Well, well, well.  It's good to see Arlos bring out the big guns.$B$BDon't get me wrong - our lads are doing the best they can, but someone of your renown fighting alongside them could really turn the tides for us.  I'm not sure how much longer we can hold out against these undead Nerubians.$B$BWhat do you say you get out there and kill me some creepers?  Show these boys how it's done.
english.progress: You're back. Hopefully you've put a dent in the enemy's numbers.
english.completion: Nice job, $n.  Show the lads how it's done.  The only good creeper's a dead creeper!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 机甲专家麦卡佐德
text.objectives: 研究机甲专家的手册，并将麦卡佐德的徽记交给菲兹兰克·铁阀。
text.description: 机甲专家麦卡佐德真是个疯子！他说他能移除所谓的“血肉诅咒”，让我们获得永生。没想到他是借此制造机械奴隶！$B$B$N，这家伙一定还在东边滚烫熔池中央的泵站。$B$B我们最后一次见到他时，他正在泵站顶端发号施令呢。去那里研究一下他的东西。$B$B你必须击败麦卡佐德，否则他会害死所有的侏儒……不，是所有的生物！
text.progress: Jinky told me to expect you.  Is it done?
text.completion: It is done then... you have saved us! If you hadn't stopped him here, then who knows how far his madness would have spread? With the threats from the blue dragons and the Nexus War, not to mention the Lich King, the last thing we need is a mad creation of the Titans running loose! Thank you, $n!
text.completed: Return to Fizzcrank Fullthrottle at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Gearmaster
english.objectives: Research the Gearmaster's Manual and return Mechazod's Head to Fizzcrank Fullthrottle.
english.description: Gearmaster Mechazod is insane! He says that he offers us immortality by removing this so-called 'Curse of the Flesh', but what he's really making are robotic slaves!$B$B$N, we're pretty certain that he's still at the pumping station out in the middle of the pools to the east.$B$BThe last we saw of him, he was in the command hut up top. Go up there and research his stuff.$B$BYou must confront Mechazod if gnomes everywhere,... no, everyone everywhere, are to stay alive!
english.progress: Jinky told me to expect you.  Is it done?
english.completion: It is done then... you have saved us! If you hadn't stopped him here, then who knows how far his madness would have spread? With the threats from the blue dragons and the Nexus War, not to mention the Lich King, the last thing we need is a mad creation of the Titans running loose! Thank you, $n!
english.completed: Return to Fizzcrank Fullthrottle at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 死不足惜
text.objectives: Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the Pile of Fake Furs to trap 8 Nesingwary Trappers.$B$B
text.description: Just south of us the caribou used to roam freely, peacefully. Then Nesingwary showed up and everything changed. Now the caribou are in a perpetual state of frenzy, always in a panic. They are stalked by the hunters and trappers hidden in the field.$B$BNesingwary's executioners are unfit for death. They must feel the torture that they put the caribou through!$B$BTake this pile of fake furs and lay it upon their caribou traps to the south. Watch as the hunters are caught in their own deadly traps!
text.progress: Feel no pity for them, $r.
text.completion: You do the Earth Mother's work, $n, but do not revel in this victory for too long. We have discovered the hiding place of the trapper leader.
text.completed: Return to Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Unfit for Death
english.objectives: Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the Pile of Fake Furs to trap 8 Nesingwary Trappers.$B$B
english.description: Just south of us the caribou used to roam freely, peacefully. Then Nesingwary showed up and everything changed. Now the caribou are in a perpetual state of frenzy, always in a panic. They are stalked by the hunters and trappers hidden in the field.$B$BNesingwary's executioners are unfit for death. They must feel the torture that they put the caribou through!$B$BTake this pile of fake furs and lay it upon their caribou traps to the south. Watch as the hunters are caught in their own deadly traps!
english.progress: Feel no pity for them, $r.
english.completion: You do the Earth Mother's work, $n, but do not revel in this victory for too long. We have discovered the hiding place of the trapper leader.
english.completed: Return to Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 敌人的耳环
text.objectives: 仁德会营地的大德鲁伊拉索留斯许诺，若你能带回15只奈辛瓦里同党的耳环，他就会给予你丰厚的奖赏。
text.description: Whether they be treasure seekers or bloodthirsty hunters of the wastes, any being that supports Nesingwary and dares to strike at our beloved wildlife shall be considered an enemy of D.E.H.T.A.$B$BShould you slay these filthy Nesingwary sympathizers, bring me proof of their demise and you shall be rewarded with a blessing from the druids of D.E.H.T.A.$B$B
text.progress: Ears will do quite nicely...
text.completion: These will hang around my neck. Let them hear our message and let these ears be the vessels that carry our truths!
text.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Ears of Our Enemies
english.objectives: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra has said that he will reward you should you bring him 15 Nesingwary Lackey Ears.
english.description: Whether they be treasure seekers or bloodthirsty hunters of the wastes, any being that supports Nesingwary and dares to strike at our beloved wildlife shall be considered an enemy of D.E.H.T.A.$B$BShould you slay these filthy Nesingwary sympathizers, bring me proof of their demise and you shall be rewarded with a blessing from the druids of D.E.H.T.A.$B$B
english.progress: Ears will do quite nicely...
english.completion: These will hang around my neck. Let them hear our message and let these ears be the vessels that carry our truths!
english.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 驯鹿杀手之死
text.objectives: 仁德会营地的扎扎要求你除掉驯鹿杀手卡琳。
text.description: Near the southern end of this bluff is where you will find the treacherous leader of the caribou trappers. She is a savage like no other, making a mockery out of the carcasses of the slain animals: drinking from their blood and howling to the moons!$B$BFind this murderer, Karen, and end her worthless existence.$B$BPrepare yourself properly, $N. Karen the Culler has indulged in the riches that Nesingwary has lavished upon her! She will be well armed and guarded by lackeys.
text.progress: Nature demands justice!
text.completion: Perhaps her death will serve as an example to others that dare slay animals for sport and riches.
text.completed: Return to Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Culler Cometh
english.objectives: Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Karen the Culler.
english.description: Near the southern end of this bluff is where you will find the treacherous leader of the caribou trappers. She is a savage like no other, making a mockery out of the carcasses of the slain animals: drinking from their blood and howling to the moons!$B$BFind this murderer, Karen, and end her worthless existence.$B$BPrepare yourself properly, $N. Karen the Culler has indulged in the riches that Nesingwary has lavished upon her! She will be well armed and guarded by lackeys.
english.progress: Nature demands justice!
english.completion: Perhaps her death will serve as an example to others that dare slay animals for sport and riches.
english.completed: Return to Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 欢乐的蚌壳
text.objectives: 仁德会营地的圣职者塞妮丝要求你杀死10名利欲熏心的潜水员。
text.description: 这里西边不远之处就是库姆亚湖。据我们所知，那里栖息着这世界上唯一的淡水巨蚌族群。$B$B当然，奈辛瓦里那帮卑贱的猎人也看上了这里，想从那些巨蚌中得到大粒的珍珠。必须阻止他们！必须好好给那些为了一己私欲就危害珍稀物种的家伙们上一课。$B$B立刻前往库姆亚湖，找到那些利欲熏心的潜水员，把他们都给干掉，即使让湖水变成红色也没有关系！完成任务之后回来找我。
text.progress: It is gruesome work that we do, $N.
text.completion: Now let us see how their nerve holds up when they see what became of their companions!
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Happy as a Clam
english.objectives: Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill 10 Loot Crazed Divers.
english.description: To the west of us you will find Lake Kum'uya. It is, as far as we know, the only freshwater giant clam habitat in the world.$B$BOf course Nesingwary's lackeys are now using the lake as a giant pearl farm. They must be stopped! A lesson must be taught to those that would think to endanger an entire species.$B$BGo to Lake Kum'uya and locate the loot crazed divers. Slay them until the water runs red! Return to me when a proper example has been made!
english.progress: It is gruesome work that we do, $N.
english.completion: Now let us see how their nerve holds up when they see what became of their companions!
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 遗弃海岸
text.objectives: 前往遗弃海岸，寻找圣职者莉安德拉。
text.description: We have just gotten word from Liandra that mercenaries hired by Nesingwary are moving goods off the beach and onto the main Nesingwary shipping vessel. No doubt they plan on making a fortune from their murderous trade!$B$BShe has asked that we send assistance to the Abandoned Reach, directly south of here on the beachfront of the Borean Tundra.$B$BMake haste, Liandra awaits you there!$B$B
text.completion: Cenius sent you? Well you're not a moment too soon!$B$B

english.title: The Abandoned Reach
english.objectives: Seek out Hierophant Liandra at the Abandoned Reach.
english.description: We have just gotten word from Liandra that mercenaries hired by Nesingwary are moving goods off the beach and onto the main Nesingwary shipping vessel. No doubt they plan on making a fortune from their murderous trade!$B$BShe has asked that we send assistance to the Abandoned Reach, directly south of here on the beachfront of the Borean Tundra.$B$BMake haste, Liandra awaits you there!$B$B
english.completion: Cenius sent you? Well you're not a moment too soon!$B$B

text.title: 不可容忍
text.objectives: 遗弃海岸的圣职者莉安德拉要求你找回12个动物杂货箱。
text.description: 在这片海岸上，在那些漂浮着的货物与残骸之间，无数的木箱与皮袋中满满地装着他们从动物身上残忍取下的东西。奈辛瓦里似乎和北海海盗勾结到了一起。这些肮脏的海盗们正在把所有堆积在海岸上的货物运回南方去。而且毫无疑问，他们背后的买主是艾泽拉斯那些毫无道德与廉耻可言、只知炫耀与奢华的富人们。$B$B必须阻止这一切。你立刻到海岸边去，把所有的货物都夺走，他们不配拥有这一切！
text.progress: We will give those animals a proper burial.
text.completion: A job well done, $N. Now we strike at the pirate leader!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Liandra at The Abandoned Reach in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Not On Our Watch
english.objectives: Hierophant Liandra at the Abandoned Reach in the Borean Tundra wants you to recover 12 Shipments of Animal Parts.
english.description: Strewn across this beach, amidst the flotsam and jetsam, are crates and sacks of animal parts. It would seem that Nesingwary is in cahoots with the Northsea Freebooters. Those dirty pirates are transporting the goods that Nesingwary's murderous lackeys gather offshore. No doubt they will end up in the homes and on the backs of wealthy, unscrupulous individuals across Azeroth.$B$BThis won't happen. Not on our watch. Bring me all shipments that you find upon this beach. They'll never have them!
english.progress: We will give those animals a proper burial.
english.completion: A job well done, $N. Now we strike at the pirate leader!$B$B
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Liandra at The Abandoned Reach in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 罪恶的蛤蜊主宰……
text.objectives: Slay Clam Master K and return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment.$B$B
text.description: It's despicable, really, to anoint one's self as the "Clam Master," as if they hold mastery over the creatures of the sea. None may make such claims!$B$BThis "Clam Master" must be found and slain. He was last seen at the wreckage just off the coast of the Abandoned Reach. Find him and kill him.$B$BOnce this is done, return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment, north of here, and let her know that the mission was a success.
text.progress: Do you bring me good news?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. We are closing in on Nesingwary!
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Nefarious Clam Master...
english.objectives: Slay Clam Master K and return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment.$B$B
english.description: It's despicable, really, to anoint one's self as the "Clam Master," as if they hold mastery over the creatures of the sea. None may make such claims!$B$BThis "Clam Master" must be found and slain. He was last seen at the wreckage just off the coast of the Abandoned Reach. Find him and kill him.$B$BOnce this is done, return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment, north of here, and let her know that the mission was a success.
english.progress: Do you bring me good news?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. We are closing in on Nesingwary!
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 通知菲兹兰克
text.objectives: 回到菲兹兰克机场，与菲兹兰克·铁阀谈一谈。
text.description: 你能先回到机场那边去吗？帮我告诉菲兹兰克，我稍后就会提交一份正式的报告。但现在，我得首先稍微处理一下我的飞行器。$B$B我敢肯定菲兹兰克在听说我还活着并且成功回收了全部菲林之后，一定会非常高兴的。$B$B现在我突然很想知道，那家伙若是跟我们一起飞的话，一切又会怎么样。唉……真怀念过去的日子啊。
text.completion: I should've gone with them. We might've been able to complete the mission without losing any pilots. Tailspin is right, though, we have you to thank for what you've been able to salvage. Your efforts may just make the difference in the fight against the Nerubians.

english.title: Give Fizzcrank the News
english.objectives: Make your way back to Fizzcrank Airstrip and speak with Fizzcrank Fullthrottle.
english.description: Would you be willing to head back to the airstrip and let Fizzcrank know that I'll be along shortly to give my formal report? I've got to deal with the wreckage of my flying machine, and then I'll be on my way.$B$BI'll be certain that Fizzcrank knows that he has you to thank for my survival and the recovery effort.$B$BI only wonder what the old man would've done himself if he'd been flying with us. I miss those days.
english.completion: I should've gone with them. We might've been able to complete the mission without losing any pilots. Tailspin is right, though, we have you to thank for what you've been able to salvage. Your efforts may just make the difference in the fight against the Nerubians.

text.title: 占据上风
text.objectives: 给沙塔斯城的摩尔丁特使带去8份虚空残渣。
text.description: The troops of the Shattered Sun Offensive will need every advantage they can get to beat back the allies of Kil'Jaeden. My colleagues in Stormwind have created oils which will strengthen the blades and armor of our troops.$B$BThe key ingredient, nether residue, pervades Outland  -- if you know where to look. Any master herbalist, skinner, or miner who knows the signs can gather it while plying $g his:her; trade. Those herbs, ores, and beasts native to Outland may all bear the residue.
text.progress: Have you any residue for me?
text.completion: Thank you for your help, $n. No contribution to the war effort is too small. Our men are going to need every advantage they can get in this battle.
text.completed: Return to Emissary Mordin in Terokkar Forest.

english.title: Gaining the Advantage
english.objectives: Bring 8 Nether Residue to Emissary Mordin in Shattrath City.
english.description: The troops of the Shattered Sun Offensive will need every advantage they can get to beat back the allies of Kil'Jaeden. My colleagues in Stormwind have created oils which will strengthen the blades and armor of our troops.$B$BThe key ingredient, nether residue, pervades Outland  -- if you know where to look. Any master herbalist, skinner, or miner who knows the signs can gather it while plying $g his:her; trade. Those herbs, ores, and beasts native to Outland may all bear the residue.
english.progress: Have you any residue for me?
english.completion: Thank you for your help, $n. No contribution to the war effort is too small. Our men are going to need every advantage they can get in this battle.
english.completed: Return to Emissary Mordin in Terokkar Forest.

text.title: 帮助弱小
text.objectives: 仁德会营地的大德鲁伊拉索留斯要求你使用陷阱破坏锤释放8只猛犸幼崽。
text.description: 它们是最尊贵的动物，难道不是吗？$B$B<拉索留斯指着北边一群缓缓走过苔原的猛犸巨象，喃喃地说。>$B$B可是，它们的族群数量却日益减少，一群自称为猎人的恶魔每天只是为了娱乐与发财而屠杀这种高贵的动物。$B$B<拉索留斯猛然转过头来，愤怒之情溢于言表。>$B$B它们的哀鸣已经快让我发疯了，$N。你也听听看，听啊，这风中传来的哀鸣。那些被困在猎人们罪恶陷阱中的小猛犸象正在呼唤我们的帮助。$B$B拿上这把锤子，毁掉那些陷阱，还它们以自由！
text.progress: They must be freed!
text.completion: They never stood a chance. Now orphaned, they will surely die on their own.
text.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Help Those That Cannot Help Themselves
english.objectives: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the D.E.H.T.A. Trap Smasher to free 8 Mammoth Calves.
english.description: They're majestic beasts, aren't they?$B$B<Lathorius points towards the mammoths of the northern tundra.>$B$BWith each passing day their numbers diminish. Demons that call themselves hunters slay the beasts for sport and riches.$B$B<Lathorius' face contorts with anger.>$B$BIt's the whimpers that drive me to madness, $N. You can hear them, carried by the wind. The mammoth calves, trapped in the hunters' vile traps, call out to us.$B$BTake this hammer and smash those traps. Free the calves!
english.progress: They must be freed!
english.completion: They never stood a chance. Now orphaned, they will surely die on their own.
english.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 日怒攻击计划
text.objectives: 沙塔斯城的托沃斯男爵希望你能缴获日怒攻击计划。
text.description: 在我们向奎尔丹纳斯岛发动进攻时，我们发现凯尔萨斯的走狗们正在计划一次反击。他命令虚空风暴的日怒血精灵对我们部署在外域的部队发动攻击，希望这样可以牵制住我们的军队，并让我们的注意力远离太阳之井。$B$B我们必须阻止这样的事情，$N。所有人都要上前线！$B$B去虚空风暴夺取他们的攻击计划书。在那儿的任何血精灵都有可能带着计划书。祝你好运，$N。
text.progress: Have you returned with the plans?
text.completion: You've done the offensive a great service, $n, but we should not rest. I wouldn't put it beyond our foes to plan more mischief in the future.
text.completed: Return to Lord Torvos in Shattrath.

english.title: Sunfury Attack Plans
english.objectives: Lord Torvos in Shattrath wants you to capture the Sunfury Attack Plans.
english.description: As we press the offensive on Quel'Danas, we've discovered that Kael'thas' minions are planning a counterattack. By ordering the Sunfury blood elves, based in Netherstorm, to attack our operations in Outland, he hopes to draw troops and attention away from the Sunwell.$B$BWe must not allow this to happen, $N. Each and every blade is needed on the front lines.$B$BGo to Netherstorm and capture their attack plans. Any of the Sunfury blood elves up there could be in possession of the plans. Good luck, $N.
english.progress: Have you returned with the plans?
english.completion: You've done the offensive a great service, $n, but we should not rest. I wouldn't put it beyond our foes to plan more mischief in the future.
english.completed: Return to Lord Torvos in Shattrath.

text.title: 库诺克的智慧
text.objectives: 将猛犸幼崽孤儿带到北风苔原的巨兽库诺克那里去。
text.description: 尽管你已经英勇地站出来解救了无数的小猛犸象，但它们当中仍有许多会死去。要知道，得不到任何照顾的小猛犸象必须独自在荒野中觅食。$B$B不过，我们还有别的办法！希望总是存在的！$B$B在北方的猛犸平原上，滚烫熔池的旁边，居住着一头被称为巨兽库诺克的古老而睿智的猛犸象。带着这只小猛犸象孤儿去觐见他，他知道该怎么做。
text.completion: <You hear a voice in your head. It is Khu'nok.>$B$BYour name has been heard in the whistling winds, $N. You have done a great thing for my kin. For this we will consider you an ally. Alas, our torment cannot end without bloodshed and violence.$B$BThe price of peace for the mammoths will be the death of Kaw...$B$B
text.end: Orphaned Mammoth Calf Delivered to Khu'nok
text.completed: Return to Khu'nok the Behemoth in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Khu'nok Will Know
english.objectives: Take the Orphaned Mammoth Calf to Khu'nok the Behemoth in the Borean Tundra.
english.description: Although you have acted valiantly in freeing the trapped calves, many of them will still die. You see, without a caretaker, these calves must fend for themselves in the wild.$B$BBut there is a way! Hope yet remains!$B$BNorth of here in the mammoth fields, bordering the Scalding Pools, you will find Khu'nok the Behemoth: a mammoth as wise as he is ancient. Take this mammoth orphan and present it to Khu'nok. He will know what to do.
english.completion: <You hear a voice in your head. It is Khu'nok.>$B$BYour name has been heard in the whistling winds, $N. You have done a great thing for my kin. For this we will consider you an ally. Alas, our torment cannot end without bloodshed and violence.$B$BThe price of peace for the mammoths will be the death of Kaw...$B$B
english.end: Orphaned Mammoth Calf Delivered to Khu'nok
english.completed: Return to Khu'nok the Behemoth in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 猛犸毁灭者卡奥
text.objectives: 杀死猛犸毁灭者卡奥，并夺取卡奥的战戟。将卡奥的战戟带回北风苔原的仁德会营地，交给大德鲁伊拉索留斯。
text.description: 你独自一个人是无法为我的族群复仇的。但是，所有苔原上的猛犸都将帮助你！$B$B到平原上去，找一只雄性猛犸象，他会让你骑上他的背，并听从你的命令。骑着他往这里的北边走，找到卡奥的营地。你们将一起终结猛犸毁灭者卡奥的生命。$B$B完成这一切之后，带着卡奥的战戟回到仁德会营地去找拉索留斯。
text.progress: 发生什么事了？
text.completion: Is this what I think it is? Smashing! Outstanding! Another of Nesingwary's lackeys brought to justice!
text.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer
english.objectives: Kill Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer and recover Kaw's War Halberd. Deliver Kaw's War Halberd to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra.
english.description: You cannot defeat the being responsible for the slaughter of my kind by yourself. The mammoths of the tundra will help you!$B$BVenture forth to the plains and find a mammoth bull. He will allow you to mount him and control his movements and actions. Ride upon his back and find Kaw, north of here at Kaw's Roost. Together, you will be the instrument of Kaw's demise.$B$BDestroy Kaw's armies and take from Kaw his coveted war halberd. Return to Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment should you succeed.
english.progress: What happened?
english.completion: Is this what I think it is? Smashing! Outstanding! Another of Nesingwary's lackeys brought to justice!
english.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 多相数据调查
text.objectives: 沙塔斯城的先驱者哈隆奈姆希望你使用多相光谱护目镜去获取6份多相数据。
text.description: 那个“侏儒发明家”一定是个疯子。他一直在嘟囔着说，纳格兰沃舒古附近的灵魂平原开始出现了一些暗色的云雾。$B$B按照他所说的，这些，多相……唔……什么光谱眼镜可以让佩戴者看到这些云雾，并能从中收集一些数据。他强调说上面记录的数据对我们在太阳之井的行动非常重要。我想他肯定是疯了，不过我需要任何可能对我们有帮助的东西。你不介意帮我去收集一些数据吧？
text.progress: Did you get those readings? That gnome will scream at me again if I don't get his precious data.
text.completion: Thanks for your help. You don't know what it's like to have to deal with "Doctor" Wafflefry over there. In between his "checkups" on my progress, he's busy hawking some gadget or another derived from his military inventions.
text.completed: Return to Harbinger Haronem at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

english.title: The Multiphase Survey
english.objectives: Harbinger Haronem in Shattrath City wants you to use the Multiphase Spectrographic Goggles to take 6 Multiphase Readings.
english.description: I'm sure that 'gnomish inventor' is a crackpot. He was babbling about some dark distortions that have begun to appear in the Spirit Fields around Oshu'gun in Nagrand.$B$BAccording to him, these, uh, multiphase... um, spectro-goggles will allow the wearer to see the distortions and take readings from them. He insisted that recording this data was fundamental to our campaign at the Sunwell. I think he's nuts, but I'm under orders to investigate anything that might help. Would you mind taking some readings?
english.progress: Did you get those readings? That gnome will scream at me again if I don't get his precious data.
english.completion: Thanks for your help. You don't know what it's like to have to deal with "Doctor" Wafflefry over there. In between his "checkups" on my progress, he's busy hawking some gadget or another derived from his military inventions.
english.completed: Return to Harbinger Haronem at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

text.title: 运货行动！
text.objectives: 帮助珍妮从坠毁点返回牦牛村的菲兹克斯·盖维斯特身边，并确保她驮载的货物完好无损。
text.description: 你见过那些突突突冒着烟的飞行器吗？那就是号称侏儒科技的最高杰作。$B$B我一直想搞些能代表侏儒科技的东西研究研究，嘿，你瞧，现在机会来啦。前几天有一架侦察机在喷泉平原西南的滚烫熔池附近坠毁了。$B$B我要你找到那架飞行器的坠落点，然后吹响这枚哨子，我最忠实的伙伴——骡子珍妮就会到你身旁。她会一直跟着你，你可以把所有回收来的东西都放进她背上的口袋里。不过，你得保证她的安全。要是被攻击的话，她可能会甩掉货物。
text.progress: Don't fail! I'm counting on you.
text.completion: Jenny's a little roughed up, but she'll be fine. As for the salvage, it's a bit more... piecemeal than I had hoped, but I should be able to find a use for it. You're not off the hook yet, though. We're going to rebuild this baby.
text.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.
text.objective1: Return Jenny to safety without losing cargo

english.title: Load'er Up!
english.objectives: Help Jenny make her way from the crash site to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village without losing all her cargo.
english.description: Have you seen the flying machines buzzing around? That's gnomish innovation at its finest.$B$BI've long waited to get my hands on some of their technology and a perfect opportunity has presented itself. One of their recon wings crashed in the Scalding Pools, in the southwest part of the Geyser Fields.$B$BBlow this whistle near one of the crashed machines and my trusty mule, Jenny will answer. She'll follow you and carry the salvage, but you must keep her safe. She'll begin to drop the cargo if attacked.
english.progress: Don't fail! I'm counting on you.
english.completion: Jenny's a little roughed up, but she'll be fine. As for the salvage, it's a bit more... piecemeal than I had hoped, but I should be able to find a use for it. You're not off the hook yet, though. We're going to rebuild this baby.
english.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.
english.objective1: Return Jenny to safety without losing cargo

text.title: 玩火
text.objectives: 与任意联盟主城的吞火大师谈一谈。
text.description: 想学点新花招吗？$B$B不知道你能不能达到我这样的境界，不过如果你花点心思，也许真的能掌握一两个小花招哦。与任意联盟主城的吞火大师谈一谈，他们或许能帮上你的忙。
text.completion: Well met. You've come to learn some new ways to handle fire?

english.title: Playing with Fire
english.objectives: Speak to a Master Fire Eater in any Alliance capital.
english.description: Are you interested in learning some hot new skills?$b$bI don't know if you'll ever be able to match my own considerable skill, but you can probably pick up a trick or two if you're an attentive student. Speak to a Master Fire Eater at any Alliance capital. They should be able to help you.
english.completion: Well met. You've come to learn some new ways to handle fire?

text.title: Fire Dancing?
text.objectives: Speak to a Master Fire Dancer in any Horde capital.
text.description: You wish the learn the art of fire dancing?$b$bWell, then. Speak to a Master Fire Dancer at any Horde capital. They should be able to help you.$B$B

english.title: Fire Dancing?
english.objectives: Speak to a Master Fire Dancer in any Horde capital.
english.description: You wish the learn the art of fire dancing?$b$bWell, then. Speak to a Master Fire Dancer at any Horde capital. They should be able to help you.$B$B

text.title: 尼达尔，犀牛之王……
text.objectives: Killinger the Den Watcher at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Nedar, Lord of Rhinos and his companion, "Lunchbox."
text.description: West of here, on the high bluffs above Lake Kum'uya, roams a despicable being known as Nedar. The self proclaimed "Lord of Rhinos" hunts the wastes for the injured or young - rhinos unable to defend themselves against Ned's cowardly attacks. To add insult to injury, Ned has raised a rhino of his own to become his mount and bodyguard.$B$BIt is a rare thing that D.E.H.T.A. would ever call for the death of an animal, but Ned's tainted rhino must be disposed of... Kill them both and return to me.
text.completion: At least for now the rhinos will know peace. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Killinger the Den Watcher at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Ned, Lord of Rhinos...
english.objectives: Killinger the Den Watcher at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Nedar, Lord of Rhinos and his companion, "Lunchbox."
english.description: West of here, on the high bluffs above Lake Kum'uya, roams a despicable being known as Nedar. The self proclaimed "Lord of Rhinos" hunts the wastes for the injured or young - rhinos unable to defend themselves against Ned's cowardly attacks. To add insult to injury, Ned has raised a rhino of his own to become his mount and bodyguard.$B$BIt is a rare thing that D.E.H.T.A. would ever call for the death of an animal, but Ned's tainted rhino must be disposed of... Kill them both and return to me.
english.completion: At least for now the rhinos will know peace. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Killinger the Den Watcher at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 仇敌的血脉
text.objectives: 在斯克提斯寻找召唤法阵中的徽记堆，用10张迷时卷轴召唤出一个泰罗克仇敌的后裔，并击败总共四个泰罗克仇敌的后裔。完成任务之后回去向黑风码头的哈吉克复命。
text.description: 这本书中列有斯克提斯爪之祭司所囚禁着的所有泰罗克的宿敌的后裔，包括猎手吉萨拉克、水晶巨人卡尔洛格，还有被贬为异端的黑暗尖啸者阿克卡莱和风怒者瓦克奇斯。必须要在泰罗克回到这个世界之前将他们全部杀死。$B$B你首先需要夺取一些迷失鸦人身上带着的卷轴，然后在斯克提斯的召唤法阵中烧掉卷轴，这样才能召唤并杀死它们。要知道，它们都是非常非常强大的存在，你最好带上几个朋友一起去。
text.progress: Have you completed your task, $n?
text.completion: Excellent!  Take this.  I've prepared this bundle with items symbolizing the foes you've defeated.  They will allow you to summon Terokk. Beware, $n.  He is the most powerful arakkoa to ever exist.  Do not underestimate him!
text.completed: Return to Hazzik at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest.

english.title: Adversarial Blood
english.objectives: Find the Skull Piles in the middle of the summoning circles of Skettis. Summon and defeat each of the descendants by using 10 Time-Lost Scrolls at the Skull Pile.  Return to Hazzik at Blackwind Landing.
english.description: The descendants held prisoner by the Skettis talonpriests are listed in this book: Gezzarak the Huntress, Karrog the crystal giant, the heretic known as Darkscreecher Akkarai and Vakkiz the Windrager.  They will all need to be slain before Terokk returns to this world.$B$BYou will need the scrolls carried by the time-lost arakkoa to call them forth at the summoning circles in Skettis.  These are powerful beings you will be facing; you would do well to bring friends.
english.progress: Have you completed your task, $n?
english.completion: Excellent!  Take this.  I've prepared this bundle with items symbolizing the foes you've defeated.  They will allow you to summon Terokk. Beware, $n.  He is the most powerful arakkoa to ever exist.  Do not underestimate him!
english.completed: Return to Hazzik at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest.

text.title: 反常的活动
text.objectives: 前往灰谷的佐拉姆海岸，在黑暗深渊入口以南寻找新建的暮光营地，从该处的暮光教徒身上搜寻暮光信件，然后使用图腾信标召唤大地之环幽灵狼。
text.description: $C，欢声笑语笼罩下的火焰节已是暗潮涌动。$B$B我们接到报告称，暮光教徒近来在佐拉姆海岸的黑暗深渊附近频繁活动。莫非这帮狂热份子也在庆祝节日？我看不像。前往黑暗深渊入口南边的废墟，暮光信徒在那里设有营地，去打探打探情报吧。收集到情报之后，用这个信标召唤一条幽灵狼。
text.progress: What have you uncovered?
text.completion: This is worrisome, friend. It hints at a much larger plot beyond simple agitation of the local fire and water elements, and something here bears investigation...
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Guide.

english.title: Unusual Activity
english.objectives: Go to the new Twilight Camp south of the Blackfathom Deeps entrance on the Zoram Strand of Ashenvale and retrieve Twilight Correspondence from the cultists, then call upon the Earthen Ring Guide using the Totemic Beacon.
english.description: While celebration has its place, $c, some of us must look to graver matters.$b$bWhen the festival began, we received reports from Zoram Strand about a sharp increase in Twilight Cult activity. The origins of this holiday are steeped in the very powers those madmen revere; this cannot be coincidence. Go to the camp just south of the Blackfathom Deeps entrance, in the ruins, and see if the cultists will part with information - forcefully if need be. Use this beacon to summon a guide when you find it.
english.progress: What have you uncovered?
english.completion: This is worrisome, friend. It hints at a much larger plot beyond simple agitation of the local fire and water elements, and something here bears investigation...
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Guide.

text.title: 应急的物资
text.objectives: 从坠机的菲兹兰克侦察机飞行员尸体上收集7个侏儒应急工具包，将它们交给牦牛村的菲兹克斯·盖维斯特。
text.description: 你在侏儒的尸体上发现了一只小包裹，里面装满了军粮、工具以及一卷侏儒胶卷。这些东西说不定能帮助菲兹克斯·盖维斯特研究如何仿造侏儒飞行器。$B$B如果再拣几个飞行员背包回去，说不定菲兹克斯会赏你点什么呢。
text.progress: What is it you have there?
text.completion: Gnomish tools? For me? These should make rebuilding that flying machine even easier than I expected.
text.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Emergency Supplies
english.objectives: Collect 7 Gnomish Emergency Toolkits from the bodies of crashed Fizzcrank Recon Pilots and bring them to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: Rifling through the dead gnome's possessions, you come across a small packet filled with rations, tools, and a handy roll of gnomish duct tape. The contents of these kits might prove helpful to Fezzix Geartwist when it comes time for him to reassemble the wreckage of the gnomish flying machines.$B$BBringing a few of these kits to Fezzix might just be worth a nice bonus.
english.progress: What is it you have there?
english.completion: Gnomish tools? For me? These should make rebuilding that flying machine even easier than I expected.
english.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 前往牦牛村
text.objectives: 与北风苔原牦牛村的天空大地先知谈一谈。
text.description: $R, the chieftain is making me wait... time that Taunka'le does not have!$B$BThere has been talk of your prowess. Rather than wait for Garrosh to send help, I ask you to go and help my people.$B$BTaunka'le village lies far to the northeast. Follow the road east out of the hold, turning north at the intersection. Not long after, you will come to another intersection. Follow the path east, passing south and then east of the great pools along the flood plains.$B$BSpeak with Sage Earth and Sky when you arrive.
text.completion: It does not surprise me that the orc chieftain does not have time to hear of our troubles. The ambassador's efforts will likely be like so much mist blowing in the wind. But you are here now. We shall see if he chose well in sending you.

english.title: Ride to Taunka'le Village
english.objectives: Speak with Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: $R, the chieftain is making me wait... time that Taunka'le does not have!$B$BThere has been talk of your prowess. Rather than wait for Garrosh to send help, I ask you to go and help my people.$B$BTaunka'le village lies far to the northeast. Follow the road east out of the hold, turning north at the intersection. Not long after, you will come to another intersection. Follow the path east, passing south and then east of the great pools along the flood plains.$B$BSpeak with Sage Earth and Sky when you arrive.
english.completion: It does not surprise me that the orc chieftain does not have time to hear of our troubles. The ambassador's efforts will likely be like so much mist blowing in the wind. But you are here now. We shall see if he chose well in sending you.

text.title: 死从天降
text.objectives: 哈默希尔中士要你到无畏要塞外使用强化捕网捕捉并杀死6只天灾烈焰蛛。
text.description: 一直以来，我们的防线都固若金汤，没有让这些虫子前进一步。但有些可恶的杂种会飞，这样它们就可以飞过外围防线，直接攻击我们的内部防御圈。$B$B我已经向民用船只征集了一些强化捕网。如果你的臂力足够的话，这些网能帮你扫清空中的敌人。去干掉一些虫子，让我们守住要塞。
text.progress: You're back. Good news, hopefully?
text.completion: We'll beat them if they come by land and we'll beat them if they come by air.  If these motherless undead come by sea we're going to give them the beating of their lives.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Death From Above
english.objectives: Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to use the Reinforced Net to help you slay 6 Scourged Flamespitters outside of Valiance Keep.
english.description: We're doing a good job of holding the front lines against these bugs.  Some of these cheeky fiends, however, can fly over the aforementioned front lines and are really beating down on our inner defenses.$B$BI've requisitioned reinforced fishing nets from our civilian ships.  If you've got a good enough throwing arm, they'll help you knock the enemy out of the sky.  Thin their numbers so that our defenses can hold the keep.
english.progress: You're back. Good news, hopefully?
english.completion: We'll beat them if they come by land and we'll beat them if they come by air.  If these motherless undead come by sea we're going to give them the beating of their lives.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 他们想干什么？
text.objectives: 调查菲兹兰克泵站周围的区域，然后返回北风苔原的牦牛村，向天空大地先知汇报你的发现。
text.description: 西边那些水池一带的侏儒似乎遇到了麻烦。谁叫他们整天搞些乱七八糟的“发明”，真是活该。$B$B我要你前往他们的泵站调查情况，然后向我汇报结果。
text.progress: What did you find out, $r?
text.completion: Troubling news indeed. My people are leaving this place soon. We are going to break through the Scourge lines to get to our capital, Icemist, in the Dragonblight. But, before we do that, we must deal with what the gnomes in their insanity have wrought.
text.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: What Are They Up To?
english.objectives: Investigate the area surrounding the Fizzcrank Pumping Station. Then, return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: The gnomes have run into some trouble in the pools to the west. It serves them right as they have been fouling up the land with their so-called inventions.$B$BI want you to go out to their pumping station and observe what has befallen them. Return to me after.
english.progress: What did you find out, $r?
english.completion: Troubling news indeed. My people are leaving this place soon. We are going to break through the Scourge lines to get to our capital, Icemist, in the Dragonblight. But, before we do that, we must deal with what the gnomes in their insanity have wrought.
english.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 人畜无害
text.objectives: 在灰谷佐拉姆海岸的黑暗深渊入口以西寻找新建的暮光营地，使用螃蟹宝珠打探情报，然后使用图腾信标召唤大地之环幽灵狼。
text.description: 暮光教徒似乎在佐拉姆海岸西北方建立了新的营地，眼下他们正与某个……神秘的访客密谋着什么。$B$B$R，如果你能偷听到谈话内容，我们或许可以了解内情。这颗宝珠能将你伪装成一只普通的沙滩蟹，带上宝珠前往西北方的营地，偷听暮光教徒与他们的“客人”之间的谈话，然后回来向我复命。
text.progress: Have you learned their secrets?
text.completion: They seek to summon a frost lord into our world? No! They cannot tip the balance!
text.end: Listen to the plan of the Twilight Cultists
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Guide.

english.title: An Innocent Disguise
english.objectives: Use the Orb of the Crawler to spy upon the new Twilight camp to the west of the Blackfathom Deeps entrance on the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, then summon the Earthen Ring Guide using the Totemic Beacon.
english.description: According to this, it seems there is another encampment of the cultists to the northwest of the large gathering on the Zoram Strand, and they are speaking with... guests?$b$bMuch could be learned from listening to these proceedings, $r. Take this orb; it will allow you to appear as one of the native crawlers on the beach. Spy on the conversation with these "guests" of the cultists at the northwestern camp and report back to me when you are successful.
english.progress: Have you learned their secrets?
english.completion: They seek to summon a frost lord into our world? No! They cannot tip the balance!
english.end: Listen to the plan of the Twilight Cultists
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Guide.

text.title: 刺杀哈罗德·兰恩
text.objectives: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Outpost in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Harold Lane.
text.description: You have done much for the animals of the Borean Tundra, $N. Nesingwary's lackeys have been beaten back and taught a lesson that they will not soon forget.$B$BHarold Lane, the primary agent responsible for the mass slaughters in Nagrand, has been identified as the man in charge of Nesingwary operations in the tundra. He is stationed at Lake Kum'uya, west of here.$B$B<Lathorius hands you an intricately carved oak horn.>$B$BFind Lane and kill him. Use this horn should you require our aid.$B$B
text.completion: Alas, Nesingwary is gone. Perhaps he was never here to begin with... The demon is a slippery one, but his days are numbered. We will find him and when we do...
text.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Assassination of Harold Lane
english.objectives: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Outpost in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Harold Lane.
english.description: You have done much for the animals of the Borean Tundra, $N. Nesingwary's lackeys have been beaten back and taught a lesson that they will not soon forget.$B$BHarold Lane, the primary agent responsible for the mass slaughters in Nagrand, has been identified as the man in charge of Nesingwary operations in the tundra. He is stationed at Lake Kum'uya, west of here.$B$B<Lathorius hands you an intricately carved oak horn.>$B$BFind Lane and kill him. Use this horn should you require our aid.$B$B
english.completion: Alas, Nesingwary is gone. Perhaps he was never here to begin with... The demon is a slippery one, but his days are numbered. We will find him and when we do...
english.completed: Return to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 元素的力量
text.objectives: 牦牛村的多莱安·霜蹄要你利用风魂图腾收集10只蒸汽狂怒者的能量。
text.description: 我一直在提醒这个笨蛋地精，叫他别太相信那些破烂机器的稳定性。$B$B但是我所掌握的元素之力并不完整，等到修行结束后，我才能完全地运用这种能力。不过，我还是能帮菲兹克斯一些忙的。$B$B带上这个风魂图腾前往西边的村落，将它插在蒸汽狂怒者旁边，图腾会从死去的元素身上汲取能量。将充满能量的图腾带回来给我，接下来的事我自己会搞定的。
text.progress: Have you charged the totem?
text.completion: Good. This should be sufficient to show Fezzix exactly what I've been trying to tell him.
text.completed: Return to Dorain Frosthoof at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Power of the Elements
english.objectives: Dorain Frosthoof at Taunka'le Village wants you to use the Windsoul Totem to gather the energy of 10 Steam Ragers.
english.description: I kept trying to tell that silly goblin his machines are unreliable.$B$BBut the power of the elements; that is deep and abiding. When my apprenticeship is over, I will wield their full power. What I know now should be sufficient to help out our friend Fezzix, though.$B$BTake this windsoul totem and plant it near any of the steam ragers to the west of the village. The totem will gather up the energies of slain elementals. Return the fully charged totem to me and I'll do the rest.
english.progress: Have you charged the totem?
english.completion: Good. This should be sufficient to show Fezzix exactly what I've been trying to tell him.
english.completed: Return to Dorain Frosthoof at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 修修补补
text.objectives: 牦牛村的菲兹克斯·盖维斯特要你给他带回5张蒸汽熟化鹿皮。
text.description: 还记得前几天你带回来的那些侏儒胶带吗？$B$B嘿嘿，我终于知道那玩意儿是干嘛的了。你瞧，这台飞行器的机身严重受损，要让它飞起来的话就需要好好加固了。$B$B多莱安说牦牛人利用蒸汽处理驯鹿皮，然后将这种韧性极强的熟化驯鹿皮制成密封的容器。村子附近就生活着许多沼泽驯鹿，南边的洪荒平原也有它们的踪迹。我要你搞一些它们的皮，然后在蒸汽平原的蒸汽泉眼上处理一下。
text.progress: Did you get that cured caribou hide for me?
text.completion: Fantastic! A few more tweaks and I'll be an airborne goblin!
text.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Patching Up
english.objectives: Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village wants you to bring him 5 Steam Cured Hides.
english.description: Remember all that gnomish duct tape you brought me?$B$BWell, I've found a use for it. The body of this flying machine is so banged up in places, that I'm going to need to reinforce it if I ever hope to fly.$B$BDorain over there has been telling me that the taunka use steam cured caribou leather for making watertight containers. Marsh caribou live all around the village and in the Flood Plains to the south. Get the best hides you can find and cure them over the steam vents in the Geyser Fields.
english.progress: Did you get that cured caribou hide for me?
english.completion: Fantastic! A few more tweaks and I'll be an airborne goblin!
english.completed: Return to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 风暴的主宰
text.objectives: 击败狂乱风暴，然后向北风苔原牦牛村的天空大地先知复命。
text.description: 从调查结果来看，那些机械生物应该不难对付。但是你必须先掌握风暴的力量。$B$B我身后的小屋中有一根图腾，当你做好准备之后，面对图腾集中精神，狂乱风暴就会现身。你必须击败它才能汲取它的精华。$B$B如果能找到帮手的话就更好啦。$C，完成任务后再回来向我复命吧。
text.progress: Have you mastered the storm yet?
text.completion: I feel the power of the storm coursing through you! You are ready, $n. Let us begin.
text.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Master the Storm
english.objectives: Defeat the Storm Tempest and then return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: From what you describe, the creatures of metal should be easy to deal with. But first, you must master the storm.$B$BBehind me in the lodge is a totem. When you are ready, focus your will upon it and the storm will come. You must defeat the storm and in so doing take its essence into yourself.$B$BIf others are there, it is enough that you all work together to defeat it. Return to me after, $c.
english.progress: Have you mastered the storm yet?
english.completion: I feel the power of the storm coursing through you! You are ready, $n. Let us begin.
english.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 闪电的力量
text.objectives: 利用风暴的力量削弱并摧毁15名机器人（不包括那些机械侏儒）。你可以在菲兹兰克泵站周围的池塘中找到它们。$B$B完成任务后回到北风苔原的牦牛村，向天空大地先知复命。
text.description: 你已经掌握了风暴的力量。我会教你如何运用这种力量来削弱西边滚烫熔池里的机器人。$B$B这是一根闪电魔杖，它可以帮你对付机械侏儒的创造物。就别在机械侏儒身上浪费时间了，塔迦祖母有别的法子对付他们。$B$B借助风暴的力量削弱机器人，然后彻底地摧毁它们！
text.progress: Have you unleashed the power of the storm upon those unnatural creations?
text.completion: With their robotic minions dealt with, it is time for us to move on to bigger prey. Unfortunately, even now I feel the power of the storm waning from within you. Nevertheless, it served its purpose, and I think that you're more than capable of taking the next step without it.
text.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Weakness to Lightning
english.objectives: While weakened by the Power of the Storm, destroy any 15 of the robotic units, except the mechagnomes, in the greater pools area surrounding the Fizzcrank Pumping Station.$B$BAfterward, return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: You now have the power of the storm within you. I will give you the means to focus that power and weaken the robots in the pools.$B$BTake this lightning rod. Use it against the robotic creations of the mechagnomes you find within the greater pools area to the west. Do not worry about using it against the mechagnomes themselves; Greatmother Taiga has other plans for them.$B$BOnce the robots are weakened by the power of the storm, dismantle them utterly!
english.progress: Have you unleashed the power of the storm upon those unnatural creations?
english.completion: With their robotic minions dealt with, it is time for us to move on to bigger prey. Unfortunately, even now I feel the power of the storm waning from within you. Nevertheless, it served its purpose, and I think that you're more than capable of taking the next step without it.
english.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 炸毁虫孔
text.objectives: 哈默希尔中士要你使用火焰炸弹摧毁无畏要塞西南方和西北方的虫孔。
text.description: 天灾军团还没有后撤的迹象，$N。都是那些该死的虫孔。据我们所知，这些虫孔直接通向冰冠冰川，而且巨大的亡灵虫子正在地下不知疲倦地拓展着虫孔。$B$B如果说我从多年的矿工工作中学到了什么的话，那就是如果没有支撑梁，只需要进行一次爆破，隧道就会非常容易崩塌。$B$B带上这些炸弹，把它们放在西边海滩那边的山脊上的虫孔入口处。炸掉那些虫孔后回来向我复命。
text.progress: Did you succeed, $N? We need to slow down the Scourge or Valiance Keep will be overrun.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Without you, Valiance Keep might've not held against the attackers.  Thanks to your help we'll live to fight another day.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Plug the Sinkholes
english.objectives: Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to use the Incendiary Explosives to collapse the sinkholes southwest and northwest of Valiance Keep.
english.description: The Scourge are showing no sign of letting up, $N.  It's those blasted sinkholes; they connect to tunnels all the way to Icecrown for all we know.  Giant undead worms burrow under the ground to create them.$B$BIf there's something years of mining has taught me it's that without support beams, tunnels will cave in easily after an explosion.$B$BTake these explosives and place them at the entrance to the sinkholes up on the ridge beyond the beach to the west.  Come back after you've collapsed them.
english.progress: Did you succeed, $N? We need to slow down the Scourge or Valiance Keep will be overrun.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Without you, Valiance Keep might've not held against the attackers.  Thanks to your help we'll live to fight another day.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 过关斩将
text.objectives: 击败瓦拉纳王子以及他手下的两名中尉，残忍的范瑟雷和邪恶的卢修恩，然后向牦牛村的冬风酋长复命。
text.description: 圣城恩其拉的最底层有一座笼罩在光芒之中的灰色祭坛。站在祭坛上，就可以进入那座可怕的浮空城——纳克萨纳尔。$B$B$N，千万小心。瓦拉纳王子拥有众多侍从，这帮走狗宁愿死也不会让你伤害他们的主子。$B$B你必须在浮空城中杀出一条血路，直抵王子的宝座。$N，如果你败在他手中，恐怕我的族人们就再也没有机会安全撤离到冰雾村了。
text.progress: Have you defeated Prince Valanar?
text.completion: With the prince defeated, the Scourge presence in Borean Tundra is broken. I have no illusions that they will stay away for long, which is why I must focus on preparing Durm to lead the villagers on their way to Icemist. For all the disagreements I've had with Durm, I trust his judgment and his abilities. I cannot bring myself to abandon Taunka'le, so I will defend it until I am slain.
text.completed: Return to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Breaking Through
english.objectives: Defeat Prince Valanar and his lieutenants, Vanthryn the Merciless and Luthion the Vile, then report to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: On the lowest tier of the Temple City, there is a gray altar bathed in light. Step into it to gain entry to the dread necropolis Naxxanar.$B$BBe cautious, $N. Prince Valanar will certainly be defended by his personal retainers, who will give their lives to keep you from ascending to the top level of the necropolis.$B$BYou must find your way through the necropolis to the prince's seat. If you fail to defeat him, $N, I fear my people will never know the safety Icemist offers.
english.progress: Have you defeated Prince Valanar?
english.completion: With the prince defeated, the Scourge presence in Borean Tundra is broken. I have no illusions that they will stay away for long, which is why I must focus on preparing Durm to lead the villagers on their way to Icemist. For all the disagreements I've had with Durm, I trust his judgment and his abilities. I cannot bring myself to abandon Taunka'le, so I will defend it until I am slain.
english.completed: Return to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 灵魂的解脱
text.objectives: 使用祖母的捕魂器捕获10个菲兹兰克机械侏儒的灵魂。完成任务后返回北风苔原的牦牛村，向塔迦祖母复命。
text.description: 也不知道西边滚烫熔池的机械侏儒是从哪儿冒出来的。总之，在泵站作业的侏儒莫名其妙地消失之后，机械侏儒就出现了。$B$B天知道这些家伙会搞出什么事来，我们还是解决掉他们比较好。$B$B带上这个捕魂器，对机械侏儒的尸体使用它就能捕获他们的灵魂。然后我们可以释放他们的灵魂，了解这些侏儒究竟遭遇了什么。
text.progress: How fares your progress?
text.completion: Now we must free the souls that you have captured.
text.completed: Return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Souls of the Decursed
english.objectives: Use The Greatmother's Soulcatcher to capture the souls of 10 Fizzcrank mechagnomes. Then, return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village once you have done so.
english.description: The mechagnomes in the pools to the west are a great mystery to us. They appeared not long after the gnomes disappeared from their pumping station and its environs.$B$BThey are an unnatural danger and must be dealt with.$B$BTake this soulcatcher and use it on the remains of the mechagnomes to capture their souls. When you return, we will set them free so that we might find out what happened.
english.progress: How fares your progress?
english.completion: Now we must free the souls that you have captured.
english.completed: Return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 监测数据
text.objectives: 永生之盾的大法师伯林纳德要你去收集他安装在考达拉的监测仪器上的数据。
text.description: 我原本还希望魔枢的影响仅仅限于这个地区。但最近从艾泽拉斯各地发来的大量分析报告指出，地质活动的不稳定程度正在以几何级数增长！$B$B在研究应对方法的同时，我需要魔枢的定期监测数据。$B$B我已经在考达拉四周安装了灵敏的监测仪器，并且把它们伪装成了玛里苟斯的占卜宝珠的样子。其中一台仪器在魔枢附近的壕沟里，另外三台藏在山谷边界的建筑物中。你去帮我查看一下，把仪器的监测数据给我带回来吧。
text.progress: Have you read all of my instruments, $c?
text.completion: This is worse than I expected. Malygos is channeling too much power to this place. If he's not stopped, Azeroth will be the next Outlands! Fortunately, I believe that I've engineered a temporary solution....
text.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Reading the Meters
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield has asked you to collect the readings from his instruments in Coldarra.
english.description: I had hoped that the Nexus' impact was limited to this region. Recently though, reports have flooded in from all over Azeroth suggesting that geologic instability is growing exponentially!$b$bI need the Nexus monitored regularly as I work to develop a solution.$b$bI've placed sensitive instruments around Coldarra, disguised as Malygos' scrying orbs. One lies in the trench near the Nexus, and three are hidden in the structures around the valley's perimeter. Visit each and return to me with their readings.
english.progress: Have you read all of my instruments, $c?
english.completion: This is worse than I expected. Malygos is channeling too much power to this place. If he's not stopped, Azeroth will be the next Outlands! Fortunately, I believe that I've engineered a temporary solution....
english.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 军队？什么军队？
text.objectives: Gerald Green in Farshire wants you to go into the mine to the north and find out what happened to the military detachment that was sent there.
text.description: There's Scourge everywhere, $c.  We've organized the farmers and miners into a militia, but this just won't cut it.$B$BThe one detachment of troops that Valiance Keep sent is defending the mine.  We haven't heard from them in days!$B$BIf you really wish to help us, why don't you go to the mine and see what's going on?  Maybe we can get them to send us some reinforcements.
text.completion: Your stomach feels uneasy as you approach the grain.  The smell is nearly unbearable.

english.title: Military?  What Military?
english.objectives: Gerald Green in Farshire wants you to go into the mine to the north and find out what happened to the military detachment that was sent there.
english.description: There's Scourge everywhere, $c.  We've organized the farmers and miners into a militia, but this just won't cut it.$B$BThe one detachment of troops that Valiance Keep sent is defending the mine.  We haven't heard from them in days!$B$BIf you really wish to help us, why don't you go to the mine and see what's going on?  Maybe we can get them to send us some reinforcements.
english.completion: Your stomach feels uneasy as you approach the grain.  The smell is nearly unbearable.

text.title: 致命的谷物
text.objectives: 回到致远郡，向吉拉德·格林复命。
text.description: 袋中的谷物发出的阵阵恶臭令你联想到了瘟疫。这可能就是造成矿井守军现状的原因。$B$B你最好把这个消息报告给吉拉德·格林。
text.completion: Those poor lads... they never had a chance! This sure sounds like an inside job.  Probably a Cult of the Damned infiltrator.  Curse those madmen!

english.title: Pernicious Evidence
english.objectives: Return to Gerald Green in Farshire.
english.description: The sacks of grain emanate the foul stench you've come to associate with the Plague.  This probably explains what happened to the footmen defending the mine.$B$BYou'd best bring word back to Gerald Green.
english.completion: Those poor lads... they never had a chance! This sure sounds like an inside job.  Probably a Cult of the Damned infiltrator.  Curse those madmen!

text.title: 战斗的时刻
text.objectives: 致远郡的吉拉德·格林要你去杀死14个天灾食腐者。
text.description: 你瞧，$N。致远郡的守军全部战死了，甚至更糟……所以我们只能靠自己打败天灾军团了。$B$B我们已经把致远郡里剩下的壮丁全部编入了民兵团，但如果没有你的帮助，他们胜利的希望会很渺茫。去帮他们一把……我和我的士兵们会守住这条路。绝对不能让天灾军团通过！
text.progress: You giving those ghouls a good beating, I hope?
text.completion: You've communicated with the Scourge in the only language they understand: violence and death.  Unfortunately they just keep coming!
text.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: It's Time for Action
english.objectives: Gerald Green in Farshire wants you to kill 14 Plagued Scavengers.
english.description: Well, $N.  With the last of our military in Farshire dead or worse, we can do but one thing: fight these Scourge ourselves.$B$BWe have deployed militia in what remains of Farshire.  Without your help, they've but little hope of winning.  Go and lend them a hand.  Me and the lads will watch this path.  We can't let the Scourge break through!
english.progress: You giving those ghouls a good beating, I hope?
english.completion: You've communicated with the Scourge in the only language they understand: violence and death.  Unfortunately they just keep coming!
english.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 劳动的果实
text.objectives: 前往致远郡的矿井，从亚克布上尉身上夺取矿石车钥匙，并用它开启矿石车。完成任务后向致远郡的吉拉德·格林复命。
text.description: 天灾军团还在不断涌来……但我们不能放弃！听着，$N。在矿井里有一车矿石，是联盟在这一地区所能采集到的最后一点矿石，因此非常珍贵。$B$B问题是矿石车被锁住了。军队开进矿井的时候，亚克布上尉征用了所有的重要设备，包括矿石车的钥匙。$B$B现在亚克布肯定也和矿井里的士兵一样被瘟疫感染了。你去从他那里拿回钥匙，把矿石带回来。
text.progress: The ore, $N, is it safe?
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  This ore will be of vital importance to the Alliance in the times to come.  I'd like to think we've made a difference today.
text.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Fruits of Our Labor
english.objectives: Go to the mine in Farshire, obtain the Cart Release Key from Captain Jacobs and use it to release the ore cart.  Return to Gerald Green in Farshire when you've completed this task.
english.description: The Scourge just keeps coming... but we can't give up!  Listen, $N.  Inside that mine there's a cart with the last of the ore the Alliance is going to see on this side of the continent for a long time.$B$BThe problem is the cart release is locked.  When the military went in there, Captain Jacobs commandeered all the important equipment, including the cart release key.$B$BThe plague that affected the soldiers in the mine must also have affected Jacobs.  Get the key from him and salvage the ore.
english.progress: The ore, $N, is it safe?
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  This ore will be of vital importance to the Alliance in the times to come.  I'd like to think we've made a difference today.
english.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 延缓灾难
text.objectives: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to use the Interdimensional Refabricator near the rift in the Nexus.
text.description: I've determined the cause of the instability!$b$bAzeroth's ley lines are being redirected to the Nexus. It's fascinating! If only I could spend the remainder of my days studying this anomaly....$b$bSadly, I must focus on the immediate crisis. The influx of arcane energies is tearing a rift between dimensions.$b$bDeep inside the Nexus, the fabric of our universe is being weakened. I cannot stop it, but I've discovered a way to slow it down.$b$bTake this into the Nexus and activate it near the forming rift.
text.progress: Have you been to the rift in the Nexus?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. The tremors have already begun to subside. With any luck, your efforts have granted us sufficient time to find a way to thwart Malygos' efforts.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Postponing the Inevitable
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to use the Interdimensional Refabricator near the rift in the Nexus.
english.description: I've determined the cause of the instability!$b$bAzeroth's ley lines are being redirected to the Nexus. It's fascinating! If only I could spend the remainder of my days studying this anomaly....$b$bSadly, I must focus on the immediate crisis. The influx of arcane energies is tearing a rift between dimensions.$b$bDeep inside the Nexus, the fabric of our universe is being weakened. I cannot stop it, but I've discovered a way to slow it down.$b$bTake this into the Nexus and activate it near the forming rift.
english.progress: Have you been to the rift in the Nexus?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. The tremors have already begun to subside. With any luck, your efforts have granted us sufficient time to find a way to thwart Malygos' efforts.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 净化水池
text.objectives: 将15个菲兹兰克备用零件交给北风苔原牦牛村的铁眼。
text.description: <一行眼泪从铁眼的脸颊上滑落。>$B$B我听说你要回到西边的水池。真是巧得很，能顺便帮我个忙吗？$B$B侏儒真是缺乏环保意识的下等种族，瞧瞧他们鼓捣出的机械设备多污染环境呀。我要你收集一些备用零件。$B$B把你收集到的零件带回来给我。在我们撤离村子之前，我会妥善处理掉这些东西。
text.progress: If we do not take care of the land, she will not suffer us to live for long.
text.completion: It is the taunka way to leave the land pristine before we move on. We will be traveling to our capital, Icemist, very soon. You have helped by allowing us to depart that much more quickly. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Iron Eyes at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Cleaning Up the Pools
english.objectives: Collect 15 Fizzcrank Spare Parts and deliver them to Iron Eyes at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: <A single tear rolls down the face of Iron Eyes.>$B$BI have heard that you are heading back into the pools to the west. I have something for you to do while you are out there, $r.$B$BThe gnomes, who care nothing for the land, have polluted it with their machinery. I want you to pick up any spare parts that you come across.$B$BReturn them to me here. I will see to it that they are properly disposed of before we leave this place for good.
english.progress: If we do not take care of the land, she will not suffer us to live for long.
english.completion: It is the taunka way to leave the land pristine before we move on. We will be traveling to our capital, Icemist, very soon. You have helped by allowing us to depart that much more quickly. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Iron Eyes at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 机械副官
text.objectives: 摧毁托奇、ED-210、麦克斯·布拉斯托和研磨者，然后返回北风苔原的牦牛村，向天空大地先知复命。
text.description: 据说机甲专家麦卡佐德指派了四名副官来操纵滚烫熔池的机器人。$B$B必须消灭他们！$B$B根据我们的远行者和猎人的说法，你只需前往西部哨站、北部哨站、中部哨站和南部哨站，转动那些哨站的阀门以破坏设施，就可以让他们露面。$B$B你应该不难找到那些哨站，上面都安置着旋转灯呢。$B$B$N，抓紧时间！
text.progress: Are the sub-chieftains dealt with?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. With these odd creatures destroyed, dealing with the rest of the pools should now be a simple matter. We owe you a debt of gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Sub-Chieftains
english.objectives: Defeat Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder, and then report back to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: It is known that Gearmaster Mechazod has four sub-chieftains that manage the robots in the pools.$B$BWe must put an end to them!$B$BOur longrunners and snow trackers say that if you were to turn the valves at the west point, north point, mid point and south point stations, each of his sub-chieftains would come quickly to prevent you from fouling their operations.$B$BThe stations are centered on the spinning lights in the pools surrounding the pumping station.$B$BHurry, $N!
english.progress: Are the sub-chieftains dealt with?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. With these odd creatures destroyed, dealing with the rest of the pools should now be a simple matter. We owe you a debt of gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 参考资料
text.objectives: 耶雷米亚·霍宁要你到致远郡矿井旁那间着火的屋子里拿回他的手册《农田、工厂与车间》。
text.description: 我原本是负责管理收割傀儡的——在天灾军团毁掉我们的大部分农场前，这可是个要紧活儿。但我想我们可以重新利用这些傀儡。$B$B我想重新组装这些傀儡，让它们帮忙抗击天灾军团。$B$B但我对此不是很精通，我需要查阅我的工作手册才行。问题是，我把它落在车间里了……就是矿井旁边那间着火的屋子。你能帮我把它拿回来吗？
text.progress: Did you get my book back?
text.completion: Excellent!  The information I need should be in here.
text.completed: Return to Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Reference Material
english.objectives: Jeremiah Hawning wants you to retrieve the book "Fields, Factories and Workshops" from the burning building next to the mine in Farshire.
english.description: I was in charge of the harvest golems - an important job until the Scourge destroyed most of our farmlands.  I've an idea that would make the golems useful again, however.$B$BI think I can rewire the harvest collectors so they'll give us a hand fighting the Scourge.$B$BI'm not an expert at this just yet, so I'm going to need my manual.  The problem is, I left it at the workshop... which happens to be that burning building next to the mine.  Think you could go salvage it?
english.progress: Did you get my book back?
english.completion: Excellent!  The information I need should be in here.
english.completed: Return to Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 击败机甲专家
text.objectives: 研究机甲专家的手册，并将机甲专家麦卡佐德的徽记带回北风苔原的牦牛村，向塔迦祖母汇报你获胜的消息。
text.description: 这个名叫机甲专家麦卡佐德的家伙显然是疯了。如果他如法炮制地拿“永生”来蛊惑我们，那我们也会成为机械奴隶！必须阻止他！$B$B我听见来自风中的低语，这家伙就呆在西边滚烫熔池中央的泵站。$B$B他很可能还在泵站顶端的指挥室里发号施令呢。进去研究一下他究竟在干什么吧。$B$B$N，你必须击败机甲专家麦卡佐德，否则他迟早会害死我们！
text.progress: Is it over then? Has the threat of Gearmaster Mechazod been eliminated?
text.completion: It is done then... you have saved us! If you hadn't stopped him here, then who knows how far this mistake of the gnomes would have spread? With the threats from the blue dragons and the Nexus War, not to mention the Lich King, the last thing we need is a mad creation of the Titans running loose! Thank you, $n.
