text.completed: Return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Defeat the Gearmaster
english.objectives: Research the Gearmaster's Manual and return Mechazod's Head to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: Clearly this Gearmaster Mechazod creature is not in his right mind. If his offer of a cure and immortality means all of us becoming robotic slaves then he must be stopped!$B$BThe winds that guide me whisper that he's atop the pumping station out in the middle of the pools to the west.$B$BMost likely, he'll be found in the command hut on top of the structure. Go inside and research his works.$B$B$N, you must confront Mechazod if we are to survive!
english.progress: Is it over then? Has the threat of Gearmaster Mechazod been eliminated?
english.completion: It is done then... you have saved us! If you hadn't stopped him here, then who knows how far this mistake of the gnomes would have spread? With the threats from the blue dragons and the Nexus War, not to mention the Lich King, the last thing we need is a mad creation of the Titans running loose! Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 古树的秘密
text.objectives: 永生之盾的大法师伯林纳德要你从考达拉的古树身上收集3块冰川古树碎片和3块魔缚古树碎片。
text.description: 显然这一地区的地质异常活动已经影响了当地的生物。$B$B我对冰川古树和它们最近表现出来的适应性变异很感兴趣。我相信它们这种向“魔缚古树”转化的变异方式是对我们当前困难的一种启示。$B$B为了研究，我需要这两种生物的样本。请你快点行动吧……
text.progress: Have you collected the samples I requested?
text.completion: Yes, yes. These shall do nicely. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Secrets of the Ancients
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to collect 3 Glacial Splinters and 3 Magic-Bound Splinters from the Ancients in Coldarra.
english.description: It's become clear that the instability in the region has had an effect on its indigenous creatures.$b$bI've taken a particular interest in the Glacial Ancients and their recent adaptations. I suspect that their transformation into these 'Magic-bound' Ancients may hold clues to our predicament here.$b$bFor my studies, I'll need samples from both. Do hurry....
english.progress: Have you collected the samples I requested?
english.completion: Yes, yes. These shall do nicely. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 加速
text.objectives: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and collect 5 Arcane Splinters from Crystalline Protectors.
text.description: Though we may be witnessing the end of our existence, I can't help but marvel. I've learned more in my short time here than in decades of studies.$b$bThese Ancients are being exposed to incredible levels of arcane energy. It's literally transforming them into something... different.$b$bI'm confident that there's another stage in their metamorphosis. I'll need you to actually enter the Nexus, $n, and find me some evidence of their final state.$b$bDo be careful....
text.progress: The Crystalline Ancients... Do they exist?
text.completion: Fascinating! And they're aggressive too, you say. That would suggest that some intelligence is behind this manipulation. It may not be natural at all.... Please, $n, accept this as a token of our gratitude for your efforts. Dalaran will hear of your service.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Quickening
english.objectives: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and collect 5 Arcane Splinters from Crystalline Protectors.
english.description: Though we may be witnessing the end of our existence, I can't help but marvel. I've learned more in my short time here than in decades of studies.$b$bThese Ancients are being exposed to incredible levels of arcane energy. It's literally transforming them into something... different.$b$bI'm confident that there's another stage in their metamorphosis. I'll need you to actually enter the Nexus, $n, and find me some evidence of their final state.$b$bDo be careful....
english.progress: The Crystalline Ancients... Do they exist?
english.completion: Fascinating! And they're aggressive too, you say. That would suggest that some intelligence is behind this manipulation. It may not be natural at all.... Please, $n, accept this as a token of our gratitude for your efforts. Dalaran will hear of your service.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 冰冷的草莓
text.objectives: 永生之盾的图书馆员塞尔拉要你从考达拉的冰莓灌木丛上收集10份冰莓。
text.description: 呀！能看到一张新面孔真是让我感到欣慰，我还以为我们已经被抛弃了呢。$B$B我们的补给线已经被切断好几天了，而目前的形势似乎有点——好吧，是非常糟糕。老实说，我觉得这完全是个自杀式的任务。$B$B可能我并没有应付这种暴力场面的天赋——更不要说这要命的冰天雪地了！我宁愿回达拉然去研究古代文献。$B$B现在的关键是，我们的食品储备已经快没了，请你帮我尽可能多地收集食物回来。
text.progress: Have you been able to find any food?
text.completion: Well, it's not much, but it should keep us alive for another day. I believe you'll find this to be a fair price for your efforts.
text.completed: Return to Librarian Serrah at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Nuts for Berries
english.objectives: Librarian Serrah in the Transitus Shield wants you to gather 10 Frostberries from the Frostberry Bushes in Coldarra.
english.description: Oh! What a relief it is to see a fresh face. I was beginning to feel we had been forsaken.$b$bOur supply lines were cut off days ago, and things have been looking - well, bleak. To be honest, this was a suicide mission to begin with if you ask me.$b$bMaybe I'm simply not cut out for all of this violence - to say nothing of the bitter cold! I'd much rather be back in Dalaran studying ancient texts.$b$bTo the point, our food supply is nearly spent. Please, gather what you can and bring it to me.
english.progress: Have you been able to find any food?
english.completion: Well, it's not much, but it should keep us alive for another day. I believe you'll find this to be a fair price for your efforts.
english.completed: Return to Librarian Serrah at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 万无一失
text.objectives: 温蒂·达伦要你使用温蒂的火炬烧掉8袋致远郡谷物。
text.description: 我听到你和吉拉德的谈话了，而且我一点也不喜欢这个消息。如果那些狂热者们能在矿井的粮食里下毒，那对外面的粮食就更容易得手。$B$B我们没有时间去分辨粮食的好坏了，必须立即行动，把所有粮食都销毁。$B$B带上这支火把，把附近所有你能找到的粮食全部烧掉。如果我们从这场袭击中幸存下来，结果却死于瘟疫，那可真成大笑话了。
text.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  I would hate to see survivors of the attack on Farshire stumble upon plagued grain.
text.completed: Return to Wendy Darren at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Take No Chances
english.objectives: Wendy Darren wants you to use Wendy's Torch to burn 8 sacks of Farshire Grain.
english.description: I heard what you told Gerald and I don't like it one bit.  If cultists managed to poison the grain in the mines with their foul plague, they could've easily done the same with the grain outside.$B$BWe don't have time to sort the good grain from the bad.  We must act quickly and burn it all.$B$BTake this torch and set fire to any sacks of grain you find out here.  It would be a tragedy if we survived this attack only to succumb to the plague afterwards.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  I would hate to see survivors of the attack on Farshire stumble upon plagued grain.
english.completed: Return to Wendy Darren at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 保持隐蔽
text.objectives: 永生之盾的图书馆员塞尔拉要你杀死魔枢附近的奥术浮蛇，并收集5份魔枢法力精华。
text.description: 我们能在这里站稳脚跟，全得仰仗我们的隐蔽措施。一旦护盾消失，哪怕只是一小会儿，玛里苟斯的手下就会发现我们。$B$B我的职责之一就是维持巫师们的法力水平，以免护盾失效。由于补给线被切断，我必须自己想办法。$B$B我需要你的帮助，$N。$B$B在靠近魔枢的地方，有一些吸收了大量魔法能量的奥术浮蛇。它们在死亡的时候会释放出体内的法力精华来，我需要这些精华。
text.progress: Do you have the mana essences I asked for?
text.completion: Your service to Dalaran will not go unnoticed, $r. I hope you find this payment sufficient.
text.completed: Return to Librarian Serrah at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Keep the Secret Safe
english.objectives: Librarian Serrah in the Transitus Shield needs you to kill Arcane Serpents near the Nexus and collect 5 Nexus Mana Essences from them.
english.description: Our existence here depends entirely upon staying hidden. Should the shield fail, even for a moment, Malygos' minions would have us.$b$bOne of my responsibilities is to rejuvenate the warmages' mana levels so their focus doesn't falter. With our supply lines lost, I've been forced to improvise.$b$bI could use your help, $n.$b$bVery near the Nexus, Arcane Serpents feast on the abundant magical energies. Once defeated, they will yield a mana essence that I can make use of.
english.progress: Do you have the mana essences I asked for?
english.completion: Your service to Dalaran will not go unnoticed, $r. I hope you find this payment sufficient.
english.completed: Return to Librarian Serrah at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 玩火
text.objectives: 与任意部落主城的食焰大师谈一谈。
text.description: 想学点新花招吗？$B$B不知道你能不能达到我这样的境界，不过如果你花点心思，也许真的能掌握一两个小花招哦。与任意部落主城的食焰大师谈一谈，他们或许能帮上你的忙。
text.completion: Greetings. You've come to learn some new ways to handle fire?

english.title: Playing with Fire
english.objectives: Speak to a Master Flame Eater in any Horde capital.
english.description: Are you interested in learning some hot new skills?$b$bI don't know if you'll ever be able to match my own considerable skill, but you can probably pick up a trick or two if you're an attentive student. Speak to a Master Flame Eater at any Horde capital. They should be able to help you.
english.completion: Greetings. You've come to learn some new ways to handle fire?

text.title: 地狱咆哮的勇士
text.objectives: 前往牦牛村与冬风酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 你勇敢地面对了各种挑战，并凭借自己的智慧战胜了困难。$N，多亏了你的帮助，部落才能在诺森德站稳脚跟。$B$B但是，新一轮的战斗才刚刚拉开序幕。我们的目标是攻下冰封王座！$B$B接下来，我要你前往东边的牦牛村。我们的盟友陷入了危机，急需我们的援助。兽栏管理员杜尔克特·狼脉会将你安全地送往目的地，到达牦牛村后请与冬风酋长谈一谈。
text.completion: I fear that you may be too late, champion. Many of my brothers and sisters have already abandoned Taunka'le, seeking shelter in the Dragonblight, far to the east. There is much work left to be done here and few willing to lend us their strength...

english.title: Hellscream's Champion
english.objectives: Seek out Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
english.description: You have faced all challenges that have been set before you and squashed them beneath your boot heel. It is because of you, $N, that the Horde is now firmly entrenched in Northrend.$B$BBut our work has only just begun. We must march to Icecrown and we must tear down its walls!$B$BYour next assignment begins to the east, at Taunka'le Village. Our taunka allies are in dire straits and require aid. Secure transport from the stable master, Durkot Wolfbrother, and seek out Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le.
english.completion: I fear that you may be too late, champion. Many of my brothers and sisters have already abandoned Taunka'le, seeking shelter in the Dragonblight, far to the east. There is much work left to be done here and few willing to lend us their strength...

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: Slay the Frostwave Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located on Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
text.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bReturn to the camp on the Zoram Strand with the large ice stones. They use them to communicate with the elementals, as they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
text.progress: You have returned victorious?
text.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

english.title: Striking Back
english.objectives: Slay the Frostwave Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located on Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
english.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bReturn to the camp on the Zoram Strand with the large ice stones. They use them to communicate with the elementals, as they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
english.progress: You have returned victorious?
english.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

text.title: 基本的训练
text.objectives: 永生之盾的莱洛拉斯要你消灭10个考达拉织法者。
text.description: 这是战争，凡人，而我们就是刺向敌人的长矛。$B$B你们那种为了领土或财富而进行的小打小闹与这场战争比起来真是不值一提。我们要面对的是玛里苟斯和他的整个蓝龙军团。你要牢牢记住，如果他胜利了，这个世界就会灰飞烟灭。$B$B我们的人手很少，而敌人的数量远远超过我们。牺牲是难以避免的，我们只要能拖住敌人就是胜利。$B$B去吧。在我想好该给你指派什么任务前，先自己找点事情来干干。
text.progress: Have you acquainted yourself with our enemy, $c?
text.completion: Alright, $c, now that you've become familiar with the enemy it's time for you to get to work.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Basic Training
english.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to slay 10 Coldarra Spellweavers.
english.description: This is war, mortal, and we are the tip of the spear.$b$bYour little spats over land or currency pale in comparison to this conflict. We face the aspect Malygos and his entire blue dragonflight. All you need to know is that if he is victorious, this world shall be no more.$b$bWe are but few here, and we fly against many. Our deaths are all but a certainty, and our ultimate success lies in merely delaying our enemy.$b$bGo now. Busy yourself while I decide what to do with you.
english.progress: Have you acquainted yourself with our enemy, $c?
english.completion: Alright, $c, now that you've become familiar with the enemy it's time for you to get to work.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 猎龙
text.objectives: 莱洛拉斯要你使用他的长矛驯服一只魔枢雏龙，并把它带回永生之盾交给他。
text.description: 蓝龙军团开始在他们的龙身上画满神秘的符文，我要知道他们的意图。$B$B<莱洛拉斯用一支长矛刺破了手指，矛尖沾上了他的血。>$B$B使用这只长矛去驯服一只龙。在它虚弱的时候制服它，并在法力消失前把它给我带回来。$B$B蓝龙的幼崽都放养在山谷的西北边界上。
text.progress: Have you managed to capture one of the Nexus Drakes?
text.completion: The fate of these young drakes need not burden your conscience, $r. Malygos alone is accountable for this. I am working ceaselessly to discover the secrets of these runes. We shall take no more lives than we must.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Drake Hunt
english.objectives: Raelorasz wants you to use Raelorasz's Spear to subdue a Nexus Drake Hatchling and return it to him at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: The blues have begun to cover their drakes in mysterious runes. I must discover their significance.$b$b<Raelorasz pokes his hand with a spear and coats the tip with his blood.>$b$bTake this and use it on one of them. Wait for it to become subdued, then bring it here to me before it expires.$b$bTheir hatchlings feed around the northwest edge of the valley.
english.progress: Have you managed to capture one of the Nexus Drakes?
english.completion: The fate of these young drakes need not burden your conscience, $r. Malygos alone is accountable for this. I am working ceaselessly to discover the secrets of these runes. We shall take no more lives than we must.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 隐藏的诅咒教徒
text.objectives: 与无畏要塞内的斩雷号战舰上的“左撇子”鲁格塞尔船长谈一谈。
text.description: 这座祭坛上画满了诅咒教派的符号。显然这些狂信徒们已经从主大陆渗透到了诺森德。你最好去通知船长。$B$B他也许在甲板上。
text.completion: Cultists?  Below deck?  I ought to have my whole crew flogged! Listen... why don't we have Admiral Cantlebree take care of this... situation?

english.title: Cultists Among Us
english.objectives: Speak to Captain "Lefty" Lugsail above the Stormbreaker in Valiance Keep.
english.description: This altar bears all the markings of the Cult of the Damned.  It appears fanatics from the mainland have made it into Northrend.  It might be prudent to notify the captain of the ship.$B$BPerhaps he is to be found above deck.
english.completion: Cultists?  Below deck?  I ought to have my whole crew flogged! Listen... why don't we have Admiral Cantlebree take care of this... situation?

text.title: 继续扔火炬
text.objectives: 赢得一场扔火炬游戏，然后与吞火大师谈一谈。
text.description: 嗨，玩火炬的！挺开心的嘛？瞧你那副乐在其中的模样！怎么样，扔火炬游戏玩得炉火纯青了吧？接下来，你要面对新的挑战啦……$B$B你知道游戏规则的：将火炬扔向带标记的火盆。这次呢，时限有所延长，但火盆的数量就多得多了。$B$B准备好了吗？
text.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
text.completion: Wow, you did it!  You are great!  Maybe next year you can apply for a job at the festival!
text.completed: Return to Master Fire Eater.

english.title: More Torch Tossing
english.objectives: Win the torch tossing game, then speak with the Master Fire Eater.
english.description: Hello, fire juggler!  Are you having fun and making fiery mayhem?  That's what I like to hear!  Now, do you think you're an expert at torch tossing?  Then I have a test for you...$B$BYou know the rules: toss torches at the marked braziers.  This time, however, you have a little more time and a LOT more braziers to hit.$B$BReady?
english.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
english.completion: Wow, you did it!  You are great!  Maybe next year you can apply for a job at the festival!
english.completed: Return to Master Fire Eater.

text.title: 扔火炬
text.objectives: 赢得一场扔火炬游戏，然后与食焰大师谈一谈。
text.description: So you want to be a fire juggler?  Do you have what it takes?  The dexterity?  The reflexes?  ...the courage?  If you think so, then let's give you a little practice!$B$BTake these torches and run near the bonfire.  You'll see  braziers with markers flashing above them.  Toss a torch at a marked brazier.  Be quick! Do it before the mark fades if you want credit for the toss!$B$BHit enough marked braziers before the time limit, then come back here... for your next lession.
text.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
text.completion: Well done!  You'll be a fire juggler faster than the fuse on a ground flower!  Now gird yourself!  The next test is when things really heat up...
text.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

english.title: Torch Tossing
english.objectives: Win the torch tossing game, then speak with the Master Flame Eater.
english.description: So you want to be a fire juggler?  Do you have what it takes?  The dexterity?  The reflexes?  ...the courage?  If you think so, then let's give you a little practice!$B$BTake these torches and run near the bonfire.  You'll see  braziers with markers flashing above them.  Toss a torch at a marked brazier.  Be quick! Do it before the mark fades if you want credit for the toss!$B$BHit enough marked braziers before the time limit, then come back here... for your next lession.
english.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
english.completion: Well done!  You'll be a fire juggler faster than the fuse on a ground flower!  Now gird yourself!  The next test is when things really heat up...
english.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

text.title: 接火炬
text.objectives: 连续接住火炬4次，然后与食焰大师谈一谈。
text.description: 扔火炬游戏对你来说已经易如反掌啦，那么试试接火炬吧！$B$B带上这捆未点燃的火炬，在篝火堆附近用力向上抛起一只，在火炬落地之前接住它……然后再往上抛！连续接住火炬4次，然后回来找我。可别接不住呀！如果你接不住的话，就得返回篝火堆那里从头再来咯。祝你好运！
text.progress: Torch catching is a lot of fun, don't you think?  But have care!  You don't want to get singed!
text.completion: Did you get burned?  If you did, then maybe you'll think twice before playing with fire... Just kidding!  Well done!  It's official.  You're a bona fide fire juggler.  Now get out there and have some fun!
text.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

english.title: Torch Catching
english.objectives: Catch 4 torches in a row, then speak with the Master Flame Eater.
english.description: Now that you can throw a torch, let's see if you can catch one!$B$BTake this stack of unlit torches.  Go to the bonfire and throw a torch high into the air.  Catch it before it hits the ground... then throw it back up!  Catch four in a row, then come back to me.$B$BCareful! They're dangerous if they hit the ground!  And don't miss any catches!  If you do then you'll have to go back to the bonfire and start over.  Good luck!
english.progress: Torch catching is a lot of fun, don't you think?  But have care!  You don't want to get singed!
english.completion: Did you get burned?  If you did, then maybe you'll think twice before playing with fire... Just kidding!  Well done!  It's official.  You're a bona fide fire juggler.  Now get out there and have some fun!
english.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

text.title: 继续接火炬
text.objectives: 连续接住火炬10次，然后与吞火大师谈一谈。
text.description: 接火炬游戏是不是很好玩？想不想试试看你能否连续接住更多的次数？$B$B来吧……
text.completion: How's that arm doing, $n?  You looked great out there.  A real juggling master!
text.completed: Return to Master Fire Eater.

english.title: More Torch Catching
english.objectives: Catch 10 torches in a row, then speak with the Master Fire Eater.
english.description: Torch catching sure keeps you on your toes.  Think you can keep it up for a long time?$B$BLet's see...
english.completion: How's that arm doing, $n?  You looked great out there.  A real juggling master!
english.completed: Return to Master Fire Eater.

text.description: 接火炬游戏是不是很好玩？想不想试试看你能否连续接住更多的次数？$B$B来吧……

text.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

english.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

text.title: 继续扔火炬
text.objectives: 赢得一场扔火炬游戏，然后与食焰大师谈一谈。
text.description: Hello, fire juggler!  Are you having fun and making fiery mayhem?  That's what I like to hear!  Now, do you think you're an expert at torch tossing?  Then I have a test for you...$B$BYou know the rules: toss torches at the marked braziers.  This time, however, you have a little more time and a LOT more braziers to hit.$B$BReady?
text.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
text.completion: Wow, you did it!  You are great!  Maybe next year you can apply for a job at the festival!
text.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

english.title: More Torch Tossing
english.objectives: Win the torch tossing game, then speak with the Master Flame Eater.

Then I have a test for you...$B$BYou know the rules: toss torches at the marked braziers.  This time, however, you have a little more time and a LOT more braziers to hit.$B$BReady?
english.progress: Quick! There's no time to waste!
english.completion: Wow, you did it!  You are great!  Maybe next year you can apply for a job at the festival!
english.completed: Return to Master Flame Eater.

text.title: 坊间的传言
text.objectives: Find Leryssa at the inn in Valiance Keep
text.description: 嘿，$N。旅馆那边有个姑娘在找你呢，她的名字叫莉蕾萨。$B$B我猜她应该不认识你，但她似乎非常需要帮助。听她说话的语气，似乎已经绝望透顶了。
text.completion: Thank you for coming to see me.  I didn't know who else to contact.

english.title: Word on the Street
english.objectives: Find Leryssa at the inn in Valiance Keep
english.description: Hey, $N.  There's a girl in the inn that's asking about you.  Her name's Leryssa.$B$BI don't think she knows you, but she said she needed your help.  She sounded really desperate.
english.completion: Thank you for coming to see me.  I didn't know who else to contact.

text.title: 致远郡
text.objectives: 前往北风苔原的致远郡，与吉拉德·格林谈一谈。
text.description: 我们应该能守住这里，$N。无畏要塞是按照能够承受比这更猛烈的攻击的标准建造的。但是我很担心致远郡的农场和矿井。$B$B在遭到袭击前，我们刚派了一队人去防守矿井——他们应该能保护那里的平民。$B$B吉拉德·格林负责管理那里的村民。沿着无畏要塞北墙的道路出去就能抵达致远郡。请你去看看他们的情况，并在需要的时候出手援助。
text.completion: You're here to help?  You're just in time then!

english.title: Farshire
english.objectives: Travel to Farshire in Borean Tundra and speak to Gerald Green.
english.description: My lads should be able to take it from here, $N.  Valiance Keep is built to take a beating far worse than this.  I worry about our farmlands and mine in Farshire, however.$B$BWe sent a full detachment to protect our mining operations right before the invasion - they should be able to defend the civilians.$B$BGerald Green's in charge of the villagers there. There's a passage out of the northern wall out of Valiance Keep; it'll take you straight to him.  See what you can do to help them.
english.completion: You're here to help?  You're just in time then!

text.title: 牦牛村的陷落
text.objectives: 与牦牛村外的陶拉努克宗母谈一谈。
text.description: $N，我们战败了。这里曾是我们世代生活的家园，如今却不再安全。村落中飘荡着死亡的气息……残存的只有对过去的美好回忆。$B$B我已经下令让所有的村民撤离了。幸存者必须立即离开，前往位于龙骨荒野的冰雾村。$B$B<冬风酋长指向东方。>$B$B$N，请你确保我的族人的安全。陶拉努克宗母就在村口等你。要快！天灾军团正在缩小他们的包围圈！
text.completion: There was once a time when I could walk across this tundra and the snow would fill my view for as far as I could see. But the snow has left us - signaling that our time here has come to an end. We leave behind Taunka'le Village and the Borean Tundra with many happy memories... Perhaps the future will welcome our return - along with the snow.

english.title: The Fall of Taunka'le Village
english.objectives: Speak to Mother Tauranook outside the gates of Taunka'le Village.
english.description: We are lost, $N. This place has been our home for many generations, but it is no longer safe. There remains only death... Death and a memory of what used to be.$B$BI have called for the evacuation of Taunka'le. All remaining taunka must leave at once and make their way to our capital city, Icemist, located in the Dragonblight.$B$B<Wintergale points east.>$B$BYou must help get my people to safety, $N. Mother Tauranook awaits you at the village gates. Hurry! The Scourge closes in from all sides!
english.completion: There was once a time when I could walk across this tundra and the snow would fill my view for as far as I could see. But the snow has left us - signaling that our time here has come to an end. We leave behind Taunka'le Village and the Borean Tundra with many happy memories... Perhaps the future will welcome our return - along with the snow.

text.title: 横贯冰原
text.objectives: Escort the Taunka'le Evacuees across Transborea to Wartook Iceborn on the border of the Dragonblight.$B$B
text.description: The path across Transborea, to the east, is the only way to reach the Dragonblight. Many perils await you as you make your journey across the tundra. Beware the Scourge and its influence upon the beasts of the land. Rumors have started to spread about our very own taunka brothers and sisters rising from the dead and attacking caravans on their way to the Dragonblight! Defend your caravan and get the evacuees to safety!$B$BWartook Iceborn waits for you across the bridge leading into the Dragonblight.
text.completion: Icemist is no more...
text.completed: Return to Wartook Iceborn in Dragonblight.

english.title: Across Transborea
english.objectives: Escort the Taunka'le Evacuees across Transborea to Wartook Iceborn on the border of the Dragonblight.$B$B

Beware the Scourge and its influence upon the beasts of the land. Defend your caravan and get the evacuees to safety!$B$BWartook Iceborn waits for you across the bridge leading into the Dragonblight.
english.completion: Icemist is no more...
english.completed: Return to Wartook Iceborn in Dragonblight.

text.title: 破译密码
text.objectives: 永生之盾的莱洛拉斯要你从审讯者卡勒拉斯那里取得碧蓝书典，并从他手下的考达拉缚法者那里收集3枚闪烁的符文。
text.description: 我感觉到这里的龙与我们有着明显的不同，但我依然无法破解它们身体上的符文。$B$B如果没有资料的话，我就需要花上更多的时间来破译它们，可我们没有那么多时间了。$B$B一个名叫卡勒拉斯的肯瑞托叛徒就在附近，他手里可能有我需要的文献，他的手下还有我进行破译工作所需的符文。$B$B快去吧，凡人。玛里苟斯正在变得越来越强大。
text.progress: Hurry, mortal. Malygos gains strength with every passing moment.
text.completion: You have done well, $r. Let us hope for a clue that we can use against Malygos.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Cracking the Code
english.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to get the Azure Codex from Inquisitor Caleras and collect 3 Shimmering Runes from his Coldarra Spellbinders.
english.description: I sense a distinct peculiarity in the drakes here but the meaning of the runes that cover their bodies still eludes me.$b$bWithout a codex, it will take more time than we can afford for me to interpret them.$b$bNot far from here is a Kirin Tor traitor, Caleras, who is likely to have a copy of the tome I require. His underlings hold the runes I will need for my translation.$b$bHurry, mortal. Malygos gains strength with every passing moment.
english.progress: Hurry, mortal. Malygos gains strength with every passing moment.
english.completion: You have done well, $r. Let us hope for a clue that we can use against Malygos.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 懦夫和蠢货
text.objectives: 前往无畏要塞东北边的卡斯卡拉，与阿泰卡谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，$N。不是我说话不客气，但他们让萨萨里安负责执行的那个狗屁任务就是彻头彻尾的自杀。$B$B我们组了一支小分队去攻击那片地区内某个天灾军团的高等生物。疯了，全疯了，这派十几个人去攻击一座蛛魔城市外围的通灵塔……是人干出来的事吗？！所以，老子开溜了！$B$B什么，你还是去想找萨萨里安，好吧，我们本来是计划在东北边的卡斯卡拉跟一个叫阿泰卡的海象人接头，然后让他带我们向东去的。你去找他吧，祝你们好运，蠢货们。
text.completion: I remember the man you speak of.  He bore the marks of Karkut. May Karkut protect our fallen.

english.title: Cowards and Fools
english.objectives: Speak to Ataika in Kaskala, northeast of Valiance Keep.
english.description: Listen, $N.  No offense, but the operation they put Thassarian in charge of was pure suicide.$B$BA handful of our men were to launch an attack on the biggest Scourge presence in the area.  Call me crazy, but storming a Scourge ziggurat outside a plagued Nerubian city with a dozen men ain't my idea of fun.$B$BIf you're still interested in finding Thassarian, we were supposed to arrange for passage east with a tuskarr by the name of Ataika in Kaskala to the northeast.  Good luck with your fool's errand.
english.completion: I remember the man you speak of.  He bore the marks of Karkut. May Karkut protect our fallen.

text.title: Stealing the Exodar's Flame
text.objectives: Return the Flame of the Exodar to the Festival Talespinner.
text.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of the Exodar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: This fire seems new... Yet, you say it came from the Exodar? Fascinating! To make your way into that ship...  Of course, I'll pay you for this. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.
text.completed: Return to Festival Talespinner.

english.title: Stealing the Exodar's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of the Exodar to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of the Exodar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: This fire seems new... Yet, you say it came from the Exodar? Fascinating! To make your way into that ship...  Of course, I'll pay you for this. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.
english.completed: Return to Festival Talespinner.

text.title: Unlocking Your Potential [PH]
text.objectives: Bring this dude some stuff.
text.description: Today you unlock a page in your spellbook, one you may not have realized it was there.  Bring me something, and I'll open it up for you.
text.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft in Designer Island.

english.description: Today you unlock a page in your spellbook, one you may not have realized it was there.  Bring me something, and I'll open it up for you.
english.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft in Designer Island.

text.title: 盗取银月城的烈焰
text.objectives: 将银月城烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从银月城偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: What a glorious fire! You received this from Silvermoon, you say? Unbelievable! With the flames of all four cities, who knows what we could accomplish?
text.completed: Return to Festival Loremaster.

english.title: Stealing Silvermoon's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Silvermoon to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from Silvermoon, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: What a glorious fire! You received this from Silvermoon, you say? Unbelievable! With the flames of all four cities, who knows what we could accomplish?
english.completed: Return to Festival Loremaster.

text.title: 蓝龙的卵
text.objectives: 永生之盾的莱洛拉斯要你杀死考达拉龙人，并用它们的冰霜战斧打碎5枚蓝龙卵。
text.description: 我们来这里的目的很简单：在不让玛里苟斯发现的前提下观察他的后裔，并尽可能阻挠他的行动。为了完成这个目标，我现在要交给你一项任务。$B$B蓝龙把他们的卵都藏在魔枢的底部。长期接受大量奥术能量的辐射显然会加快这些卵的孵化速度，而且会对幼龙的成长产生不可预见的影响。$B$B我没兴趣去研究这种影响。你现在就去杀掉一些龙人，用它们冰冷的斧头砸掉那些卵。
text.progress: Have you destroyed the blues' eggs, $c?
text.completion: It pains me to order the destruction of dragon eggs, enemy or no. May the ends of this war justify the means....
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Hatching a Plan
english.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to kill Coldarra Wyrmkin and use their frozen axes to break 5 blue dragon eggs.
english.description: Our goals here are simple. We are to remain hidden from Malygos, observe his brood, and thwart his efforts wherever possible. To that end, I have a task for you.$b$bThe blues are laying their eggs at the base of the Nexus. Exposure to so much arcane energy will surely make them hatch sooner, and there's no telling what effect it will have on their spawn.$b$bI don't intend to find out. Slay the local wyrmkin and use their frozen axes to break the eggs.
english.progress: Have you destroyed the blues' eggs, $c?
english.completion: It pains me to order the destruction of dragon eggs, enemy or no. May the ends of this war justify the means....
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: FLAG - all torch return quests are complete

english.title: FLAG - all torch return quests are complete

text.title: 争取时间
text.objectives: 悲叹通灵塔里的萨萨里安要求你杀进圣城恩其拉，消灭20名天灾军团士兵。如果你需要帮助，就使用鲁瑞德的骨头。
text.description: 好了，现在有了护命匣，我应该可以得到我想知道的一切了。不过，圣城那边的天灾军团不可能对此一无所知，他们很快就会反应过来的。$B$B我们绝对无法抵御他们的全力攻击。或许我可以……算了，就当我没说。$B$B我希望你能到那边去，骚扰他们一下，给他们造成一些损失。希望这样可以耽搁他们足够久的时间，让这两个家伙把肠肠肚肚都给我吐出来……当然，这只是个比喻的说法。带上鲁瑞德，他肯定能助你一臂之力。
text.progress: 任务完成了吗?
text.completion: That should buy us some time.  Isidorus has been cooperative, but I really needed that alone time with the lich.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Buying Some Time
english.objectives: Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra wants you to inflict 20 casualties against the Scourge inside the Temple City of En'kilah.  Use Lurid's Bones if you need assistance.
english.description: Now that we have this phylactery, I shouldn't have any problems getting the information I need.  It won't take long for the Scourge in the Temple City to notice something's up, however.$B$BI won't be able to fend off a full scale attack here.  Or maybe I would... but I'd rather not find out.$B$BI want you to head down there and inflict some casualties.  Hopefully they'll be distracted long enough for these two to spill their guts... figuratively, of course.  Take Lurid with you, he might be of aid.
english.completion: That should buy us some time.  Isidorus has been cooperative, but I really needed that alone time with the lich.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

text.description: [PH]Quest to close this questline - summon and kill a mature drake (Elite?) - Fight a drake in the dungeon?

english.description: [PH]Quest to close this questline - summon and kill a mature drake (Elite?) - Fight a drake in the dungeon?

text.title: 猎龙
text.objectives: 莱洛拉斯要你使用他的长矛驯服一只魔枢雏龙，并把它带回永生之盾交给他。
text.description: 为了研究它们身上的符文，我需要更多的雏龙。$B$B你可以在山谷的西北边界找到它们……$B$B<莱洛拉斯用一支长矛刺破了手指，矛尖沾上了他的血。>$B$B使用这只长矛去驯服一只龙。在它虚弱的时候制服它，并在法力消失前把它给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you recovered a drake hatchling for my studies?
text.completion: The fate of these young drakes need not burden your conscience, $r. Malygos alone is accountable for this. I am working ceaselessly to discover the secrets of these runes. Rest assured, we shall take no more lives than we must.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Drake Hunt
english.objectives: Raelorasz wants you to use the Blood-tipped Spear to subdue a Nexus Drake Hatchling and return it to him at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: I need more drake hatchlings to continue researching the runes covering their bodies.$b$bThey can be found around the northwest edge of the valley....$b$b<Raelorasz pokes his hand with a spear and coats the tip with his blood.>$b$bTake this and use it on one of them. Wait for it to become subdued, then bring it here to me before it expires.
english.progress: Have you recovered a drake hatchling for my studies?
english.completion: The fate of these young drakes need not burden your conscience, $r. Malygos alone is accountable for this. I am working ceaselessly to discover the secrets of these runes. Rest assured, we shall take no more lives than we must.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 奇怪……
text.objectives: 把闪耀的碎片交给永生之盾的莱洛拉斯。
text.description: 这块金属碎片的某些特性吸引了你，使你没有随手把它仍掉。$B$B莱洛拉斯也许能发现它的作用。
text.progress: What have you found, $c?
text.completion: It was wise of you to bring this to me, $n. If you truly desire to contribute to our efforts, no matter the risk, I shall share with you its meaning.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Puzzling...
english.objectives: Bring the Scintillating Fragment to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: Something about this scrap of metal prevents you from casting it aside.$b$bPerhaps Raelorasz might be able to shed some light on its purpose.
english.progress: What have you found, $c?
english.completion: It was wise of you to bring this to me, $n. If you truly desire to contribute to our efforts, no matter the risk, I shall share with you its meaning.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 力量之语
text.objectives: 悲叹通灵塔里的萨萨里安要求你前往圣城恩其拉，在痛苦尖塔中夺取高阶祭司塔雷坎的卷轴，在凋零尖塔中夺取高阶祭司纳菲塞特的卷轴，在鲜血尖塔中夺取高阶祭司安多拉斯的卷轴。
text.description: 那只巫妖终于肯张嘴了，$N。恩其拉的高阶祭司们掌握着如何进入纳克萨纳尔的秘密。$B$B立刻前往鲜血尖塔、痛苦尖塔，和凋零尖塔，进去以后杀死里面的祭司。$B$B拿到他们身上的三张卷轴之后马上回来。
text.progress: Taking your time, are you?  I don't know how much longer I can keep this lich restrained.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Now for one last bit of information.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Words of Power
english.objectives: Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat wants you to go to the Temple City of En'kilah and retrieve High Priest Talet-Kha's Scroll from the Spire of Pain, High Priest Naferset's Scroll from the Spire of Decay and High Priest Andorath's Scroll at the Spire of Blood.
english.description: The lich has spoken, $N.  The high priests of En'kilah hold the secret to entering Naxxanar.$B$BGo to the Spire of Blood, the Spire of Pain and the Spire of Decay and slay each of the priests.$B$BReturn once you've obtained the three scrolls.
english.progress: Taking your time, are you?  I don't know how much longer I can keep this lich restrained.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Now for one last bit of information.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 牢笼
text.objectives: 永生之盾的莱洛拉斯要你从塞鲁利恩将军手里夺取牢笼外壳，从战争使者戈德拉克手里夺取能量核心。
text.description: 你发现的这块碎片是一种特殊牢笼的组成部分，$N。$B$B玛里苟斯的手下用这种牢笼关押他们俘虏的法师和其它奥术实体，但这只牢笼似乎是用来关押一种……更强大的生物。$B$B敌人的敌人很可能就是我们的朋友。你应该去搜索这只牢笼的其它碎片。$B$B它们很可能在玛里苟斯最亲信的下属手里。
text.progress: Have you discovered any other pieces to the prison?
text.completion: It is done. I sense a strong presence within this prison. Let us hope it proves to be an ally.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Cell
english.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to obtain the Prison Casing from General Cerulean and the Energy Core from Warbringer Goredrak.
english.description: You've discovered a fragment of a special prison, $n.$b$bMalygos' minions use similar prisons to hold their captured mages and other arcane entities, but this prison was constructed to hold something... stronger.$b$bIn hopes that the enemy of our enemy will prove to be a friend, you must search for the prison's remaining fragments.$b$bThey are likely to be in the possession of Malygos' most trusted underlings.
english.progress: Have you discovered any other pieces to the prison?
english.completion: It is done. I sense a strong presence within this prison. Let us hope it proves to be an ally.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 我们被包围了！
text.objectives: 死亡营地的韦恩下士希望你消灭7名通灵塔防御者。
text.description: 我们现在的情况很让人绝望。我们接到命令说，要凭借两只手都数得过来的兵力占领悲叹通灵塔。$B$B我们能守住这个地方跟天灾军团对峙就已经很不错了！现在，我们寡不敌众，伤痕累累，而且还找不到撤退路线。$B$B如果你能帮忙减轻一下压力，我们有就机会巩固防线了。把围在建筑周边的那些亡灵干掉一些吧，那样我们就能抵挡住他们的进攻了。
text.progress: Did you make any progress? We're in a bind here.
text.completion: That should buy us some time, $n.  We'll hope against hope for reinforcements from Valiance Keep.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Venn at Death's Stand in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Surrounded!
english.objectives: Corporal Venn at Death's Stand wants you to slay 7 Ziggurat Defenders.
english.description: Our situation is nearly hopeless.  We were ordered to take the Wailing Ziggurat with a handful of men.$B$BWe'll be lucky if we can hold this position against the Scourge.  We're outnumbered, injured and have no escape route.$B$BIf you can take some of the pressure off of us, we might be able to solidify our position.  Kill some of the undead circling the structure - we'll hold off their advance.
english.progress: Did you make any progress? We're in a bind here.
english.completion: That should buy us some time, $n.  We'll hope against hope for reinforcements from Valiance Keep.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Venn at Death's Stand in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 做最坏的打算
text.objectives: 乌泰克要你在卡斯卡拉收集8份卡斯卡拉补给品。
text.description: 黑暗已经降临。卡库特的灵魂漫步在卡斯卡拉，召集死去的海象人的幽魂。$B$B潜伏在迷雾中的敌人杀害了我们许多的同胞。很快，卡斯卡拉就会沦为死亡一般寂静的废墟。$B$B但是，还有一线希望。部分族人开始往乌努比转移。我们竭尽全力地作战，为的是让他们安全撤离这里。$B$B他们急需食物补给，否则就会活活饿死，因为乌努比也没有足够的粮食。请你尽快替我们的族人收集到足够的食物。
text.progress: Have you succeeded, $n?  Our relatives in Unu'pe are depending on your efforts.
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  These supplies will feed our cousins and children.  Even if Kaskala falls, our tribes must carry on.
text.completed: Return to Utaik at Kaskala in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Preparing for the Worst
english.objectives: Utaik wants you to gather 8 Kaskala Supplies in Kaskala.
english.description: Dark times are upon us.  Karkut's spirit walks the earth and gathers the spirits of dead tuskarr.$B$BThe sons of the mist have taken many of our brethren.  Soon dear Kaskala will be reduced to ashes.$B$BThere is hope yet.  Not for us perhaps, but we've sent our families to Unu'pe.  We fight here so there may be a future for them.$B$BThey will need supplies or they will starve.  There's not enough food in Unu'pe.  Salvage any supplies before it's too late for our families.
english.progress: Have you succeeded, $n?  Our relatives in Unu'pe are depending on your efforts.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  These supplies will feed our cousins and children.  Even if Kaskala falls, our tribes must carry on.
english.completed: Return to Utaik at Kaskala in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 克莉斯塔萨
text.objectives: Keristrasza wants you to speak to her when you are ready to prepare for a confrontation with Malygos.$b$bIf you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
text.description: 我……自由了？$B$B我本以为自己只能永远在那个空无一物的空间中游荡，但是现在……我得救了？你无法想象我是多么感激你，凡人。$B$B因为我拒绝臣服于玛里苟斯，他就把我关进了那只牢笼，并打碎了笼子，把碎片分散到各地。即使我的生命将是你的一百倍那么漫长，我也不会忘记你的帮助。$B$B也许以后我会想办法报答你。但现在，我们必须先对付玛里苟斯。我还很虚弱，而且我们还有很多事情要做。$B$B我需要你的帮助，$N。
text.completion: We cannot wait for me to regain my strength. I must rely on you to make our preparations....

english.title: Keristrasza
english.objectives: Keristrasza wants you to speak to her when you are ready to prepare for a confrontation with Malygos.$b$bIf you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: I am... free?$b$bI was destined to spend an eternity roaming an empty abyss, and now am saved? You cannot fathom my gratitude, mortal.$b$bWhen I refused to bend to his will Malygos bound me to that prison, then shattered it and scattered the pieces. Should I live one hundred of your lifetimes, I shall not forget this kindness.$b$bPerhaps, in time, I will find ways to repay you. For now, though, we must focus our attention on Malygos. I am weak, and there is much to be done.$b$bI need your help, $n.
english.completion: We cannot wait for me to regain my strength. I must rely on you to make our preparations....

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: Slay the Hailstone Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located at Ethel Rethor in Desolace, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
text.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bThere is a camp located in the shadow of Ethel Rethor within northwestern Desolace. There, they use ice stones to communicate with the elementals, as they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
text.progress: You have returned victorious?
text.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

english.objectives: Slay the Hailstone Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located at Ethel Rethor in Desolace, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.

Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...

english.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: Slay the Chillwind Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located on the water elemental's island in western Stranglethorn Vale, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
text.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bNeptulon has long had a base of operations on an island in western Stranglethorn. There, the Twilight Cult has set up ice stones to communicate with the Tidehunter's realm, much like they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
text.progress: You have returned victorious?
text.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

english.objectives: Slay the Chillwind Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located on the water elemental's island in western Stranglethorn Vale, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.

There, the Twilight Cult has set up ice stones to communicate with the Tidehunter's realm, much like they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...

english.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

text.title: 战斗到底！
text.objectives: 阿泰卡要你在卡斯卡拉杀死12名克瓦迪尔劫掠者。
text.description: $R，卡斯卡拉是我们海象人氏族的圣地。塔尤卡的灵魂指引我们的祖先来到这里。$B$B眼下，潜伏在迷雾中的邪恶生灵不断向我们发动攻击。$B$B是时候给它们点颜色瞧瞧了，我们的长矛可不仅仅是捕鲸的工具。朋友，请和我们并肩作战吧。海象人氏族将铭记你的恩情。
text.progress: We are fighting tooth and nail, $N. We'll not give these Kvadir an inch without making them pay for it dearly.
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  I will be deeply in your debt if we ever make it out of here alive.
text.completed: Return to Ataika at Kaskala in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Not Without a Fight!
english.objectives: Ataika wants you to slay 12 Kvaldir Raiders in Kaskala.
english.description: Kaskala is a sacred place for us, $r.  Our ancestors were guided here by the spirit of Tayutka herself.$B$BNow these foul creatures attack us from the mists without any provocation.$B$BWe will show them that our spears are not merely for whaling.  Fight alongside us, friend.  Perhaps my people might repay you some time in the future.
english.progress: We are fighting tooth and nail, $N. We'll not give these Kvadir an inch without making them pay for it dearly.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  I will be deeply in your debt if we ever make it out of here alive.
english.completed: Return to Ataika at Kaskala in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 穆希特的智慧
text.objectives: 在卡斯卡拉找到长者穆希特。
text.description: 听着，$N。像我这样的战士并不是无可替代的。如果我死了，我的兄弟们会捡起我的长矛继续战斗。$B$B但是海象人氏族必须在睿智长者的指引下才能存活。我们最敬重的萨满祭司穆希特拒绝离开中央小岛的塔尤卡祭坛。如果他被那些怪物杀害的话，氏族必将遭受惨痛的损失。$B$B你是个外族人，或许他会听听你的建议。和他讲讲道理……请求他前往乌努比的安全地带避难吧。
text.completion: Ataika sent you, didn't he?  I am not to be swayed. All is not lost.  The spirits are still with us.

english.title: Muahit's Wisdom
english.objectives: Find Elder Muahit in Kaskala.
english.description: Listen, $N.  Warriors like me are replaceable.  If I fall, my brothers and cousins will pick up my spear and fight.$B$BMy people cannot survive without wise elders.  Stubborn Muahit, our most venerable shaman, refuses to leave the altar to Tayutka in the central island.  We would suffer a significant loss if he was slain by these monsters.$B$BYou are an outsider, maybe he'll listen to you.  Show him reason... ask him to flee to the safety of Unu'pe before it's too late.
english.completion: Ataika sent you, didn't he?  I am not to be swayed. All is not lost.  The spirits are still with us.

text.title: 诱饵
text.objectives: 克莉斯塔萨要你在考达拉一带收集10块晶化法力碎片。$B$B如果你把奥术牢笼弄丢了，可以去找永生之盾的莱洛拉斯。
text.description: 我在被囚禁期间了解到很多玛里苟斯的情况。在命运的推动下，我们终于有机会用这些情报来对抗他。$B$B在魔枢的上方盘旋着一条强大的蓝龙，莎拉苟萨。她既是玛里苟斯的护卫，也是他的配偶。如果有严重的威胁逼近，她就会警告她的主人。$B$B我在被囚禁的日子里可没少吃莎拉苟萨的苦头，现在她的末日就要来临了。但首先，我们要准备一个绝妙的诱饵……
text.progress: Have you gathered the mana shards I require?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I am drained from the effects of my confinement and my strength is returning ever so slowly. I shall use the power from these crystals wisely. They are a byproduct of Malygos' malevolent schemes. With luck, they will play a part in his undoing.
text.completed: Speak to Keristrasza at Coldarra in Borean Tundra. If you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.

english.title: Bait and Switch
english.objectives: Keristrasza has asked you to collect 10 Crystalized Mana Shards from around Coldarra.$b$bIf you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: During my captivity I was able to learn much about Malygos. Fate now allows us to use this knowledge against him.$b$bThere is a great blue dragon, Saragosa, who circles high above the Nexus. She serves both as the aspect's guardian and as his consort. If any serious threats arise, she alerts her master of the danger.$b$bI suffered greatly at the hand of Saragosa during my captivity, and now her time to die has come. First, however, we must fashion the perfect bait....
english.progress: Have you gathered the mana shards I require?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. I am drained from the effects of my confinement and my strength is returning ever so slowly. I shall use the power from these crystals wisely. They are a byproduct of Malygos' malevolent schemes. With luck, they will play a part in his undoing.
english.completed: Speak to Keristrasza at Coldarra in Borean Tundra. If you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: Slay the Frigid Lieutenant summoned from the Ice Stone located in the cave underneath Firewatch Ridge in the northwest of Searing Gorge, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
text.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bFirewatch Ridge in Searing Gorge is an established bastion of Twilight Cult activity. Recently, they have been using ice stones in the cave to communicate with the Tidehunter's realm, much like they do in Silithus. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's lieutenants and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
text.progress: You have returned victorious?
text.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

In the north, they have been using new ice stones to communicate with the Tidehunter's realm. text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 前往地狱火半岛的黑暗之门，杀死从寒冰之石中召唤出来的冰川圣殿骑士，然后返回任意主城中的大地之环长者处复命。
text.description: 我们必须采取行动，维系平衡！时间非常紧迫。$B$B暮光教徒在德拉诺世界的黑暗之门附近建立了营地，利用寒冰之石与冰霜之王交流。虽然我很不情愿这样做，但是灵魂会理解的——你必须召唤并杀死埃霍恩手下的一员军官。或许这样就能阻止暮光教徒的阴谋……
text.progress: You have returned victorious?
text.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

english.title: Striking Back
english.objectives: Slay the Glacial Templar summoned from the Ice Stone located near the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula, then return to the Earthen Ring Elder in a capital city.
english.description: We must act to preserve the balance! Time is against us.$b$bIn order to ensure Ahune's success, the cult has established a base near the Dark Portal itself in Draenor. They use ice stones to coordinate the frost lord's arrival. Much as I am loath to do this, the spirits will understand - you must summon one of this Ahune's templar protectors and destroy it. Perhaps this forestalling action will be enough...
english.progress: You have returned victorious?
english.completion: You have done well. It may seem a small act, but even this can aid the fight as a whole. Take this with my blessing, and return later, as I may have more for you to do.
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

text.title: 冰霜之王埃霍恩
text.objectives: 前往赞加沼泽盘牙水库的奴隶围栏，与努玛·云女谈一谈。
text.description: 我相信你有能力帮助我们解除迫在眉睫的危机。$B$B绝不能让暮光教徒与纳迦异教徒的阴谋得逞。为了艾泽拉斯世界和所有无辜的生灵，我们必须采取行动。前方的道路已经明朗，你要立即动身前往盘牙水库深处的奴隶围栏，与我们的萨满祭司会面。去吧，抓紧时间！
text.completion: Thank the spirits you're here! We must summon Ahune quickly before it's too late...

english.title: Ahune, the Frost Lord
english.objectives: Travel to the Slave Pens in Coilfang Reservoir within Zangarmarsh and speak with Numa Cloudsister.
english.description: I believe you are strong enough for the ultimate task set before us.$b$bWe cannot allow the plot between the Twilight Cult and the naga heretics of Neptulon to come to fruition. For the sake of Azeroth and all life upon it, we must act. Our path is clear. You must journey to the Slave Pens deep within Coilfang Reservoir and meet with our shaman there. Go, and quickly!
english.completion: Thank the spirits you're here! We must summon Ahune quickly before it's too late...

text.title: 寻找护命匣
text.objectives: 前往死亡营地，骑着黄昏找到塔纳沙尔藏匿护命匣的地方。将它找出来并带回悲叹通灵塔，交给萨萨里安。
text.description: 没时间说别的了，$N。我被派来执行一项自杀式的任务，要我们占领这座通灵塔。我已经完成了作为一个士兵的义务，现在，我要去寻求一些答案。$B$B这只巫妖掌握着许多我希望知道的情报，但我却无法对他造成任何伤害。$B$B这只巫妖将他的灵魂封在了一个护命匣中，藏在了其它地方。只要找不到那个护命匣，我就拿他一点办法都没有。$B$B所以，你得立刻回到营地去，骑上我的战马“黄昏”，它会带你去找到护命匣，把它带回来给我。
text.progress: You're back, $n.  Did you get the phylactery?
text.completion: Just in time, $n.  Pinning down a lich is not as easy as it looks.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Finding the Phylactery
english.objectives: Go to Death's Stand and ride Dusk to the location of Tanathal's Phylactery.  Obtain it and bring it back to Thassarian inside the Wailing Ziggurat.
english.description: No time for small talk, $N.  I was sent on what was to be a suicide mission to take this ziggurat.  I've accomplished my duty as a soldier, now is the time to get some answers.$B$BThis lich has knowledge I seek, yet I cannot inflict pain to his physical body to obtain that knowledge.$B$BThe lich stored his soul in a phylactery, and while it remains hidden, I won't be able to pry the information from him.$B$BReturn to the camp and take my horse, Dusk, she will lead you to the phylactery.  Bring it to me.
english.progress: You're back, $n.  Did you get the phylactery?
english.completion: Just in time, $n.  Pinning down a lich is not as easy as it looks.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 莎拉苟萨的末日
text.objectives: 克莉斯塔萨要你使用奥术能量源引出莎拉苟萨并打败她。
text.description: Using the mana crystals you provided, I have created this Power Focus.$b$bSaragosa is a glutton. She will be unable to resist its lure. Inside it lie magics that will greatly diminish her power. Let us hope she does not see through my ruse....$b$bPrepare yourself, $n, and speak to me again when you are ready to face Saragosa.$B$B
text.progress: Saragosa must not be allowed to live!
text.completion: This world is a better place now that Saragosa is no more, but our work is not yet finished. The time has come to strike at Malygos himself!
text.completed: Return to Keristrasza at Coldarra in Borean Tundra. If you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.

english.title: Saragosa's End
english.objectives: Keristrasza wants you to use the Power Focus to lure Saragosa, and then defeat her.
english.description: Using the mana crystals you provided, I have created this Power Focus.$b$bSaragosa is a glutton. She will be unable to resist its lure. Inside it lie magics that will greatly diminish her power. Let us hope she does not see through my ruse....$b$bPrepare yourself, $n, and speak to me again when you are ready to face Saragosa.$B$B
english.progress: Saragosa must not be allowed to live!
english.completion: This world is a better place now that Saragosa is no more, but our work is not yet finished. The time has come to strike at Malygos himself!
english.completed: Return to Keristrasza at Coldarra in Borean Tundra. If you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.

text.title: 不要浪费
text.objectives: 从狼獾人手中夺回6份被偷走的莫亚基货物，把它们带回龙骨荒野的莫亚基港口，交给长者库纳尼。
text.description: 狼獾人一直是我们的天敌。不过随着你们的人大量涌入龙骨荒野，他们已经被逼到了北面的一小块林地里。$B$B今早的地震过后，他们的攻击性变得更强了。到现在，他们已经劫走了我们好几批货物……那都是我们迁徙途中的必需品。$B$B为了证实你的善意和友好，请从飘雪林地的狼獾人那里夺回我们的货物。
text.progress: The natural balance has been tipped over and over of late. I hope that you will be able to help us survive the upheaval of our way of life.
text.completion: I will not say that I am pleased to ask you to do such things on our behalf. It is all we can do to prepare quickly for our departure, though we know not yet where we go. My sorcerers tell me that you are here to save the land from He Who Walks in Shadow. I trust that you will save the peoples of the land as well.
text.completed: Return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Let Nothing Go To Waste
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Stolen Moa'ki Goods from the wolvar. Return them to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: The wolvar have always been our natural enemies. But the incursion of your peoples into the Great Dragonblight has forced them into a small space upon the glade to the north.$B$BCombined with the land's upheaval this morning, they have become even more aggressive than ever before. They have made several raids upon our goods... things that we'll need if we are to survive the trek from our home here.$B$BAs a sign of good faith and friendship, retrieve our goods from the Snowfall Glade wolvar.
english.progress: The natural balance has been tipped over and over of late. I hope that you will be able to help us survive the upheaval of our way of life.
english.completion: I will not say that I am pleased to ask you to do such things on our behalf. It is all we can do to prepare quickly for our departure, though we know not yet where we go. My sorcerers tell me that you are here to save the land from He Who Walks in Shadow. I trust that you will save the peoples of the land as well.
english.completed: Return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 消灭洛根
text.objectives: 将洛根的血抹在身上，然后回到龙骨荒野的莫亚基港口，向长者库纳尼复命。
text.description: 情况越来越糟糕了。现在只有一个办法……虽然很遗憾，但我们必须杀了洛根！$B$B他是飘雪林地部族的首领，一个残忍的狼獾人。这是让他们暂停劫掠的唯一办法了。$B$B他的茅屋就在林地的北部，这个“金刚狼”应该就站在自己的房前。他的房子比其他狼獾人的都大，你不会认错的。去杀死他，将他的鲜血抹在身上，以显示你的强大和高贵。
text.progress: Is that Loguhn's blood or your own, $r?
text.completion: Loguhn's honorable sacrifice at your hands is exactly what my people need. Now we will make the most of the wolvar in-fighting for his place. It will have to be enough.
text.completed: Return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Slay Loguhn
english.objectives: Smear the Blood of Loguhn upon yourself and then return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: Already it goes from bad to worse. There is only one course to take... regrettably, Loguhn must die!$B$BHe's the alpha male of the Snowfall Glade tribe and one mean wolvar. But it's the only way to get a short break from their attacks and stealing forays.$B$BYou will find the "Render of Flesh" in front of his hovel upon the northern rise of the glade. It's larger than the others and hard to miss. Kill him and smear his blood upon yourself, both to show your dominance and respect.
english.progress: Is that Loguhn's blood or your own, $r?
english.completion: Loguhn's honorable sacrifice at your hands is exactly what my people need. Now we will make the most of the wolvar in-fighting for his place. It will have to be enough.
english.completed: Return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 未来的种子
text.objectives: 收集12只飘雪林地幼崽，把它们交给莫亚基港口的猎手莫伊。
text.description: 如果我们想要生存下去，就必须对狼獾人采取果断行动了。但我担心我们的狂热会导致残酷的屠杀。$B$B飘雪林地的狼獾人和我们一样拥有生存的权利。我们要确保他们能得到生存下去的机会。$B$B就算长者库纳尼现在还没有提出，迟早他也会让你去解决他们的。当你前往北面的林地时，请你把他们的幼崽带回来。
text.progress: How many pups could you have possibly saved in so short a time?
text.completion: Well, I guess you saved plenty of them. Thank you, $r. Now the wolvar will have a chance of surviving along with us. If we survive at all, that is. Do you think that you could return tomorrow so that we can save more of the pups?
text.completed: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Planning for the Future
english.objectives: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$B$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$B$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.
english.progress: How many pups could you have possibly saved in so short a time?
english.completion: Well, I guess you saved plenty of them. Thank you, $r. Now the wolvar will have a chance of surviving along with us. If we survive at all, that is. Do you think that you could return tomorrow so that we can save more of the pups?
english.completed: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 神灵的眷顾
text.objectives: 尼约德海湾的长者穆希特要你潜入水中找到伊鲁克的尸体，取回伊斯利鲁克的图腾。
text.description: 拥有强大力量的灵魂守护着海象人的氏族，卡斯卡拉是不会沦陷的。$B$B伊斯利鲁克赐予我们勇气，塔尤卡为幸存的族人提供食物和避难所，卡库特则负责守护亡魂并确保他们不会迷失方向。$B$B眼下我们迫切需要伊斯利鲁克的指引。我本来派了我的侄子伊鲁克去取回伊斯利鲁克的图腾，但是他不幸被克瓦迪尔的长矛刺穿，倒在北边的海水中。$N，替我取回图腾。别让我的侄子就这么白白搭上一条性命。
text.progress: The totem, $r.  Do you have it?
text.completion: Can you feel Issliruk's presence, $n?  He does not want his children to perish at the hand of the mist-walkers.
text.completed: Return to Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Spirits Watch Over Us
english.objectives: Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay wants you to find Iruk's corpse in the water and retrieve Issliruk's totem.
english.description: Powerful spirits watch over my tribe -- Kaskala will not be lost.$B$BIssliruk will give us courage, Tayutka will make sure our survivors always have food and shelter and Karkut will watch over the fallen so they do not lose their way.$B$BIssliruk's guidance is the one we need the most right now.  I asked my nephew, Iruk, to bring me Issliruk's totem, but the Kvaldir's spears struck him down and his body fell into the waters to the north.  Bring me the totem, $N.  Don't let my nephew's death be in vain.
english.progress: The totem, $r.  Do you have it?
english.completion: Can you feel Issliruk's presence, $n?  He does not want his children to perish at the hand of the mist-walkers.
english.completed: Return to Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 最后一批矿石
text.objectives: 将一箱致远郡矿石交给无畏要塞里的希尔达·熔石。
text.description: 那么，有了你带回来的矿石，我们总算能凑齐足够的物资送往无畏要塞了。$B$B如果致远郡从艾泽拉斯的版图上消失，至少人们会记住，我们是第一批站出来保卫自己土地的人，也是最后一批倒下的人。$B$B把这些矿石交给希尔达·熔石——她是我的好朋友。让她用这些矿石制造一些精良的武器，我们很快就会需要大量武器了。
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: Ore from Farshire?  We weren't scheduled for a shipment just yet.  Is something wrong?
text.completed: Return to Hilda Stoneforge at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

english.title: One Last Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Farshire Ore to Hilda Stoneforge in Valiance Keep.
english.description: That's it then.  With the last of the ore you salvaged we now have enough to send to Valiance Keep.$B$BIf Farshire is wiped off the face of Azeroth, then at least let us be remembered as the first ones to defend our land and the last ones to give up.$B$BTake this ore to Hilda Stoneforge - she is a good friend of mine.  Tell her to make some good weapons with this ore.  We'll need plenty of them in the days to come.
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: Ore from Farshire?  We weren't scheduled for a shipment just yet.  Is something wrong?
english.completed: Return to Hilda Stoneforge at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 给致远郡的武器
text.objectives: 回到致远郡，向吉拉德·格林复命。
text.description: 致远郡濒临陷落，而吉拉德只想着要把矿石给我送来？我发誓，他和我们在前线战斗的所有士兵一样勇敢。$B$B既然这些平民还有抵抗的勇气，我们就不能让他们失去自己的家园。也许我们无法派出军队支援，但可以支援他们一些武器。$B$B这些武器本来是为新兵们打造的，但有了你送来的矿石，我可以另外造一批补上。去告诉吉拉德，他的武器马上送到！
text.completion: Hilda's sending us weapons?  That's excellent news, $n.  I was about ready to tell the lads to pack things up.

english.title: Weapons for Farshire
english.objectives: Return to Gerald Green in Farshire.
english.description: Farshire is overrun and all that Gerald can think of is to get me my ore shipment?  I swear that man has as much heart as any of our soldiers on the frontlines.$B$BWe cannot let the civilians lose their lands if they're willing to fight for them.  We might not have the troops to spare, but we can send them weapons.$B$BThese were earmarked for new recruits, but I'll be able to cover those with the ore you've brought me.  Send word to Gerald that weapons are on the way.
english.completion: Hilda's sending us weapons?  That's excellent news, $n.  I was about ready to tell the lads to pack things up.

text.title: 夏季的焚香
text.objectives: 节日博学者希望你带着夏季焚香前往任意联盟营地外的篝火旁，将焚香交给该处的夏季火元素。
text.description: 每座联盟营地外都设有节日篝火，你知道吗？护火者就驻扎在营地外的帐篷中，确保篝火熊熊燃烧，直到火焰节结束。$B$B每个护火者身边都会有一个夏季火元素，它是火元素之魂派来的使者。$B$B你想不想去祭拜一下这些夏季火元素呢，$N？拿着这把夏季焚香，把它交给任意一个夏季火元素。只要你对这些小家伙表示出足够的敬意，它就会奖赏你。
text.progress: A fiery salutations to you, honored $c.  Welcome to this hallowed ground of the Midsummer Fire Festival.
text.completion: Ah, and what is this?  Such a delightful aroma!  I am sure it will burn with a flame pure and bright! Take this blossom, $n.  Take it, and leave me be... I must attend to this precious fuel...
text.completed: Return to Summer Scorchling.

english.title: Incense for the Summer Scorchlings
english.objectives: The Festival Loremaster wants you to take Summer Incense to a Summer Scorchling outside any Alliance settlement.
english.description: Did you know that our festival fires burn in every land with an Alliance settlement? Flame Wardens tend to them in camps outside of each town, ensuring the bonfires are bright and the celebrations continue.$b$bWith each Flame Warden is a summer scorchling -- an emissary to the elemental spirits of fire.$B$BWould you like to honor a scorchling, $N?  Take this summer incense and bring it to any summer scorchling.  Appease the little fire spirit, and it may reward you.
english.progress: A fiery salutations to you, honored $c.  Welcome to this hallowed ground of the Midsummer Fire Festival.
english.completion: Ah, and what is this?  Such a delightful aroma!  I am sure it will burn with a flame pure and bright! Take this blossom, $n.  Take it, and leave me be... I must attend to this precious fuel...
english.completed: Return to Summer Scorchling.

text.title: 作战公告！
text.objectives: 前往致远郡的议事大厅，敲响里面的钟。
text.description: 现在致远郡有了放手一搏的能力，$N。你做到了我们甚至不敢奢望的事。$B$B现在我们必须集合起来发动进攻。我会让我的人把武器运到镇子的议事大厅里，请你去敲响议事厅里的钟，让所有的幸存者到那里集合。$B$B现在该让天灾军团看看我们的力量了。
text.progress: Have you rallied the survivors, $N?
text.completion: Thanks once again for aiding us, $n.  The people of Farshire will always remember you.
text.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Call to Arms!
english.objectives: Go to the town hall building in Farshire and ring the bell inside of it.
english.description: Farshire has a fighting chance now, $N.  That's all we could've asked for and you've made it possible.$B$BAll we need now is a rallying point.  I'll have my men deliver the weapons to our town hall.  Go and ring the town hall bell so any survivors know to rally there.$B$BIt's time to show the Scourge what we're made of.
english.progress: Have you rallied the survivors, $N?
english.completion: Thanks once again for aiding us, $n.  The people of Farshire will always remember you.
english.completed: Return to Gerald Green at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 节日的焚香
text.objectives: 节日诗人希望你带着夏季焚香前往任意部落营地外的篝火旁，将焚香交给该处的夏季火元素。
text.description: 每座部落营地外都设有节日篝火，你知道吗？护焰者就驻扎在营地外的帐篷中，确保篝火熊熊燃烧，直到火焰节结束。$B$B每个护焰者身边都会有一个夏季火元素，它是火元素之魂派来的使者。$B$B你想不想去祭拜一下这些夏季火元素呢，$N？拿着这把夏季焚香，把它交给任意一个夏季火元素。只要你对这些小家伙表示出足够的敬意，它就会奖赏你。
text.progress: A fiery salutations to you, honored $c.  Welcome to this hallowed ground of the Midsummer Fire Festival.
text.completion: Ah, and what is this?  Such a delightful aroma!  I am sure it will burn with a flame pure and bright! Take this blossom, $n.  Take it, and leave me be... I must attend to this precious fuel...
text.completed: Return to Festival Scorchling.

english.title: Incense for the Festival Scorchlings
english.objectives: The Festival Talespinner wants you to take Summer Incense to a Festival Scorchling outside any Horde settlement.
english.description: Did you know that our festival fires burn in every land with a Horde settlement? Flame Keepers tend to them in camps outside of each town, ensuring the bonfires are bright and the celebrations continue.$b$bWith each Flame Keeper is a festival scorchling -- an emissary to the elemental spirits of fire.$B$BWould you like to honor a scorchling, $N?  Take this summer incense and bring it to any festival scorchling.  Appease the little fire spirit, and it may reward you.
english.progress: A fiery salutations to you, honored $c.  Welcome to this hallowed ground of the Midsummer Fire Festival.
english.completion: Ah, and what is this?  Such a delightful aroma!  I am sure it will burn with a flame pure and bright! Take this blossom, $n.  Take it, and leave me be... I must attend to this precious fuel...
english.completed: Return to Festival Scorchling.

text.title: 集结红龙
text.objectives: 克莉斯塔萨要你带她去永生之盾会见莱洛拉斯。
text.description: 玛里苟斯肯定已经发现情况有些不对劲了。$B$B我了解他。他的精神很难集中。我敢肯定，如果他知道他那亲爱的莎拉苟萨出了什么事，肯定会不顾危险地从他的领地里冲出来。$B$B立刻带我去见莱洛拉斯，$N。他必须调集所有的龙来对抗玛里苟斯。
text.progress: You have news for me, $n?
text.completion: Word of Keristrasza's rescue has reached my ears. You are to be commended. I am eager to speak with her again.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Mustering the Reds
english.objectives: Keristrasza has asked you to bring her to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
english.description: Malygos is certainly aware that something is amiss.$b$bI know him. His focus is fragmented. I am confident that I can lure him from the safety of his realm when he learns what has become of his precious Saragosa.$b$bTake me to Raelorasz at once, $n. He must rouse every dragon he commands to face Malygos.
english.progress: You have news for me, $n?
english.completion: Word of Keristrasza's rescue has reached my ears. You are to be commended. I am eager to speak with her again.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 情势扭转
text.objectives: 长者穆希特要你去除掉尼约德海湾的可怕的赫迦尔。
text.description: $N，神灵们听到了我们发出的呼喊，卡斯卡拉的局势也许会有所转机。$B$B趁着浓雾潜入尼约德海湾，除掉克瓦迪尔部族的首领。只要他一死，我们就能稳占上风。
text.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: You've done us a great favor, $r.  The fight is not yet won, but my people now have a chance.
text.completed: Return to Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay in Borean Tundra.

english.title: The Tides Turn
english.objectives: Elder Muahit wants you to kill Heigarr the Horrible in Njord's Breath Bay.
english.description: The spirits have heard our cry for help, $N.  It's a sign that Kaskala might yet be saved.$B$BTake advantage of the confusion the weather has created and slay the Kvaldir leader.  Your actions will sway the battle in our favor, I am sure of it.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: You've done us a great favor, $r.  The fight is not yet won, but my people now have a chance.
english.completed: Return to Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 触动陷阱
text.objectives: 莱洛拉斯要你在考达拉的信号火焰处使用莱洛拉斯的火花。
text.description: 多亏了你的帮助，我们才能得到这个机会，$N。$B$B所以应该由你来发动对玛里苟斯的攻势。$B$B前往魔枢的西北入口处，用这种火花点燃那里的信号火焰。克莉斯塔萨会与你并肩作战的。
text.progress: Did you meet with Keristrasza?
text.completion: We have dealt a blow to Malygos, but it has come at a high price.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Springing the Trap
english.objectives: Raelorasz wants you to use Raelorasz' Spark at the signal fire in Coldarra.
english.description: We owe this opportunity in great part to your efforts, $n.$b$bIt is only fitting that you initiate the attack on Malygos.$b$bTake this spark and use it to light the signal fire northwest of the Nexus. Keristrasza will direct you from there.
english.progress: Did you meet with Keristrasza?
english.completion: We have dealt a blow to Malygos, but it has come at a high price.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 节日博学者
text.objectives: 与任意联盟主城的节日博学者谈一谈。
text.description: 火焰节是欢笑玩乐的时节，这固然没错，但是了解火焰节的历史也非常重要。对知识的渴求应该得到满足。$B$B联盟主城的节日博学者可以解答你的疑问。去拜访他吧。
text.completion: I'll be happy to tell you what I know.

english.title: The Master of Summer Lore
english.objectives: Speak to the Festival Loremaster in any Alliance capital.
english.description: The festival is a time for fun and laughter, there's no mistake. It's important, however, that you understand the origins of this holiday. Education should be sought out and savored.$b$bThe Festival Loremaster in the Alliance capitals can guide your way. Go now and learn.
english.completion: I'll be happy to tell you what I know.

text.title: 节日诗人
text.objectives: 与任意部落主城的节日诗人谈一谈。
text.description: 火焰节是欢笑玩乐的时节，这固然没错，但是了解火焰节的历史也非常重要。对知识的渴求应该得到满足。$B$B部落主城的节日诗人可以解答你的疑问。去拜访他吧。
text.completion: I'd be happy to tell you what I know.
