english.objectives: Speak to the Festival Talespinner in any Horde capital.
english.description: The festival is a time for fun and laughter, there's no mistake. It's important, however, that you understand the origins of this holiday. Education should be sought out and savored.$b$bThe Festival Talespinner in the Horde capitals can guide your way. Go now and learn.
english.completion: I'd be happy to tell you what I know.

text.title: 埃霍恩的碎片
text.objectives: 将寒冰碎片交给鲁玛·天母。
text.description: 碎片跳动着，透露出不祥的征兆。难道其中蕴含着冰霜领主的精华？
text.progress: Greetings, $n.  You look worried, but you shoud rejoice.  The Frost Lord is defeated!
text.completion: Yes, these shards hold the final essence of the Frost Lord in this land.  We will dispose of them and banish Ahune to the nether regions of cold. Thank you, $n.  Your name will echo in the chants of the Earthen Ring for days without end.  Please honor us by accepting this vestige, a symbol of your kinship with warmth and light.
text.completed: Return to Luma Skymother in the Slave Pens.

english.title: Shards of Ahune
english.objectives: Bring the Ice Shards to Luma Skymother.
english.description: These shards pulse with foreboding.  Do they hold the last essence of the Frost Lord?
english.progress: Greetings, $n.  You look worried, but you shoud rejoice.  The Frost Lord is defeated!
english.completion: Yes, these shards hold the final essence of the Frost Lord in this land.  We will dispose of them and banish Ahune to the nether regions of cold. Thank you, $n.  Your name will echo in the chants of the Earthen Ring for days without end.  Please honor us by accepting this vestige, a symbol of your kinship with warmth and light.
english.completed: Return to Luma Skymother in the Slave Pens.

text.title: 战争的囚徒
text.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and release Keristrasza.
text.description: Malygos has taken Keristrasza to serve as his consort!? Unthinkable!$b$bShe'll never cooperate willingly, but Malygos is a powerful aspect, and will eventually bend her will.$b$bThis cannot come to pass, $n. I refuse to allow her to suffer this indignity.$b$bYou must enter the Nexus and do whatever is required to spare her this fate.
text.completion: So, it is done then.... Our kind shall never forget the sacrifice Keristrasza has made for this cause. Nor shall we forget the part you have played, $n. May this tragic event serve to further steel our resolve against the threat we face. On behalf of the Red Dragonflight, please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Prisoner of War
english.objectives: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and release Keristrasza.
english.description: Malygos has taken Keristrasza to serve as his consort!? Unthinkable!$b$bShe'll never cooperate willingly, but Malygos is a powerful aspect, and will eventually bend her will.$b$bThis cannot come to pass, $n. I refuse to allow her to suffer this indignity.$b$bYou must enter the Nexus and do whatever is required to spare her this fate.

May this tragic event serve to further steel our resolve against the threat we face. On behalf of the Red Dragonflight, please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: [ph] Now, When I Grow Up...
text.objectives: Take your orphan, Salandria, to see L70ETC in Silvermoon City's Walk of Elder's.  Make sure to call for her if she is not present when you arrive.
text.description: When you were my age did you know that you wanted to be a $c when you grew up?$B$BI'm not sure what I want to be.  I used to want to be a Blood Knight, but not anymore.  Now I want to be a Rock Star!  Like the blood elf in L70 ETC!$B$BWhen they aren't touring, they hang out in Silvermoon City! Could you take me there? They hang out in the Walk of Elder's on a balcony... Probably to keep the fans away  But that shouldn't stop us from trying, right?$B$BPlease take me there.  Please!
text.end: Salandria visits L70ETC in Silvermoon City
text.completed: Return to Blood Elf Orphan.

They hang out in the Walk of Elder's on a balcony... Probably to keep the fans away  But that shouldn't stop us from trying, right?$B$BPlease take me there.  Please!
english.end: Salandria visits L70ETC in Silvermoon City
english.completed: Return to Blood Elf Orphan.

text.title: Now, When I Grow Up...
text.objectives: 带你的孤儿，萨兰德里亚，看看银月城长者之行中的精英牛头人酋长。如果您到达时不在场，请务必打电话给她。
text.description: Maybe I already asked you this, but when you were my age did you know that you wanted to be a $c when you grew up?$B$BI'm not sure what I want to be.  Maybe a mage or a warlock or a Blood Knight, like I said before?  Or maybe... A rock star!!  Like Sig Nicious, the blood elf, in the Elite Tauren Chieftain!$B$BI heard that when they aren't touring, they hang out in Silvermoon City!  They just sit on a balcony in the Walk of Elders waiting for people to stop by.$B$BPlease take me there.  Please!
text.completion: Did you see that?  They were cheering for me!! Now I know how they feel when they are up on stage singing!  I felt the power and the energy! Just like they say in their song! My mind is made up, I am going to be a rock star when I grow up!
text.end: Take Salandria to visit the Elite Tauren Chieftain in Silvermoon City.
text.completed: Return to Blood Elf Orphan.

They just sit on a balcony in the Walk of Elders waiting for people to stop by.$B$BPlease take me there.  Please!

text.description: 碎片跳动着，透露出不祥的征兆。难道其中蕴含着冰霜领主的精华？
text.completed: Return to Luma Skymother at Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Ice Shards
english.objectives: Bring the Ice Shards to Luma Skymother.
english.description: These shards pulse with foreboding.  Do they hold the last essence of the Frost Lord?
english.completed: Return to Luma Skymother at Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 牦牛人中的牛头人
text.objectives: 在西风避难营内找到特使艾米萨·闪蹄。
text.description: 在西风避难营内找到特使艾米萨·闪蹄。
text.completion: What you see here is all that remains of the taunka from the Borean Tundra and the Dragonblight. They are a broken people... battered and brought to the brink of extinction by the Scourge. Only the Horde can save them now. Only the Horde can mend their broken spirits. We will nurse them back to full health and they will in turn strengthen the Horde in Northrend.

english.title: A Tauren Among Taunka
english.objectives: Seek out Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp.
english.description: <Wartook points northeast.>$B$BShe is quite kind, you know. If it were not for your emissary, the surviving refugees may have given up hope. While she may not be taunka by birthright, the tribe has taken to her as a village elder for the time being.$B$BIf you are who I think you are, please go and pay Emissary Brighthoof a visit inside the refugee camp. She has been waiting for you.
english.completion: What you see here is all that remains of the taunka from the Borean Tundra and the Dragonblight. They are a broken people... battered and brought to the brink of extinction by the Scourge. Only the Horde can save them now. Only the Horde can mend their broken spirits. We will nurse them back to full health and they will in turn strengthen the Horde in Northrend.

text.title: 深入密林
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野西风避难营的特使艾米萨·闪蹄要求你找回10套部落军备。
text.description: 在正式将牦牛人引入部落之前，我们得先把附近森林里那些阿努巴尔蛛魔夺走的东西抢回来。昨天深夜里，阿格玛之锤过来的一支补给车队遭到了天灾军团的伏击，武器装备都被抢走了。$B$B去吧，进入西风避难营东边的森林，夺回我们的武器装备，$R。
text.progress: Without armor and weapons our newest members will be defenseless in their trek to Agmar's Hammer.
text.completion: This is exactly what we need, $n! Brandishing Horde arms will lift their spirits and give them the protection they need against the Scourge. Are you prepared for the ceremony of initiation? You will be the one to admit our new allies into the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

english.title: Into the Fold
english.objectives: Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in the Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 Horde Armaments.
english.description: Before we can officially bring these taunka into the Horde we must recover our armaments from the Anub'ar Nerubians that infest the nearby woods. The armaments were lost when a caravan from Agmar's Hammer was ambushed by the Scourge late last night.$B$BVenture out into the woods to the east of Westwind Refugee Camp and recover those armaments, $r.
english.progress: Without armor and weapons our newest members will be defenseless in their trek to Agmar's Hammer.
english.completion: This is exactly what we need, $n! Brandishing Horde arms will lift their spirits and give them the protection they need against the Scourge. Are you prepared for the ceremony of initiation? You will be the one to admit our new allies into the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

text.title: 牦牛人和牛头人
text.objectives: 在西风避难营内找到特使艾米萨·闪蹄。
text.description: 牦牛人部族的首都冰雾村目前已经被天灾军团占领并控制了！所有躲过那次大屠杀、得以幸运逃出的牦牛人难民都在部落的保护之下，在龙骨荒野西部边界上的西风避难营避难。$B$B地狱咆哮大人坚信，这些牦牛人为了生存下去，一定会选择加入部落，他已经派出一名特使到西风避难营去巩固我们与牦牛人之间的关系了。立刻前往西风避难营，找到特使艾米萨·闪蹄。看看你能帮上她什么忙。
text.completion: What you see here is all that remains of the taunka from the Borean Tundra and the Dragonblight. They are a broken people... battered and brought to the brink of extinction. Only the Horde can save them now. Only the Horde can mend their broken spirits. We will nurse them back to full health and they will in turn strengthen the Horde in Northrend.

english.title: The Taunka and the Tauren
english.objectives: Seek out Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp.$B$B
english.description: The Scourge have seized control of the capital city of the taunka, Icemist Village! All living taunka that escaped the massacre are being held in protective custody at the Westwind Refugee Camp on the western border of Dragonblight.$B$BLord Hellscream believes that the taunka must join the Horde if they are to survive and has sent a tauren emissary to Westwind to bolster our relationship with the winter tauren. Travel to Westwind Refugee Camp and seek out Emissary Brighthoof. You will assist her.
english.completion: What you see here is all that remains of the taunka from the Borean Tundra and the Dragonblight. They are a broken people... battered and brought to the brink of extinction. Only the Horde can save them now. Only the Horde can mend their broken spirits. We will nurse them back to full health and they will in turn strengthen the Horde in Northrend.

text.title: 部落的荣耀
text.objectives: Blood Guard Roh'kill at the Westwind Refugee Camp in the Dragonblight wants you to slay 15 Anub'ar Ambushers.$B$B
text.description: I was one of the guards chosen to escort the caravan carrying the armament shipment to this camp. The attack came fast and without warning. We fought and killed dozens of the beasts, but in the end there were simply too many. Tor'zin and I barely made it out alive...$B$BIf not for our injuries we would be out in the woods hunting down those fiends ourselves. Will you help us regain our lost pride? Search the woods east of here for Anub'ar Nerubians and kill them! For the Horde!
text.progress: Show no mercy, $r.  Slay the Anub'ar!
text.completion: You have preserved our honor, $n. Tor'zin and I both thank you for this selfless act!
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Roh'kill at Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

We fought and killed dozens of the beasts, but in the end there were simply too many. Search the woods east of here for Anub'ar Nerubians and kill them! For the Horde!
english.progress: Show no mercy, $r.  Slay the Anub'ar!
english.completion: You have preserved our honor, $n. Tor'zin and I both thank you for this selfless act!
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Roh'kill at Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

text.title: 找到库伦！
text.objectives: 前往俯瞰索尔莫丹的丘陵地带，在那里找到库伦。
text.description: 这位土灵战士的石质皮肤的表面上密密麻麻地分布着无数的创伤与龟裂。尽管没有任何血液流淌出来，但你仍然能感觉到生命的气息正在他身上飞速地消逝。$B$B他似乎是感觉到了你的存在，一阵低沉而嘶哑的声音从这位濒死的战士口中传了出来：$B$B“去找……库伦……你一定要……去找……库伦。”$B$B他无助地看着你，而你则急切地开始思考“库伦”又是谁。$B$B幸运的是，他在最终逝世之前还是告诉了你有关“库伦”这个名字的线索，“我们的……领袖……他就在……那座……俯瞰着索尔莫丹的……山上……指挥着我们。请……告诉他……我们……没能夺回……城市……”
text.completion: They fight bravely, but he is right. We will not overcome the iron dwarves of Thor Modan without help. My giants and the Earthen have long struggled against iron's evil, but our forces are not numerous enough to win the battle for Thor Modan. Will you aid us?

english.title: Find Kurun!
english.objectives: Speak with Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.
english.description: The Earthen warrior's stone surface is covered with cracks and gouges. Although it is incapable of bleeding, you can sense that the warrior is near death.$B$BA low, hoarse voice escapes from the dying warrior's mouth.$B$B"Find... Kurun... you must find... Kurun."$B$BIt looks at you helplessly as you ask for any clues as to who or what Kurun might be.$B$B"Our... leader... he stands on the... hill overlooking Thor Modan... commands us. Please... tell him... we cannot take... the city... "
english.completion: They fight bravely, but he is right. We will not overcome the iron dwarves of Thor Modan without help. My giants and the Earthen have long struggled against iron's evil, but our forces are not numerous enough to win the battle for Thor Modan. Will you aid us?

text.title: 巨石横飞
text.objectives: 在丘陵上俯瞰索尔莫丹的库伦要求你向索尔莫丹的露天区域投掷石块，以此骚扰铁矮人的挖掘工作。
text.description: 我们下方就是铁矮人自古以来的领地——索尔莫丹。几千年前，石巨人踏裂了大地，将那座地底城市的一部分永远掩埋在了坍塌的山石之下，另一部分则暴露出了地表，几近毁灭。$B$B然而，直到今天，那些铁矮人仍在试图夺回他们过去的王城，但我们绝不会允许。我手下的巨人们每天都在用巨岩与碎石填补着他们挖出来的沟壑，希望能阻止他们的进犯，让他们永远放弃这里。你也带上一些巨石到东北方的沟壑边去，帮助我们彻底毁灭敌人的顽抗吧。
text.progress: What have you to report?
text.completion: As quickly as we're able to fill the trench, the iron dwarves keep clearing it. Our assault from above will not take the city alone. You must aid the earthen fighting in the plaza below.
text.completed: Return to Kurun at Boulder Hills in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Raining Down Destruction
english.objectives: Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan wants you to disrupt the iron dwarves' work by throwing boulders into the exposed area of Thor Modan.
english.description: Beneath us is iron's ancient bastion, Thor Modan. Thousands of years ago, the stone giants tore the land asunder, collapsing part of the city and exposing much of the rest.$B$BEven now, the iron dwarves attempt to reclaim their old capital, but we will not permit it. My giants fill the trench with boulders and debris, hoping to seal it off and kill the servants of iron as they work. Take up the boulders you see near the trench to the northeast, and help us put an end to their efforts.
english.progress: What have you to report?
english.completion: As quickly as we're able to fill the trench, the iron dwarves keep clearing it. Our assault from above will not take the city alone. You must aid the earthen fighting in the plaza below.
english.completed: Return to Kurun at Boulder Hills in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 部落的血誓
text.objectives: 与西风避难营的牛头人交谈，并收集5份他们对部落的效忠宣誓书。$B$B完成任务之后，带着部落的血誓向特使艾米萨·闪蹄复命。
text.description: 他们已经准备好了，$N。这些牦牛人迫切地希望加入部落，并愿意倾尽全力向亡灵天灾复仇。$B$B<特使掏出了一封印有部落徽记的羊皮卷，郑重地递给了你。>$B$B这封卷轴上写着部落的血誓。根据我们古老而高贵的传统，牦牛人兄弟姐妹们将跟随着一位引导人念出卷轴上面所载的神圣誓言，从而完成加入部落的仪式。$B$B去吧，将这个卷轴交给他们，让牦牛人们宣誓加入部落，指挥官。完成你在仪式中的职责之后，再回来找我。
text.progress: They will strengthen the Horde, commander.
text.completion: Thank you for doing this, Commander $n. They had nothing left. You have given them purpose and with purpose comes hope... Hope for a new tomorrow... for a new life.
text.completed: Return to Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

english.title: Blood Oath of the Horde
english.objectives: Speak to the taunka at Westwind Refugee Camp and make 5 of them pledge their allegiance to the Horde.$B$BReturn the Blood Oath of the Horde to Emissary Brighthoof once you have completed this task.
english.description: They are ready, $N. These taunka will all willingly join the Horde and give all that they have to see the Scourge driven from this world.$B$B<Brighthoof hands you a scroll bearing the insignia of the Horde.>$B$BWithin this scroll you will find the blood oath of the Horde. Tradition dictates that our new taunka brothers and sisters utter the sacred words herein.$B$BTake the scroll and swear the taunka into the Horde, commander. Return the scroll to me when you have completed your duty.
english.progress: They will strengthen the Horde, commander.
english.completion: Thank you for doing this, Commander $n. They had nothing left. You have given them purpose and with purpose comes hope... Hope for a new tomorrow... for a new life.
english.completed: Return to Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in Dragonblight.

text.title: 抓巨魔
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的萨米尔希望你对被巴德打昏的达卡莱巨魔使用赏金猎人的笼子。
text.description: 老巴德以前也风光过。$B$B不过从我们来到幽魂之地开始，他就完全帮不上忙了。很多时候我们只能靠自己，而今天，我们就打算把冰巨魔卖给出价最高的人。$B$B幸运的是，我们最近又帮巴德找了个差事。以他的“条件”，他可以很轻易地混入本地的巨魔之中，所以我们只要教他一点小把戏，他就能给我们带来一笔可观的收入。$B$B去和巴德谈谈，把他带去西南方的达克辛废墟，等他标记了某个巨魔之后就使用这只笼子。
text.progress: Have you managed to cage an ice troll?
text.completion: Great work, $c. Looks like we'll be keepin' Budd around a little longer. We'll have your cage picked up right away. Here's your share of the bounty. Oh, and welcome to the camp. Stick around and I'm sure we'll find a use for ya....
text.completed: Return to Samir at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Filling the Cages
english.objectives: Samir at Granite Springs wants you to use the Bounty Hunter's Cage on a drakkari troll that's been stunned by Budd.
english.description: 'Ol Budd's seen better days.$b$bEver since our stay in Ghostlands he's been useless to us. We've had to find ways to make it on our own, and today that means sellin' trolls to the highest bidder.$b$bFortunately, we've recently found a use for Budd. Something about his condition allows him to mingle with the local trolls, so we taught him a little game that's turned us a tidy profit.$b$bSee for yourself. Talk to Budd, take him southwest to Drak' Zin Ruins and use this cage as soon as he tags a troll.
english.progress: Have you managed to cage an ice troll?
english.completion: Great work, $c. Looks like we'll be keepin' Budd around a little longer. We'll have your cage picked up right away. Here's your share of the bounty. Oh, and welcome to the camp. Stick around and I'm sure we'll find a use for ya....
english.completed: Return to Samir at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 勇往直前
text.objectives: 库伦要你杀死指挥官阿格鲁姆，然后返回鸟瞰索尔莫丹的小山坡向他复命。
text.description: 如果不能攻破索尔莫丹的外围防线，那么铁矮人就永远不会投降。土灵战士们正在勇敢地应对着那些钢铁之子造出来的机械，可这些机械的强大与坚韧彻底将他们阻拦在了城市之外。$B$B周围那些可以用于潜入的坑道却又太过狭窄，巨人们完全无法利用，所以，我们的选择很有限。你愿意潜入城市，帮我们除掉指挥防务的矮人军官吗？
text.progress: Were you able to kill the commander?
text.completion: Well done, $n. The loss of the iron dwarf commander should be enough to break the remaining defenders. The Earthen should be able to deal with the survivors.
text.completed: Return to Kurun at Boulder Hills in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Into the Breach
english.objectives: Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan wants you to kill Iron Thane Argrum.
english.description: If we can't overcome the defenders inside Thor Modan, the iron dwarves can hold out forever. The Earthen are bravely taking on the constructs built by the sons of iron, but they cannot break into the city.$B$BThe tunnels narrow too quickly for my fellow giants to be of use, so our options are few. Would you be willing to venture into the city and kill the dwarf commanding the resistance?
english.progress: Were you able to kill the commander?
english.completion: Well done, $n. The loss of the iron dwarf commander should be enough to break the remaining defenders. The Earthen should be able to deal with the survivors.
english.completed: Return to Kurun at Boulder Hills in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 破损的日记
text.objectives: 找到8张遗失的日记书页，将它们与不完整的日记拼凑起来，然后将日记交给月溪旅营地的托尔森·迪普迪格。
text.description: 你翻阅着这本污渍斑斑、残缺不全的日记，发现书页上排着密密麻麻的笔记，还配有图表和地图。$B$B作者的字迹有些眼熟，可一时之间你也想不起是谁，直到你看见一则笔记中留有布莱恩·铜须的名字。$B$B日记的后半部分被撕掉了，无法看到最新的笔记内容。书页散落在战场上，要想知道布莱恩究竟发现了什么，就必须复原这本日记。
text.progress: What's that you have there?
text.completion: You found Brann's journal? Incredible! The league hasn't gotten a report from him in some time, and we began to fear he may have been captured or killed. What did he discover inside Thor Modan?
text.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Damaged Journal
english.objectives: Recover 8 Missing Journal Pages, combine them with the Incomplete Journal, and return the completed journal to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: This battered, mud-stained journal has seen better days. Leafing through the pages, you discover dozens of notes, diagrams, and maps.$B$BThe author's handwriting seems vaguely familiar, but you're unable to place it until you discover an entry signed with the name of Brann Bronzebeard.$B$BThe back half of the book, containing the most recent entries, has been torn away. Pages litter the battlefield, and it will be impossible to know what Brann discovered here until the book is whole again.
english.progress: What's that you have there?
english.completion: You found Brann's journal? Incredible! The league hasn't gotten a report from him in some time, and we began to fear he may have been captured or killed. What did he discover inside Thor Modan?
english.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 符文钥石
text.objectives: 将5块符文钥石碎片交给月溪旅营地的托尔森·迪普迪格。
text.description: 布莱恩在日记中提到，他利用符文钥石来破译雕刻在金属板上的符文。没有那玩意儿的话，我们根本无法参透金属板上的内容。$B$B最后一则笔记写道，铁矮人从布莱恩手中抢走了符文钥石，将它砸成若干块碎片，分别保存起来。我们必须夺回碎片，才能破译符文金属板。索尔莫丹以及附近的建筑物中到处都是矮人，他们可能携带着符文钥石碎片。
text.progress: Do you have enough of the fragments to reconstruct the keystone?
text.completion: This is incomplete, but it should still allow us to get most of the information from the plate.
text.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Runic Keystone
english.objectives: Bring 5 Runic Keystone Fragments to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: Brann's journal mentions that he used a runic keystone to illuminate the important runes on the plate he discovered. Without the keystone, the plate's contents would be little better than gibberish.$B$BAt the end of Brann's last entry, he describes the iron dwarf defenders seizing the keystone from him, shattering it, and dividing it among themselves. Before we can decipher the runed plate, we must hunt down the fragments. Any of the dwarves within Thor Modan or the buildings around it may carry fragments.
english.progress: Do you have enough of the fragments to reconstruct the keystone?
english.completion: This is incomplete, but it should still allow us to get most of the information from the plate.
english.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 停战？
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的达库鲁希望你在他的笼子附近使用钝刻刀，然后和他对话。
text.description: 你给我小心点。$B$B达库鲁已经记不清自己拿到过多少颗$R徽记了——即便能记得，我都不知道该怎么数下去了。对你来说幸运的是，我被关在了这只笼子里，否则我的名单上又会增加一个名字。$B$B不过事情总是在发展的，也许我们可以把彼此之间的分歧暂时放在一边，嗯？$B$B达库鲁知道一些事情，朋友。一些能帮助你的事情。$B$B<达库鲁用他的獠牙割开了手掌，然后把手伸出笼子。>$B$B那么，你怎么想，朋友……让我们定下停战协议，歃血为盟怎么样？
text.progress: Good choice, mon. You won't be livin' to regret it....
text.completion: There! Now we be connected by blood, mon. A true bond we be havin'. You lissen carefully to Drakuru, $r. There be much to do.
text.completed: Return to Drakuru at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Truce?
english.objectives: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to use the Dull Carving Knife near his cage and then speak to him.
english.description: Watch yerself, mon.$b$bDrakuru shrunk more $r heads than I can remember - and even if I could remember, I couldn't count that high. Lucky for you I be stuck in dis cage or I'd be addin' one more to da list.$b$bBut things bein' what they are, mebbe we be puttin' our differences aside fer a time, eh?$b$bDrakuru know things, mon. Things that will aid you in your struggle here.$b$b<Drakuru cuts the palm of his hand on one of his tusks and extends it through the cage.>$b$bSo, what you say, mon... truce?
english.progress: Good choice, mon. You won't be livin' to regret it....
english.completion: There! Now we be connected by blood, mon. A true bond we be havin'. You lissen carefully to Drakuru, $r. There be much to do.
english.completed: Return to Drakuru at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 幻象之瓶
text.objectives: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to bring him an Crystal Vial, a Waterweed Frond, and 3 Haze Leaves.
text.description: 事有轻重缓急，朋友。首先有些准备工作需要去做。$B$B我不知道他们要把我关在这里多久，所以你需要一种强大的药剂让我们保持联络。$B$B你很走运，我正好知道怎么制作那东西，而这附近碰巧又有必需的材料。$B$B我需要一只瓶子——那边的巨魔朋友就有卖，一些生长在这里北面湖泊里面的水草叶，外加几片营地周围就有的薄雾叶。$B$B在他们把我拖走之前，赶紧的，朋友。
text.progress: You got da stuff, mon?
text.completion: This should do it, mon. Now it be time to get to work.
text.completed: Return to Drakuru at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Vial of Visions
english.objectives: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to bring him an Crystal Vial, a Waterweed Frond, and 3 Haze Leaves.
english.description: First things first, mon. There be some preparatory work that need doin'.$b$bNo tellin' how long dey gunna keep me here. Ya be needin' a powerful elixir so we can be keepin' in touch.$b$bLucky for you, I know just the thing! And the ingredients all be close by.$b$bI need a vial from the pretty little troll over there, some waterweed from the lake just north of here, and a few haze leaves found around the camp here.$b$bHurry now, mon, before dey be haulin' me away.
english.progress: You got da stuff, mon?
english.completion: This should do it, mon. Now it be time to get to work.
english.completed: Return to Drakuru at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 解读象形文字
text.objectives: Drakuru wants you to get 5 Frozen Mojo from the Drakkari Trolls at the Ruins of Drak'Zin and then use the elixir at Drakuru's Brazier there.
text.description: A legendary set of artifacts, lost for thousands of years, were created to make Drak'Tharon Keep impervious.$b$bMost think they be myth, but Drakuru knows better, mon!$b$bI nearly discovered where one be, but got captured while interpreting hieroglyphs. Ya gotta summon my soul back dere so I can finish readin' em!$b$bUse my elixir at da brazier on Drak'Zin Ruins, southwest of here. You'll hafta mix in da frozen mojo my bruddas be holdin'. I hate ta see my bruddas fall, but it be for the greater good.$B$B
text.completion: Ahh, yes. Ya done good, mon. I be readin' the walls just fine from here....

english.title: Subject to Interpretation
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to get 5 Frozen Mojo from the Drakkari Trolls at the Ruins of Drak'Zin and then use the elixir at Drakuru's Brazier there.
english.description: A legendary set of artifacts, lost for thousands of years, were created to make Drak'Tharon Keep impervious.$b$bMost think they be myth, but Drakuru knows better, mon!$b$bI nearly discovered where one be, but got captured while interpreting hieroglyphs. Ya gotta summon my soul back dere so I can finish readin' em!$b$bUse my elixir at da brazier on Drak'Zin Ruins, southwest of here. You'll hafta mix in da frozen mojo my bruddas be holdin'. I hate ta see my bruddas fall, but it be for the greater good.$B$B
english.completion: Ahh, yes. Ya done good, mon. I be readin' the walls just fine from here....

text.title: 海图
text.objectives: 将斯卡迪尔海图的缺失部分交给裂鞭海岸的卡鲁克。
text.description: 你在龙皮上发现了海图的一部分。如果能拼凑出完整的海图，或许可以了解克瓦迪尔未来的攻击计划。$B$B裂鞭海岸的水手身上说不定就携带着海图的缺失部分。卡鲁克应该会对上面的内容感兴趣吧。
text.completed: Return to Karuk in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Navigation Charts (Deprecated)
english.objectives: Obtain the missing parts of the Skadir Navigational Chart and bring it to Karuk in Riplash Stand.
english.description: You've uncovered the first part of a navigation chart drawn on flayed dragonskin.  If you could complete it you'd be able to find the kvaldir's future plans of attack.$B$BOther mariners in Riplash might have the missing charts on them.  Karuk would be interested in the information they contain.
english.completed: Return to Karuk in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 符文中的预言
text.objectives: 月溪旅营地的托尔森·迪普迪格要你破译3块符文金属板的内容。
text.description: 时间宝贵！我们已经完全修复了符文钥石——呃，几乎是完全。不管怎么说，现在可以破译那些符文金属板啦，布莱恩在失踪前一直潜心研究金属板上面的内容。$B$B我们也不确定布莱恩是否能解读三块金属板上的所有文字，但是他应该会采用抽丝剥茧、逐一破译的思路。$B$B在三块金属板前分别使用钥石解读上面的内容。布莱恩的希望就寄托在我们身上了！
text.progress: What've you found out?
text.completion: By Madoran's hammer, he's discovered a whole new titan city! 'The cradle of stone and iron.' 'Ulduar nestled in the storm.' What d'you suppose that means? Could it be where we come from, after all these years? We have to follow him! We have to find him!
text.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Runic Prophecies
english.objectives: Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
english.description: We've no time to lose! Now that we've reassembled the runic keystone -- well, most of it -- we can decipher the contents of those very same runic plates Brann was working on before he fled.$B$BWe have no way of knowing if he managed to read the contents of all three plates, but we'll have to assume he got enough information to determine his next destination.$B$BStand before each of the plates and use the keystone to determine the contents of each. Brann may be counting on us!
english.progress: What've you found out?
english.completion: By Madoran's hammer, he's discovered a whole new titan city! 'The cradle of stone and iron.' 'Ulduar nestled in the storm.' What d'you suppose that means? Could it be where we come from, after all these years? We have to follow him! We have to find him!
english.completed: Return to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 前往群星之墓
text.objectives: 前往群星之墓，与大法师茉德拉的影像谈一谈。
text.description: $C，我知道这群海象人会让你帮他们忙这忙那的，但你必须尽快前往群星之墓。$B$B今天早晨在这片大陆所发生的剧变，一定造成了巨大的影响，而并不只是给当地人带来些麻烦这么简单。$B$B沿着港口北边的道路一直走，群星之墓就在十字路口的西面。大法师茉德拉在那里等着你！
text.completion: I've been expecting you, $c. We have much work to do, you and I.

english.title: Your Presence is Required at Stars' Rest
english.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: $C, I know these tuskarr will ask you to do many favors for them, but you must get to Stars' Rest with all due haste!$B$BThe upheaval in the land this morning is sure to have broader repercussions than just inconveniencing the natives.$B$BStars' Rest is westward past the intersection of the road leading north out of the harbor. There is an archmage there named Modera. She will be expecting you.
english.completion: I've been expecting you, $c. We have much work to do, you and I.

text.title: 前往阿格玛之锤
text.objectives: 前往阿格玛之锤，与大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像谈一谈。
text.description: $C，我知道这群海象人会让你帮他们忙这忙那的，但你必须尽快前往阿格玛之锤。$B$B今天早晨在这片大陆所发生的剧变，一定造成了巨大的影响，而并不只是给当地人带来些麻烦这么简单。$B$B沿着港口北边的道路一直走，阿格玛之锤就在十字路口的西面。大法师艾萨斯·夺日者在那里等着你！
text.completion: What took you so long? Time waits only for Aspects, $r. We have much work to do, you and I.

english.title: Your Presence is Required at Agmar's Hammer
english.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: $C, I know these tuskarr will ask you to do many favors for them, but you must get to Agmar's Hammer with all due haste!$B$BThe upheaval in the land this morning is sure to have broader repercussions than just inconveniencing the natives.$B$BThe Hammer is westward past the intersection of the road leading north out of the harbor. Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself will be expecting you!
english.completion: What took you so long? Time waits only for Aspects, $r. We have much work to do, you and I.

enders.name: 大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像

text.title: REUSE
text.objectives: Speak with Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
text.description: The Westfall Brigade has been dispatched to the northeastern part of Grizzly Hills to secure passage for our troops. They have established a base camp to the northeast of Grizzlemaw, and to the southwest of Thor Modan.$B$BYou might recognize the brigade's leader, Captain Gryan Stoutmantle as an honored veteran of the war against the Scourge in Lordaeron. But the people of Westfall know him best for his decision to leave the battlefield and return home to take on the Defias.

english.title: REUSE
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: The Westfall Brigade has been dispatched to the northeastern part of Grizzly Hills to secure passage for our troops. They have established a base camp to the northeast of Grizzlemaw, and to the southwest of Thor Modan.$B$BYou might recognize the brigade's leader, Captain Gryan Stoutmantle as an honored veteran of the war against the Scourge in Lordaeron. But the people of Westfall know him best for his decision to leave the battlefield and return home to take on the Defias.

text.title: 灵活的手段
text.objectives: 将一桶冰风月光酒交给月溪旅营地的布鲁加尔·石剪。
text.description: 想让大部队迅速抵达冰冠冰川，最好的方法就是利用铁矮人的古老城邦——索尔莫丹的地下隧道系统。$B$B探险者协会的布鲁加尔·石剪和他手下的同伴多半不乐意这样做，但是军令如山，就由不得他啦。$B$B如果你能捎上一桶冰风月光酒，他或许会勉为其难地接受这项指令。沿着林地线往东南走，你可以从红木商栈的猎户休·格兰斯手中买到这种酒。$B$B那家伙的神经有点不正常，不过他卖的酒倒是绝无第二家的。
text.progress: What's that you have there?
text.completion: Let me get this straight -- a $r I don't know brings me a cask of the finest booze in this miserable forest. Ok, then, what are you after?
text.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Softening the Blow
english.objectives: Bring Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment a cask of Howlin' Good Moonshine.
english.description: Our best bet for moving our forces quickly to Icecrown Glacier lies with the network of tunnels beneath the ancient iron dwarf city of Thor Modan.$B$BBrugar Stoneshear and his Explorers' League boys aren't going to be happy, but orders are orders.$B$BThe news might go over better if you brought him a cask of that moonshine sold by that trapper, Hugh Glass, down at Redwood Trading Post, southeast of here along the tree line.$B$BMan's not right in the head, but you won't find better moonshine out here.
english.progress: What's that you have there?
english.completion: Let me get this straight -- a $r I don't know brings me a cask of the finest booze in this miserable forest. Ok, then, what are you after?
english.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 寻找线索
text.objectives: 找到眠月花园计划书，然后返回阿格玛之锤，将它交给大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像。
text.description: 西南面的眠月花园以前曾经是一群高贵的上层精灵的最终安息地，那里同样是一个强大的魔网能量线枢纽。$B$B蓝龙军团利用一种被他们自己称为“湍流之针”的魔法设备摧毁了那个枢纽，释放了能量，将能量指引去他们想要的地方。$B$B我希望你能帮我寻找我想要的信息。$B$B在这片土地被摧毁之后，上层精灵的鬼魂开始复活并击败了一部分法师猎手成员。去他们的尸体上看看有什么有用的信息。
text.progress: You have returned.  What did you uncover?
text.completion: Curious, they seek an accord with the Ethereum. The ethereals could prove a powerful ally for Malygos and his madness. This will not do!
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Rifle the Bodies
english.objectives: Find the Moonrest Gardens Plans and return them to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: The Moonrest Gardens to the southwest were the final resting place of a group of Highborne elves. It was also a ley line nexus.$B$BThe blue dragonflight used a magical device they call a surge needle to destroy that nexus, freeing the power to redirect at their will.$B$BI want more information and you are going to get it for me!$B$BAfter the land was destroyed at the ruins, the ghosts of the Highborne rose up and decimated half of the mage hunters there. Go rifle their corpses for clues.
english.progress: You have returned.  What did you uncover?
english.completion: Curious, they seek an accord with the Ethereum. The ethereals could prove a powerful ally for Malygos and his madness. This will not do!
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像

text.title: 寻找线索
text.objectives: 找到眠月花园计划书，然后返回群星之墓，将它交给大法师茉德拉的影像。
text.description: 西南面的眠月花园以前曾经是一群高贵的上层精灵的最终安息地，那里同样是一个强大的魔网能量线枢纽。$B$B蓝龙军团利用一种被他们自己称为“湍流之针”的魔法设备摧毁了那个枢纽，释放了能量，将能量指引去他们想要的地方。$B$B我希望你能帮我寻找我想要的信息。$B$B在这片土地被摧毁之后，上层精灵的鬼魂开始复活并击败了一部分法师猎手成员。去他们的尸体上看看有什么有用的信息。
text.progress: You have returned.  What did you uncover?
text.completion: Curious, they seek an accord with the Ethereum. The ethereals could prove a powerful ally for Malygos and his madness. This will not do!
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: Rifle the Bodies
english.objectives: Find the Moonrest Gardens Plans and return them to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: The Moonrest Gardens to the southwest were the final resting place of a noble group of Highborne elves. It was also a powerful ley line nexus.$B$BThe blue dragonflight used a magical device they call a surge needle to destroy that nexus, freeing the power to redirect at their will.$B$BI need more information and I hope that you will get it for me.$B$BAfter the upheaval at the ruins, the ghosts of the Highborne rose up and decimated half of the mage hunters present. Go rifle their corpses for clues.
english.progress: You have returned.  What did you uncover?
english.completion: Curious, they seek an accord with the Ethereum. The ethereals could prove a powerful ally for Malygos and his madness. This will not do!
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: zzOLDHunting Tarot: Lesser Beasts
text.objectives: Collect 12 Torn Hides and then summon the Huntsman with the Hunting Tarot.  The Torn Hides can only be gathered from beasts of level 5 or higher.
text.description: Staring into the card, the image blurs until you see yourself standing covered in the furs from many wolves and bears.  You can only assume this is your destiny should you invoke the tarot's power.
text.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft in Designer Island.

english.title: zzOLDHunting Tarot: Lesser Beasts
english.objectives: Collect 12 Torn Hides and then summon the Huntsman with the Hunting Tarot.  The Torn Hides can only be gathered from beasts of level 5 or higher.
english.description: Staring into the card, the image blurs until you see yourself standing covered in the furs from many wolves and bears.  You can only assume this is your destiny should you invoke the tarot's power.
english.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft in Designer Island.

text.title: 战斗中的兄弟
text.objectives: 消灭10台符文作战魔像，然后返回月溪旅营地向布鲁加尔·石剪复命。
text.description: 战争打响后，我就下令探险队撤离了索尔莫丹，格里安难道不知道？除非那里恢复和平，否则别想让我们挖掘地下隧道。$B$B你能赢得格里安·斯托曼的信任，看上去倒是个勇敢的家伙。$B$B索尔莫丹就在东北方，我们的同伴还在和那些该死的铁矮人作战呢。帮助他们赢得胜利，这样我才能着手部署详细的调查方案。
text.progress: How are things at Thor Modan?
text.completion: It sounds like things may be calming down there a bit. We'll start looking for entrances to the iron dwarves' tunnel system.
text.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Brothers in Battle
english.objectives: Kill 10 Runic Battle Golems and return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: I hope Gryan knows I withdrew my men from Thor Modan when the battle began. There's no way we can excavate anything until that place settles down.$B$BYou seem like a brave sort, though, and you have Stoutmantle's trust.$B$BThor Modan is just to the northeast of us and the battle still rages between our Earthen brothers and the creations of those accursed iron dwarves. Help our brethren to even the odds and I'll start figuring out how we're going to accomplish this survey of Thor Modan.
english.progress: How are things at Thor Modan?
english.completion: It sounds like things may be calming down there a bit. We'll start looking for entrances to the iron dwarves' tunnel system.
english.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 寻找隧道
text.objectives: 月溪旅营地的布鲁加尔·石剪要你前去侦查索尔莫丹的北部建筑物、东部建筑物和南部建筑物。
text.description: 我们打算从索尔莫丹边缘地带的建筑群开始搜寻，看看能不能发现地下隧道系统的入口。$B$B探险队撤离那里时，我留意到铁矮人防御者将建筑物作为掩体，所以你得当心点。$B$B隧道入口极有可能位于建筑物背面。格里安·斯托曼大概希望我们有所发现吧，不过我怀疑铁矮人会不会让我们轻易得手。
text.progress: I don't suppose you managed to find the tunnels, did you?
text.completion: No entrances? None? No, of course it couldn't be that easy. Well, I suppose there's no avoiding a foray into the city proper. My boys'll never get back to their real work.
text.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Uncovering the Tunnels
english.objectives: Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment wants you to explore the North Building, the East Building, and the South Building of Thor Modan.
english.description: The first place we'll search for entrances to the Thor Modan tunnel system will be the outlying buildings.$B$BAs I left the site with my men, it looked like the iron dwarf defenders were taking refuge inside the buildings. Be careful as you explore them.$B$BAny tunnel entrances are likely to be toward the back of the buildings. I'm not sure what Stoutmantle thinks we're going to find down there, but I doubt the iron dwarves will make the search easy.
english.progress: I don't suppose you managed to find the tunnels, did you?
english.completion: No entrances? None? No, of course it couldn't be that easy. Well, I suppose there's no avoiding a foray into the city proper. My boys'll never get back to their real work.
english.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 阻碍协议
text.objectives: 将商人穆法赫的遗骸和古拉莫什的鳞片带回群星之墓，交给大法师茉德拉的影像。
text.description: 现在我们需要做的就是一箭双雕，$C。$B$B你就是那支箭，而商人穆法赫和古拉莫什就是那两只雕。他们应该就在眠月花园的西半边，去那座两层楼的大房子里找找看。$B$B如果可以的话，我希望看到他们死亡的凭证。
text.progress: Have you prevented the accord between the blue dragonflight and the Ethereum?
text.completion: Unfortunate that Goramosh indicated the accord had already been reached. Nonetheless, that's two less worms we'll have to worry about. Let us get to more important business.
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: Prevent the Accord
english.objectives: Deliver Wind Trader Mu'fah's Remains and the Scales of Goramosh to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: We need to kill two birds with one stone here, $c. You're the stone.$B$BOur two birds are Wind Trader Mu'fah and Goramosh. They should be somewhere in the western half of the Moonrest Gardens. Most likely they're in the larger two-story building overlooking the pit.$B$BI require proof of their demise, if you would be so kind.
english.progress: Have you prevented the accord between the blue dragonflight and the Ethereum?
english.completion: Unfortunate that Goramosh indicated the accord had already been reached. Nonetheless, that's two less worms we'll have to worry about. Let us get to more important business.
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 阻碍协议
text.objectives: 将商人穆法赫的遗骸和古拉莫什的鳞片带回阿格玛之锤，交给大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像。
text.description: 现在我们需要做的就是一箭双雕，$C。$B$B你就是那支箭，而商人穆法赫和古拉莫什就是那两只雕。他们应该就在眠月花园的西半边，去那座两层楼的大房子里找找看。$B$B如果可以的话，我希望看到他们死亡的凭证。
text.progress: Have you prevented the accord between the blue dragonflight and the Ethereum?
text.completion: That's alright, $c, just put them down on the ground there in front of Agmar's throne. Unfortunate that Goramosh indicated the accord had already been reached. Nonetheless, that's two less worms we'll have to worry about. Let us get on to more important business.
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Prevent the Accord
english.objectives: Deliver Wind Trader Mu'fah's Remains and the Scales of Goramosh to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: We need to kill two birds with one stone here, $c. You're the stone.$B$BOur two birds are Wind Trader Mu'fah and Goramosh. They should be somewhere in the western half of the Moonrest Gardens. Most likely they're in the larger two-story building overlooking the pit.$B$BI require proof of their demise, if you would be so kind.
english.progress: Have you prevented the accord between the blue dragonflight and the Ethereum?
english.completion: That's alright, $c, just put them down on the ground there in front of Agmar's throne. Unfortunate that Goramosh indicated the accord had already been reached. Nonetheless, that's two less worms we'll have to worry about. Let us get on to more important business.

text.title: 上层精灵的愤怒
text.objectives: 击败龙骨荒野法师猎手、眠月魔犬、湍流之针巫师和魔法焦点巫师，总计15名。完成任务后返回眠月花园，向伊瑟尼安·月影复命。
text.description: 那些所谓的法师猎手毁了我们的安息之地。$B$B去为我们复仇，否则，我发誓——你们的基地会被亡者的怒火夷为平地！
text.progress: Somehow I sense that you haven't quite killed enough of these defilers!
text.completion: Very well, you have satisfied my request if nothing more. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Blue Dragonflight forces at Moonrest Gardens slain

english.title: Avenge this Atrocity!
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 15 Dragonblight Mage Hunters, Moonrest Stalkers, Surge Needle Sorcerers, and Focus Wizards. After you have done that, return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens.
english.description: These so-called mage hunters came here and destroyed our resting place.$B$BAvenge us, or I will see to it that your base of operations is overrun with the spirits of the dead!
english.progress: Somehow I sense that you haven't quite killed enough of these defilers!
english.completion: Very well, you have satisfied my request if nothing more. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Blue Dragonflight forces at Moonrest Gardens slain

text.title: 必要的牺牲
text.objectives: 达库鲁希望你前往塞布哈拉克，找到他的火盆，并将预言者之眼交给他。$B$B你需要取得督军希姆波的魔精，才能在那里使用达库鲁的药剂。
text.description: 我明白了，朋友！$B$B在北边，塞布哈拉克的通灵塔上有个镶着红宝石眼睛的石头脑袋，其中一颗红宝石就是预言者之眼！你要把它拿到那里的火盆旁，然后喝下我的药剂。$B$B跟以前一样，你仍然需要一些特殊的魔精才能让我的药剂生效——这次是督军希姆波的。他就藏在塞布哈拉克的某个棚屋里。$B$B要杀死希姆波真的很可惜，但他发过血誓要保卫达克萨隆，最后却失败了。现在他的魔精能够帮助我们夺回达克萨隆。
text.progress: You get da Eye of the Prophets, mon?
text.completion: Dis be it, mon! It be even more precious than I hoped. Dis be sure to bring mah people hope in dese dark times. No time to waste, now. Let's be seein' where da next artifact be hidin'.
text.completed: Return to Image of Drakuru at Zeb'Halak in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Sacrifices Must be Made
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to bring the Eye of the Prophets to him at Drakuru's Brazier in Zeb'Halak.$b$bYou will need to collect Zim'bo's Mojo to use Drakuru's Elixir there.
english.description: I've got it, mon!$b$bTo da north, on da Ziggurat at Zeb'Halak be a stone head with ruby eyes. One o' dem be da Eye of the Prophets! Bring it to the brazier there and drink my elixir.$b$bAgain, ya be needing some mojo for my elixir to work - dis time from da warlord, Zim'bo. He be hidin' in one of da huts in Zeb'Halak.$b$bIt be a shame to kill Zim'bo, mon, but he swore da blood oath to defend Drak'Tharon and he done failed. Now at least his mojo be helpin' us to reclaim Drak'Tharon.
english.progress: You get da Eye of the Prophets, mon?
english.completion: Dis be it, mon! It be even more precious than I hoped. Dis be sure to bring mah people hope in dese dark times. No time to waste, now. Let's be seein' where da next artifact be hidin'.
english.completed: Return to Image of Drakuru at Zeb'Halak in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 阿格玛之锤
text.objectives: Travel to Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight and speak to Overlord Agmar.$B$B
text.description: Directly east of this refugee camp stands Agmar's Hammer - testament to the Hordes' power in the Dragonblight.$B$BWhile I have no doubt that our Horde brothers and sisters are already seeing the result of your efforts to bring the taunka into the Horde, I want you to deliver news of your success to Overlord Agmar in person.$B$BGo now, $N! Race the winds! East to Agmar's Hammer!$B$B
text.completion: While you have undoubtedly championed the cause of the Horde elsewhere, many more have been working towards expanding our grasp deeper into Northrend. Even now we have forces establishing bases in the frozen reaches of this desolate wasteland. We surround the Scourge on all sides. Victory nears as our armies amass at the foot of the Wrathgate, Angrathar. Soon we will tear down the gate and breach Icecrown. But there is much work left to be done... First we stop the Nerubians!

english.title: Agmar's Hammer
english.objectives: Travel to Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight and speak to Overlord Agmar.$B$B
english.description: Directly east of this refugee camp stands Agmar's Hammer - testament to the Hordes' power in the Dragonblight.$B$BWhile I have no doubt that our Horde brothers and sisters are already seeing the result of your efforts to bring the taunka into the Horde, I want you to deliver news of your success to Overlord Agmar in person.$B$BGo now, $N! Race the winds! East to Agmar's Hammer!$B$B
english.completion: While you have undoubtedly championed the cause of the Horde elsewhere, many more have been working towards expanding our grasp deeper into Northrend. Even now we have forces establishing bases in the frozen reaches of this desolate wasteland. We surround the Scourge on all sides. Victory nears as our armies amass at the foot of the Wrathgate, Angrathar. Soon we will tear down the gate and breach Icecrown. But there is much work left to be done... First we stop the Nerubians!

text.title: 图尔凯的螃蟹陷阱
text.objectives: 收集8个图尔凯的螃蟹陷阱，然后把它们交给莫亚基港口的图尔凯。
text.description: 一片混乱之中，我和我的助手失散了。你能不能帮我个忙呢？$B$B我在港口的水下设了许多捉螃蟹的陷阱，你能帮我去把它们收回来吗？我太老了，干不了这种活，而且水下很危险。$B$B拿着这只气囊，它能帮你在水下呼吸。
text.progress: How many crabs did you manage to retrieve?
text.completion: I'm a simple trapper. The world has turned upside-down all of a sudden. It doesn't make sense. I hope that you'll be able to set it right again.
text.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Tua'kea's Crab Traps
english.objectives: Collect 8 of Tua'kea's Crab Traps and return them to him at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: With all of the troubles, I've lost my assistants. I was wondering if maybe you could help me?$B$BI have many crab traps under the waves of the harbor. Will you retrieve them for me? I'm too old for that sort of thing and the waters can be very dangerous.$B$BPlease, take this bladder. It will help you to breathe while you're down there.
english.progress: How many crabs did you manage to retrieve?
english.completion: I'm a simple trapper. The world has turned upside-down all of a sudden. It doesn't make sense. I hope that you'll be able to set it right again.
english.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 奥尔隆德的命运
text.objectives: 前往索尔莫丹寻找勘查员奥尔隆德的下落。
text.description: 探险者协会着手挖掘这座城市时，我派勘查员奥尔隆德前去测试索尔莫丹地下隧道的稳定性。战争打响后，我们就撤离了那里，可奥尔隆德却音讯全无，恐怕他还被困在索尔莫丹呢。$B$B没有他收集的第一手资料，我可不敢贸然攻打索尔莫丹。如果月溪旅在穿越地下隧道时遭遇塌方事件，格里安·斯托曼和他的上司肯定会剥了我的皮！
text.completion: A quick examination of the body reveals that the surveyor has been dead for some time. Looking through his pack, you stumble upon Orlond's handwritten notes.

english.title: The Fate of Orlond
english.objectives: Locate Surveyor Orlond within Thor Modan.
english.description: When we began excavating the city, I sent Surveyor Orlond to check the stability of the tunnels in Thor Modan. I didn't see him escape when we withdrew at the beginning of the battle, and I worry he may still be trapped inside the city.$B$BIf we're going to get an army through Thor Modan, we'll need the information he was collecting. Stoutmantle and his superiors would have my hide if the tunnels collapsed on one of their brigades!
english.completion: A quick examination of the body reveals that the surveyor has been dead for some time. Looking through his pack, you stumble upon Orlond's handwritten notes.

text.title: 大麻烦的征兆
text.objectives: 前往莫亚基港口，将螃蟹陷阱被破坏的事情告诉图尔凯。
text.description: 这个螃蟹陷阱被某种比附近的鲨鱼体型还要大的东西破坏了。$B$B也许莫亚基港口的渔夫图尔凯知道那是什么？
text.completion: That's not the news I wanted to hear, $r. No, no... it's good that you told me, but I fear my old nemesis has returned to these waters.

english.title: Signs of Big Watery Trouble
english.objectives: Inform Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor about the wrecked crab trap.
english.description: This crab trap appears to have been destroyed by something much larger than the nearby circling sharks.$B$BPerhaps Tua'kea, the fisherman at Moa'ki Harbor, should be told about this?
english.completion: That's not the news I wanted to hear, $r. No, no... it's good that you told me, but I fear my old nemesis has returned to these waters.

text.title: 告知长者
text.objectives: Travel to a capital city and speak to the Earthen Ring Elder.
text.description: 这个消息必须尽快让大地之环的成员全都知道。 我还不知道该如何去做，不过派遣你执行这一任务的长者应该会有方案。请回去见长者，确认下一个行动步骤。我们一定要采取行动！
text.progress: What troubles you, my child?
text.completion: This is grave news indeed. We must do everything in our power to stop this war from coming to pass.

english.title: Inform the Elder
english.objectives: Travel to a capital city and speak to the Earthen Ring Elder.
english.description: This information must be spread to the entirety of the Earthen Ring. I'm not certain how to proceed, but the elder who set you on this task in the first place may. Please, return to the elder and seek the next course of action - we must do something!
english.progress: What troubles you, my child?
english.completion: This is grave news indeed. We must do everything in our power to stop this war from coming to pass.

text.title: 阿坎尼姆斯的终结
text.objectives: 摧毁阿坎尼姆斯，然后返回眠月花园向伊瑟尼安·月影复命。
text.description: 我还要请你做最后一件事，$R$N。我要你去杀死阿坎尼姆斯！$B$B西面的那些巫师在空中部署的巨大装置……它在我们的安息之地里炸出一个大坑，也释放出了那个怪物！$B$B如果它只对凡人感兴趣，那我才懒得理它。但是阿坎尼姆斯专吃死者的灵魂。$B$B你必须立刻去终结它！
text.progress: Do you think me a fool? Arcanimus is still eating the souls of my brothers and sisters, $c!
text.completion: You have my deepest gratitude, $n. If you haven't already, you should alert your betters to the danger that the blue dragonflight has unleashed. By blowing apart the ley line anchor underneath the gardens, they threaten to destroy us all!
text.completed: Return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight.

english.title: End Arcanimus
english.objectives: Destroy Arcanimus and then return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens.
english.description: There is one last thing that I would have you do, $N the $r. I would have you destroy Arcanimus!$B$BThe sorcerers to the west used that giant device in the sky to bore a massive pit into our resting place. When they did that, they unleashed a monstrosity!$B$BI would not care if it were only a concern for mortals, but Arcanimus feeds upon the spirits of the dead.$B$BYou will put an end to it now!
english.progress: Do you think me a fool? Arcanimus is still eating the souls of my brothers and sisters, $c!
english.completion: You have my deepest gratitude, $n. If you haven't already, you should alert your betters to the danger that the blue dragonflight has unleashed. By blowing apart the ley line anchor underneath the gardens, they threaten to destroy us all!
english.completed: Return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight.

text.title: 坚如磐石？
text.objectives: 夺回便携式测震仪，并用它记录索尔莫丹地下隧道的稳定性指数，然后返回月溪旅营地，向布鲁加尔·石剪复命。
text.description: 奥尔隆德在日记中写道，他随身携带着一件名叫便携式测震仪的器械，不过你在他的尸体附近没找到这样的东西。$B$B勘察记录显示，除了“暴露在地表的那条隧道的东部端口”，奥尔隆德已经对索尔莫丹的其它隧道进行了稳定性测试。$B$B从最后一则日记来看，他企图躲入水中避难，却遭到水下蛇颈龙的攻击。那件器械很可能是被蛇颈龙夺走了。你必须取回仪器才能完成测试工作。
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: This isn't good at all. Even if we could excavate the tunnels behind the blockage, there's no guarantee they wouldn't collapse again. It looks like some of these areas haven't been used in generations. We'll have to give Captain Gryan the bad news.
text.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Steady as a Rock?
english.objectives: Retreive the Portable Seismograph and use it to take stability readings in Thor Modan, then return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: Orlond's notes indicate that he brought a piece of equipment called a portable seismograph with him, but the device is nowhere to be seen.$B$BThe survey log shows that Orlond completed all his readings in the Thor Modan tunnel, save one labeled the 'east end of the exposed tunnel.'$B$BThe last entry in the log indicates Orlond tried to take refuge in the water and was attacked by subterranean threshers. They might've taken his equipment.You'll need to recover it before you can take the last reading.
english.progress: What did you find?
english.completion: This isn't good at all. Even if we could excavate the tunnels behind the blockage, there's no guarantee they wouldn't collapse again. It looks like some of these areas haven't been used in generations. We'll have to give Captain Gryan the bad news.
english.completed: Return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 诱饵
text.objectives: 取得“双钳巨蟹”的肉，把它交给莫亚基港口的图尔凯。
text.description: 我可以肯定……远古的水族复仇者，“戏耍猎物者”图格瓦尔已经回来了。我们必须给它设一个陷阱。$B$B图格瓦尔唯一的弱点就是贪吃。有一种肉它是绝对无法抗拒的。$B$B所有螃蟹的母亲，“双钳巨蟹”基利瓦盘踞在西南方的小岛上。你必须去找到她，把她的肉带回来。
text.progress: You return with the succulent flesh of Kili'ua?
text.completion: You were able to slay Kili'ua... perhaps you'll be able to do the same to Tu'u'gwar. Perhaps not.
text.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Bait
english.objectives: Obtain The Flesh of "Two Huge Pincers" and deliver it to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: I'm sure of it... our ancient aquatic nemesis, Tu'u'gwar, "He Who Plays With Food", has returned. We must lay a trap for him, you and I.$B$BIf Tu'u'gwar has one weakness it's his stomach. There's one meat for certain that he'd never be able to pass up.$B$B"Two Huge Pincers", the mother of all crabs, Kili'ua, paces upon her island out in the waters to the southwest. You must pay her a visit and return with her meat.
english.progress: You return with the succulent flesh of Kili'ua?
english.completion: You were able to slay Kili'ua... perhaps you'll be able to do the same to Tu'u'gwar. Perhaps not.
english.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 鱼钩上的肉
text.objectives: 杀死图格瓦尔，然后向莫亚基港口的图尔凯复命。
text.description: 是时候了，我的朋友。我们必须解决图格瓦尔！$B$B我已经把肉准备好了，只要你把肉挂在我放进水里的鱼钩上，它就肯定会出现。你只需顺着这根鱼线就能找到鱼钩。$B$B无论怎样，可千万别让图格瓦尔把你给吞了，$N！
text.progress: I thought I might have spotted some thrashing... is Tu'u'gwar dead?
text.completion: We shall rejoice at your success, my young friend! There's blood in the water and it is our enemy's! You have the eternal gratitude of this old fisherman, and most certainly of all the Kalu'ak once I spread the word! Here now, I insist, take something as a reward, please.
text.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Meat on the Hook
english.objectives: Slay Tu'u'gwar and then return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: The time has come my friend: Tu'u'gwar must be dealt with!$B$BI've prepped the meat so that the beast is sure to come once you bait the hook I have out in the water. Just follow the fishing line here down to it.$B$BWhatever you do, don't let Tu'u'gwar swallow you whole, $N!
english.progress: I thought I might have spotted some thrashing... is Tu'u'gwar dead?
english.completion: We shall rejoice at your success, my young friend! There's blood in the water and it is our enemy's! You have the eternal gratitude of this old fisherman, and most certainly of all the Kalu'ak once I spread the word! Here now, I insist, take something as a reward, please.
english.completed: Return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: Sweet Revenge
text.objectives: Obtain 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle from Carrion Gargoyles in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis when the task is complete.
text.description: 你在那里......你看看战斗类型。我想要一些甜美的复仇杀死我的家人。去找我2 Stone Hunks O'Gargoyle，这样我就可以把它们扔在地上，猛烈地踩在它们上面，直到它们被捣碎成一堆小卵石
text.completed: Return to .

english.title: Sweet Revenge
english.objectives: Obtain 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle from Carrion Gargoyles in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis when the task is complete.
english.description: You there... you look the fighting type.  I want some sweet Revenge on the Scourge that killed my family.  Go get me 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle so that I can throw them on the ground and stomp on them violently until they are mashed into itty bitty pebbly bits. $b$bYes. Go. Kill.
english.completed: Return to .

text.title: 最后的义务
text.objectives: 进入圣城恩其拉，找到浮空城纳克萨纳尔下方的传送宝珠。使用它进入浮空城的顶部，然后帮助萨萨里安。
text.description: 我之所以会在死后侍奉阿尔萨斯，是因为我别无选择。他曾经完完全全地控制我的意志与我的身体。而诅咒教派则不同，他们全体成员……都自愿地侍奉阿尔萨斯……$B$B现在，既然已经知道了进入纳克萨纳尔的咒语，我们就可以彻底消灭诅咒教派。立刻前往恩其拉，在浮空城的正下方寻找传送宝珠。$B$B找到之后，和我在上面会合。准备好你的一切武器与装备，鼓起你的勇气，我们或许……会永远倒在那里。
text.progress: Hail, $N.
text.completion: You did well, $n.  I was hoping to leave my sister out of all this.  Thanks to you she is alive and well. My obligations to my king and my army have been fulfilled.  It is clear I'm not welcome among my comrades anymore.  I will have to find my own way, fighting no wars but my own and following no orders but my heart's. Perhaps we shall meet again, $c.  Until then, take this as a token of my gratitude.
text.completed: Seek out Thassarian at Naxxaanar in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Last Rites
english.objectives: Go to the Temple City of En'kilah and find the teleportation orb beneath the floating Scourge citadel of Naxxanar.  Use it to reach the top and help Thassarian there.
english.description: I served Arthas in death, because I had no choice.  He had control over my will and my body.  The Cult of the Damned serves Arthas in life... willingly.$B$BNow that we know the words of power to enter Naxxanar we can put an end to the cultist blight.  Go to En'kilah and look for the teleportation orb beneath the floating citadel.$B$BWork your way up and meet me at the top.  Arm yourself with what courage you can, we might not make it out of this alive.
english.progress: Hail, $N.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  I was hoping to leave my sister out of all this.  Thanks to you she is alive and well. My obligations to my king and my army have been fulfilled.  It is clear I'm not welcome among my comrades anymore.  I will have to find my own way, fighting no wars but my own and following no orders but my heart's. Perhaps we shall meet again, $c.  Until then, take this as a token of my gratitude.
english.completed: Seek out Thassarian at Naxxaanar in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 那次，我喝醉了之后……
text.objectives: 与美酒节营地的波克希·博斯宾谈一谈。
text.description: 黑铁矮人遭到了重创！在他们仓惶逃回黑铁酒吧时，有数架运输机坠毁了。更重要的是，今天……你成功地保卫了营地的安全。$B$B将你击退黑铁矮人的英雄事迹告诉波克希吧。
text.completion: So you managed to stop the Dark Irons... While drunk too?  That, $c, is truly the spirit of Brewfest!  I guess in keeping with the spirit of Brewfest you want your prize tokens. Thanks for your help, $n.  Enjoy the rest of Brewfest.

english.title: This One Time, When I Was Drunk...
english.objectives: Talk to Boxey Boltspinner in the Brewfest camp.
english.description: The Dark Irons took a beating!  As they rushed back to the Grim Guzzler, a portion of their transport fell off.  More importantly, you managed to keep the camp safe... today.$b$bHead over to Boxey and explain your heroic triumph over the Dark Iron dwarves.
english.completion: So you managed to stop the Dark Irons... While drunk too?  That, $c, is truly the spirit of Brewfest!  I guess in keeping with the spirit of Brewfest you want your prize tokens. Thanks for your help, $n.  Enjoy the rest of Brewfest.

text.description: This letter appears to be addressed to a resident of Stormwind from one of the late Villagers in the Carrion Fields.  Perhaps one of the surviving residents in the Eastern camp would be interested in forwarding it to its intended recipient.

text.title: 扔酒杯！
text.objectives: Use the Complimentary Brewfest Sampler to hit S.T.O.U.T. 5 times, then talk to Boxey Boltspinner.
text.description: Hey there!  You look like you can handle your brew.  But can you handle your brew mug? $b$bThe Dark Irons have come back with a vengeance to ruin our celebration.  Tossing mugs at them is the best way to stop them, but first, let's see if you can toss one at old S.T.O.U.T. here.$b$bIt's easy, pick up a complimentary sampler and take a drink.  Just make sure you're facing S.T.O.U.T.  Talk to me after you've hit him 5 times.
text.progress: Toss one back, then toss one forward. S.T.O.U.T. can take the abuse, it's why I built him.
text.completion: Do you know what that was?  Gnomish engineering at its finest!  S.T.O.U.T. took the abuse like a champ! I think you're ready now to take on the Dark Irons if they show up again.
text.completed: Return to Boxey Boltspinner in Dun Morogh.

Just make sure you're facing S.T.O.U.T.  Talk to me after you've hit him 5 times.
english.progress: Toss one back, then toss one forward. S.T.O.U.T. can take the abuse, it's why I built him.

text.objectives: Kill the Abomination on the hillside in Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis once the slaughter is complete.
text.description: Satisfyingly crunchy.  Now... you... $R thing... there's an Abomination wandering the hillside to the south.  Go kill it.  Kill it good.

text.title: 记录阵亡者
text.objectives: 在腐臭平原的骸骨中寻找联盟居民名单。
text.description: 感谢你的到来，$N。尽管我们一直没有收到暮冬要塞那边传来的消息，但我坚信，他们仍然在与天灾军团激烈地抗争着。不过，恐怕他们也无力再支援我们，我们将在这里独自抵抗那座屠宰房的威胁了。$B$B首先，我们得确认那些战死者的身份，好将他们英勇牺牲的消息通知他们的家人。联盟军部将我们派驻到这里时，所有人都填写了身份证明文书，以清点这里的驻军状况。$B$B到那些战士们的遗体身上去找这些文书吧，有了这些文书，我就可以开始罗列阵亡将士的名单了。
text.completed: Return to .

english.title: Recording the Fallen
english.objectives: Search the skeletons in the Carrion Fields for Alliance Settlement Documents.
english.description: Thank you for coming $N.  We haven't recieved any word from Wintergarde Keep.  I'm sure they're still battling the Scourge, but I can believe they left us alone to this slaughter.  $b$bWe need to gather the names of the dead so that we can notify their families.  When the Alliance Military brought us here, we all filled out Settlement Documentation and were required to keep it on our persons.  $b$bGo sift through the corpses and bring me any Documents that you find so that I can start a list of the names.
english.completed: Return to .

text.title: A Scarlet Among Us
text.objectives: 在Eastern Carrion Fields内刚被召唤起的Carrion Ghoul中寻找有关血色十字军的线索。将你的发现报告给Lady Alustra。
text.description: 又能看见一个没被天灾军团干掉的幸运家伙，这可真好。或许你愿意帮忙我们？$B$B血色十字军最近在北边建立起了一座前线岗哨，明显是想和这里的天灾军团全面开战。但，令我们费解的是，他们竟然在我们被攻击之前就完全建好了这座基地——他们一定知道了些什么。$B$B我想知道我们的村民是否跟这些事有关。在那些以前还是我们村民的食尸鬼身上寻找线索，有任何发现就回来找我。
text.completed: Return to .

english.title: A Scarlet Among Us
english.objectives: Search for evidence of the Scarlet Crusade on the freshly risen Carrion Ghouls in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lady Alustra with anything you find.
english.description: It's good to see that you were not ravaged by the Scourge as well.  Perhaps you'd be willing to lend a hand.  $b$bThe Scarlet Crusade has taken up a post to the north with the obvious intent of battling the Scourge.  The thing that bothers me is that they were building before we were attacked - they must have known something.  $b$bI need to know if one of our Villagers was involved.  Search for evidence on those of us that were brought back as ghouls.  If you find anything, bring it to me.
english.completed: Return to .

text.title: 破损的日记
text.objectives: Recover 8 Missing Journal Pages, combine them with the Incomplete Journal, and return the completed journal to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: This battered, mud-stained journal has seen better days. Leafing through the pages, you discover dozens of notes, diagrams, and maps in the dwarven language.$B$BThe only text you're able to decipher is the name of Brann Bronzebeard scrawled at the end of one of the entries.$B$BThe back half of the book, containing the most recent entries, has been torn away. Someone thought the notes important enough to attempt to destroy them. Perhaps gathering the missing pages from the battlefield will yield some clues.
text.progress: What's that you have there?
text.completion: Who is this Brann Bronzebeard? The iron dwarves found no reason to treat with him, but I have no idea why we'd be interested in his writings.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

Someone thought the notes important enough to attempt to destroy them. Perhaps gathering the missing pages from the battlefield will yield some clues.

text.title: 小毛球的冒险
text.objectives: 帮助艾米莉和小毛球逃回月溪旅营地，然后向侍从瓦尔特复命。
text.description: 对不起，$G先生:女士;，请问您是否知道回军营的路呢？$B$B我和小毛球本来只是想在周围的树林里散散步的，我哥哥瓦尔特也想跟我们来的，可他又有一些侍从的工作要做。$B$B结果……结果呢，我和小毛球就……就迷路了。这森林里饿狼好多，还有许多其它可怕的东西，我……我们就只好躲到这座塔里来了。$B$B现在，狼虽然走了，可我们还迷着路呢。$B$B我问小毛球该怎么走，它也不知道如何回去。你能不能帮帮我们，带我们回去呢？拜托你了！
text.completion: Thank goodness you found Emmy! When she left without me, I was worried she'd get lost. I'm glad to see Mr. Floppy's back safe and sound, too.
text.end: Help Emily and Mr. Floppy return to the camp
text.completed: Return to Squire Walter at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Mr. Floppy's Perilous Adventure
english.objectives: Help Emily and Mr. Floppy get back to the Westfall Brigade Encampment, then speak to Squire Walter.
english.description: Excuse me, $g Mister: Ma'am;, do you know the way back to the soldiers' camp?$B$BMr. Floppy and I decided to go for a walk in the woods, and my brother Walter was gonna come with us, but then he had squire things to do.$B$BSo Mr. Floppy and I went by ourselves, but we got lost, and there were a whole bunch of hungry wolves, but we found this tower.$B$BThe wolves went away, but we're still lost.$B$BI asked Mr. Floppy, and he doesn't know the way back. Would you help us? Please?
english.completion: Thank goodness you found Emmy! When she left without me, I was worried she'd get lost. I'm glad to see Mr. Floppy's back safe and sound, too.
english.end: Help Emily and Mr. Floppy return to the camp
english.completed: Return to Squire Walter at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 灵魂视界
text.objectives: 通过灵魂视界观察因度雷村，然后向莫亚基港口的秘法师图阿鲁汇报情况。
text.description: $R, we have not heard from our people at Indu'le Village since the ground shook and was torn apart!$B$BHave you ever been upon a vision quest? You've bested Loguhn, so you must be capable.$B$BI will give you a special incense to sprinkle into my brazier. Breathe deep from its vapors and your spirit will be sent aloft to view what has transpired at Indu'le.$B$BAs your spirit soars, I will be able to look through your eyes.
text.progress: 你怎么想？
text.completion: Ghosts and gibbering madness? This cannot be! We must seek further guidance.
text.end: Spiritual insight concerning Indu'le Village attained.
text.completed: Return to Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.objectives: Speak with Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor after you have attained your spiritual insight.

You've bested Loguhn, so you must be capable.$B$BI will give you a special incense to sprinkle into my brazier. Breathe deep from its vapors and your spirit will be sent aloft to view what has transpired at Indu'le.$B$BAs your spirit soars, I will be able to look through your eyes.

english.end: Spiritual insight concerning Indu'le Village attained.
