text.title: 净化天灾巨魔
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的马克希望你在达克萨隆用他的烈酒净化20个饥饿的天灾巨魔。
text.description: <嗝儿>……必须得在这些巨魔又开始起来走动前采取行动。$B$B爸爸经常跟我说，比起不得不干掉一个巨魔来说更糟的只有一件事，就是必须得杀死一个巨魔两次。$B$B呃，<嗝儿>……说起天灾，在我们想办法削减那些巨魔的数量之前，显然是没法进入北边那座巨魔城堡的。$B$B不如你带上一些我的酒，把这些巨魔在复活前通通净化掉？
text.progress: Ya getter done, $N?
text.completion: Well done! Aww, come on now. That was funny....
text.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Seared Scourge
english.objectives: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 20 Famished Scourge Trolls at Drak'Tharon.
english.description: <Hic>... gotta burn these corpshes 'fore they shtart walkin' around again.$b$bPoppa always said, only thing worshe than havin' to kill a troll is havin' ta kill a troll twice.$b$bSay,<hic>... shpeakin' of Scourge, we can't get into tha' troll keep up north 'til we get them trolls thinned out a bit.$b$bHow 'bout ya take shome o my grog here and put them bashtards outta their misery?
english.progress: Ya getter done, $N?
english.completion: Well done! Aww, come on now. That was funny....
english.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 长者玛纳洛
text.objectives: 前往因度雷村，与长者玛纳洛的雕像谈一谈。
text.description: 我的同胞们……$B$B<秘法师几乎崩溃了。>$B$B当你的灵魂飞过村子上空时，我感觉长者玛纳洛发现了你，$N，他想和你谈一谈。长者们的雕像是我们智慧的源泉，深受我们的尊敬。$B$B他一定是想要帮助我们。到村子的西北角去找他吧。
text.completion: I've been expecting you, $r. I saw your spirit fly by and sensed the mystic watching behind your eyes. Your fate and that of the Kalu'ak are now tied together.

english.title: Elder Mana'loa
english.objectives: Speak with the statue, Elder Mana'loa, at Indu'le Village.
english.description: My people....$B$B<The mystic is on the verge of breaking down.>$B$BWhile your spirit was flying through the village, I sensed that Elder Mana'loa took notice of you. $N, he wishes to speak with you. The stone elders are revered by us as fonts of ancient wisdom.$B$BThe elder must want to help. Seek him in the northwest corner of the village.
english.completion: I've been expecting you, $r. I saw your spirit fly by and sensed the mystic watching behind your eyes. Your fate and that of the Kalu'ak are now tied together.

text.title: 解脱和安息
text.objectives: 让15名因度雷海象人安息，渔夫、秘法师或是战士都行。完成任务后向因度雷村的长者玛纳洛复命。
text.description: 西面的精灵圣地已经崩裂，它们的魔法能量正在这片土地上流动，所到之处皆成废墟。$B$B由于蓝龙军团正试图控制这股法力，卡鲁亚克的亡魂们现在正处于极度的危险之中。$B$B湖中溢出的能量杀死了村中的大部分人，少数幸存下来的也都疯了。$B$B$N，你必须去释放那些灵魂，让他们离开。别去管那些发疯的人，他们也许会慢慢恢复理智的。
text.progress: <Elder Mana'loa looks through you, sensing that you have not yet completed his task.>
text.completion: Not the most pleasant task, but necessary and merciful. And now there is something else that you are destined to do for the Kalu'ak.
text.completed: Return to Elder Mana'loa at Indu'le Village in Dragonblight.

english.title: Freedom for the Lingering
english.objectives: Put to rest any combination of 15 Indu'le Fishermen, Mystics and Warriors, then return to Elder Mana'loa at Indu'le Village.
english.description: The sacred ground of the elves to the west has been torn asunder. Now their magic is moving through the land causing ruin where it flows.$B$BThe souls of the Kalu'ak are in danger as the blue dragons forces attempt to control the magic.$B$BThe power came up through the lake, instantly slaying most in the village. Those that survived were driven insane.$B$B$N, you must release these spirits so that they may move on. Leave the deranged living alone; they may yet regain their sanity in time.
english.progress: <Elder Mana'loa looks through you, sensing that you have not yet completed his task.>
english.completion: Not the most pleasant task, but necessary and merciful. And now there is something else that you are destined to do for the Kalu'ak.
english.completed: Return to Elder Mana'loa at Indu'le Village in Dragonblight.

text.title: 海洋女神
text.objectives: 与深海珍珠进行沟通，按照海之女神奥卡诺娅的指示行动。$B$B通过考验后，回到龙骨荒野的莫亚基港口，向秘法师图阿鲁复命。
text.description: 我们必须去请求水之女神奥卡诺娅的指引；只有她知道卡鲁亚克的命运会怎样。而只有深海珍珠才能把她从黑暗的虚空中召唤出来。$B$B西南方的海岸上有一座被称为海洋之巅的山峰，那颗珍珠就在山顶的祭坛上。$B$B去祭坛上祈祷吧，奥卡诺娅一定会听到你的召唤。你一定要按照她的吩咐行事，以免激怒她，给所有海象人召来灾难。$B$B如果你成功了，就去向秘法师复命吧。
text.progress: $N, you have returned!
text.completion: You spoke with Oacha'noa?! If it is her will that we stand with your people then so be it. Elder Ko'nani will accept this as our destiny, for weal or woe. My people believe that all souls are one with the magic of the world. We must oppose the blue dragon attempts to control the magic or we are all doomed! I never thought that a $r would be the champion of the Kalu'ak, but you have proven me wrong. On behalf of my people, I give you thanks, $n. May the gods smile upon you and keep you safe.
text.completed: Return to Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Conversing With the Depths
english.objectives: Commune with The Pearl of the Depths and do as the sea-goddess Oacha'noa instructs.$B$BShould you survive the ordeal, return to Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: The watery goddess, Oacha'noa, must be consulted; only she will know what the destiny of the Kalu'ak is to be. And only The Pearl of the Depths can call her forth from the murky nether.$B$BOff the coast to the southwest rises The Briny Pinnacle. Atop it sits the altar upon which the pearl rests.$B$BCommune at the altar and Oacha'noa is certain to hear your call. Do as she says lest you incur her wrath and bring ruin upon all of the tuskarr.$B$BShould you survive, return to the mystic.
english.progress: $N, you have returned!
english.completion: You spoke with Oacha'noa?! If it is her will that we stand with your people then so be it. Elder Ko'nani will accept this as our destiny, for weal or woe. My people believe that all souls are one with the magic of the world. We must oppose the blue dragon attempts to control the magic or we are all doomed! I never thought that a $r would be the champion of the Kalu'ak, but you have proven me wrong. On behalf of my people, I give you thanks, $n. May the gods smile upon you and keep you safe.
english.completed: Return to Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 萨鲁法尔的信
text.objectives: 阅读萨鲁法尔给你的信，然后摧毁它。$B$B做完这件事情之后与信使托弗斯谈一谈。
text.description: <托弗斯一边与你握手，一边悄悄塞给你一只信封。>$B$B<托弗斯压低了声音对你说道。>$B$B假装什么事也没发生，$N。$B$B能在这里找到你真好，士兵！毫无疑问，地狱咆哮大人将最优秀的士兵派给了阿格玛大人！$B$B<托弗斯继续压低声音说道。>$B$B读了这封信之后就在我旁边的火盆上把它烧掉。
text.progress: We will crush the Scourge!
text.completion: So we are understood? I will return to my lord and tell him that you have accepted.
text.end: Letter from Saurfang read and destroyed
text.completed: Speak to Messenger Torvus at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Message from the West
english.objectives: Read the Letter from Saurfang and then destroy it.$B$BSpeak to Messenger Torvus once you have completed this task.
english.description: <Torvus shakes your hand, giving you a letter in the process.>$B$B<Torvus speaks under his breath.>$B$BJust play along, $N.$B$BIt is good to see you here, soldier! Lord Hellscream has undoubtedly sent his strongest warriors to Lord Agmar!$B$B<Torvus speaks under his breath.>$B$BRead it and then destroy it in the fire pot next to me.
english.progress: We will crush the Scourge!
english.completion: So we are understood? I will return to my lord and tell him that you have accepted.
english.end: Letter from Saurfang read and destroyed
english.completed: Speak to Messenger Torvus at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 胜利将近……
text.objectives: 与阿格玛之锤的军士长祖托克谈一谈。
text.description: 目前这个地区内，对我们构成威胁的天灾军团基地只有两个。一个是东边漂浮在联盟要塞暮冬城上方的恐怖之城纳克萨玛斯，而另一个就是艾卓-尼鲁布的兵力输送点，纳尔苏深渊。前几天，正是从纳尔苏深渊中涌出的大量阿努巴尔蛛魔突袭了冰雾村，并几乎将那里夷为平地。$B$B现在，我们的目标就是彻底毁灭阿努巴尔蛛魔，并将纳尔苏深渊封锁起来。$B$B去向军士长祖托克报告，领取你的作战任务简报吧。
text.completion: By land and by air, that's how we will end the Anub'ar threat.

english.title: Victory Nears...
english.objectives: Speak to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: There remain only two primary threats that stand in our way. One is the dread citadel of Naxxramas, far to the east, above the Alliance fortress of Wintergarde and the other is the Pit of Narjun, exit point for the undead armies of Azjol'Nerub. It is from the Pit of Narjun that the Anub'ar Nerubians assaulted and ultimately razed the taunka village of Icemist.$B$BWe will destroy the Anub'ar and close off the Pit of Narjun.$B$BReport to Senior Sergeant Juktok for your mission orders.
english.completion: By land and by air, that's how we will end the Anub'ar threat.

text.title: 重新装配
text.objectives: 致远郡的耶雷米亚·霍宁要你打倒5个收割采集者，并使用耶雷米亚的工具重新组装它们。
text.description: 好，我明白了！重新组装的活儿有点复杂，但还有什么事能难倒像你这么聪明的$C呢。$B$B带上我的工具，去打倒一些收割采集者。等它们停止运转以后，使用工具把所有的红色线路接到蓝色接口里，这样它们就会进入自动防卫模式。快去，$N。再拖延下去的话，就没有活人需要我们去拯救了。
text.progress: You done yet, $N?
text.completion: Nice job!  I finally feel useful again... and that's sayin' something.
text.completed: Return to Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Repurposed Technology
english.objectives: Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire wants you to destroy 5 Harvest Collectors and then use Jeremiah's Tools to rewire them.
english.description: Ok, I've got it!  The rewiring is a little complicated, but nothing a clever $c like you can't handle.$B$BTake my tools and put some of the harvest collectors out of commission.  Once they're down use the tools to plug all the red wires into the blue sockets.  That'll make them go into self-defense mode.  Hurry, $N.  Before long there won't be anything left to save.
english.progress: You done yet, $N?
english.completion: Nice job!  I finally feel useful again... and that's sayin' something.
english.completed: Return to Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 艾卓-尼鲁布的深渊
text.objectives: 探索纳尔苏深渊，并将你的发现汇报给阿格玛之锤的军士长祖托克。
text.description: The undead Nerubians that attacked Icemist Village came from a gigantic sinkhole known as the Pit of Narjun. If left alone, those fiends will no doubt flank our forces at the Wrathgate and end our march to victory.$B$BI need eyes on the ground, $N. You are to head west and investigate the Pit of Narjun. We need to locate their primary exit point and seal it off! Find me that location.$B$B
text.completion: That damned sinkhole must be directly connected to Azjol-Nerub. This is worse than I thought. Seek and destroy... That'll be the next course of action.
text.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: From the Depths of Azjol-Nerub
english.objectives: Explore the Pit of Narjun and return with your findings to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: The undead Nerubians that attacked Icemist Village came from a gigantic sinkhole known as the Pit of Narjun. If left alone, those fiends will no doubt flank our forces at the Wrathgate and end our march to victory.$B$BI need eyes on the ground, $N. You are to head west and investigate the Pit of Narjun. We need to locate their primary exit point and seal it off! Find me that location.$B$B
english.completion: That damned sinkhole must be directly connected to Azjol-Nerub. This is worse than I thought. Seek and destroy... That'll be the next course of action.
english.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 搜寻和营救
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的马克希望你前往达克萨隆，看看库塞尔到底出了什么事。
text.description: 女兽人……她们就是不愿意听别人的意见——嗝儿，懂我什么意思吗，$C？$B$B库塞尔和我们在一起共事很多年了。你知道我们做事的方法：引诱一些傻兮兮的冒险者去做危险的工作，等到确认没有危险了，我们再去捡宝贝。这有什么难懂的？$B$B可是她却偏不这样……这个急躁的绿皮女人偏要亲自去处理。也许她现在已经挂了，不过如果我们不去找她的话，我没准会厌恶我自己。话又说回来，我是绝不会亲自去的——嗝儿。$B$B你怎么说，朋友？
text.completion: I knew it! Even my going missing wasn't enough to get those spineless weasels to come in here after me. Well, they sent you. I suppose that's something.... Here, take this. I'd rather it go to you than to those dimwits back at the camp.

english.title: Search and Rescue
english.objectives: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to go into Drak'Tharon and find out what became of Kurzel.
english.description: Orc women... they just don't lissen - hic. Know what I mean, $r?$b$bKurzel's been with us fer years. You'd think she'd get a feel fer how we do things by now. Lure the fools in fer the dangerous work, then reap the rewards when it's safe. What's so hard to understand?$b$bNot her though... impatient green-skin goes off and takes matters into her own hands. Probably dead by now, but I'd feel horrible if we didn't follow after her, and I'm in no shape to do it myself - hic.$b$bSo whatdya say, pal?
english.completion: I knew it! Even my going missing wasn't enough to get those spineless weasels to come in here after me. Well, they sent you. I suppose that's something.... Here, take this. I'd rather it go to you than to those dimwits back at the camp.

text.title: 净化天灾巨魔
text.objectives: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 30 Famished Scourge Trolls.
text.description: Whatcha waitin' fer, $c? Them shcourged trolls ain't gunna kill themselves!$b$bYou know the drill. Git up ta Drak'Tharon up north... Take some o thish here grog and hurl it at 'em from a distance...<hic>.  Then jusht sit back an' watch 'em burn.
text.progress: Ya getter done, $N?
text.completion: Well done! Aww, come on now. That was funny...hic.
text.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Seared Scourge
english.objectives: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 30 Famished Scourge Trolls.
english.description: Whatcha waitin' fer, $c? Them shcourged trolls ain't gunna kill themselves!$b$bYou know the drill. Git up ta Drak'Tharon up north... Take some o thish here grog and hurl it at 'em from a distance...<hic>.  Then jusht sit back an' watch 'em burn.
english.progress: Ya getter done, $N?
english.completion: Well done! Aww, come on now. That was funny...hic.
english.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 尤格-萨隆的黑血
text.objectives: 阿格玛之锤的伯鲁斯·折铁要求你收集10份尤格-萨隆黑血样本。
text.description: 天谴之门安加萨……我曾无数次看见那道金属巨门的表面如同有生命一般跳动、起伏！五十多年来，我从未见过金属会这样“呼吸”。$B$B恐怕只有海象人略略了解其中的秘密，他们将其称为“尤格-萨隆的黑血”，还让我对其敬而远之。$B$B冰雾村外面有一处蛛魔的虫孔，纳尔苏深渊。我听说这个虫孔里面有很多这种奇特的金属矿石，如果你顺路的话，能不能帮我取些矿石的样本回来？
text.progress: What's life without risks?
text.completion: It's so light... As if it weighs nothing at all! I'll need time to analyze the metal and see if I can do anything with it! Tests! I need to run tests! I'll keep in contact, $n. If anything comes of this, you'll be the first to know.
text.completed: Return to Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Black Blood of Yogg-Saron
english.objectives: Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 Black Blood of Yogg-Saron Samples.
english.description: Angrathar, the Wrathgate... I watched as the metal holding the gate together pulsed and undulated as if it were alive! In 50 years I've never seen metal "breathe."$B$BOnly ones who knew anything about it were the tuskarr. They called it the "Black Blood of Yogg-Saron" and told me to keep my distance.$B$BThere's a sinkhole outside Icemist Village to the west called the Pit of Narjun. I've heard of these sinkholes being rich with this strange ore. If you head that way, could you try and get me some samples?
english.progress: What's life without risks?
english.completion: It's so light... As if it weighs nothing at all! I'll need time to analyze the metal and see if I can do anything with it! Tests! I need to run tests! I'll keep in contact, $n. If anything comes of this, you'll be the first to know.
english.completed: Return to Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 阿尔萨斯的死敌
text.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in the Dragonblight has asked that you slay 6 Anub'ar Underlords.$B$B
text.description: 我们已经深陷内战的漩涡，无法自拔。在地下，我族中仅存的生者正在挣扎着避免逐渐迫近的灭绝厄运。巫妖王不惜一切代价想要彻底统治伟大的艾卓-尼拉布王国，所有拒绝侍奉巫妖王的人都将被天灾军团消灭。$B$B阿尔萨斯是我族与你们共同的敌人……$B$B帮助我们……帮助我们净化这里，净化阿努巴尔蛛魔的玷污！让阿努巴拉克听到它们死亡时的凄惨哀嚎吧！
text.progress: The Azjol Empire will rise again!
text.completion: There are thousands more and they spill out from every dark crevice in Northrend. Alone you stand no chance, but together... Maybe...
text.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

english.title: An Enemy in Arthas
english.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in the Dragonblight has asked that you slay 6 Anub'ar Underlords.$B$B
english.description: We are in the midst of a civil war. At the heart of this world the last living members of my species defend themselves against total annihilation. The Lich King seeks to rule the kingdom of Azjol-Nerub at any cost. Those that do not acquiesce are branded enemies of the Scourge and marked for death.$B$BIn Arthas we both have an enemy...$B$BJoin our cause and rid this place of the taint of Anub'ar! Let Anub'arak himself hear the anguish of their death cries!
english.progress: The Azjol Empire will rise again!
english.completion: There are thousands more and they spill out from every dark crevice in Northrend. Alone you stand no chance, but together... Maybe...
english.completed: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

text.title: 失落的帝国
text.objectives: 将基里克斯的作战计划带到东边的阿格玛之锤去，交给阿格玛大王。
text.description: You have proven that you are willing to assist the Azjol Empire in its time of need and as such the Azjol Empire will assist the Horde.$B$BTake this scroll back to your leader. It documents the strengths and weaknesses of the Nerubians attacking Icemist Village. Consider it a gesture of good faith - a willingness to help your people. Use the knowledge on those pages to crush the Anub'ar and you will have done a service for us all.$B$BFarewell, $r.$B$B
text.progress: What have you got there?
text.completion: Is this what I think it is? With the information contained within these pages we will CRUSH the Anub'ar assault! You have done well to bring this document to me, $n. Perhaps you will be allowed to watch or even participate in the final battle at Angrathar! LOK'TAR!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Lost Empire
english.objectives: Deliver Kilix's Battle Plan to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer to the east.
english.description: You have proven that you are willing to assist the Azjol Empire in its time of need and as such the Azjol Empire will assist the Horde.$B$BTake this scroll back to your leader. It documents the strengths and weaknesses of the Nerubians attacking Icemist Village. Consider it a gesture of good faith - a willingness to help your people. Use the knowledge on those pages to crush the Anub'ar and you will have done a service for us all.$B$BFarewell, $r.$B$B
english.progress: What have you got there?
english.completion: Is this what I think it is? With the information contained within these pages we will CRUSH the Anub'ar assault! You have done well to bring this document to me, $n. Perhaps you will be allowed to watch or even participate in the final battle at Angrathar! LOK'TAR!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 古树精华宝石
text.objectives: 达库鲁希望你前往蓝天伐木场的最上层房间，在一个地精的尸体附近找到古树精华宝石。
text.description: 远古的秘密被我揭开了！$B$B<达库鲁通过预言者之眼观察着。>$B$B啊，命运之神真是眷顾啊。你能认识我真是走大运了。$B$B就在那里，我看到了，朋友！古树精华宝石，这实在太轻松了……$B$B喏，东面不远处有具地精尸体，就在一排枯树附近的一栋建筑物里，你可以在尸体旁找到古树精华宝石。$B$B快一点，朋友，别让其他人抢了先！
text.completion: This unfortunate goblin must have unearthed the Heart of the Ancients during his excavations in the region. It's doubtless that he had no clue as to its nature. You determine that it must have been overlooked in the chaos sweeping through the area.

english.title: Heart of the Ancients
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to go to the uppermost chamber at Blue Sky Logging Ground and find the Heart of the Ancients.
english.description: Secrets of da ages, be revealed to me now!$b$b<Drakuru peers through the Eye of the Prophets.>$b$bAhh, great be mah destiny, $n. You be lucky ta know me....$b$bThere! I be seein' it, mon. The Heart of the Ancients. Dis be too easy!$b$bYou gunna find da heart lyin' near da corpse of a goblin east of here. He be up in a chamber, near a river of broken trees.$b$bHurry, mon, before someone else be findin' it!
english.completion: This unfortunate goblin must have unearthed the Heart of the Ancients during his excavations in the region. It's doubtless that he had no clue as to its nature. You determine that it must have been overlooked in the chaos sweeping through the area.

text.title: 诺兹拉斯的防御
text.objectives: 在迦拉克隆之墓附近的挖掘站内杀死12个废土挖掘者和1个废土工头。完成任务之后向诺兹拉斯哨站的纳尔弗复命。
text.description: 你，$C！南边那些亡灵整天对我们骚扰不休，我们的工作受到了很大的影响。去把它们都干掉，行不行？
text.progress: Huh? Who are you? What do you want?
text.completion: Oh!  Yeah, the undead.  Here's your coin, bugger off.
text.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Nozzlerust Defense
english.objectives: Kill 12 Wastes Diggers and 1 Wastes Taskmaster at the digs surrounding Galakrond's Rest.  Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post when the task is complete.
english.description: You, $c!  These undead south of us are being a constant nuisance to our work.  Go clear them out, will ya?
english.progress: Huh? Who are you? What do you want?
english.completion: Oh!  Yeah, the undead.  Here's your coin, bugger off.
english.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 囤积绷带
text.objectives: 在迦拉克隆之墓附近的挖掘站内收集8堆合金矿石，把它们交给诺兹拉斯哨站的辛克。
text.description: Hello hello!  The Scourge to the south are digging up some ancient dragon thing.  I could care less why they're doing it, but they're pulling cartloads of composite ore in the process.$b$bGo lift me a bunch of that ore.  That stuff should yield a pretty penny for all the weapons the Horde are crafting.$B$B
text.progress: Did you get the ore?  My carrier will be back shortly - we need to get this shipment out while the fight's still going!
text.completion: Hah!  That's quite a load!  Your back feeling alright?
text.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Stocking Up
english.objectives: Gather 8 bundles of Composite Ore from the digs surrounding Galakrond's Rest and bring them to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.
english.description: Hello hello!  The Scourge to the south are digging up some ancient dragon thing.  I could care less why they're doing it, but they're pulling cartloads of composite ore in the process.$b$bGo lift me a bunch of that ore.  That stuff should yield a pretty penny for all the weapons the Horde are crafting.$B$B
english.progress: Did you get the ore?  My carrier will be back shortly - we need to get this shipment out while the fight's still going!
english.completion: Hah!  That's quite a load!  Your back feeling alright?
english.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 刨冰
text.objectives: 在北边的冰元素身上收集4块碎冰簇，把它们交给诺兹拉斯哨站的希弗里克斯。
text.description: I've never seen you before... are you new to the Vice?  Glad to have you.  I could always use some more hands.$b$bYou get the materials, I'll finish my machine, then we can sell it to those commander types and all go home rich.$b$bI actually have most of the primary components, so I just need some of the materials for the weapon itself.  Narf said that jagged ice shards from those elementals to the north would make perfect shrapnel for my bombs - go nab some, will ya?$B$B
text.progress: Do you have the shards?  I'm almost finished with the main refrigeration unit.
text.completion: Excellent!  They're even sharper than I expected them to be.  I'll pack them in the snow until the bomb is ready.$b$bLet's see... what next...$B$B
text.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Shaved Ice
english.objectives: Collect 4 Ice Shard Clusters from Ice Elementals in the north and bring them to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post.
english.description: I've never seen you before... are you new to the Vice?  Glad to have you.  I could always use some more hands.$b$bYou get the materials, I'll finish my machine, then we can sell it to those commander types and all go home rich.$b$bI actually have most of the primary components, so I just need some of the materials for the weapon itself.  Narf said that jagged ice shards from those elementals to the north would make perfect shrapnel for my bombs - go nab some, will ya?$B$B
english.progress: Do you have the shards?  I'm almost finished with the main refrigeration unit.
english.completion: Excellent!  They're even sharper than I expected them to be.  I'll pack them in the snow until the bomb is ready.$b$bLet's see... what next...$B$B
english.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 柔软的包装
text.objectives: 从诺兹拉斯哨站附近的掘洞冰虫或龙骨秃鹫身上收集12张薄兽皮，把它们交给希弗里克斯。
text.description: I need some new packaging for the shrapnel bombs.  All the stuff I have is too hard and the shrapnel doesn't spread when it bursts.  $b$bWhat we need is some really thin animal hide.  Those jormungar tunnelers to the west might work... or perhaps the condors sifting through the dragon bones.  Go get me whatever you can find.$B$B
text.progress: How goes the hunt?  Do you have my hides?
text.completion: Good... good... these should do fine.  The shrapnel bombs are almost finished. $b$bWait... what happened to my ice shards?  Narf told me shards from those elementals should be enchanted, but they're melting just like the ones hanging from Narf's grumpy chin!
text.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Soft Packaging
english.objectives: Collect 12 Thin Animal Hides from the Jormungar Tunnelers or the Dragonbone Condors near Nozzlerust Post.  Once you've located the hides, return them to Zivlix.
english.description: I need some new packaging for the shrapnel bombs.  All the stuff I have is too hard and the shrapnel doesn't spread when it bursts.  $b$bWhat we need is some really thin animal hide.  Those jormungar tunnelers to the west might work... or perhaps the condors sifting through the dragon bones.  Go get me whatever you can find.$B$B
english.progress: How goes the hunt?  Do you have my hides?
english.completion: Good... good... these should do fine.  The shrapnel bombs are almost finished. $b$bWait... what happened to my ice shards?  Narf told me shards from those elementals should be enchanted, but they're melting just like the ones hanging from Narf's grumpy chin!
english.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 不会融化的东西
text.objectives: 在诺兹拉斯哨站东边的巨龙骸骨堆里收集12块破碎的骨片。
text.description: 不行不行不行！这些冰块完全不行！它们在爆炸之前就全融化成水了。见鬼，这是我最后一次上纳尔弗的当了。这意味着我们要完全另找一种材料来制作破片。$B$B嗯……啊……我知道了！我真是个天才！骨头的碎片就可以呀！$B$B这周围到处都是冰虫啃过的骨头，尺寸和形状都不错。你快去看看，给我找些骨头碎片回来。
text.progress: Were there any splinters to be found?
text.completion: Excellent!  That should be the last thing I need to test out the new bombs.  Just a moment and I'll try this out!
text.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Something That Doesn't Melt
english.objectives: Search the dragon bones east of Nozzlerust Post for 12 Splintered Bone Chunks.
english.description: No no no! Those ice shards didn't work at all! They'll melt before they even do any damage. That's the last time I'll trust Narf's word on materials. This means we need something else entirely for the shrapnel.$b$bI know! I'm brilliant. Bone splinters.$b$bThere are some bones all around here that the jormungar have been gnawing on pretty thoroughly. Go check them out and see if you can find me some splintered bone that I can use.
english.progress: Were there any splinters to be found?
english.completion: Excellent!  That should be the last thing I need to test out the new bombs.  Just a moment and I'll try this out!
english.completed: Return to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 天灾的装备
text.objectives: 阿格玛之锤的伯鲁斯·折铁要求你给他带回8套天灾军备。
text.description: 这该死的天灾矿石，我完全想不出来该怎么搞。你看，它根本不熔化！而且，我费尽了力气，也没法让这些金属的外形改变一丁点！$B$B看来，我必须搞一些铸造好的天灾军团武器装备，好好分析研究一下，才能弄清楚这些东西到底是怎么造出来的。$B$B冰雾村里面现在盘踞着大量披盔带甲的蛛魔，它们身上的盔甲就是不错的样品，去帮我弄一些来！只要你肯出手帮忙，我没准可以从这些矿石里捣鼓出一些名堂来。$B$B冰雾村就在西边，快去吧。
text.progress: These are useless!
text.completion: These are in excellent condition, $n. I'll get to work right away. If anything comes of this, you will be the first to know!
text.completed: Return to Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Scourge Armaments
english.objectives: Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to bring him 8 Scourge Armaments.
english.description: I can't make a damned thing out of this ore. It simply will not hold together! Despite my best efforts the Scourge metal will not bend!$B$BPerhaps if I had some samples of some forged Scourge armaments I might be able to reverse engineer the process by which the items are created.$B$BIcemist Village is crawling with armored Scourge Nerubians. Go there and get me some Scourge armaments! With your help I might actually succeed in creating something from this ore.$B$BYou'll find Icemist to the west.
english.progress: These are useless!
english.completion: These are in excellent condition, $n. I'll get to work right away. If anything comes of this, you will be the first to know!
english.completed: Return to Borus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 难以下咽
text.objectives: 在诺兹拉斯哨站东面与巨大的冰虫作战，直到它张开嘴，然后将高能炸药扔进它的嘴里。爆炸之后，收集6块烧焦的冰虫肉，把它们交给辛克。
text.description: 部队显然需要超大量的食物补给才能满足士兵们的胃。$B$B在这种常规食材极端稀匮乏的环境下，我不得不跟你分享一个机密，一般情况像你这种胆小的$R食客绝对不可能知道的机密。你不知道吧，那些冰虫的肉其实味道很棒，像鸡肉。$B$B你去东边引一只巨大的冰虫出来，显然你不可能采取传统方式干掉它，但只要使用这个小工具，趁它张大嘴的时候直接扔进它的喉咙里就可以了。你能背多少肉，就带多少回来。
text.progress: Did ya get it all?  You certainly stink of it.
text.completion: Ha ha!  One of those meat slabs landed clear over here!  Nice work there!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Hard to Swallow
english.objectives: Battle a Hulking Jormungar east of Nozzlerust Post until it opens its mouth, then throw a Potent Explosive Charge into its throat. After it explodes, collect 6 slabs of Seared Jormungar Meat off of the ground and bring them back to Xink.
english.description: Those troops are sure to be needin' a hefty supply of food in their bellies.$B$BI'll let you in on a little secret that a squeamish $r like you would never know... those jormungar worms taste just like chicken.$b$bGo provoke one of those giant hulking jormungar to the east.  You're not likely to be able to kill one straight out, so just toss this down its throat when it opens its mouth wide.  Bring me back as many of the slabs of meat as you can tote.
english.progress: Did ya get it all?  You certainly stink of it.
english.completion: Ha ha!  One of those meat slabs landed clear over here!  Nice work there!$B$B
english.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 抢木材
text.objectives: 前往北边的鹰身人巢穴，使用辛克的伐木机控制器召唤出一只伐木机器人。从该区域的树上收集50捆木材，然后把它们交给诺兹拉斯哨站的辛克。$B$B如果你弄丢了辛克的伐木机控制器，就去找诺兹拉斯哨站的辛克再要一个。
text.description: Next up, we need to haul in some lumber for all the towers the Alliance are building.  There are some thin trees to the south, but the trees the Harpies are nesting in to the north look much more fit for structures.$b$bTake this.  When you get to the Harpy nesting area, use the control and one of my Shredders should come to you.  Gather as much lumber as it can carry.  The Harpies are sure to disagree with you chopping down their homes - just deal with them as necessary.$b$bHop to it!
text.progress: Where's that carrier?  Hope the Jormungar didn't get him.  He was carrying a good sized load that time.
text.completion: If a tree falls in the forest, and you can't hear it through the saw blade, does it really make a sound?
text.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Lumber Hack
english.objectives: Use Xink's Shredder Control Device to call a Shredder once you reach the Harpy Nesting Grounds in the North.  Gather 50 Bundles of Lumber from the trees in the area, and then return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.$B$BShould you lose Xink's Shredder Control Device, speak to Xink at Nozzlerust Post to obtain a new one.
english.description: Next up, we need to haul in some lumber for all the towers the Alliance are building.  There are some thin trees to the south, but the trees the Harpies are nesting in to the north look much more fit for structures.$b$bTake this.  When you get to the Harpy nesting area, use the control and one of my Shredders should come to you.  Gather as much lumber as it can carry.  The Harpies are sure to disagree with you chopping down their homes - just deal with them as necessary.$b$bHop to it!
english.progress: Where's that carrier?  Hope the Jormungar didn't get him.  He was carrying a good sized load that time.
english.completion: If a tree falls in the forest, and you can't hear it through the saw blade, does it really make a sound?
english.completed: Return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: Rustling Some Feathers
text.objectives: Kill 20 Harpies Northwest of Nozzlerust Post for Narf at Nozzlerust Post.
text.description: Those harpies have slowed our profits long enough!  Kill them all.
text.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Rustling Some Feathers
english.objectives: Kill 20 Harpies Northwest of Nozzlerust Post for Narf at Nozzlerust Post.
english.description: Those harpies have slowed our profits long enough!  Kill them all.
english.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 该死的鹰身人！
text.objectives: 前往诺兹拉斯哨站西北方的山地中，杀死冷风女王和15个冷风女巫。完成任务之后向纳尔弗复命。$B$B如果你需要辛克的伐木机控制器，就去找诺兹拉斯哨站的辛克。
text.description: $C，你看到那个鹰身人没有？就是它率领手下，对我们派去天谴之门的补给车队发动了袭击！我在冷风高地见过它！$B$B看来这些鸟人是不想活了！杀光它们！
text.progress: I remember you. You're not dead, so those harpy wretches better be.
text.completion: That should make those uglies think twice.  Here... take your reward and get away with ya.
text.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

english.title: Harp on This!
english.objectives: Kill the Mistress of the Coldwind and 15 Coldwind harpies in the mountains northwest of Nozzlerust Post. Return to Narf once the task is complete.$B$BShould you be in need of Xink's Shredder Control Device, speak to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.
english.description: $C, did you see that? That's the harpy that's been leading the attack on our shipments to the gate! I've seen her in the back of Coldwind Heights before.$B$B Those harpies have slowed our profits long enough! Kill them all.
english.progress: I remember you. You're not dead, so those harpy wretches better be.
english.completion: That should make those uglies think twice.  Here... take your reward and get away with ya.
english.completed: Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post in Dragonblight.

text.title: 部落的力量
text.objectives: 阿格玛之锤的军士长祖托克要求你在冰雾村使用战歌军旗，并确保它免遭一切攻击。$B$B完成任务之后，将战歌军旗还给军士长祖托克。
text.description: 现在，牦牛人决定与我们并肩作战。我们必须体现出部落的团结与互助精神，为他们夺回冰雾村。$B$B冰雾村就在阿格玛之锤的西方，就在山脚下。立刻到那边去，对那里的阿努巴尔蛛魔发起攻击！你要把我们最高贵最神圣的部落旗帜插在冰雾村的土地上，并消灭一切试图亵渎它的敌人！$B$B让阿努巴尔蛛魔感受一下部落的真正力量吧！让我们的战旗成为它们死前见到的最后一样东西！
text.progress: It is a challenge, $n!
text.completion: We have crushed them by land! Soon we will crush them by air!
text.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Might of the Horde
english.objectives: Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Warsong Battle Standard at Icemist Village and defend it against attackers.$B$BReturn the Warsong Battle Standard when you are finished.
english.description: The taunka are now our brothers in arms. We must show our solidarity and retake Icemist Village.$B$BYou will find Icemist Village west of Agmar's Hammer, sitting at the foot of the mountains. Travel there and challenge the Anub'ar Nerubians! Plant our beloved Horde banner at Icemist Village and destroy all that dare come to tear it down!$B$BLet the Anub'ar feel the true might of the Horde! Let our battle standard be the last thing that they see before death!
english.progress: It is a challenge, $n!
english.completion: We have crushed them by land! Soon we will crush them by air!
english.completed: Return to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: Deciphering the Journal
text.objectives: Bring a sprig of Spiritsbreath to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: Vor'takh is right -- we cannot allow this opportunity to slip through our fingers.$B$BFortunately, I think I know of a way to translate the journal of this Brann.$B$BThe shamans of the Redfang furbolgs, who congregate at the Heart's Blood Shrine south of the camp, grow an herb known as spiritsbreath. An experienced mystic can use incense made from it to seek wisdom from the spirits of the ancestors.$B$BSeek out the shaman known as Grumbald One-Eye. He should carry the herb for his devotions to Ursoc.
text.progress: Have you brought sufficient quantities of the herb?
text.completion: Well done, $n. I'll prepare the incense and then we'll see what exactly this royal dwarf was doing so far from home.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Deciphering the Journal
english.objectives: Bring a sprig of Spiritsbreath to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.
english.description: Vor'takh is right -- we cannot allow this opportunity to slip through our fingers.$B$BFortunately, I think I know of a way to translate the journal of this Brann.$B$BThe shamans of the Redfang furbolgs, who congregate at the Heart's Blood Shrine south of the camp, grow an herb known as spiritsbreath. An experienced mystic can use incense made from it to seek wisdom from the spirits of the ancestors.$B$BSeek out the shaman known as Grumbald One-Eye. He should carry the herb for his devotions to Ursoc.
english.progress: Have you brought sufficient quantities of the herb?
english.completion: Well done, $n. I'll prepare the incense and then we'll see what exactly this royal dwarf was doing so far from home.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 奇怪的设备
text.objectives: 将古拉莫什的奇怪设备带回群星之墓，交给大法师茉德拉的影像。
text.description: 你拣起了这个奇怪的设备，并且立刻断定它充满着魔力。但它似乎并没有任何用处。$B$B也许眠月花园东面群星之墓那里的大法师略知一二？
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: $n, if I'm not mistaken, you've uncovered the key to allow us to discern exactly what the mage hunter forces are up to!
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: A Strange Device
english.objectives: Deliver Goramosh's Strange Device to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: Picking up this strange device, you are certain that it is magical in nature. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to connote any other kind of use.$B$BPerhaps the archmage back at Stars' Rest to the east of the Moonrest Gardens would be able to tell what it's used for?
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: $n, if I'm not mistaken, you've uncovered the key to allow us to discern exactly what the mage hunter forces are up to!
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 死亡名单：高阶教徒扎古斯
text.objectives: 杀死高阶教徒扎古斯，并将高阶教徒扎古斯的徽记带回龙骨荒野的阿格玛之锤，交给高尔特上尉。
text.description: I witnessed his treachery with my own eyes! The traitor led an Anub'ar assault on this stronghold, taking out some of my best soldiers.$B$B<Gort shakes his head.>$B$BHe'd been working with the Scourge the whole time and we didn't have a clue! How many more like Zangus are there? We'll find 'em all and when we do...$B$B<Gort makes a cutting motion across his neck.>$B$BFirst on the list is Zangus. Our scouts report that he is hiding in The Pit of Narjun, west of here. Find him, kill him, bring me his head.$B$B
text.progress: Is that a severed orc head in your pack or are you just happy to see me?
text.completion: I told you we'd get you... Here's your reward, $c. That's one less headache for us to worry about.
text.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: Marked for Death: High Cultist Zangus
english.objectives: Kill High Cultist Zangus and return High Cultist Zangus's Head to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
english.description: I witnessed his treachery with my own eyes! The traitor led an Anub'ar assault on this stronghold, taking out some of my best soldiers.$B$B<Gort shakes his head.>$B$BHe'd been working with the Scourge the whole time and we didn't have a clue! How many more like Zangus are there? We'll find 'em all and when we do...$B$B<Gort makes a cutting motion across his neck.>$B$BFirst on the list is Zangus. Our scouts report that he is hiding in The Pit of Narjun, west of here. Find him, kill him, bring me his head.$B$B
english.progress: Is that a severed orc head in your pack or are you just happy to see me?
english.completion: I told you we'd get you... Here's your reward, $c. That's one less headache for us to worry about.
english.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 血之魔典
text.objectives: 将血之魔典交给阿格玛之锤的高尔特上尉。
text.description: 这本书似乎是以特殊的材料写成，历久弥新。仔细阅读之后，你发现书页上充斥着某种奇特符号。$B$B无论这本书里究竟写的是什么，它一定都是非常重要的内容。立刻把它带回冰雾村东边的阿格玛之锤，交给高尔特上尉。
text.progress: <Gort raises an eyebrow.>
text.completion: Savages... Bound in orc flesh... This language... Its existence has never been proven. It is the language of death... The tongue of the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Flesh-Bound Tome
english.objectives: Return the Flesh-bound Tome to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: The tome is bound in flesh and appears to be bleeding. Upon examination you discover page after page filled with strange symbols that appear to be written in blood.$B$BWhatever knowledge is held within the pages of this tome could be important. Return it to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer, east of Icemist Village.
english.progress: <Gort raises an eyebrow.>
english.completion: Savages... Bound in orc flesh... This language... Its existence has never been proven. It is the language of death... The tongue of the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 符文中的预言
text.objectives: Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
text.description: Brann's journal also contained a guide to iron dwarf symbols. I've inscribed these on a keystone which will help you to understand the words inscribed on the rune plates.$B$BFrom the journal entries, it seems Brann may be chasing after clues to the origins of his people. Keep your eyes open for any clues as to his destination.$B$BReturn to Thor Modan, northeast of here, stand before each of the plates, and use the stone to determine the contents of each. We can't allow the Alliance to find him first.
text.progress: Have you discovered Thor Modan's secrets?
text.completion: So Brann thinks he's discovered a new titan city? 'The cradle of stone and iron.' 'Ulduar nestled in the storm.' I will ask the chieftain to dispatch longrunners to the Storm Peaks. My people know these lands well and have the best chance of tracking down this wayward dwarf.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Runic Prophecies
english.objectives: Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
english.description: Brann's journal also contained a guide to iron dwarf symbols. I've inscribed these on a keystone which will help you to understand the words inscribed on the rune plates.$B$BFrom the journal entries, it seems Brann may be chasing after clues to the origins of his people. Keep your eyes open for any clues as to his destination.$B$BReturn to Thor Modan, northeast of here, stand before each of the plates, and use the stone to determine the contents of each. We can't allow the Alliance to find him first.
english.progress: Have you discovered Thor Modan's secrets?
english.completion: So Brann thinks he's discovered a new titan city? 'The cradle of stone and iron.' 'Ulduar nestled in the storm.' I will ask the chieftain to dispatch longrunners to the Storm Peaks. My people know these lands well and have the best chance of tracking down this wayward dwarf.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 奇怪的设备
text.objectives: 将古拉莫什的奇怪设备带回阿格玛之锤，交给大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像。
text.description: 你拣起了这个奇怪的设备，并且立刻断定它充满着魔力。但它似乎并没有任何用处。$B$B也许眠月花园东北面阿格玛之锤那里的大法师略知一二？
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: $n, if I'm not mistaken, you've uncovered the key to allow us to discern exactly what the mage hunter forces are up to!
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: A Strange Device
english.objectives: Deliver Goramosh's Strange Device to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: Picking up this strange device, you are certain that it is magical in nature. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to connote any other kind of use.$B$BPerhaps the archmage back at Agmar's Hammer to the northeast of the Moonrest Gardens would be able to tell what it's used for?
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: $n, if I'm not mistaken, you've uncovered the key to allow us to discern exactly what the mage hunter forces are up to!
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像

text.title: 投影和计划
text.objectives: 靠近并观察漂浮在眠月花园上空的湍流之针上的物品。$B$B完成任务后返回群星之墓，向大法师茉德拉的影像汇报你的发现。
text.description: 这是一件传送装置。如果要我说的话，它多半通往漂浮在西面眠月花园上空的湍流之针平台。$B$B我打算派你去用它调查一下那里。这种设备似乎是双向的，这样你就不用从平台上跳下来了。$B$B我猜想等你传送到湍流之针后，会看到一些与之关联的设备。$B$B我觉得你应该能在眠月花园内的任何地方使用这件传送装置。
text.progress: 这么快就回来了？
text.completion: What you're describing... that's a projection of the Arcanomicon! The Arcanomicon is a map of all of the magical ley line intersections in the world. The blue dragonflight has been using it to find and destroy ley line 'anchors' to send the magical power back to the Nexus. The question is, why is the path of destruction leading east when it should be heading west instead?
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Object on the Surge Needle observed

english.title: Projections and Plans
english.objectives: Get close to and observe the projection atop the Surge Needle floating above Moonrest Gardens.$B$BAfterward, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest with the information.
english.description: This is a teleportation device. If I had to guess, I'd say that it leads to the surge needle platform floating above the Moonrest Gardens to the west.$B$BI need you to use it to investigate what's up there. It appears that the device works both ways so you shouldn't have to jump off.$B$BI expect that once you teleport to the top of the surge needle, there will be some sort of apparatus on it to observe.$B$BYou should be able to use the teleporter from anywhere within the gardens.
english.completion: What you're describing... that's a projection of the Arcanomicon! The Arcanomicon is a map of all of the magical ley line intersections in the world. The blue dragonflight has been using it to find and destroy ley line 'anchors' to send the magical power back to the Nexus. The question is, why is the path of destruction leading east when it should be heading west instead?
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Object on the Surge Needle observed

text.title: 侮辱科林·烈酒
text.objectives: 与科林·烈酒谈一谈。
text.description: 科林·烈酒就在隔壁房间，煽动黑铁矮人对美酒节发动新一轮攻击。去击败他！$B$B你只需用言语挑衅他就行啦，比如告诉他他酿造的啤酒连猪都不愿意喝。$B$B做好战斗准备。上一个侮辱他的啤酒的家伙……被送去喂了野猪。
text.completion: What? What did you say? How dare you! My beer can stand up to any of that rot they serve at Brewfest!$b$bYou'll pay for this insult, $c!

english.title: Insult Coren Direbrew
english.objectives: Speak with Coren Direbrew.
english.description: Coren Direbrew is in the next room, riling up Dark Iron dwarves for another attack on Brewfest.  Defeat him!$B$BGo to Coren and pick a fight.  Tell him his beer isn't fit for pigs.$B$BWhen you do that, be ready for a fight.  The last person who insulted his brew... was fed to dire boars.
english.completion: What? What did you say? How dare you! My beer can stand up to any of that rot they serve at Brewfest!$b$bYou'll pay for this insult, $c!

text.title: 冰雾的力量
text.objectives: 在冰雾村内找到班索克·冰雾。
text.description: <冰雾祖母向你鞠了一躬。>$B$B很荣幸见到你，英雄。因为你的努力，我们的许多族人得以幸运地活了下来，并来到这里准备与天灾军团作战。$B$B你已经为我们做了太多的事，再请求你帮助真是令我感到惭愧万分……可是，我唯一的儿子班索克前几天突然离开这里，去寻找他的父亲——冰雾部族的大酋长了。有人看见他一直走向西边，应该是冰雾村的方向。求求你，帮我找到班索克吧。如果我再失去这唯一的儿子，真不知道要怎样才好了。
text.completion: My father still lives! We must save him! I cannot do it alone, $r. You must help me!

english.title: Strength of Icemist
english.objectives: Find Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village.
english.description: <Greatmother Icemist bows.>$B$BIt is an honor to meet you, hero. It is because of your actions that many of us are here now, alive and ready for battle against the Scourge.$B$BYou have done so much for us that it shames me to ask you for your assistance once more. Despite my pleas, my only son, Banthok, left here to go in search of his father, High Chief Icemist. He was last seen heading west, towards Icemist Village. Please find Banthok. I do not know what I would do if I lost my son.
english.completion: My father still lives! We must save him! I cannot do it alone, $r. You must help me!

text.title: 阿努巴尔的束缚
text.objectives: Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village in the Dragonblight has asked that you bring him Anok'ra's Key Fragment, Tivax's Key Fragment and Sinok's Key Fragment.$B$B
text.description: They have my father bound by magical chains in the middle of Icemist Village. From what I have been able to gather, the prison is controlled by three powerful Anub'ar magi - each holding a piece of the key.$B$BScour Icemist and locate the magi. Kill them and take their key fragments. With all three pieces we might be able to free my father. Once he is free...$B$BRetribution will come swiftly.
text.progress: Bring me those key fragments!
text.completion: Yes, this will work. Here it is, $c. With this key, my father will be freed of the Anub'ar prison.
text.completed: Return to Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village in Dragonblight.

english.objectives: Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village in the Dragonblight has asked that you bring him Anok'ra's Key Fragment, Tivax's Key Fragment and Sinok's Key Fragment.$B$B

Kill them and take their key fragments. With all three pieces we might be able to free my father. Once he is free...$B$BRetribution will come swiftly.
english.progress: Bring me those key fragments!
english.completion: Yes, this will work. Here it is, $c. With this key, my father will be freed of the Anub'ar prison.
english.completed: Return to Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village in Dragonblight.

text.title: 海岸上的魔法焦点
text.objectives: 夺取魔网能量焦点控制指环，用它从灿烂海岸的魔网能量线焦点中获取信息。$B$B然后返回群星之墓，向大法师茉德拉的影像复命。
text.description: 法师猎手部队正在眠月花园南面的灿烂海岸忙碌着。我想你应该可以在沙滩上看到被重兵防守着的魔法焦点和领头的指挥官。$B$B很显然，指挥官肯定会随身带着些什么控制设备。夺取控制器，然后在魔法焦点上使用它。$B$B如果足够幸运的话，我们可以获取更多有关他们真正目的的信息。
text.progress: What news do you bring from the beach, $c?
text.completion: How very odd that it imprinted this information upon you magically. So, not only do we know that they've redirected the flow of the power coming out of the Moonrest Gardens, but we now know that the power is being purposefully changed in some way. Just what are they up to with all of that magic? I don't like where this is leading, $n, not one bit!
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Focus on the Beach
english.objectives: Obtain the Ley Line Focus Control Ring and use it to gain information from the Ley Line Focus on the Glittering Strand.$B$BThen, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
english.description: The mage hunter forces are active on the Glittering Strand to the south of Moonrest Gardens. My guess is that you'll find a heavily guarded focus on the beach and a captain who is in charge of it.$B$BNo doubt the captain will have some sort of controlling device on their person. Get the controller and use it on the focus.$B$BWith any luck, we'll be able to get some more information about what they're really up to out there.

english.completion: How very odd that it imprinted this information upon you magically.
