text.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Informing the Queen
english.objectives: Deliver your Letter of Introduction to Wyrmrest Temple to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: <The dragon steward pulls your letter of introduction out of his sleeve.>$B$BYes... yes, I think that you are ready to see the queen now.$B$BWhen you are ready, speak to me again and I will see to it that one of these drakes delivers you safely to the top of the temple. You will need to present your letter in person to Queen Alexstrasza.
english.progress: It is good to finally meet you in person, $n. I have known you since before you were born.
english.completion: You are very courageous to bring us this information. I was beginning to wonder why the blue dragonflight had so boldly initiated an attack upon the temple itself. Now we know that they are using enormous amounts of the very magic they view as such a threat to Azeroth. Hypocritical, but so be it. If Malygos will not come to his senses, we have no choice but to take action in response to their assault.
english.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 邪能之约
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野阿格玛之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要求你在一名疯狂的因度雷村民身上使用能量宝石，然后将充能的能量宝石还给他。
text.description: 我们需要能令这把剑满足的祭品，可是部落的军令禁止我们用以往的形式完成充能。$B$B<库尔迪拉停下来思考了片刻。>$B$B是时候做出一些改变啦。在这里的南方的高崖之上，有一处叫作因度雷的海象人村落。这座村落最近被蓝龙军团的混乱魔法侵蚀了，村中所有的海象人都陷入疯狂。$B$B带上这颗能量宝石，对那些疯狂的村民使用它，抽取他们的精神能量。
text.progress: Bring the blood of the meek to me.
text.completion: A simple task for a simpleton. You have performed within my expectations.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: In Service of Blood
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Blood Gem on a Deranged Indu'le Villager and return to him with a Filled Blood Gem.
english.description: The blood of innocents was once used to sate the thirst of the blade. Alas, such options are no longer available to me.$B$B<Koltira pauses to think.>$B$BWe must improvise. South of here, upon the high bluffs, is the tuskarr village of Indu'le. Having been recently overrun by the Blue Dragonflight's chaotic magic, the resident tuskarr of Indu'le have gone mad.$B$BTake this blood gem and use it on a deranged villager. If I cannot take the blood of innocents, I shall have the blood of the meek!
english.progress: Bring the blood of the meek to me.
english.completion: A simple task for a simpleton. You have performed within my expectations.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 邪恶之约
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野阿格玛之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要求你对瓦伦哈尔公爵使用邪恶宝石，然后将充能的邪恶宝石还给他。
text.description: The power of the unholy is coveted among my kind. It makes up the very fiber of our existence, granting death to those that dare make a mockery of it! Thankfully there is a font from which I may draw from in my time of need.$B$BTake this unholy gem and make your way to the Ruby Dragonshrine, east of here. It is there that you will find Duke Vallenhal, death knight of Arthas. Weaken his resolve in battle and unleash the power of the gem upon him. It will finish him off and steal his unholy energy!$B$B
text.progress: Fill the gem with the power of the unholy!
text.completion: Impressive. You bested a deathknight of Arthas... Clearly you were not alone... but still...
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: In Service of the Unholy
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Unholy Gem on Duke Vallenhal and return to him with a Filled Unholy Gem.
english.description: The power of the unholy is coveted among my kind. It makes up the very fiber of our existence, granting death to those that dare make a mockery of it! Thankfully there is a font from which I may draw from in my time of need.$B$BTake this unholy gem and make your way to the Ruby Dragonshrine, east of here. It is there that you will find Duke Vallenhal, death knight of Arthas. Weaken his resolve in battle and unleash the power of the gem upon him. It will finish him off and steal his unholy energy!$B$B
english.progress: Fill the gem with the power of the unholy!
english.completion: Impressive. You bested a deathknight of Arthas... Clearly you were not alone... but still...
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 冰霜之约
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野阿格玛之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要求你对冰雪亡魂使用冰霜宝石，然后将充能的冰霜宝石还给他。
text.description: 噬骨的冰霜之力永远在死亡骑士作战时保卫着他们。号令冰霜之力的死亡骑士就是混乱与毁灭的代名词！$B$B拿着这颗冰霜宝石，穿过龙骨荒野的苔原，到龙眠神殿以东的黎明之镜去。在那里，你将与湖面上的冰雪亡魂军团作战，并夺取他们的冰霜精华。在削弱它们以后，你就可以利用宝石的力量了，$N！
text.progress: We are all in service of frost here in Northrend.
text.completion: I can already feel the cold coursing through me, $n.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: In Service of Frost
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Frost Gem on Ice Revenants and return to him with a Filled Frost Gem.
english.description: The biting cold protects the death knight while repelling his enemies. He that commands the power of frost can incite chaos and destruction!$B$BTake this frost gem and travel far across the open tundra of the Dragonblight until you come upon the Mirror of Dawn, east of Wyrmrest Temple. It is there that you are to battle the legions of ice revenants that dwell upon the lakes surface and take from them the essence of frost. Utilize the power of the gem when they are weak, $N!
english.progress: We are all in service of frost here in Northrend.
english.completion: I can already feel the cold coursing through me, $n.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 找到莱加尔
text.objectives: 与勘探员哨站的莱加尔·断眉谈一谈。
text.description: 瞧联盟军队穿越索尔莫丹这事儿把我激动得，差点就忘记关注勘探员哨站的情况了。$B$B我指派莱加尔带领他的助手以及一名巡山人去南部建立一座哨站，就在东风海岸南端的丹厄古尔附近。$B$B他们奉命调查在南部丘陵一带活动的铁矮人，但是我至今都没有收到任何报告。如果你刚好要往那个方向去的话，能帮我催催他们吗？
text.completion: Hmm... you don't look like a research assistant, which is just as well. The iron dwarves look to be preparing for war, and my research team hasn't returned. We could use some help around here.

english.title: Check Up on Raegar
english.objectives: Speak with Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: With all the excitement about the army trying to move through Thor Modan, I'd almost forgotten about Raegar's crew down at Prospector's Point.$B$BI sent Raegar and his assistants, along with a mountaineer friend, down to establish a small post near Dun Argol, at the southern end of the Eastwind Shore.$B$BThey were to investigate the iron dwarf presence in the southern hills, but I haven't received any reports yet. Could you check up on them if you're going down that way?
english.completion: Hmm... you don't look like a research assistant, which is just as well. The iron dwarves look to be preparing for war, and my research team hasn't returned. We could use some help around here.

text.title: 完美的计划
text.objectives: 将一份完整的作战魔像蓝图交给勘探员哨站的莱加尔·断眉。
text.description: 铁矮人显然在进行战前准备。这帮家伙有石巨人、作战魔像和闪电元素来扩充兵力，相比之下月溪旅就处于劣势了。如果联盟没有及时找到往北挺进的路线，铁矮人很可能会出其不意地发动袭击。$B$B我们必须牵制铁矮人的行动，好在我已经想到办法啦。大批铁符文铸造师聚集在丹厄古尔制造作战魔像。他们狡猾地将设计图分成若干部分，分别保存起来。你必须收集到一份完整的设计图。
text.progress: Were you able to get those plans from the rune-smiths?
text.completion: You got all of them? Brilliant! I can't wait to see the looks on their faces when the golem's done.
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Perfect Plan
english.objectives: Bring the completed War Golem Blueprint to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: The iron dwarves are making no secret of the fact that they're preparing for war. With their giants, golems, and lightning elementals, they'd have a technological advantage against the Westfall Brigade. If they don't find passage north in time, the irons could take them by surprise.$B$BWe've got to tie them up here, and I've got just the way to do it. Dun Argol is full of rune-smiths churning out war golems. They carry plans for specific pieces, so you'll need to find and assemble all the parts.
english.progress: Were you able to get those plans from the rune-smiths?
english.completion: You got all of them? Brilliant! I can't wait to see the looks on their faces when the golem's done.
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 抢夺零件
text.objectives: 将8份作战魔像零件交给勘探员哨站的莱加尔·断眉。
text.description: 设计图是到手了，但是缺零件怎么搞啊！我们既没铸造工具，也没原材料，不过……应该能在丹厄古尔找到不少零件。$B$B你的任务？$B$B你的任务就是替我弄些回来啊。$B$B在铁符文铸造师工作的建筑物附近就散落着很多零件。当然，这属于偷窃他人的劳动成果，我可不敢保证那些铁矮人不会冲你发火。尽可能多弄些零件回来吧，这样我们才能制造作战魔像。
text.progress: I see you made it out in one piece. Do you have the parts?
text.completion: Oh, no. This is going to be harder than I thought. These things don't have serial numbers or anything, do they? Never a gnome around when you need one...
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Why Fabricate When You Can Appropriate?
english.objectives: Bring 8 War Golem Parts to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: We've got the blueprints, but we can't do anything with them without parts! We don't have access to a foundry, much less materials, but there's a whole load of parts up in Dun Argol.$B$BYour job?$B$BGive them a new home.$B$BThey're likely to be scattered around any of the buildings where the iron rune-smiths are working, and I wouldn't blame the irons for being cranky when you try to filch their handiwork. The more parts you can bring, the better we can make this golem.
english.progress: I see you made it out in one piece. Do you have the parts?
english.completion: Oh, no. This is going to be harder than I thought. These things don't have serial numbers or anything, do they? Never a gnome around when you need one...
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 我们有能源
text.objectives: 将杜拉尔的能量晶格和卡索恩的能量晶格交给勘探员哨站的莱加尔·断眉。
text.description: 就快大功告成啦，不过作战魔像需要能量晶格做动力源。在被丹厄古尔的铁矮人发现之前，我们已经收集到了很多颇有价值的情报。符文铸造师杜拉尔和符文铸造师卡索恩身上就有能量晶格。$B$B我们得设法搞来这两块能量晶格。$B$B他们应该在丹厄古尔中层的两座车间里。
text.progress: Well, did you get those power cells?
text.completion: Excellent! We should be all ready to go.
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: We Have the Power
english.objectives: Bring Durar's Power Cell and Kathorn's Power Cell to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: We're almost there, but the war golem won't run without power cells. From the information I was able to collect in Dun Argol before we were discovered, both Rune-Smith Durar and Rune-Smith Kathorn each create one power cell.$B$BWe'll need one power cell from each of the rune-smiths before our golem will work.$B$BYou should be able to find each rune-smith in his workshop on the central level of Dun Argol.
english.progress: Well, did you get those power cells?
english.completion: Excellent! We should be all ready to go.
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 毁灭的力量
text.objectives: 阿格玛之锤的库尔迪拉·织亡者要求你进入阴影界并击败6名暗影折磨者。$B$B如果需要再次进入阴影界，就去找库尔迪拉·织亡者帮忙。
text.description: 尽管你已经帮了我很多忙，但根据约定，你还有最后一件事要做。$B$B与这个世界平行的还有另一个世界，那就是阴影界。有一些该死的恶魔从阴影界过来突袭了我。我自己无力面对这些源自我内心的恶魔，但你却可以帮我结束它们所带来的痛苦。你很强大，这一点我已经亲眼证实了。$B$B进入阴影界，挑战那些折磨着我的恶魔吧！$B$B只要你帮了我这个忙，我就会按照约定帮你翻译这本书。
text.completion: The power I hold comes at a great cost, $n. Many knights, light and dark alike, lost their lives in the final battle at Light's Hope. The prospect of the future looks grim, but at least now I know what I face. The Lich King will never release his grasp and for that alone he must die!
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Power to Destroy
english.objectives: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to enter the world of shadows and defeat 6 Shadowy Tormentors.$B$BSpeak to Koltira Deathweaver should you need to re-enter the world of shadows.
english.description: While you have done much for me, one task remains.$B$BBeside the world you know exists another world. It is from that world, the world of shadows, that my tormentors assault me. While I am powerless to face my own demons, you could end their reign of terror. You have the strength, I have seen it with my own eyes.$B$BEnter the world of shadows and face the demons that torment me!$B$BDo this and I will translate the tome, as promised.
english.completion: The power I hold comes at a great cost, $n. Many knights, light and dark alike, lost their lives in the final battle at Light's Hope. The prospect of the future looks grim, but at least now I know what I face. The Lich King will never release his grasp and for that alone he must die!
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 击碎南瓜
text.objectives: 将烧焦的神圣符记交给穿戏服的孤儿院长。
text.description: This large jack-o'-lantern rests in the middle of the village.  It eyes those who look upon it, betraying a dark menace within.$B$BSmashing the pumpking reveals an old, scorched holy symbol.
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: You found this inside the Headless Horseman's jack-o-lantern?  It is an old symbol of the Light.  It must have been the Horseman's, before he was cursed and turned into the monster he is today.  Thank you, $n.  This symbol deserves to be with paladins.  I will make sure they get it. Oh, and I almost forgot!  You have a secret admirer... One of the children wanted you to have this.  She was too shy to give it to you herself.
text.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

english.title: Smash the Pumpkin
english.objectives: Give the Scorched Holy Symbol to the Costumed Orphan Matron.
english.description: This large jack-o'-lantern rests in the middle of the village.  It eyes those who look upon it, betraying a dark menace within.$B$BSmashing the pumpking reveals an old, scorched holy symbol.
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: You found this inside the Headless Horseman's jack-o-lantern?  It is an old symbol of the Light.  It must have been the Horseman's, before he was cursed and turned into the monster he is today.  Thank you, $n.  This symbol deserves to be with paladins.  I will make sure they get it. Oh, and I almost forgot!  You have a secret admirer... One of the children wanted you to have this.  She was too shy to give it to you herself.
english.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

text.title: 萨莎的狩猎
text.objectives: 萨莎要求你在冬至村中击败12名冬至村猎人。
text.description: 这个东西……这个诅咒……它毁了银溪镇，它毁了冬至村……它将所有的人都变成了野兽。$B$B我的父亲曾试图警告他们，但他们已经完全沦落成了拜狼教的奴隶。$B$B他们已经无可挽救了，为了让他们的灵魂解脱……你必须去除掉他们。
text.progress: Have you taken care of the hunters in the village yet, $N?
text.completion: Killing these monsters won't bring my father back... but that's not the point now, is it?
text.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Sasha's Hunt
english.objectives: Sasha wants you to kill 12 Solstice Hunters in Solstice Village.
english.description: This thing... this curse... that's affecting Silverbrook and Solstice Village... it makes beasts out of people.$B$BMy father tried to warn them, but they all listened to the wolfcult instead.$B$BThey're too far gone now, it's time to put them down... for their own sake.
english.progress: Have you taken care of the hunters in the village yet, $N?
english.completion: Killing these monsters won't bring my father back... but that's not the point now, is it?
english.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: “放火过来吧！”
text.objectives: The Costumed Orphan Matron wants you to help put out all the village fires after the Headless Horseman lights them.  When they are out, speak again to the Costumed Orphan Matron.
text.description: You must help us!  The Headless Horseman will attack the village at any moment!  Fires will be everywhere!  The children aren't safe!$B$BPlease, $n, will you face the fires of the Headless Horseman?  When he comes, you must join the fire brigade.  Grab a bucket and toss it on the fires, or pass it to a friend who's closer to the blaze.  If you put out all the fires then we may yet be saved!
text.progress: $N, you promised to save the children!
text.completion: Oh, thank you!  May the Light bless your good works, kind sir.  The shadow of the Dark Horseman yet looms, but at least, for now, the village is safe from his flames.
text.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

english.title: "Let the Fires Come!"
english.objectives: The Costumed Orphan Matron wants you to help put out all the village fires after the Headless Horseman lights them.  When they are out, speak again to the Costumed Orphan Matron.
english.description: You must help us!  The Headless Horseman will attack the village at any moment!  Fires will be everywhere!  The children aren't safe!$B$BPlease, $n, will you face the fires of the Headless Horseman?  When he comes, you must join the fire brigade.  Grab a bucket and toss it on the fires, or pass it to a friend who's closer to the blaze.  If you put out all the fires then we may yet be saved!
english.progress: $N, you promised to save the children!
english.completion: Oh, thank you!  May the Light bless your good works, kind sir.  The shadow of the Dark Horseman yet looms, but at least, for now, the village is safe from his flames.
english.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

text.title: 翻译过的魔典
text.objectives: 将翻译过的血之魔典交给阿格玛之锤的高尔特上尉。
text.description: 给你，$N。我已经把这本书上面每一页所写着的东西都翻译给你了。在这些内容中有一份诅咒教派的成员名单，名单上详细罗列了他们分布在整个大陆的间谍网和行动组织的成员及结构。$B$B说实话，这套情报网的确非常优秀。$B$B再见，朋友。愿这本书上的内容能帮到你。
text.progress: It's about time! Where have you been?
text.completion: WHAT! This can't be right. I've known some of these orcs for years! Leave me, $n. I have much work to do and many traitors to execute. Take one of these items for your trouble. You've done a great service for the Horde this day.
text.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Translated Tome
english.objectives: Deliver the Translated Flesh-bound Tome to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: Here it is, $N. I have translated everything printed upon the pages of the tome. Inside it you will find a list of the names of Cult of the Damned members spanning the entire continent.$B$BTheir network of spies and operatives is impressive, to say the least.$B$BFarewell, friend. May the book serve you and your people well.
english.progress: It's about time! Where have you been?
english.completion: WHAT! This can't be right. I've known some of these orcs for years! Leave me, $n. I have much work to do and many traitors to execute. Take one of these items for your trouble. You've done a great service for the Horde this day.
english.completed: Return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 冷静一下，伙计
text.objectives: 甘休希望你能从他在达基尔金废墟的箱子里拿到永恒休眠之雪。$B$B对那里的上古阿卡莱幽魂使用永恒休眠之雪，然后把它们的达卡莱灵魂微粒交给哈考尔营地的克拉斯。
text.description: 正如预言所说的那样，朋友。一个$R$C会来到这里，让我们的灵魂得到安息。我们已经等了很久了！$B$B达卡莱巨魔已经迷失了，他们残暴而又野蛮，他们忘记了许多神圣的戒律，而现在他们正在为此付出代价。$B$B但是我们在这里所忍受的痛苦，却并非是我们自己的错误所引起的。这个地方需要得到净化，而只有活人可以这么做。$B$B当你准备好重新回到你的躯壳中时，就找我谈谈，然后拿上我身旁箱子里的雪，让我的同胞长眠吧。$B$B把他们的残迹交给你的灵魂导师。他知道下一步该怎么做。
text.progress: Have you completed your task in the crypt, $c?
text.completion: You have done well. Please, sit and listen. There are many things we must discuss.
text.completed: Return to Kraz at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Chill Out, Mon
english.objectives: Gan'jo wants you to collect the Snow of Eternal Slumber from his chest in the Drakil'jin Ruins.$b$bYou are to use the Snow on the Ancient Drakkari Spirits there and take their Drakkari Spirit Particles back to Kraz at Harkor's Camp.
english.description: It be as the prophecies said, mon. A $r $c be comin' to set our spirits to rest. We been waitin' for a long time now!$b$bThe Drakkari have become a lost people, fierce and savage.$b$bBut here we suffer by no fault of our own, mon. This place need cleansin' and only the living can do it.$b$bSpeak to me when ya be ready to rejoin your body. Then take the snow from the chest near me here and put my bruddas to sleep.$b$bTake their remnants to your spirit guide. He be knowin' what to do next.
english.progress: Have you completed your task in the crypt, $c?
english.completion: You have done well. Please, sit and listen. There are many things we must discuss.
english.completed: Return to Kraz at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: ……我们没有能源
text.objectives: 利用10个闪电斥候为你的作战魔像充能，然后将充能完毕的作战魔像交给勘探员哨站的莱加尔·断眉。
text.description: 你以为这帮家伙会很厚道地给能量晶格充满电？事实上，他们留了一手防着我们呢。$B$B好吧，我们总是能想出办法的，虽然麻烦了点。这两块能量晶格的电力仅够维持作战魔像很短时间内的动力，要它作战是不可能的。$B$B你瞧，铁矮人将闪电斥候部署在丹厄古尔周围。杀死这些闪电斥候，就可以用作战魔像从它们的尸体上吸取能量了。
text.completion: Finally, it's ready. I only hope it holds together long enough to get the job done. If we don't take out the thane leading Dun Argol, Captain Gryan'll be in for a nasty surprise.
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: ... Or Maybe We Don't
english.objectives: Charge your War Golem with the energy from 10 Lightning Sentries and return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: You'd think the guys making the power cells would've thought to power them up, but no, they've got to make it difficult for us.$B$BFine, we'll charge those cells the hard way. There's enough power in them to run the golem for a short time, but don't expect it to be any good in combat.$B$BYou see the lightning sentries that the irons have posted around the perimeter of Dun Argol? Bring the golem with you, take it close to them, and use the golem to absorb the power as the sentries die.
english.completion: Finally, it's ready. I only hope it holds together long enough to get the job done. If we don't take out the thane leading Dun Argol, Captain Gryan'll be in for a nasty surprise.
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: “放火过来吧！”
text.objectives: 戴面具的孤儿院长希望你能帮忙扑灭村子里的所有火焰。在扑灭了所有火焰之后，回去向戴面具的孤儿院长汇报。
text.description: The Headless Horseman will attack the village at any moment!  Fires will be everywhere!$B$B$n, will you face the fires of the Headless Horseman?  When he comes, you must join the fire brigade.  Grab a bucket and toss it on the fires, or pass it to a friend who's closer to the blaze.  If you put out all the fires then we may yet be saved!
text.completion: The fires are out!  You and your fire brigade were victorious!  Hah! The Headless Horseman's attack has failed, but until he and his head are destroyed together, he will return. Until then, however, let's take comfort in the safety you brought our children.  I am honored to have watched your brave work today.
text.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

english.title: "Let the Fires Come!"
english.objectives: The Masked Orphan Matron wants you to help put out all the village fires.  When they are out, speak again to the Masked Orphan Matron in town.
english.description: The Headless Horseman will attack the village at any moment!  Fires will be everywhere!$B$B$n, will you face the fires of the Headless Horseman?  When he comes, you must join the fire brigade.  Grab a bucket and toss it on the fires, or pass it to a friend who's closer to the blaze.  If you put out all the fires then we may yet be saved!
english.completion: The fires are out!  You and your fire brigade were victorious!  Hah! The Headless Horseman's attack has failed, but until he and his head are destroyed together, he will return. Until then, however, let's take comfort in the safety you brought our children.  I am honored to have watched your brave work today.
english.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

text.title: 洛纳乌克万岁！
text.objectives: Seek out Roanauk Icemist at Agmar's Hammer and initiate him as a member and leader of the Horde forces.$B$BReturn to Overlord Agmar with the Blood Oath of the Horde when you complete this task.$B$B
text.description: Like the tauren, Forsaken, trolls and blood elves, so too do the taunka need a leader born of their own blood. The one you saved from Icemist, Roanauk, will be this leader.$B$B<Overlord Agmar hands you a parchment.>$B$BI give to you something familiar - the blood oath of the Horde.$B$BTake the oath to Roanauk Icemist and initiate him into the Horde as leader of the taunka.$B$BLet us not keep him waiting.$B$B<Agmar nods.>$B$B
text.completion: With the aid of such a powerful shaman, we are sure to be victorious at the Wrathgate!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: All Hail Roanauk!
english.objectives: Seek out Roanauk Icemist at Agmar's Hammer and initiate him as a member and leader of the Horde forces.$B$BReturn to Overlord Agmar with the Blood Oath of the Horde when you complete this task.$B$B
english.description: Like the tauren, Forsaken, trolls and blood elves, so too do the taunka need a leader born of their own blood. The one you saved from Icemist, Roanauk, will be this leader.$B$B<Overlord Agmar hands you a parchment.>$B$BI give to you something familiar - the blood oath of the Horde.$B$BTake the oath to Roanauk Icemist and initiate him into the Horde as leader of the taunka.$B$BLet us not keep him waiting.$B$B<Agmar nods.>$B$B
english.completion: With the aid of such a powerful shaman, we are sure to be victorious at the Wrathgate!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 外交任务
text.objectives: 前往无畏要塞西南方的裂鞭海岸，与卡鲁克谈一谈。
text.description: $N，你似乎很乐意帮助别人。既然你大老远地跑来诺森德，那么你想必不是那种畏首畏尾的家伙！我有件事想交给你办……要去很远的地方。$B$B我们一直在尝试与居住在诺森德的海象人氏族建立良好的关系。最近，一名年轻的海象人来这里寻求帮助，但是我们暂时抽不出人手。$B$B或许你可以帮帮他？去西南方的裂鞭海岸附近寻找卡鲁克，看看有什么能帮得上忙的。
text.completion: You've come to my aid?  I thank you, $n.

english.title: A Diplomatic Mission
english.objectives: Speak to Karuk at Riplash Strand, southwest of Valiance Keep.
english.description: I see that you are very eager to help, $N.  You didn't come all the way to Northrend to stay holed up in a city!  I've just the task for you... something that'll take you far away from here.$B$BWe've long sought to gain the favor of the tuskarr native to Northrend.  Recently a young tuskarr came to us seeking help, something we couldn't offer at the time.$B$BNow that you're around, maybe you can lend him a hand.  Look for Karuk near the Riplash Strand, southwest of here, and see what you can do to help.
english.completion: You've come to my aid?  I thank you, $n.

text.title: 害虫控制
text.objectives: 第七军团前线的杜埃尼希望你前往龙眠神殿周围的猛犸人营地，消灭10个雪原北地狗头人和3个龙骨荒野猛犸人。
text.description: 啊！有只狗头人趁我们忙着对付龙族时跑进营地闹腾了一番。稍不留神，它们就来捣乱……我真是受够了！$B$B狗头人就待在南边的猛犸人营地里。去那里干掉它们。$B$B如果猛犸人打算替他们的奴隶出头，就连他们一起杀掉。
text.progress: Did you finish off those pests?
text.completion: 解脱了。
text.completed: Return to Duane at the 7th Legion Front in Dragonblight.

english.title: Pest Control
english.objectives: Duane at the 7th Legion Front wants you to kill 10 Snowplain Snobolds and 3 Dragonblight Magnataur at the magnataur camps surrounding Wyrmrest.
english.description: Ugh! One of those little snobold runts trashed our camp while we were busy with that last dragon. They've been plaguing us whenever we turn our backs... I've had enough!$B$BTo the south you'll find the snobolds hiding under the skirts of some of the local magnataur. Go slaughter them.$B$BIf the magnataur interfere on behalf of their slaves, kill them as well.
english.progress: Did you finish off those pests?
english.completion: Good riddance.
english.completed: Return to Duane at the 7th Legion Front in Dragonblight.

text.title: 峡谷追击
text.objectives: 杜埃尼希望你在第七军团前线东北方向的峡谷中找到北地狗头人的踪迹，并干掉它们的领袖。
text.description: 真不敢相信！另一群狗头人刚刚偷袭了我们的营地，抢走了一批补给品。他们朝北边的峡谷逃去了，追上这帮强盗，干掉他们的首领！
text.progress: 任务完成了吗?
text.completion: Chilltusk, eh?  I've heard his name before.  That's some good work, $c.  Hopefully we can turn our attention back to the dragon menace now.
text.completed: Return to Duane at the 7th Legion Front in Dragonblight.

english.title: Canyon Chase
english.objectives: Duane wants you to chase the snobolds down the canyon northeast of 7th Legion Front and deal with their leader.
english.description: I can't believe this! Another band of those vermin just tried to take off with more of our supplies. They're scurrying off towards that north canyon, get after them and deal with whoever they're going to!
english.completion: Chilltusk, eh?  I've heard his name before.  That's some good work, $c.  Hopefully we can turn our attention back to the dragon menace now.
english.completed: Return to Duane at the 7th Legion Front in Dragonblight.

text.title: 害虫控制
text.objectives: 猎龙营地的肯图卡尼斯要你前往龙眠神殿周围的猛犸人营地，消灭10个雪原北地狗头人和3个龙骨荒野猛犸人。
text.description: 哟，伙计！有一些北地狗头人趁着上次冰霜巨龙突袭的时候把我们的营地搞了个底朝天。这帮混账老是跟在我们后面，让我们焦头烂额。受够啦，老子受够啦！$B$B去东边找找那些家伙的晦气，它们就躲在猛犸人营地的周围。把它们都给我杀光，要是猛犸人敢插手，就把他们也杀光！
text.completion: Good riddance, mon.
text.completed: Return to Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall in Dragonblight.

english.title: Pest Control
english.objectives: Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall wants you to kill 10 Snowplain Snobolds and 3 Dragonblight Magnataur at the magnataur camps surrounding Wyrmrest.
english.description: Oi, mon! One of dose little snobold runts trashed our camp during da last dragon attack. Dey've been houndin us wheneva we turn our backs and I've had enough. $b$bTo da east you'll find da snobolds hiding under da skirts of some of da local magnataur. Go slaughter dem. If da magnataur interfere on behalf of deir slaves, kill dem as well.
english.completion: Good riddance, mon.
english.completed: Return to Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall in Dragonblight.

text.title: 峡谷追击
text.objectives: Kontokanis wants you to chase the snobolds down the canyon south of Dragon's Fall and deal with their leader.
text.description: I can't believe dis! Another band of dose vermin just tried ta take off with more of our supplies. Dey're scurrying down da canyon now, get after dem and deal with whoever dey're going to!
text.progress: 除非你亲手杀死一条龙，否则我可不认你这个朋友……
text.completion: Icefist, eh?  I've heard his name before.  Dat's some good work, mon.  Hopefully we Darkspear can turn our attention back to dat dragon menace now.
text.completed: Return to Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall in Dragonblight.

english.title: Canyon Chase
english.objectives: Kontokanis wants you to chase the snobolds down the canyon south of Dragon's Fall and deal with their leader.
english.description: I can't believe dis! Another band of dose vermin just tried ta take off with more of our supplies. Dey're scurrying down da canyon now, get after dem and deal with whoever dey're going to!
english.completion: Icefist, eh?  I've heard his name before.  Dat's some good work, mon.  Hopefully we Darkspear can turn our attention back to dat dragon menace now.
english.completed: Return to Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall in Dragonblight.

text.title: 奇怪的符号
text.objectives: 带上精美的战斗号角前往龙眠神殿，看看那里有谁可以评估一下这潜在的威胁。
text.description: 号角内侧装饰着一枚绘有铁锤与闪电的纹章。这显然不是猛犸人的东西。$B$B带上号角，沿着泰坦之路向南走，到龙眠神殿去看看有谁能解读其中的奥秘。
text.progress: 怎麽了，$R?
text.completion: It is indeed strange for any magnataur to carry an item such as this... and very concerning. I am glad that you have shown this to me.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at The Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

english.title: Disturbing Implications
english.objectives: Bring the Emblazoned Battle Horn to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in assessing the potential threat.
english.description: The underside of the horn boasts an emblazoned seal with a hammer and a lightning bolt. Something about the horn seems extremely out of place on a Magnataur.$b$bTake the horn south down the Path of the Titans to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in these threatening implications.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: It is indeed strange for any magnataur to carry an item such as this... and very concerning. I am glad that you have shown this to me.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at The Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

text.title: 奇怪的符号
text.objectives: 带上精美的战斗号角前往龙眠神殿，看看那里有谁可以评估一下这潜在的威胁。
text.description: The underside of the horn boasts an emblazoned seal with a hammer and a lightning bolt. Something about the horn seems extremely out of place on a Magnataur. $b$bTake the horn east across the Dragon Wastes to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in these threatening implications.
text.progress: 怎麽了，$R?
text.completion: It is indeed strange for any magnataur to carry an item such as this... and very concerning. I am glad that you have shown this to me.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at The Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

english.title: Disturbing Implications
english.objectives: Bring the Emblazoned Battle Horn to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in assessing the potential threat.
english.description: The underside of the horn boasts an emblazoned seal with a hammer and a lightning bolt. Something about the horn seems extremely out of place on a Magnataur. $b$bTake the horn east across the Dragon Wastes to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in these threatening implications.
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: It is indeed strange for any magnataur to carry an item such as this... and very concerning. I am glad that you have shown this to me.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at The Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

text.title: 集结的信号
text.objectives: 在碧蓝巨龙圣地西北边的峡谷附近找到裂骨者，并杀死它。带着证据回去向龙眠神殿的奥拉斯塔萨复命。
text.description: 这在猛犸人当中是一个非常非常少见的标识……它代表着某种大规模集结的信号。$B$B猛犸人各部族之间很少会放弃争斗，联合行动。我认为他们很可能在策划洗劫某个大型定居点。$B$B我深刻怀疑这支号角是不是用来集结各个猛犸人部族的，不过希望你能证明我是错的，否则威胁可就太大了。在碧蓝巨龙圣地西北方的悬崖地带有一个名叫裂骨者的猛犸人。去挑战他吧，把任何能证实我的担忧的证据带回来。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: So it is true. They could not have chosen better timing for such an attack... between the Scourge and the blue flight, it is unlikely that anyone else has noticed yet.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: One of a Kind
english.objectives: Find and kill Bonesunder in or near the canyon northwest of the Azure Dragonshrine. Bring any evidence you find back to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: Such a strange seal to see among magnataur... it suggests an unusual amount of organization.$B$BMagnataur rarely put aside their aggressive natures to cooperate with each other.  I suspect they have their eyes set on raiding a large settlement.$b$bI very much doubt that this horn is unique, I need you to prove me wrong. In the canyon northwest of the Azure Dragonshrine you will find Bonesunder. Go challenge him and bring me back any evidence you find that might confirm my concerns.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: So it is true. They could not have chosen better timing for such an attack... between the Scourge and the blue flight, it is unlikely that anyone else has noticed yet.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 强大的猛犸人
text.objectives: Hunt down and kill Bloodfeast, Iceshatter, and Drakegore east of Wyrmrest$B$BBloodfeast resides in the southeastern corner of the Dragon Wastes, just north of the Emerald Dragonshrine. Iceshatter patrols the northern edge of the Mirror of Dawn. Drakegore wanders at the bottom of the cliffs west of the Bronze Dragonshrine.$B$BReturn to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the magnataur have been slain.
text.description: 猛犸人生性凶残……一旦聚集起来，就免不了互相杀戮。这也是他们难以构成很大威胁的主要原因。但是近来，猛犸人氏族中涌现出一位强大的领袖。我们必须在猛犸人形成可怕的凝聚力之前除掉他。$B$B我会对此进行周密的调查。在此期间，我打算派你去骚扰他们。$B$B神殿东面有三支火炬，猛犸人氏族中最强大的三名头目就驻扎在火炬旁。去干掉他们，为我们争取足够的时间来收集那位领袖的信息。
text.progress: Have you defeated the magnataur?
text.completion: Excellent work. No one could tell me who this leader might be, but I was able to uncover the name of someone who will have our answer.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Mighty Magnataur
english.objectives: Hunt down and kill Bloodfeast, Iceshatter, and Drakegore east of Wyrmrest$B$BBloodfeast resides in the southeastern corner of the Dragon Wastes, just north of the Emerald Dragonshrine. Iceshatter patrols the northern edge of the Mirror of Dawn. Drakegore wanders at the bottom of the cliffs west of the Bronze Dragonshrine.$B$BReturn to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the magnataur have been slain.
english.description: Magnataur are hideously violent creatures... this is the main reason we rarely see them come together in any real numbers without killing each other. A powerful leader has stepped up somewhere among them and we need to hunt him down if we are to stop this threat. $B$BI will start asking around. I need you to disrupt them as much as possible in the meantime.$B$BEast of here there are 3 torches erected. Near them, there are 3 dominant Magnataur - put them down to buy us some time to hunt down this leader.
english.progress: Have you defeated the magnataur?
english.completion: Excellent work. No one could tell me who this leader might be, but I was able to uncover the name of someone who will have our answer.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 隐居的铭语师
text.objectives: Locate Dregmar Runebrand near his cave on the path to the cliffs overlooking the Mirror of the Dawn. Challenge him and uncover the name of the magnataur leader by any means necessary. Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the information is obtained.
text.description: 德雷格玛尔·符印是一名猛犸人铭语师……一个异类。他过着独居的生活，却与龙骨荒野上的一位更有影响力的猛犸人长期保持着密切的联系。他应该知道这位脱颖而出的新任领袖是谁。$B$B在天灾军团和蓝龙军团的双重威胁之下，恐怕我们很难得到其他同僚的协助。因此，我命令你不惜一切代价，从德雷格玛尔口中问出这条信息。$B$B我听说他居住在俯瞰黎明之镜的悬崖地带。
text.progress: Did you get the name?  Do you know who the magnataur warlord is?
text.completion: Grom'thar the Thunderbringer. Good. Let's end any threat these magnataur might pose here and now.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Reclusive Runemaster
english.objectives: Locate Dregmar Runebrand near his cave on the path to the cliffs overlooking the Mirror of the Dawn. Challenge him and uncover the name of the magnataur leader by any means necessary. Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the information is obtained.
english.description: Dregmar Runebrand is a magnataur runemaster... a rare breed. He's generally solitary, but has been known to associate with the more powerful and influential magnataur in Dragonblight for quite some time. He will know who this new leader is. $b$bIt is unlikely we will gain any aid with the increasing concerns with the Scourge and the blue flight, so I need you to procure the information from Dregmar by any means necessary.$B$BI was told he can be found amongst the cliffs overlooking the Mirror of the Dawn.
english.progress: Did you get the name?  Do you know who the magnataur warlord is?
english.completion: Grom'thar the Thunderbringer. Good. Let's end any threat these magnataur might pose here and now.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 暴虐的酋长
text.objectives: Travel to the ring of torches south of the Azure Dragonshrine and blow the Emblazoned Battle Horn. Defeat Grom'thar the Thunderbringer and bring his head back to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest.
text.description: 没有必要怀疑德雷格玛尔所说的。无论是戈洛塔尔获胜还是你获胜，他都能置身事外。$B$B按他的指示去做吧……带上你之前给我的那只号角，前往碧蓝巨龙圣地南边的火炬之环。吹响号角，向戈洛塔尔宣战。$B$B击败雷霆使者戈洛塔尔，将他的首级带回来给我。
text.progress: Did you end this threat for good?
text.completion: You are formidable indeed. With Grom'thar the Thunderbringer gone, we can leave the remaining Magnataur to fight among themselves and turn our attentions back towards more prominent threats. Impressive work, $c.
text.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Wanton Warlord
english.objectives: Travel to the ring of torches south of the Azure Dragonshrine and blow the Emblazoned Battle Horn. Defeat Grom'thar the Thunderbringer and bring his head back to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest.
english.description: There's no reason to suspect Dregmar's words are anything but true. Whether Grom'thar defeats you or is defeated by you, he can wash his hands of this.$b$bFollow his instructions... take the horn that you brought me earlier, travel to the ring of torches south of the Azure Dragonshrine, and blow it to announce your challenge.$B$BWhen Grom'thar the Thunderbringer arrives, kill him and bring me his head.
english.progress: Did you end this threat for good?
english.completion: You are formidable indeed. With Grom'thar the Thunderbringer gone, we can leave the remaining Magnataur to fight among themselves and turn our attentions back towards more prominent threats. Impressive work, $c.
english.completed: Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 金亚拉克的末日
text.objectives: 哈考尔营地的克拉斯希望你从达基尔金废墟收集神圣达卡莱供品，然后将达卡莱灵魂之尘撒在上面。你必须在达基尔金废墟的锣处使用灌注能量的达卡莱供品。
text.description: 很高兴看到你能活着回来。很多去过亡者世界的人都没能回来。$B$B在你离开的时候，克拉斯看到一个幻象，并得知了接下来需要做什么。$B$B在墓穴内有一份神圣的供品。带上这些由你带来的残迹制成的灵魂之尘，把它撒在供品上。$B$B这样就可以了结那个堕落的督军，并释放出无数痛苦的灵魂。$B$B让灵魂引领你的行动吧，$N。
text.progress: Has Jin'arrak been defeated, $N?
text.completion: It is done. Your selflessness has brought eternal peace to many souls, ending eons of misery. May this act lighten your own soul and lessen your burdens, for I see that there are yet many perils you must face. Farewell, $n.
text.completed: Return to Kraz at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Jin'arrak's End
english.objectives: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to collect the Sacred Drakkari Offering from the Drakil'jin Ruins and use the Drakkari Spirit Dust on it. You must use the Infused Drakkari Offering at the gongs outside of Drakil'jin Ruins.
english.description: It is good to see you back among the living. Many who travel the path of the dead do not return to speak of it.$b$bWhile you were away, a vision appeared to Kraz revealing what remains to be done.$b$bA sacred offering lies somewhere inside the crypt. Take this spirit dust fashioned from the remnants you collected and use it on the offering.$b$bThe infused offering will bring an end to the corrupted warlord and will release the many tormented souls.$b$bMay the spirits guide your actions, $n.
english.progress: Has Jin'arrak been defeated, $N?
english.completion: It is done. Your selflessness has brought eternal peace to many souls, ending eons of misery. May this act lighten your own soul and lessen your burdens, for I see that there are yet many perils you must face. Farewell, $n.
english.completed: Return to Kraz at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 铁领主和他的保镖
text.objectives: 驾驶作战魔像击败铁领主弗雷哈默尔，然后返回勘探员哨站向莱加尔·断眉复命。
text.description: 作战魔像已经充电完毕，轮到它大展身手的时候啦。在丹厄古尔启动魔像，控制它开始作战。$B$B关于丹厄古尔的铁领主弗雷哈默尔，我们收集到的情报表明他有一名非常强力的护卫。$B$B这个名叫“铁砧”的构造体随时都跟在他身旁。只要摧毁构造体，弗雷哈默尔就容易对付了。$B$B铁领主通常呆在丹厄古尔顶层的大型设备间，监督铁矮人的生产线。
text.progress: Were you able to get past the iron thane's defenses?
text.completion: It worked? I mean... of course it worked! This is incredible! Years from now, Explorers' League initiates will hear the story of how Raegar Breakbrow, $n, and some hunk o' junk golem defeated the thane of Dun Argol!
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Iron Thane and His Anvil
english.objectives: Using the abilities of your War Golem, defeat Iron Thane Furyhammer, then return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: Now that you've charged up your war golem, we're going to put all that energy to good use. Activate the golem inside Dun Argol to take control of it.$B$BOur  information about Dun Argol's leader, Iron Thane Furyhammer, suggests his bodyguard protects him from all harm.$B$BThat bodyguard is the construct he travels with, called The Anvil. Disable the construct, and his protection will disappear.$B$BThe thane stays in the building at the top of Dun Argol and supervises production from the bottom level.
english.progress: Were you able to get past the iron thane's defenses?
english.completion: It worked? I mean... of course it worked! This is incredible! Years from now, Explorers' League initiates will hear the story of how Raegar Breakbrow, $n, and some hunk o' junk golem defeated the thane of Dun Argol!
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 断电
text.objectives: 使用莱加尔的炸药摧毁丹厄古尔的符文能量核心，然后返回勘探员哨站向莱加尔·断眉复命。
text.description: 安置在丹厄古尔顶层大厅的能量源向整片区域提供电力。如果摧毁能量源，丹厄古尔就会暂时陷入瘫痪。$B$B如此一来，铁矮人就不能继续制造魔像和闪电元素之类的玩意了。$B$B本来呢，这些炸药是用于挖掘工事的。托铁领主弗雷哈默尔的福，我们的研究工作已经完全搁浅啦。不过，我们还是用得着这些炸药的。它是摧毁能量源的唯一手段。
text.progress: Have you disabled the power source for their runeforges?
text.completion: I can't stand to see explosives go to waste and it'll set our enemies back for sure.
text.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Blackout
english.objectives: Use Raegar's Explosives to destroy the Runic Power Core at Dun Argol, then report to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
english.description: The large hall at the top of Dun Argol houses the power source for the entire area. If you can destroy the power core, it will cripple Dun Argol for some time.$B$BNo power means no golems, no sentries, and no more lightning armaments.$B$BWhen we were sent up here, they told us these explosives were for excavation, but thanks to Iron Thane Furyhammer, the research has been scrapped. We may as well get some use out of them, though. They're the only thing we have on hand capable of destroying the power core.
english.progress: Have you disabled the power source for their runeforges?
english.completion: I can't stand to see explosives go to waste and it'll set our enemies back for sure.
english.completed: Return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 击碎南瓜
text.objectives: Give the Scorched Holy Symbol to the Masked Orphan Matron.
text.description: This large jack-o'-lantern rests in the middle of the village.  It eyes those who look upon it, betraying a dark menace within.$B$BSmashing the pumpking reveals an old, scorched holy symbol.
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: You found this inside the Headless Horseman's jack-o-lantern?  It is an old symbol of the Light.  It must have been the Horseman's, before he was cursed and turned into the monster he is today.  Thank you, $n.  This symbol deserves to be with paladins.  I will make sure they get it. Oh, and I almost forgot!  You have a secret admirer... One of the children wanted you to have this.  She was too shy to give it to you herself.
text.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

english.title: Smash the Pumpkin
english.objectives: Give the Scorched Holy Symbol to the Masked Orphan Matron.
english.description: This large jack-o'-lantern rests in the middle of the village.  It eyes those who look upon it, betraying a dark menace within.$B$BSmashing the pumpking reveals an old, scorched holy symbol.
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: You found this inside the Headless Horseman's jack-o-lantern?  It is an old symbol of the Light.  It must have been the Horseman's, before he was cursed and turned into the monster he is today.  Thank you, $n.  This symbol deserves to be with paladins.  I will make sure they get it. Oh, and I almost forgot!  You have a secret admirer... One of the children wanted you to have this.  She was too shy to give it to you herself.
english.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

text.title: DEPRECAED
text.objectives: Escort the Alliance Envoy to the town of Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont at the Amberpine Lodge when you've completed this task.
text.description: 我本打算在大约一个小时前来到这里的西北部的Silverbrook。我的军队护送似乎迟到了，如果这个外交使团因为一些新的招聘者过度睡觉而被误解了，那么我们可能会被诅咒。
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: DEPRECAED
english.objectives: Escort the Alliance Envoy to the town of Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont at the Amberpine Lodge when you've completed this task.
english.description: I was meant to set off for Silverbrook, northwest of here, about an hour ago.  My military escort appears to be running late.$B$BI'll be damned if this diplomatic mission gets sidetracked because some new recruit overslept.$B$BWe're negotiating a deal with the locals and timeliness is essential.  What do you say?  If you come with me, you'll be well compensated for your troubles.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 失踪的信使
text.objectives: Speak to Courier Lanson at Star's Rest in Dragonblight.
text.description: We're lucky we made it this far, $N.  We were ambushed by Scourge as soon as we landed.$B$BOne of our men turned out to be a spy for the Cult of the Damned.  Thassarian appears to have more evidence of cultist infiltration.  Apparently it goes all the way to the top.$B$BI've sent one of my best couriers to our outpost in western Dragonblight, but he has not yet returned. I fear he may have fallen to the Scourge. Will you go to Dragonblight and search for him? Courier Lanson is his name.$B$B
text.completion: As I crossed the bridge into Dragonblight a small group of Anub'ar ambushed me! I was surrounded! Those monsters knew I was coming. I barely made it out of there with my flesh intact. This list I hold must be taken to Wintergarde Keep, but I am too badly injured to make the journey.

english.title: The Lost Courier
english.objectives: Speak to Courier Lanson at Star's Rest in Dragonblight.
english.description: We're lucky we made it this far, $N.  We were ambushed by Scourge as soon as we landed.$B$BOne of our men turned out to be a spy for the Cult of the Damned.  Thassarian appears to have more evidence of cultist infiltration.  Apparently it goes all the way to the top.$B$BI've sent one of my best couriers to our outpost in western Dragonblight, but he has not yet returned. I fear he may have fallen to the Scourge. Will you go to Dragonblight and search for him? Courier Lanson is his name.$B$B
english.completion: As I crossed the bridge into Dragonblight a small group of Anub'ar ambushed me! I was surrounded! Those monsters knew I was coming. I barely made it out of there with my flesh intact. This list I hold must be taken to Wintergarde Keep, but I am too badly injured to make the journey.

text.title: 空石矿洞
text.objectives: 进入月溪旅营地西北方的空石矿洞寻找线索。
text.description: 我其实很早就想派人去彻底调查一下空石矿洞了。可是一直没有适当的时机——毕竟，我这里的人仅仅是应付西边那群部落和东边那些铁矮人就够头疼的了。$B$B既然杜蒙特派你去调查矿洞，那么我想我至少得为你指明正确的方向。这也是我唯一能提供的帮助了，真是不好意思。$B$B你可以在西北方的不远处找到矿洞的入口。到了那边以后，记得评估一下那座矿洞的开采设备有没有被破坏，还有没有挽回的可能。在致远郡的矿洞重新投入生产之前，我们的确需要一些额外的资源。
text.completion: You've come to help me, haven't you!

english.title: Hollowstone Mine
english.objectives: Look for clues inside Hollowstone Mine northwest of the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: I've been meaning to send some of our lads to check out Hollowstone Mine.  Haven't had a chance to yet -- we've had our hands full between the Horde on the west and the iron dwarves to the east.$B$BIf Dumont sent you, though, the least I can do is point you in the right direction.$B$BYou'll find the mine entrance to the northwest, not far from here.  See if you think operations there can be salvaged.  We sure could use the additional resources until our mine in Farshire is operational again.
english.completion: You've come to help me, haven't you!

text.title: 无法安息的灵魂
text.objectives: 空石矿洞的派特洛夫要求你使用矿工的灯笼净化8具空石矿工的躯体。
text.description: <派特洛夫似乎是遭受到了某种沉重的打击，他的呼吸很沉重也很急促，双眼一直在扫视着矿洞内的一切。>$B$B我的同志们……我们必须让他们的灵魂得到安息！我一次又一次击败他们……可是……他们却一次又一次地站起来！$B$B我已经有了一个办法，但却无法下狠心去这么做。$B$B或许你可以帮我的忙？带着这盏灯，用里面的灯油净化他们的躯体，这样他们或许就再也不会站起来了……$B$B等下我会回答你所有的问题，先帮帮我的朋友们！
text.progress: Have you put my friends to rest yet, $N?
text.completion: Rest in peace friends!  Do not worry -- I will tell everyone that we never gave up!
text.completed: Return to Petrov at the Hollowstone Mine in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Souls at Unrest
english.objectives: Petrov at Hollowstone Mine wants you to use the Miner's Lantern to burn the corpses of 8 Hollowstone Miners.
english.description: <Petrov looks deeply disturbed, breathing heavily and shifting his gaze nervously around the mine.>$B$BMy comrades... we must put their souls to rest!  I kill them and kill them but.. they just come back!$B$BI've had an idea for a while but I just don't have the heart to do it myself.$B$BMaybe you can do this for me?  Take this lantern and use its oil to burn their remains so they never get up again.$B$BI'll answer your questions later.  Help my friends first!
english.progress: Have you put my friends to rest yet, $N?
english.completion: Rest in peace friends!  Do not worry -- I will tell everyone that we never gave up!
english.completed: Return to Petrov at the Hollowstone Mine in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 往日的名字
text.objectives: 向月溪旅营地的格里安·斯托曼复命。
text.description: 有效！太好了，有效！我的同志们终于可以得到安息了……$B$B我会留在这里完成其它的工作。我们这些空石矿工从不临阵脱逃，我们从不放弃！$B$B这恐怕也是阿鲁高视我们为眼中钉的原因，明白吗？我们死也不会加入他的拜狼教！
text.completion: Curse our luck.  We find the one functioning mine this side of the hills and it's full of Scourge. No offense, friend.  But that survivor you found sounds like he's been a little traumatized due to losing his friends.  Arugal's been dead for years... I even saw his grave once.

english.title: A Name from the Past
english.objectives: Return to Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: It worked!  It worked!  My comrades can finally enjoy their well-earned rest...$B$BI'll stay here and finish the job.  We Hollowstone miners always finish the job -- we never give up!$B$BThat's why Arugal made an example of us.  We wouldn't fall in line, you see?  We wouldn't join his wolfcult!
english.completion: Curse our luck.  We find the one functioning mine this side of the hills and it's full of Scourge. No offense, friend.  But that survivor you found sounds like he's been a little traumatized due to losing his friends.  Arugal's been dead for years... I even saw his grave once.

text.title: 盲眼卢娜
text.objectives: 前往沃达希尔小径附近的卢娜的营地，与盲眼卢娜谈一谈。
text.description: 你好。我刚才无意中听到你和中士的谈话，我刚好知道点什么，所以只想提醒你一下……诺森德的事情没有这么简单。$B$B某个人仅仅是死了的话，绝不会简单地退出历史的舞台，这里死而复生的事情你还见得少了吗？$B$B此地西南方，就在沃达希尔小径附近居住着一位名叫盲眼卢娜的女人。据说，这个女人可以与死者交谈，还能看见过去或未来的一些情景。$B$B虽然不太清楚你这里的情况，但我感觉她会对你有所帮助。
text.completion: You seek knowledge beyond your reach so you've come to me.  I must warn you, stranger, the answers I provide might not be to your liking.

english.title: Ruuna the Blind
english.objectives: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp near Vordrassil Pass.
english.description: Hey there.  I overheard what you were saying to the captain and I just want you to know...  things aren't that simple in Northrend.$B$BJust because someone's dead it doesn't mean they're out of the picture.$B$BSouthwest of here, near Vordrassil Pass, lives a blind woman who goes by the name Ruuna the Blind.  They say she speaks to the dead and has visions of the past and future.$B$BI haven't heard your whole story but it sounds like she'd be right up your alley.
english.completion: You seek knowledge beyond your reach so you've come to me.  I must warn you, stranger, the answers I provide might not be to your liking.

text.title: 狼人的末日
text.objectives: 白松商栈的萨莎要求你前往血月岛，杀死塞拉斯、瓦拉姆、污血之喉和阿鲁高之影。
text.description: 是时候了，$N。必须除掉阿鲁高。$B$B我们要集结一小队值得信赖的精锐冒险者前往海岸对面的血月岛，就在东边。$B$B我们必须组织一次快速的打击。先清除掉阿鲁高手下最忠心的几个守卫，等到你正式向他挑战时，我会及时赶来的。
text.progress: 见到你很高兴，$N。
text.completion: We got him good, $n.  But not good enough. One thing's for sure... we won't be seeing him around these parts any longer.
text.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Hour of the Worg
english.objectives: Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to go to  Bloodmoon Isle and slay Selas, Varlam, Goremaw and the Shade of Arugal.
english.description: It is time, then, $N.  Arugal must be defeated.$B$BGet a couple of people you can trust and head for Bloodmoon Isle.  It's just off the coast, east of here.$B$BWe'll hit them fast.  Take out Arugal's lieutenants -- I'll catch up with you when it's time to take out the monster himself.
english.completion: We got him good, $n.  But not good enough. One thing's for sure... we won't be seeing him around these parts any longer.
english.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: An Intriguing Plan
text.objectives: Bring the completed War Golem Blueprints to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: Prospector Rokar has decided to help us. He's concocted a plan to use the iron dwarves' strength against them.$B$BI must admit, our new 'friend' is more insightful than I'd given him credit for. He's correct in that our numbers are too few for a direct attack.$B$BTravel to Dun Argol, in the snowy regions to the southeast, and capture all the parts of their war golem blueprints from the iron rune-smiths there. Bring the assembled blueprint to Rokar and we'll see if his plan has any merit.
text.progress: Do... do you have those blueprints I asked for?
text.completion: So Tormak's going to go ahead with the plan? I suppose he wouldn't have sent you if he didn't. Oh, bother... Now how am I going to figure out how to put this together under all this pressure?
text.completed: Return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.objectives: Bring the completed War Golem Blueprints to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
english.description: Prospector Rokar has decided to help us. Bring the assembled blueprint to Rokar and we'll see if his plan has any merit.

english.completion: So Tormak's going to go ahead with the plan? I suppose he wouldn't have sent you if he didn't. Oh, bother... Now how am I going to figure out how to put this together under all this pressure?
english.completed: Return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 艾露恩的火油
text.objectives: 群星之墓的典狱官朱蒂·月歌要你使用艾露恩的火油净化6只天灾麋鹿的尸体和6只狂暴灰熊的尸体。
text.description: $R will you assist me?$B$BThe Scourge have moved into Icemist to the north. Wherever they go, they spread their taint, and the creatures of the land suffer.$B$BTake this vial, which is filled with the liquid fire of Elune from the moonwell. Please, use the liquid to cleanse the corpses of the blighted wildlife that you find.
text.progress: It is a shame that we cannot heal the bears and elk that have fallen victim to the Scourge presence.$B$BAt least we can prevent the taint from spreading further.
text.completion: We have done what we can for the creatures of the land. Now we must take direct action against those that have caused this!
text.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Liquid Fire of Elune
english.objectives: Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest has asked you to use the Liquid Fire of Elune to cleanse the corpses of 6 Blighted Elk and 6 Rabid Grizzlies.
english.description: $R will you assist me?$B$BThe Scourge have moved into Icemist to the north. Wherever they go, they spread their taint, and the creatures of the land suffer.$B$BTake this vial, which is filled with the liquid fire of Elune from the moonwell. Please, use the liquid to cleanse the corpses of the blighted wildlife that you find.
english.progress: It is a shame that we cannot heal the bears and elk that have fallen victim to the Scourge presence.$B$BAt least we can prevent the taint from spreading further.
english.completion: We have done what we can for the creatures of the land. Now we must take direct action against those that have caused this!
english.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 消灭教徒
text.objectives: 群星之墓的典狱官朱蒂·月歌要你收集5件教徒的衣物。
text.description: 阿努巴尔教徒是间接造成动物们感染瘟疫的原因，因此我们必须阻止他们！$B$B他们衣服里冒出的毒雾会渗入那些接近过他们的生物体内，污染着环境。$B$B你必须到北面的冰雾村去杀了他们，把他们的衣服给我带来，我会妥善处理掉。
text.progress: The cultists are a blight upon creation!
text.completion: Well done. I will dispose of these filthy garments by cleansing them in the moonwell and destroying them through the power of the goddess!
text.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: Kill the Cultists
english.objectives: Collect 5 Functional Cultist Suits for Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest.
english.description: The Anub'ar cultists are indirectly responsible for the plaguing of the beasts, and we must put an end to it!$B$BThe fumes that emit from the cultists' suits seep into everything they come near, poisoning and corrupting their surroundings.$B$BYou must go north to Icemist Village and slay them. Bring back any of their suits that survive your assault and I will see to it that they are properly disposed of.
english.progress: The cultists are a blight upon creation!
english.completion: Well done. I will dispose of these filthy garments by cleansing them in the moonwell and destroying them through the power of the goddess!
english.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 扎古斯的礼物
text.objectives: 将扎古斯的礼物交给群星之墓的典狱官朱蒂·月歌要。
text.description: 在这件礼物的背面写着：$B$B“给我最爱的学生，$B$B如果你能继续遵守诺言，我会让你领略超乎你想象的奇迹。$B$B如果你胆敢背叛，我就毁灭你！$B$B你永远的良师，$B$B高阶教徒扎古斯”$B$B群星之墓的典狱官肯定会对这东西感兴趣的。
text.progress: I sense something foul is near. It is upon your person! What is it, $n?
text.completion: So, the leader of the cultists has revealed himself. We have a name. Vanity and pride will be his downfall!
text.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Favor of Zangus
english.objectives: Deliver the Favor of Zangus to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest.
english.description: An inscription on the back of the favor reads,$B$B"To my favorite pupil,$B$BIf you continue to show promise, I will teach you wonders beyond your imaginings.$B$BIf you do not, I will have you destroyed!$B$BAs ever,$B$BHigh Cultist Zangus"$B$BNo doubt the warden at Stars' Rest will want to see this.
english.progress: I sense something foul is near. It is upon your person! What is it, $n?
english.completion: So, the leader of the cultists has revealed himself. We have a name. Vanity and pride will be his downfall!
english.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 高阶教徒
text.objectives: 群星之墓的典狱官朱蒂·月歌要你杀死高阶教徒扎古斯。
text.description: 我曾经梦见过扎古斯，但如果没有你发现的这些文字，我就不可能理解那个梦意味着什么。你的发现让我明白了，这是女神给我的指示，而我们已经知道，他就在北面的纳尔苏深渊里。$B$B你知道该怎么做，$N。为了拯救这片土地，必须除掉这个高阶教徒！
text.progress: I sense that High Cultist Zangus yet lives.$B$BIs there something wrong, $N? Perhaps you need to rest first?
text.completion: With the high cultist destroyed, the rest of his forces can be mopped up and the land and its creatures will recover. Thank you, $n. May the goddess illuminate your path.
text.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: The High Cultist
english.objectives: Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest has asked you to slay High Cultist Zangus.
english.description: I have dreamed of Zangus before but without the context that you have discovered, I knew not what it meant. You have brought clarity to the vision that the goddess has bestowed upon me, and now I know that he can be found within the Pit of Narjun to the north.$B$BYou know your target, $N. If there's to be an end to the suffering of the land, the high cultist must die!
english.progress: I sense that High Cultist Zangus yet lives.$B$BIs there something wrong, $N? Perhaps you need to rest first?
english.completion: With the high cultist destroyed, the rest of his forces can be mopped up and the land and its creatures will recover. Thank you, $n. May the goddess illuminate your path.
english.completed: Return to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 黑水伐木场的战斗
text.objectives: 骑兵队长克洛恩希望你在黑水伐木场击杀10名联盟士兵或者玩家。
text.description: 我们在这里出现后不久，风险投资公司就放弃了他们在这里的工程。显然他们担心我们会对他们贪婪的小把戏有所行动。$B$B既然他们已经离开了，他们的伐木场也就属于公共财产了。我们的战争机器是一头饥饿的野兽……如果没有持续不断的补给，我们是不可能成功抵达冰冠冰川的。$B$B不过，联盟似乎和我们有着相同的想法，因此我们必须保证只有部落才是最终获胜的一方。向伐木场出发吧，帮我们对抗那些联盟狗。
text.progress: Have you slain the Alliance dogs? Victory must be ours!
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Our control over the logging camp might not be complete yet, but thanks to you we're one step closer to smashing these Alliance worms.
text.completed: Return to Raider Captain Kronn in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Blackriver Brawl
english.objectives: Raider Captain Kronn wants you to slay 10 Alliance units or players at the Blackriver Logging Camp.
english.description: The Venture Company abandoned operations shortly after we showed up.  Clearly they were afraid of what we were going to do to their greedy little hides.$B$BWith them gone, their logging camps are up for grabs.  Our war machine is a hungry beast... without renewing our supplies we won't make it to Icecrown.$B$BUnfortunately the Alliance seems to have the same idea and we must make sure we're the ones that prevail.  Head into the logging camp and help us fight the Alliance scum.
english.progress: Have you slain the Alliance dogs? Victory must be ours!
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Our control over the logging camp might not be complete yet, but thanks to you we're one step closer to smashing these Alliance worms.
english.completed: Return to Raider Captain Kronn in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 叛徒的名单
text.objectives: 向群星之墓的帕蕾娜·银云出示联盟信函。
text.description: 你必须立即把我手里的这份名单交给高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩。他指挥的第七军团就驻扎在龙骨荒野东部的暮冬要塞里。$B$B如果这份名单上的叛徒进入了暮冬要塞……那就太可怕了。$B$B赶快，$N。把这份文件给群星之墓这里的帕蕾娜·银云看看，向她解释你的任务性质。她会派最快的角鹰兽送你前往暮冬要塞！
text.progress: 你好，$R。
text.completion: You will take my fastest hippogryph, $r! This information must be delivered to High Commander Wyrmbane at once!
text.completed: Return to Palena Silvercloud at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

english.title: Of Traitors and Treason
english.objectives: Show the Alliance Missive to Palena Silvercloud at Stars' Rest.
english.description: The list I hold must be delivered to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He commands the 7th Legion, stationed at Wintergarde Keep on the eastern borders of Dragonblight.$B$BIf any of the traitors on this list are stationed at Wintergarde... it could be catastrophic.$B$BHurry, $N. Show the document to Palena Silvercloud here at Stars' Rest and explain the nature of your mission. She will put you on her fastest hippogryph to Wintergarde!
english.progress: Hello, $r.
english.completion: You will take my fastest hippogryph, $r! This information must be delivered to High Commander Wyrmbane at once!
english.completed: Return to Palena Silvercloud at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.

text.title: 达拉然的能量调和
text.objectives: The Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest has asked you to become Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend.
text.description: Welcome, mage.$B$BBy now you must be wondering where Dalaran is and how to get there. I will help you.$B$BBut before I can teach you how to teleport to our great city, you must attune yourself to the ley lines of Northrend. Otherwise, you risk destroying yourself in the process.$B$BTake this attunement crystal and use it in the pit under the surge needle at the Moonrest Gardens to the west. Then you will be ready to learn the spell.
text.progress: Are you attuned? You mustn't lie about this, $N.$B$BIf you fail to prepare yourself properly, and I teach you the spell, the first time that you cast it will be the last time anyone will ever see you!
text.completion: Very well. If you are ready, then so am I.
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend

english.objectives: The Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest has asked you to become Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend.

I will help you.$B$BBut before I can teach you how to teleport to our great city, you must attune yourself to the ley lines of Northrend. Otherwise, you risk destroying yourself in the process.$B$BTake this attunement crystal and use it in the pit under the surge needle at the Moonrest Gardens to the west. Then you will be ready to learn the spell.
english.progress: Are you attuned? You mustn't lie about this, $N.$B$BIf you fail to prepare yourself properly, and I teach you the spell, the first time that you cast it will be the last time anyone will ever see you!

text.title: 达拉然的能量调和
text.objectives: 阿格玛之锤的大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像要你与诺森德的魔网能量线进行调和。
text.description: 欢迎你，法师。$B$B你现在肯定在想，达拉然在哪里？怎样才能去那里呢？让我来帮你吧。$B$B不过在我教你如何传送到我们伟大的城市去之前，你必须得对你自己和诺森德的魔网能量线进行调和。否则，你可能会在传送过程中伤害到自己。$B$B带上这块魔网调和水晶，前往这里西南面的眠月花园，在那里的湍流之针下面的深坑中使用它。这样你就完成了学习法术的准备。
text.completion: Very well. If you think you are ready, then let's not waste anymore of my time.
text.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend

english.title: Attunement to Dalaran
english.objectives: The Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer has asked you to become Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend.
english.description: Hello, mage.$B$BBy now you must be wondering where Dalaran is and how to get there. I can help you with this if you can survive a simple test.$B$BBefore I teach you how to teleport to our great city, you must attune yourself to the ley lines of Northrend. Otherwise, you will destroy yourself in the process!$B$BTake this attunement crystal and use it in the pit under the surge needle at the Moonrest Gardens to the southwest. Then you will be ready to learn what I have to teach.
english.completion: Very well. If you think you are ready, then let's not waste anymore of my time.
english.completed: Return to Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend

enders.name: 大法师艾萨斯·夺日者的影像

text.title: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩
text.objectives: Deliver the Alliance Missive to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in eastern Dragonblight. $B$B
text.description: <Palena hands the missive back to you.>$B$BSnowstorm will take you to Wintergarde, $N. I guarantee you that it will be the fastest flight you've ever taken. Go now!$B$B
text.progress: What have you got there, soldier?
text.completion: Do you know where the people on this list are now? Take a look outside, near the front gate. They're the ones hanging from the arches. Ghoul bait...

text.title: 灰狼的毛皮
text.objectives: 征服堡的皮货商人休尼克希望你能从北面森林的灰雾捕猎者身上获取3张灰色座狼皮。
text.description: 让我来告诉你一些事情吧，朋友。当你负责给部落的军队提供装备时，就会需要大量的毛皮！$B$B征服者克雷娜，就是那个负责这地方各类事务的母老虎，她给我定了一个严格的交货日期。如果我不能在本周末前给她的整支部队置办好军装的话，她会把我扔进坑里跟熊摔跤的。$B$B帮我一把，我会出最好的价钱给你。我需要灰雾捕猎者身上的毛皮。$B$B你可以在这里的北面找到它们，一般来说它们都在捕猎野鹿。记住，朋友，最好的价钱哦。
text.progress: You get dose hides, mon?
text.completion: You're a life saver, brother.  If you're interested in more work, there's more where that came from.
text.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Gray Worg Hides
english.objectives: Hidetrader Jun'ik in Conquest Hold wants you to get 3 Gray Worg Hides from Graymist Hunters in the woods to the north.
english.description: Let me tell you something, mon.  When you get put in charge of outfittin' the armies of the Horde, you go through a lot of hides!$B$BConqueror Krenna, the she-wolf runnin' this place, she gave me a tight deadline.  If I don't outfit her whole regiment by week's end she's gonna have me wrestling bears in the pit.$B$BHelp me out and I'll pay you top price.  I'll be needin' hides from graymist hunters.$B$BYou'll find them all around in pockets to the north, hunting stag.  Remember, mon.  Top price!
english.progress: You get dose hides, mon?
english.completion: You're a life saver, brother.  If you're interested in more work, there's more where that came from.
english.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 替代品
text.objectives: 皮货商人休尼克希望你能交给他6张灰熊皮。
text.description: 克雷娜想用座狼的皮来制作所有军装。可是，似乎没有足够多的座狼皮能满足她这支部队的需要。现在不够，永远也都不可能够。$B$B那些座狼实在是太瘦小了，朋友！如果你能保守秘密的话……我们可以这样……$B$B沃德伦的东面生活着像食人魔一样肥硕的大灰熊。我们可以使用那些大家伙的毛皮来充数！$B$B快点，朋友。克雷娜可没有什么耐心。
text.progress: You get those hides, mon?
text.completion: I'm in your debt, mon.  Take this as payment.
text.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: A Minor Substitution
english.objectives: Hidetrader Jun'ik wants you to bring him 6 Grizzly Hides.
english.description: Krenna, she be wantin' worg hides for all the outfits.  There's not gonna be enough worg hides for her army, though.  Not now, not ever.$B$BThose worgs -- they be skinny, mon!  Here's what we're gonna do... if you can keep a secret that is.$B$BEast of Voldrune there be grizzly bears as fat as an ogre.  Those large hides -- those we can use!$B$BHurry, $g brother:sister;.  Krenna's not known for her patience.
english.progress: You get those hides, mon?
english.completion: I'm in your debt, mon.  Take this as payment.
english.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Jun'ik's Coverup
text.objectives: Bring 1 piece of Coal and 5 Simple Flour to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.
text.description: 啊，我们有一个小问题。灰熊隐藏着......他们是棕色的，星期一！$B$B认为...想！$B$B我明白了，mon！就是这样：灰黑色的一个白色都混在一起了。你给我一些煤和一些面粉，我就把它磨好，然后用它去掸。没有人会知道更好的！$B$BBlacksmiths出售煤炭的'smeltin'你可以从提供者面粉。
text.progress: You get the stuff, mon?
text.completion: Hope for the best, mon.
text.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Jun'ik's Coverup
english.objectives: Bring 1 piece of Coal and 5 Simple Flour to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.
english.description: Ah, we have a small problem.  Grizzly hides... they be brown, mon!$B$BThink... think!$B$BI got it, mon!  Is like this: gray is black an' white all mixed up.  You get me some coal an' some flour, I'll grind it all up and dust the hides with it.  No one will know the better!$B$BBlacksmiths sell coal for smeltin' an' you can get flour from the provisioner.
english.progress: You get the stuff, mon?
english.completion: Hope for the best, mon.
english.completed: Return to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Delivery to Krenna
text.objectives: Take the Bundle of Hides to Krenna in Conquest Hold.
text.description: This is it, mon.  Let's take these hides to Krenna and see if they pass the test.$B$BLet's hope for both our sakes Krenna doesn't notice anything.
text.progress: Do you have any idea who you're talking to?
text.completion: Just who do you take me for?  These hides smell of flour! This is a complete insult to the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.objectives: Take the Bundle of Hides to Krenna in Conquest Hold.
english.description: This is it, mon.  Let's take these hides to Krenna and see if they pass the test.$B$BLet's hope for both our sakes Krenna doesn't notice anything.
english.progress: Do you have any idea who you're talking to?
english.completion: Just who do you take me for?  These hides smell of flour! This is a complete insult to the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.
