text.objectives: LOG: Complete this quest for Specialization 1.
text.description: DESCRIPTION: Complete this quest for Specialization 1.
text.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft.

english.title: Specialization 1 [PH]
english.objectives: LOG: Complete this quest for Specialization 1.
english.description: DESCRIPTION: Complete this quest for Specialization 1.
english.completed: Return to Jonathan LeCraft.

text.title: 被俘虏的勘探员
text.objectives: 营救勘探员甘恩、勘探员托尔根和勘探员瓦拉纳，然后返回勘探员哨站，向巡山人基连复命。
text.description: 莱加尔派了一队勘察员前往丹厄古尔搜寻古器，顺便收集关于这座遗址的历史资料。他们未曾料到丹厄古尔竟是个有重兵把守的要塞。$B$B勘察小队被丹厄古尔的铁矮人囚禁起来了。我们暂时找不到接替他们的人手，而莱加尔整日里挖空心思地计划如何打败铁矮人，根本无暇顾及此事。$B$B$N，营救勘察员的重任就交给你啦。铁矮人或是他们的仆从身上可能携带着囚笼的钥匙。
text.progress: Did you locate the missing prospectors?
text.completion: They mentioned Loken and a war against stone giants? You're certain? So Raegar's instincts were right. We have to find a way to get in there and learn more about their plans.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Captive Prospectors
english.objectives: Free Prospector Gann, Prospector Torgan, and Prospector Varana, then return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
english.description: Raegar sent a team of prospectors into Dun Argol to search for artifacts and information about the history of the settlement. Raegar's team never expected Dun Argol to be this heavily populated.$B$BThey're being held captive while the iron dwarves prepare for war. We haven't the men to charge in after them, and Raegar's too busy fantasizing about defeating the irons to be of much help.$B$BIt falls to you, $N. Any of the irons or their servants could be carrying the keys to the cages holding our men.
english.progress: Did you locate the missing prospectors?
english.completion: They mentioned Loken and a war against stone giants? You're certain? So Raegar's instincts were right. We have to find a way to get in there and learn more about their plans.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 给它一个名字
text.objectives: Show the Blight Specimen to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand.$B$B
text.description: My, my, how long has it been? How long have we been working on this damned plague? Finally, after an eternity of failure, we are blessed with perfection. This... It doesn't even have a proper name yet! This blight... That's it, BLIGHT! This blight will tear down the very fabric of life!$B$B<Harris hands you a vial.>$B$BNow, find the bat handler, Tobias, and show him the specimen. He'll get you on your way to Venomspite.$B$B
text.progress: Highly lethal poisonous gas delivery to Venomspite? Step right up!
text.completion: Uh, yea, you can go ahead and hold on to that vial, friend. I trust you.
text.completed: Return to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Give it a Name
english.objectives: Show the Blight Specimen to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand.$B$B
english.description: My, my, how long has it been? How long have we been working on this damned plague? Finally, after an eternity of failure, we are blessed with perfection. This... It doesn't even have a proper name yet! This blight... That's it, BLIGHT! This blight will tear down the very fabric of life!$B$B<Harris hands you a vial.>$B$BNow, find the bat handler, Tobias, and show him the specimen. He'll get you on your way to Venomspite.$B$B
english.progress: Highly lethal poisonous gas delivery to Venomspite? Step right up!
english.completion: Uh, yea, you can go ahead and hold on to that vial, friend. I trust you.
english.completed: Return to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 前往怨毒镇！
text.objectives: 前往龙骨荒野东部的怨毒镇，将凋零药剂样本交给首席药剂师米德尔顿。
text.description: 我这里正好有一只整装待发的蝙蝠可以给你用，伙计。它可是我这里飞得最快的，保证又快又稳地把你送到怨毒镇去。$B$B到了那边之后，把样本交给首席药剂师米德尔顿就行了。
text.progress: You are the delivery boy?
text.completion: Oh joyous day! And look, just beyond the mountain to the northeast creeps a whole field of Scourge for us to obliterate!
text.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton in Dragonblight.

english.title: To Venomspite!
english.objectives: Deliver the Blight Specimen to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in eastern Dragonblight.
english.description: I got a special bat all lined up for you, buddy. Fastest and smoothest ride I've got. He'll take you right to Venomspite - in style.$B$BJust hand that vial over to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton once you land.
english.progress: You are the delivery boy?
english.completion: Oh joyous day! And look, just beyond the mountain to the northeast creeps a whole field of Scourge for us to obliterate!
english.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton in Dragonblight.

text.title: 搜集制服
text.objectives: 将一件监工的制服交给勘探员哨站的巡山人基连。
text.description: 如果勘探员瓦拉纳所言非虚的话，似乎只有监工级别的铁矮人才有权接近这个洛肯。$B$B你得设法混进去探个究竟，不过这事儿有点棘手。首先我们要搞到一件监工的制服。$B$B然后我们就替你好好地伪装一番。$B$B前往丹厄古尔，干掉一名监工，把他的制服给我带回来。如果你不小心让血溅到制服上，那就自认倒霉吧。
text.progress: Did you get the uniform?
text.completion: This should do. I won't have time to sew on a little patch with '$n' embroidered on it or anything, but anyone looking closely at you should be convinced that you're an overseer by the time we're done with you.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Looking the Part
english.objectives: Bring an Overseer's Uniform to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
english.description: If, as Prospector Varana said, only certain irons are permitted to communicate with this Loken, it'll probably be the overseers who have the privilege.$B$BWe have to get you in there to see what all this is about, but it won't be easy. The first step will be to get a proper uniform for you.$B$BThen, we'll worry about doing your makeup.$B$BFind one of the overseers at Dun Argol, kill him, and bring back his uniform. If you get blood on it, you'll have only yourself to blame.
english.progress: Did you get the uniform?
english.completion: This should do. I won't have time to sew on a little patch with '$n' embroidered on it or anything, but anyone looking closely at you should be convinced that you're an overseer by the time we're done with you.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 拍摄照片
text.objectives: 用基连的相机拍摄8张丹厄古尔铁矮人的照片，然后返回勘探员哨站，向巡山人基连复命。
text.description: 制服已经到手啦，不过我们需要更为详细的资料来完善伪装。$B$B这台相机是莱加尔用来记录探险队的发现的，不过它或许能派上别的用场。我要你带上它进入丹厄古尔，拍摄一些铁矮人的照片。$B$B当然，你的模特们很可能不是那么合作，如此一来呢，你就必须……嗯……制伏他们。完成任务后把相机和照片一同带回来给我。
text.progress: Did you get those snapshots?
text.completion: Good, these should do. Now, to create a kit to pass you off as a convincing iron dwarf.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Cultivating an Image
english.objectives: Use Kilian's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
english.description: Now that we've got the uniform, we've got to get enough information to complete your camouflage.$B$BRaegar brought along this camera to document the team's finds, but I have a different use in mind. I want you to take it with you to Dun Argol and use it to capture the images of iron dwarves.$B$BOf course, your models aren't going to be a cooperative lot, so you may have to, err... subdue them first. Bring back the camera and the images when you're done.
english.progress: Did you get those snapshots?
english.completion: Good, these should do. Now, to create a kit to pass you off as a convincing iron dwarf.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 笑脸面对洛肯！
text.objectives: 伪装成铁符文监工，截获洛肯的指令，然后返回勘探员哨站，向巡山人基连复命。
text.description: 参考了你拍摄的照片之后，我已经为你做好了监工伪装包。我可不是吹牛，这玩意儿能将你包装成货真价实的铁矮人。$B$B进入丹厄古尔后使用伪装包，然后前往废墟中层最东边的建筑物。$B$B领主和监工利用安置在建筑物中的底座接收来自洛肯的指令。在伪装状态下激活底座，截获情报。
text.progress: Did the disguise work?
text.completion: Could it be that Loken isn't really exaggerating? The titans' stone and iron sons fighting against each other for control of the ancient city of Ulduar. This is madness, $n and it could destroy our only chance to learn the true history of dwarvenkind!
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Put on Your Best Face for Loken
english.objectives: Disguise yourself as an Iron Rune Overseer, intercept the message from Loken, then report to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
english.description: Using the images you've captured, I've created everything you need for your overseer disguise kit. You'll make a fine iron dwarf, if I do say so myself.$B$BTake the kit with you to Dun Argol, use it to disguise yourself, then go to the easternmost building on the broad middle tier of the city.$B$BThere, you should see a pedestal where the thane and overseers receive their orders from this Loken. Activate it while disguised and learn all you can from the communication.
english.progress: Did the disguise work?
english.completion: Could it be that Loken isn't really exaggerating? The titans' stone and iron sons fighting against each other for control of the ancient city of Ulduar. This is madness, $n and it could destroy our only chance to learn the true history of dwarvenkind!
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 凋零药剂与你：如何自保
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的首席药剂师米德尔顿要求你给他带回10份灵质残渣。
text.description: 凋零药剂的化学组成是怎样它如何生效如何发挥其功能等等，这些细节问题都完全不重要。你所需要知道的仅仅就是：它是否能按设计指标达成它的效能，这就足够了。我已经成功地把成分导入了休眠状态。$B$B<米德尔顿拔开一个试管的塞子，放在鼻子边上猛吸了一口。>$B$B看，完全没事，我的身体完全没变化。这种成分只要混入使它重新活化的催化剂，就能恢复威力。$B$B现在的课题就是找到催化剂最合理的成分。你可以在南边海滩上找到许多联盟士兵的鬼魂。把他们干掉，然后把他们身上的灵质残渣带回来给我。
text.progress: The residue will be used as the reactive agent to activate the blight!$B$B
text.completion: This will do nicely, $n. Did those pathetic whelps put up a fight or did they just shower you with ghostly tears of sorrow? Ah, they get so emotional...
text.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Forsaken Blight and You: How Not to Die
english.objectives: Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to bring him 10 Ectoplasmic Residue.
english.description: The details behind the functionality of the blight are hardly important. All you need to know is that it does the job it was designed to do. I have managed to synthesize a strain of the blight that is inert.$B$B<Middleton uncorks a vial and inhales.>$B$BSee, my body is still, mostly, intact. Now mix this with a reactive agent and we'd all be turned to shapeless piles of goo.$B$BOn the beach south of here you will find pathetic specters of Alliance soldiers past. Slay them and bring me ectoplasmic residue.
english.progress: The residue will be used as the reactive agent to activate the blight!$B$B
english.completion: This will do nicely, $n. Did those pathetic whelps put up a fight or did they just shower you with ghostly tears of sorrow? Ah, they get so emotional...
english.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 笨蛋加傻瓜！
text.objectives: Travel to Venomspite in Dragonblight and speak with Chief Plaguebringer Middleton.$B$B
text.description: 那些从新阿加曼德出发的货物本来上周就该抵达怨毒镇，并且在完成一些简单的实地测试之后立刻就送到我手上的。这是部落的军令——那批货物可是“胜利拼图”的最后一部分！$B$B<辛塔尔无奈地叹了一口气。>$B$B这世上最让人无奈和灰心的事情，就是你突然发现身边的人都是一群无能的白痴笨蛋！$B$B没办法，拜托你了，你现在必须立刻前往龙骨荒野东部边境的怨毒镇，找到米德尔顿那个猪头，然后揪着他的衣领告诉他，本大爷在等那个该死的包裹。
text.completion: We ran into a little - MINOR - problem. Everyone that tried handling the blight vaporized. We're working on adjusting the formula a tad so it doesn't instantly kill you for looking at it sideways. The good news is that I think I've almost got it!

english.title: Imbeciles Abound!
english.objectives: Travel to Venomspite in Dragonblight and speak with Chief Plaguebringer Middleton.$B$B
english.description: The shipment from New Agamand was to arrive at Venomspite last week and then be delivered to me after some simple field tests. It is a Horde imperative - the last piece of the "victory puzzle."$B$B<Sintar sighs.>$B$BIt is quite disheartening to know that you are surrounded by imbeciles and incompetent boobs!$B$BYou must travel to Venomspite, near the eastern border of Dragonblight. Find that buffoon, Middleton, and let him know that I am waiting on the package.
english.completion: We ran into a little - MINOR - problem. Everyone that tried handling the blight vaporized. We're working on adjusting the formula a tad so it doesn't instantly kill you for looking at it sideways. The good news is that I think I've almost got it!

text.title: 跟我的小朋友打招呼
text.objectives: 普雷蒙希望你将哈考尔的调料的交给哈考尔营地的哈考尔。
text.description: 哈考尔肯定愿意用金砖来换这些精选的材料。你只需把东西都带给他就行啦。$B$B他就驻营在东部海岸的那些废墟附近——好像是叫达基尔金废墟什么的。$B$B你应该能在我处理掉这些尸体之前达到那里……除非，你情愿待在这里帮这些尸体涂上防腐剂？
text.progress: What can I do fer ya?
text.completion: Well now! Good ol' Prigmon sent ya did he? This should make fer some mighty fine eatin'. Needs just a couple things...
text.completed: Seek out Harkor at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Say Hello to My Little Friend
english.objectives: Prigmon wants you to bring Harkor's Ingredients to Harkor at Harkor's Camp.
english.description: Harkor's gunna drop a gold brick when he sees these choice ingredients. All that be left is gettin' them to him.$b$bHe's camped out on the eastern coast near dem haunted ruins - Drakil'jin, dey be called.$b$bYou'll likely be makin' it there before I can finish up with these corpses... unless, ya think you'd rather try your hand at embalming?
english.progress: What can I do fer ya?
english.completion: Well now! Good ol' Prigmon sent ya did he? This should make fer some mighty fine eatin'. Needs just a couple things...
english.completed: Seek out Harkor at Harkor's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 扔酒杯！
text.objectives: Use the Complimentary Brewfest Sampler to hit S.T.O.U.T. 5 times, then talk to Bizzle Quicklift.
text.description: Those pesky Dark Irons are back!  We need to make sure that you can defend yourself if needed.  More importantly, we need to know that you can defend our property!$b$bS.T.O.U.T. here is ready for action, are you?  Drink from the Complimentary Brewfest Samplers then throw the mug at S.T.O.U.T.!  Hit the target 5 times then talk to me.
text.progress: Chug from the mug, then chuck the mug at S.T.O.U.T. I think he can withstand the pounding. I wouldn't have stol.. er... built him if he couldn't!
text.completion: Wow...  S.T.O.U.T. didn't break... Hmm... Who would have guessed? I mean, hey, you did it!  Your aim is true, or at least true enough to help guard the camp.  I think you're ready now to take on the Dark Irons if they show up again.
text.completed: Return to Bizzle Quicklift in Durotar.

english.objectives: Use the Complimentary Brewfest Sampler to hit S.T.O.U.T. 5 times, then talk to Bizzle Quicklift.

Hit the target 5 times then talk to me.

text.title: 那次，我喝醉了之后……
text.objectives: Talk to Bizzle Quicklift in the Brewfest camp.
text.description: The Dark Irons took a beating!  As they rushed back to the Grim Guzzler, a portion of their transport fell off.  More importantly, you managed to keep the camp safe... today.$b$bHead over to Bizzle and explain your heroic triumph over the Dark Iron dwarves.
text.completion: So you managed to stop the Dark Irons... While drunk too?  That, $c, is truly the spirit of Brewfest!  I guess in keeping with the spirit of Brewfest you want your prize tokens. Thanks for your help, $n.  Enjoy the rest of Brewfest.

english.title: This One Time, When I Was Drunk...
english.objectives: Talk to Bizzle Quicklift in the Brewfest camp.
english.description: The Dark Irons took a beating!  As they rushed back to the Grim Guzzler, a portion of their transport fell off.  More importantly, you managed to keep the camp safe... today.$b$bHead over to Bizzle and explain your heroic triumph over the Dark Iron dwarves.
english.completion: So you managed to stop the Dark Irons... While drunk too?  That, $c, is truly the spirit of Brewfest!  I guess in keeping with the spirit of Brewfest you want your prize tokens. Thanks for your help, $n.  Enjoy the rest of Brewfest.

text.title: Say, There Wouldn't Happen to be a Souvenir This Year, Would There?
text.objectives: 去美酒节营地的贝尔比那里兑换美酒节礼品券。
text.description: Brewfest isn't just about racing rams, it's also about drinking!  When you have a moment, take this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch.  She's near the back of the Brewfest camp.  If you can't see her, don't worry, she'll be sure to see you.$b$bIn any case, take this voucher to her to get your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.
text.progress: What's happening hot stuff?  Got something for me?
text.completion: Aww, it's just a stein voucher... Maybe you're just playing hard to get. So here's this year's stein for you.$b$bBut I suspect I'll be seeing a lot more of you. After all, if you want any Brewfest tokens redeemed, I'm your girl...$b$bOr maybe I'm his girl...$b$bOooohhh... or his...
text.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

text.title: Say, There Wouldn't Happen to be a Souvenir This Year, Would There?
text.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
text.description: Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out!  Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means!  Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.
text.progress: What's happening hot stuff?  Got something for me?
text.completion: What's this? A stein voucher? So you like drinking? Great! After I give you this stein, go have a few drinks! Then a few more. Maybe have a few more after that... Then, now this is important, come see me.$b$bLook, I know you'll be back eventually. If you want your Brewfest tokens redeemed you have to see me.$b$bAnyways, here's the stein, and remember to talk to me later.
text.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

text.title: The Unexpected 'Guest'
text.objectives: Bring 5 Mature Stag Horns to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: A recent hunting expedition brought back more than just game.$B$BThey encountered a wounded dwarf fleeing the iron dwarf stronghold of Dun Argol. He may have information we can use to strike at our ancient enemy, but before he's of any use to us, we must bring down his fever.$B$BThe horns of the silvercoat stags, who roam the nearby forest, have long been used to make healing poultices. If you can bring enough of the horns to me, we'll see if the poultice can bring our 'guest' around.
text.progress: Did you bring the horns?
text.completion: These should serve. Now, let's see if it works.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: From the Ground Up
text.objectives: Bring 8 War Golem Parts to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: We don't have enough time for me to forge the parts myself, but the foundries over at Dun Argol, to the southeast, are working day and night to churn out golem parts.$B$BI think you should go back there and pick up enough of them for me to make a golem from this blueprint.$B$BThey're probably scattered around any of the buildings where the iron rune-smiths are working.$B$BPlease hurry, $N. That Tormak looks like he's just waiting for an excuse to carry out his threat!
text.progress: D-did you b-b-bring those golem parts?
text.completion: Oh, thank the Light. He was threatening not to feed me until you returned. Let's sort through this pile of parts and see what we can make.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 我们有能源
text.objectives: Bring Durar's Power Cell and Kathorn's Power Cell to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: Well, we've got the shell of a golem, but that's not good enough for Tormak. He doesn't realize that these things don't just come together and miraculously start working! We're going to need power cells to animate it.$B$BWhen I was in Dun Argol, I noticed that Rune-Smith Durar and Rune-Smith Kathorn were the ones who manufactured the cells. We'll need one from each to power our golem.$B$BYou should be able to find each rune-smith in his workshop on the central level of Dun Argol.
text.progress: Do you have those power cells?
text.completion: These are low, but they'll be enough to start up the golem. He's nowhere near ready for battle, though.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: ……我们没有能源
text.objectives: Charge your War Golem with the energy from 10 Lightning Sentries and return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: The golem's cells have just enough power to run it at the lowest levels, but it can't power any of its combat systems.$B$BThe good news is that the perimeter of Dun Argol is patrolled by lightning sentries. We should be able to use their power to charge up the golem's weapon systems.$B$BBring the golem with you, take it close to them, it will absorb the power as the sentries die.
text.completion: Well, now Tormak can't complain anymore. This baby's as ready as I can make it. After you tear your way through Dun Argol with it, that overgrown cow'll have to release me.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Bringing Down the Iron Thane
text.objectives: Using the abilities of your War Golem, defeat Iron Thane Furyhammer, then return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: Now that the golem is fully charged, it can be used against the leader at Dun Argol.$B$BWhen I observed Iron Thane Furyhammer, he was always guarded by a personal golem that shielded him from all harm.$B$BThat construct, called The Anvil, can be disrupted, causing him to drop the shield. Use your golem's EMP ability to do just that. You'll be able to activate and take control of your golem inside Dun Argol.$B$BThe thane is in the main plant at the top and supervises production from the bottom level.
text.progress: Please tell me it worked...
text.completion: So the prospector made good on his promises? Good. I was beginning to wonder if all of this scrounging for bits of metal and stealing building materials would amount to anything. It's a shame he's of no further use to us.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

You'll be able to activate and take control of your golem inside Dun Argol.$B$BThe thane is in the main plant at the top and supervises production from the bottom level.
english.progress: Please tell me it worked...
english.completion: So the prospector made good on his promises? Good. I was beginning to wonder if all of this scrounging for bits of metal and stealing building materials would amount to anything. It's a shame he's of no further use to us.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 翡翠龙泪
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的首席药剂师米德尔顿要求你收集8份翡翠龙泪。
text.description: 现在，能使凋零药剂进入惰性状态的催化剂已经研制成功了，触发装置也没问题，唯一剩下的课题就是找到一个合适的外壳来容纳这些危险的东西。$B$B在这里的西南方，龙骨荒野中部的海岸上有一处地方叫作翡翠巨龙圣地。你可以在那里找到由绿龙的眼泪凝结而成的固体结晶。虽然具体原理我不甚了解，但我知道这些龙在死前尤其喜欢掉眼泪，所以……采集方法你了解了吧。$B$B立刻前往翡翠巨龙圣地，收集那些龙的眼泪。
text.progress: Fortunate it is that we have a location nearby holding a surplus of emerald dragon tears. I would have had to send you to Feralas otherwise.
text.completion: I do believe that the blight is now ready for a field test. Fortuitously, the dread citadel, Naxxramas, is laying siege to Wintergarde Keep. From beneath the very earth that Wintergarde was built upon rise the living dead, eager to do the bidding of Kel'Thuzad. The Alliance are, of course, outmanned and outgunned. The people laid to rest in the Wintergarde Mausoleum awaken, hungering for flesh! Perhaps we shall give them a taste of the blight, yes?
text.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Emerald Dragon Tears
english.objectives: Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to collect 8 Emerald Dragon Tears.
english.description: With an inert specimen of the blight compound complete and the activating agent in hand there only remains a need for a suitable shell to house the components.$B$BSouthwest of here, on the shores of central Dragonblight, is where you will find the Emerald Dragonshrine. Within the shrine you will find the hardened remnants of a green dragon's tear drop. I don't know the whole story, but apparently they cry a lot right before they die. Go figure.$B$BGo to the Emerald Dragonshrine and gather tears.
english.progress: Fortunate it is that we have a location nearby holding a surplus of emerald dragon tears. I would have had to send you to Feralas otherwise.

The people laid to rest in the Wintergarde Mausoleum awaken, hungering for flesh! Perhaps we shall give them a taste of the blight, yes?
english.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: The Overseer's Shadow
text.objectives: Bring an Overseer's Uniform to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: 这听起来像是这个Loken是突然准备战争的铁矮人的背后的策划者$B$BOnly最高排名的铁杆可能有他的访问，所以我们会让你成为一个监督，看看那里正在发生什么，$B$B我有一个计划，为此，但是我们需要一些补给品$B$B找一个铁盾符文监督把东南的阿戈尔杀了，把他的制服拿回来。
text.progress: Did you get the uniform?
text.completion: This should work, but there's still the matter of the rest of your disguise. Even those dimwitted metal dwarves will recognize an impostor with a stolen suit.
text.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Overseer's Shadow
english.objectives: Bring an Overseer's Uniform to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
english.description: It sounds like this Loken is the mastermind behind the sudden preparations for war on the part of the iron dwarves.$B$BOnly the highest ranking irons are likely to have access to him, so we'll have to make you into an overseer to find out what's going on in there.$B$BI have a plan, for that, but we'll need some supplies.$B$BFind one of the iron rune overseers at Dun Argol, to the southeast, kill him, and bring back his uniform.
english.progress: Did you get the uniform?
english.completion: This should work, but there's still the matter of the rest of your disguise. Even those dimwitted metal dwarves will recognize an impostor with a stolen suit.
english.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 拍摄照片
text.objectives: Use Rokar's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: Now we have to finish the job of making you as repulsive as those iron dwarves.$B$BThe best way to do that is to base your disguise on the ugly mugs of real iron dwarves.$B$BWhen Tormak's hunting party discovered that wayward prospector, they took the camera he carried. Now, I suppose, we'll get the chance to use it.$B$BTake it with you to Dun Argol, kill some iron dwarves, and record their likenesses in this device. Bring it back once you have enough examples.
text.progress: Did you get those snapshots?
text.completion: These should serve. By Garrosh, these creatures are ugly.
text.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.objectives: Use Rokar's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.

Now, I suppose, we'll get the chance to use it.$B$BTake it with you to Dun Argol, kill some iron dwarves, and record their likenesses in this device. Bring it back once you have enough examples.

english.completion: These should serve. By Garrosh, these creatures are ugly.
english.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Loken's Orders
text.objectives: Disguise yourself as an Iron Rune Overseer, intercept the message from Loken, then report to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: I've created everything else you'll need for your overseer disguise kit. Try not to retch when you put it on. I took pains to make it as true to reality as possible.$B$BTake the kit with you southeast to Dun Argol, use it to disguise yourself, then go to the easternmost building on the broad middle tier of the city.$B$BThere, you should see a pedestal where the thane and overseers receive their orders from this Loken. Activate it while disguised and learn all you can from the communication.
text.progress: What did you learn of Loken?
text.completion: So he means to foment civil war between the factions of the titans' creation? Why does this titan city of Ulduar mean so much to him? I suppose this is what Kurun and his giants are hoping to prevent. Well, I doubt we're in a position to keep the giants from fighting each other, but we can find a way to use this to our advantage. I must inform our leaders at once.
text.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: In the Name of Loken
text.objectives: Speak with Hugh Glass and Gavrock about Loken, then report your findings to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqeah.
text.description: The iron dwarves stand as one of the fiercest and most coordinated foes in Northrend. Wherever we have traveled, they have battled us with the name of Loken on their lips.$B$BWe must learn who this Loken is and what he seeks. The locals may be of help.$B$BTo the northeast, at the Redwood Trading Post, a human named Hugh Glass peddles his wares. Further east, at the Ruins of Tethys, you'll find a stone giant named Gavrock. Ask them about this Loken. They've got to know something of use.
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: So he is the mastermind behind the iron dwarves? We must find out what he has been ordering the iron dwarves of Dun Argol to do.
text.completed: Return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 通缉：血色先锋军
text.objectives: 消灭20个血色先锋军的成员，然后向怨毒镇的高级执行官乌洛斯汇报。
text.description: 根据高级执行官乌洛斯的命令，对于非法组织“血色先锋军”的所有成员格杀勿论。$B$B如果你被血色先锋军俘虏，等待你的只有死亡，甚至更糟的结局！$B$B按照高级执行官乌洛斯的话来说：“用他们的鲜血染红这片雪地吧！”
text.progress: Are you here to waste my time, $Gboy:girl;, or did you fulfill my vendetta against the Scarlet Onslaught?
text.completion: Very well done, $r. I trust that you were cleverly vicious in your slaying? Let's see, how much I can offer you from the coffins... er, excuse me, coffers?
text.completed: Return to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Members of the Scarlet Onslaught slain

english.title: Wanted: The Scarlet Onslaught
english.objectives: Kill 20 members of the Scarlet Onslaught and report to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite.
english.description: By order of High Executor Wroth all members of the illegal organization known as the Scarlet Onslaught are to be put to death immediately.$B$BNo quarter is to be offered, and those proceeding to action upon this decree should be aware that any who are captured by the humans will be left to die, or worse!$B$BIn the High Executor's words, "Paint the snow red with their blood!"
english.progress: Are you here to waste my time, $Gboy:girl;, or did you fulfill my vendetta against the Scarlet Onslaught?
english.completion: Very well done, $r. I trust that you were cleverly vicious in your slaying? Let's see, how much I can offer you from the coffins... er, excuse me, coffers?
english.completed: Return to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Members of the Scarlet Onslaught slain

text.title: 测试药剂
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的药剂师薇吉·莱文要你把药剂泼在血色先锋军士兵的身上。
text.description: 你看过那道通缉令了吗？$B$B高级执行官到底在想些什么？！$B$B<薇吉环视四周，然后继续压低音调。>$B$B我们不能就这样让那些血色先锋军的蠢货们一次次地被他们的牧师复活，或者更糟——被复活成天灾士兵。$B$B不，我完全赞同你的想法，我们得做点什么。$B$B我正好有样东西。拿上这个我们最近研制出来的凋零药剂，去泼在旁边的士兵身上。$B$B清洁溜溜，不会再有反复跳起来给我们找麻烦的敌人。
text.progress: Did you do it?$B$BHey, I forgot to tell you that you probably shouldn't let any of that stuff get on you! It's nasty, and you'll never get the stains out, let alone have a hell of a time healing the bubbled-away fleshy bits.
text.completion: WHAT?! That's impossible! We've perfected the blight. It has a one-hundred percent lethality. This is just really odd. Hand me that flask, $c. I'm not going to be known as the apothecary that ruined everything!
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Blighted Last Rites
english.objectives: Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to test the Flask of Blight upon the Scarlet Onslaught Prisoner.
english.description: Have you read the wanted poster? What is the high executor thinking?!$B$B<Vicky looks around and continues in hushed tones.>$B$BWe can't very well have those Scarlet Onslaught idiots being raised by their priests, or worse, rising as the Scourge, now can we?$B$BNo, I'm in total agreement with you, we have to do something about the corpses.$B$BI have just the thing. Take this blight that we just created and test it on the prisoner in the cage right here.$B$BNo muss, no fuss, no returning enemies.
english.progress: Did you do it?$B$BHey, I forgot to tell you that you probably shouldn't let any of that stuff get on you! It's nasty, and you'll never get the stains out, let alone have a hell of a time healing the bubbled-away fleshy bits.
english.completion: WHAT?! That's impossible! We've perfected the blight. It has a one-hundred percent lethality. This is just really odd. Hand me that flask, $c. I'm not going to be known as the apothecary that ruined everything!
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: Vordrassil's Fall
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Limb, Vordrassil's Heart or Vordrassil's Tears and obtain 6 Slime Samples from the Entropic Oozes.
text.description: Long ago, powerful druids planted a tree to the northeast of here.$B$BIt was called Vordrassil and it was to be a world tree.  It is not known why, but after the tree was fully grown, the druids decided it needed to be destroyed.$B$BEver since we arrived here, the earth has spoken to me, $N.  Its cries of pain come from the places where Vordrassil's remains fell on the ground.$B$BCorrupting ooze roams those places.  Bring me samples of it so we may begin to heal the land.
text.progress: Have you obtained the samples, $n?
text.completion: This slime is foul with a darkness far more ancient than their worldly forms would indicate.  The land itself has a memory of this evil for as long as it has existed. We must find out more, $n.
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Good Troll Hunting
text.objectives: Sergeant Thurkin told you to speak to Samir at Granite Springs.
text.description: Good for nothing wretches!$b$bThey could have had it easy. We extended our hand in peace. All they had to do was give us passage through Drak'Tharon and we'd have let them be.$b$bBut no, the prideful little ice trolls decided that they wanted it rough. Now they'll be destroyed and we'll pass through their precious keep to Zul'Drak anyway.$b$bWe've contracted a gang to deliver us captured trolls. Talk to Samir if you want in on the action. You can find him to the northwest of here, due south of Zeb'Halek.
text.completion: Here to get in on the bounty action, eh?

You can find him to the northwest of here, due south of Zeb'Halek.
english.completion: Here to get in on the bounty action, eh?

text.title: 夺取装备
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的军需官巴莱特要你去夺取8件血色先锋军护甲和8件血色先锋军武器。
text.description: 啊，很好，新人。你想证明自己的能力吗，新人？$B$B血色先锋军，也就是血色十字军中最狂热的那些成员，就盘踞在我们的南面。如果我们想要跟他们一决高下，就需要大量的装备和武器，而我在短期内想必是打造不出这么多的。$B$B为什么我们不去夺取他们的武器装备呢？$B$B换句话说，为什么你不去呢？
text.progress: I'll take what armor and weapons you can steal for me, new meat. Though they'll be of inferior quality to what I can make here, it's better than nothing.
text.completion: You do not smell so fresh now, new meat. Very well, all of this will do. By what name might I call you, $c?
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Materiel Plunder
english.objectives: Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite has asked you to steal 8 Scarlet Onslaught Armor and 8 Scarlet Onslaught Weapons.
english.description: Ah good, new meat. Do you wish to prove yourself, new meat?$B$BThe Scarlet Onslaught, the most zealous and racist of the Scarlet Crusade, are in our backyard to the south. If we're going to fight them, we'll need more armor and weapons than I can make in such a short time.$B$BWhy don't we take theirs?$B$BMore to the point, why don't YOU take theirs?
english.progress: I'll take what armor and weapons you can steal for me, new meat. Though they'll be of inferior quality to what I can make here, it's better than nothing.
english.completion: You do not smell so fresh now, new meat. Very well, all of this will do. By what name might I call you, $c?
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 狩猎巨魔的季节！
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的杜蒙特中尉希望你去跟岩石之泉的萨米尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你，$C！说你呢！我们还有很多工作要做，而你竟然在这里闲逛。$B$B达克萨隆要塞是通往祖达克的最佳捷径。我们必须占领它，以保证给联盟打开一条安全通道。不过在我们有足够的人手发动进攻前，必须先清理冰巨魔，并收集足够的情报。$B$B所以呢，我们需要招募一群暴徒来帮忙抓捕和押送巨魔俘虏。前往西北方的岩石之泉，跟萨米尔谈谈。他会告诉你下一步该怎么做。
text.completion: Here to get in on the bounty action, eh?

english.title: Troll Season!
english.objectives: Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge wants you to speak to Samir at Granite Springs.
english.description: You, $r! No sense standing around here when there's work to be done!$b$bDrak'Theron Keep is the most direct route to Zul'Drak. We MUST capture it to ensure safe passage for the Alliance. But until we get the numbers to make an assault, we'll have to content ourselves in thinning out the ice trolls and collecting intel.$b$bTo that end, we've conscripted a gang of thugs to capture and deliver live trolls for interrogation. Travel northwest and speak with Samir at Granite Springs. He'll direct you further.
english.completion: Here to get in on the bounty action, eh?

text.title: 确保他们不再站起来！
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的药剂师薇吉·莱文要你前往新壁炉谷，在15个倒下的血色先锋军成员那里使用她的老鼠箱。
text.description: 我真是搞不明白。凋零药剂明明应该有效的啊！$B$B不过现在也不是讨论这个的时候。$B$B<药剂师显得轻松了一些。>$B$B虽然由于奇怪的原因，它对血色先锋军不起作用，但是我们仍然要想办法阻止他们继续被牧师复活。$B$B我又想到一个办法，只要没有了佩戴的血色之印，他们就没法被牧师找到了。$B$B$N，带上一盒我的老鼠，把它们拿到新壁炉谷去，它们经过训练，可以准确地找出印记。
text.progress: Well? Success I assume?$B$BDon't tell me that they have some kind of protection against being eaten by rats?!
text.completion: Oh good! For a moment I thought I was going to have to test the rats out on someone to make sure that they weren't defective. Progress, finally!
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Let Them Not Rise!
english.objectives: Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to use her Container of Rats to pick clean the corpses of 15 Scarlet Onslaught members at New Hearthglen.
english.description: I don't understand it. The blight should have worked!$B$BNo sense worrying about it now.$B$B<The apothecary seems relieved for some reason.>$B$BThough it doesn't work on the Onslaught for some strange reason, we still need to keep their priests from raising them.$B$BI have another idea, one that their corpses shouldn't have any protection from.$B$B$N, take a container of my rats and unleash them upon any Onslaught corpses you come across at New Hearthglen. I starve the vermin, so they should be voracious!
english.progress: Well? Success I assume?$B$BDon't tell me that they have some kind of protection against being eaten by rats?!
english.completion: Oh good! For a moment I thought I was going to have to test the rats out on someone to make sure that they weren't defective. Progress, finally!
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 补充食物
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的护林主管安德霍尔希望你能去猎杀耸角雄鹿，并收集8份肥美的鹿肉。
text.description: 你好啊，$C。$B$B这里的长官说部落掠夺了我们的仓库，剩余的食物储备已经岌岌可危了。$B$B毫无疑问，我们会让这群混蛋们付出代价，但首先得把我们的注意力集中在食物的重新储备上。我的手下正在尽全力补充食物，但如果我们想要避免一场危机的话，就需要每个人都身体力行地出一份力。$B$B依你的能力，去周围猎杀些鹿肉回来应该没什么问题吧。祝你狩猎愉快！
text.progress: How goes the hunt, $r?
text.completion: These are some choice pieces of meat!
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Replenishing the Storehouse
english.objectives: Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to kill Tallhorn Stag and collect 8 Succulent Venison.
english.description: G'day, $c.$b$bThe good lieutenant here says that there's been a Horde raid on our storehouse that's left our food supply dangerously low.$b$bNo doubt we'll make those cretins pay, but first we need to focus our attention on restocking. My men are doing all they can, but we're going to need every able body to contribute if we're to avert a crisis.$b$bYou should have no trouble harvesting venison from the local stag in these parts. Happy hunting!
english.progress: How goes the hunt, $r?
english.completion: These are some choice pieces of meat!
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Darkness Beneath
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.
text.description: Something... dark... happened to the tree Vordrassil.  After the druids decided to destroy it, its hollow remains grew roots deep into the ground.$B$BI want you to go to the three locations to the northeast where the tree's trunk shattered and go as far beneath the ground as you can.$B$BUse this orb once you get there to get an imprint of the energy surrounding the area.  This might shed some light on what happened to Vordrassil and why it failed to become a world tree.
text.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: This orb... it has been tainted by... a purely evil force. Whatever else I might learn from studying this energy, one thing is certain.  I must destroy this orb as soon as possible.  Its corrupting force is just too strong.
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Darkness Beneath
english.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.
english.description: Something... dark... happened to the tree Vordrassil.  After the druids decided to destroy it, its hollow remains grew roots deep into the ground.$B$BI want you to go to the three locations to the northeast where the tree's trunk shattered and go as far beneath the ground as you can.$B$BUse this orb once you get there to get an imprint of the energy surrounding the area.  This might shed some light on what happened to Vordrassil and why it failed to become a world tree.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: This orb... it has been tainted by... a purely evil force. Whatever else I might learn from studying this energy, one thing is certain.  I must destroy this orb as soon as possible.  Its corrupting force is just too strong.
english.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 补充坐骑
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的汉瑟·鲍尔要你牵回3匹血色先锋军战马，并将战马缰绳交给他。
text.description: 你好啊，$G先生:女士;。我是汉瑟·鲍尔，很高兴见到你。$B$B高级执行官来到我这里对我说：“汉瑟,我希望你能给我们弄些新的坐骑。”$B$B他以为这些恐惧战马是哪来的？地里长出来的吗？$B$B<汉瑟低声地说>当然如果你能找到马墓地的话，它们的确是地里长出来的……$B$B但我们并没有那么好运！所以你要做的就是前往南面的新壁炉谷，击败那些骑士，拿上他们的马鞭，然后跳上血色先锋军战马。$B$B你可以骑马回到我这里，把它们的缰绳交给我就行了。
text.progress: I'm sure glad that you came around. I was afraid that I was going to have to go down there and rustle them up myself.
text.completion: Ah, nothing makes me happier than a job well done. You've done Venomspite a great service in acquiring these horses, $c.
text.completed: Return to Hansel Bauer at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Scarlet Onslaught Warhorse reins handed over

english.title: Fresh Remounts
english.objectives: Hansel Bauer at Venomspite has asked you to steal 3 Onslaught Warhorses and deliver them to him, handing over the reins when you do so.
english.description: Hello. I am Hansel. Pleased to meet you, $g sir : ma'am;.$B$BThe high executor came to me and said, 'Hansel, I want you to get us new mounts.'$B$BWhere does he think dreadsteeds come from? The ground?$B$B<whispering> Actually, they do if you can find a horse graveyard.$B$BBut we don't have one of those, so what we need you to do is go south to New Hearthglen, kill the knights, take their riding crops, and steal their warhorses.$B$BRide the horse back to me here and hand over the reins, if you would.
english.progress: I'm sure glad that you came around. I was afraid that I was going to have to go down there and rustle them up myself.
english.completion: Ah, nothing makes me happier than a job well done. You've done Venomspite a great service in acquiring these horses, $c.
english.completed: Return to Hansel Bauer at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Scarlet Onslaught Warhorse reins handed over

text.title: 你死我活！
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的安德霍尔希望你能在灰熊丘陵找到并杀死6条灰雾捕猎者。
text.description: 所谓福无双至祸不单行……$B$B由于现在的食物危机，我们发现自己在跟当地的座狼争夺食物。情况也越来越严峻了，我担心如果我们不能马上解决这个问题的话，很快就没有东西可以去狩猎了。$B$B去森林里转转，$R。杀死你所找到的每一条灰雾座狼。最近有报告称它们在西边那条河流附近活动。
text.progress: A few less worgs hunting these forests, I trust?
text.completion: Good work, $c. This should help ensure that the wildlife in these parts ends up where it should - roasting over our fires.
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Them or Us!
english.objectives: Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to find and kill 6 Graymist Hunters in Grizzly Hills.
english.description: As if we didn't have enough to concern ourselves with....$b$bWith the present food crisis, we find ourselves competing for food with the local worgs. The situation is becoming more dire, and I fear that if we don't address the issue immediately we'll soon find ourselves with nothing to hunt.$b$bScour the forest, $r. Kill any graymist you find. Recent reports have sighted a concentration of them on the other side of the river west of here.
english.progress: A few less worgs hunting these forests, I trust?
english.completion: Good work, $c. This should help ensure that the wildlife in these parts ends up where it should - roasting over our fires.
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 猎熊！
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的安德霍尔希望你从灰熊丘陵的灰鬃熊身上收集8块灰鬃熊肋排。
text.description: 通过所有人的辛勤努力，现在食物已经开始有所盈余了，不过离我们的目标仍然很远。我们需要更多的肉，很明显仅靠当地的鹿肉是远远不够的。$B$B恐怕你需要把注意力放在更危险的猎物上……对，灰熊。这个地区因它们而得名。它们的数量非常多，而且被河里的鱼喂得膘肥体壮。$B$B多加小心，$C！
text.progress: The mighty $c has returned!
text.completion: Outstanding! Our stores are nearly replenished now. You've done your part, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Take Their Rear!
english.objectives: Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to collect 8 Grizzly Flanks from the Grizzly Bears in Grizzly Hills.
english.description: We've all been working hard and it's beginning to pay off, but we're still far from our goal. We need much more meat than we have and it's growing clear that the local stag population won't be enough by itself.$b$bI'm afraid we need you to turn your attention to more dangerous prey - the grizzlies that give this region its name. They're plentiful, and they're well fed from the abundant fish that swim in these streams.$b$bBe safe, $c!
english.progress: The mighty $c has returned!
english.completion: Outstanding! Our stores are nearly replenished now. You've done your part, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 鹰的眼睛
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的安德霍尔希望你去消灭5只白肩鹰，然后向他复命。
text.description: 嗯，$N。我们终于知道部落是怎么发现我们那些隐蔽的食物仓库的了。原来他们的探子就是周围那些看似悠闲的鹰。利用鹰的视界，他们就能有效地暗中监视我们的一举一动。$B$B根据长官的命令，我们必须猎杀这些高贵的鸟类，以挫败敌人的阴谋。
text.progress: Have you completed your task, $c?
text.completion: A somber task, I know. But we can rest easier now knowing the enemy's eyes are no longer upon us.
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Eagle Eyes
english.objectives: Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge wants you to kill 5 Imperial Eagles and then report back to him.
english.description: Well, $n, we've determined how the Horde was able to locate our hidden stores of food.$b$bIt turns out that they were binding their sight to the unsuspecting eagles that soar above the trees here. Using eagle vision, they were able to effectively spy on our every action.$b$bBy order of the lieutenant, we've got to hunt down these majestic birds in order to thwart our enemy.
english.progress: Have you completed your task, $c?
english.completion: A somber task, I know. But we can rest easier now knowing the enemy's eyes are no longer upon us.
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 传达好消息
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的首席药剂师米德尔顿要求你使用被遗忘者凋零战车上的凋零炸弹，在腐臭平原外围消灭30名饥饿的死尸。
text.description: 在我让你带着好消息前往玛菲奥斯博士那里之前，你还得再去对这种凋零药剂执行一次简单的实地测试，看看我新做的调整到底效果怎样。$B$B暮冬城的旧城区中有无数不停涌出的亡灵，它们是最好的实验材料。你可以直接在东门那里征用一辆车，然后开着它一路向东北方沿着复仇小径冲过去，一直杀到暮冬城东南城墙边的双塔边上。然后呢，你把炸弹向里面那堆亡灵那里一丢，看看结果如何，直接向我汇报就可以了。
text.progress: This test will be the final experiment in the series, $N.
text.completion: As much as it irritates me that we may have assisted the Alliance, I declare the field test a success! Next stop: Agmar's Hammer!
text.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Spread the Good Word
english.objectives: Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to use the Forsaken Blight Spreader's Blight Bomb to destroy 30 Hungering Dead on the outskirts of the Carrion Fields.
english.description: Before I can ship you off to Doctor Malefious with the good news, you will have to run a simple field test of the blight with the modifications I have made.$B$BThe hungering dead stream out from what remains of Old Wintergarde. Commandeer a vehicle from the east gate and drive it northeast through Vengeance Pass until you reach the twin towers at the southeastern edge of Wintergarde. Drop the blight bomb on the undead that cover the area. Report back to me with the results!
english.progress: This test will be the final experiment in the series, $N.
english.completion: As much as it irritates me that we may have assisted the Alliance, I declare the field test a success! Next stop: Agmar's Hammer!
english.completed: Return to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 倒下的世界之树
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的圣职者塞瑞恩希望你前往沃达希尔之臂、沃达希尔之心或沃达希尔之泪，从熵能软泥怪那里取回6份软泥怪样本。
text.description: 很久以前，我的祖先在灰熊丘陵中部种下了一棵树。$B$B他们将它称为沃达希尔，它曾被认为是诺达希尔的继承者……一棵世界之树。$B$B不知道什么原因，在沃达希尔完全长成之后，他们却决定将它摧毁。它巨大的树干被劈成三段，躺在北边的森林里。$B$B树干接触到地面后开始腐烂，肮脏的软泥怪开始在那里蠕动。给我带些软泥怪的样本回来，这样才能开始我的工作，拯救痛苦的大地。
text.progress: Have you gathered the samples, $n?
text.completion: The slime is not natural, $n.  Its very nature is corrupt and... evil. We must find out more.
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Failed World Tree
english.objectives: Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Vordrassil's Limb, Vordrassil's Heart or Vordrassil's Tears and obtain 6 Slime Samples from the Entropic Oozes.
english.description: My ancestors once planted a tree in the middle of the Grizzly Hills.$B$BIt was called Vordrassil and it was to become a world tree.$B$BFor reasons long forgotten, after the tree was fully grown, they decided it needed to be destroyed.  Its giant trunk splintered at three locations in the area to the north.$B$BWhere the tree touched the ground, foul ooze began to crawl the earth.  Bring me slime samples so I can begin my work and the earth can be healed.
english.progress: Have you gathered the samples, $n?
english.completion: The slime is not natural, $n.  Its very nature is corrupt and... evil. We must find out more.
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 黑暗的影响
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的圣职者塞瑞恩希望你前往沃达希尔之臂、沃达希尔之心和沃达希尔之泪，然后在地表之下使用地占师的宝珠。
text.description: 沃达希尔倒下之后，它的空壳仍然在向地底深处扎根。$B$B我希望你能前往北方那三处树干破裂的位置，尽可能地深入地下。它们就在灰喉堡的西边。$B$B等你进入地下以后，使用这枚宝珠来读取该区域周围的能量特征。如果我们要治愈这片土地，就必须首先查明这棵世界之树为什么会突然陨落。
text.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: The energy in the orb is... overpowering... A dark force has tainted the ground near Vordrassil's remains.  We will need to investigate more.
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: A Dark Influence
english.objectives: Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.
english.description: When the tree Vordrassil fell, its hollow remains grew roots deep into the ground.$B$BI want you to go north of here to the three locations where the trunk shattered and go as far beneath the ground as you can.  You'll find them west of Grizzlemaw.$B$BUse this orb once you get there to get an imprint of the energy surrounding the area.  If we're to heal the land, we must first find out what caused Vordrassil to fail as a world tree all those years ago.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
english.completion: The energy in the orb is... overpowering... A dark force has tainted the ground near Vordrassil's remains.  We will need to investigate more.
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 被遗忘者的凋零药剂
text.objectives: 将被遗忘者的凋零药剂交给阿格玛之锤的辛塔尔·玛菲奥斯博士。
text.description: I have prepared a package that must be delivered to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer. The contents of the package include the final blight specimen along with instructions on preparation and samples of the reactive agent.$B$BYou will find Agmar's Hammer in western Dragonblight. Just look for the black, jagged metal orc buildings - that will be Agmar's Hammer.$B$B
text.progress: About bloody time!
text.completion: Glorious! Exactly to specifications! Here is your payment, $n. Keep what you've seen and done to yourself. This work is all classified - information is given out on a need to know basis.
text.completed: Return to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Forsaken Blight
english.objectives: Deliver The Forsaken Blight to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: I have prepared a package that must be delivered to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer. The contents of the package include the final blight specimen along with instructions on preparation and samples of the reactive agent.$B$BYou will find Agmar's Hammer in western Dragonblight. Just look for the black, jagged metal orc buildings - that will be Agmar's Hammer.$B$B
english.progress: About bloody time!
english.completion: Glorious! Exactly to specifications! Here is your payment, $n. Keep what you've seen and done to yourself. This work is all classified - information is given out on a need to know basis.
english.completed: Return to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.

text.title: 缚焰者的秘密
text.objectives: 将3枚烈焰能量护符交给琥珀松木营地的伐木工德拉克。
text.description: 就在我们跟部落僵持不下的时候，维库人的掠龙部族又不安分起来。他们在南边海岸旁的沃德伦村集结了大量的兵力。$B$B据说村里那些最强大的战士还被授予了一种灌入火焰能量的护符，这使得他们可以驾驭狂暴而凶残的始祖龙。如果这些始祖龙能被我们所用，那么我们就可以解决沃德伦方面逐渐加剧的威胁。$B$B负责为战士们制作这些护符的是掠龙缚焰者，杀死他们，把护符抢回来。
text.progress: Did you collect those talismans?
text.completion: With the talismans in hand, the drake will have no choice but to obey you. I can't wait to see the look on the thane's face when he realizes you've commandeered his proto-drake.
text.completed: Return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Secrets of the Flamebinders
english.objectives: Bring 3 Flame-Imbued Talismans to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: Even as we attempt to fight off the Horde, the Dragonflayer tribe musters in their village of Voldrune, near the coast to the south.$B$BThe most powerful warriors in the village are granted flame-imbued talismans that give them the ability to control powerful, savage proto-drakes. If we can gain control of one of these drakes, perhaps we can use it to neutralize the threat posed by Voldrune.$B$BThe Dragonflayer flamebinders create the talismans and imbue them with power. Kill them and take the talismans.
english.progress: Did you collect those talismans?
english.completion: With the talismans in hand, the drake will have no choice but to obey you. I can't wait to see the look on the thane's face when he realizes you've commandeered his proto-drake.
english.completed: Return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 削弱邪兽人
text.objectives: 消灭12个掠龙侍卫，然后向琥珀松木营地的伐木工德拉克复命。
text.description: 最近南边的维库人村落沃德伦内似乎有着大量军事活动的迹象。托瓦德·埃里克森领主和他手下那群侍卫正在筹备战争，可我们的人大多数都疲于应付部落的背叛，无暇南望，琥珀松木营地危在旦夕。$B$B必须向那群掠龙维库人显示联盟的实力，让他们知道我们不是什么软柿子。$B$B立刻前往南边海岸上的沃德伦，杀死你看到的所有侍卫。这样一来，如果他们再想要趁我们和部落冲突之时渔利，也会先称称自己的分量。
text.progress: Have you done the deed?
text.completion: Well done, $n. Now, we must follow through and press the advantage.
text.completed: Return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Thinning the Ranks
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dragonflayer Huscarls and return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: There's a flurry of activity down in Voldrune village to the south. Thane Torvald Eriksson and his huscarls are preparing for war. With most of our men in the field dealing with the Horde's treachery, Amberpine will be vulnerable.$B$BTravel to Voldrune, which is near the southern coast, and show those Dragonflayers we're no soft target.$B$BSlay as many of the huscarls as you can find. Make them think twice about taking advantage of our conflict with the Horde.
english.progress: Have you done the deed?
english.completion: Well done, $n. Now, we must follow through and press the advantage.
english.completed: Return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 库卡隆先锋！
text.objectives: 前往库卡隆先锋营地，向小萨鲁法尔报到。
text.description: 你干得很好，我的$G兄弟:姐妹;。你像一位真正的部落勇士那样面对了一切，战胜了一切。即使是天灾军团的艾卓-尼鲁布蛛魔，也粉碎在你的脚下！勇敢与智慧并重的牦牛人，也因为你而毅然决然地投靠了部落！我们将用于对抗天灾军团的终极武器，也因你的参与而历经测试，达到了完美的境界！$B$B是时候了，就是现在，天谴之门的精英们需要你。萨鲁法尔正在库卡隆先锋营地等着你。去吧，到东北边的天谴之门去。
text.completion: Lok'tar ogar! I have heard much about you, $n. Your battle scars run deep - a testament to your dedication and power! With the flanking attacks of the Lich King crushed in both the west and east, only the forces at the gate remain. We gain ground each day, soon to break through this wall and into Icecrown! Once we stop the skeletal dragons, Highlord Fordragon and I will take the field.

english.title: The Kor'kron Vanguard!
english.objectives: Report to Saurfang the Younger at the Kor'kron Vanguard.
english.description: You have done well, $g brother:sister;. All that you have faced, you have done as a champion of the Horde. The Scourged Anub'ar of Azjol-Nerub, crushed under your foot! The taunka, brave and powerful new members of the Horde, because of you! Our super-weapon against the Scourge, tested and perfected by you!$B$BThe time has come, the moment is now - our elite soldiers at the Wrathgate need you. The son of Saurfang awaits your arrival at the Kor'kron Vanguard. Go now, northeast to the Wrathgate.
english.completion: Lok'tar ogar! I have heard much about you, $n. Your battle scars run deep - a testament to your dedication and power! With the flanking attacks of the Lich King crushed in both the west and east, only the forces at the gate remain. We gain ground each day, soon to break through this wall and into Icecrown! Once we stop the skeletal dragons, Highlord Fordragon and I will take the field.

text.title: 美味的琥珀种子！
text.objectives: 与琥珀松木营地的护林主管安德霍尔谈一谈。
text.description: Your stomach growls as the pungent smell of hearty nuts draws your attention to the bucket of seeds.$b$bSome thoughtful soul has obviously left these complimentary morsels here to rejuvenate weary visitors. Grateful, you take the remaining few and devour them.$b$bThe seeds do not disappoint. Finding yourself hungry for more, you set out to discover their origins....
text.completion: You did what!!! Those were Amberseeds! And that was an entire harvest's worth! Those magical seeds may have been the answer to our food crisis. Believe me when I tell you, $n, you're going to make this right!

english.title: Mmm... Amberseeds!
english.objectives: Speak with Master Woodsman Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: Your stomach growls as the pungent smell of hearty nuts draws your attention to the bucket of seeds.$b$bSome thoughtful soul has obviously left these complimentary morsels here to rejuvenate weary visitors. Grateful, you take the remaining few and devour them.$b$bThe seeds do not disappoint. Finding yourself hungry for more, you set out to discover their origins....
english.completion: You did what!!! Those were Amberseeds! And that was an entire harvest's worth! Those magical seeds may have been the answer to our food crisis. Believe me when I tell you, $n, you're going to make this right!

text.title: 种子穿肠过……
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的安德霍尔要你去收集5份黑根草杆。
text.description: 我们必须赶快行动起来，$R！我们不能冒这个险，让这些珍贵的种子被完全消化掉。现在就得把它们弄出来。现在！$B$B快去这里西面的河岸边寻找一些黑根草，我会帮你制作一瓶泻药来帮助你完成工作。$B$B赶快！记住，这都是你自找的……
text.progress: Have you found the blackroot?
text.completion: These should do just fine... There we go, now it's time to get down to business.
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Just Passing Through
english.objectives: Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to bring him 5 Blackroot Stalks.
english.description: We must act quickly, $r! We can't risk letting those precious seeds become fully digested. They need to come out, NOW.$b$bForage up some blackroot from the riverbank just west of here and I'll make you a purgative that should get things moving.$b$bHurry now! And remember, you brought this upon yourself....
english.progress: Have you found the blackroot?
english.completion: These should do just fine... There we go, now it's time to get down to business.
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 尽你的职责
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的安德霍尔希望你在附近的厕所里喝下安德霍尔的泻药，以此来取回还未消化掉的琥珀种子。
text.description: 好吧，$C。就是这个了。$B$B它非常有效，所以在你进厕所前不要使用它。$B$B现在帮我把那些种子弄出来！
text.progress: Got those seeds for me yet, $r?
text.completion: Well, $n? Everything come out okay? Hmm, looks like we caught 'em just in time....
text.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Doing Your Duty
english.objectives: Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge wants you to take the Anderhol's Slider Cider and use the nearby outhouse to retrieve the Partially Processed Amberseeds.
english.description: Alright, $r. Here's the juice.$b$bIt works immediately, so don't use it until you're safely inside the outhouse.$b$bNow go get me those seeds!
english.progress: Got those seeds for me yet, $r?
english.completion: Well, $n? Everything come out okay? Hmm, looks like we caught 'em just in time....
english.completed: Return to Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 可能的关联
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to obtain 8 Crazed Furbolg Blood from the Furbolgs at Heart's Blood Shrine and Rage Fang Shrine.
text.description: Not long ago we sent an expedition to the east, where it was attacked by crazed furbolgs.  One of the survivors described slaying one of them and its body expelling a dark slimy substance.$B$BFor thousands of years, the furbolgs in this region have been peaceful.  It is possible that there is a link to the furbolgs' behavior and the dark energy we were able to detect earlier.$B$BBring me samples of the furbolgs' blood.  You will find them to the east in the Rage Fang Shrine and the Heart's Blood Shrine.
text.progress: Have you obtained the blood samples, $n?
text.completion: This blood carries the same taint as the slime you obtained earlier... this does not bode well, $n.
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 收取炸弹
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的亡灵卫兵莫德尔要你收集6颗攻城锻造师的炸弹。
text.description: 我被指派去摧毁血色先锋军的弩炮。但不幸地是，药剂师和我在资源分配问题上有分歧，所以我没有任何可用的东西！$B$B这里的东北方是腐臭平原。在那里的熔炉和绞肉车附近摆弄器械的天灾攻城锻造师简直就是破坏的代名词。$B$B对我们来说幸运的是，他们的爆炸品扔得满地都是。$B$B我希望你能帮我把它们拿回来，不管是地上还是从那些攻城锻造师身上。
text.progress: You'd think that they'd let me make use of the blight spreaders... maybe load them up with something nasty to destroy the ballistae. But no, they tell me that they're only for special missions. Whatever!
text.completion: Excellent. Their loss is my... our gain! You didn't have trouble with any of these along the way? Some of them look rather unstable. I may be undead, but I value my existence!
text.completed: Return to Deathguard Molder at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Stealing from the Siegesmiths
english.objectives: Deathguard Molder at Venomspite has asked you to retrieve 6 Siegesmith Bombs.
english.description: I'm tasked with the destruction of the Scarlet Onslaught's ballistae. Unfortunately, the apothecaries and I are at odds on the use of our resources, so I've nothing to destroy them with!$B$BTo the northeast are the Carrion Fields. The Scourge siegesmiths there at their forge and meat wagons are demolition masters.$B$BLuckily for us, they also leave their bombs lying about. $B$BI want you to retrieve them for me, off of the ground or the siegesmiths, I don't care which.
english.progress: You'd think that they'd let me make use of the blight spreaders... maybe load them up with something nasty to destroy the ballistae. But no, they tell me that they're only for special missions. Whatever!
english.completion: Excellent. Their loss is my... our gain! You didn't have trouble with any of these along the way? Some of them look rather unstable. I may be undead, but I value my existence!
english.completed: Return to Deathguard Molder at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: The Bear God's Offspring
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to speak to Orsonn at the Ragefang Shrine and Kodian at the Heart's Blood Shrine.
text.description: It is possible that the furbolg of Grizzly Hills have the same taint that plagued Vordrassil.  They've been involved in a deadly tribal war recently after years of peaceful coexistence.$B$BThe shrines that they guard to the east are home to Ursoc's offspring.$B$BIf the corruption has affected the furbolg, it is possible that because of their lineage, Kodian and Orsonn have remained unharmed.$B$BIf that's the case, find them and listen to what they have to say.
text.progress: Have you spoken to Ursoc's children yet, $N?
text.completion: Ursoc's children are wise.  Their words explain much of what we've seen so far.
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to speak to Orsonn at the Ragefang Shrine and Kodian at the Heart's Blood Shrine.

english.completion: Ursoc's children are wise.  Their words explain much of what we've seen so far.
english.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 炸毁弩炮
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的亡灵卫兵莫德尔要你前往新壁炉谷，利用攻城锻造师的炸弹炸毁5台新壁炉谷弩炮。
text.description: 终于，我们有机会去解决他们的攻城器械了！别把事情搞砸了，伙计。$B$B我在开玩笑呢。$B$B真的。$B$B$C，用这些炸弹去解决新壁炉谷的弩炮吧。$B$B我们要让皇家药剂师协会看看，我们是怎么以经典的方式来完成这一切的。根本不需要什么药剂！
text.progress: Someday I'll be lead deathguard!$B$BSomeday....
text.completion: Oh happy day! By not using the time and resources of the apothecaries to get the job done, I'm sure to attract the attention of the high executor! Thinking outside the box, that's what I'm all about. Yes, yes, you had a hand in helping too. Here, if I give you something will you promise to not mention your part in all of this?
text.completed: Return to Deathguard Molder at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Bombard the Ballistae
english.objectives: Deathguard Molder at Venomspite has asked you to use the Siegesmith Bombs to bombard 5 New Hearthglen Ballistae.
english.description: At last, our chance to strike at their siege engines! Don't flub it.$B$BI kid.$B$BA little.$B$B$C, bombard New Hearthglen's ballistae with these bombs.$B$BWe'll show the Royal Apothecary Society how it's done old style. No concoctions required!
english.progress: Someday I'll be lead deathguard!$B$BSomeday....
english.completion: Oh happy day! By not using the time and resources of the apothecaries to get the job done, I'm sure to attract the attention of the high executor! Thinking outside the box, that's what I'm all about. Yes, yes, you had a hand in helping too. Here, if I give you something will you promise to not mention your part in all of this?
english.completed: Return to Deathguard Molder at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: [Depricated]Sewing Your Seed
text.description: No, no... You hold on to these.$b$bYou didn't actually expect me to handle them after all of that did you?$b$bhere's what you're going to do....

english.title: [Depricated]Sewing Your Seed
english.description: No, no... You hold on to these.$b$bYou didn't actually expect me to handle them after all of that did you?$b$bhere's what you're going to do....

text.title: 日常计划
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的间谍女王瑞贝娅要你收集血色先锋军日常命令：修道院、血色先锋军日常命令：兵营和血色先锋军日常命令：海滩。
text.description: 我需要知道新壁炉谷的那帮家伙到底想干什么。$B$B我希望你能去收集他们的命令书，这样我就能查明一切了。$B$B往南边走，在他们的修道院、兵营和海滩上寻找那些日常计划！$B$B哦，铁匠铺旁边的大型建筑物就是兵营了。
text.progress: If you take too long, their daily plans will change, and we may have to start over again. Don't take too long!
text.completion: Well, what are you waiting for, $r? Hand them over!
text.completed: Return to Spy Mistress Repine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Need to Know
english.objectives: Spy Mistress Repine at Venomspite has asked you to steal the Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Abbey, Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Barracks, and Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Beach.
english.description: I need to know what New Hearthglen is up to.$B$BI want you to steal their orders of the day so that I can find that out.$B$BHead south and in their abbey, in their barracks, and on their beach, find those daily plans!$B$BJust in case you're confused, the barracks is the large building right next to the smithy.
english.progress: If you take too long, their daily plans will change, and we may have to start over again. Don't take too long!
english.completion: Well, what are you waiting for, $r? Hand them over!
english.completed: Return to Spy Mistress Repine at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 纳克萨玛斯与暮冬城的陷落
text.objectives: 与暮冬要塞飞行点的狮鹫指挥官乌瑞克谈一谈。
text.description: Lord Fordragon has led a crushing assault against Arthas at the Wrathgate. In response to this affront, Arthas has sent Naxxramas down upon us. While Kel'Thuzad hides in the floating citadel, his ground commander, Thel'zan, lays siege to Wintergarde Keep. The lower village is already lost and any chance of extracting survivors from the ruins diminishes by the minute.$B$BWe must act quickly! Report to Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station at once! He'll get you up to speed.$B$BLeave me!$B$B
text.completion: Have you ever ridden one of those? It's simple, friend. Just hop on and tell it where to go.

english.title: Naxxramas and the Fall of Wintergarde
english.objectives: Speak with Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station in Wintergarde Keep.
english.description: Lord Fordragon has led a crushing assault against Arthas at the Wrathgate. In response to this affront, Arthas has sent Naxxramas down upon us. While Kel'Thuzad hides in the floating citadel, his ground commander, Thel'zan, lays siege to Wintergarde Keep. The lower village is already lost and any chance of extracting survivors from the ruins diminishes by the minute.$B$BWe must act quickly! Report to Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station at once! He'll get you up to speed.$B$BLeave me!$B$B
english.completion: Have you ever ridden one of those? It's simple, friend. Just hop on and tell it where to go.

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 乌索克，巨熊之神
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to find Tur Ragepaw near Ursoc's Den and defeat Ursoc with his help.  Use the Purified Ashes of Vordrassil on Ursoc's Corpse when you've accomplished this.
text.description: The time has come, $N.  Now we will learn whether our efforts will accomplish what we need or nothing at all.$B$BTake these ashes and seek the furbolg that Kodian told you about, Tur Ragepaw, near Ursoc's Den.  You will find the den to the north of Grizzlemaw.$B$BConvince Tur to aid you, for you will need all the help you can get.$B$BOnce you've defeated the bear god, use these ashes over his body.$B$BEven if his worldly form is destroyed, his spirit must be saved.
text.progress: You've returned. Did you succeed?
text.completion: <The druid looks pale and her eyes stare blankly past you.  She has left a package in anticipation of your return.>
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.completion: <The druid looks pale and her eyes stare blankly past you.  She has left a package in anticipation of your return.>

text.title: 拯救暮冬城平民
text.objectives: Rescue 10 Helpless Wintergarde Villagers and return to Gryphon Commander Urik at Wintergarde Keep.
text.description: 你可以用这只哨子召唤一头暮冬城狮鹫。骑上它前往东南方的暮冬城遗址吧——那里现在叫腐臭平原。到了那里以后，要注意搜索那些无助的暮冬城平民。当你发现目标的时候，就降低飞行高度，让狮鹫把他们提起来。把获救的村民带回飞行站来。$B$B那里到处都是天灾军团的成员，你一定要随时保持警惕。祝你好运！
text.progress: Hurry, $N! You need to save the helpless villagers!
text.completion: Outstanding work, $n! We can get this keep back into working order now with the return of our citizens.
text.completed: Return to Gryphon Commander Urik at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Flight of the Wintergarde Defender
english.objectives: Rescue 10 Helpless Wintergarde Villagers and return to Gryphon Commander Urik at Wintergarde Keep.
english.description: With this whistle you can call down a Wintergarde gryphon. Mount the creature and head towards the ruins of Wintergarde Village, now known as the Carrion Fields, southeast of here. Once at the fields, keep your eyes peeled for helpless Wintergarde villagers. When you spot one, fly low and use the gryphon to pick them up. Return the rescued villager here, to the gryphon station.$B$BThere are Scourge all over the place so you'll need to keep your wits about you, hero. Good luck!
english.progress: Hurry, $N! You need to save the helpless villagers!
english.completion: Outstanding work, $n! We can get this keep back into working order now with the return of our citizens.
english.completed: Return to Gryphon Commander Urik at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

text.title: 净化达克萨隆
text.objectives: 达库鲁要求你前往达克萨隆，并对他的火盆使用达库鲁的药剂。使用达库鲁的药剂需要消耗5份耐久魔精。
text.description: The time be here at last, good friend.$b$bDrak'Tharon soon be cleansed of them foul undead and restored to her noble purpose. My soul will be havin' peace, and in return for your help, the keep's most valuable treasures be yours, mon!$b$bDa keep rises up into a sacred ziggurat. Once ya be reachin' its top, ya must summon me a final time, and I'll perform the ritual.$b$bAlas, mon, my summonin' will again be comin' at a cost. Ya must collect the mojo from the survivors in the keep,
text.completion: We done a great thing, mon! And dis just be da beginning.... Seek me out in Zul'Drak when da time be right. Dere be a war to be won, mon!

english.title: Cleansing Drak'Tharon
english.objectives: Drakuru wants you to use Drakuru's Elixir at his brazier inside Drak'Tharon. Using Drakuru's Elixir there will require 5 Enduring Mojo.
