So powerful is the effect of the murkweed that even your spirit will be fooled, allowing you to temporarily enter the world of the dead.$B$BOnce a spirit, you must speak to the ghostly denizens of the Forgotten Shore. Seek out the cause of their anguish and return to me.$B$BRemember, $N, these spirits were once Alliance soldiers. Treat them with respect, honor and dignity.$B$BNow, with elixir in hand, venture south to the Forgotten Shore.
english.progress: I have enough murkweed to make more elixirs, $N.
english.completion: They don't know. None of them know! They think Arthas to be some great hero, when in truth it was Arthas who ordered the ships to be burned. It was Arthas who left us all for dead in this frozen wasteland! Not all of the soldiers from the Prince's fleet perished in the freezing winter. I was only a lad when I was given the chance to battle the Scourge... to save our home from certain destruction. I took that chance, $n.
english.completed: Return to Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight.

text.title: 当地人的支持
text.objectives: 琥珀松木营地的杜蒙特中尉要你前往常青商栈夺回雪松木箱。
text.description: 最近在灰熊丘陵这一带，我们和部落的军队进入了一个长期的对峙阶段。双方的军队无论是在数量上、士气上、装备上还是策略上都旗鼓相当，谁在任何一方面都无法取得优势。因此，这里的形势不可避免地陷入了僵局。$B$B好吧，至少是在今天早上之前如此。刚才，一些当地的猎人过来请求我们的援助，似乎是部落那边抢走了一些对他们来说很重要的东西……好像是某种宗教圣物的样子。$B$B我们得把这件东西抢回来，这样就能拉拢这些猎人加入联盟这边，从而获得战略上的优势。立刻出发前往征服堡西边的常青商栈，寻找一只雪松木箱。
text.progress: You bring me that box, $n?
text.completion: It's locked, isn't it?  It looks pretty ordinary. No matter, I suppose.  If this gets us the edge we need against the Horde, then I could care less if the cure for the Plague was in there.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Local Support
english.objectives: Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Evergreen Trading Post and obtain the Cedar Chest.
english.description: We've reached a deadlock with the Horde in Grizzly Hills.  Our forces are just about evenly matched and all signs so far have pointed to a stalemate.$B$BUntil this morning, that is.  The local trappers have requested our help.  Apparently the Horde took something that belongs to them... a relic of some sort.$B$BWe get this back for them and they'll give us the edge we need.  Head to the Evergreen Trading Post, west of Conquest Hold and look for a cedar chest.
english.progress: You bring me that box, $n?
english.completion: It's locked, isn't it?  It looks pretty ordinary. No matter, I suppose.  If this gets us the edge we need against the Horde, then I could care less if the cure for the Plague was in there.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 完成交易
text.objectives: 将雪松木箱交给白杨商栈的伊凡。
text.description: 现在我们有了那些猎人想要的东西。是时候把他们全部拉到我们这边了。$B$B带着这只箱子到北边的白杨商栈，找一个名叫伊凡的猎人。$B$B如果一切顺利，那么这群猎人很快就将成为我们最好的斥候，为国王陛下的军队效力。
text.progress: You've brought something for us?
text.completion: You did it!  You recovered the Sc... you recovered the chest that the Horde stole from us.  We thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ivan at Aspen Grove Post in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Close the Deal
english.objectives: Bring the Cedar Chest to Ivan at Aspen Grove Post.
english.description: We have what the trappers want.  Now it's up to us to sign them up with our side.$B$BTake the chest to a trapper named Ivan at the Aspen Grove Post, just north of here.$B$BIf all goes well, we'll have local woodsmen serving as scouts for the king's army in no time.
english.progress: You've brought something for us?
english.completion: You did it!  You recovered the Sc... you recovered the chest that the Horde stole from us.  We thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ivan at Aspen Grove Post in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 暂时的协议
text.objectives: 向琥珀松木营地的杜蒙特中尉复命。
text.description: 很好，$N。你们信守了高贵的和约。$B$B那么，告诉杜蒙特，我们也将信守诺言。
text.completion: Excellent news, $n.  With the locals' help we'll have the logistical support we need to outmaneuver the Horde in this region. I have further tasks for you if you're interested.

english.title: A Tentative Pact
english.objectives: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: Very well, $N.  Your people kept their end of the bargain.$B$BTell Dumont that we'll honor the deal.
english.completion: Excellent news, $n.  With the locals' help we'll have the logistical support we need to outmaneuver the Horde in this region. I have further tasks for you if you're interested.

text.title: 外交活动
text.objectives: 与银溪镇的杜卡尔特使谈一谈。
text.description: 我们尝试跟那群猎人交涉已经持续了好几周了，可是在你找到那只该死的箱子之前都没有任何进展可言。$B$B这对我们派去银溪镇的特使来说一定是个好消息。我们一周前派了杜卡尔去那边常驻，他在上一封公文里说那边交涉的进展也不是很理想。$B$B到银溪镇去帮助他开展外交工作吧。从这里一路向西北方向前进，穿过几座桥之后，就能找到银溪镇了。
text.completion: It's good to finally meet you, $n!  We'd heard about you up here.  Welcome to Silverbrook. These trappers are a great bunch of lads and lasses.  Hardy people, they know the lay of the land really well.  You'll find it's a great thing that we finally won them over to our side.

english.title: An Exercise in Diplomacy
english.objectives: Speak to Envoy Ducal in Silverbrook.
english.description: We'd been trying to negotiate with the trappers for weeks, but we'd gotten nowhere until you found that blasted chest of theirs.$B$BThis should be good news to our envoy in Silverbrook.  We sent Ducal there about a week ago and his last letter indicated he'd been making little progress.$B$BGo to Silverbrook and aid him in his diplomatic efforts.  Take the roads heading northwest of here and you should find it after crossing a couple of bridges.
english.completion: It's good to finally meet you, $n!  We'd heard about you up here.  Welcome to Silverbrook. These trappers are a great bunch of lads and lasses.  Hardy people, they know the lay of the land really well.  You'll find it's a great thing that we finally won them over to our side.

text.title: 生存或是死亡
text.objectives: 蓝天伐木场的蕾安娜要你对10名受伤的月溪旅步兵使用恢复绷带。
text.description: 唉，真是血流成河……$B$B我经历过许多场战斗，$C。而这次战斗比我所见过的都要惨烈得多。我们与部落的战争比以往更加激烈了，在诺森德，我们之间只有你死我活的杀戮。$B$B如果我们要在这里多生存一天的话，就必须尽量治疗我们的伤者。对我来说，要一个人救治这么多人实在是太困难了。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我的话，我已经准备好了特殊的绷带。拿上绷带，去治疗那些尚未彻底倒下的同伴吧。
text.completion: Wonderful! The Alliance shall live to see another day, in part due to your diligence. Please accept my thanks, friend.
text.completed: Return to Rheanna at Blue Sky Logging Grounds in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Life or Death
english.objectives: Rheanna at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to use the Renewing Bandage on 10 Wounded Westfall Infantry units.
english.description: Oh, the carnage....$b$bI've been through many battles, $c, and this one was more brutal than any I've seen. Our fight with the Horde has become more intense than ever. It's them or us here in Northrend - life or death.$b$bIf we are to survive here another day we'll need to mend our wounded. There are too many for me to rescue alone.$b$bI've prepared special bandages that will enable you to assist me. Take one and tend to those who have not yet succumbed to their wounds.
english.completion: Wonderful! The Alliance shall live to see another day, in part due to your diligence. Please accept my thanks, friend.
english.completed: Return to Rheanna at Blue Sky Logging Grounds in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 叛徒的名单
text.objectives: 亚当斯上尉要你向西部卫戍要塞的格雷尔·岩锤出示联盟信函。
text.description: 你必须立即把我手里的这份名单交给高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩。他指挥的第七军团就驻扎在龙骨荒野东部的暮冬要塞里。$B$B如果这份名单上的叛徒进入了暮冬要塞……那就太可怕了。$B$B赶快，$N。把这份文件给西部卫戍要塞这里的格雷尔·岩锤看看，向他解释你的任务性质。他会派最快的狮鹫送你前往暮冬要塞！
text.progress: Hello, $c.
text.completion: You will have my fastest gryphon! This information must be delivered to High Commander Wyrmbane at once!
text.completed: Return to Greer Orehammer in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Of Traitors and Treason
english.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to show the Alliance Missive to Greer Orehammer at Westguard Keep.
english.description: The list I hold must be delivered to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He commands the 7th Legion, stationed at Wintergarde Keep on the eastern borders of the Great Dragonblight.$B$BIf any of the traitors on this list are stationed at Wintergarde... it could be catastrophic.$B$BHurry, $N. Show the document to Greer Orehammer here at Westguard Keep and explain the nature of your mission. He'll put you on his fastest gryphon to Wintergarde!
english.progress: Hello, $c.
english.completion: You will have my fastest gryphon! This information must be delivered to High Commander Wyrmbane at once!
english.completed: Return to Greer Orehammer in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩
text.objectives: Deliver the Alliance Missive to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in eastern Dragonblight. $B$B
text.description: <Greer hands the missive back to you.>$B$BSkysong will take you to Wintergarde, $N. I guarantee you that it will be the fastest flight you've ever taken. Go now!$B$B
text.progress: What have you got there, soldier?
text.completion: Do you know where the people on this list are now? Take a look outside, near the front gate. They're the ones hanging from the arches. Ghoul bait...
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: High Commander Halford Wyrmbane
english.objectives: Deliver the Alliance Missive to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in eastern Dragonblight. $B$B
english.description: <Greer hands the missive back to you.>$B$BSkysong will take you to Wintergarde, $N. I guarantee you that it will be the fastest flight you've ever taken. Go now!$B$B
english.progress: What have you got there, soldier?
english.completion: Do you know where the people on this list are now? Take a look outside, near the front gate. They're the ones hanging from the arches. Ghoul bait...
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 北边的敌人
text.objectives: 银溪镇的瑟尔基要你杀死8名征服堡劫掠者。
text.description: 很高兴见到你。传统而富有娱乐性的“消灭部落成员”活动让你们和我们达成了许多一致，这真是可喜可贺。$B$B其实这个镇子西边也有许多来自征服堡的劫掠者。不如你冲出去像对付野兽一样把他们清扫一遍？$B$B让我们看看我们的新盟友能做出多少实际行动来支持谈判桌上的努力。
text.progress: You done with those Horde cretins yet?
text.completion: Not bad, not bad.  You might not be as soft as some of the others.
text.completed: Return to Sergei at Silverbrook in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Northern Hospitality
english.objectives: Sergei at Silverbrook wants you to slay 8 Conquest Hold Marauders.
english.description: It's good to meet you.  Let us celebrate our pact by partaking in some good old fashioned Horde-killing.$B$BYou'll find marauders from Conquest Hold just outside our town, west of here.  Why don't you head out there and hunt them like the filthy animals they are?$B$BLet's see if our new allies can back all their talk with some action.
english.progress: You done with those Horde cretins yet?
english.completion: Not bad, not bad.  You might not be as soft as some of the others.
english.completed: Return to Sergei at Silverbrook in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 勇气的试炼
text.objectives: 在银溪镇西北边找到博斯纳普中士，以此通过勇气的试炼。
text.description: 好吧，朋友。你的确帮了我们一两个忙，但这绝不是对勇气的真正考验。$B$B在我们这里，只有你亲自杀死某只强大的猎物，并把它的皮毛穿在身上时，人们才会承认你是一名伟大的猎手。$B$B<瑟尔基从鞘中抽出他的剥皮小刀递给了你。>$B$B那群胆敢进犯我们镇子的白痴兽人有个头目叫作博斯纳普，你可以在镇子西北边的一处营地里找到他。$B$B没错了，朋友，你要剥下那个混蛋的皮。
text.progress: The people in Silverbrook... they're not what they seem.
text.completion: Don't do it, $n.  The people that sent you here.... you shouldn't trust them.
text.completed: Return to Captured Trapper at Silverbrook Hills in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Test of Mettle
english.objectives: Find Sergeant Bonesnap northwest of Silverbrook and pass the Test of Mettle.
english.description: Alright, friend.  You've done us a favor or two, but that's not the true test of a person's courage.$B$BAround these parts, you're not a real hunter unless you wear your prey's skin.$B$B<Sergei unsheathes his skinning knife and hands it to you.>$B$BThe leader of those motherless orcs attacking our town is called Bonesnap; you'll find him at a camp further northwest.$B$BThat's right.  You're going to skin the monster.
english.progress: The people in Silverbrook... they're not what they seem.
english.completion: Don't do it, $n.  The people that sent you here.... you shouldn't trust them.
english.completed: Return to Captured Trapper at Silverbrook Hills in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 真相会让我们解脱
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野黎明河滩的欧瑞克·图哈特要你在遗忘海岸的废墟中使用欧瑞克的水晶球，以拯救那些被遗忘的灵魂。
text.description: 这颗水晶球是好几年以前瑟里格送给我的，他还特别嘱咐过它的使用方法。五年以来，每当我因这里所发生的事情而感到愤怒、焦躁或是悲伤时，我就会全神贯注地凝视这颗水晶球，以获得心灵上的平静与安宁。$B$B现在，我终于可以理解瑟里格将它送给我的真意了。$B$B带上水晶球，到遗忘海岸去，在海滩上找到曾经是我们基地的那片废墟，然后将这颗水晶球放在基地的中央。让那些被遗忘的鬼魂们也能通过我的内心与灵魂，重新审视这个世界吧。
text.completion: You did a good thing this day, $n. Hundreds of lost souls are now redeemed, thanks to you.
text.completed: Return to Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Truth Shall Set Us Free
english.objectives: Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight wants you to use Orik's Crystalline Orb in the ruins located at the Forgotten Shore to redeem the Forgotten.
english.description: Zelig gave this crystal ball to me years ago with specific instruction on its use. For five years - whenever I would feel anger, anxiety, or sorrow over the events that transpired here - I was to focus my thoughts upon the orb.$B$BI now understand why Zelig gave this crystal to me.$B$BTake my crystalline orb to the Forgotten Shore. Find the ruins of my old base on the upper reaches of the beach and place the orb in the center of town. Let the forgotten see the world through my heart and soul.
english.completion: You did a good thing this day, $n. Hundreds of lost souls are now redeemed, thanks to you.
english.completed: Return to Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight.

text.title: 萨莎的警告
text.objectives: 前往银溪镇的西北角。
text.description: 谢谢你的帮助，$N。我叫萨莎。听着，我必须……必须从这里逃出去。$B$B派你来的那些人……我的同胞们……他们已经不再是原来的他们了。他们不再善良……而且……他们想把你……变成他们当中的一员。$B$B这个……所谓的“试炼”只是个开始。$B$B总之，如果你相信我的话，就立刻到银溪镇的西北角去看一眼。你会找到一些有趣的东西。$B$B祝你好运……还有，不要轻信任何人。
text.completion: Who's there?  Are you here to kill me? Please!  You don't have to do this!

english.title: Words of Warning
english.objectives: Go to the northwestern end of Silverbrook.
english.description: Thanks for helping me, $N.  My name's Sasha.  Listen, I have to get the hell out of here.$B$BThe people that sent you here... my people... they've changed.  They're not good people anymore... and they want to turn you into one of... one of them.$B$BThis... 'test' they sent you on is just the beginning.$B$BHead to the northwestern end of Silverbrook.  You'll find something of interest to you.$B$BGood luck... and trust no one.
english.completion: Who's there?  Are you here to kill me? Please!  You don't have to do this!

text.title: 战争的开销
text.objectives: 怨毒镇的军需官巴莱特要求你去取回6份被遗忘的宝藏。
text.description: <军需官低沉下声音轻声对你说。>$B$B$C，我需要你的帮助。我们的保险箱已经空了，因为天谴之门的库卡隆先锋营地拿走了我们的所有金币，以支持他们在那边进行的战事。$B$B不过，我听到传言说，东南面遗忘海岸一带的失事船只残骸中有着大量的宝藏。$B$B我们得马上行动，否则就没法对付那些血色先锋军了。你要知道，战争可并不便宜！
text.progress: How much of that Alliance treasure did you manage to get your hands on?
text.completion: I trust that you didn't stash any of this on the side for yourself? You wouldn't be that selfish when the fate of Venomspite is at stake? Besides, I'm going to reward you with a percentage of the take. It's not much, but in times like this, we all have to make sacrifices.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

english.title: Funding the War Effort
english.objectives: Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite has asked you to recover 6 Forgotten Treasure.
english.description: <The quartermaster lowers his voice and whispers to you.>$B$B$C, I need your help; our coffers are empty. The Kor'kron Vanguard at the Wrath Gate has taken all of our coin for the fight there.$B$BBut, I've heard whispers that there's treasure to be had amongst the wrecks on the Forgotten Shore to the southeast.$B$BWe have to do something soon, or we won't be able to continue the fight against the Scarlet Onslaught. War isn't cheap, you know!
english.progress: How much of that Alliance treasure did you manage to get your hands on?
english.completion: I trust that you didn't stash any of this on the side for yourself? You wouldn't be that selfish when the fate of Venomspite is at stake? Besides, I'm going to reward you with a percentage of the take. It's not much, but in times like this, we all have to make sacrifices.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite in Dragonblight.

text.title: 海边的地产
text.objectives: 测量员汉森要求你前往南面的遗忘海岸，击杀20个被遗忘的幽灵。
text.description: 是时候扩张怨毒镇了！$B$B很快，我们就会解决血色先锋军，不过我希望你先去一个被称为遗忘海岸的地方跑一趟。那里有着巨大的发展潜力，而且，你有没有注意到那里的风景？$B$B不幸的是，那里遍地都是人类的幽灵，都是些失事船只的船员，以及没有认识到自己已经死了的家伙。$B$B清理海滩和岸边的水域吧。也许不久以后我们就可以畅想在那里建造一座舒适安逸的坟墓了。
text.completion: Can't you just see it now, $c? It'll be the vacation spot of Northrend! What do you think of the name, "Hansen's Cove", or maybe "$n Bay"? Kind of catchy, don't you think?
text.completed: Return to Surveyor Hansen at The Forgotten Shore in Dragonblight.

english.title: Beachfront Property
english.objectives: Surveyor Hansen, just north of the Forgotten Shore, has asked you to slay 20 Forgotten ghosts.
english.description: It's time for Venomspite to expand!$B$BWe'll take care of the Onslaught in due time, but I want you to spearhead our efforts on the Forgotten Shore. The property value has outstanding potential and just look at that view!$B$BUnfortunately, there's an infestation of human ghosts, shipwrecked crews and the like who haven't quite realized that they're dead.$B$BClear the beach and the waters off the shore, and maybe you and I will talk about building a cozy, new mausoleum down there soon.
english.completion: Can't you just see it now, $c? It'll be the vacation spot of Northrend! What do you think of the name, "Hansen's Cove", or maybe "$n Bay"? Kind of catchy, don't you think?
english.completed: Return to Surveyor Hansen at The Forgotten Shore in Dragonblight.

text.title: 离别的思绪
text.objectives: 回到龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，向幻象师瑟里格复命。
text.description: You have honored me and honored the memory of hundreds of Alliance veterans, $N. Zelig was wise in sending you here. Please return to him and give him my thanks. He will be happy to hear of the events that transpired at the Forgotten Shore.$B$BI do not have the gift of foresight like Zelig, but I am certain that great things await you, friend.$B$BFarewell. $B$B
text.completion: It is I who owe you a debt of gratitude, hero. Orik is like a brother to me. You have changed his life and given renewed hope to countless others.

english.title: Parting Thoughts
english.objectives: Return to Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
english.description: You have honored me and honored the memory of hundreds of Alliance veterans, $N. Zelig was wise in sending you here. Please return to him and give him my thanks. He will be happy to hear of the events that transpired at the Forgotten Shore.$B$BI do not have the gift of foresight like Zelig, but I am certain that great things await you, friend.$B$BFarewell. $B$B
english.completion: It is I who owe you a debt of gratitude, hero. Orik is like a brother to me. You have changed his life and given renewed hope to countless others.

text.title: 本月美酒俱乐部
text.objectives: Bring the "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.
text.description: There is strength in numbers, $n.  Being part of the "Brew of the Month" club means knowing you and your brethren will always have access to the best brew.$b$bBring your "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.
text.progress: Do ya have your membership forms filled out?
text.completion: So you be joinin' our ranks, $N? We treat ya nice here. You only get the best when you part of dis club!$B$BWe be sendin' out brew to you at da start of every month. If you like what you got, and you be wantin' more, head back over here. We make sure you get more of da brew you like.
text.completed: Return to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Brew of the Month Club
english.objectives: Bring the "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.
english.description: There is strength in numbers, $n.  Being part of the "Brew of the Month" club means knowing you and your brethren will always have access to the best brew.$b$bBring your "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.
english.progress: Do ya have your membership forms filled out?
english.completion: So you be joinin' our ranks, $N? We treat ya nice here. You only get the best when you part of dis club!$B$BWe be sendin' out brew to you at da start of every month. If you like what you got, and you be wantin' more, head back over here. We make sure you get more of da brew you like.
english.completed: Return to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 破狼草根
text.objectives: 银溪镇的卡娅要求你拔出8株破狼草根。
text.description: 你有没有听说过一种名叫破狼草的植物？这种草非常非常可怕……它强大的繁殖与抢夺养分的能力会使我们所有的庄稼都绝收。$B$B我们上星期花了一整周的时间将这种草除光，可它们的根目前仍然还在土壤里，似乎又开始恢复生长了。$B$B虽然不是很急迫的事情，可这样一种顽强的植物生长在田地里实在是……灾难。村子附近到处都是残余的草根，你是否能帮我们除掉它们呢？
text.progress: 再次欢迎你，$N!你是来向我展示你完成狩猎的证明的吗?
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  You didn't get any wolfsbane on you, did you?  I've got these... allergies that act up once in a while.
text.completed: Return to Katja at Silverbrook in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Wolfsbane Root
english.objectives: Katja in Silverbrook wants you to uproot 8 Wolfsbane Roots.
english.description: Have you heard of the wolfsbane plant?  It is a horrible weed... it destroys our farmable crops.$B$BWe spent all of last week cutting them down, but the roots are beginning to sprout again.$B$BIt might not seem like an urgent matter, but a resurgence of the plant could be a real... disaster.  Do you think you could help us by uprooting them where you find them near the village?
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  You didn't get any wolfsbane on you, did you?  I've got these... allergies that act up once in a while.
english.completed: Return to Katja at Silverbrook in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 逃离银溪镇
text.objectives: 打开木笼，帮助联盟斥候逃出银溪镇。抵达琥珀松木营地后向杜蒙特中尉汇报情况。
text.description: 你……你不是他们的人？快！快把我放出来！$B$B我们必须马上逃往琥珀松木营地！一旦杜蒙特中尉发现这些家伙的真面目，就会夷平这个镇子！
text.progress: You made it back. I was a worried about you, $N.
text.completion: Worgen.  Blasted, Light-forsaken, filth-ridden worgen. It's time we showed the locals what us civilized folk do with beasts like them.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Escape from Silverbrook
english.objectives: Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
english.description: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$B$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!
english.progress: You made it back. I was a worried about you, $N.
english.completion: Worgen.  Blasted, Light-forsaken, filth-ridden worgen. It's time we showed the locals what us civilized folk do with beasts like them.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 找到杜尔库！
text.objectives: Seek out Cavalier Durkon at the Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.$B$B
text.description: After the Scourge breached the south wall, I ordered Cavalier Durkon to investigate the town crypt. Moments ago I was handed his report.$B$BThe undead that plague us are coming from two sources: the ruins of Wintergarde, now a breeding ground for Scourge, and our very own town crypt! Amidst the chaos and confusion the Scourge managed to get a necrolord inside the crypt.$B$BIn his message, Durkon requested assistance. You will find him and help him, $N. The crypt is on the western border of the town square.
text.completion: Oh brother, it's a mess down there! I barely made it out last time - which is what prompted my request to the High Commander. You got that crazy look in your eyes, $r. Thankfully, you're gonna need to be crazy to do what I'm about to ask of you.

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 快速反应
text.objectives: 杜蒙特中尉要你前往林边哨站，杀死弗拉德克以及7名银溪镇猎人。
text.description: 我们必须立刻对此作出反应与决断。我们一定要让那些野蛮人知道，绝对别想与我们为敌。$B$B斥候们已经找到了残余的银溪镇猎人的位置……不过你要知道，这群家伙也绝对不愿意坐以待毙。他们目前十分高调地封锁了通向东南方的路……看来是想包围我们了。$B$B立刻前往林边哨站，处理掉他们。他们的头目据说是个叫弗拉德克的家伙……马上去搞定他。
text.progress: Is it done, %N?
text.completion: It's a shame those trappers turned out to be... afflicted.  We sure could've used a few more fighting men. May the poor souls rest in peace.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: A Swift Response
english.objectives: Lieutenant Dumont wants you to go to Forest's Edge Post and slay Vladek and 7 Silverbrook Hunters.
english.description: Our response must be immediate.  Decisive.  We must teach these savages not to cross us.$B$BOur scouts have located what's left of the Silverbrook trappers... you know, the ones you didn't get to douse in flames.  Apparently they're blockading the road to the southeast... perhaps they're trying to box us in.$B$BHead to the Forest's Edge post and take care of them.  Their leader's reported to be a man named Vladek... make sure he's dealt with.
english.progress: Is it done, %N?
english.completion: It's a shame those trappers turned out to be... afflicted.  We sure could've used a few more fighting men. May the poor souls rest in peace.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 贵族的陵墓
text.objectives: 暮冬要塞的骑兵杜尔库要求你杀死通灵领主阿玛里恩。
text.description: Held within the cold stone walls of this crypt are the remains of the nobles and dignitaries that died in Northrend. At its very core now sits a necrolord who raises the corpses as servants of the Scourge.$B$BYou must make your way to the bottom of the Wintergarde Crypt and kill Necrolord Amarion. Only then will the assault from within cease!$B$BAnd $N, be on the lookout for any information that might be laying about inside the room where Amarion resides. $B$B
text.progress: Is Amarion dead?
text.completion: Now if we could stop the Scourge attacks coming from outside the keep we might be able to send help to Lord Fordragon at the Wrathgate.
text.completed: Return to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Noble's Crypt
english.objectives: Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Keep wants you to slay Necrolord Amarion.
english.description: Held within the cold stone walls of this crypt are the remains of the nobles and dignitaries that died in Northrend. At its very core now sits a necrolord who raises the corpses as servants of the Scourge.$B$BYou must make your way to the bottom of the Wintergarde Crypt and kill Necrolord Amarion. Only then will the assault from within cease!$B$BAnd $N, be on the lookout for any information that might be laying about inside the room where Amarion resides. $B$B
english.progress: Is Amarion dead?
english.completion: Now if we could stop the Scourge attacks coming from outside the keep we might be able to send help to Lord Fordragon at the Wrathgate.
english.completed: Return to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.

text.title: 天灾的秘密
text.objectives: 将血之魔典交给龙骨荒野暮冬要塞的骑兵杜尔库。
text.description: 这本长达数百页的魔典的每一页上，都用刀刻着一些奇怪的符号，还辅以数幅诡秘的图形。你完全看不明白这上面刻的是什么，但你的直觉告诉你：这一定是非常重要的情报。$B$B将这本书拿去给暮冬地穴外的骑兵杜尔库看看吧，他或许会对此有所了解。
text.progress: A Scourge tome?
text.completion: Whatever information is held in this book must be of great importance! I could hear the howls and wails echoing through the crypt as you made your escape! The High Commander must be notified!
text.completed: Return to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.

english.title: Secrets of the Scourge
english.objectives: Deliver the Flesh-bound Tome to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
english.description: Scrawled across the flesh-bound chapters of this tome are strange symbols and shapes that seem to have been scraped into the pages with a blade. You have no idea what is written, but you are certain that whatever it is, it must be important.$B$BDeliver the tome to Cavalier Durkon standing guard topside at Wintergarde Crypt.
english.progress: A Scourge tome?
english.completion: Whatever information is held in this book must be of great importance! I could hear the howls and wails echoing through the crypt as you made your escape! The High Commander must be notified!
english.completed: Return to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.

text.title: 除掉佐娜船长！
text.objectives: 杀死佐娜船长，然后向风险湾的弗里曼男爵复命。
text.description: 部落已经做好了战前准备，如果我们不立即反击，他们就会突破防线，夺得风险湾的控制权。佐娜船长统领着驻扎在港口的部落军队，她的船只就停泊在海湾的另一侧。$B$B只要击败她，削弱部落的防御势力，我们或许就能抓住这个机会占领港口。$N，小心，佐娜是个凶暴好斗的家伙。我估计要好几个人才能制服她，有机会的话你可以利用那台修好的伐木机。
text.progress: Have you slain Captain Zorna?
text.completion: Well done, $n! Without their leader, the Horde is weak and disorganized. I will order our men forward.
text.completed: Return to Baron Freeman at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Down With Captain Zorna!
english.objectives: Slay Captain Zorna and report to Baron Freeman at Venture Bay.
english.description: The Horde's forces are poised to break through our lines and complete their conquest of Venture Bay if we do not act. The Horde's forces in the port are commanded by Captain Zorna, near the ship on the far side of the bay.$B$BIf you can defeat her, the Horde's offensive will falter and we can seize the chance to capture the port. Beware, $N, for Zorna is a fierce fighter. It may take several people to defeat her, or if you have access to a repaired shredder, you might try using it to your advantage.
english.progress: Have you slain Captain Zorna?
english.completion: Well done, $n! Without their leader, the Horde is weak and disorganized. I will order our men forward.
english.completed: Return to Baron Freeman at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 消灭布莱沃特船长！
text.objectives: 杀死布莱沃特船长，然后向风险湾的卡兹加尔将军复命。
text.description: 我们每前进一步，就会遭遇联盟新的增援。好像他们的指挥官能预知我的每一步行动一样！$B$B是时候解决布莱沃特船长了，那家伙在远处港湾中的联盟驱逐舰上指挥着他的部队。$B$B这场战斗并不轻松，$N。带上几个可以信赖的伙伴，或者搞到那些修理过的伐木机的钥匙，用它们去消灭布莱沃特船长！不管你用什么方法，他必须得死！
text.progress: Have you eliminated the enemy captain?
text.completion: You are a true soldier of the Horde, $n. Your bravery will inspire my men to victory!
text.completed: Return to General Khazgar at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Crush Captain Brightwater!
english.objectives: Slay Captain Brightwater and report to General Khazgar at Venture Bay.
english.description: With every advance, our men are met by fresh Alliance reinforcements. It's almost as though their commander anticipates my every move!$B$BThe time has come for good Captain Brightwater to meet his end. He commands his troops from aboard an Alliance destroyer at the far end of the bay.$B$BThis will be no easy fight, $N. Take along a couple of trusted friends, or if you have a key to one of those repaired shredders, use it to disembowel Brightwater! Either way, he must fall!
english.progress: Have you eliminated the enemy captain?
english.completion: You are a true soldier of the Horde, $n. Your bravery will inspire my men to victory!
english.completed: Return to General Khazgar at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 夺取港口！
text.objectives: 杀死10名部落成员，然后返回风险湾向斯图亚特中尉复命。
text.description: 我们绝不能允许部落占领风险湾，它对我们在灰熊丘陵一带的军事行动起着至关重要的作用。$B$B斯托曼上尉率领月溪旅的其他士兵去东边寻找穿越山岭的道路，我们已经没有援军可用了。$B$B$N，深入敌阵收割征服堡狂战士吧，联盟必须夺得港口的控制权！
text.progress: What have you to report?
text.completion: Your bravery has inspired the men of the Westfall Brigade. Even now they fight with greater ferocity. The port will soon be ours.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Stuart at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Keep Them at Bay!
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Horde units or players in Venture Bay and return to Lieutenant Stuart.
english.description: We cannot permit the Horde to control Venture Bay. The port is essential to our operations in Grizzly Hills and beyond.$B$BCaptain Stoutmantle has taken the rest of the Westfall Brigade east in search of a passage through the mountains, so we'll have no reinforcements.$B$BGo into the field, $N, and kill the Conquest Hold berserkers the Horde has sent against us. Cut them down until none remain standing. The Alliance must have this port!
english.progress: What have you to report?
english.completion: Your bravery has inspired the men of the Westfall Brigade. Even now they fight with greater ferocity. The port will soon be ours.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Stuart at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 港口中的联盟
text.objectives: Defeat 10 Alliance units or players in Venture Bay and return to Centurion Kaggrum.
text.description: This wretched Westfall Brigade is proving a tougher opponent than we'd thought. Though few in number, they fight well and bravely, but we cannot afford to wait them out.$B$BConqueror Krenna's orders were to capture the port quickly. You must break the stalemate, $N. Find the enemy's marines and slaughter them until the resistance ceases. Only then will we be able to claim ownership of the port.$B$BGo quickly. We don't want to keep Conqueror Krenna waiting.
text.progress: Have you done as ordered?
text.completion: The port will soon fall to us. You have done well this day, $n.
text.completed: Return to Centurion Kaggrum at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.progress: Have you done as ordered?
english.completion: The port will soon fall to us. You have done well this day, $n.
english.completed: Return to Centurion Kaggrum at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Save Brewfest!
text.objectives: Speak with the Brewfest Spy in the Grim Guzzler of Blackrock Depths.$B$B
text.description: $n, our spies have discovered a fiendish plot!  The Dark Iron dwarves want our beloved Brewfest destroyed!$B$BCoren Direbrew, head of a renegade family of brewers, has marshaled the dwarves of Blackrock Depths.  Their vile mole machines attack us constantly.$B$BOur spy is in the Grim Guzzler, a tavern in the bowels of Blackrock Depths.  He'll know more of Direbrew's plot.$B$BFind our spy.  Save Brewfest!
text.completion: You're from the Brewfest camp? Glory day! Brewfest may yet be saved.$B$B$N, Coren Direbrew must be stopped! We cannot let him sabotage our sacred holiday. Our brews must flow!

english.title: Save Brewfest!
english.objectives: Speak with the Brewfest Spy in the Grim Guzzler of Blackrock Depths.$B$B
english.description: $n, our spies have discovered a fiendish plot!  The Dark Iron dwarves want our beloved Brewfest destroyed!$B$BCoren Direbrew, head of a renegade family of brewers, has marshaled the dwarves of Blackrock Depths.  Their vile mole machines attack us constantly.$B$BOur spy is in the Grim Guzzler, a tavern in the bowels of Blackrock Depths.  He'll know more of Direbrew's plot.$B$BFind our spy.  Save Brewfest!
english.completion: You're from the Brewfest camp? Glory day! Brewfest may yet be saved.$B$B$N, Coren Direbrew must be stopped! We cannot let him sabotage our sacred holiday. Our brews must flow!

text.title: 血之魔典
text.objectives: 将血之魔典交给龙骨荒野暮冬要塞的高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩。
text.description: 这究竟是什么，$N？那个秽恶的巫妖在你身上降下的诅咒看来绝不一般！$B$B<杜尔库飞速地翻阅这本恐怖的书籍，希望能查出什么内容。>$B$B啊，不行，这书完全我无法理解，我甚至根本不知道该往哪里看。我们必须另想办法查出这本书中的有用信息！$B$B<杜尔库把书交还给你。>$B$B高级指挥官应该知道要怎么做。带上这本血之魔典去找他，记得先详细描述一下这里所发生的一切。
text.progress: The necrolord is no more?
text.completion: The fates smile down upon us on this day, $n. I know just the person to see about this tome.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Mystery of the Tome
english.objectives: Take the Flesh-bound Tome to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
english.description: What can it be, $N? That was certainly no ordinary curse that the blasted lich put on you!$B$B<Durkon flips through the grisly pages of the tome.>$B$BI don't even know if I'm looking at it the right way. We must find out what information is held within this tome!$B$B<Durkon hands the book back to you.>$B$BThe High Commander will know what to do. Take the flesh-bound tome to him and tell him exactly what happened here.
english.progress: The necrolord is no more?
english.completion: The fates smile down upon us on this day, $n. I know just the person to see about this tome.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 破译魔典
text.objectives: 将血之魔典交给龙骨荒野暮冬要塞监狱内的审讯员哈尔拉德。
text.description: 拿上书，沿门口的路一直走到兵营。进入兵营以后直接从楼梯下楼，到兵营内的监狱去。你可以在那边找到审讯员哈尔拉德，还有我们以前的市长高弗雷，我想高弗雷或许就是我们面前这张谜图中没有拼上的那一块，而哈尔拉德就是能把这块拼图拼上去的人。$B$B快去吧！
text.progress: You come from high command, my son?
text.completion: Perhaps, with proper motivation, Godfrey will tell us what he knows about the tome. Isn't that right, mayor?
text.completed: Return to Inquisitor Hallard at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Understanding the Language of Death
english.objectives: Take the Flesh-bound Tome to Inquisitor Hallard at the Wintergarde Keep prison.
english.description: Take the book and follow the path leading up to the barracks. Once inside the barracks take the staircase down to the prison. At the prison you will find Inquisitor Hallard and our mayor, Godfrey. I believe Godfrey might be the missing piece of this puzzle and Hallard the man to put it all together.$B$BGo now!
english.progress: You come from high command, my son?
english.completion: Perhaps, with proper motivation, Godfrey will tell us what he knows about the tome. Isn't that right, mayor?
english.completed: Return to Inquisitor Hallard at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 正义的审判
text.objectives: 等待审讯员哈尔拉德完成他的正义审讯，然后带着你获得的情报回到暮冬要塞的高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩那里复命。
text.description: 高弗雷·古塔德，他曾是暮冬城的市长，一位正义之士，但是现在却沦为了天灾军团的仆从。他从人类向亡灵食尸鬼转化的过程异常缓慢，用了很长的时间。现在，他听从了巫妖王的召唤，只为侍奉他的新主人而活下去。$B$B但是和其他天灾军团的爪牙一样，他通晓亡者的语言，只要给予适当的“刺激”，他就会把他对那本书的全部理解都告诉我们。$B$B那么，你听到想要知道的消息以后，就立刻回到前线那边去向高级指挥官复命。我会负责这里的善后工作。
text.completion: We should have known about the damned mausoleum. This is preposterous! Duke August Foehammer and Ambo Cash will be dispatched to the front lines in preparation for our next assault. Once you have cleared the mines I will send you to Foehammer so that we may begin our attack against the Scourge of Naxxramas! The information you have garnered thus far will be sent to Lord Fordragon at the Wrathgate upon the wings of our most able gryphon!
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: A Righteous Sermon
english.objectives: Wait for Inquisitor Hallard to finish his Righteous Sermon and return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight with the information you uncover.
english.description: Godfrey Goodard, once a righteous man and mayor of Wintergarde, is now an agent of the Scourge. His transformation from man to undying ghoul has taken place slowly, over time. He hears the call of the Lich King now and lives only to serve his master.$B$BBut as with all Scourge, Godfrey knows the language of death and with proper motivation, will tell us what we need to know about the tome.$B$BOnce you hear what you need to hear, return to the High Commander at the front lines. I'll clean up here as needed.
english.completion: We should have known about the damned mausoleum. This is preposterous! Duke August Foehammer and Ambo Cash will be dispatched to the front lines in preparation for our next assault. Once you have cleared the mines I will send you to Foehammer so that we may begin our attack against the Scourge of Naxxramas! The information you have garnered thus far will be sent to Lord Fordragon at the Wrathgate upon the wings of our most able gryphon!
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 把他们熏出来！
text.objectives: 利用烟雾炸弹迫使20名风险投资公司游荡者逃出他们的藏身之地，然后向杜内恩中士复命。
text.description: 还有一小部分风险投资公司的成员藏匿在风险湾中心的建筑物中。我一方面要不断地抽调人手对抗部落军队，另一方面又不能任由那些风险投资公司游荡者龟缩在暗处。$B$B或许我们能“说服”他们从工棚、锯木厂或是马厩之类的地方现身。利用这枚烟雾炸弹将他们从藏身之处熏出来。你最好别靠得太近，兔子急了也会咬人的。
text.progress: Have you smoked out the last of the Venture Company guys yet?
text.completion: Well done, soldier! Now the rest of the men can focus their efforts on the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Downey at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Smoke 'Em Out
english.objectives: Use the Smoke Bomb to drive 20 Venture Company Stragglers from their buildings and then report to Sergeant Downey.
english.description: There are still pockets of cowardly Venture Company men holed up in some of the buildings at the center of Venture Bay. I need every man I can spare out there fighting against the Horde, but we can't allow those Venture Company stragglers to camp out in those buildings, either.$B$BMaybe we can "convince" them to make for their ship. Take this smoke bomb and use it to smoke out the stragglers from their places in the bunkhouse, sawmill, or stables. Don't get too close, though; they probably bite.
english.progress: Have you smoked out the last of the Venture Company guys yet?
english.completion: Well done, soldier! Now the rest of the men can focus their efforts on the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Downey at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 把他们熏出来！
text.objectives: Use the Smoke Bomb to drive 20 Venture Company Stragglers from their buildings and then report to Stone Guard Ragetotem.
text.description: Not only is this port infested with sniveling Alliance cowards, but to make matters worse, there are still Venture Company employees holed up in some of the buildings. They're not worth the time it takes to kill and I can't spare the warriors anyway.$B$BMaybe we can "convince" them to make for their ship. Take this smoke bomb and use it to smoke out the stragglers from their places in the bunkhouse, sawmill, or stables. Don't get too close, though; there's no telling what diseases they're carrying.
text.progress: Have you smoked out the last of the Venture Company vermin yet?
text.completion: The general will be pleased that you've dealt with the Venture Company problem. Now, the men can focus on beating back the Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ragetotem at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Smoke 'Em Out
english.objectives: Use the Smoke Bomb to drive 20 Venture Company Stragglers from their buildings and then report to Stone Guard Ragetotem.
english.description: Not only is this port infested with sniveling Alliance cowards, but to make matters worse, there are still Venture Company employees holed up in some of the buildings. They're not worth the time it takes to kill and I can't spare the warriors anyway.$B$BMaybe we can "convince" them to make for their ship. Take this smoke bomb and use it to smoke out the stragglers from their places in the bunkhouse, sawmill, or stables. Don't get too close, though; there's no telling what diseases they're carrying.
english.progress: Have you smoked out the last of the Venture Company vermin yet?
english.completion: The general will be pleased that you've dealt with the Venture Company problem. Now, the men can focus on beating back the Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ragetotem at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

starters.name: 石头守卫诺卡·暴怒图腾

enders.name: 石头守卫诺卡·暴怒图腾

text.title: 进入敌占区
text.objectives: Speak with Gryphon Commander Urik to secure a ride to Thorson's Post. Report to Duke August Foehammer when you arrive at Thorson's Post in Dragonblight.$B$B
text.description: You have done much to advance our efforts against the Scourge, $N. In fact, the morale of all those who have come into contact with you soars! Such is your influence over the soldiers and citizenry of Wintergarde, ally.$B$BAnd because of you we are now prepared to go on the offensive! You are to report to Duke August Foehammer, across the Carrion Fields at Thorson's Post, east of here. Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station has prepared a special gryphon to drop you behind enemy lines. Go now!
text.completion: Ah, the distinguished hero arrives. Welcome to ground zero, $n. Allow me to bring you up to speed! Thel'zan's most powerful forces have made their way into the Wintergarde Mausoleum. They plumb its depths in search of corpses and souls to send against Wintergarde while Naxxramas rains down terrible Scourge plague machines, set to hold us at bay! We must strike now and hope that Lord Fordragon is able to hold out at the Wrathgate for just a little longer.

english.title: Into Hostile Territory
english.objectives: Speak with Gryphon Commander Urik to secure a ride to Thorson's Post. Report to Duke August Foehammer when you arrive at Thorson's Post in Dragonblight.$B$B

You are to report to Duke August Foehammer, across the Carrion Fields at Thorson's Post, east of here. starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 蒸汽坦克行动
text.objectives: 使用联盟蒸汽坦克摧毁6台天灾战车，并将第七军团精英送入暮冬陵园。成功之后与暮冬陵园里的阿姆博·卡什谈一谈。
text.description: 本次行动的核心内容是搜索与消灭。你将驾驶一辆坦克直接进入腐臭平原，摧毁一切天灾军团的天灾战车。此外，跟随你进入敌占区的还有三名隶属于第七军团的士兵，若想任务成功，你必须保证他们的存活！$B$B执行任务时，你只需要将坦克开近敌人的天灾战车，派出车上的工兵，掩护他们完成爆破作业，然后前往下一辆天灾战车旁即可。消灭战场上的全部天灾战车以后，你要直接将坦克开往要塞废墟前的陵园，将车组成员送到那里去。之后，进入陵园，与阿姆博·卡什会面。
text.progress: Name's Cash. Ambo Cash. And the pleasure is all yours.
text.completion: Why I'm not wearing any pants isn't important. Let's just say I took some Scourge shrapnel in the wrong place and leave it at that, ok? So you wiped out those plague wagons up in the fields and got my soldiers here in one piece. Impressive. You're one of the first to make it this far, friend. Too bad you gotta go right back out into the Carrion Fields. Yep, we've had a bit of a setback.
text.completed: Speak to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

english.title: Steamtank Surprise
english.objectives: Use an Alliance Steam Tank to destroy 6 Plague Wagons and deliver the 7th Legion Elites to Wintergarde Mausoleum. Speak with Ambo Cash inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight should you succeed.
english.description: This is a seek and destroy mission. You'll be driving a tank into the Carrion Fields to dismantle Scourge plague wagons. With the tank comes a crew of three 7th Legion soldiers. All must survive if this mission is to succeed!$B$BYou'll need to get in close to a plague wagon to unleash your engineer. Let them do their deed and move on to the next one. When the field is clear of plague wagons, head to the mausoleum in front of the ruined keep and drop off the rest of your crew. Meet with Ambo Cash inside.
english.progress: Name's Cash. Ambo Cash. And the pleasure is all yours.
english.completion: Why I'm not wearing any pants isn't important. Let's just say I took some Scourge shrapnel in the wrong place and leave it at that, ok? So you wiped out those plague wagons up in the fields and got my soldiers here in one piece. Impressive. You're one of the first to make it this far, friend. Too bad you gotta go right back out into the Carrion Fields. Yep, we've had a bit of a setback.
english.completed: Speak to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

text.title: 梦游体验
text.objectives: 在卢娜的水晶球旁饮下幻境药水，见证过去的景象。
text.description: 啊，你想要知道过去发生了些什么？很好，你真是一个睿智的$R。$B$B每次有人路过这里，慕名来找我时，总是想问有关未来的事。但是当你到了我这个年纪时，你就会明白，了解过去远比了解未来更有用。$B$B饮下这瓶药水，凝视这枚水晶球吧。让我们看看你能发现些什么。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: Did you learn anything from your vision?  You mentioned Solstice Village during your trance -- which marks the second time someone has spoken the place's name today.
text.completed: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Out of Body Experience
english.objectives: Drink the Gossamer Potion near Ruuna's Crystal Ball and witness the Vision from the Past.
english.description: Ah, you seek a vision of the past.  You're a wise $r.$B$BEvery time someone drops by for a reading, they seem to always ask about the future.  When you get to be my age, you learn that scrying the past, more often than not, is more useful.$B$BDrink this potion and peer into my crystal ball.  Let us see what knowledge we can obtain.
english.completion: Did you learn anything from your vision?  You mentioned Solstice Village during your trance -- which marks the second time someone has spoken the place's name today.
english.completed: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 卢娜的要求
text.objectives: 盲眼卢娜要你收集4堆幻境粉尘。
text.description: 我不会向你收取任何费用，因为我清晰地感觉到，你的一举一动对所有人的命运都非常重要，而今天的预言则将大大推动你的进展。$B$B不过，你得帮我带回一种占卜所必需的材料。到东北边那些食蕨蛾身上收集一些幻境粉尘，我可以用它们调制出一种药水，喝下它之后，你就将在梦境中前往正确的时间与地点去见证你需要见证的一切。
text.progress: Did you obtain the dust, $n?
text.completion: Good.  These will do just fine. I will have the potion ready for you in no time at all.
text.completed: Return to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Ruuna's Request
english.objectives: Ruuna the Blind wants you to obtain 4 handfuls of Gossamer Dust.
english.description: I will not charge you gold for my services, for I can foresee that your actions are necessary and much hinges on what you learn today.$B$BI will, however, ask you to collect a reagent for me.  Obtain gossamer dust from the fern feeder moths northeast of here.  Do this and I will prepare a potion that will take you to the time and place where the events took place that you need to witness.
english.progress: Did you obtain the dust, $n?
english.completion: Good.  These will do just fine. I will have the potion ready for you in no time at all.
english.completed: Return to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 命运与巧合
text.objectives: 与白松商栈的萨莎谈一谈。
text.description: 这个世界上的人分成两类，$N，相信巧合的，与不相信的。$B$B在我失去了双眼的那一天，上天赐予了我另一件礼物，这件礼物让我重新能看到一些东西，过去与未来的东西。我想，你应该可以猜到我属于哪类人了。$B$B不久之前，一个名叫萨莎的年轻女孩看到了与你一样的的东西，或许你愿意和她谈谈。$B$B她就在东边的白松商栈，通向冬至村的路旁。
text.completion: I was wondering when you'd turn up.  Think you can give me a hand here?

english.title: Fate and Coincidence
english.objectives: Speak to Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post.
english.description: There are two types of people in this world, $N.  Those who believe in coincidence and those who don't.$B$BOn the day I lost my eyesight I was given the gift of clairvoyance.  I suppose you can guess what sort of person I am.$B$BEarlier today, a young woman named Sasha was granted the same vision you were.  You will want to talk to her.$B$BYou'll find her directly east of here at the White Pine Trading Post, on the way to Solstice Village.
english.completion: I was wondering when you'd turn up.  Think you can give me a hand here?

text.title: 阿纳托雷
text.objectives: 白松商栈的萨莎要你进入冬至村，对塔特亚娜使用麻醉飞镖。然后将塔特亚娜带回白松商栈。
text.description: 我的妹妹应该被困在这个村子里，但囚禁她的那个混蛋不愿意跟我谈判。$B$B他似乎完全不关心自己的幸福。不过我有个计划。早在拜狼教到来之前，我就认识了阿纳托雷的妻子塔特亚娜，她是个驯马师。$B$B拿上这根麻醉飞镖，她看到就知道是我派你去的，我想请她来好好谈一谈，看她能不能帮忙说服阿纳托雷。$B$B只要我们一救出我的妹妹，我一定会帮你找出这一切的幕后黑手。
text.progress: I'm glad to see you in one piece.
text.completion: That... that was close. We need to save Anya.  Now!
text.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Anatoly Will Talk
english.objectives: Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to take the Tranquilizer Dart and use it on Tatjana in Solstice Village.  Bring Tatjana back to the White Pine Trading Post.
english.description: My sister is here somewhere, and I can't seem to get this monster to talk.$B$BHe doesn't seem to care about his own well-being, but I've an idea.  I knew Anatoly's wife, Tatjana, from before the wolfcult arrived -- she was a horse-handler.$B$BTake this tranquillizer dart.  Bring her back alive, we're going to need her if we're to have any leverage with Anatoly.$B$BI will help you find the person behind all this once we save my sister.
english.progress: I'm glad to see you in one piece.
english.completion: That... that was close. We need to save Anya.  Now!
english.completed: Return to Sasha at White Pine Trading Post in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 保卫龙眠神殿
text.objectives: 龙眠神殿的阿弗拉沙斯塔兹要你骑着龙眠神殿防御者加入战斗，杀死3条碧蓝巨龙和5条碧蓝幼龙，并破坏碧蓝巨龙圣地。
text.description: 蓝龙军团受到碧蓝巨龙圣地中流动的过剩法力的鼓舞，居然胆敢来攻击龙眠神殿！$B$B请你骑上龙眠神殿防御者加入战斗，消灭蓝龙和他们的幼龙。你还要攻击碧蓝巨龙圣地喷发出来的魔网能量，使它变得不稳定。$B$B龙眠神殿防御者就在东面和西面的平台上。与其中一头防御者交谈，他就会载你一起战斗。$B$B如果没有你的帮助，$N，我们一定会输掉这场战争。
text.progress: How fares the fight? Are we pushing them back?
text.completion: Incredible! Let me just say that I continue to be amazed by what you younger races seem capable of. We are indebted to you. Will you come back and help us again tomorrow?
text.completed: Return to Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Defending Wyrmrest Temple
english.objectives: Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to slay 3 Azure Dragons, slay 5 Azure Drakes, and to destabilize the Azure Dragonshrine while riding a Wyrmrest Defender into battle.
english.description: Emboldened by the overabundance of magic now flowing through the Azure Dragonshrine, the blue dragonflight has dared to attack Wyrmrest Temple itself!$B$BI ask that you ride one of our defenders into battle to slay their dragons and drakes, and to attack the eruption of ley line energies at the dragonshrine itself in order to destabilize it.$B$BOutside on the east and west terraces are wyrmrest defenders. Speak with one to ride it into battle.$B$BWithout your help, $N, we will surely lose.
english.progress: How fares the fight? Are we pushing them back?
english.completion: Incredible! Let me just say that I continue to be amazed by what you younger races seem capable of. We are indebted to you. Will you come back and help us again tomorrow?
english.completed: Return to Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 姐姐的誓言
text.objectives: 在冬至村附近的暗嚎兽穴中寻找安娅。
text.description: 求求你了，$N。我知道你在寻找阿鲁高的踪迹。我以我父亲的名义发誓，一定会帮助你杀掉他。$B$B但……但我必须先求求你，安娅是无辜的，我们不能把她留在这群野兽身旁。$B$B请你先帮我救出妹妹，之后我一定会全力帮助你对付阿鲁高的。$B$B我知道阿纳托雷所说的那个洞穴在哪里，我们从山的另一侧爬上去就能找到。快走吧，我妹妹现在很危险。
text.completion: I don't want to be here anymore.  The worgen-men are mean.

english.title: A Sister's Pledge
english.objectives: Look for Anya in the Duskhowl Den near Solstice Village.
english.description: Please, $N.  I know it is Arugal you're after.  I swear on my father's memory I will help you take him down.$B$BBut I must beg you... Anya is completely innocent, we cannot leave her with these savages.$B$BHelp me rescue my sister and you'll have me at your side when you face Arugal.$B$BI know the den Anatoly spoke of.  We'll find it on the other side of this hill.  Let's go, my sister's in danger.
english.completion: I don't want to be here anymore.  The worgen-men are mean.

text.title: My Enemy's Friend
text.objectives: Conqueror Krenna in Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Hunters and their leader, Vladek, at the Forest's Edge Post.
text.description: If there is one thing I can get through your head, let it be this: the Alliance will be crushed in the Grizzly Hills.$B$BThere is far too much lumber, ore, game and strategic territory for us to give up on any single battlefront here.$B$BSo far we've been successful... but there's something that could tip the scales in our enemy's favor.$B$BFar to the east  of here, at the Forest Edge's Post, local trappers seek to join the Alliance.  Slaughter them before they have the chance to do so.
text.progress: Did you complete your task? If not, what are you doing here?
text.completion: You're back.  And you're alive. Now what's this nonsense about worgen?
text.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: My Enemy's Friend
english.objectives: Conqueror Krenna in Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Hunters and their leader, Vladek, at the Forest's Edge Post.
english.description: If there is one thing I can get through your head, let it be this: the Alliance will be crushed in the Grizzly Hills.$B$BThere is far too much lumber, ore, game and strategic territory for us to give up on any single battlefront here.$B$BSo far we've been successful... but there's something that could tip the scales in our enemy's favor.$B$BFar to the east  of here, at the Forest Edge's Post, local trappers seek to join the Alliance.  Slaughter them before they have the chance to do so.
english.progress: Did you complete your task? If not, what are you doing here?
english.completion: You're back.  And you're alive. Now what's this nonsense about worgen?
english.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Attack on Silverbrook
text.objectives: Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Defenders in the Silverbrook Hills.
text.description: A few hours ago, the trappers were nothing but peasants threatening to add their number to the Alliance's.$B$BNow they've become something else... an uncertainty.  I do not like uncertainties.  Go to the hills outside their main town in northern Grizzly Hills, Silverbrook, and help my men crush them.
text.progress: Have you completed your task yet, $N?
text.completion: Not bad, $n.  You might be slightly more useful than I initially thought.
text.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Attack on Silverbrook
english.objectives: Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Defenders in the Silverbrook Hills.
english.description: A few hours ago, the trappers were nothing but peasants threatening to add their number to the Alliance's.$B$BNow they've become something else... an uncertainty.  I do not like uncertainties.  Go to the hills outside their main town in northern Grizzly Hills, Silverbrook, and help my men crush them.
english.progress: Have you completed your task yet, $N?
english.completion: Not bad, $n.  You might be slightly more useful than I initially thought.
english.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 顺手牵马
text.objectives: 驱赶5匹高地野马回到月溪旅营地的侍从皮尔斯那里。
text.description: 斯托曼上尉一直不让我们这些骑……骑兵……好吧……养马的去参加风险湾一带的战斗。$B$B无所事事的我们只好把营地扎到了这处好地方，你看，周围漫山遍野都是高地野马在跑来跑去，从巨石丘陵到东北边，全都是！队长要我负责抓几只野马来补充坐骑。$B$B你愿意帮个忙吗？你看，绳子和棍子都有了，营地周围的土里还长满了野生胡萝卜。你只要拔上几根胡萝卜然后把它用绳子捆在棍子上，一路把野马引回到这里来，就搞定啦，轻松愉快！
text.progress: Did you get all the mustangs we'll need?
text.completion: Wow! These sure are good horses! I think the Cap'n will be real pleased with our work.
text.completed: Return to Squire Percy at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Mounting Up
english.objectives: Ride 5 Highland Mustangs back to Squire Percy at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
english.description: Cap'n Stoutmantle left most of our calvary... cavlary... uh, horsemen at the fight for Venture Bay.$B$BWe chose a good place to put the camp 'cause there are tons of highland mustangs running around near here and in the Boulder Hills to the northeast. The Cap'n put me in charge of capturing some of 'em.$B$BWill you help? I've got a stick and some string, and there are loads of wild carrots growing near the camp. Pick the carrots and use them with the stick to lure in the mustang, then ride it back here.
english.progress: Did you get all the mustangs we'll need?
english.completion: Wow! These sure are good horses! I think the Cap'n will be real pleased with our work.
english.completed: Return to Squire Percy at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Horse Hollerer
text.objectives: Scare 15 Highland Mustangs and return to Soulok Stormfury at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: The Alliance's 'Westfall Brigade' is camped far to the north, near Thor Modan. They have foolishly divided their forces to contest our control of Venture Bay, and they have been left without cavalry.$B$BThey're now trying to capture and tame the wild highland mustangs that roam the area around the Westfall Brigade Encampment and Boulder Hills. We must stop them before they're able to replace their lost mounts. Take this and throw it near the horses to drive them away.
text.completion: Well done, $n. We must not let the Alliance gain any kind of advantage.
text.completed: Return to Soulok Stormfury at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: The Horse Hollerer
english.objectives: Scare 15 Highland Mustangs and return to Soulok Stormfury at Camp Oneqwah.
english.description: The Alliance's 'Westfall Brigade' is camped far to the north, near Thor Modan. They have foolishly divided their forces to contest our control of Venture Bay, and they have been left without cavalry.$B$BThey're now trying to capture and tame the wild highland mustangs that roam the area around the Westfall Brigade Encampment and Boulder Hills. We must stop them before they're able to replace their lost mounts. Take this and throw it near the horses to drive them away.
english.completion: Well done, $n. We must not let the Alliance gain any kind of advantage.
english.completed: Return to Soulok Stormfury at Camp Oneqwah in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 白热化的战斗
text.objectives: 杀死12个进攻的冰冷食尸鬼、8个进攻的冰冷恶鬼和1个进攻的冰冷憎恶，帮助伊斯坎达尔上尉守住峡谷。完成任务后向塞雷斯塔兹复命。
text.description: 天灾军团向圣地发动了猛烈的攻击，而圣地的守护者达莉亚不知去向。那些在混战中死去的红龙变成了扭曲的灰烬之龙，转而与我们为敌。情况实在是糟透了，$C。$B$B伊斯坎达尔上尉率领着一支你们的军队在圣地外抵御如潮水般涌来的天灾军团。$B$B去帮帮他吧……不过别冲得太靠前了。天灾士兵源源不断地攻上来，我不想让你就这样丢了性命。
text.progress: I'm glad you're still with us, $r.
text.completion: It is a disgusting task, but I thank you dearly for doing it. The Scourge cannot be permitted to push any further towards Wyrmrest or we are sure to lose it.
text.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

english.title: Heated Battle
english.objectives: Aid Captain Iskandar in holding the canyons by participating in the death of 12 Frigid Ghoul Attackers, 8 Frigid Geist Attackers, and 1 Frigid Abomination Attacker.$B$BReturn to Ceristrasz once you have finished this task.
english.description: The Scourge have overrun the shrine. The shrine's keeper, Dahlia Suntouch, is nowhere to be found. The red wyrms that fell in the shrine's defense now beset us in the form of twisted skeletal emberwyrms. The situation is dire, $r.$B$BCaptain Iskandar leads a group of your kind in stemming the flow of the Scourge out of the shrine.$B$BGo to his aid... but please stay behind his men. The flow of Scourge is endless and I don't want to lose you in one of those scarred canyons.
english.progress: I'm glad you're still with us, $r.
english.completion: It is a disgusting task, but I thank you dearly for doing it. The Scourge cannot be permitted to push any further towards Wyrmrest or we are sure to lose it.
english.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

text.title: 重归尘土
text.objectives: 从南面或北面的小路进入红玉巨龙圣地并寻找红玉橡果。对死去的红龙使用红玉橡果，让他们的尸体回归大地。完成任务后向塞雷斯塔兹复命。
text.description: 还有件事要交给你办。我有很多兄弟都在激烈的空战中阵亡了。如果我们不赶快行动的话，他们就会加入灰烬之龙的队伍。$B$B请你从南面或北面的小路进入圣地……那里的天灾军团应该比较少。$B$B在圣地里寻找从树上掉下来的红玉橡果，然后把它们种在我死去的同胞们的尸体旁。这样他们就能获得新生……这是红龙氏族的高贵宿命。
text.progress: I started to worry that the Scourge in the shrine had claimed you. It is good that you yet live.
text.completion: In the earth, my brothers can grant life anew. You have saved them from a fate far worse than death. I don't know a word in your tongue that could express how much this means to my kind. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth

english.title: Return to the Earth
english.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through one of the northern or southern passes and search for Ruby Acorns.  Use the Ruby Acorns on the fallen red dragons to return their bodies to the earth.  Return to Ceristrasz once the task is complete.
english.description: I have another task that needs attention. I have brothers who are falling in the battle overhead and if we do not act quickly, they will only bolster the emberwyrm ranks.$B$BGet into the shrine through one of the other passes to the south or north... the Scourge presence should be lighter there.$B$BSearch the shrine for ruby acorns that have fallen from the tree and plant them near the bodies of my fallen brood. Through this, they can give new life... a proud fate for any of my kind.
english.progress: I started to worry that the Scourge in the shrine had claimed you. It is good that you yet live.
english.completion: In the earth, my brothers can grant life anew. You have saved them from a fate far worse than death. I don't know a word in your tongue that could express how much this means to my kind. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth

text.title: 烈焰之地
text.objectives: 从南面或北面的小路进入红玉巨龙圣地，杀死6个冰冷通灵师并摧毁圣地下面的堕落之源。完成任务后向塞雷斯塔兹复命。
text.description: 我还有最后一个任务要给你，$R……一个足以扭转战局的任务。$B$B请你回到圣地，去杀死那些指挥战斗的通灵师。只要他们死了，我们就能击退天灾的军队，并慢慢夺回圣地。$B$B我还要你去找到圣地下面的堕落之源并摧毁它。$B$B我知道我要你做的事情太多了，但如果你能做到的话，我们就可以赢得这场战斗。
text.progress: You've returned! Have you don as I've asked of you?
text.completion: Dahlia... they turned her? Dahlia has been loyal to us for a very long time... if they can corrupt a being of her devotion, it does not bode well for the rest of the young races. Thank you for freeing her. I hope she has found some peace. You have honored us with your selfless assistance today, $r. I will send word to the council of what your kind have accomplished here. Go with our blessing.
text.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

english.title: Through Fields of Flame
english.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through one of the northern or southern passes, then kill 6 Frigid Necromancers and eliminate the source of the corruption under the shrine. Return to Ceristrasz once the task is complete.
english.description: I have one final task for you, $r... one that should turn the tide of this fight.$B$BReturn to the shrine and kill the necromancers that are fueling this onslaught. With them dead, we should be able to beat these forces back and eventually retake the shrine.$B$BI also need you to find the source of the corruption under the shrine and put an end to it.$B$BI know I have asked a lot of you, but if you do this for me, we will win this battle.
english.progress: You've returned! Have you don as I've asked of you?
english.completion: Dahlia... they turned her? Dahlia has been loyal to us for a very long time... if they can corrupt a being of her devotion, it does not bode well for the rest of the young races. Thank you for freeing her. I hope she has found some peace. You have honored us with your selfless assistance today, $r. I will send word to the council of what your kind have accomplished here. Go with our blessing.
english.completed: Return to Ceristrasz at the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight.

text.title: 红玉巨龙圣地的命运
text.objectives: 将达莉亚的红玉胸针带回龙眠神殿的议会大厅交给克拉苏斯，并将她的命运告诉他。
text.description: 你捡起这只胸针之后，发现它所发出的微弱光芒又黯淡了一些。$B$B克拉苏斯一定很关心达莉亚的命运。把这只胸针带回龙眠神殿交给他吧。
text.progress: Hello, $r. I sense the presence of my Ruby Brooch. Hand it here. What has become of Dahlia?
text.completion: Dahlia was taken by the Scourge? This is a sad day for all of us. I will look to finding a new keeper once the shrine is retaken. Thank you for your efforts... the Ruby Dragonshrine is a sacred place to us, and the sacrifices your kind have made will not be easily forgotten. It is good to know there are still heroes such as you - I will call upon you one day. Until that day comes, may your adventures be fruitful.
text.completed: Return to Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Bring Dahlia Suntouch's Ruby Brooch to Krasus in the Ruling Council Chamber at Wyrmrest and inform him of Dahlia's fate.
english.description: As you pick up the brooch, its faint glow brightens slightly.$B$BKrasus will want to know of Dahlia's fate. Take the brooch to him at Wyrmrest.
english.progress: Hello, $r. I sense the presence of my Ruby Brooch. Hand it here. What has become of Dahlia?
english.completion: Dahlia was taken by the Scourge? This is a sad day for all of us. I will look to finding a new keeper once the shrine is retaken. Thank you for your efforts... the Ruby Dragonshrine is a sacred place to us, and the sacrifices your kind have made will not be easily forgotten. It is good to know there are still heroes such as you - I will call upon you one day. Until that day comes, may your adventures be fruitful.
english.completed: Return to Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 本月美酒俱乐部
text.objectives: 将“本月美酒”俱乐部会员资料表交给铁炉堡石火旅店的拉尔金·雷酒。
text.description: 会员总是享有特权的。只要你成为“本月美酒”俱乐部的成员，就能在第一时间品尝到世间最棒的佳酿。$B$B将“本月美酒”俱乐部会员资料表交给铁炉堡石火旅店的拉尔金·雷酒吧。
text.progress: Do you have your membership forms filled out?
text.completion: Your paperwork looks to be in order.  Welcome to the club, $n! You can expect to get our mail at the start of every month.  If you like what you got, stop by and we can sell you some more.  This is the club that keeps on giving.
text.completed: Return to Larkin Thunderbrew in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Brew of the Month Club
english.objectives: Bring the "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Larkin Thunderbrew in the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge.
english.description: Membership has its privileges.  Being part of the "Brew of the Month" club means knowing where to get the latest and greatest brew.$b$bBring your "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Larkin Thunderbrew in the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge.
english.progress: Do you have your membership forms filled out?
english.completion: Your paperwork looks to be in order.  Welcome to the club, $n! You can expect to get our mail at the start of every month.  If you like what you got, stop by and we can sell you some more.  This is the club that keeps on giving.
english.completed: Return to Larkin Thunderbrew in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 本月美酒俱乐部
text.objectives: Bring the "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma Orgrimmar.
text.description: There is strength in numbers, $n.  Being part of the "Brew of the Month" club means knowing you and your brethren will always have access to the best brew.$b$bBring your "Brew of the Month" club membership form to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.
text.progress: Do ya have your membership forms filled out?
text.completion: So you be joinin' our ranks, $n?  We treat ya nice here.  You only get the best when you part of dis club! We be sendin' out brew to you at da start of every month.  If you like what you got, and you be wantin' more, head back over here.  We make sure you get more of da brew you like.
text.completed: Return to Ray'ma in Orgrimmar.

If you like what you got, and you be wantin' more, head back over here.  We make sure you get more of da brew you like.

text.title: Tactical Clemency
text.objectives: Deliver the Letter of Amnesty to the Captured Trapper in Silverbrook Hills.
text.description: Listen, $N.  I need you to act with discretion and speed.$B$BOne of Krenna's top sergeants has captured a trapper outcast outside of Silverbrook.  Now, if things turn out the way they usually do, the prisoner is going to be executed before the day is over.$B$BWe can't let that happen.  You see, the prisoner matches the description of Mikhail's older daughter in his diary.$B$BIf we set her loose and follow her closely, she'll lead us to whoever's controlling the trappers.  Take this letter to her.
text.progress: Are you here to kill me?
text.completion: You're going to let me go... just like that?  Listen, I don't want any trouble with you... these monsters killed my father and took my sister.  I have other things on my mind right now.
text.completed: Return to Captured Trapper at Silverbrook Hills in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 米克哈尔的日记
text.objectives: 将米克哈尔的日记交给征服堡的征服者克雷娜。
text.description: 根据你所掌握的情况，你认为这本日记是一个名叫米克哈尔的银溪镇居民写下的。$B$B他想必使用了人类通用语的某种变体或是方言，以防被人读懂其中的内容。或许你应该将这本书交给征服者克雷娜。
text.progress: What's that you've got there?
text.completion: Hah!  Is this some sort of joke? I barely have any use for books I can actually understand.
text.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Mikhail's Journal
english.objectives: Bring Mikhail's Journal to Conqueror Krenna in Conquest Hold.
english.description: From what you can gather, this journal was written by a denizen of Silverbrook named Mikhail.$B$BIt is written in some variant of the common human tongue.  Perhaps you should bring this back to Conqueror Krenna.
english.progress: What's that you've got there?
english.completion: Hah!  Is this some sort of joke? I barely have any use for books I can actually understand.
english.completed: Return to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 高戈娜
text.objectives: Bring Mikhail's Journal to Gorgonna in Conquest Hold.
text.description: This book is written in the pig-tongue the humans use.  It needs to be burned immediately.$B$BHand it to my sister Gorgonna and do not waste my time.
text.progress: 你有什么东西要给我看？
text.completion: Could it be?  The man who wrote this journal feared for his daughters' lives so he sent them away from Silverbrook. We just captured an outcast in the outskirts of town about the same age as the eldest daughter. Listen, $n.  There's more happening here than meets the eye... we can't just burn this diary.
text.completed: Speak to Gorgonna in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Gorgonna
english.objectives: Bring Mikhail's Journal to Gorgonna in Conquest Hold.
english.description: This book is written in the pig-tongue the humans use.  It needs to be burned immediately.$B$BHand it to my sister Gorgonna and do not waste my time.
english.progress: You have something to show me?
english.completion: Could it be?  The man who wrote this journal feared for his daughters' lives so he sent them away from Silverbrook. We just captured an outcast in the outskirts of town about the same age as the eldest daughter. Listen, $n.  There's more happening here than meets the eye... we can't just burn this diary.
english.completed: Speak to Gorgonna in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 盲眼卢娜
text.objectives: 前往沃达希尔小径附近的卢娜的营地，与盲眼卢娜谈一谈。
text.description: This trapper business has the potential to be more important than we've accounted for.$B$BIf they're not with the Alliance, there's a good chance they're with the Scourge, which could mean trouble.$B$BOur previous efforts might've paid off, though.  We spotted our former captive meeting with a fortune teller of some sort before we lost track of her.$B$BI'm almost certain now that she will take us to their leader if we can find her again.  Find Ruuna the Blind and see what you can find out.
text.completion: You seek knowledge beyond your reach so you've come to me.  I must warn you, stranger, the answers I provide might not be to your liking.

english.title: Ruuna the Blind
english.objectives: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp near Vordrassil Pass.
english.description: This trapper business has the potential to be more important than we've accounted for.$B$BIf they're not with the Alliance, there's a good chance they're with the Scourge, which could mean trouble.$B$BOur previous efforts might've paid off, though.  We spotted our former captive meeting with a fortune teller of some sort before we lost track of her.$B$BI'm almost certain now that she will take us to their leader if we can find her again.  Find Ruuna the Blind and see what you can find out.
english.completion: You seek knowledge beyond your reach so you've come to me.  I must warn you, stranger, the answers I provide might not be to your liking.

text.title: The Conquest Pit: Bear Wrestling!
text.objectives: Defeat Ironhide inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.
text.description: So you're interested in the fights, eh?  Well, Krenna has outlawed pit-fighting for all enlisted combatants.  But you, my friend, are technically a free agent and are not included in this prohibition.$B$BNice loophole, eh?$B$BAnyway, if you're interested I can start you off with something easy, a measly bear.  I'll even let you bring friends along!
text.progress: It's not over until you or the bear tips over, friend!
text.completion: Nice work, mon!  Here's your cut.
text.completed: Return to Bookie Vel'jen at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Conquest Pit: Mad Furbolg Fighting
text.objectives: Defeat Torgg Thundertotem inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B$B
text.description: You're not bad.  Not bad at all.$B$BThink you can take a furbolg?  What about one of those extra-large crazed Northrend furbolgs?$B$BGood, good.  Get your crew together, and head to the ring.  Let's give these folks a show... maybe we can earn some more coin while we're at it.
text.completion: Those were some sharp moves, friend!  Lots of bets against you, which is good news cash-wise!
text.completed: Return to Bookie Vel'jen at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Conquest Pit: Blood and Metal
text.objectives: Defeat Rustblood inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B$B
text.description: It's nice to have a real fighter around these parts... we'd only had prisoners and caged beasts for the past few weeks.  The people get bored, ya know?$B$BAnyhow, your next challenge is a genuine iron golem stolen from the depths of Thor Modan... think you can swing it?
text.completion: My heart nearly skipped a beat there!  Thought that mound of metal was gonna get ya, mon!
text.completed: Return to Bookie Vel'jen at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Conquest Pit: Death Is Likely
text.objectives: Defeat Horgrenn Hellcleave inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B$B
text.description: I'm gonna shoot straight with ya, kid.  This next contender's a murderer.$B$BLiterally.$B$BHe was to be executed last week, but he strangled the hangman with his left hand, so Krenna's guards sort of let me have him.$B$BFeel free to pass on this one.  I wouldn't blame ya.
text.completion: Fancy footwork, fancy footwork.  You really made quick work of that crazy orc, friend. Odds were against you seven-to-one; made some nice coin on that one!
text.completed: Return to Bookie Vel'jen at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: The Conquest Pit: Final Showdown
text.objectives: Defeat Krenna in the Conquest Pit.
text.description: You must've really upset Krenna.  She and Gorgonna have had a spat and you're wanted in the pit immediately.$B$BThere are some wild rumors that it's a fight to the death!  That would be bad news for you, but great news for our business venture!$B$BAt any rate, you can't run away from fate... best get in there on the quick and get it over with.
text.completion: What happened today... had to happen.  It doesn't mean I have to be happy about it. I've freed my people from a tyrant, but I've also lost a sister.  I thank you for your help, $n.  I wish to be alone now.
text.completed: Speak to Gorgonna at the Conquest Pit in Grizzly Hills.
