text.title: 驾驶红色火箭
text.objectives: 风险湾灯塔的高洛克将军希望你去摧毁联盟的木材运输船。$B$B只有在部落占领灯塔的时候，高洛克将军才会出现。
text.description: 就是你，$C！给我滚过来！$B$B联盟已经在这里的东北方装了满满一船的木材，正准备把它们运出去。既然我们没法夺走那些木材，那么就只有一个选择了——摧毁它！$B$B码头尽头的地精已经准备好了一些鱼雷，你可以在停泊在北边的地精船只上搞到开动鱼雷所需的燃料。$B$B去弄些燃料，然后驾驶一枚鱼雷冲向他们的运输船。$B$B出发！
text.progress: Has that Alliance lumber been burned yet, $c?
text.completion: Ha hah! What a ride, eh $c? If we can't control the resources here, then no one can! When will those puny Alliance pests realize that they are no match for the might of the Horde?
text.completed: Return to General Gorlok at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Riding the Red Rocket
english.objectives: General Gorlok at the lighthouse in Venture Bay wants you to destroy the Alliance Lumber Boat.$b$bGeneral Gorlok will only be present at the lighthouse when the Horde has it in their possession.
english.description: You there, $r! Get your lousy carcass over here!$b$bThe Alliance have a shipment of lumber all ready for transport just northeast of here. Since getting our hands on that wood is out of the question, there's only one thing to do - destroy it!$b$bThe goblin at the end of the dock here has some torpedoes all ready to go. He's got all the fuel for them on the docked goblin ship to the north.$b$bGet some fuel, then commandeer one of the torpedoes and ride it into their ship.$b$bDismissed!
english.progress: Has that Alliance lumber been burned yet, $c?
english.completion: Ha hah! What a ride, eh $c? If we can't control the resources here, then no one can! When will those puny Alliance pests realize that they are no match for the might of the Horde?
english.completed: Return to General Gorlok at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 寻找溶解剂
text.objectives: 风险湾部落基地的古图尔要你取回一罐115号元素。
text.description: 不会吧！又坏了一个垫圈……$B$B每次有垫圈坏掉，润滑剂都会流得到处都是。如果没有溶解剂的话，就得折腾好几个小时才能清理干净。$B$B我跟你说啊，在风险投资公司闯入的那个港口里有一种奇特的火箭燃料——我想他们把它称为“115号元素”。那东西可是很猛的溶解剂哦。$B$B帮我弄些过来，我不会让你白辛苦的。
text.progress: You got some of that element 115, $n?
text.completion: Ahh yes. That'll save me hours. Take this for your trouble, friend. And keep an eye out for more element 115. I'll take all you can find.
text.completed: Return to Gurtor at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Seeking Solvent
english.objectives: Gurtor at the Venture Bay Horde base wants you to bring him a canister of Element 115.
english.description: Gah! Not again. Another blown gasket....$b$bEvery time one of these goes, lubricant gums up all of the gears. Without solvent, it takes hours to clean.$b$bTell ya what, $r. There's some fancy rocket fuel on the Venture Company barge in the dock there - element 115 I think they call it. That stuff makes for a great solvent.$b$bGet me one of those and I'll make it worth your trouble.
english.progress: You got some of that element 115, $n?
english.completion: Ahh yes. That'll save me hours. Take this for your trouble, friend. And keep an eye out for more element 115. I'll take all you can find.
english.completed: Return to Gurtor at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Always Seeking Solvent
text.completed: Return to Gurtor in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Always Seeking Solvent
english.completed: Return to Gurtor in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 向阿弗拉沙斯塔兹报到
text.objectives: 与龙眠神殿的阿弗拉沙斯塔兹谈一谈。
text.description: 我讨厌生命的消逝……任何生命都一样。但我不会放弃抵抗，我不会让玛里苟斯杀死我们并玷污神殿！$B$B我已经指派阿弗拉沙斯塔兹全权负责龙眠神殿的防御事宜。$B$B去找托拉斯塔萨谈谈，让他派一条幼龙载你去找阿弗拉沙斯塔兹吧。$B$B请你帮助他，$N。你是守卫龙眠神殿、挫败蓝龙军团的关键。
text.completion: You must be $n. The queen informed me that you would be coming. If you are willing, we are in great need of your assistance.

english.title: Report to Lord Afrasastrasz
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: I abhor the loss of life... any life. But I will not stand idly by and allow Malygos to kill us and defile the temple!$B$BI have appointed Lord Afrasastrasz as the commander of Wyrmrest's defenses.$B$BSpeak with Torastrasza to ride a drake down to him.$B$BPlease lend him your aid, $N. Your involvement with the defense of Wyrmrest will be critical to us prevailing against the blue dragonflight.
english.completion: You must be $n. The queen informed me that you would be coming. If you are willing, we are in great need of your assistance.

starters.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 赚外快
text.objectives: 征服堡的粮食商人洛克兰要求你从附近的耸角雄鹿身上采集5块肥美的鹿肉。
text.description: 向你致敬，$C。不知道你有没有发现，在征服堡这个地方，一切都在克蕾娜的控制之下，我们买克蕾娜让我们买的，卖克蕾娜让我们卖的，连价格都是克蕾娜规定好的。$B$B这一些都在让这里的经济死亡！我决定偷偷赚一笔小钱，顺便让步兵小伙子们饱点口福。你不如去猎几头鹿，然后给我弄点鹿肉回来，怎么样？$B$B这附近的鹿可真是漫山遍野，所以呢，你必须只挑选最好的肉。
text.progress: You get that venison yet, $n?
text.completion: Nice job, $n.  These will feed two or three grunts each.  Not bad.
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Lorkran at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Supplemental Income
english.objectives: Provisioner Lorkran at Conquest Hold wants you to obtain 5 Succulent Venison from  the nearby Tallhorn Stag.
english.description: Hail, $c.  You'll find that here at Conquest Hold, we buy and sell what Krenna wants us to buy and sell... at the price that Krenna wants us to buy and sell.$B$BAll this is stifling business.  I'm hoping to make a little bit of coin on the side and feed our grunts at the same time.  Why don't you go hunt down some stag and bring me the venison?$B$BThey're numerous in the area, so bring me only the best meat.
english.progress: You get that venison yet, $n?
english.completion: Nice job, $n.  These will feed two or three grunts each.  Not bad.
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Lorkran at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 驾驶红色火箭
text.objectives: 风险湾灯塔的霍瑟尔司令希望你去摧毁部落的木材运输船。$B$B只有在联盟占领灯塔的时候，霍瑟尔司令才会出现。
text.description: 听着，$N。这场战斗说穿了无非就是在比谁的资源多。$B$B我有一个计划，可以让我们对部落占有更大的优势。$B$B在码头尽头停泊着一些鱼雷，我们可以利用它们击毁部落停泊在西北面的木材运输船。$B$B你去北边港口里的地精船只那里弄些燃料，然后骑在一枚鱼雷上，直接冲进他们的运输船里去！
text.progress: Has that Horde lumber ship been burned yet, $N?
text.completion: Good to see that you survived that impact. Quite the explosion! We can't afford for the Horde to make off with all that lumber. Well done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Commander Howser at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Riding the Red Rocket
english.objectives: Commander Howser at the lighthouse in Venture Bay wants you to destroy the Horde lumber shipment.$b$bCommander Howser will only be present at the lighthouse when the Alliance has it in their possession.
english.description: Listen, $n. This battle is as much over resources as tactical supremacy.$b$bI have a mission that could turn the tide in our struggle against the Horde here.$b$bThere are torpedoes at the end of the dock that we can use to take down the Horde's lumber ship to the northwest.$b$bYou'll need to get some of the fuel that's stored on the docked goblin ship just north of here, then ride one of the torpedoes into their transport!
english.progress: Has that Horde lumber ship been burned yet, $N?
english.completion: Good to see that you survived that impact. Quite the explosion! We can't afford for the Horde to make off with all that lumber. Well done, $c.
english.completed: Return to Commander Howser at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 悬赏：克留格·碎誓者
text.objectives: 杀死克留格·碎誓者，然后前往龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，向李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵领取奖赏。
text.description: 悬赏发布人伊露希亚·卢恩$B$B一个名叫克留格·碎誓者的天灾军团血肉巨人杀死了我的丈夫、孩子和我最好的朋友，韦斯帕尔一家。敢于揭下这张布告的勇士可以在腐臭平原东南边的海岸附近找到克留格。$B$B我要为死者讨回公道！去杀死克留格·碎誓者！$B$B杀死克留格的勇士可以去向李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵领取金钱和物品奖赏。$B$B请为我们伸张正义！
text.progress: Are you here to collect a bounty, ally?
text.completion: Well done, $n. I will notify Illusia that a hero has heard her call for help and risen to meet the challenge! Here is your reward.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Wanted: Kreug Oathbreaker
english.objectives: Kill Kreug Oathbreaker and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.
english.description: Posted by: Illusia Lune$B$BThe Scourge flesh giant known as Kreug Oathbreaker was responsible for the deaths of my husband, children and my dear friends, the Whisperveils. Those brave enough to take on this bounty will find Kreug in the southeastern reaches of the Carrion Fields.$B$BI demand justice! Kill Kreug Oathbreaker!$B$BIn the event that Kreug is slain, I have pooled money and items together and given them to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig to give out as a reward.$B$BPlease vindicate us!
english.progress: Are you here to collect a bounty, ally?
english.completion: Well done, $n. I will notify Illusia that a hero has heard her call for help and risen to meet the challenge! Here is your reward.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵
李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵

text.title: 西部的扰动
text.objectives: 去和暮冬要塞的罗尼·威尔斯谈一谈，向他要一头坐骑，前往龙骨荒野西部的群星之墓。
text.description: 有一股力量正在试图毁灭我们所珍惜的一切，$N。你必须前往西方的群星之墓。大法师茉德拉感觉到我们这个世界的魔法基础正在动摇，我们必须立刻解决这个问题！$B$B现在就出发吧，$N！去和暮冬要塞狮鹫站的罗尼·威尔斯谈一谈，把你的任务告诉他。他会让最快的狮鹫送你前往群星之墓。到达目的地以后，去找大法师茉德拉谈一谈。
text.completion: We definitely don't want another sundering, friend. I'll do all that I can to help you on your mission.

english.title: A Disturbance In The West
english.objectives: Speak to Rodney Wells at Wintergarde Keep to secure a ride to Stars' Rest in western Dragonblight.
english.description: Another force threatens to destroy all that we have worked for, $N. You must head westward to Stars' Rest. Archmage Modera has sensed a great disturbance in the magical ley lines of our world that must be dealt with immediately!$B$BGo now, $N! Speak to Rodney Wells at the gryphon station here in Wintergarde and let him know the nature of your mission. He will place you on his fastest gryphon to deliver you to Stars' Rest. Speak with Archmage Modera when you arrive.
english.completion: We definitely don't want another sundering, friend. I'll do all that I can to help you on your mission.

text.title: 前往群星之墓！
text.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in western Dragonblight.$B$B
text.description: When you are ready I will place you on my fastest gryphon to Stars' Rest. Once you get there, find and speak with Archmage Modera.$B$BGood luck, ally!
text.completion: Vas heard my distress call then, eh? Not a moment too soon, friend.

english.title: To Stars' Rest!
english.objectives: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in western Dragonblight.$B$B
english.description: When you are ready I will place you on my fastest gryphon to Stars' Rest. Once you get there, find and speak with Archmage Modera.$B$BGood luck, ally!
english.completion: Vas heard my distress call then, eh? Not a moment too soon, friend.

text.title: 通缉：高阶萨满祭司德金·血爪
text.objectives: 杀死高阶萨满祭司德金·血爪，然后前往龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，找李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵领取奖赏。
text.description: 悬赏发布人：德洛菲$B$B我和我的表亲，斯克罗提和布鲁特，在埃尔德齐断崖遭到了一群邪恶的血爪氏族狼獾人的袭击。我们逃走了，但斯克罗提和布鲁特恐怕被他们抓住了。$B$B我要报仇雪恨！在此招募无畏的勇士前往龙骨荒野东南部的埃尔德齐断崖，杀死高阶萨满祭司德金·血爪和他的爪牙。$B$B杀死这个恶棍的勇士可以向李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵领取大笔赏金！
text.progress: Have you faced Bloodpaw?
text.completion: Outstanding work, $n! I will notify Drolfy that a hero did rise to meet his challenge and that the cruel Bloodpaw is no more!
text.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Wanted: High Shaman Bloodpaw
english.objectives: Kill High Shaman Bloodpaw and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.
english.description: Posted by: Drolfy$B$BWhile out in the Eldritch Heights with my cousins, Skrotee and Brote, a vicious band of wolvar from the Bloodpaw tribe attacked us. We attempted to flee, but I fear they got Skrotee and Brote.$B$BI demand retribution! Is there someone brave enough to venture to the southeastern reaches of Dragonblight, to the Eldritch Heights, and kill High Shaman Bloodpaw and his cronies?$B$BI have given a hefty sum of gold to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig to disperse to anyone that claims this bounty!
english.progress: Have you faced Bloodpaw?
english.completion: Outstanding work, $n! I will notify Drolfy that a hero did rise to meet his challenge and that the cruel Bloodpaw is no more!
english.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵
李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵

text.title: 悬赏：先锋军指挥官尤斯图斯
text.objectives: Kill Onslaught Commander Iustus and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.$B$B
text.description: Posted by: Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig$B$BUpon the northeastern path from Wintergarde a battalion of 7th Legion were ambushed and slain by Onslaught Commander Iustus and an army of mindless Scarlet Onslaught zealots. Such cold and calculated actions must be met with force!$B$BWintergarde demands justice! Seek out Onslaught Commander Iustus at Onslaught Base Camp to the northeast and end his miserable existence.$B$BI will hand out the reward for this bounty to any who would dare take up the task!$B$B
text.completion: At least for now the Scarlet Onslaught suffers a setback in their nefarious plans. You have done Wintergarde a great service, $n.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Wanted: Onslaught Commander Iustus
english.objectives: Kill Onslaught Commander Iustus and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.$B$B
english.description: Posted by: Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig$B$BUpon the northeastern path from Wintergarde a battalion of 7th Legion were ambushed and slain by Onslaught Commander Iustus and an army of mindless Scarlet Onslaught zealots. Such cold and calculated actions must be met with force!$B$BWintergarde demands justice! Seek out Onslaught Commander Iustus at Onslaught Base Camp to the northeast and end his miserable existence.$B$BI will hand out the reward for this bounty to any who would dare take up the task!$B$B
english.completion: At least for now the Scarlet Onslaught suffers a setback in their nefarious plans. You have done Wintergarde a great service, $n.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵
李奥瑞克·冯·泽尔迪格公爵

text.title: 寻找溶解剂
text.objectives: 风险湾联盟基地的巴布芬克要你取回一罐115号元素。
text.description: 不会吧！又坏了一个垫圈……$B$B每次有垫圈坏掉，润滑剂都会流得到处都是。如果没有溶解剂的话，就得折腾好几个小时才能清理干净。$B$B我跟你说啊，在风险投资公司闯入的那个港口里有一种奇特的火箭燃料——我想他们把它称为“115号元素”。那东西可是很猛的溶解剂哦。$B$B帮我弄些过来，我不会让你白辛苦的。
text.progress: You got some of that element 115, $n?
text.completion: Ahh yes. That'll save me hours. Take this for your trouble, friend. And keep an eye out for more element 115. I'll take all you can find.
text.completed: Return to Barblefink at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Seeking Solvent
english.objectives: Barblefink at the Alliance base in Venture Bay wants you to bring him a canister of Element 115.
english.description: Gah! Not again. Another blown gasket....$b$bEvery time one of these goes, lubricant gums up all of the gears. Without solvent, it takes hours to clean.$b$bTell ya what, $r. There's some fancy rocket fuel on the Venture Company barge in the dock there - element 115 I think they call it. That stuff makes for a great solvent.$b$bGet me one of those and I'll make it worth your trouble.
english.progress: You got some of that element 115, $n?
english.completion: Ahh yes. That'll save me hours. Take this for your trouble, friend. And keep an eye out for more element 115. I'll take all you can find.
english.completed: Return to Barblefink at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 黑水伐木场的战斗
text.objectives: 斥候队长卡特尔希望你在黑水伐木场击杀10名部落士兵或者玩家。
text.description: 风险投资公司正在撤离灰熊丘陵。他们以前在这里运作着木材生意，但眼下的形势对他们来说有点太危险了。$B$B他们放弃的伐木场现在很容易就能占领，我们肯定不能让部落占领它们。$B$B黑水伐木场是这一地区的三处伐木场中最小的一个，但我们仍然需要它。你的任务就是去赶走部落的部队，他们从这里获得的任何木材都将是在别处对抗我们的武器。
text.progress: How's the hunt going?
text.completion: Nice work, $n.  We could use a few more folks like you up here.  We could really show the Horde not to mess with us.
text.completed: Return to Scout Captain Carter in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Blackriver Skirmish
english.objectives: Scout Captain Carter wants you to kill 10 Horde units or players in the Blackriver Logging Camp.
english.description: The Venture Company's on its way out of Grizzly Hills.  They used to run logging operations here, but things got a little too dangerous for them.$B$BTheir abandoned sites are up for grabs and we sure as hell can't let the Horde get their hands on them.$B$BThe Blackriver Logging Camp is the smallest of the three logging sites in this zone, but we still need it.  Do your part and fend off the Horde forces.  Any lumber they get here will be made into weapons to be used against us elsewhere.
english.progress: How's the hunt going?
english.completion: Nice work, $n.  We could use a few more folks like you up here.  We could really show the Horde not to mess with us.
english.completed: Return to Scout Captain Carter in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Always Seeking Solvent
text.completed: Return to Barblefink at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Always Seeking Solvent
english.completed: Return to Barblefink at Venture Bay in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 黑曜石巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 前往位于龙眠神殿西北方、天谴之门正西方的黑曜石巨龙圣地，找到瑟里纳尔并帮助他。
text.description: 天灾军团来了。克里奥斯塔兹无奈地召集盟友，试图拯救他们的红玉巨龙圣地，不过善良仁慈的红龙似乎并不打算帮忙挽救其余龙族的圣地。$B$B很意外吗？我一点儿也不。$B$B我的另一个同胞已经去清理盘踞在我们的黑曜石巨龙圣地里的亡灵了。现在你只要到那里去挥几下剑，就能证明自己比阿莱克丝塔萨更高贵更公正。$B$B我真开心。
text.completion: I'm trying to decide at which I'm more surprised... that you actually came to the aid of a Black Dragon or that you're still in one piece after speaking with Nalice. Her words drip venom, but I suppose Wyrmrest can keep even our kind in check sometimes. Or perhaps it's just the armies of the red dragonflight that are massed around her.

english.title: The Obsidian Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Travel to the Obsidian Dragonshrine Northwest of Wymrest and just West of the Wrath Gate. Locate Serinar inside of the shrine and offer him your aid.
english.description: The Scourge come. Korialstrasz calls upon his allies in a futile attempt to save their Ruby Dragonshrine, but it seems the good graces of the red flight don't extend to saving the shrines of the other flights.$B$BSurprised? I'm not.$B$BThere is another of my brood who has left to clear our Obsidian Dragonshrine of the undead vermin that now infest it. All it would take to prove yourself more noble and righteous than Alexstrasza herself is a quick jaunt over there and a few swings of a blade.$B$BI'm amused.
english.completion: I'm trying to decide at which I'm more surprised... that you actually came to the aid of a Black Dragon or that you're still in one piece after speaking with Nalice. Her words drip venom, but I suppose Wyrmrest can keep even our kind in check sometimes. Or perhaps it's just the armies of the red dragonflight that are massed around her.

text.title: 白热化的战斗
text.objectives: 杀死12个进攻的冰冷食尸鬼、8个进攻的冰冷恶鬼和1个进攻的冰冷憎恶，帮助德雷森上尉守住峡谷。完成任务后向瓦加斯塔兹复命。
text.description: 天灾军团占领了圣地。圣地的守护者达莉亚已经失踪了。在守卫圣地时阵亡的红龙都变成了扭曲的灰烬之龙，转头攻击我们。情况非常危急，$R。$B$B天灾军团如今源源不断地从神殿中涌来，德雷森上尉带着一队你们的人去阻止他们了。$B$B去帮助他……但请你一定要站在士兵身后。我可不希望你抵抗不住潮水般的敌军，牺牲在那些烧焦的峡谷里。
text.completion: It is a disgusting task, but I thank you for doing it. The Scourge cannot be permitted to push any further out of the shrine lest all of these lands be overrun.
text.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.

english.title: Heated Battle
english.objectives: Aid Captain Drayzen in holding the canyons by participating in the death of 12 Frigid Ghoul Attackers, 8 Frigid Geist Attackers, and 1 Frigid Abomination Attacker.$B$BReturn to Vargastrasz once you have finished this task.
english.description: The Scourge have overrun the shrine. The shrine's keeper, Dahlia Suntouch, is nowhere to be found. The red wyrms that fell in the shrine's defense now beset us in the form of twisted skeletal emberwyrms. The situation is dire, $r.$B$BCaptain Drayzen leads a group of your kind in stemming the flow of the Scourge out of the shrine.$B$BGo to his aid... but please stay behind his men. The flow of Scourge is endless and I don't want to lose you in one of those scarred canyons.
english.completion: It is a disgusting task, but I thank you for doing it. The Scourge cannot be permitted to push any further out of the shrine lest all of these lands be overrun.
english.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.

text.title: 重归尘土
text.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass and search for Ruby Acorns.  Use the Ruby Acorns on the fallen red dragons to return their bodies to the earth.  Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
text.description: I have another task that needs attention. I have brothers who are falling in the battle overhead and if we do not act quickly, they will only bolster the emberwyrm ranks.$B$BGet into the shrine through the pass in the south... the Scourge presence should be lighter there.$B$BSearch the shrine for ruby acorns that have fallen from the tree and plant them near the bodies of my fallen brood. Through this, they can give new life... a proud fate for any of my kind.
text.completion: In the earth, my brothers can grant life anew. You have saved them from a fate far worse than death. I don't know a word in your tongue that could express how much this means to my kind. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.
text.objective1: Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth

english.title: Return to the Earth
english.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass and search for Ruby Acorns.  Use the Ruby Acorns on the fallen red dragons to return their bodies to the earth.  Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
english.description: I have another task that needs attention. I have brothers who are falling in the battle overhead and if we do not act quickly, they will only bolster the emberwyrm ranks.$B$BGet into the shrine through the pass in the south... the Scourge presence should be lighter there.$B$BSearch the shrine for ruby acorns that have fallen from the tree and plant them near the bodies of my fallen brood. Through this, they can give new life... a proud fate for any of my kind.
english.completion: In the earth, my brothers can grant life anew. You have saved them from a fate far worse than death. I don't know a word in your tongue that could express how much this means to my kind. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.
english.objective1: Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth

text.title: 烈焰之地
text.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass, then kill 6 Frigid Necromancers and eliminate the source of the corruption under the shrine. Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
text.description: 我还有最后一个任务要给你，$R……一个足以扭转战局的任务。$B$B请你回到圣地，去杀死那些指挥战斗的通灵师。只要他们死了，我们就能击退天灾的军队，并慢慢夺回圣地。$B$B我还要你去找到圣地下面的堕落之源并摧毁它。$B$B我知道我要你做的事情太多了，但如果你能做到的话，我们就可以赢得这场战斗。
text.progress: You've returned! Have you done as I've asked of you?
text.completion: Dahlia... they turned her? Dahlia has been loyal to us for a very long time... if they can corrupt a being of her devotion, it does not bode well for the rest of the young races. Thank you for freeing her. I hope she has found some peace. You have honored us with your selfless assistance today, $r. Perhaps not all of the Horde bear the black hearts of their ancestors.  I will send word to the council of what your kind have accomplished here.
text.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.

english.title: Through Fields of Flame
english.objectives: Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass, then kill 6 Frigid Necromancers and eliminate the source of the corruption under the shrine. Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
english.description: I have one final task for you, $r... one that should turn the tide of this fight.$B$BReturn to the shrine and kill the necromancers that are fueling this onslaught. With them dead, we should be able to beat these forces back and eventually retake the shrine.$B$BI also need you to find the source of the corruption under the shrine and put an end to it.$B$BI know I have asked a lot of you, but if you do this for me, we will win this battle.
english.progress: You've returned! Have you done as I've asked of you?
english.completion: Dahlia... they turned her? Dahlia has been loyal to us for a very long time... if they can corrupt a being of her devotion, it does not bode well for the rest of the young races. Thank you for freeing her. I hope she has found some peace. You have honored us with your selfless assistance today, $r. Perhaps not all of the Horde bear the black hearts of their ancestors.  I will send word to the council of what your kind have accomplished here.
english.completed: Return to Vargastrasz in Dragonblight.

text.title: Onward to Camp Oneqwah
text.objectives: Speak with Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
text.description: While we build Conquest Hold, I sent Scout Vor'takh to make contact with our taunka allies in the east. They're based in Camp Oneqwah, which is in the easternmost part of Grizzly Hills, beyond Grizzlemaw.$B$BMake the journey there, hear Vor'takh's report and offer your assistance with anything he and the local chieftain may need. Your contributions to Conquest Hold have been exemplary and I know Vor'takh will be grateful for the assistance.
text.completion: Ah, so you're something in the way of reinforcements, then. Good. Tormak and his men have need of your blade.

english.title: Onward to Camp Oneqwah
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
english.description: While we build Conquest Hold, I sent Scout Vor'takh to make contact with our taunka allies in the east. They're based in Camp Oneqwah, which is in the easternmost part of Grizzly Hills, beyond Grizzlemaw.$B$BMake the journey there, hear Vor'takh's report and offer your assistance with anything he and the local chieftain may need. Your contributions to Conquest Hold have been exemplary and I know Vor'takh will be grateful for the assistance.
english.completion: Ah, so you're something in the way of reinforcements, then. Good. Tormak and his men have need of your blade.

text.title: zzOLD The Fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine
text.objectives: Bring Dahlia's Ruby Broach to Ceristrasz and inform him of her fate.

english.title: zzOLD The Fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Bring Dahlia's Ruby Broach to Ceristrasz and inform him of her fate.

text.title: Eyes Above
text.objectives: Windseer Grayhorn wants you to use the Silver Feather on 6 Imperial Eagles in Grizzly Hills.
text.description: I've been asked to lend my support to our efforts against the Alliance.  At the moment our military forces are about evenly matched and we're looking for ways to find an edge.$B$BThe imperial eagles that fly over the mountains and trees in this area would make excellent scouts for us.  Take this silver feather and use it to bind my sight to that of them.$B$BBeing able to see our enemy's movements will grant us the strategic advantage we need.  You'll find abundant eagles in the mountains to the east.
text.progress: Have you done what I asked of you, $N?
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  Your help is appreciated.
text.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

At the moment our military forces are about evenly matched and we're looking for ways to find an edge.$B$BThe imperial eagles that fly over the mountains and trees in this area would make excellent scouts for us.  Take this silver feather and use it to bind my sight to that of them.$B$BBeing able to see our enemy's movements will grant us the strategic advantage we need.  You'll find abundant eagles in the mountains to the east.
