english.completion: I thank you, $n.  Your help is appreciated.
english.completed: Return to Windseer Grayhorn at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 生命的循环
text.objectives: 翡翠巨龙圣地的护园者尼瑟拉要你去杀死5只翡翠天爪枭。
text.description: 伊瑟拉在翡翠梦境中沉睡，守护着梦境世界和艾泽拉斯。但是可怕的噩梦入侵了梦境世界，这使得我担心伊瑟拉也受到了影响。$B$B最近，我请求她帮助我们对抗天灾军团——那些亡灵正在各个巨龙圣地中制造冰霜巨龙。可是她误解了我的请求。$B$B她命令我们这个巨龙圣地的守卫攻击所有非绿龙军团的人。$B$B我要你去杀死一些天爪枭，以此来恢复圣地的平衡。
text.progress: The sooner that the ermerald skytalons can be dealt with, the sooner the Emerald Dragonshrine can be returned to its natural balance.
text.completion: Do not regret the part that you played in the cycle of life. Birth, death, and rebirth are all part of the natural order.
text.completed: Return to Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

english.title: Cycle of Life
english.objectives: Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine has asked you to slay 5 Emerald Skytalons.
english.description: Ysera sleeps in the Emerald Dream, watching over both the Dream and Azeroth. But a horrible nightmare has taken hold in the Dream, and now I fear that Ysera is being affected by it.$B$BRecently, I asked her to aid in the fight against the Scourge that are raising frostwyrms at the other dragonshrines. She misunderstood.$B$BInstead, she told our dragonshrine's defenders to treat those not of the green dragonflight as enemies.$B$BI need you to slay some of the skytalons. The shrine must regain its balance.
english.progress: The sooner that the ermerald skytalons can be dealt with, the sooner the Emerald Dragonshrine can be returned to its natural balance.
english.completion: Do not regret the part that you played in the cycle of life. Birth, death, and rebirth are all part of the natural order.
english.completed: Return to Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

text.title: 随风散落
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野暮冬陵园的阿姆博·卡什要你取回8箱暮冬军需品。
text.description: 朋友，军需品的数量严重短缺。我们打算从暮冬要塞空运来一批弹药，却在半路遭到了冰霜巨龙的袭击。货运飞船根本不堪一击，瞬间就散了架，好在大多数弹药箱都散落在了腐臭平原。$B$B我要你前往腐臭平原，取回我们的军需品。$B$B快点！没有枪支和弹药，你叫我们如何打仗！
text.progress: Where are my munitions, fella?
text.completion: Just in time! Some of my soldiers got a little overzealous and decided to wade into the crypts directly to the east and west of us. Needless to say, they were quickly overwhelmed by those mindless ghouls. We need to rescue the survivors!
text.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

english.title: Scattered To The Wind
english.objectives: Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to recover 8 Wintergarde Munitions.
english.description: The munitions drop went badly, friend. The shipment of ammo from Westguard Keep was intercepted by the frostwyrms circling overhead. The flying machines were torn apart in a matter of seconds and their cargo was scattered to the wind. Most of it is still topside - on the Carrion Fields.$B$BI'm gonna need you to go back up and recover the munitions crates that are scattered all over this damned place.$B$BHurry it up! We can't start this offensive without guns and ammo, $g buddy:missy;!
english.progress: Where are my munitions, fella?
english.completion: Just in time! Some of my soldiers got a little overzealous and decided to wade into the crypts directly to the east and west of us. Needless to say, they were quickly overwhelmed by those mindless ghouls. We need to rescue the survivors!
english.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

text.title: 奥雷托斯的羽毛
text.objectives: 翡翠巨龙圣地的护园者尼瑟拉要你取得奥雷托斯的羽毛。
text.description: 我能感觉到圣地并没有完全恢复平衡。翠羽守护者已经被我们的行动激怒了，我预感它不会听我们解释的。$B$B奥雷托斯是一头巨大的天爪枭，它栖息在翡翠巨龙圣地的最南部，控制着整个巨龙圣地的空中防御。恐怕我们也得让它进入轮回了。$B$B把这些天爪枭的绒毛放在它能看见的地方，它就会出现。把它的羽毛给我带来。
text.progress: Have you managed to deal with Alystros? The verdant keeper is very powerful.
text.completion: Do not weep for Alystros. He has dedicated his eternal life to the defense of the Emerald Dragonshrine and will be reborn. Hopefully when he returns to us, he will not be gripped with the confusion of the Emerald Nightmare that seems to have taken hold of The Dreamer.
text.completed: Return to Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Plume of Alystros
english.objectives: Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine has asked you to acquire The Plume of Alystros.
english.description: I can feel that the shrine is not completely back in balance. The verdant keeper has been angered by our actions, and I sense that he will not listen to reason.$B$BAlystros is an immense skytalon who perches at the south end of the Emerald Dragonshrine. It is he who is in charge of the dragonshrine's aerial defenses. I fear that we will have to deal with him.$B$BTake these skytalon molts and place them on the ground where he can see them. He will come. Bring me his plume.
english.progress: Have you managed to deal with Alystros? The verdant keeper is very powerful.
english.completion: Do not weep for Alystros. He has dedicated his eternal life to the defense of the Emerald Dragonshrine and will be reborn. Hopefully when he returns to us, he will not be gripped with the confusion of the Emerald Nightmare that seems to have taken hold of The Dreamer.
english.completed: Return to Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

text.title: 重机枪与你
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野暮冬陵园的阿姆博·卡什要你营救8名受伤的第七军团士兵。
text.description: 我们在正东方和正西方都架设了重型机枪和路障。受伤的士兵就躲在障碍物后，连大气都不敢出，唯恐被无脑的食尸鬼发现。$B$B弹药短缺的难题已经解决了，所以我要你拿起一挺重型机枪朝敌人扫射，掩护我们的士兵逃出来！你准备好之后，就呼唤一名受伤的士兵，然后朝涌上来的天灾军团士兵开火！$B$B前进！
text.progress: Have you rescued our injured soldiers?
text.completion: $n, I haven't seen heroics like that since Silithus! I'll be sure that each and every one of those soldiers puts in a recommendation to Lord Fordragon that you be promoted! Now, on to more pressing matters. We've gotten reports back from our scouts that Thel'zan is close.
text.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Chain Gun And You
english.objectives: Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to save 8 Injured 7th Legion Soldiers.
english.description: We've set up chain guns and barricades directly to the east and to the west. Our injured soldiers are hiding in both rooms - trying their best to not alert the mindless ghouls to their presence.$B$BNow that we have ammo, I need you to man one of the chain guns and use it to blast a path clear for our soldiers! Once you're on board, call a soldier out from hiding and then lay down heavy fire to keep the Scourge off him!$B$BGet a move on!
english.progress: Have you rescued our injured soldiers?
english.completion: $n, I haven't seen heroics like that since Silithus! I'll be sure that each and every one of those soldiers puts in a recommendation to Lord Fordragon that you be promoted! Now, on to more pressing matters. We've gotten reports back from our scouts that Thel'zan is close.
english.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

text.title: 鞭笞者的种子
text.objectives: 龙眠神殿顶层的伊萨里奥斯勋爵要你去收集3份鞭笞者的种子。
text.description: 我们需要更多对抗天灾军团的武器。东南方的翡翠巨龙圣地也许就是我们要寻找的答案。$B$B所有的亡灵生物——除了希尔瓦娜斯手下的那些——只要踏入圣地就会化为尘土。$B$B我需要你的帮助来完成一个试验，年轻的$R。请你到翡翠巨龙圣地去，拿一些翡翠鞭笞者的种子回来。
text.progress: And just how many seeds have you managed to acquire thus far?
text.completion: Even now I can feel the pulse of nature from within these seeds. We must put them to good use!
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Seeds of the Lashers
english.objectives: Lord Itharius at the top of Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to return with 3 Lasher Seeds.
english.description: We need more weapons in the fight against the Scourge. The natural properties of the Emerald Dragonshrine to the southeast may be the answer.$B$BAny unliving creature, save those that Sylvanas has redeemed, that steps foot in the dragonshrine falls to dust.$B$BI want to test a theory, and I want you to be my instrument in doing so, young $r. Go to the Emerald Dragonshrine and take the seeds from the emerald lashers therein.
english.progress: And just how many seeds have you managed to acquire thus far?
english.completion: Even now I can feel the pulse of nature from within these seeds. We must put them to good use!
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 创造与毁灭的力量
text.objectives: 龙眠神殿顶层的伊萨里奥斯勋爵要你去杀死一头被削弱的冰霜巨龙、被削弱的图尔基德和被削弱的监工戴瑟盖斯。
text.description: 我们只有三颗种子，必须把它们用在最需要的地方。$B$B你的目标是北面迦拉克隆之墓附近的一只冰霜巨龙，东面腐臭平原的兵营废墟中的卑鄙的图尔基德，以及遥远的东北方的金萨卡拉的监工戴瑟盖斯。$B$B虽然这些种子能完全摧毁一个低级天灾士兵，但对于这三个家伙却只能起到削弱的作用。但这也足够了，因为他们被削弱之后，你就可以自己解决他们了。
text.progress: What were the results? Are they destroyed?$B$BI need answers!
text.completion: Excellent. Just as I suspected all along. I shall have to attempt to contact Ysera and see if she approves. If she can be coaxed from her nightmare, of course. Thank you, $n. You have been indispensable.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: That Which Creates Can Also Destroy
english.objectives: Lord Itharius at the top of Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to destroy a Weakened Reanimated Frost Wyrm, Weakened Turgid the Vile, and Weakened Overseer Deathgaze.
english.description: Since we only have three seeds, we must put them to the best possible use.$B$BYour targets are one of the reanimated frost wyrms circling to the north near Galakrond's Rest, Turgid the Vile in the ruined barracks at the Carrion Fields to the east, and Overseer Deathgaze at Jintha'kalar far to the northeast.$B$BWhile the seeds would outright destroy one of the lesser Scourge, they will greatly weaken these three. Enough so, in fact, that you should be able to handle them on your own.
english.progress: What were the results? Are they destroyed?$B$BI need answers!
english.completion: Excellent. Just as I suspected all along. I shall have to attempt to contact Ysera and see if she approves. If she can be coaxed from her nightmare, of course. Thank you, $n. You have been indispensable.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 前往红玉巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 前往红玉巨龙圣地东面的山脊，向塞雷斯塔兹报到。红玉巨龙圣地就在龙眠神殿以西。
text.description: 红玉巨龙圣地急需增援。$B$B蓝龙和天灾军团令红龙腹背受敌……他们的处境和我们一样糟糕。局势危急，但这是我们与红龙结盟的好机会。$B$B我已经派了一个团的将士前往红玉巨龙圣地，帮助红龙对抗天灾军团。如果你也渴望投身战斗，就去圣地东面的山脊找塞雷斯塔兹，照他的吩咐去做吧。
text.completion: Ambassador Lauriel sent you? If you talk to her again, please let her know that we are very appreciative of her aid. We are fighting battles on far too many fronts.

english.title: Report to the Ruby Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Report to Ceristrasz on the ridge east of the Ruby Dragonshrine, west of Wyrmrest.
english.description: We need you at the Ruby Dragonshrine.$B$BThe dragons are beset on all sides by the blue flight and the scourge... they're in no better a state than we are. The situation seems dire, but this affords us a rare opportunity to establish a valuable alliance.$B$BI secured a regiment to aid the red dragonflight against the Scourge at the Ruby Dragonshrine. If you have a fight in you, please go find Ceristrasz on the ridge east of the shrine and help him in any way that you can.
english.completion: Ambassador Lauriel sent you? If you talk to her again, please let her know that we are very appreciative of her aid. We are fighting battles on far too many fronts.

text.title: 前往红玉巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 前往阿格玛之锤以东的红玉巨龙圣地，向圣地外面山脊上的瓦加斯塔兹报到。
text.description: 你必须立即前往红玉巨龙圣地。这是命令。$B$B龙族已经完全被蓝龙军团和天灾军团压制住了……他们的情况一点儿也不比我们好。这个机会非常难得，可以让我们为祖先的过错赎罪。$B$B我已经派了一个团的将士前往红玉巨龙圣地，帮助红龙对抗天灾军团。去加入他们吧，把天灾军团踩在脚下！$B$B为了部落！
text.completion: Ambassador Golluck sent you? If you talk to him again, please let him know that we are very appreciative of his aid. We are fighting battles on far too many fronts.

english.title: Report to the Ruby Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Report to Vargastrasz on a ridge outside of the Ruby Dragonshrine, just east of Agmar's Hammer.
english.description: You are leaving to the Ruby Dragonshrine. This is not a request.$B$BThe dragons are beset on all sides by the blue flight and the scourge... they're in no better a state than we are. It is not often we are afforded the opportunity to redeem ourselves for the transgressions of our ancestors.$B$BI have secured a regiment to aid the red dragonflight against the Scourge at the Ruby Dragonshrine. Join them and crush the Scourge beneath your boots!$B$BFor the Horde!
english.completion: Ambassador Golluck sent you? If you talk to him again, please let him know that we are very appreciative of his aid. We are fighting battles on far too many fronts.

text.title: 深入陵园
text.objectives: Yord "Calamity" Icebeard at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to kill Necrolord X'avius, Necrolord Horus, and 15 Naxxramas Scourge.$B$B
text.description: 沿着台阶往下走，就是通往被诅咒的地宫的大门：那里聚集着数都数不清的天灾军团士兵，而且他们的数量还在不断增长。我们费尽心思收集到的情报表明，天灾军团的两名通灵领主正在前两座地穴里努力制造新的士兵。在我们攻入塞尔赞所在的核心密室之前，必须除掉这两个家伙和他们手下的天灾军团渣滓。$B$B进入暮冬陵园，杀死通灵领主、纳克萨玛斯恐怖卫士和纳克萨玛斯之影。
text.progress: Did you break yourself off a piece?
text.completion: That oughta buy Ambo a little bit of time to get things situated.
text.completed: Return to Yord "Calamity" Icebeard at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

english.title: Breaking Off A Piece
english.objectives: Yord "Calamity" Icebeard at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to kill Necrolord X'avius, Necrolord Horus, and 15 Naxxramas Scourge.$B$B
english.description: Just down the steps lies the gateway to damnation: Scourge as far as the eye can see and getting thicker with each passing moment. What little intelligence we've been able to gather indicates that two Scourge necrolords are furiously working at emptying the first two crypts down below. Before we can breach the inner chamber to Thel'zan, we'll need to take care of those two clowns and their Naxxramas cronies.$B$BGo down into the mausoleum and take out the necrolords and the Naxxramas dreadguards and shades.
english.progress: Did you break yourself off a piece?
english.completion: That oughta buy Ambo a little bit of time to get things situated.
english.completed: Return to Yord "Calamity" Icebeard at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

text.title: 找到普兰比尔德！
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野暮冬陵园的阿姆博·卡什要你寻找普兰比尔德的下落。
text.description: There's been talk of a tunnel dug by Scourge that connects the embalming chambers of the mausoleum with the large crypts, now unearthed by Thel'zan and his minions. I recently sent my best rogue, Plunderbeard, in search of answers, but have yet to hear back from him. If I were a betting man I'd wager that he's a goner.$B$BI want you to go down those steps and head straight through the embalming chamber and look for Plunderbeard. Dead or alive, he'll have answers.$B$B
text.completion: Entry One: They drag corpses through the tunnel to the embalming room for experimentation. There is an endless supply in this mausoleum. Whatever cannot be reanimated is turned into a bone construct of one kind or another. Entry Two: I fear that this lich, Thel'zan, hides a dark secret. Who is he? Was he once... one of us? Entry Three: I have discovered the location of the lich's phylactery. It is...

english.title: Plunderbeard Must Be Found!
english.objectives: Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to find Plunderbeard.
english.description: There's been talk of a tunnel dug by Scourge that connects the embalming chambers of the mausoleum with the large crypts, now unearthed by Thel'zan and his minions. I recently sent my best rogue, Plunderbeard, in search of answers, but have yet to hear back from him. If I were a betting man I'd wager that he's a goner.$B$BI want you to go down those steps and head straight through the embalming chamber and look for Plunderbeard. Dead or alive, he'll have answers.$B$B
english.completion: Entry One: They drag corpses through the tunnel to the embalming room for experimentation. There is an endless supply in this mausoleum. Whatever cannot be reanimated is turned into a bone construct of one kind or another. Entry Two: I fear that this lich, Thel'zan, hides a dark secret. Who is he? Was he once... one of us? Entry Three: I have discovered the location of the lich's phylactery. It is...

text.title: 我的老对手
text.objectives: 把阿比迪斯将军的徽记交给暮冬要塞的指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者。
text.description: 我的老对手，阿比迪斯将军也来到了诺森德。$B$B她在我们对提尔之手的进攻中逃了出来，带着一小队残兵向北逃窜，在这里的南部建立了新壁炉谷。$B$B虽然他们对付天灾军团也很积极，但阿比迪斯太狡猾了，我们不能让这样的敌人继续活着。相信我，如果我们不干掉她，她的剑会在尘埃落定前架上我们的脖子。$B$B所以我们要干掉他们的首领，然后再做自己的事。把她的徽记给我带来。
text.progress: It is done then?
text.completion: An unfortunate, but necessary action that we had to take in dealing with Abbendis. In another lifetime, I think I could have imagined fighting side-by-side with her. I'm a little concerned about this grand admiral you describe. Barean Westwind you say? I can't believe that he's still alive. He must be ancient. We'll have to deal with him later, however. In the meantime, I think you've earned a reward and a little R & R.
text.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: My Old Enemy
english.objectives: Deliver The High General's Head to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Wintergarde Keep.
english.description: My old enemy, High General Abbendis, has come to Northrend.$B$BSomehow she survived the attacks upon Tyr's Hand and brought a small force north. They've established New Hearthglen to the south.$B$BWhile they could prove useful in fighting the Scourge, Abbendis herself is far too shrewd an opponent to let live. Trust me, if we let them stand, she will be at our throats before the dust settles.$B$BSo, we'll deprive them of their leadership and go about our business. Bring me her head as proof.
english.progress: It is done then?
english.completion: An unfortunate, but necessary action that we had to take in dealing with Abbendis. In another lifetime, I think I could have imagined fighting side-by-side with her. I'm a little concerned about this grand admiral you describe. Barean Westwind you say? I can't believe that he's still alive. He must be ancient. We'll have to deal with him later, however. In the meantime, I think you've earned a reward and a little R & R.
english.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

enders.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

text.title: 普兰比尔德的日记
text.objectives: 将普兰比尔德的日记的第4页、第5页、第6页和第7页交给龙骨荒野暮冬陵园的阿姆博·卡什。
text.description: 看来必须找到日记中缺失的书页。袭击普兰比尔德的家伙或许就躲在隧道另一侧的房间中。一定是他们撕掉了后面的书页！$B$B一旦你找到缺失的书页，就把它们交给暮冬陵园入口处的阿姆博·卡什。
text.progress: I certainly don't feel like a winner...
text.completion: There's some good news and there's some bad news. Which do you want first? Ah hell, why give you a choice? The good news is that if we can get Thel'zan's phylactery, we can destroy him. The bad news is that the phylactery is on a rather large frostwyrm.
text.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

english.title: Plunderbeard's Journal
english.objectives: Recover Page 4 of Plunderbeard's Journal, Page 5 of Plunderbeard's Journal, Page 6 of Plunderbeard's Journal, and Page 7 of Plunderbeard's Journal and return them to Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
english.description: Whatever was written on the remaining pages of Plunderbeard's journal must be recovered. Search the chambers located on the other side of this tunnel for Plunderbeard's assailants. They must be the ones who tore the journal apart!$B$BShould you recover the missing pages, return them to Ambo Cash at the entrance of the Wintergarde Mausoleum.
english.progress: I certainly don't feel like a winner...
english.completion: There's some good news and there's some bad news. Which do you want first? Ah hell, why give you a choice? The good news is that if we can get Thel'zan's phylactery, we can destroy him. The bad news is that the phylactery is on a rather large frostwyrm.
english.completed: Return to Ambo Cash at Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.

text.title: 追击冰雪风暴：第七军团前线
text.objectives: 前往龙骨荒野中部的第七军团前线，向军团司令泰拉里安报到。
text.description: 你必须北上，前往龙骨荒野的第七军团前线。返回暮冬要塞，沿着北边的道路离开要塞。在交叉路口往左转，抵达雪线后继续朝西走，直到你踏上泰坦之路。沿着泰坦之路继续北上就是第七军团前线了。$B$B抵达那里之后，与军团司令泰拉里安谈一谈。他一直盼着你呢。$B$B$N，和你相处很愉快。再见。
text.completion: Now you know why they call this the Dragon Wastes. Bones of the beasts are strewn about as far as the eye can see. We've probably taken down a dozen or more frostwyrms and there's still no end in sight. The Scourge's got fuel for ten-thousand more what with all the bones laying about. I don't mean to bore you with the details, hero. We've got the wyrm you're looking for locked in our sights.

english.title: Chasing Icestorm: The 7th Legion Front
english.objectives: Report to Legion Commander Tyralion at the 7th Legion Front in central Dragonblight.
english.description: You need to get to the 7th Legion Front in northern Dragonblight. Return to Wintergarde Keep and take the north gate out of town. Keep north until you hit a road. Take a left on that road and follow it until you reach the snowline. Once at the snowline keep heading west until you hit the Path of the Titans. Follow that north and it'll lead you right into the 7th Legion Front.$B$BOnce there, speak with Legion Commander Tyralion. He'll be expecting you.$B$BAnd $N - it has been a pleasure. Farewell.
english.completion: Now you know why they call this the Dragon Wastes. Bones of the beasts are strewn about as far as the eye can see. We've probably taken down a dozen or more frostwyrms and there's still no end in sight. The Scourge's got fuel for ten-thousand more what with all the bones laying about. I don't mean to bore you with the details, hero. We've got the wyrm you're looking for locked in our sights.

text.title: 追击冰雪风暴：塞尔赞的护命匣
text.objectives: Recover Thel'zan's Phylactery from Icestorm and return it to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.$B$B
text.description: Your frostwyrm is out there.$B$B<Tyralion points west.>$B$BAnd it's a big one!$B$BWhen you're ready to fight, go speak with "Wyrmbait." He'll "fetch" her. Once Icestorm is close enough we'll chain her to the ground and finish her off! Hopefully, with your help, we'll be able to take her down and get you that phylactery.$B$BOnce you've got the phylactery, return to Wintergarde Keep and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He's been making preparations for the final showdown with Thel'zan.
text.progress: Have you recovered Thel'zan's phylactery?
text.completion: We've lost so many good soldiers to that monster, Thel'zan. I wish I could be there to see you crush his phylactery in front of him and end his existence.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: Chasing Icestorm: Thel'zan's Phylactery
english.objectives: Recover Thel'zan's Phylactery from Icestorm and return it to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.$B$B
english.description: Your frostwyrm is out there.$B$B<Tyralion points west.>$B$BAnd it's a big one!$B$BWhen you're ready to fight, go speak with "Wyrmbait." He'll "fetch" her. Once Icestorm is close enough we'll chain her to the ground and finish her off! Hopefully, with your help, we'll be able to take her down and get you that phylactery.$B$BOnce you've got the phylactery, return to Wintergarde Keep and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He's been making preparations for the final showdown with Thel'zan.
english.progress: Have you recovered Thel'zan's phylactery?
english.completion: We've lost so many good soldiers to that monster, Thel'zan. I wish I could be there to see you crush his phylactery in front of him and end his existence.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 征服者的指派
text.objectives: 与征服堡的纳兹戈林中士谈一谈。
text.description: 部落就是一部宏伟的战争机器，而你只是其中的一颗小齿轮。$B$B我在确保着这部机器有足够的燃料供应。如果我失败了，那么机器就会发生故障。$B$B木材，矿石，水……我们需要这里的一切。当然联盟也一样。$B$B在我们能够对抗这些人类垃圾之前，必须得巩固我们对西部区域的控制。$B$B去跟纳兹戈林中士谈谈消灭沃德伦的维库人的事情，然后——如果你能成功完成任务的话——我们会指派更多的任务给你。
text.completion: So Krenna sent you to me?  She must've not liked you very much, but then again who does she like? Cracking this vrykul outpost is going to be a tough, tough job.

english.title: The Conqueror's Task
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Nazgrim in Conquest Hold.
english.description: The Horde is a magnificent war machine and you are nothing but a cog.$B$BI am in charge of securing fuel for this machine.  If I fail, the machine fails.$B$BLumber, ore, water... it's all here and we want it.  And so does the Alliance.$B$BBefore we can move against the human scum, we need to solidify our control over the western region.$B$BSpeak to Sergeant Nazgrim about eradicating the vrykul in Voldrune and then maybe - if you turn out to not be a complete failure - we'll send you on further tasks.
english.completion: So Krenna sent you to me?  She must've not liked you very much, but then again who does she like? Cracking this vrykul outpost is going to be a tough, tough job.

text.title: 退件
text.objectives: 沿着山脊向东面走，将炸药包交给龙骨荒野北部诺兹拉斯哨站的辛克。
text.description: 经过进一步的调查，那个地精似乎是想要穿越荒地，把一大堆炸药运过去。半埋在附近雪地里的鹰身人羽毛让我们可以猜想他遇到了怎样的悲惨命运。$B$B那地精应该是从东面的某个地方出发，把炸药运向天谴之门。最谨慎的做法就是沿着山脊回到东面，向寄件人通报他们的送货员的遭遇。
text.progress: Hello there!
text.completion: Hah! We lost another one, eh? Those harpies are becoming a real nuisance. No matter! There's work to be done. Lend a hand around here, will ya?
text.completed: Return to Xink at Coldwind Heights in Dragonblight.

english.title: Return to Sender
english.objectives: Follow the ridge to the east and deliver the pack of explosives to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in northern Dragonblight.
english.description: Upon closer examination, the goblin appears to have been running a pack full of explosives across the wastes for delivery. The harpy feathers half-buried in the snow nearby suggest how he met his ill fate.$B$BIt appears that the goblin was bringing the explosives towards the Wrath Gate from somewhere to the east. It seems most prudent to follow the ridge back to the east and inform the sender of their runner's fate.
english.progress: Hello there!
english.completion: Hah! We lost another one, eh? Those harpies are becoming a real nuisance. No matter! There's work to be done. Lend a hand around here, will ya?
english.completed: Return to Xink at Coldwind Heights in Dragonblight.

text.title: 永恒之龙的秘密
text.objectives: 克罗米要你进入青铜巨龙圣地，将永恒沙漏放在地上。$B$B保护沙漏，直到你获得克罗米想要的情报。完成任务后返回龙眠神殿顶层向她复命。
text.description: 东北方的青铜巨龙圣地周围的时间风暴会阻止任何永生者进入其中。$B$B永恒之龙正在里面和守卫战斗，试图夺取巨龙圣地的控制权。我们必须利用这个机会获取一些情报。$B$B你不是永生者，因此你可以进入巨龙圣地并使用永恒沙漏。你要保护好这个沙漏，直到永恒之龙的首领显身。$B$B你要小心，永恒之龙会试图阻止你！
text.progress: What news do you bring? What happened at the Bronze Dragonshrine?$B$BDid you find out who the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight is?
text.completion: You saw Nozdormu? That doesn't make any sense. Actually, that's great news! We had no idea of where or when the Lord of Time had gone to. We just knew that he had disappeared to deal with very important matters. So, even though the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight wasn't revealed, you've discovered that Nozdormu is alive and well, and fighting back against them! Thank you, $n. I'll be seeing you soon!
text.completed: Return to Chromie at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: Mystery of the Infinite
english.objectives: Chromie, at the top of Wyrmrest Temple, has asked you to travel to the Bronze Dragonshrine. Once inside, place the Hourglass of Eternity on the ground.$B$BProtect the hourglass for as long as it lasts and then return to her with whatever information you gain.
english.description: A time storm at the Bronze Dragonshrine to the northeast is keeping immortals from entering.$B$BThe Infinite Dragonflight are in a fight inside with the defenders to wrest control of the dragonshrine. We must take this opportunity to gain information.$B$BYou are not immortal. You can cross into the dragonshrine and use the Hourglass of Eternity. Protect the hourglass for long enough and the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight should be revealed.$B$BBe warned, the Infinite Dragonflight will try to stop you!
english.progress: What news do you bring? What happened at the Bronze Dragonshrine?$B$BDid you find out who the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight is?
english.completion: You saw Nozdormu? That doesn't make any sense. Actually, that's great news! We had no idea of where or when the Lord of Time had gone to. We just knew that he had disappeared to deal with very important matters. So, even though the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight wasn't revealed, you've discovered that Nozdormu is alive and well, and fighting back against them! Thank you, $n. I'll be seeing you soon!
english.completed: Return to Chromie at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 残忍的克瓦迪尔
text.objectives: 将海象人囚犯的情况告诉卡鲁克。
text.description: $N，谢谢你救了我。这帮克瓦迪尔的禽兽！$B$B他们强迫我们与其他囚犯角斗，并以此为乐。还不如将我们一刀捅死算了！$B$B年轻的卡鲁克还活着，我见过他。请转告他，他的父亲战斗到了生命的最后一刻。
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  You've shown a great deal of goodwill towards my clan.

english.title: Cruelty of the Kvaldir
english.objectives: Speak to Karuk about the Captured Tuskarr Prisoner.
english.description: I thank you for saving me, $N.  The kvaldir are animals!$B$BThey made us fight the other prisoners.  It would've been more merciful to just kill us all.$B$BThe youngling Karuk is still alive -- I noticed him arrive here.  Tell him his father fought until the end.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  You've shown a great deal of goodwill towards my clan.

text.title: 终结
text.objectives: 带着塞尔赞的护命匣前往龙骨荒野的暮冬陵园，向军团司令尤瑞克报到。
text.description: 非常感谢你的义举，弗塔根大人已经下令对塞尔赞发动全面攻击了。第七军团已经开进了陵园的召唤大厅，现在正驻扎在一条仿佛通往地狱的走廊外。现在就缺你一个了。$B$B带着这只护命匣去暮冬陵园那里，向军团司令尤瑞克报到吧。$B$B要塞外面有一条天灾军团挖出的隧道，你可以从那里抄近路。现在就去，$N！带领我们走向胜利吧！
text.progress: We thought you might not show up, $n.
text.completion: When you're ready I'll place the phylactery out in front of the gateway and call forth Thel'zan.
text.completed: Return to Legion Commander Yorik at The Carrion Fields in Dragonblight.

english.title: Finality
english.objectives: Take Thel'zan's Phylactery to Legion Commander Yorik inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
english.description: Thanks to your heroics, Lord Fordragon has given the command to launch a full assault against Thel'zan. 7th Legion have made their way into the summoning chamber of the mausoleum and located what appears to be a gateway to hell. The only piece that's missing now is you.$B$BTake the phylactery and report to Legion Commander Yorik inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum.$B$BThere is a tunnel that the Scourge dug out just outside the keep that you can take to get to Yorik quickly. Go now, $N! Lead us to victory!
english.progress: We thought you might not show up, $n.
english.completion: When you're ready I'll place the phylactery out in front of the gateway and call forth Thel'zan.
english.completed: Return to Legion Commander Yorik at The Carrion Fields in Dragonblight.

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 结束和开始
text.objectives: 击败塞尔赞，然后前往龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，向高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩报告。
text.description: 无论多精彩的故事都会有开头和结尾，$N。虽然你的故事还远没有结束，但我敢打赌它一定会成为伟大的传说！当这里的一切都结束后，无论我们的结局怎样，你为暮冬城所做的一切必将被人们代代相传。$B$B现在，朋友，如果你准备好了，我就要用护命匣引诱塞尔赞出来了。$B$B如果我们能够获得胜利，就去暮冬要塞向高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩报捷吧。
text.completion: Wintergarde is saved because of you, $n. To think that one man could so swiftly turn the tides of battle is hard for most to comprehend; yet here we are - victorious! You have managed to restore the faith of these people and earned the respect of your commanding officers. Lord Fordragon has returned to Angrathar to prepare our forces for the destruction of the Wrathgate and has requested that you join him! I couldn't recommend a better soldier for the job, $n.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: An End And A Beginning
english.objectives: Defeat Thel'zan the Duskbringer and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
english.description: Every good story has a beginning and an ending, $N. While your story is far from over, I'll be damned if it's not already turning out to be the stuff of legend! No matter what happens to us when this is all over, what you've done at Wintergarde will be a tale told for years to come.$B$BNow, ally, when you are ready I will use the phylactery to coax Thel'zan out of hiding.$B$BShould we somehow succeed, report the victory to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.
english.completion: Wintergarde is saved because of you, $n. To think that one man could so swiftly turn the tides of battle is hard for most to comprehend; yet here we are - victorious! You have managed to restore the faith of these people and earned the respect of your commanding officers. Lord Fordragon has returned to Angrathar to prepare our forces for the destruction of the Wrathgate and has requested that you join him! I couldn't recommend a better soldier for the job, $n.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 前往弗塔根要塞！
text.objectives: Venture to Fordragon Hold in Dragonblight and speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.$B$B
text.description: 随着纳克萨玛斯战争机器的哑火，现在你要去天谴之门安加萨援助我们的部队。我们的指挥部——弗塔根要塞就坐落在龙骨荒野北部的群山环抱之中。弗塔根大人正在那里等着你！立刻就动身吧，$N！$B$B从镇子的北门出去，向西北方向进发。$B$B圣光与你同在！
text.completion: This commendation is only given to those who have gone above and beyond the call of duty in the name of the Alliance. I could count the number of times I've handed this one out on one hand, $n, and never has anyone been more deserving than you! Congratulations! Now, let us look upon the Wrathgate. Does it look familiar? It should. That strange ore you found at the Wintergarde Mine is exactly what the Wrathgate is made from. We will find its weakness and expose it for all to see! First, though...

english.title: To Fordragon Hold!
english.objectives: Venture to Fordragon Hold in Dragonblight and speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.$B$B
english.description: With the Naxxramas war machine stopped dead in its tracks the time has come for you to help our forces at Angrathar, the Wrathgate. Nestled against the mountain in northern Dragonblight is our base of operations, Fordragon Hold. It is there that Lord Fordragon awaits your arrival! Go now, $N!$B$BTake the north gate out of town and travel north by northwest until you arrive at your destination.$B$BLight protect you!
english.completion: This commendation is only given to those who have gone above and beyond the call of duty in the name of the Alliance. I could count the number of times I've handed this one out on one hand, $n, and never has anyone been more deserving than you! Congratulations! Now, let us look upon the Wrathgate. Does it look familiar? It should. That strange ore you found at the Wintergarde Mine is exactly what the Wrathgate is made from. We will find its weakness and expose it for all to see! First, though...

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 隐藏的秘密
text.objectives: 暮冬要塞的幻象师瑟里格要你去找到先锋军地图。
text.description: 自从在遗忘海岸叛变之后，阿尔萨斯王子就开始寻找霜之哀伤，而穆拉丁一直陪着他。藏有霜之哀伤的洞穴会不会就在附近呢？它隐藏着怎样的秘密呢？虽然水晶球不能给我答案，但它确实告诉了我一些信息。$B$B在暮冬要塞的东北方有一座血色先锋军的堡垒，那里面的某处收藏着一份地图。水晶球告诉我，这份地图会给我们提供很大的帮助。$B$B去把它拿来！
text.progress: Have you recovered the Onslaught map?
text.completion: A cave? Could it be? There can be no other correlation!
text.completed: 回到龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，向幻象师瑟里格复命。

english.title: What Secrets Men Hide
english.objectives: Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to find the Onslaught Map and return it to him.
english.description: After the betrayal at the Forgotten Shore, Prince Arthas - with Muradin in tow - began his quest for Frostmourne. Could the location of the cavern where Frostmourne was found be near? What secrets could it hold? While the orb has no answers for these questions, it does show me something.$B$BTo the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is an outpost built by the Scarlet Onslaught. Somewhere within that outpost is a map. The orb tells me that this map will be of great use to us.$B$BRetrieve it!
english.progress: Have you recovered the Onslaught map?
english.completion: A cave? Could it be? There can be no other correlation!
english.completed: Return to Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

text.title: 血色十字军归来？
text.objectives: 暮冬要塞的指挥官莱诺尔·风矛要你前往先锋军营地，消灭20个血色先锋军成员。
text.description: To the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is a newly built encampment, set up by the Scarlet Crusade - or rather - the Scarlet Onslaught as they now call themselves. While we are unsure as to why they are in Northrend, they are certainly no less dangerous than they were before. As of last night the Scarlet Onslaught has killed twelve of our soldiers. They must be taught a lesson, $N.$B$BGo to Onslaught Base Camp and thin them out. $B$B
text.progress: Clear out the Onslaught Base Camp, $N.
text.completion: Hopefully the message is now clear to the Onslaught. I hope it was enough of a beating to make them doubt their affiliations.
text.completed: Return to Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Return of the Crusade?
english.objectives: Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to kill 20 Scarlet Onslaught at the Onslaught Base Camp.
english.description: To the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is a newly built encampment, set up by the Scarlet Crusade - or rather - the Scarlet Onslaught as they now call themselves. While we are unsure as to why they are in Northrend, they are certainly no less dangerous than they were before. As of last night the Scarlet Onslaught has killed twelve of our soldiers. They must be taught a lesson, $N.$B$BGo to Onslaught Base Camp and thin them out. $B$B
english.progress: Clear out the Onslaught Base Camp, $N.
english.completion: Hopefully the message is now clear to the Onslaught. I hope it was enough of a beating to make them doubt their affiliations.
english.completed: Return to Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

text.title: 救赎之路
text.objectives: 将《救赎之路》带回龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，交给高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩。
text.description: 你听说过《救赎之路》吗？据说这本日记中记载了阿比迪斯将军的预言。它提到了血色十字军的狂热动机和目的——还有许多其它胡扯的内容。$B$B你现在就到暮冬要塞东北方的先锋军营地去，从他们的士兵身上拿一本《救赎之路》回来。
text.progress: Did you find a copy?
text.completion: Abbendis has gone off the deep end. The Light speaks to her now? Despite the inane ramblings, this journal gives us a never before seen look into the mind of the Scarlet zealots. This was a great find, $n. Lord Fordragon will be pleased.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Path of Redemption
english.objectives: Return "The Path of Redemption" to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
english.description: "The Path of Redemption," ever heard of it? It is allegedly a journal that holds the prophetic ramblings of High General Abbendis of the Scarlet Onslaught. Within that book can be found the motivations and goals of the Scarlet zealots - not to mention a whole lot of insanity.$B$BVenture to Onslaught Base Camp, northeast of Wintergarde Keep, and recover a copy of "The Path of Redemption" from one of the Onslaught soldiers.
english.progress: Did you find a copy?
english.completion: Abbendis has gone off the deep end. The Light speaks to her now? Despite the inane ramblings, this journal gives us a never before seen look into the mind of the Scarlet zealots. This was a great find, $n. Lord Fordragon will be pleased.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

starters.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

enders.name: 高级指挥官哈尔弗·维姆班恩

text.title: 霜之哀伤洞穴
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野暮冬要塞的幻象师瑟里格要你在霜之哀伤洞穴深处使用瑟里格的占卜宝珠，解开尘封的秘密！
text.description: 他们把这处山洞称为霜之哀伤洞穴。我们还不知道为什么血色先锋军会对此感兴趣，但据我们所知，该地区周围都有重兵把守。无论如何，我们必须勇往直前！$B$B带着这颗水晶球从镇子北方出去，然后前往西北方的血色哨站。你要进入洞穴并一直杀到最深处去。到那里以后，使用水晶球，然后回来把你的发现都告诉我。
text.progress: Have you searched Frostmourne Cavern?
text.completion: Muradin lives? Could it be? I must notify King Bronzebeard at once! I need to consult the orb. There must be more information - somewhere!
text.completed: 回到龙骨荒野的暮冬要塞，向幻象师瑟里格复命。

english.title: Frostmourne Cavern
english.objectives: Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to use Zelig's Scrying Orb at the bottom of Frostmourne Cavern. Unlock the secrets of the past!
english.description: They have labeled the cave as Frostmourne Cavern. Why the Scarlet Onslaught is interested in such things is unknown, but by the look of things, the area surrounding the cave is heavily guarded. Nonetheless, we must proceed!$B$BTake this scrying orb and travel north out of town and then northwest towards Scarlet Point. Make your way into the cave and battle your way to the bottom. Once there, use the orb. Return here with what you discover.
english.progress: Have you searched Frostmourne Cavern?
english.completion: Muradin lives? Could it be? I must notify King Bronzebeard at once! I need to consult the orb. There must be more information - somewhere!
english.completed: Return to Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.

text.title: Onwards to Northrend!
text.objectives: Speak to the Alliance Recruiter inside Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra or the one at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
text.description: 欢迎来到巫妖王之友和家人的愤怒阿尔法。使用我旁边的门户开始你的旅程，进入诺森德$B$B你可以选择向盟军招募人员报告在北风苔原的勇气保存区，或者你可以去瓦雷德在嚎叫

english.title: Onwards to Northrend!
english.objectives: Speak to the Alliance Recruiter inside Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra or the one at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
english.description: Welcome to the Wrath of the Lich King Friends and Family Alpha.  Use the portals next to me to begin your journey into Northrend.$B$BYou can choose to report to the Alliance recruiter in Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra or you can go to Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Onwards to Northrend!
text.objectives: Speak to the Horde Recruiter inside Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra or Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
text.description: 欢迎来到巫妖王之友和家人的愤怒阿尔法。使用我旁边的门户开始你的诺森德之旅。$B$B你可以选择向北风苔原的战歌召唤部落招募者报告，或者你可以去“复仇登陆

english.title: Onwards to Northrend!
english.objectives: Speak to the Horde Recruiter inside Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra or Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
english.description: Welcome to the Wrath of the Lich King Friends and Family Alpha.  Use the portals next to me to begin your journey into Northrend.$B$BYou can choose to report to the Horde recruiter in Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra or you can go to Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Adding Injury to Insult
text.objectives: Read the Vrykul Insult to Bjorn Halgurdsson in Baleheim, then lead him back to Lydell's Ambush and help slay him.
text.description: The vrykul are being clever about this.  Fortunately I've a trick up my sleeve.$B$BThis leader of theirs, Bjorn, is a real hothead.  We've pieced together enough of their language to fashion what we think is a good insult.  Something involving his mother and large barnyard animals... we're not quite sure.$B$BTake this piece of paper and read it to him.  Once he starts chasing you, lure him back here.  We'll make sure he doesn't make it out alive.
text.progress: Assassination work isn't as glamorous as it's made out to be.
text.completion: Nice work.  That poor sap never saw it coming.
text.completed: Return to Lydell at Lydell's Ambush in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Adding Injury to Insult
english.objectives: Read the Vrykul Insult to Bjorn Halgurdsson in Baleheim, then lead him back to Lydell's Ambush and help slay him.
english.description: The vrykul are being clever about this.  Fortunately I've a trick up my sleeve.$B$BThis leader of theirs, Bjorn, is a real hothead.  We've pieced together enough of their language to fashion what we think is a good insult.  Something involving his mother and large barnyard animals... we're not quite sure.$B$BTake this piece of paper and read it to him.  Once he starts chasing you, lure him back here.  We'll make sure he doesn't make it out alive.
english.progress: Assassination work isn't as glamorous as it's made out to be.
english.completion: Nice work.  That poor sap never saw it coming.
english.completed: Return to Lydell at Lydell's Ambush in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 进攻尼弗莱瓦
text.objectives: 游侠队长艾蕾尔要你前往尼弗莱瓦，杀死5名掠龙战士、4名掠龙符文法师和4条掠龙猎犬。
text.description: 我们迫切希望复仇港派来增援，帮助我们对抗尼弗莱瓦。如果我们能够尽早夺得那里的控制权，就能在与联盟的对抗中取得巨大的优势。$B$B去尼弗莱瓦看看你能做点什么吧。
text.progress: Hail, $N.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  When our forces from Vengeance Landing arrive, we'll be able to take care of any vrykul that are left.
text.completed: Return to Ranger Captain Areiel at Ghostblade Post in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Against Nifflevar
english.objectives: Ranger Captain Areiel wants you to go to Nifflevar and slay 5 Dragonflayer Warriors, 4 Dragonflayer Rune-Seers and 4 Dragonflayer Hunting Hounds.
english.description: We await reinforcements from Vengeance Landing to move against Nifflevar.  If we were to capture it earlier, though, it would provide us with a great advantage over the Alliance.$B$BHead into town and see if you can put a dent in their numbers.
english.progress: Hail, $N.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  When our forces from Vengeance Landing arrive, we'll be able to take care of any vrykul that are left.
english.completed: Return to Ranger Captain Areiel at Ghostblade Post in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 蘑菇汤！
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的普雷蒙要你在达克辛废墟中收集5份幽光雪菇和5份冰蛇之眼，再到塞布哈拉克去收集5份甜根茎。
text.description: 你瞧，既然你已经到了这里，不如帮老普雷蒙一个小忙怎么样？我有一个朋友，会煮一种非常好吃的菜——你从来没尝过的美味！$B$B这附近有他需要的食材，就在西南边的废墟和北边的营地里。$B$B你觉得怎么样，伙计？
text.progress: You get those ingredients for 'ol Prigmon, $n?
text.completion: Oh, mon - shimmercap stew! I can almost taste it already....
text.completed: Return to Prigmon at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Shimmercap Stew
english.objectives: Prigmon in Granite Springs wants you to collect 5 Shimmering Snowcaps and 5 Ice Serpent Eyes from Drak'Zin Ruins and 5 Sweetroot from Zeb'Halak.
english.description: Say, while yer here, how bout ya help ol' Prigmon with a little chore? I got a friend who can make a mean stew - one like ya never tasted before!$b$bThere be a few ingredients found in these parts that he be needin'. They be in ruins to the southwest and the camp just north o' here.$b$bWhatd'ya say, mon?
english.progress: You get those ingredients for 'ol Prigmon, $n?
english.completion: Oh, mon - shimmercap stew! I can almost taste it already....
english.completed: Return to Prigmon at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: 清理天灾
text.objectives: 岩石之泉的普雷蒙要你把一具僵化的巨魔尸体拖到马克·菲尔森那里，并把它用高温处理掉。
text.description: 呃。$B$B要把这些可怜的巨魔清理掉让我很心疼，但不如我的背疼！$B$B帮老普雷蒙一个忙，把这拖到马克那里去。$B$B如果我们不把它们清理掉，它们很快又会变得活蹦乱跳了。
text.progress: Whatcha got there, $r?
text.completion: Nothin' better than watchin' them shcourge burn... . Wrote a little shong about it. Wanna hear it? Here goes....
text.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

english.title: Scourgekabob
english.objectives: Prigmon at Granite Springs wants you to bring a Mummified Troll Carcass to Mack Fearsen and place it in the fire.
english.description: Ugh.$b$bWrappin' up these unfortunate trolls be makin' my heart ache, but not so much as my back!$b$bHelp ol' Prigmon out and haul one of these carcasses over to Mack.$b$bIf we don't burn 'em they be walkin' again in no time.
english.progress: Whatcha got there, $r?
english.completion: Nothin' better than watchin' them shcourge burn... . Wrote a little shong about it. Wanna hear it? Here goes....
english.completed: Return to Mack Fearsen at Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

text.title: Howling Fjord: aa - A - LK FLAG

english.title: Howling Fjord: aa - A - LK FLAG

text.title: 立即前往博古洛克前哨站！
text.objectives: 与博古洛克前哨站的灵语者斯纳尔芬谈一谈。
text.description: 你感觉到了吗？$B$B<萨乌拉诺克突然开始胡乱地在自己的胸口上乱抓，直到抓出了一道道血痕。>$B$B我刚感觉到……在我的老朋友格雷姆沃克身上发生了一些可怕的事情。$B$B他的一个学生与他一起前往北方，去帮助酋长在索拉查盆地的边缘建立前哨站。$B$B她名叫斯纳尔芬，是个灵语者。$B$B或许她知道发生了些什么事情，至少她能帮你找出原因。
text.completion: The mystic knows? You say he felt that something horrible happened to Farseer Grimwalker? It is as I feared!

english.title: To Bor'gorok Outpost, Quickly!
english.objectives: Speak with Spirit Talker Snarlfang at Bor'gorok Outpost.
english.description: Did you feel it?$B$B<Sauranok momentarily clutches his chest in confusion. His hand comes away trailing red-hot steam.>$B$BSomething terrible has happened to my old friend, Farseer Grimwalker. I just sensed it.$B$BHe had a pupil that he took with him when he went north. They were going to help the overlord establish an outpost on the edge of Sholazar Basin.$B$BHer name is Snarlfang. She is a spirit talker.$B$BPerhaps she will know what happened. Or, at least, she can help you to find out.
english.completion: The mystic knows? You say he felt that something horrible happened to Farseer Grimwalker? It is as I feared!

text.title: 前往征服堡，自求多福吧！
text.objectives: 前往灰熊丘陵的征服堡，向征服者克雷娜介绍你自己。
text.description: 我收到了一封来自灰熊丘陵的寻求帮助的信，所以我决定派你去见见征服者克雷娜。$B$B<高级执行官挥舞着一捆羊皮纸，似乎他并不在乎上面写了些什么。>$B$B她正试图保护所有天然资源之类的东西。不过在她周围的时候要小心点，据说即使是对待兽人，她也是毫不客气。$B$B沿着这条路向东走，然后转向东南。跨过龙脊河上的桥之后，从常青商栈往东走就到了。
text.completion: Who are you? Tell me why I shouldn't split you in two where you stand!

english.title: To Conquest Hold, But Be Careful!
english.objectives: Present yourself to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.
english.description: I've received a request for help from our base in the Grizzly Hills. I'm sending you to see Conqueror Krenna.$B$B<The high executor waves a sheaf of parchment in the air as if he could care less what is written on it.>$B$BShe's attempting to secure all of the natural resources or somesuch. Just watch your back around her. The word is that she's aggressive even for an orc.$B$BFollow the road east and then southeast. Cross the bridge at the Dragonspine Tributary and go east from the Evergreen Trading Post.
english.completion: Who are you? Tell me why I shouldn't split you in two where you stand!

text.title: 高级执行官需要你
text.objectives: 与龙骨荒野怨毒镇的高级执行官乌洛斯谈一谈。
text.description: 幸运的是，在这封请求信交到阿格玛大王手上之前，我从高级执行官乌洛斯这里把它截获了下来。乌洛斯在想什么？$B$B<中士把他手里的信件撕得粉碎。>$B$B$C，去看看高级执行官需要些什么。$B$B沿着这条路往东，穿过巨龙废土。你可以在东南边找到一条走出荒地的道路，亡灵城镇怨毒镇就矗立在山脉的南面。
text.completion: You were sent from Agmar's Hammer? It's about time! No, the help is not for me. I simply have no one else to spare, but you'll do.

english.title: The High Executor Needs You
english.objectives: Speak with High Executor Wroth at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
english.description: It's a good thing that I intercepted this request from High Executor Wroth before it got to Overlord Agmar. What is Wroth thinking?$B$B<The sergeant rips up the letter that he's holding.>$B$B$C, go see what it is that the high executor wants.$B$BFollow the road east and pass through The Dragon Wastes. You'll find a path leading up out of the wastes on the southeast side, and the Forsaken town, Venomspite, will stand before you on the south side of the mountain.
english.completion: You were sent from Agmar's Hammer? It's about time! No, the help is not for me. I simply have no one else to spare, but you'll do.

text.title: 欢迎来到索拉查盆地
text.objectives: 沿着西北方的道路前往蒙特提到的营地。
text.description: 那么，你是从哪儿来的？该不会是那些白痴大法师把你派到这里来的吧？$B$B听我说，$G小子:小丫头;，你现在还没缺胳膊少腿的可真是个奇迹，绝对的奇迹！$B$B这片丛林是块非常非常危险的地方，特别是在风险投资公司掺和进来以后。$B$B不如你去见见我们老大吧，他会安排你的工作的。营地就在西北边道路的尽头。$B$B还不快去！
text.completion: Hah! It's not often you run into a complete stranger in the middle of the jungle. You one those druid lackeys sent to "stop me and my evil ways?" Yeah, good luck with that one! Didn't think so! You're more than welcome to join us in the hunt, soon as we've dealt with those Venture Company dogs. There'll be plenty to go around.

english.title: Welcome to Sholazar Basin
english.objectives: Follow the path to the northwest to reach the camp that Monte mentioned.
english.description: So, where did you come from? I don't suppose that fool of an archmage sent you, too?$B$BYou're lucky to be in one piece, $g laddie:lass;! They nearly blew you up!$B$BThe jungle here's a darned dangerous place, 'specially with the Venture Company about.$B$B Git you! Go see the boss... he'll sort you out. The camp's at the end of that path to the northwest.$B$BNow, git!
english.completion: Hah! It's not often you run into a complete stranger in the middle of the jungle. You one those druid lackeys sent to "stop me and my evil ways?" Yeah, good luck with that one! Didn't think so! You're more than welcome to join us in the hunt, soon as we've dealt with those Venture Company dogs. There'll be plenty to go around.

text.title: 维赫亚的复仇
text.objectives: 蛇鳞神殿的维赫亚希望你去消灭6个斯卡迪尔水手、3个斯卡迪尔织雾者和2个斯卡迪尔符文法师。
text.description: $R，看样子我们有一个共同的敌人了！我的同胞被这群克瓦迪尔混账杀光了……我的城市也被完全摧毁了。我要向他们复仇！$B$B作为我帮你的条件，我希望你去消灭那些玷污裂鞭海岸的野蛮怪物。我会好好奖励你的，$C。
text.completed: Return to Veehja at the Shrine of Scales in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Veehja's Revenge
english.objectives: Veehja at the Shrine of Scales wants you to slay 6 Skadir Mariners, 3 Skadir Mistweavers and 2 Skadir Runecasters.
english.description: We share a common enemy today, $r!  My people have been wiped out by these Kvaldir... my city has been all but destroyed.  It is time for exacting revenge!$B$BIn return for my help, I'd like you to slay the barbaric monsters that defile Riplash.  You will be well rewarded, $c.
english.completed: Return to Veehja at the Shrine of Scales in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 科林的烈酒
text.objectives: 将科林的烈酒交给铁炉堡附近美酒节营地的埃菲库格·铁桶。
text.description: 断气的科林·烈酒手中还紧紧抓着一只小酒桶。这大概就是他所酿造的臭名昭著的烈酒吧！
text.progress: $n, your face has a grim set to it.  Do you have dire news?
text.completion: This is the Coren Direbrew's drink?  The brew he wanted more than anything to submit at Brewfest?  Well, officially we can't recognize this submission, but out of respect for a fallen brewer, perhaps I'll have a taste...
text.completed: Return to Ipfelkofer Ironkeg in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Direbrew's Dire Brew
english.objectives: Give Direbrew's Dire Brew to Ipfelkofer Ironkeg at the Brewfest camp near Ironforge.
english.description: Coren Direbrew's corpse clutched this small cask tightly to its gut.  This must be his infamous Dire Brew!
english.progress: $n, your face has a grim set to it.  Do you have dire news?
english.completion: This is the Coren Direbrew's drink?  The brew he wanted more than anything to submit at Brewfest?  Well, officially we can't recognize this submission, but out of respect for a fallen brewer, perhaps I'll have a taste...
english.completed: Return to Ipfelkofer Ironkeg in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 科林的烈酒
text.objectives: 将科林的烈酒交给奥格瑞玛附近美酒节营地的塔波尔·斯威雷格。
text.description: 断气的科林·烈酒手中还紧紧抓着一只小酒桶。这大概就是他所酿造的臭名昭著的烈酒吧！

text.title: 红龙女王的指引
text.objectives: 在龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿寻找阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者。
text.description: 我们对安加萨的进攻让天灾军团乱了阵脚，但仍然没有露出什么破绽。他们派出了冰霜巨龙向我们狂轰滥炸，使得我们在天谴之门无法再前进半步。我们必须阻止冰霜巨龙的攻击，不过在我们解决这些古代巨龙的骨架之前，必须获得他们女王的许可。$B$B去东南方的龙眠神殿寻找阿莱克丝塔萨女王。告诉她我们必须这么做，并寻求她的指引。$B$B去吧，$N！
text.completion: You have come seeking my council, mortal. This I know, but do you know what it is that you face? North of here are the dying grounds of Galakrond - progenitor of dragonkind. It is from Galakrond that the Titans created the Aspects. Imagine, then, the power of Galakrond. His size alone was greater than all of the Aspects combined! Now attempt to understand what the Scourge do in the Great Dragonblight. Frost wyrms, mortal, should be the least of your concerns.

english.title: Audience With The Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Seek out Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
english.description: Our assault against Angrathar has staggered the Scourge, but they remain unrelenting. From overhead they send their frost wyrms to strafe the field of battle, making an advance upon the gate itself impossible. The frost wyrm attacks must be stopped, but before we defile the bones of ancient dragons, we must gain permission from their queen.$B$BTravel southeast to Wyrmrest Temple and seek out Queen Alexstrasza. Tell her what we must do and ask her for guidance.$B$BGo now, $N!

text.description: Though I know you hunger to destroy the Scourge that stand before us at the Wrath Gate, we must first deal with the threat that looms overhead. Until the strafing assaults of the frost wyrms are halted, we cannot move forward.$B$BBut before we assault the dying grounds of dragons, we must first be granted permission. Venture now to the hallowed halls of dragonkind: Wyrmrest Temple. Once there, seek out Queen Alexstrasza.$B$BRide now, $N! Southeast, to Wyrmrest!

text.title: 迦拉克隆与天灾军团
text.objectives: 与龙骨荒野龙眠神殿的托拉斯塔萨谈一谈。
text.description: 在邪恶之旋的顶端，天灾军团的通灵主宰安提沃克正坐在经他改造过的风暴巨人之王——西亚斯的肩膀上，指挥着亡灵日以继夜地挖掘迦拉克隆的巨大骨架。如果他们成功地复活了迦拉克隆，你们所有的努力都将化为乌有。$B$B虽然我不能调动红龙的全部力量来帮助你，但我会将我的祝福赐予你。出发吧，去和我的总管托拉斯塔萨谈谈。
text.completion: The bravery of mortals never fails to astound me. Death affixes its cold stare upon you and in return you rise to challenge its assertion! It is why your kind is so loved... and so hated. Even though the Red Dragonflight is entrenched in a war with Malygos, there is something that we can do to help.

english.title: Galakrond and the Scourge
english.objectives: Speak with Torastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
english.description: Atop the Wicked Coil, the Grand Necrolord of the Scourge, Antiok, sits upon the shoulders of the reconstructed storm giant lord, Thiassi. From there he commands the armies of undead to work day and night to unearth Galakrond's massive bones. Should they succeed in raising Galakrond, all of your efforts will have been for naught.$B$BWhile I cannot call down the full fury of the Red Dragonflight to assist you in your journey, I will grant you my blessing. Go now and speak with my majordomo, Torastrasza.
english.completion: The bravery of mortals never fails to astound me. Death affixes its cold stare upon you and in return you rise to challenge its assertion! It is why your kind is so loved... and so hated. Even though the Red Dragonflight is entrenched in a war with Malygos, there is something that we can do to help.

starters.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 红龙之翼
text.objectives: 消灭30个废土挖掘者并夺取安提沃克的镰刀。完成这个任务之后，回到龙眠神殿去找阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者。
text.description: 用这枚信标召唤一头龙眠征服者，骑上它飞往北面的迦拉克隆之墓，指挥它去消灭那些正在挖掘迦拉克隆骨架的废土挖掘者。等到整个地区都清理干净之后，飞去迦拉克隆之墓旁的邪恶之旋，消灭通灵主宰安提沃克，取回那把他用以控制冰霜巨龙的镰刀。$B$B完成这个任务后，去向阿莱克丝塔萨汇报，她会给你一份英雄应得的奖励！$B$B$N，小心在这一地区徘徊的腐烂的风暴巨人！
text.progress: Destroy the Scourge at Galakrond's Rest before it is too late!
text.completion: I knew that you would return, $n. You have served the Wyrmrest Accord and saved your people from certain death. Let it be known to all and let it be recorded for posterity!
text.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

english.title: On Ruby Wings
english.objectives: Destroy 30 Wastes Scavengers and recover the Scythe of Antiok. Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple should you complete this task.
english.description: Use this beacon to signal a Wyrmrest vanquisher. Climb upon its back and fly north to Galakrond's Rest. Once there, command the dragon to destroy the Scourge scavengers that work to unearth Galakrond. Once the area has been cleansed, fly to the Wicked Coil, overlooking Galakrond's Rest, to destroy Grand Necrolord Antiok and recover the scythe that he uses to control the wyrms.$B$BDo this and return to Queen Alexstrasza for a hero's reward!$B$B$N, beware the rotting storm giants that wander the area!
english.progress: Destroy the Scourge at Galakrond's Rest before it is too late!
english.completion: I knew that you would return, $n. You have served the Wyrmrest Accord and saved your people from certain death. Let it be known to all and let it be recorded for posterity!
english.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

enders.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 返回安加萨
text.objectives: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon at Fordragon Hold and tell him of your victory over the Scourge.$B$B
text.description: With Antiok slain and the scythe in our possession, the frost wyrm assaults upon your forces at Angrathar will halt. The wyrms that remain in the Dragonblight will be hunted and destroyed, their bones returning to the earth.$B$BThe time to make your final stand is now, $N. Return to Fordragon Hold and notify Highlord Fordragon.$B$B
text.completion: Know this: all that you have done has led to this moment. Without your efforts, we would have been finished! Now, stand guard as I take to the field and end this!

text.title: 返回安加萨
text.objectives: Speak with Saurfang the Younger at the Kor'kron Vangaurd and tell him of your victory over the Scourge.
text.description: With Antiok slain and the scythe in our possession, the frost wyrm assaults upon your forces at Angrathar will halt. The wyrms that remain in the Dragonblight will be hunted and destroyed, their bones returning to the earth.$B$BThe time to make your final stand is now, $N. Return to the Kor'kron Vanguard and notify Saurfang the Younger.
text.completion: My father was right about you, $n. Everything that he said has come to pass - only one final duty remains unfulfilled. I will now lead the Kor'kron to the front line. The time to end this war is at hand. The Lich King's tyranny ends today! Take my post now, $n, and stand guard over our forces.

text.title: 巡逻员
text.objectives: 银色前沿的指挥官库恩斯要你拜访四座银色北伐军的岗哨，并完成那里的上尉交给你的任务，然后回去向他复命。$B$B布兰顿上尉和鲁伯特上尉驻扎在达克索塔。格隆迪尔上尉驻扎在达克迦尔。炼金师菲肯斯坦驻扎在赫布瓦罗。
text.description: 拔出你的武器，$R。巡逻的时候到了！$B$B我们要拼死保住手中的四座岗哨，这对我们取得胜利有着关键性的意义。我要你去逐一巡查这几处岗哨，并向他们提供帮助。$B$B你可以从东南方的布兰顿上尉那里开始。等你完成他指派的任务后，他就会指引你去下一座岗哨。$B$B巡查完所有四座岗哨后再回来向我复命。记住——你回来得越快，报酬就越丰厚！所以给我动作麻利一点！$B$B解散！
text.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
text.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
text.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol
english.objectives: Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$b$bCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok.
english.description: Unsheathe that weapon, $r. It's time to go on patrol!$b$bI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$b$bYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$b$bReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$b$bDismissed!
english.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
english.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
english.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: High Standards
text.objectives: Captain Brandon wants you to place the Argent Crusade Banner in the Drakkari Pedestals at Drak'Sotra.
text.description: Listen, $c. This is the Argent Crusade. Our men will fight to the end and never complain no matter what the conditions.$b$bThat said, we've taken some heavy casualties in this campaign and we've been hitting it hard with little or no sleep for months. That all takes a toll on morale, whether we admit it or not.$b$bIt may not seem like much, but seeing our standard raised over the battlefield is of considerable comfort to a soldier. Take these banners and raise them at the pedestals in Drak'Sotra.
text.completion: Good work, friend. Amazing what a little of one's colors do for a battleground. You'll want to head on over to Captain Rupert next. He's stationed at the wall, just northeast of here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

Take these banners and raise them at the pedestals in Drak'Sotra.

text.title: 保卫银色前沿
text.objectives: 指挥官法斯塔夫要你到银色前沿的庭院中去，消灭任意10个天灾军团士兵。
text.description: 尽管我们在祖达克的下层区域取得了重大胜利，但还是要对面天灾军团的猛攻。在这个冰封的地狱里，事情就是这样。$B$B进攻总是一波接一波，可我的部队需要休息。如果你愿意帮忙，就请你去支援他们吧。$B$B在下面的庭院里，我的部队正在与天灾军团没日没夜地战斗。带着你的全部热情去干掉那些天灾士兵吧，$C。
text.progress: Perhaps you could destroy a few more?
text.completion: Your assistance in this matter is greatly appreciated. Were it not for your efforts, we would have difficulty in holding the unliving back from our steps.
text.completed: Return to Commander Falstaav at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
text.objective1: Scourge at The Argent Stand destroyed

english.title: Defend the Stand
english.objectives: Commander Falstaav has tasked you with the destruction of any 10 Scourge in the courtyard at The Argent Stand.
english.description: Despite our substantial successes in the lower third of Zul'Drak, we must still face the onslaught of the Scourge. Such is the way in this frigid hell.$B$BThe attacks are unrelenting, yet my men need rest. If you are willing, we could use your aid in reinforcing them.$B$BBelow in the courtyard you'll find no end to the fighting. Dispatch the Scourge there with all the zeal you can muster, $c.
english.progress: Perhaps you could destroy a few more?
english.completion: Your assistance in this matter is greatly appreciated. Were it not for your efforts, we would have difficulty in holding the unliving back from our steps.
english.completed: Return to Commander Falstaav at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
english.objective1: Scourge at The Argent Stand destroyed

text.title: 银色北伐军，撤退！
text.objectives: 西莱图斯祭坛的斯塔哈默中士要你和10个银色士兵交谈，让他们回去向他复命。
text.description: <The sergeant quickly reads through the orders you've handed him, a frown coming over his face.>$B$BLook, $g lad : lass;, I'd love to just up and leave, but take a look out there. All of my people are fighting.$B$BTell you what, you've come this far, you think you're up to doing me a small favor? Head out there and round up my soldiers?$B$BTell 'em that the sergeant orders them to report back immediately. Lend them a hand if you will.
text.progress: I'll need more of them to report back in than that.
text.completion: Alright then. We'll collect up the rest and head back to the stand. It's a shame that we have to leave so soon. Doesn't quite feel like the job's done here, and quite frankly, I get the feeling that prophet in front of the altar is going to be big trouble!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak.
text.objective1: Argent Soldiers told to report back to the sergeant

english.title: Argent Crusade, We Are Leaving!
english.objectives: Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus wants you to speak with 10 of his Argent Soldiers and tell them to report back to him.
