All of my people are fighting.$B$BTell you what, you've come this far, you think you're up to doing me a small favor? Head out there and round up my soldiers?$B$BTell 'em that the sergeant orders them to report back immediately. Lend them a hand if you will.
english.progress: I'll need more of them to report back in than that.
english.completion: Alright then. We'll collect up the rest and head back to the stand. It's a shame that we have to leave so soon. Doesn't quite feel like the job's done here, and quite frankly, I get the feeling that prophet in front of the altar is going to be big trouble!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak.
english.objective1: Argent Soldiers told to report back to the sergeant

text.title: 给斯塔哈默中士的新命令
text.objectives: 指挥官库恩斯要你把调度命令交给西莱图斯祭坛的斯塔哈默中士。
text.description: $C，你是来帮忙的，对吗？我对部署在北方达卡莱祭坛的部队有新的指示。$B$B那地方很容易找，只要沿着大路走就到了。到那边之后就去找斯塔哈默中士。
text.progress: What's this all about?
text.completion: Are those new orders for me, mister?
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Stackhammer at Frigid Breach in Zul'Drak.

english.title: New Orders for Sergeant Stackhammer
english.objectives: Commander Kunz has asked you to deliver the New Deployment Orders to Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus.
english.description: $C, you're here to help, right? I've got new orders for our forces that are currently deployed at the Drakkari altar to the north.$B$BYou can't miss it. Just head straight up the avenue. Sergeant Stackhammer shouldn't be hard to find.
english.progress: What's this all about?
english.completion: Are those new orders for me, mister?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Stackhammer at Frigid Breach in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 西莱图斯祭坛的麻烦
text.objectives: 银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈要你去调查西莱图斯祭坛的主建筑。
text.description: 蛇神的祭坛那里有些麻烦。$B$B天灾军团的出现削弱了这片土地，$R。而这也削弱了那些原始神灵。$B$B我们知道那些达卡莱巨魔正在利用这个机会对这些神灵做某种邪恶的事。$B$B我要你充当我的耳目。西莱图斯祭坛就在通往北边的大路尽头。你要从背面潜入祭坛的主建筑里去看一眼。$B$B无论你怎么做，一定要避开那个先知！
text.progress: What did you see, $r?
text.completion: Dead? They've killed Sseratus and drunk deeply of his mojo; the prophet especially! We must figure out a way to put an end to him before he drinks too much more!
text.end: Main building at the Altar of Sseratus investigated.
text.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Trouble at the Altar of Sseratus
english.objectives: Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand has asked you to investigate the main altar building at the Altar of Sseratus.
english.description: There's trouble at the altar of the snake god.$B$BThe presence of the Scourge has weakened the land, $r. This in turn has weakened the wild gods.$B$BWe know that the Drakkari are taking advantage of this to do evil things to the gods.$B$BI need you to be my eyes and ears. The Altar of Sseratus is at the end of the avenue to the north. Sneak around the back and get a look inside of the main altar building.$B$BWhatever you do, avoid the prophet at all costs!
english.progress: What did you see, $r?
english.completion: Dead? They've killed Sseratus and drunk deeply of his mojo; the prophet especially! We must figure out a way to put an end to him before he drinks too much more!
english.end: Main building at the Altar of Sseratus investigated.
english.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 奇怪的魔精
text.objectives: 把奇怪的魔精交给银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈。
text.description: 这瓶奇怪的魔精也许可以解释这里所发生的一切。$B$B银色前沿的赞达拉巨魔——妖术师乌布戈可能会对这东西感兴趣。
text.progress: What's that you have there?
text.completion: That's the mojo of the wild gods, $c! This is not good!
text.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at The Dead Fields in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Strange Mojo
english.objectives: Deliver the Strange Mojo to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
english.description: This bottle of strange mojo may be the key to what is truly going on here.$B$BThe Zandalari troll Hexxer Ubungo, back at The Argent Stand, may want to take a look at it.
english.progress: What's that you have there?
english.completion: That's the mojo of the wild gods, $c! This is not good!
english.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at The Dead Fields in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 扫清巨魔
text.objectives: 西莱图斯祭坛的玛加下士要你杀死任意10个西莱图斯勇士、西莱图斯祭司或达卡莱驯蛇者。
text.description: 很抱歉我听到了你和中士的谈话。虽然上面来了命令，但我们在这里仍然有事情要做。$B$B你出去的时候，能帮我们把一些西莱图斯的追随者从痛苦中解放出来吗？
text.progress: How about killing a few more?
text.completion: Thanks, $c. I'd have hated to leave without accomplishing what we came out here for in the first place.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Maga at the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Mopping Up
english.objectives: Corporal Maga at the Altar of Sseratus wants you to kill any combination of 10 Champions of Sseratus, Priests of Sseratus, or Drakkari Snake Handlers.
english.description: I couldn't help but overhear what you were talking to the sergeant about. That doesn't change the fact that we still have a job to do here.$B$BWhile you're out there, do you think you could help us to put some of those followers of Sseratus out of their misery?
english.progress: How about killing a few more?
english.completion: Thanks, $c. I'd have hated to leave without accomplishing what we came out here for in the first place.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Maga at the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Intestinal Fortitude
text.objectives: Captain Rupert in Drak'Sotra wants you to restore courage to the cowering Crusade Recruits.
text.description: 最后，巡逻队到达！$B$B的情况，$R。在这场战役中，我们失去了许多最优秀的士兵，不得不招募新兵填补空白。我们刚打了一场最激烈的战斗，许多新兵根本没准备好去面对这个敌人前面有更多的战斗，我需要他们准备按照命令。$B$B如果有一件事情我不能忍受，那就是懦弱。也许你可以帮助他们找到继续的勇气。
text.completion: Well done, $c. And not a moment too soon. I've received word that a counter-attack is imminent. You should be on your way. The next post is to the northeast, near the coliseum. Captain Grondel should be waiting for you there.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol: Intestinal Fortitude
english.objectives: Captain Rupert in Drak'Sotra wants you to restore courage to the cowering Crusade Recruits.
english.description: Finally, the patrol arrives!$b$bHere's the situation, $r. We've lost many of our finest soldiers in this campaign and have had to call upon our recruits to fill in the gaps.$b$bWe've just fought one of our fiercest battles and many of the recruits were simply not prepared to face this enemy. There are more fights ahead, and I need them ready to follow orders.$b$bIf there's one thing I can't stomach, it's cowardice. Perhaps you can help them find the courage to continue.
english.completion: Well done, $c. And not a moment too soon. I've received word that a counter-attack is imminent. You should be on your way. The next post is to the northeast, near the coliseum. Captain Grondel should be waiting for you there.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 珍贵的元素液体
text.objectives: 银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈要你收集3份珍贵的元素液体。
text.description: <妖术师仔细研究了装着魔精的瓶子。>$B$B我知道怎么对付西莱图斯的先知了。但首先，我们需要一些东西。$B$B达克索塔农田就在正南方。由于天灾军团入侵和原始神灵的死亡，诸界间的藩篱已经越来越脆弱了，许多元素生物借此机会涌了进来。$B$B我们要从它们的首领身上弄一些珍贵的元素液体来。如果你能把那些元素生物身上的三条锁链连在一起，它们的某个首领就会出现。
text.progress: Do you have the precious fluids?
text.completion: Excellent. When combined with the mojo, these fluids will dilute the effectiveness of the mojo without completely eliminating it. Now, one more thing.
text.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Precious Elemental Fluids
english.objectives: Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand wants you to acquire 3 Precious Elemental Fluids.
english.description: <The hexxer examines the decanter of mojo.>$B$BI have an idea for how to deal with the prophet of Sseratus. But first, we're going to need some things.$B$BThe Drak'Sotra Fields are directly to the south. Because of the stresses on the land from the Scourge and the deaths of gods, the wall between worlds has weakened and the elementals are flooding in.$B$BWe need the precious fluids of their lords. If you combine three links from the elementals a tether will be made, and one of their lords can be summoned.
english.progress: Do you have the precious fluids?
english.completion: Excellent. When combined with the mojo, these fluids will dilute the effectiveness of the mojo without completely eliminating it. Now, one more thing.
english.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 丘陵援兵
text.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in western Grizzly Hills.$B$B
text.description: While we focus to hold our ground at Wintergarde and deal with the unfolding events of the Wrathgate, battalions from as far away as Westfall battle their way through the dense foliage and inhospitable denizens of Grizzly Hills. All in hopes of finding an alternate route into Icecrown.$B$BLieutenant Dumont, stationed at Amberpine Lodge, has enlisted the aid of able bodied citizens willing to risk life and limb in the uncharted wilds. Will you rise to meet this challenge?
text.completion: You were almost shot down, eh? Savage monsters - those Horde. Payback will come for what they've done. You can count on at least that much, $c. Now, it's time to put you to work.

english.title: The Hills Have Us
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in western Grizzly Hills.$B$B
english.description: While we focus to hold our ground at Wintergarde and deal with the unfolding events of the Wrathgate, battalions from as far away as Westfall battle their way through the dense foliage and inhospitable denizens of Grizzly Hills. All in hopes of finding an alternate route into Icecrown.$B$BLieutenant Dumont, stationed at Amberpine Lodge, has enlisted the aid of able bodied citizens willing to risk life and limb in the uncharted wilds. Will you rise to meet this challenge?
english.completion: You were almost shot down, eh? Savage monsters - those Horde. Payback will come for what they've done. You can count on at least that much, $c. Now, it's time to put you to work.

text.title: 一个也不能少
text.objectives: 达克索塔的罗杰斯博士要你找到北伐军战士拉莫夫、北伐军战士乔纳森和北伐军战士约瑟芬。对他们使用北伐军的绷带，并护送他们安全回来。
text.description: 啊，太好了。他们终于派人来了。$B$B听着，$R。我们需要帮助。我们的部队被击退了，达克索塔已经落入了天灾军团手里。没人知道他们是从哪里冒出来的……$B$B关键是，我们需要一切可以找到的人手，但我们最棒的几个士兵还没有从战场上回来。$B$B我要你立刻进入废墟中去，找到那些伤员，帮他们包扎好，然后把他们带回来。他们都是老兵，所以可能会隐蔽起来。找不到他们就别回来见我！$B$B就在达克索塔一带找！他们应该走不远。
text.progress: Have you rescued our veterans, $N?
text.completion: Saved them all, did you? Outstanding! Maybe you'd consider sticking around the post here? We could sure use someone like you....
text.completed: Return to Dr. Rogers at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Leave No One Behind
english.objectives: Dr. Rogers at Drak'Sotra wants you to find Crusader Lamoof, Crusader Jonathan, and Crusader Josephine. Use the Crusader's Bandage on them, and escort them safely back to him.
english.description: Ahh, good. They sent someone.$b$bListen, $r. We need a hand here. Our forces were pushed back and we've lost Drak'Sotra to the Scourge. Where they came from is anyone's guess....$b$bThe point is, we need every man we can get here, and some of our best have yet to return from battle.$b$bI need you to enter the ruins now that the fighting has died down and find our wounded, patch them up, and bring them here to me.$b$bScour Drak'Sotra! They couldn't have gone far.
english.progress: Have you rescued our veterans, $N?
english.completion: Saved them all, did you? Outstanding! Maybe you'd consider sticking around the post here? We could sure use someone like you....
english.completed: Return to Dr. Rogers at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 好帽子……
text.objectives: 卡洛斯要你进入旧希尔斯布莱德，击败年轻时候的卡洛斯。然后将他的帽子交给塔纳利斯的卡洛斯。
text.description: 我的帽子？是啊，那顶帽子的款式非同寻常，很早以前的事儿啦……如今可没几个裁缝知道怎么缝制。$B$B年少轻狂的时候，我将它当作身份的象征。很多人想要击败我，赢得那顶帽子……可惜没人成功。$B$B啊，这些都是陈芝麻烂谷子的事了。我已经老了，每天喝喝酒，钓钓鱼，早就不与人决斗啦。
text.progress: I was unbeatable, in those days... proud, and rightly so. No challenger ever won this fine hat...
text.completion: My... my hat! So... it WAS you. I'd thought so. The old scars ached when you drew near, but... so young! You've not changed at all! Well... so now you know my secret. I WAS beaten... once. Here: take this hat, in return for mine. You've more than earned it.
text.completed: Return to Don Carlos in Tanaris.

english.title: Nice Hat...
english.objectives: Don Carlos has inadvertently challenged you to defeat his younger self in Old Hillsbrad. Afterwards, bring Don Carlos' Hat to him in Tanaris as proof.
english.description: My hat? Yes, it's an unusual style, I know, from far away... few tailors here know how to make them.$B$BWhen I was young and hot-blooded, I wore it as a standing challenge. Many came seeking to defeat me and win it for themselves... but no one ever did.$B$BAh, but those days are long past. I'm an old man, now: I drink, I fish, but I no longer duel.
english.progress: I was unbeatable, in those days... proud, and rightly so. No challenger ever won this fine hat...
english.completion: My... my hat! So... it WAS you. I'd thought so. The old scars ached when you drew near, but... so young! You've not changed at all! Well... so now you know my secret. I WAS beaten... once. Here: take this hat, in return for mine. You've more than earned it.
english.completed: Return to Don Carlos in Tanaris.

text.title: 蘑菇混合剂
text.objectives: 收集10份混乱毒菇，将它们交给银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈。
text.description: 现在我们要找一种东西，把它混入魔精，让先知喝了它以后非但不会变强，而且被大大削弱。$B$B东边的达克迦尔生长着一种蘑菇，当地的原住民称之为混乱毒菇。我想这就是我们要找的东西。$B$B帮我多采一些混乱毒菇回来，等我们把这些蘑菇混入魔精里面后，喝了它的人就会变得糊里糊涂的。
text.progress: Do you have all of the fungus? Oh, and watch out for the basilisks lurking over there.
text.completion: Hand that fungus over and I'll mix it up with the mojo and elemental lord fluids.
text.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Mushroom Mixer
english.objectives: Collect 10 Muddlecap Fungus and deliver them to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
english.description: Now what we need is something to spike the mojo with. Something that'll make it so that when the prophet drinks it, he'll become less powerful.$B$BDrak'Agal lies to the east. There's a mushroom there that the natives call muddlecap fungus. I think it's exactly what we need.$B$BBring back lots of them. When we mix them into the mojo, the mind of anyone who drinks it will become muddled.
english.progress: Do you have all of the fungus? Oh, and watch out for the basilisks lurking over there.
english.completion: Hand that fungus over and I'll mix it up with the mojo and elemental lord fluids.
english.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.completion: My... my hat! But... how did you...? Well... no matter. So, now you know my secret. I WAS beaten... once. Here: take this hat, in return for mine. You've earned it.
text.completed: Return to Don Carlos in Tanaris.

Many came seeking to defeat me and win it for themselves... but no one ever did.$B$BAh, but those days are long past. I'm an old man, now: I drink, I fish, but I no longer duel.

text.title: 过犹不及
text.objectives: 杀死混乱的西莱图斯先知，然后向银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈复命。
text.description: 喏，我已经重新调配过这瓶魔精了。现在先知只要喝下它，就会失去一部分力量，而且还会变得昏头昏脑。$B$B至少理论上是这样的。$B$B至于说如何能让他喝下这玩意，我想也许你只需把魔精扔给他就行了？根据他在祭坛上表现出来的傲慢态度来看，他肯定会直接喝下去的。$B$B除非你能杀了他，$C，否则你们的银色北伐军一定会落得无比悲惨的下场。
text.progress: Is it over?$B$BDid the modified mojo work?$B$BDid you deliver vengeance for Sseratus by slaying his prophet?
text.completion: Amazing! You've saved your people and the rest of Northrend from his madness. Unfortunately there's more of this insanity occurring up in the higher tiers of Zul'Drak.
text.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Too Much of a Good Thing
english.objectives: Slay the Muddled Prophet of Sseratus and then return to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
english.description: There. I've modified the mojo. Now when the prophet drinks it, not only will he lose some of his power, his mind will also be addled by the effects of the fungus.$B$BAt least that's the theory.$B$BAs for how to get him to drink it, might I suggest you simply throw it at him? No doubt he'll catch and drink it given the arrogance that he's displayed at the altar.$B$BUnless you can kill him, $c, your Argent Crusade is about to come to a terrible end.
english.progress: Is it over?$B$BDid the modified mojo work?$B$BDid you deliver vengeance for Sseratus by slaying his prophet?
english.completion: Amazing! You've saved your people and the rest of Northrend from his madness. Unfortunately there's more of this insanity occurring up in the higher tiers of Zul'Drak.
english.completed: Return to Hexxer Ubungo at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 盗贼套牌
text.objectives: 使用盗贼套牌召唤一位暗月占卜师，并把套牌交给占卜师。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了盗贼套牌的所有卡片，一张新的卡片神秘地出现在你手中。卡面上描绘着一位占卜师，无论你把卡片转动到何种角度，占卜师似乎都在盯着你。$B$B你觉得似乎可以用这张卡片来联络某些人，或某些事物。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to collect a deck of Rogues!   I'm impressed.
text.completion: The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to collect more.  We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in return.
text.completed: Return to Darkmoon Fortune Teller.

english.title: Rogues Deck
english.objectives: Use the Rogues Deck to summon a Darkmoon Fortune Teller and give the deck to them.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Rogue cards together into a deck, another card appears on top.  It depicts a fortune teller that seems to stare at you no matter how you hold the card.$b$bYou feel the card could be used to communicate with someone or something.
english.progress: I see that you have managed to collect a deck of Rogues!   I'm impressed.
english.completion: The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to collect more.  We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in return.
english.completed: Return to Darkmoon Fortune Teller.

text.objectives: 使用法师套牌召唤一位暗月占卜师，并把套牌交给占卜师。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了法师套牌的所有卡片，一张新的卡片神秘地出现在你手中。卡面上描绘着一位占卜师，无论你把卡片转动到何种角度，占卜师似乎都在盯着你。$B$B你觉得似乎可以用这张卡片来联络某些人，或某些事物。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Mages!   Congratulations!
text.completion: The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to collect more.  We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in return.
text.completed: Return to Darkmoon Fortune Teller.

english.objectives: Use the Mages Deck to summon a Darkmoon Fortune Teller and give the deck to them.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Mage cards together into a deck, another card appears on top.  It depicts a fortune teller that seems to stare at you no matter how you hold the card.$b$bYou feel the card could be used to communicate with someone or something.

english.completion: The tarot cards are of great interest to the Darkmoon Faire, so do not hesitate to call upon us if you manage to collect more.  We are not without our own skilled tradesmen, so please allow us to offer something in return.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Whatdya Want, a Medal?
text.objectives: Captain Grondel outside the Coliseum wants you to gather 7 Drakkari Medallions from the nearby Drakkari Corpses.
text.description: Look at me, $r. Do I look like I have time fer fillin' out reports?$b$bIt be all I can do to keep this post free o' the bloody Scourge, and they want me to mess with paperwork!$b$b<sigh> No sense in complainin'. I need to get the commander some kinda kill count from the last skirmish.$b$bYou wanna be helpful? Go and get me all the medals you can find from the dead trolls around here. That'll hafta be close enough.
text.progress: You get those medals for me, $r?
text.completion: Well, now! Ya saved me a fair bit o' work there lad. I'm grateful. I'll be sure ta make mention of ya in me report. Off with yeh now. Finklestein'll likely be waitin fer ya a bit west o' here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

That'll hafta be close enough.

english.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 狩猎犀牛：初试身手
text.objectives: 杀死15头碎角犀牛，然后返回奈辛瓦里营地，向赫米特·奈辛瓦里复命。
text.description: 就算是迫降，也不会败了老子征服索拉查盆地这片原始丛林的兴致。你瞧，营地西北方生活着许多健壮的碎角犀牛，它们是这片丛林的统治者。如果你想对探险队证明自己的实力，就去挑战这些凶猛的野兽吧。
text.progress: Did you master the rhinos, or are you throwing in the towel?
text.completion: Well, well, well, it looks like you've survived the rhinos, after all, and in pretty good shape if I do say so myself. But there's more to rhino hunting than just staring down the beast as it charges you and hoping your aim is true. No, you'll need more than that to take on the rhino patriarch that's rumored to dwell in the jungle.
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Rhino Mastery: The Test
english.objectives: Kill 15 Shardhorn Rhinos and return to Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: No rough landing is going to stop ol' Hemet from mastering the largest game Sholazar has to offer. In the wilds northwest of the camp, the jungles are ruled by the mighty shardhorn rhino. You can prove your worth to the expedition, $g lad:lass;, by showing me that you're tough enough to face down those powerful beasts.
english.progress: Did you master the rhinos, or are you throwing in the towel?
english.completion: Well, well, well, it looks like you've survived the rhinos, after all, and in pretty good shape if I do say so myself. But there's more to rhino hunting than just staring down the beast as it charges you and hoping your aim is true. No, you'll need more than that to take on the rhino patriarch that's rumored to dwell in the jungle.
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 赫米特·奈辛瓦里哪去了？
text.objectives: 当你准备好动身前往索拉查盆地时，就与大法师伯塔鲁斯谈一谈。到达索拉查盆地之后，与蛮藤谷的蒙特谈一谈。
text.description: 当我听说传说中的赫米特·奈辛瓦里启程前往索拉查盆地时，我向他的探险队提供了资金援助。我们对索拉查盆地几乎一无所知，但据说那里是这片冰冷大陆中的人间仙境。$B$B赫米特同意将珍稀植物、材料和水晶的样本送回来给我，但他至今还是杳无音信。蒙特本应给他们带去补给，但同样的，我们也与他失去了联系。如果你愿意去调查的话，我可以用我的飞行器把你送过去。
text.completion: Aye, Hemet's here. He's at the camp, just go northwest toward the river and you'll soon see it. And for the love of the Light, lad, have him send someone to cut me down!

english.title: Where in the World is Hemet Nesingwary?
english.objectives: Talk to Archmage Pentarus when you're ready to leave for Sholazar Basin. When you arrive, speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
english.description: When I heard that the legendary Hemet Nesingwary was setting sail for the Sholazar Basin, I offered to help fund his expedition. We know little of Sholazar,  but it's said to be a lush paradise in the midst of this frozen continent.$B$BHemet has agreed to send back samples of exotic plants, reagents, and crystals. There hasn't been any word from him. Monte Muzzleshot was supposed to be bringing them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either. If you'll look into it, I'll send you in my flying machine.
english.completion: Aye, Hemet's here. He's at the camp, just go northwest toward the river and you'll soon see it. And for the love of the Light, lad, have him send someone to cut me down!

text.title: 需要引擎
text.objectives: 奈辛瓦里营地的维斯雷·扭钳要你帮他找到一台飞行器引擎。
text.description: 毁了……全毁了！我早就提醒过船长，让她小心运送精密的仪器，她怎么就不把我的话当回事呢！$B$B由于她的疏忽，导致我的飞行器“诺莫瑞根之魂”在这艘船触礁搁浅时被撞坏了。这下完蛋了吧，我们连报告都没法送出去了！$B$B不过，天无绝人之路！风险投资公司的地精或许能帮上我们。前些日子，他们击落了另一架飞行器。喏，残骸就落在东边的沼泽地里，也就是蒙特跳伞着陆的地方。我要你去回收它的引擎，这很可能是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: Well, were you able to get the engine? I just know that archmage who funded the expedition is getting nervous.
text.completion: There... just set it down there. Be careful! If you ruin this one, we're in big trouble. Now, let's see what I can do.
text.completed: Return to Weslex Quickwrench at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Need an Engine, Take an Engine
english.objectives: Weslex Quickwrench at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to bring him a Flying Machine Engine.
english.description: She's ruined... ruined! I told that captain to be careful with such a precious cargo, but would she listen to me? No!$B$BWhen the ship ran aground, it damaged my flying machine, the Spirit of Gnomeregan. Now, we're left without any means to send our reports!$B$BThere is a chance, though, that the Venture Company's antics may work in our favor. They shot down another flying machine right about where Monte parachuted into the swamp to the east. Go there and retrieve the engine. It may be our only hope.
english.progress: Well, were you able to get the engine? I just know that archmage who funded the expedition is getting nervous.
english.completion: There... just set it down there. Be careful! If you ruin this one, we're in big trouble. Now, let's see what I can do.
english.completed: Return to Weslex Quickwrench at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 借零件
text.objectives: 将7份风险投资公司备用零件交给奈辛瓦里营地的维斯雷·扭钳。
text.description: 很好，我们有了一台能用的引擎。接下来嘛，只要替换飞行器的部分零件，就能让她正常运转啦。别担心，我知道自己在做什么。$B$B优秀的机械师可以使用最烂的材料修复他的发明创造！不过，如果能找到合适的材料，那自然是再好不过啦。$B$B风险投资公司在斯温迪格林挖掘场中作业，那里到处散落着采矿设备的备用零件。喏，挖掘场就在东北方那根黄色水晶柱的另一端。替我弄一些零件回来吧。
text.progress: Did you get those parts?
text.completion: With a little work, these should suffice. My poor flying machine might end up looking more like a Venture Company shredder, though. Poor girl will have to wait until we get back to Dalaran to be restored to her rightful form.
text.completed: Return to Weslex Quickwrench at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Have a Part, Give a Part
english.objectives: Bring 7 Venture Co. Spare Parts to Weslex Quickwrench at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: Great, now that we've got an engine, we're going to need an assortment of other parts to get her back in flying condition. Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.$B$BA good mechanic can hold his creations together with anything, but we're better off if it doesn't come to that.$B$BAnyway, those Venture Company dullards have plenty of spare parts for their mining equipment all over Swindlegrin's Dig on the far side of that yellow crystal pillar to the northeast. Scoop up a few and bring them back here.
english.progress: Did you get those parts?
english.completion: With a little work, these should suffice. My poor flying machine might end up looking more like a Venture Company shredder, though. Poor girl will have to wait until we get back to Dalaran to be restored to her rightful form.
english.completed: Return to Weslex Quickwrench at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 风险投资公司的风险
text.objectives: 奈辛瓦里营地的蒂巴尔要你去杀死15名风险投资公司雇员，风险投资公司无赖或是风险投资公司挖掘者都可以。
text.description: 自打我们来到这里，风险投资公司就一直在给我们制造麻烦，营地的安全受到威胁，调查工作更是难以开展。本来呢，我们也不想招惹是非，但是他们竟然袭击我们的斥候，还击落了运送补给物资的飞行器。$B$B我们绝不能容忍这样的侮辱。赫米特·奈辛瓦里的探险队是来这里狩猎的，他们也将成为我们的猎物！$B$B前往东北方的那根水晶柱的另一端，消灭那些在斯温迪格林挖掘场中作业的风险投资公司雇员！
text.completion: That should hamper their operations, but I worry that the foreman will try to bring in more workers. We have to complete the job while we can.
text.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Venture Co. Misadventure
english.objectives: Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to kill 15 Venture Company members. You may kill either Venture Co. Ruffians or Venture Co. Excavators.
english.description: Ever since we arrived, the Venture Company has hampered our efforts to secure our campsite and survey the area. Normally, we wouldn't care what they were up to, but they've started antagonizing our scouts and shooting down supply flights.$B$BWe can't allow this insult to stand. Hemet Nesingwary's expedition came here to hunt, and hunt it shall.$B$BGo to Swindlegrin's Dig, on the far side of the crystal pillar to the northeast, and kill any Venture Company employee you see!
english.completion: That should hamper their operations, but I worry that the foreman will try to bring in more workers. We have to complete the job while we can.
english.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 工头斯温迪格林
text.objectives: 杀死工头斯温迪格林和肉饼，然后返回奈辛瓦里营地，向蒂巴尔复命。
text.description: 我们必须干掉工头斯温迪格林，才能彻底让他们的矿洞完蛋。但这家伙随身带着一个名叫“肉饼”的食人魔保镖。看来不经过一番激烈的搏斗，你是见不着工头的。$B$B他们很可能呆在高处的平台，监视着风险投资公司在斯温迪格林挖掘场的工作进展。$B$B挖掘场就在东北方的日灼之柱的另一端。祝你好运，$N。
text.progress: Have you dealt with Swindlegrin and his bodyguard?
text.completion: What a relief to hear that the Venture Company will trouble us no more. You have my thanks, and that of Hemet for dealing with this problem. A game hunter cannot, in good conscience, lift her weapon against another person.
text.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Wipe That Grin Off His Face
english.objectives: Kill Foreman Swindlegrin and Meatpie and return to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: We must send Foreman Swindlegrin packing if we're going to shut down his mine permanently, but be careful. His bodyguard, Meatpie, is a large, mean ogre, and  isn't likely to let you see the foreman without a fight.$B$BThe two probably occupy a platform that would let them look out over the entire Venture Company operation at Swindlegrin's Dig.$B$BRemember, the dig is on the far side of the Suntouched Pillar to the northeast. Good luck, $N.
english.progress: Have you dealt with Swindlegrin and his bodyguard?
english.completion: What a relief to hear that the Venture Company will trouble us no more. You have my thanks, and that of Hemet for dealing with this problem. A game hunter cannot, in good conscience, lift her weapon against another person.
english.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 狩猎犀牛：乘胜追击
text.objectives: 与诺兹隆之骨的神谕者索乌拉姆谈一谈。
text.description: 呃，就这么办吧。我们得找这位土著先知好好谈谈。他多半不会心甘情愿地为我们效劳。$B$B据说他住在诺兹隆之骨附近的一间小屋里，就在南边河流的对岸。找到他之后先做个自我介绍吧，然后问问他要怎么样才肯帮助我们追踪那头犀牛之王。
text.completion: What brings you to Rahm's shrine?

english.title: Rhino Mastery: The Chase
english.objectives: Speak to Oracle Soo-rahm at the Bones of Nozronn.
english.description: Well, that's settled then. We'll seek out this native sage and have a word with him. He's not likely to volunteer his services, though.$B$BI'm told he keeps a small lean-to near the Bones of Nozronn, just across the river to the south. Seek him out, introduce yourself, and ask what he requires to help us track down this patriarch of the rhinos.
english.completion: What brings you to Rahm's shrine?

text.title: 贪吃的蜥蜴
text.objectives: 将5块石化蜥蜴水晶交给赫布瓦罗神殿的炼金师菲肯斯坦。
text.description: 我的主人菲肯斯坦正在西北方的赫布瓦罗制作一种真言药剂，他需要大量的石化蜥蜴水晶作为材料。赫布瓦罗就在这条通往北边的西莱图斯祭坛的大道西侧。$B$B幸运的是，东边的达克迦尔就潜伏着不少蜥蜴。$B$B如果你能抓一些祖达克老鼠，把它们扔给蜥蜴吃的话，那些蜥蜴在吃掉五只老鼠以后就会变得很温顺。然后你就可以安全地从它们身上取走水晶了。$B$B杀死蜥蜴是没有用的……那样只会把水晶弄碎。
text.progress: What's all this? By any chance have you seen my no-good apprentice, Pestlepot? I sent him on an errand quite some time ago and he has yet to return!
text.completion: Oh, most excellent! Thank you. The crystals appear to be in fine condition! I have no doubt that Pestlepot put you up to doing his chores for him. Nevertheless, your assistance in this matter is greatly appreciated!
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at the shrine at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Gluttonous Lurkers
english.objectives: Deliver 5 Basilisk Crystals to Alchemist Finklestein in the shrine at Heb'Valok.
english.description: My master, Finklestein, is in the shrine at Heb'Valok to the northwest preparing a truth serum, and he needs basilisk crystals. Heb'Valok is on the west side of the road leading north before the Altar of Sseratus.$B$BThere are basilisks to the east at Drak'Agal.$B$BIf you grab the Zul'Drak rats and throw them at the basilisk, they will become gorged and docile after eating five. Then you'll be able to take their crystals.$B$BKilling the basilisk won't do you any good. That'd just break its crystals!
english.progress: What's all this? By any chance have you seen my no-good apprentice, Pestlepot? I sent him on an errand quite some time ago and he has yet to return!
english.completion: Oh, most excellent! Thank you. The crystals appear to be in fine condition! I have no doubt that Pestlepot put you up to doing his chores for him. Nevertheless, your assistance in this matter is greatly appreciated!
english.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at the shrine at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 伪装奴隶
text.objectives: 以新“奴隶”的身份向狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克报到。
text.description: 是我杀的！你竟敢抢我的猎物！$B$B<基克吉克挥舞着长矛，对你高声咆哮。>$B$B蠢货！算你欠我的！你是狂心氏族的奴隶了！你必须替我们杀死那些长刺的野兽。$B$B前往东北方的狂心岭，向高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克报到，就说你是新来的奴隶。$B$B快去！不然我可发火了！$B$B<基克吉克摇晃着长矛以示威胁。>
text.completion: You the new slave? Good. We running out.

english.title: Playing Along
english.objectives: Report to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill as the new "slave."
english.description: My kill! You take my kill!$B$B<Gekgek taunts you with his spear.>$B$BYou dumb, $r. Now you owe Gekgek! You be Frenzyheart slave. You slay many more beasts for Frenzyheart.$B$BYou go Frenzyheart Hill to northeast - you tell High-Shaman Rakjak you the new slave.$B$BGo, $r! Go or I taunt you a second time!$B$B<Gekgek waves his spear around menacingly.>
english.completion: You the new slave? Good. We running out.

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 猩猩猎手的奴隶
text.objectives: 狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克要你去杀死8只硬皮抢夺者和6只硬皮冲锋者。$B$B如果你弄丢了格拉克伊克的镣铐，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 你？伟大的猎手？你根本不属于狂心氏族，也配谈论狩猎的技巧？$B$B格拉克伊克，他才算得上是真正的猩猩猎手。要说死在他手里的猩猩，你数也数不清。$B$B你，跟着他。去东边猎杀硬皮猩猩吧。记住，你只是个奴隶，凡事都照格拉克伊克说的做。
text.progress: You still alive! Hardknuckles not eat you yet?$B$BMaybe they eat you later.
text.completion: Goregek show silly $r slave how it done.
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Ape Hunter's Slave
english.objectives: Kill 8 Hardknuckle Foragers and 6 Hardknuckle Chargers for High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$BIf you lose Goregek's Shackles, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: You think you so great hunter, eh? You no Frenzyheart, you not know of hunt.$B$BGoregek is great ape hunter. He slay so many ape you can't count on claws.$B$BYou go with Goregek and hunt hardknuckles to east. You the slave, $r. You do what Goregek tell you.
english.progress: You still alive! Hardknuckles not eat you yet?$B$BMaybe they eat you later.
english.completion: Goregek show silly $r slave how it done.
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

starters.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 狩猎硬皮猩猩
text.objectives: 对软皮猩猩使用格拉克伊克给你的软皮木棍，将雌性硬皮猩猩引出来。击败雌性硬皮猩猩，然后向狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克汇报情况。$B$B如果你弄丢了格拉克伊克的镣铐，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 嘿！奴隶！$B$B拉克亚克要我带上你外出狩猎硬皮猩猩，换了平常我才不乐意呢。不过今天我的心情很好，所以打算也让你过过瘾。但是，你最好别给我惹麻烦！$B$B拉克亚克还不知道吧，其实我早就想对那只坏坏的雌性硬皮猩猩下手了。我们去东边的硬皮旷野，对软皮猩猩使用软皮木棍，这样就能迫使她显身啦！$B$B<格拉克伊克兴奋地摩挲着双手。>
text.progress: What you want, slave?
text.completion: Goregek take you to kill big mom of hardknuckles, eh? You lucky! Dumb softknuckles squeal good!
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Tormenting the Softknuckles
english.objectives: Goregek has given you a Softknuckle Poker for use on Softknuckles to draw the Hardknuckle Matriarch out of hiding. Slay the Hardknuckle Matriarch and report her death to High-Shaman Rajak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$BIf you lose Goregek's Shackles, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Slave thing!$B$BRakjak want me to babysit you while I kill hardknuckles. I feeling generous today, so I let you kill some too, but don't get in Goregek's way!$B$BRakjak not know yet, but Goregek has eye on big bad hardknuckle mama. We go to Hardknuckle Clearing to east and poke softknuckles with poker and she sure to come yelling!$B$B<Goregek rubs his hands together gleefully.>
english.progress: What you want, slave?
english.completion: Goregek take you to kill big mom of hardknuckles, eh? You lucky! Dumb softknuckles squeal good!
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 地下的威胁
text.objectives: 前往南部河流的沙滩，找到并杀死瑟菲克斯，将他的爪子交给狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克。$B$B如果你弄丢了达伊克的旧粉笔，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 啧啧，狮子杀手，捕鸡者，新来的奴隶……$B$B我知道你不愿意当一辈子奴隶，所以啊，我来告诉你要如何获得自由的身份。你必须证明自己比其他猎手更厉害，才能赢得拉克亚克的尊重。$B$B在南部河流的沙地下，生活着一只名叫瑟菲克斯的野兽。蓝蜂、猩猩，甚至狼獾人都不是它的对手。如果你能将瑟菲克斯的爪子交给拉克亚克，或许他会考虑解除你的奴隶身份。$B$B希望达伊克能教你对付瑟菲克斯的诀窍。
text.progress: I not ask for you, $r. What you want?
text.completion: You kill Serfex? I bet you follow mighty wolvar that kill Serfex and take claw. My claw now.
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Underground Menace
english.objectives: Locate Serfex under the sands of the southern river, slay him, and bring his claw to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Lion killer, chicken chaser, new Frenzyheart slave...$B$BI know you no want to stay slave, so I tell you what to do. Show you better than the other Frenzyheart hunters and then Rakjak respect you.$B$BUnder sands of south river there a beast that kills wasp, apes, and even wolvar. He called Serfex. You bring claw of Serfex to Rakjak and maybe he release you from slaveness.$B$BHope Dajik teaching you good so Serfex be easy stuff.
english.progress: I not ask for you, $r. What you want?
english.completion: You kill Serfex? I bet you follow mighty wolvar that kill Serfex and take claw. My claw now.
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 鸡飞狼跳！
text.objectives: 捕捉12只逃走的小鸡，然后向长者哈尔卡克复命。$B$B如果你弄丢了达伊克的旧粉笔，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 格利基克没头没脑地闯入鸡舍，结果鸡们受到惊吓，全都逃掉了！$B$B它们就在附近——替我把它们抓回来！$B$B<长者哈尔卡克发出嘘声，催你赶紧去抓鸡。>
text.progress: You catch chickens?
text.completion: Good! I was worried about foodstuffs. I already pretty hungry. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Flown the Coop!
english.objectives: Capture 12 Chicken Escapees for Elder Harkek.$B$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Dumb Goregek stumble into chicken house and let all the chickens go!$B$BThey all around hill - go get chickens back!$B$B<Elder Harkek shoos you away.>
english.progress: You catch chickens?
english.completion: Good! I was worried about foodstuffs. I already pretty hungry. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 蓝蜂猎手的学徒
text.objectives: 狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克要你杀死6只蓝玉虫巢巨蜂和9只蓝玉虫巢雄蜂。$B$B如果你弄丢了达伊克的旧粉笔，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 拉克亚克又不蠢。或许你真的很擅长捕杀猎物。说不定狂心氏族可以将你培养成真正的猎手。$B$B说到狩猎巨型蓝蜂的本事，达伊克是所有狼獾人中最厉害的。你跟他去东南方的蓝玉虫巢或者南部的河流附近，好好学习吧。
text.progress: You learn the hunt?
text.completion: We kill many many wasps. Rakjak don't think they run out.
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Wasp Hunter's Apprentice
english.objectives: Kill 6 Sapphire Hive Wasps and 9 Sapphire Hive Drones for High-Shaman Rakjak in Frenzyheart Hill.$B$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Rakjak not dumb. Maybe you good at killing things. Maybe Frenzyheart can make you into real hunter.$B$BDajik hunts giant wasp things better than all wolvar. Go with Dajik to Sapphire Hive to southeast or to river in south and learn the hunt.
english.progress: You learn the hunt?
english.completion: We kill many many wasps. Rakjak don't think they run out.
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

starters.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 蓝色蜂后
text.objectives: 将蓝玉虫巢蜂后的钉刺交给狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克。$B$B如果你弄丢了达伊克的旧粉笔，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 钢刺野猪虽然颇具威胁，但它们大多生活在远离狼獾人的区域。蓝蜂就不同了，这种可怕的巨型蜂接连杀死了狂心氏族的好几名猎手……$B$B拉克亚克一直想除掉蜂后，可是最厉害的猎手也没有勇气踏足她的巢穴。我要你进入东南方的蓝玉虫巢杀死那里的蜂后，然后把她的钉刺交给拉克亚克。我敢打赌拉克亚克会欣喜若狂的。
text.progress: You smell like wasp things.
text.completion: You killed queen wasp! You stronger than Rakjak thought. Maybe wasps go away now and stop attacking Frenzyheart hunters.
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Sapphire Queen
english.objectives: Bring the Stinger of the Sapphire Queen to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Bristlepine can be dangerous, but most stay far away from wolvar. Wasps on other hand not fear the Frenzyheart... they even kill some of our hunters.$B$BI know Rakjak want wasp queen dead, but no wolvar want to go into her hive. You go kill wasp queen in Sapphire Hive to southeast and get stinger for Rakjak. Me bet Rakjak like that.
english.progress: You smell like wasp things.
english.completion: You killed queen wasp! You stronger than Rakjak thought. Maybe wasps go away now and stop attacking Frenzyheart hunters.
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 恶作剧的材料
text.objectives: 狂心岭的高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克要你去收集8块通天水晶簇。
text.description: 你是个好猎人，但我们能让你变得更厉害。哈尔卡克认为现在是时候让你承担重任了。$B$B不过呢，在派你执行重要任务之前，我要你先去收集一些东西。瞧，南面的河流沿岸分布着许多蓝水晶。拉克亚克需要很多很多蓝水晶。$B$B你这就去收集一些。
text.progress: Almost ready for long journey. Gekgek come back with crocolisk just moment ago.
text.completion: Good $r! Okay, all ready.
text.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Mischief in the Making
english.objectives: High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill wants 8 Skyreach Crystal Clusters.
english.description: You good hunter, but Frenzyheart can make you stronger. Harkek think maybe you ready for something more important.$B$BBefore Rakjak send you on important mission, you need gather things for Rakjak. All along river to south are blue crystals. Rakjak need lots of blue crystals.$B$BYou go get crystals now.
english.progress: Almost ready for long journey. Gekgek come back with crocolisk just moment ago.
english.completion: Good $r! Okay, all ready.
english.completed: Return to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

starters.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 颠簸的航行
text.objectives: 骑上被俘虏的鳄鱼前往雾语村，向瑟匹克寻求下一步的指示。$B$B如果你弄丢了瑟匹克的狩猎号角，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 瑟匹克是狂心氏族最优秀的猎手。他擅长狩猎大舌头怪……嗯，就是沼泽地里那群什么东西都要偷的丑八怪。$B$B瑟匹克打算出趟远门，摧毁大舌头怪的祭坛，把它们统统吓跑。我们要把这些家伙赶出这片土地。$B$B狂心岭的东北边锁着一只鳄鱼，就在大树旁——你和瑟匹克一起去，照他说的做就是了。
text.progress: They tell Zepik you good hunter for not being Frenzyheart.
text.completion: We here! Must work fast. Watch out for big-tongues.
text.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

english.title: A Rough Ride
english.objectives: Ride the captive crocolisk to Mistwhisper Refuge and then speak to Zepik for further instructions.$B$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Zepik is best hunter of the Frenzyheart. Zepik hunts big-tongues... ugly things near swamps that try to steal all stuff they can find.$B$BZepik going on long trek to break big-tongue shrine and try to scare them away. We no want big-tongues in this land anymore.$B$BThere a crocolisk chained on northeast side of hill, next to tree - go with Zepik and do what Zepik tell you.
english.progress: They tell Zepik you good hunter for not being Frenzyheart.
english.completion: We here! Must work fast. Watch out for big-tongues.
english.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

starters.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 闪电确实两次打中同一个地方！
text.objectives: 瑟匹克要你在雾语天气祭坛前敲碎通天水晶簇。$B$B如果你弄丢了瑟匹克的狩猎号角，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 嗯，说到水晶……$B$B大舌头怪使用水晶为天气祭坛充能。瑟匹克并不清楚其中的原理，但是一旦它们用错了水晶，就会风雨大作！$B$B原本呢，瑟匹克打算悄悄地潜入一座祭坛，结果却并不顺利。所以啊，还是拉上你一起去比较好！$B$B把这些水晶放在祭坛附近，然后击碎它们，释放其中的能量。瑟匹克也不确定会发生什么事，打破水晶之后你最好躲远点。
text.progress: Zepik think this go much better with partner. You strong for not Frenzyheart.
text.completion: It work so good! You see lightning smash that oracle guy? So good!
text.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

english.title: Lightning Definitely Strikes Twice
english.objectives: Zepik wants you to smash the Skyreach Crystal Clusters in front of the Mistwhisper weather shrine.$B$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Okay, the crystal things...$B$BThe big-tongues use the crystals to power their rain shrines. Zepik not know quite how it works, but Zepik does know that if they use wrong crystals, the clouds and the rain go crazy!$B$BZepik tried to sneak in at one of their other rain shrines, but it not go so well. It sure to go much better with two!$B$BTake crystals, place at big stone pillar shrine thing, then smash them to release power. Zepik not sure what will happen, so might want to step back after.
english.progress: Zepik think this go much better with partner. You strong for not Frenzyheart.
english.completion: It work so good! You see lightning smash that oracle guy? So good!
english.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

text.title: 猎杀雾语鳄鱼人
text.objectives: 瑟匹克要你去杀死12个雾语鳄鱼人。$B$B如果你弄丢了瑟匹克的狩猎号角，就去找狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克。
text.description: 杀些猩猩和蓝蜂有什么意思啊！狩猎大舌头怪才好玩呢！$B$B在我们破坏天气祭坛的同时，不如趁机多杀几只大舌头怪。这样它们就不敢再来我们的地盘惹事啦。$B$B<瑟匹克自信地点了点头。>
text.progress: We best hunters of basin!
text.completion: I stab those big-tongues good. You did okay I guess. No, I just kidding! You good hunter. I glad to hunt with you.
text.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

english.title: The Mist Isn't Listening
english.objectives: Zepik wants you to kill 12 Mistwhisper Gorlocs.$B$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: Gorillas and wasps are boring! Big-tongues the only thing fun to hunt.$B$BWhile we mess up rain shrine, we kill lots of mist big-tongues. That sure to make them not want to come back to village thing.$B$B<Zepik nods to himself confidently.>
english.progress: We best hunters of basin!
english.completion: I stab those big-tongues good. You did okay I guess. No, I just kidding! You good hunter. I glad to hunt with you.
english.completed: Speak to Zepik the Gorloc Hunter. Zepik can be summoned using Zepik's Hunting Horn if he is not nearby.

text.title: 步行回家
text.objectives: 返回狂心岭，与高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克谈一谈。
text.description: 搞定啦！我们回去吧，不过这次没有鳄鱼骑了。唉，如果猎人也能像鳄鱼那样划水划得哗哗响，那我们就能自己游回去啦。$B$B这样吧，我们沿着山脊一路往东走，应该就能返回狂心岭。$B$B要是我们不小心偏离了山脊，很可能会撞上那些大舌头怪。瑟匹克觉得它们现在肯定不会善罢甘休。
text.completion: Blown up by lightning? You good hunter. Rakjak like you. Maybe one day you can be honorary Frenzyheart! Only maybe though!

english.title: Hoofing It
english.objectives: Find your way back to Frenzyheart Hill and speak to High-Shaman Rakjak.
english.description: Okay, we done! Time to go back. No crocolisk to ride this time though.$B$BIf we go east and stay near ridge, it should lead all the way back near hill.$B$BNeed to be careful not to go far below ridge though or we might go right into big-tongue tree village thing. Zepik not think they like us right now.
english.completion: Blown up by lightning? You good hunter. Rakjak like you. Maybe one day you can be honorary Frenzyheart! Only maybe though!

enders.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: 遵命行事
text.objectives: Locate an Injured Rainspeaker Oracle for High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$B
text.description: 那么，拉克亚克有个重要的任务要交给你。狂心氏族的猎手在北边的河流附近发现了一只受伤的大舌头怪，你去抓它回来。$B$B这次你独自上路吧，就别带上其他的猎手了。要是他们一时手痒，把它给剁了就不好办了。嗯，我想悄悄把这家伙囚禁起来，然后时不时去戳它眼睛，让它交待各种秘密。$B$B去吧，把那只大舌头怪带回来。
text.completion: No kill me please! We was just looking for fish. We not want to die.
text.completed: Speak to the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle north of Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Just Following Orders
english.objectives: Locate an Injured Rainspeaker Oracle for High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B$B
english.description: Okay $g guy:lady;, Rakjak have very important job. You go capture injured big-tongue that tracker spotted at river to north.$B$BNot bring hunter this time because they maybe want to just kill it. I want to hide it so that I can poke it and make it tell me things.$B$BGo you and bring me big-tongue prize thing.
english.completion: No kill me please! We was just looking for fish. We not want to die.
english.completed: Speak to the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle north of Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

starters.name: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克

text.title: Troll Patrol: The Alchemist's Apprentice
text.objectives: Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok wants you to assist him in the creation of a truth serum.$b$bWhen you are ready to begin, you are to speak to him and follow his instructions.
text.description: Ahh, you must be the promised patrol. Your timing couldn't be better. I have urgent need of an extra pair of hands.$b$bWe have a Drakkari prisoner who's been sent here to undergo questioning. Before the interrogation begins, I require assistance in the creation of a truth serum.$b$bCreating a truth serum is tricky business, demanding keen instincts, perfect timing, and improvisation at every step.$b$bLet me know when you're ready, $r. And remember, timing is everything!$B$B
text.progress: You see, $n, there is far more to true alchemy than mixing a few ingredients....
text.completion: You've done it! The intelligence gathered from that troll will undoubtedly be of great value. I'll be certain to make mention of your efforts in my report to the commander. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

english.objectives: Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok wants you to assist him in the creation of a truth serum.$b$bWhen you are ready to begin, you are to speak to him and follow his instructions.

text.title: 北伐军的召唤
text.objectives: Report to Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.$B$B
text.description: $C! The Argent Crusade is looking for able bodied soldiers that are willing to set aside their differences and join forces to battle the forces of the Lich King. Will you take up our cause?$B$BShould you be interested, venture north to Light's Trust and speak with Crusader Valus.$B$BYou will find Light's Trust amidst the ruins of the sacked troll city of Jintha'kalar - bordering Zul'Drak.$B$BFarewell.
text.completion: Mere footsteps from here lies the Drakkari empire. For thousands of years the Drakkari remained isolated, preferring to keep within the boundaries of their sprawling temple cities and ziggurats. It was surprising then, to come upon this wreckage. Further up, beyond the foreboding stairs leading into Zul'Drak, Drak'Tharon Keep lies in ruin. The entire first tier of Zul'Drak, destroyed... Why has the Scourge waited until now to attack?

english.title: The Call Of The Crusade
english.objectives: Report to Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.$B$B
english.description: $C! The Argent Crusade is looking for able bodied soldiers that are willing to set aside their differences and join forces to battle the forces of the Lich King. Will you take up our cause?$B$BShould you be interested, venture north to Light's Trust and speak with Crusader Valus.$B$BYou will find Light's Trust amidst the ruins of the sacked troll city of Jintha'kalar - bordering Zul'Drak.$B$BFarewell.
