text.title: 给索乌拉姆的祭品
text.objectives: 将5颗完整的眼镜蛇牙交给诺兹隆之骨附近的神谕者索乌拉姆。
text.description: 陌生人，我们并不认识你，但是我们知道你来此的目的。$B$B想要让我与诺兹隆之骨交谈，就必须奉上祭品。我们需要眼镜王蛇的毒牙来给神谕者制作项链。$B$B前往东北方的蛮藤谷吧，找到眼镜蛇，取回完整的毒牙。然后，我们自然会让你与诺兹隆之骨对话。
text.progress: We must know -- do you bring fangs?
text.completion: We approve! Bones of Nozronn will speak to $n!
text.completed: Return to Oracle Soo-rahm in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: An Offering for Soo-rahm
english.objectives: Bring 5 Intact Cobra Fangs to Oracle Soo-rahm, near the Bones of Nozronn.
english.description: We not know you, stranger, but we know you want something.$B$BWe will talk to Bones of Nozronn for you, but you must bring us offerings. We need powerful emperor cobra fangs to complete our oracle's necklace.$B$BGo to the Wildgrowth Mangal, northeast of our hut, find cobras and bring back best fangs. Then we make bones speak to you.
english.progress: We must know -- do you bring fangs?
english.completion: We approve! Bones of Nozronn will speak to $n!
english.completed: Return to Oracle Soo-rahm in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 诺兹隆之骨
text.objectives: 在诺兹隆之骨附近使用索乌拉姆的薰香，然后返回奈辛瓦里营地，向赫米特·奈辛瓦里汇报你得到的情报。
text.description: 诺兹隆之骨，神谕者索乌拉姆请求您为$N解惑！$B$B我们已经为你备好了薰香。你只需在诺兹隆的头部附近将它点燃，就能听到他的解答了。$B$B<你心中充满疑惑，对索乌拉姆说，你还没有说出是什么问题呢。>$B$B我们确实不知道你想问什么，但是伟大的诺兹隆知道。不用怀疑。诺兹隆会为你解答心中的一切疑问。$B$B去吧，别让诺兹隆等太久。
text.progress: Well, have you consulted the native oracle?
text.completion: Way to go, lad. No dead rhino tells Hemet Nesingwary where and what he can hunt. We'll show that heap o' bones.
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Bones of Nozronn
english.objectives: Use Soo-rahm's Incense near the Bones of Nozronn, then return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Base Camp with the information you learned.
english.description: Bones of Nozronn, Oracle Soo-rahm sends $N to you!$B$BWe have prepared incense for you. Light it and place it near Nozronn's head and you will hear his voice.$B$B<Confused, you tell Soo-rahm that you haven't even told him your question.>$B$BTrue, we not know, but mighty Nozronn does. Do not doubt. Nozronn will answer your heart's question.$B$BGo. Nozronn not wait long.
english.progress: Well, have you consulted the native oracle?
english.completion: Way to go, lad. No dead rhino tells Hemet Nesingwary where and what he can hunt. We'll show that heap o' bones.
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 净化金萨卡拉
text.objectives: 龙骨荒野圣光之望礼拜堂的北伐军战士瓦鲁斯要求你去消灭15个金萨卡拉天灾成员。
text.description: 我们从一群天灾侵略者手中夺回了这座古老的达卡莱神殿。不到一百码以外，就是金萨卡拉城的废墟。天灾通灵师在那里大肆杀戮，将活着的达卡莱巨魔转变为巫妖王的奴仆。$B$B所有的一切都不再属于圣光了，因此所有的一切都必须得到净化。$B$B<瓦鲁斯无情地看着你。>$B$B所有的一切。
text.progress: Leave nothing for the Lich King to resurrect!
text.completion: As you can see, the Scourge war machine presses onward, yet the armies of the Horde and the Alliance remain divided, making for easy prey. It is for this reason that we must remain united. The Argent Crusade has use for a man like you. Perhaps you would be interested in joining our cause? To battle and die at the side of the Ashbringer?
text.completed: Return to Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.

english.title: The Cleansing Of Jintha'kalar
english.objectives: Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight has asked you to slay 15 Jintha'kalar Scourge.
english.description: We wrested this ancient Drakkari temple from a swarm of invading Scourge. Not more than one-hundred paces from where we stand is the ruined city of Jintha'kalar. Scourge necromancers run amok, turning the living Drakkari trolls that remain into servants of the Lich King.$B$BAll are now lost to the Light. All must be purged.$B$B<Valus looks upon you sternly.>$B$BAll.
english.progress: Leave nothing for the Lich King to resurrect!
english.completion: As you can see, the Scourge war machine presses onward, yet the armies of the Horde and the Alliance remain divided, making for easy prey. It is for this reason that we must remain united. The Argent Crusade has use for a man like you. Perhaps you would be interested in joining our cause? To battle and die at the side of the Ashbringer?
english.completed: Return to Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.

text.title: 力挽狂澜
text.objectives: 前往索拉查盆地的雪崩山麓，使用欧米伽符文操纵源生石像，消灭200名天灾军团的爪牙、血肉塑造者拜休斯、千墓之魔乌格雷斯和海斯克恩。$B$B完成任务后与索拉查盆地的弗蕾亚的化身谈一谈。
text.description: 时机成熟了，$N。源生石像是泰坦的诸类造物中杀伤力最强的武器之一，我本不愿在这片圣洁的土地上释放他的力量。$B$B但是，我别无选择。入侵者已经将我逼入绝境，就让泰坦的怒火将他们烧得一干二净吧。
text.progress: Those who would threaten life... have they been dealt with?
text.completion: I am grateful for your help, $n.  It is my duty to watch over these lands and all life that dwells on them. Thanks to you, that life will continue to thrive while the forces of death wage in the bordering regions. Your actions will not be forgotten.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Reclamation
english.objectives: Go to the Avalanche in Sholazar Basin and use the Omega Rune to deploy Etymidian.  Use him to slay 200 Scourge Minions, Bythius the Flesh-Shaper, Urgreth of the Thousand Tombs and Hailscorn.$B$BSpeak to the Avatar of Freya in Sholazar Basin when you've completed this task.
english.description: It is time, $N.  The Etymidian is one of the most destructive forces ever created by the titans and I am loathe to unleash him in my lands.$B$BThere is little choice, however.  Our enemies have forced my hand and the fury of the titans will cleanse all.
english.progress: Those who would threaten life... have they been dealt with?
english.completion: I am grateful for your help, $n.  It is my duty to watch over these lands and all life that dwells on them. Thanks to you, that life will continue to thrive while the forces of death wage in the bordering regions. Your actions will not be forgotten.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 启动符文
text.objectives: 在塑造者之台内找到欧米伽符文，将它带至源生石像身边。
text.description: 这尊巨大的石像仿佛陷入了沉睡。你注意到它的胸前有一块符文形状的凹槽。$B$B或许你可以在附近找到那块失踪的符文。
text.progress: <The rune-shaped slot on The Etymidian's chest appears to glow with faint power.>
text.completion: I am needed somewhere?
text.completed: Return to The Etymidian in Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: The Activation Rune
english.objectives: Obtain the Omega Rune inside the Shaper's Terrace and bring it to The Etymidian.
english.description: This colossal being appears to be inactive.  You notice an empty rune-shaped slot on its chest.$B$BPerhaps you might be able to find the missing rune inside the nearby overlook.
english.progress: <The rune-shaped slot on The Etymidian's chest appears to glow with faint power.>
english.completion: I am needed somewhere?
english.completed: Return to The Etymidian in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 源生石像
text.objectives: 穿越索拉查盆地南端的界门，在另一侧寻找那件被称为源生石像的武器。
text.description: 时机成熟了，$N。封闭了七个世纪之久的界门已经打开。穿越界门，去寻找我们最后的希望。$B$B将那些企图玷污这片神圣土地的渣滓送入地狱。让我们释放源生石像的力量吧！
text.completion: <As you read the engravings on this stone colossus, you realize that this is the weapon that Freya spoke of. This is the Etymidian.>

english.title: The Etymidian
english.objectives: Go through the Waygate in the southern end of Sholazar Basin and look for the weapon known as the Etymidian on the other side.
english.description: It is time, $N.  The Waygate has been activated for the first time in seven centuries.  Use it to travel to where our final hope lies.$B$BLet us put an end to those who would seek to bring the taint of undeath to this pristine land.  Let us unleash the Etymidian.
english.completion: <As you read the engravings on this stone colossus, you realize that this is the weapon that Freya spoke of. This is the Etymidian.>

text.title: 狩猎恶刃豹：成为猎手
text.objectives: 杀死15只恶刃豹，然后向奈辛瓦里营地的巴克·坎维尔复命。
text.description: 如果你和赫米特一起打过猎的话，就该知道他能轻而易举地应付多种大型猫科动物。但是索拉查盆地的恶刃豹却不然，这种凶残而敏捷的野兽比我见过的所有猫科动物都要凶狠。只有真正的猎手，才能征服这样的猎物。$B$B如果你愿意接受挑战，就勇敢地面对恶刃豹吧。营地四周的荒野以及河流南岸都有它们的踪迹。
text.progress: Have you tested your skills against the dreadsabers?
text.completion: Well, you've proven yourself a capable hunter, but how are you as a tracker?
text.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Becoming a Predator
english.objectives: Kill 15 Dreadsabers and return to Buck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: If you've hunted with Hemet before, you know that he's tested his skill against many large cats, but the dreadsabers here in Sholazar are different. They're able to bring down larger game than I've ever seen a cat hunt. To overcome and kill such a predator is the mark of a true hunter.$B$BIf you seek to prove you're up to the challenge, test yourself against the dreadsabers. They live in the wilderness surrounding the camp and south of the river.
english.progress: Have you tested your skills against the dreadsabers?
english.completion: Well, you've proven yourself a capable hunter, but how are you as a tracker?
english.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 狩猎恶刃豹：追踪猎物
text.objectives: 奈辛瓦里营地的巴克·坎维尔要你从苦潮湖附近的恶刃豹足迹中鉴别出3条杉苟的足迹。
text.description: 我曾听这里的土著提到过一只名叫杉苟的巨型恶刃豹，据说它相当富有传奇色彩。可惜我至今也没发现这家伙存在的证据。你看，我身负重伤，自然是没法离开营地进行实地调查的。$B$B如果你自认为在追踪方面有丰富经验的话，不如帮我去探寻这件事的真相吧。蒂巴尔说她上次外出时发现了一些大脚印。我要你前往营地北边的苦潮湖，在湖的南岸搜寻恶刃豹的脚印。
text.progress: How goes the tracking?
text.completion: I think you may have found the proof we need for this Shango. And I think I have an idea as to where we can find him.
text.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Stalking the Prey
english.objectives: Buck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to identify 3 Shango Tracks from the Dreadsaber Tracks near Bittertide Lake.
english.description: I have heard that the natives tell stories of a large dreadsaber they call Shango. I haven't seen any evidence of this Shango's existence, but my injuries have kept me from venturing outside the camp.$B$BIf you fancy yourself something of a tracker, you might be able to find out the truth about Shango. Debaar said she saw some large tracks on her last outing. Go north from the camp toward Bittertide Lake, and search its southern shore for the prints.
english.progress: How goes the tracking?
english.completion: I think you may have found the proof we need for this Shango. And I think I have an idea as to where we can find him.
english.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 狩猎鳄鱼：试炼
text.objectives: 杀死15条蛮藤谷鳄鱼，然后向奈辛瓦里营地的蒂巴尔复命。
text.description: 陌生人，我警告你：禁止对沉船的事情做任何评论。探险队那帮喋喋不休的家伙已经令我不胜其烦了。$B$B不过，如果你只是想检验一下自己的狩猎技术，我建议你先用蛮藤谷鳄鱼试试身手。这些狡猾的野兽生活在南边的河流沿岸，以及东边的蛮藤谷。去展示一下你的实力，然后再来找我谈谈。
text.progress: Did you make the kills?
text.completion: Impressive, $c. Are you certain you're not a member of the expedition? No, I'm certain of it. There would've been a crash joke in there somewhere.
text.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Trial
english.objectives: Kill 15 Mangal Crocolisks and return to Debaar at the Nesingwary Encampment.
english.description: I warn you, stranger -- do not make any comments about crashing the ship. I already get enough of it from the rest of the expedition.$B$BIf you're looking to try your hand at hunting, though, you should test your skills against the wily mangal crocolisks. They live all along the river to the south, and in the Wildgrowth Mangal to the east. Prove you can hold your own against them and we'll talk again, hunter.
english.progress: Did you make the kills?
english.completion: Impressive, $c. Are you certain you're not a member of the expedition? No, I'm certain of it. There would've been a crash joke in there somewhere.
english.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 通灵师之死
text.objectives: 达克索塔的穆尔沙·月影中士要你去杀死8个哈沙尔通灵师。
text.description: 当巨魔们推倒科尔拉玛斯的时候，它就倒在我们的东南面。不幸的时候，当它倒塌的时候，里面的天灾军团并没有死绝。$B$B现在他们正在复活我们的士兵，并用他们来对付我们！$B$B我们必须阻止这种事。你一定要杀死他们的通灵师！明白了吗？
text.progress: No, $c, you're not quite done. I know for a fact that there are still necromagi walking around at Kolramas.
text.completion: It's not enough! We must do more to show respect for the memories of those men!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Death to the Necromagi
english.objectives: Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra has asked you to destroy 8 Hath'ar Necromagi.
english.description: When the trolls brought down Kolramas, it crashed next to us to the southeast. Unfortunately the crash did not destroy all of the Scourge within.$B$BNow they're raising our men from the dead and using them against us!$B$BThis will not be allowed to continue. You will see to it that their necromagi are slaughtered! Do we understand each other?
english.progress: No, $c, you're not quite done. I know for a fact that there are still necromagi walking around at Kolramas.
english.completion: It's not enough! We must do more to show respect for the memories of those men!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 撒网者的喷丝头
text.objectives: 达克索塔的专家考格维尔要你去收集5个完整的撒网者喷丝头。
text.description: 为什么最棘手的任务总是派给我？$B$B科尔拉玛斯的天灾军团已经把药剂喷射器派到了离我们很近的地方，这是非常危险的。你无法想象如果他们朝这里来的话，会发生什么事！$B$B我有一个办法可以解决他们，但首先我们需要一些材料……要从天灾军团那里去弄。$B$B哈沙尔撒网者可以织出一种非常坚韧的网，正好为我们所用。给我带一些完整的喷丝头回来。
text.progress: Those spinnerets have to be intact if I'm going to be able to put them together into a device that you can use.
text.completion: Those'll do! Now we're going to need some raw parts so that I can put the launching device together for you.
text.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Skimmer Spinnerets
english.objectives: Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to collect 5 Intact Skimmer Spinnerets.
english.description: Why do I always get the tough tasks to tackle?$B$BThe Scourge at Kolramas have plague sprayers that are getting dangerously close. You don't want to know what's going to happen if they start heading this way!$B$BI've got an idea for how we might bring them down, but first we're going to need something... something from their own creatures.$B$BThe Hath'ar skimmers can spin a very strong web that we can put to good use. Bring back some of their spinnerets.
english.progress: Those spinnerets have to be intact if I'm going to be able to put them together into a device that you can use.
english.completion: Those'll do! Now we're going to need some raw parts so that I can put the launching device together for you.
english.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 腐蚀者玛拉斯
text.objectives: 达克索塔的穆尔沙·月影中士要你带回腐蚀者的徽记。
text.description: $N, gather at least one other person and head back down there!$B$BYou'll find the leader of Kolramas, Malas the Corrupter, gloating from atop the crashed necropolis.$B$BKill him and bring me his head!
text.progress: I look forward to mounting his head on a pike. Let's see him come back from that!
text.completion: You're the hero of the hour, $n. You deserve our deepest respect, and something more I think.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Malas the Corrupter
english.objectives: Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra insists that you return with the Head of the Corrupter.
english.description: $N, gather at least one other person and head back down there!$B$BYou'll find the leader of Kolramas, Malas the Corrupter, gloating from atop the crashed necropolis.$B$BKill him and bring me his head!
english.progress: I look forward to mounting his head on a pike. Let's see him come back from that!
english.completion: You're the hero of the hour, $n. You deserve our deepest respect, and something more I think.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 缠绕投网器
text.objectives: 达克索塔的专家考格维尔要你使用缠绕投网器摧毁5台药剂喷射器。
text.description: 好了！投网器已经完成，你可以用它去摧毁那些药剂喷射器了。$B$B你只需要瞄准并按下发射键，蛛网就会扰乱它们的浮空法术，直到那些喷雾器像科尔拉玛斯一样坠毁。$B$B多有诗意啊。我喜欢！
text.progress: You sure you brought down enough of those things? Do I look like I want the plague?!
text.completion: Yay! You're the best, $n! I wasn't looking forward to being sprayed with Scourge stuff, that's for sure! I guess it's going to be hard for those stupid nerubians to spread their evil now! How about I give you a little something for saving my skin?
text.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: A Tangled Skein
english.objectives: Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to use the Tangled Skein Thrower in order to cause the destruction of 5 Plague Sprayers.
english.description: There! One tangled skein thrower ready and waiting for you to take those plague sprayers down.$B$BYou just aim and let loose. The webbing should foul up their hover spells long enough to cause them to crash to the ground just like Kolramas.$B$BKind of poetic. I like that!
english.progress: You sure you brought down enough of those things? Do I look like I want the plague?!
english.completion: Yay! You're the best, $n! I wasn't looking forward to being sprayed with Scourge stuff, that's for sure! I guess it's going to be hard for those stupid nerubians to spread their evil now! How about I give you a little something for saving my skin?
english.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 狩猎犀牛：终极决战
text.objectives: 将法鲁恩的犄角交给奈辛瓦里营地的赫米特·奈辛瓦里。
text.description: 我们已经得知法鲁恩的行踪，现在就和这头巨兽来一场惊天动地的决斗吧。$N，你愿意接受挑战吗？从丛林之魂的躁动中，我可以感受到法鲁恩的强大力量。$B$B等你做好准备之后，就往北穿过日灼之柱，在苦潮湖的东北岸寻找法鲁恩。它有时甚至会在光芒之柱附近出没。杀死法鲁恩后，把它的角带回来。
text.progress: Did you kill the beast?
text.completion: An astounding trophy from an amazing animal! $n, I've been hearing rumors of even bigger, more ferocious game in the northern reaches of the basin and I'd like you to help us track it down.
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Rhino Mastery: The Kill
english.objectives: Bring Farunn's Horn to Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: Now that we know where to find Farunn, all that remains is the battle against the great beast. Are you ready to take on this rhino, $N? For all the spirit's blustering, I'm certain it was telling the truth about the beast's strength.$B$BWhen you're ready to face him, head north past the Suntouched Pillar and look for Farunn on the northeast shore of the Bittertide Lake. It may even venture near the Glimmering Pillar. Bring back its horn to commemorate your kill.
english.progress: Did you kill the beast?
english.completion: An astounding trophy from an amazing animal! $n, I've been hearing rumors of even bigger, more ferocious game in the northern reaches of the basin and I'd like you to help us track it down.
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 实验室的学徒
text.objectives: 赫布瓦罗的炼金师菲肯斯坦要求你在他的实验室内找到一只泥潭蛆虫、一片干瘪的蝙蝠翼、一粒琥珀种子和一些冰冷的毒蛇粘液。
text.description: 我猜，你也是想要成为我的学徒吧。$B$B很好，年轻人很有志气……$B$B但是我是否会接受你的申请，取决于你到底都能为我做什么，能在我的实验室里帮到什么忙了。你看，这里面有无数的材料，有些备料充足，有些就短缺了。$B$B那么，$C，你得花点时间帮我找点东西。我要一只泥潭蛆虫、一片干瘪的蝙蝠翼、一粒琥珀种子和一些冰冷的毒蛇粘液。$B$B都找到的话，我就认真考虑你的请求。
text.progress: Have you become accustomed to my laboratory, $c?
text.completion: Yes, yes, that's a good start. Should I call upon you to help me with an actual recipe, you'll need to locate ingredients in a timely manner. Keep that in mind, $c. Farewell.
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Lab Work
english.objectives: Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok wants you to find a Muddy Mire Maggot, a Withered Batwing, an Amberseed, and some Chilled Serpent Mucus from within his laboratory.
english.description: I assume by your interruption that you wish to be numbered among those I am considering for apprenticeship.$b$bA worthy aspiration...$b$bShould I someday choose to accept your petition, I must be confident that you can find your way around my laboratory. I have many ingredients here; some plentiful, and others in short supply.$b$bTake your time, $c. Find a muddy mire maggot, a withered batwing, an amberseed, and some chilled serpent mucus.$b$bSucceed, and I'll know to take your request seriously.
english.progress: Have you become accustomed to my laboratory, $c?
english.completion: Yes, yes, that's a good start. Should I call upon you to help me with an actual recipe, you'll need to locate ingredients in a timely manner. Keep that in mind, $c. Farewell.
english.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 狩猎恶刃豹：突然袭击
text.objectives: 将杉苟的毛皮交给奈辛瓦里营地的巴克·坎维尔。
text.description: $N，杉苟在等着你呢。只要你的追踪技术够娴熟，它就不会发现你，这样你就可以取得先手了。$B$B与索拉查盆地的其它恶刃豹相比，杉苟的体型应该更大，性情也更加凶残。往北走，你可以在苦潮湖西岸的瀑布附近找到杉苟的踪迹，向它发起挑战吧。如果你获胜了，就把它的毛皮给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you taken on Shango?
text.completion: What an exquisite pelt from such a noble animal! It heartens me to see that the rumors about Shango were indeed true, $n. Your pursuit of the creature has been flawless. You are a true huntsman.
text.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Ready to Pounce
english.objectives: Bring Shango's Pelt to Buck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: Shango awaits, $N. If you have succeeded in your tracking, he will not know that you stalk him, and you will need the advantage.$B$BHe is supposed to be bigger, stronger, and more ferocious than the other dreadsabers of the basin. Travel north, to the western shore of Bittertide Lake and near the falls that feed it, do battle with Shango. If you succeed, return with his pelt.
english.progress: Have you taken on Shango?
english.completion: What an exquisite pelt from such a noble animal! It heartens me to see that the rumors about Shango were indeed true, $n. Your pursuit of the creature has been flawless. You are a true huntsman.
english.completed: Return to Buck Cantwell at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 开启界门 - 造物者之座
text.objectives: The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to go to the Makers' Perch and use the Activation Switch Gamma.
text.description: It is time then.  Let us activate the waygate.$B$BYou will find the first switch inside the Makers' Perch in the western edge of the basin.$B$BBeware, $N.  The titans used the perch to watch over their creations.  Many of their stone servants still guard the place.
text.progress: You're back, little one. I was beginning to worry about your well-being.
text.completion: We're halfway there, $n.  One more switch needs to be activated before we can retrieve the Etymidian.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Powering the Waygate - The Makers' Perch
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to go to the Makers' Perch and use the Activation Switch Gamma.
english.description: It is time then.  Let us activate the waygate.$B$BYou will find the first switch inside the Makers' Perch in the western edge of the basin.$B$BBeware, $N.  The titans used the perch to watch over their creations.  Many of their stone servants still guard the place.
english.progress: You're back, little one. I was beginning to worry about your well-being.
english.completion: We're halfway there, $n.  One more switch needs to be activated before we can retrieve the Etymidian.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 狩猎鳄鱼：计划
text.objectives: 将5片沙蕨叶交给奈辛瓦里营地的蒂巴尔。
text.description: 蛮藤谷鳄鱼擅长偷袭猎物，我打算以牙还牙，就用这招来对付它们。因此，我们得为你制作一件完美的伪装。材料嘛，最好用生长在河边湖畔沙地上的沙蕨。$B$B它非常适合制作伪装。喏，南边的碎浪河，北边的苦潮湖和苦潮瀑布，以及东边的河流之心，这些河流或是湖泊附近的沙地上就有这种植物。
text.progress: Did you bring all the ferns we'll need?
text.completion: Yes, this should work. Stand still! We'll make a bush of you yet.
text.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Plan
english.objectives: Bring 5 Sandfern fronds to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: The mangal crocolisk is a master of the ambush, and I intend to beat the best at his game. To do that, we'll need to construct a convincing camouflage for you. We'll use plants that grow in the sandy soil of the riverbanks and lake beaches.$B$BThe sandfern is best for this purpose. It grows in the sandy areas near the shores of the Seabreach Flow, just to the south, Bittertide Lake and Bittertide Falls, to the north, and the edges of River's Heart, the large lake beyond the mangal to the east.
english.progress: Did you bring all the ferns we'll need?
english.completion: Yes, this should work. Stand still! We'll make a bush of you yet.
english.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 信任危机
text.objectives: 进入迷失之地，消灭6个损毁的天灾怪和10个骨镰劫掠者，以此获得弗蕾亚的信任。
text.description: 这一切本不该发生的。亡灵大军如风暴般席卷了这处生命的摇篮！$B$B如果你的来意不是铲除巫妖王的爪牙，就请立即离开。若是再打扰我，必将招致我的愤怒与憎恶。
text.progress: Do not waste my time, mortal.  The titans' creations must be defended!
text.completion: Very well, $r.  I am satisfied that you're not one of the Lich King's minions... perhaps there is something you can do for us after all.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: An Issue of Trust
english.objectives: Obtain Freya's trust by destroying 6 Blighted Corpses and 10 Bonescythe Ravagers in the Lost Lands.
english.description: This should never have happened.  The forces of undeath storm the very cradle of life!$B$BIf you're not here to destroy the minions of the Lich King, then leave at once.  Do not incur my wrath by distracting me from my duties.
english.progress: Do not waste my time, mortal.  The titans' creations must be defended!
english.completion: Very well, $r.  I am satisfied that you're not one of the Lich King's minions... perhaps there is something you can do for us after all.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 达卡莱巨魔不需要水元素！
text.objectives: 银色前沿的亚克斯中尉要求你去消灭10名达卡莱缚水者。
text.description: 根据情报，自从那些水元素在达克索塔农田出现以后，大量达卡莱萨满祭司从祖达克上层赶过来控制他们。$B$B不是我罗嗦，$G先生:女士;，但这实在是太危险了。我们不希望水元素受到他们的支配。$B$B指挥官已经下令处死这些达卡莱缚水者。等你准备好了，就去南面动手吧。
text.progress: If I may suggest, you might want to take care of a few more of those Drakkari water binders.
text.completion: Excellent work, sir! I'll see to it that the commander is apprised of your mission results.
text.completed: Return to Sub-Lieutenant Jax at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Drakkari Do Not Need Water Elementals!
english.objectives: Sub-Lieutenant Jax at The Argent Stand has asked you to kill 10 Drakkari Water Binders.
english.description: Intelligence reports that ever since those water elementals appeared in the Drak'Sotra Fields, a number of Drakkari shaman have come down from the upper tiers of Zul'Drak to take control of them.$B$BI cannot stress enough, $g sir : ma'am;, how dangerous that could prove. We do not want them to have water elementals at their disposal.$B$BThe commander has ordered that these Drakkari water binders are to be put to the sword. Head south when you're ready.
english.progress: If I may suggest, you might want to take care of a few more of those Drakkari water binders.
english.completion: Excellent work, sir! I'll see to it that the commander is apprised of your mission results.
english.completed: Return to Sub-Lieutenant Jax at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 巡逻员
text.objectives: 银色前沿的指挥官库恩斯要你拜访四座银色北伐军的岗哨，并完成那里的上尉交给你的任务，然后回去向他复命。$B$B布兰顿上尉和鲁伯特上尉驻扎在达克索塔。格隆迪尔上尉驻扎在达克迦尔。炼金师菲肯斯坦驻扎在赫布瓦罗。
text.description: 拔出你的武器，$R。巡逻的时候到了！$B$B我们要拼死保住手中的四座岗哨，这对我们取得胜利有着关键性的意义。我要你去逐一巡查这几处岗哨，并向他们提供帮助。$B$B你可以从东南方的布兰顿上尉那里开始。等你完成他指派的任务后，他就会指引你去下一座岗哨。$B$B巡查完所有四座岗哨后再回来向我复命。记住——你回来得越快，报酬就越丰厚！所以给我动作麻利一点！$B$B解散！
text.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
text.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
text.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol
english.objectives: Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$b$bCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok.
english.description: Unsheathe that weapon, $r. It's time to go on patrol!$b$bI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$b$bYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$b$bReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$b$bDismissed!
english.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
english.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
english.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Something for the Pain
text.objectives: 达克索塔的布兰顿上尉希望你从达克索塔农田采集5份成熟的水罂粟。
text.description: 我的弟兄们虽然坚韧勇猛，但他们毕竟是血肉之躯。$B$B受伤和疼痛削弱了他们完成任务的能力，没有什么训练或者诀窍可以改变这一点。$B$B值得欣慰的是，我们的炼金师发明了一种药膏，与我们的绷带一起使用的话，可以大大缓解士兵的疼痛。$B$B药膏需要用到一种特殊的罂粟，正好这里的巨魔在西边的达克索塔农田中种了不少。去采一些罂粟回来，以保证我们的库存充足。
text.progress: Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
text.completion: Fine specimens, $n. On behalf of my soldiers, I thank you for your efforts today. Captain Rupert is likely the next stop on your patrol. He's stationed at the wall just east of here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol: Something for the Pain
english.objectives: Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra wants you to collect 5 Mature Water-Poppies from Drak'Sotra Fields.
english.description: Gritty as my men are, they're still mortal.$b$bWounds and pain diminish their ability to perform their missions. No amount of training changes that simple fact of life.$b$bThankfully, one of our alchemists has developed a recipe for a salve that binds to our bandages and greatly reduces the pain our soldiers experience.$b$bThe salve requires a special poppy these trolls cultivate just west of here. Go to Drak'Sotra Fields and harvest some of them to keep our stockpiles from running out.
english.progress: Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
english.completion: Fine specimens, $n. On behalf of my soldiers, I thank you for your efforts today. Captain Rupert is likely the next stop on your patrol. He's stationed at the wall just east of here.
english.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 希姆埃巴的祝福
text.objectives: 银色前沿的妖术师乌布戈要求你在希姆埃巴的雕像前奉上10份达卡莱供品。
text.description: 你们的银色北伐军在消灭天灾这件事情上表现出了极大的热诚，这让我非常感动，$R。我很愿意助你们一臂之力。$B$B达卡莱巨魔曾经在这座盛极一时的城市中定期供奉他们的神灵，而现在他们非但对神灵毫无敬意，甚至表现得更糟糕了。$B$B如果你去供奉神灵的话，他们一定会对你表示感谢的。$B$B希姆埃巴的雕像就在这里的西南面，强大的希姆埃巴会接受你供奉的达卡莱圣物，作为你正在保护祖达克的证明。
text.progress: <Zim'Abwa stares inscrutably to the north and the south.>
text.completion: <If Zim'Abwa could move his face, Zim'Abwa would make a vicious grin.>
text.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Abwa, southwest of Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Blessing of Zim'Abwa
english.objectives: Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Abwa.
english.description: I am heartened to see the zeal with which your Argent Crusade is dealing with the Scourge, $r. I would like to help with your efforts.$B$BThe Drakkari trolls of this once-great city used to make regular offerings to their gods, but now neglect them, or worse.$B$BIf you were to make offerings to the gods, they would show their appreciation in return.$B$BZim'Abwa's statue is just to the southwest. Zim'Abwa would gladly accept your offerings of Drakkari artifacts as a sign that you are protecting Zul'Drak.
english.progress: <Zim'Abwa stares inscrutably to the north and the south.>
english.completion: <If Zim'Abwa could move his face, Zim'Abwa would make a vicious grin.>
english.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Abwa, southwest of Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 增援冬蹄营地
text.objectives: 与冬蹄营地的灰烬图腾酋长谈一谈。
text.description: 我是牦牛人远行者纳尼克，冬蹄营地的酋长派我来寻找同盟以对抗维库人。他们从我们村子的西面和南面大举进攻，虽然我们的勇士以一当十，勇猛作战，但也快要坚持不下去了。$B$B药剂师塞利斯答应派出勇敢的$C去帮助我们，你会帮助我的人民抵挡维库人的进攻吗？$B$B沿着这条路一直往西北走，穿过河流，冬蹄营地就在山脚下。
text.completion: So, Nanik did find help then? Tell me, $n, how is it you made it here without him? None know this land better than the Taunka.

english.title: Help for Camp Winterhoof
english.objectives: Speak with Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
english.description: I am Longrunner Nanik of the Taunka, sent by the chieftain of Camp Winterhoof to seek out allies in the fight against the vrykul. They mass to the west and south of our village, and though we slay 10 of them for every one of our dead, we cannot hold.$B$BApothecary Scyllis has promised to send brave $cs northwest to our aid. Will you help my people fend off the vrykul assaults?$B$BFollow the road far to the northwest, across the river, and into the foothills of the mountains to reach Camp Winterhoof.
english.completion: So, Nanik did find help then? Tell me, $n, how is it you made it here without him? None know this land better than the Taunka.

text.title: 希姆埃巴的祝福
text.completed: Return to Zim'Abwa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Blessing of Zim'Abwa
english.completed: Return to Zim'Abwa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Done to Death
text.objectives: Captain Rupert wants you to use the Incinerating Oil on 5 Defeated Argent Footmen in Drak'Sotra.
text.description: Trust me, $r. I know....$b$bThe smell of burnt flesh has become sickening to even me, a Forsaken. Nevertheless, it is our solemn duty to ensure that our brethren never walk with the Scourge.$b$bPour this oil on the corpses of our fallen to ensure that we never face them on the battlefield as enemies.
text.completion: Thank you, $n. It's not the most glorious job on the battlefield, but it must be done. I'll make note of your service in my report. Captain Grondel is likely waiting for you to the northeast, just outside the amphitheater.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol: Done to Death
english.objectives: Captain Rupert wants you to use the Incinerating Oil on 5 Defeated Argent Footmen in Drak'Sotra.
english.description: Trust me, $r. I know....$b$bThe smell of burnt flesh has become sickening to even me, a Forsaken. Nevertheless, it is our solemn duty to ensure that our brethren never walk with the Scourge.$b$bPour this oil on the corpses of our fallen to ensure that we never face them on the battlefield as enemies.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. It's not the most glorious job on the battlefield, but it must be done. I'll make note of your service in my report. Captain Grondel is likely waiting for you to the northeast, just outside the amphitheater.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 狩猎鳄鱼：伏击
text.objectives: 将丛林霸王的颚骨交给奈辛瓦里营地的蒂巴尔。
text.description: 说起那条称霸水域的巨鳄，偷袭猎物的本事可高明着呢。我们都叫它“丛林霸王”，这家伙喜欢趴在河流之心的浅滩上晒太阳。喏，出了营地一路往东，河流之心就位于盆地中央，那可是索拉查盆地最大的一片湖泊。$B$B我要你带上这件伪装，埋伏在河流之心的西岸，看准机会向丛林霸王发动突袭。如果你能获胜的话，就将它的颚骨带回来。
text.progress: Did our plan work?
text.completion: What do you mean, our plan didn't work as intended? Well, you did manage to get the kill, to your credit. Look at the size of this jaw! Hemet will be proud of our efforts. This crocolisk was truly a monster.
text.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Ambush
english.objectives: Bring Bushwhacker's Jaw to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: The largest crocolisk in the basin, known around here as "Bushwhacker" for his ambush prowess, likes to sun himself in the shallow waters of River's Heart. It's the large lake at the basin's center, and is to the east of our camp.$B$BI want you to take the camouflage I've prepared and hide on the western beach of River's Heart and ambush Bushwhacker when he shows himself. Bring back his mighty jaws if you are able to overcome him.
english.progress: Did our plan work?
english.completion: What do you mean, our plan didn't work as intended? Well, you did manage to get the kill, to your credit. Look at the size of this jaw! Hemet will be proud of our efforts. This crocolisk was truly a monster.
english.completed: Return to Debaar at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 幸福的误会
text.objectives: Escort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspeaker Canopy and speak to High-Oracle Soo-say.
text.description: 真是抱歉！我不想让你惹上麻烦！$B$B<受伤的雨声神谕者困惑地盯着你看了一会儿。>$B$B你救了我！谢谢你。我们这就返回村落。一起走吧……可以结伴同行！反正那些狗狗人很讨厌。$B$B如果你准备好了，就告诉我一声。
text.progress: Who you? You stink of puppy-men.
text.completion: You help us? You welcome then, dryskin.
text.end: Escort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspaker Canopy
text.completed: Speak to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Fortunate Misunderstandings
english.objectives: Escort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspeaker Canopy and speak to High-Oracle Soo-say.
english.description: I sorry! I not mean to get you in trouble!$B$B<The injured oracle stares at you blankly for a long while.>$B$BYou save me! We thank you. We going to go back to village now. You come too... you can stay with us! Puppy-men kind of mean anyway.$B$BLet me know when you ready to go, okay?
english.progress: Who you? You stink of puppy-men.
english.completion: You help us? You welcome then, dryskin.
english.end: Escort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspaker Canopy
english.completed: Speak to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 赶走坏蛇
text.objectives: 雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞要你杀死毒尖和10条帝王眼镜蛇。$B$B如果你弄丢了拉弗乌的虫袋，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 很久之前我们就生活在这里啦，那些狗狗人是后来才跑来的。这里非常神圣——我们才不要离开。$B$B你看上去倒是挺有本事的，不过还是让拉弗乌待在你身边以防万一吧。希望你能理解我们的决定。$B$B眼镜蛇一直在偷吃我们的宝宝。你和拉弗乌一起去阻止它们，尤其要除掉东北方瀑布附近那条巨型眼镜蛇。
text.progress: <High-Oracle Soo-say seems to stare right through you.>
text.completion: Snake gone? Good $r. We thank you.
text.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Make the Bad Snake Go Away
english.objectives: High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to kill Venomtip and 10 Emperor Cobras.$B$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: We were here long before the puppy-men came. This is very sacred place - we will not leave.$B$BYou seem like maybe you good, but we have Lafoo stay with you just in case. You understand we think.$B$BThere snakes thing that keeps trying to eat our hatchlings. Go with Lafoo and make them stop, okay? Especially big one near waterfall to northeast.
english.progress: <High-Oracle Soo-say seems to stare right through you.>
english.completion: Snake gone? Good $r. We thank you.
english.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 神祗喜欢亮闪闪的东西
text.objectives: 收集6份拉弗乌从土堆里挖出的闪闪发亮的宝贝，将它们交给雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。$B$B如果你弄丢了拉弗乌的虫袋，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 索乌塞让我们待在你身边。你会很友好的，对吧？$B$B啊！对啦！如果我们能为祭坛奉上更多祭品的话，肯定能哄索乌塞开心！我们不用走太远，村子附近就能挖到合适的祭品……留意土堆中发光的东西！$B$B走吧！走吧！去弄祭品！
text.progress: Hello dryskin. You get along with Lafoo good?
text.completion: Shinies for the Great Rain Stone! Good! Good! We offer these right away. Lafoo thought of this, yes? He a very smart Rainspeaker.
text.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Gods like Shiny Things
english.objectives: Collect 6 of the treasures that Lafoo digs up and bring them to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.$B$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: Soo-say said we go with you. You be nice, okay?$B$BOoh, ooh! We know! We can make Soo-say happy if we bring back more offerings for shrine! We not need to go far, there's always stuffs to dig up around village... just look for sparkles in dirt!$B$BLet's go! Let's go! More offerings for shrine!
english.progress: Hello dryskin. You get along with Lafoo good?
english.completion: Shinies for the Great Rain Stone! Good! Good! We offer these right away. Lafoo thought of this, yes? He a very smart Rainspeaker.
english.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 议和
text.objectives: 雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞要你将雨声议和礼物交给萨满祭司维克伊克，然后转达他的回应。$B$B如果你弄丢了拉弗乌的虫袋，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 我们有个想法。既然你以前是狗狗人的朋友，他们或许会听你的。$B$B你能不能去为萨满祭司维克伊克奉上一份礼品啊？他就在西南边，河流变成瀑布的地方。告诉狗狗人，我们不想打仗。我们愿意友好相处。$B$B去吧，$R。这件事就交给你办啦。
text.progress: Puppy-men play nice now?
text.completion: So mean! We only be nice and they only be mean. They keep messing with great stones... maybe they not know great stones are sacred.
text.end: Extend Peace Offering to Shaman Vekjik
text.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Making Peace
english.objectives: High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to give a peace offering to Shaman Vekjik and then return with his response.$B$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: We have great idea. You were friends with puppy-men, they maybe listen to you.$B$BWe want you to go give offering to Shaman Vekjik. He southwest where river turns into waterfall.  Tell puppy-man we no want fight. Tell him we play nice.$B$BYou good $r. We trust you do this right.
english.progress: Puppy-men play nice now?
english.completion: So mean! We only be nice and they only be mean. They keep messing with great stones... maybe they not know great stones are sacred.
english.end: Extend Peace Offering to Shaman Vekjik
english.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 这么快就回来了？
text.objectives: Travel to Mistwhisper Refuge and speak to Mistcaller Soo-gan.$B$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
text.description: <High-Oracle Soo-say stares at your forehead for a while before speaking.>$B$BSoo-gan ask for help. We think they might have been attacked by puppy-men again.$B$BWe sending you and Jaloot to help... follow west river up to Mistwhisper Refuge. Do what Soo-gan says... hit the puppy-men on the nose if they being mean, they don't like that.$B$B<High-Oracle Soo-say goes back to staring at your forehead as you leave.>
text.completion: We think we seen you before. You visit Mistwhisper village sometime already? Soo-say said you good. Soo-say smart, so we trust you too.

english.title: Back So Soon?
english.objectives: Travel to Mistwhisper Refuge and speak to Mistcaller Soo-gan.$B$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: <High-Oracle Soo-say stares at your forehead for a while before speaking.>$B$BSoo-gan ask for help. We think they might have been attacked by puppy-men again.$B$BWe sending you and Jaloot to help... follow west river up to Mistwhisper Refuge. Do what Soo-gan says... hit the puppy-men on the nose if they being mean, they don't like that.$B$B<High-Oracle Soo-say goes back to staring at your forehead as you leave.>
english.completion: We think we seen you before. You visit Mistwhisper village sometime already? Soo-say said you good. Soo-say smart, so we trust you too.

text.title: 被抢走的雾语宝物
text.objectives: 雾语村的唤雾者索乌甘要你杀死督军塔尔特克，并取回雾语宝物。$B$B如果你弄丢了亚鲁乌特的宝贝水晶，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 狗狗人又来迷雾巨石捣乱了，他们敲碎了蓝色水晶！你瞧这又是暴雨又是闪电的……不能在迷雾巨石使用蓝色水晶啊！狗狗人真该死！$B$B他们还趁乱偷走了我们在大湖中找到的宝藏。我们本来是要将它供奉给迷雾巨石的！迷雾巨石很生气，后果很严重！$B$B就是被那个塔特尔……呃，好像是塔塔克……不对不对……哦，是塔尔特克。哼，就是被塔尔特克偷走的！他逃到北边的营地去了。抢回我们的宝贝！
text.progress: Dumb puppy-thieves.
text.completion: You did it! You strong and nice! Good friend of Mistwhispers!
text.completed: Return to Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Lost Mistwhisper Treasure
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Tartek and retrieve the Mistwhisper Treasure for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge.$B$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: So some puppy-men come and smash blue crystals at Great Mist Stone! Lots of rain and lightning and badness... blue is wrong crystal for Great Mist Stone! Dumb puppy-men.$B$BAfter lightning, puppy-men stole big treasure we found in the sea-lake. We need treasure back to give to Great Mist Stone! Mist Stone is angry after what the puppy-men did!$B$BOne who took it named Tarter... no, Tiktak... no, no... Tartek. That it, Tartek! He went to the camp thing to north. Go get treasure back!
english.progress: Dumb puppy-thieves.
english.completion: You did it! You strong and nice! Good friend of Mistwhispers!
english.completed: Return to Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 被迫出手
text.objectives: 雾语村的唤雾者索乌甘要你杀死8个狂心持矛者和6个狂心清除者。$B$B如果你弄丢了亚鲁乌特的宝贝水晶，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 自从狗狗人来到这里，我们就一直想和他们保持友好关系，但是他们却不领情。$B$B本来嘛，狗狗人傻乎乎的，倒不至于造成什么麻烦。可现在他们竟然想打祭坛的主意。神圣的祭坛不容他们侵犯！这些巨石是伟大的造物主在创世的时候为我们竖立在这里的。$B$B要是迷雾巨石被破坏的话，我们该怎么办呀。去北边的狗狗人营地，阻止他们！
text.progress: They always want fight! We no want fight, but we need to protect sacred stuffs.
text.completion: You squash good. Thank you for help.
text.completed: Return to Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Forced Hand
english.objectives: Kill 8 Frenzyheart Spearbearers and 6 Frenzyheart Scavengers for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge.$B$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: We try to be nice to puppy-men ever since they came, but they nothing but mean.$B$BWe okay with them being dumb - they not do much harm. Now they mess with sacred shrines though. Sacred shrines not for messing with. The Great Stones are here from all the way back when the Great Ones made us.$B$BWe wouldn't know what to do if the Great Mist Stone were hurt. Go to their camp to north... make puppy-men stop and not come back!
english.progress: They always want fight! We no want fight, but we need to protect sacred stuffs.
english.completion: You squash good. Thank you for help.
english.completed: Return to Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 终于可以回家啦！
text.objectives: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy.
text.description: You're a good dryskin. Mistwhisper safe, treasure safe, and puppy-men sure to leave us alone now.$B$BYou go back to Rainspeaker Canopy and tell Soo-say you done good.
text.completion: You back so soon! Went good then, yeah?

english.title: Home Time!
english.objectives: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: You're a good dryskin. Mistwhisper safe, treasure safe, and puppy-men sure to leave us alone now.$B$BYou go back to Rainspeaker Canopy and tell Soo-say you done good.
english.completion: You back so soon! Went good then, yeah?

text.title: 愤怒的鳄鱼人
text.objectives: 抵达苔行村后与莫乌德谈一谈。$B$B如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 我以为你没这么快回来呢，看来是我错了。我正打算派莫乌德去警告附近苔行村的朋友们，叫他们别过来祭坛这边。苔行村在东边，就在倒塌的大石柱的东北方。$B$B你也一起去吧！莫乌德很聪明……听他的没错啦。
text.progress: Soo-say fumbles a bit, but he's not dumb. I do think he's been far too forgiving though... the puppy-men are not going to stop or leave us alone. The only way to stop them is to kill them... there is no "peace."$B$B<Moodle puffs up his chest and points to himself.>$B$BThat I am good at.
text.completion: Before you say anything, do not assume me as foolish as most of the Oracles you've met. I've been into the world a bit, I've learned your language, and I'm not easily duped. I knew the Mosswalkers were dead before we ever came, though I didn't know that the undead were behind it. They are not supposed to be able to enter this land... the destruction of the Lifeblood Pillar must have allowed them in somehow. We must see to it that they leave.
text.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

english.title: The Angry Gorloc
english.objectives: Travel to Mosswalker Village and speak to Moodle once you've arrived.$B$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: I not think you be back in time to go out again, but I wrong. I sending Moodle to nearby Mosswalker friends to bop silly Mosswalkers for not coming see shrine. Their village is east, up ridge, northeast of broken pillar.$B$BYou go with Moodle! He extra smart Rainspeaker... you listen to him good-like.
english.progress: Soo-say fumbles a bit, but he's not dumb. I do think he's been far too forgiving though... the puppy-men are not going to stop or leave us alone. The only way to stop them is to kill them... there is no "peace."$B$B<Moodle puffs up his chest and points to himself.>$B$BThat I am good at.
english.completion: Before you say anything, do not assume me as foolish as most of the Oracles you've met. I've been into the world a bit, I've learned your language, and I'm not easily duped. I knew the Mosswalkers were dead before we ever came, though I didn't know that the undead were behind it. They are not supposed to be able to enter this land... the destruction of the Lifeblood Pillar must have allowed them in somehow. We must see to it that they leave.
english.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

text.title: 苔行祭坛的源血碎片
text.objectives: 莫乌德要你去收集10块源血碎片，但是你最好不要进入石柱中的洞穴。$B$B如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 我早就猜测那些大石柱是导致气候异常温暖的原因，也正是它们的力量替我们抵挡了亡灵的入侵……看来我的观点得到了初步的验证。$B$B不久前，源血之柱在巨大的爆炸声中轰然倒塌。紧接着苔行村就遭遇了不幸，气候也随即突变……转眼之间就有雪花飘落，我们从来没有见过这样的天气。$B$B苔行村的居民为苔藓巨石供奉大量的源血水晶，这才阻止了降雪。如果我们也这么做的话，说不定能抵御亡灵的进犯。
text.progress: The Mosswalkers were good people... they did not deserve this.
text.completion: We might be too late for the shards to make a difference, but our options are somewhat limited.
text.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

english.title: Lifeblood of the Mosswalker Shrine
english.objectives: Moodle wants you to collect 10 Lifeblood Shards, but stay away from the cave inside of the pillar itself.$B$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: I've always suspected that the pillars have been the main reason for our weather and seclusion from the undead... this confirms it a bit.$B$BNot terribly long ago, there was a sound of a great explosion when the Lifeblood Pillar fell. The weather changed for the mosswalkers almost immediately... it began to snow, something we never see.$B$BThey were able to stop the snow by bringing more lifeblood crystals to the Great Moss Stone. Perhaps if we can do the same, it will help ward off the undead as well.
english.progress: The Mosswalkers were good people... they did not deserve this.
english.completion: We might be too late for the shards to make a difference, but our options are somewhat limited.
english.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

text.title: 苔行村的救星
text.objectives: 莫乌德要你前往苔行村搭救6名苔行村受害者。也许有些鳄鱼人已经命在旦夕，难以挽救了。$B$B如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
text.description: 说不定苔行村中还有幸存者……我们不能眼睁睁地看着他们都沦为亡魂。$B$B我们要揪出这场惨剧的主谋，替他们报仇，顺便看看还有没有幸存者。
text.progress: I wish I had known how key the pillars and the stones were much earlier... perhaps I could have prevented this.
text.completion: I'm very glad there were some to be saved... with luck, they'll make it back to Rainspeaker Canopy safely.
text.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

english.title: The Mosswalker Savior
english.objectives: Moodle wants you to rescue 6 of the Mosswalker Victims in Mosswalker Village, though some of them may no longer be alive to save.$B$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
english.description: There's some small chance that the Mosswalkers are not all dead yet... and at the very least, they deserve to not be butchered like this.$B$BLet's find some revenge for this slaughter and see if there are any to be saved in the process.
english.progress: I wish I had known how key the pillars and the stones were much earlier... perhaps I could have prevented this.
english.completion: I'm very glad there were some to be saved... with luck, they'll make it back to Rainspeaker Canopy safely.
english.completed: Speak to Moodle. Moodle can be summoned using Moodle's Stress Ball if he is not nearby.

text.title: 英雄的负担
text.objectives: Kill Artruis the Heartless.$B$BWhile securing the aid of friends is highly recommended, Moodle will not be able to accompany you on this task.
text.description: Perhaps the crystals will ward off the undead gradually, but there is one more thing that must be done.$B$BWe need to find the leader of these undead and kill him to ensure there's no one to push the wretches back upon us. If my suspicions are correct, he will be somewhere inside the fallen pillar... the Sundered Shard.$B$BThe corpses being dragged there would suggest as much anyway.$B$BI'll place the shards and bring the news to Soo-say... you will need to find other help in the meantime.
text.completed: Recover Artruis's Phylactery within the Sundered Shard.

english.title: A Hero's Burden
english.objectives: Kill Artruis the Heartless.$B$BWhile securing the aid of friends is highly recommended, Moodle will not be able to accompany you on this task.
english.description: Perhaps the crystals will ward off the undead gradually, but there is one more thing that must be done.$B$BWe need to find the leader of these undead and kill him to ensure there's no one to push the wretches back upon us. If my suspicions are correct, he will be somewhere inside the fallen pillar... the Sundered Shard.$B$BThe corpses being dragged there would suggest as much anyway.$B$BI'll place the shards and bring the news to Soo-say... you will need to find other help in the meantime.
english.completed: Recover Artruis's Phylactery within the Sundered Shard.

text.title: 坠毁的喷射器
text.objectives: 达克索塔的专家考格维尔要求你去收集药剂喷射器零件。
text.description: 我听说有一台药剂喷射器坠毁在西边的达克索塔一带。$B$B你为什么不去试试，看能不能找到它？我可以使用这台喷射器的零件制造一件设备，击落其它的喷射器！
text.progress: Do you have the parts? Huh? Do you?
text.completion: Ew, those things are totally gross! Okay, okay, hand them over and I'll see what I can do. I probably should have had you take them to a priest first for purification.
text.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Crashed Sprayer
english.objectives: Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to collect Plague Sprayer Parts.
english.description: I know that one of those plague sprayers crashed somewhere within Drak'Sotra to the west of us.$B$BWhy don't you see if you can find it. I can use the parts from the sprayer to create the device that's going to bring those things down!
english.progress: Do you have the parts? Huh? Do you?
english.completion: Ew, those things are totally gross! Okay, okay, hand them over and I'll see what I can do. I probably should have had you take them to a priest first for purification.
english.completed: Return to Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 纯粹的邪恶
text.objectives: 鲁伯特上尉要求你收集10份大块的萨隆邪铁，并将它们交给银色前沿的伊崔格。
text.description: 情报指出，被巨魔击坠在东南方的浮空城科尔拉玛斯里面有大量的萨隆邪铁矿石。$B$B我的斥候告诉我，很多矿石就散落在那座要塞的内部。$B$B银色前沿的伊崔格和他的朋友希望能弄到一些萨隆邪铁，以便对它进行研究。$B$B我希望你去跑一趟，看看能否收集到足够多的样本。
text.progress: Yes, $c? Please tell me that you have the saronite that we requested Captain Rupert to acquire?
text.completion: Can you not feel the pure evil of the stuff? We must use the expertise and magics at our disposal, combined with the power of the Holy Light, to pierce the veil of iniquity surrounding this tainted ore. We must determine its origins. Quickly, hand the saronite to me!
text.completed: Return to Eitrigg at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Pure Evil
english.objectives: Captain Rupert has asked you to collect 10 Chunks of Saronite and deliver them to Eitrigg at The Argent Stand.
english.description: We know that Kolramas, the crashed necropolis to the southeast, was carrying a large amount of an ore known as saronite when the trolls shot it down.$B$BMy scouts tell me that much of the saronite is strewn about within the innards of that thing.$B$BEitrigg and his friends back at The Argent Stand want a bunch of the stuff so that they can study it.$B$BI want you to head in there and see if you can collect enough for them.
english.progress: Yes, $c? Please tell me that you have the saronite that we requested Captain Rupert to acquire?
english.completion: Can you not feel the pure evil of the stuff? We must use the expertise and magics at our disposal, combined with the power of the Holy Light, to pierce the veil of iniquity surrounding this tainted ore. We must determine its origins. Quickly, hand the saronite to me!
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Creature Comforts
text.objectives: 达克迦尔的格隆迪尔上尉要你为他收集20份枯死的荆木。
text.description: 好吧，这事可能不怎么有趣，但总要有人去做。$B$B我的部队已经在没膝的死水里连续激战数天了。这样对身体可不好。$B$B他们需要的一堆温暖的篝火，不但能把他们自己烤干，还可以鼓舞士气。$B$B这座城市整天都湿漉漉的，但这些荆木树的枯根却有抗潮的能力。$B$B请帮我们收集一些点火的燃料来，我们会非常感谢你的。
text.progress: Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
text.completion: Mighty kind of ya, $n. Mighty kind indeed. Now you'll be findin' Cap'n Arnath due west o' here, just over the rise.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol: Creature Comforts
english.objectives: Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal wants you to bring him 20 pieces of Dead Thornwood.
english.description: Well, it ain't glamorous, but it needs doin'.$b$bMy troops have been fightin' their hearts out while knee-deep in stagnant water for days on end. That just can't be good fer ya.$b$bWhat they need is a nice fire to dry 'em out and lighten their spirits.$b$bThis part of the city's soaked, but the dead roots of these thornwood trees have a way of resistin' the moisture.$b$bRound us up some fuel for burnin' and we'll be mighty grateful.
english.progress: Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
english.completion: Mighty kind of ya, $n. Mighty kind indeed. Now you'll be findin' Cap'n Arnath due west o' here, just over the rise.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 更大的猎物
text.objectives: Talk to <x> at <x>.
text.description: Well, $N, you've been an enormous asset to the expedition so far. Debaar, Buck, and I couldn't have have assembled such an amazing collection of trophies without you.$B$BBut, I hear there are even fiercer monsters in other parts of the basin. I've sent a search party up north to get an idea of what other beasts await us.$B$BI'd like you to meet up with them and see what they've found. Head north, beyond Bittertide Lake and search for the encampment.

english.title: In Search of Bigger Game
english.objectives: Talk to <x> at <x>.
english.description: Well, $N, you've been an enormous asset to the expedition so far. Debaar, Buck, and I couldn't have have assembled such an amazing collection of trophies without you.$B$BBut, I hear there are even fiercer monsters in other parts of the basin. I've sent a search party up north to get an idea of what other beasts await us.$B$BI'd like you to meet up with them and see what they've found. Head north, beyond Bittertide Lake and search for the encampment.

text.title: 巡逻员
text.objectives: 银色前沿的指挥官库恩斯要你拜访四座银色北伐军的岗哨，并完成那里的上尉交给你的任务，然后回去向他复命。$B$B布兰顿上尉和鲁伯特上尉驻扎在达克索塔。格隆迪尔上尉驻扎在达克迦尔。炼金师菲肯斯坦驻扎在赫布瓦罗。
text.description: 拔出你的武器，$R。巡逻的时候到了！$B$B我们要拼死保住手中的四座岗哨，这对我们取得胜利有着关键性的意义。我要你去逐一巡查这几处岗哨，并向他们提供帮助。$B$B你可以从东南方的布兰顿上尉那里开始。等你完成他指派的任务后，他就会指引你去下一座岗哨。$B$B巡查完所有四座岗哨后再回来向我复命。记住——你回来得越快，报酬就越丰厚！所以给我动作麻利一点！$B$B解散！
text.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
text.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
text.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol
english.objectives: Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$b$bCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'valok.
english.description: Unsheathe that weapon, $r. It's time to go on patrol!$b$bI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$b$bYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$b$bReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$b$bDismissed!
english.progress: What news from our posts, $r?
english.completion: Well, $n, at least you've made it back in one piece. I suppose that's worth something....
english.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Can You Dig It?
text.objectives: Captain Brandon in Drak'Sotra wants you to use the Steel Spade on the nearby Ancient Dirt Mounds to recover the Ancient Drakkari Relic.
text.description: One of our troops came across an old treasure map during our last offensive. If what it shows is true, then there are priceless troll artifacts nearby.$b$bMy soldiers have their hands full, pressed between the Drakkari and the Scourge. I need you to follow up on this intelligence.$b$bTake this shovel and use it at the loose dirt mounds to the southwest. Return to me after a diligent search has been conducted.
text.completion: Thank you for looking into this for me, $n. I'll make mention of your service in my report. You'll likely want to visit Captain Rupert next. He's stationed at the wall due east of here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Troll Patrol: Can You Dig It?
english.objectives: Captain Brandon in Drak'Sotra wants you to use the Steel Spade on the nearby Ancient Dirt Mounds to recover the Ancient Drakkari Relic.
english.description: One of our troops came across an old treasure map during our last offensive. If what it shows is true, then there are priceless troll artifacts nearby.$b$bMy soldiers have their hands full, pressed between the Drakkari and the Scourge. I need you to follow up on this intelligence.$b$bTake this shovel and use it at the loose dirt mounds to the southwest. Return to me after a diligent search has been conducted.
english.completion: Thank you for looking into this for me, $n. I'll make mention of your service in my report. You'll likely want to visit Captain Rupert next. He's stationed at the wall due east of here.
english.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 后坐力？什么后坐力？
text.objectives: 使用RJR步枪击中幸运的威尔海姆头顶的苹果，然后与德洛斯坦谈一谈。
text.description: 你自认为是个射击能手咯？$B$B啧啧，那我倒要瞧瞧。呃，先从温和的武器开始吧。放心啦，它根本没有后坐力。记住，别把枪口对准你不想射击的目标。$B$B好啦，瞄准威尔海姆头顶的苹果，扣动扳机击飞它吧！
text.progress: Satisfied with the results?
text.completion: You're not a bad shot, but you'll get better with practice. How would you like to make a little wager?
text.completed: Return to Drostan at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.
text.objective1: Shot apple on Lucky Wilhelm's Head

english.title: Kick, What Kick?
english.objectives: Using the RJR Rifle, shoot the apple on top of Lucky Wilhelm's head, then speak with Drostan.
english.description: So you think you can shoot?$B$BWell, let's give it a try. Here, we'll start you out with something nice and gentle. Don't worry, it's got no kick to it at all. Remember, don't point that gun at anything you don't intend to fire at.$B$BNow, when you're ready, just take aim at that apple on top o' old Lucky Wilhelm's head and let 'er fly!
english.progress: Satisfied with the results?
english.completion: You're not a bad shot, but you'll get better with practice. How would you like to make a little wager?
english.completed: Return to Drostan at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.
english.objective1: Shot apple on Lucky Wilhelm's Head

text.title: Troll Patrol: Throwing Down
text.objectives: Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra wants you to use High Impact Grenades near 5 Nethurbian Craters.
text.description: Clever...$b$bJust when it seemed we were getting things under control, they tunneled right underneath us and secured the shrine!$b$bNow we're caught between two nethurbian armies and our predicament is worsening by the minute.$b$bAs our first course of action, we must stop them from reinforcing. Their tunnels must be sealed.$b$bTake these grenades and throw them down their craters to the northwest.
text.completion: We're not out of the woods by any means, but your efforts have helped to slow the enemy down. Captain Grondel up in Drak'Agal will likely have need of you. Farewell, $n.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 猎人的挑战
text.objectives: 在协助赫米特和探险队其他成员狩猎的过程中，杀死60只猎物。在你达成60个的击杀目标后，回到奈辛瓦里营地，与德洛斯坦比对猎物数量。
text.description: 看来你确实有些猎人的天分，射击技术也不赖。赫米特将你留在营地，想必是打算拉你入伙。$B$B想不想比一比啊？就咱们俩。$B$B赫米特和探险队的其他成员稍后会邀请你参与狩猎行动。我们在协助他们的过程中各自计算猎物的击杀数目，看看谁杀得比较多。这场比赛的胜负可不是瞬间就能分出的，任何种类的猎物都作数。祝你好运！
text.progress: Care to count 'em up?
text.completion: So, you've come to concede already? No way! How in Azeroth did you do that? I just made my 58th. So close! But fair's fair. I underestimated you, $n, but you've earned this victory fair and square.
text.completed: Return to Drostan at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Great Hunter's Challenge
english.objectives: Kill 60 Game Animals while you aid Hemet and his companions in their hunting. When you've killed your 60, return to Drostan at the Nesingwary Base Camp to compare numbers.
english.description: So y'have something of a hunter's instinct. You're not a bad shot, and Hemet hasn't driven you out, so he must be planning on including you in the hunt.$B$BHow'd you like to have a bit of a competition, just me and you?$B$BHemet and the others will ask you to help in their hunting. Along the way, you and I will count up the kills we contribute to their goals. Now, this isn't something you can win in the blink of an eye, and you'll find yourself killing many different kinds of creatures. Good luck!
english.progress: Care to count 'em up?
english.completion: So, you've come to concede already? No way! How in Azeroth did you do that? I just made my 58th. So close! But fair's fair. I underestimated you, $n, but you've earned this victory fair and square.
english.completed: Return to Drostan at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 为巫妖王而战
text.objectives: Report to Instructor Razuvious in the Heart of Acherus.$B$B
text.description: All that I am: anger, cruelty, vengeance - I bestow upon you, my chosen knight. I have granted you immortality so that you may herald in a new, dark age for the Scourge.$B$BGaze now upon the lands below us. The Scarlet Crusade scurries to undo my work, while Light's Hope stands defiantly against us - a blemish upon these Plaguelands. They must all be shown the price of their defiance.$B$BYou will become my force of retribution. Where you tread, doom will follow. Go now and claim your destiny, death knight.
text.completion: You have heard the call of the Lich King, $c. Now is the time to answer your master.

english.title: In Service Of The Lich King
english.objectives: Report to Instructor Razuvious in the Heart of Acherus.$B$B

english.completion: You have heard the call of the Lich King, $c. Now is the time to answer your master.

text.title: Troll Patrol: Couldn't Care Less
text.objectives: Captain Grondel wants you to kill 7 Mossy Rampagers in Drak'Agal.
text.description: Of all the posts, they throw me in this one.$b$bThe place is flooded with putrid, stagnant water and now it's host to sewage elementals!$b$bI don't really know what they are or why they're here, and frankly I couldn't care less. What I do know is they're making a mess of my sector! How am I supposed to conduct any dignified military operations with those foul things roaming around?$b$bGet out there, $c, and don't come back 'til you've cleared your share of 'em off of my battlefield!
text.completion: You sure about that, $r?$b$bSeems to me like there are more of them things out there now than when you started!
text.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

english.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 更大的猎物
text.objectives: 与索拉查盆地中多里安营地的多里安·达克斯托谈一谈。
text.description: $N，你确实是个优秀的猎手——犀牛、大型猫科动物甚至鳄鱼都不是你的对手。对探险队的部分成员来说，能狩猎这样的动物就很了不得了；但是像我这样的王牌猎手，却时刻渴望着更大的挑战。$B$B多里安·达克斯托克就与我志同道合，他去了北边，在苦潮湖对面搭建了一座营地。听说那里栖息着一种体型庞大的始祖龙，堪称极品猎物啊！我要你找到多里安，问问他的运气怎么样。
text.completion: So old Hemet didn't forget about me, after all. I suppose he's going to want to participate in the hunt once we've done all the hard work. Don't worry, there are plenty of drakes to go around. Hemet will get his wish.

english.title: In Search of Bigger Game
english.objectives: Speak with Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.
english.description: Well, $N, you've certainly proven your mettle as a hunter of all kinds of game animals -- rhinos, cats, and crocolisks. For some members of the expedition, these creatures are sufficient to test their hunting skills, but others, like myself, crave larger challenges.$B$BDorian Drakestalker went north, across Bittertide Lake and established a camp there. He's heard rumors of gigantic primordial drakes. Just imagine what a quarry they would be! Go check up on Dorian and see if he's had any luck.
english.completion: So old Hemet didn't forget about me, after all. I suppose he's going to want to participate in the hunt once we've done all the hard work. Don't worry, there are plenty of drakes to go around. Hemet will get his wish.

text.title: 巡逻任务
text.objectives: 银色前沿的指挥官库恩斯要你拜访四座银色北伐军的岗哨，并完成那里的上尉交给你的任务，然后回去向他复命。$B$B布兰顿上尉和鲁伯特上尉驻扎在东南面的达克索塔。$B$B格隆迪尔上尉驻扎在正东边的达克迦尔。$B$B炼金师菲肯斯坦驻扎在北边的赫布瓦罗。
text.description: 欢迎来到银色前沿，小鬼。我是指挥官库恩斯，而你——你可以叫我……指挥官。$B$B别以为你是来我这里观光的，可以自由挑选任务又不用向任何人汇报。在这里，你必须精确执行我的命令并向我汇报。明白吗？！$B$B首先，你要熟悉一下我的弟兄们，以及我们控制的地区。$B$B依次去向他们报到并执行他们的命令。完成巡逻之后再回来向我复命。
text.progress: Have you met with each of my captains, $r?
text.completion: It's about time you got your carcass back here! Thought we'd lost ya to the Scourge - not that it would've been a great loss.... If you're going to continue to serve the Crusade, you'd best make a more impressive showing. Take note, $r! Your future patrols will be rewarded based on your timeliness. Dismissed.
text.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Pa'Troll
english.objectives: Commander Kunz at The Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their leaders' orders, and then return and report to him.$b$bCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Southeast of here.$b$bCaptain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, due east.$b$bAlchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok, to the north.
english.description: Welcome to The Argent Stand, scrub. I am Commander Kunz, but you - you can call me... Commander.$b$bDon't think you're going to just cruise through my region, picking which missions you're going to participate in, answering to no one.$b$bHere, you report to me and you follow my orders to the letter. Understood?!$b$bFirst, you're going to get familiar with my men and the region we're charged with clearing.$b$bReport to each of them and do as they ask. Return to me when your patrol is done.
english.progress: Have you met with each of my captains, $r?
english.completion: It's about time you got your carcass back here! Thought we'd lost ya to the Scourge - not that it would've been a great loss.... If you're going to continue to serve the Crusade, you'd best make a more impressive showing. Take note, $r! Your future patrols will be rewarded based on your timeliness. Dismissed.
english.completed: Return to Commander Kunz at Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 止痛药
text.objectives: 达克索塔的布兰顿上尉希望你从达克索塔农田采集5份成熟的水罂粟。
text.description: 我的弟兄们虽然坚韧勇猛，但他们毕竟是血肉之躯。$B$B受伤和疼痛削弱了他们完成任务的能力，没有什么训练或者诀窍可以改变这一点。$B$B值得欣慰的是，我们的炼金师发明了一种药膏，与我们的绷带一起使用的话，可以大大缓解士兵的疼痛。$B$B药膏需要用到一种特殊的罂粟，正好这里的巨魔在西边的达克索塔农田中种了不少。去采一些罂粟回来，以保证我们的库存充足。
text.progress: Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
text.completion: Fine specimens, $n. On behalf of my soldiers, I thank you for your efforts today. Captain Rupert is likely the next stop on your patrol. He's stationed at the wall just east of here.
text.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Something for the Pain
english.objectives: Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra wants you to collect 5 Mature Water-Poppies from Drak'Sotra Fields.
english.description: Gritty as my men are, they're still mortal.$b$bWounds and pain diminish their ability to perform their missions. No amount of training changes that simple fact of life.$b$bThankfully, one of our alchemists has developed a recipe for a salve that binds to our bandages and greatly reduces the pain our soldiers experience.$b$bThe salve requires a special poppy these trolls cultivate just west of here. Go to Drak'Sotra Fields and harvest some of them to keep our stockpiles from running out.
english.progress: Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
english.completion: Fine specimens, $n. On behalf of my soldiers, I thank you for your efforts today. Captain Rupert is likely the next stop on your patrol. He's stationed at the wall just east of here.
english.completed: Return to Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 扔手雷
text.objectives: 达克索塔的鲁伯特上尉希望你在5个蛛魔隧道附近使用高能冲击手雷。
text.description: 真聪明啊……$B$B就在我们自以为已经控制了局面的时候，他们悄悄地在我们脚下挖出隧道，占领了圣殿！$B$B现在我们被两支蛛魔部队夹在中间，而且情况还在迅速恶化。$B$B我们的第一步行动是阻止他们的增援，封闭他们的隧道。$B$B拿着这些手雷，把它们扔到西北方的蛛魔隧道里去。
text.progress: Have you sealed the nerubian tunnels, $N?
text.completion: We're not out of the woods by any means, but your efforts have helped to slow the enemy down. Captain Grondel up in Drak'Agal will likely have need of you. Farewell, $n.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.description: Clever...$b$bJust when it seemed we were getting things under control, they tunneled right underneath us and secured the shrine!$b$bNow we're caught between two Nerubian armies and our predicament is worsening by the minute.$b$bAs our first course of action, we must stop them from reinforcing. Their tunnels must be sealed.$b$bTake these grenades and throw them down their craters to the northwest.

text.title: 温暖的篝火
text.objectives: 达克迦尔的格隆迪尔上尉要你为他收集20份枯死的荆木。
text.description: 好吧，这事可能不怎么有趣，但总要有人去做。$B$B我的部队已经在没膝的死水里连续激战数天了。这样对身体可不好。$B$B他们需要的一堆温暖的篝火，不但能把他们自己烤干，还可以鼓舞士气。$B$B这座城市整天都湿漉漉的，但这些荆木树的枯根却有抗潮的能力。$B$B请帮我们收集一些点火的燃料来，我们会非常感谢你的。
text.progress: Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
text.completion: Mighty kind of ya, $n. Mighty kind indeed. Now you'll be findin' ol' Finklestein due west o' here, just over the rise.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Creature Comforts
english.objectives: Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal wants you to bring him 20 pieces of Dead Thornwood.
english.description: Well, it ain't glamorous, but it needs doin'.$b$bMy troops have been fightin' their hearts out while knee-deep in stagnant water for days on end. That just can't be good fer ya.$b$bWhat they need is a nice fire to dry 'em out and lighten their spirits.$b$bThis part of the city's soaked, but the dead roots of these thornwood trees have a way of resistin' the moisture.$b$bRound us up some fuel for burnin' and we'll be mighty grateful.
english.progress: Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
english.completion: Mighty kind of ya, $n. Mighty kind indeed. Now you'll be findin' ol' Finklestein due west o' here, just over the rise.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.

text.title: The Alchemist's Apprentice
text.objectives: Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'valok wants you to assist him in the creation of a truth serum.$b$bWhen you are ready to begin, you are to speak to him and follow his instructions.
text.description: Ahh, you must be the promised patrol. Your timing couldn't be better. I have urgent need of an extra pair of hands.$b$bWe have a Drakkari prisoner who's been sent here to undergo questioning. Before the interrogation begins, I require assistance in the creation of a truth serum.$b$bCreating a truth serum is tricky business, demanding keen instincts, perfect timing, and improvisation at every step.$b$bLet me know when you're ready, $r. And remember, timing is everything!
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Finklestein at Reliquary of Pain in Zul'Drak.
