text.title: 磨尖你的爪子
text.objectives: 杀死6只始生幼龙，然后与多里安哨站的多里安·达克斯托克谈一谈。
text.description: 始生龙占据了北边和东边的大片区域，我甚至在这么远的距离都能感受到它们喷吐出的灼热气息。在挑战最强大的始祖龙之前，我们最好拿族群中较弱的成员来试试手。$B$B即便如此，你也不能放松警惕，毕竟它们可以轻易地吞噬你的躯体。等你熟练掌握与始祖龙搏斗的技巧后，再回来找我吧，我会指示你下一步该怎么做。
text.progress: Have you tested your skills?
text.completion: I can hear the confidence in your words. Good, the experience will come in handy when we face the queen of the drakes.
text.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Sharpening Your Talons
english.objectives: Kill 6 Primordial Drakes and then speak with Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: The primordial drakes occupy most of the area to the north and east, and I can feel the heat of their breath even at this distance. Before we can challenge the mightiest among the drakes, we must test our skills against the lesser creatures.$B$BStill, don't let your guard down; any one of these beasts can devour a man whole. Once you've familiarized yourself with the combat tactics of these drakes, return and I will tell you our next step.
english.progress: Have you tested your skills?
english.completion: I can hear the confidence in your words. Good, the experience will come in handy when we face the queen of the drakes.
english.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 诱龙出巢
text.objectives: 将6只始生龙幼崽交给多里安哨站的多里安·达克斯托克。
text.description: 我觉得吧，像傻瓜一样手舞足蹈是不可能吸引母龙斯利维娜的注意的。我们应该耍个花招，尽快诱使她与我们作战。这样的话，我们还能为后期计划积攒一些……呃……资源。$B$B<多里安瞥了苏特菲兹一眼。>$B$B暂且不用考虑那么远啦。去营地东边和东北边寻找始生龙卵吧。我要你敲碎蛋壳，把幼龙掳走！等母龙察觉情况有异时，肯定会怒气冲冲地向我们开战。
text.progress: Have you secured the bait we'll need to get the broodmother's attention?
text.completion: Ah, well done. Plenty of little hatchlings for Zootfizzle over there!
text.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Securing the Bait
english.objectives: Bring 6 Primordial Hatchlings to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: We're not likely to get Broodmother Slivina's attention waving our arms around like fools, but if we're smart, we can bait her into fighting us. We'll also secure more, uh, fodder for my little project.$B$B<Dorian glances over at Zootfizzle.>$B$BBut don't worry about that for now. Just look for the primordial drake eggs in the area east and northeast of the camp. Burst them open and scoop up the hatchlings that come out. When the broodmother realizes what we've done, she'll have no choice but to face us.
english.progress: Have you secured the bait we'll need to get the broodmother's attention?
english.completion: Ah, well done. Plenty of little hatchlings for Zootfizzle over there!
english.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 茧中人
text.objectives: 鲁伯特上尉要你打开达克索塔的蛛魔之茧，释放3个被俘虏的步兵，然后回去向他复命。
text.description: 既然那些隧道已经被封闭了，我们接下来就要关注那些落入敌人手里的同伴。$B$B幸运的是，我们的一些士兵还活着，只是被困在蛛魔的茧子里，情况还不算很糟糕。$B$B去把他们救出来，$C，不然就来不及了！
text.progress: Have you freed our soldiers from the clutches of the nerubians?
text.completion: These nerubians have taken a heavy toll, $c. Nevertheless, I am grateful for your efforts.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Cocooned!
english.objectives: Captain Rupert wants you to open the Nerubian Cocoons in Drak'Sotra and return to him once you have freed 3 Captive Footmen.
english.description: Now that the tunnels have been sealed, our next concern is recovering those who have fallen to the enemy.$b$bWith any luck, several of our soldiers are still alive and relatively well inside the nerubian cocoons.$b$bFree them, $c, while you still can!
english.progress: Have you freed our soldiers from the clutches of the nerubians?
english.completion: These nerubians have taken a heavy toll, $c. Nevertheless, I am grateful for your efforts.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 驯服猛犸象
text.objectives: 将一头裂牙猛犸交给多里安哨站的苏特菲兹。
text.description: Before you go off challenging Broodmother Slivina, Dorian thought it might be a good idea for you and Hemet to coordinate your efforts by riding into battle on the back of a mammoth.$B$BThe area around the camp is full of them. Just take this bridle and slip it over the head of a shattertusk mammoth. Be careful of the bulls, though. They won't tolerate the harness at all. Bring the mammoth back here when you've found a suitable one.
text.progress: Everything taken care of?
text.completion: Perfect! Now, all we need to do is get Hemet a stepladder...
text.completed: Return to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: A Mammoth Undertaking
english.objectives: Bring a Shattertusk Mammoth to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: Before you go off challenging Broodmother Slivina, Dorian thought it might be a good idea for you and Hemet to coordinate your efforts by riding into battle on the back of a mammoth.$B$BThe area around the camp is full of them. Just take this bridle and slip it over the head of a shattertusk mammoth. Be careful of the bulls, though. They won't tolerate the harness at all. Bring the mammoth back here when you've found a suitable one.
english.progress: Everything taken care of?
english.completion: Perfect! Now, all we need to do is get Hemet a stepladder...
english.completed: Return to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 诅咒教派的袭击
text.objectives: 前往雨声河，与弗蕾亚的化身谈一谈。
text.description: <弗蕾亚的推断没错。若不是源血之柱倒塌，亡灵根本无法踏足索拉查盆地——因此，天灾军团派出了诅咒教派的信徒来搞破坏。>$B$B<你最好立即向弗蕾亚的化身汇报，说盆地内有巫妖王的信徒出没。>
text.completion: The living... willingly serve the Lich King? All this time I've been searching for the wrong enemy, $r.  Let us make haste and uproot these cultists from these lands.

english.title: Cultist Incursion
english.objectives: Speak to the Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids.
english.description: <It appears the Avatar of Freya was right.  The undead were not able to enter Sholazar Basin before the Lifeblood Pillar was brought down -- they used their living agents from the Cult of the Damned instead.>$B$B<You'd best warn her about the Lich King's living agents within Sholazar Basin.>
english.completion: The living... willingly serve the Lich King? All this time I've been searching for the wrong enemy, $r.  Let us make haste and uproot these cultists from these lands.

text.title: 收集腐液
text.objectives: 赫布瓦罗的阿纳斯上尉要你从祖达克的暗门爬行者身上收集7份新鲜的蜘蛛腐液。
text.description: 听着，$C。我知道这个要求有点高……$B$B新鲜的蜘蛛腐液多少有些难找，即使是在这个遍地蜘蛛的地区也是如此。但菲肯斯坦说他至少需要二十份，而且要尽快拿到。$B$B我会让我的士兵继续到野外去收集材料，但他们还需要一些帮助才能赶上炼金师规定的时间。$B$B当你在祖达克的野外冒险时，请留意那些暗门爬行者，把你能找到的所有腐液都拿回来给我。
text.progress: Have you collected the reagents I need, $c?
text.completion: These look to be excellent samples, $n. Thank you for your assistance.
text.completed: Return to Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Stocking the Shelves
english.objectives: Captain Arnath in Heb'Valok asked you to collect 7 units of Fresh Spider Ichor from the Trapdoor Crawlers in Zul'Drak.
english.description: Listen, $c. I realize that it's a lot to ask....$b$bFresh spider ichor is somewhat hard to come by, even in these heavily infested regions. But Finklestein said he'd settle for no less than a vat of it, and that he needs it soon.$b$bI'll keep my men out in the field collecting reagents, but if the alchemist's order is going to be filled in time, they'll require some assistance.$b$bAs you roam the fields of Zul'Drak, keep your eyes peeled for trapdoor crawlers and bring me all of the ichor you can find.
english.progress: Have you collected the reagents I need, $c?
english.completion: These look to be excellent samples, $n. Thank you for your assistance.
english.completed: Return to Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 蝙蝠翅膀
text.objectives: 赫布瓦罗的阿纳斯上尉要你从祖达克蝙蝠身上收集7对完美的蝙蝠翅膀。
text.description: 自从菲肯斯坦来了以后，我已经沦为专门为他的实验和配方收集各种材料的下手了。$B$B我会遵守参军时的誓言，无条件执行一切命令。但我毕竟是个老兵，参加过许多战斗。我更愿意上前线去，直接为北伐军做贡献。$B$B帮帮我，$R。为我收集一些蝙蝠翅膀来，这样或许我很快就能回到真正的战斗中去了。
text.progress: Have you finished collecting those bat wings for Finklestein?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. I thank you for your assistance.
text.completed: Return to Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Clipping Their Wings
english.objectives: Captain Arnath in Heb'Valok has asked you to collect 7 Unblemished Bat Wings from Zul'Drak Bats.
english.description: Ever since Finklestein's arrival, I've been relegated to collecting various ingredients for his experiments and recipes.$b$bI'll follow my orders as I've vowed to do, but I'm a seasoned veteran. I've taken part in dozens of conflicts. I'd much rather be on the front lines, having a more direct impact on the Crusade's outcome here.$b$bHelp me, $r. Collect some bat wings for me so that I might get back to the real action sooner.
english.progress: Have you finished collecting those bat wings for Finklestein?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. I thank you for your assistance.
english.completed: Return to Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 七倍奉还
text.objectives: The Avatar of Freya wants you to defeat Thalgran Blightbringer by using Freya's Ward to reflect his Deathbolts back to him sevenfold.
text.description: 生命的源力在这片土地上涌动，巫妖王手下那些愚蠢的走狗却胆敢贸然入侵。他们造成的所有伤害，我都要七倍地奉还。$B$B指挥天灾军团腐蚀大地的罪魁祸首就是沙格兰·凋零使者，你可以在此地以北找到他。带上这个结界，使用它反射沙格兰的死亡能量。让天灾军团见识一下生命之力的伟大吧。
text.progress: Is it done, $N?
text.completion: You continue to prove yourself, $n.  Perhaps I was too quick to judge you. I had assumed you were here with the poachers who were recently stranded in my lands, but perhaps you're ready to put that behind you.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Returned Sevenfold
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya wants you to defeat Thalgran Blightbringer by using Freya's Ward to reflect his Deathbolts back to him sevenfold.
english.description: The agents of the Lich King have foolishly trespassed upon these lands where the power of life rules supreme.  All harm they inflict will be returned to them sevenfold.$B$BThe monster directly responsible for corrupting the land is known as Thalgran Blightbringer; you will find him just to the north of here.  Take this ward and use it to reflect the power of death upon him.  Show the Scourge that the power of life prevails above all.
english.progress: Is it done, $N?
english.completion: You continue to prove yourself, $n.  Perhaps I was too quick to judge you. I had assumed you were here with the poachers who were recently stranded in my lands, but perhaps you're ready to put that behind you.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 倒塌的水晶柱
text.objectives: 前往源血之柱，寻找石柱倒塌的原因。
text.description: 上古时代，泰坦在这里塑造出所有的生命体，并培育万物茁壮成长。$B$B环绕索拉查盆地的五根擎天水晶柱散发着持久的生命之力，使得天灾军团的势力无法渗透这片土地。但是，有一根柱子突然倒塌了。$B$B我要你前往源血之柱，调查一下到底发生了什么事。亡灵是没可能靠近石柱的，恐怕你需要将注意力放在那些有生命的入侵者身上。倒塌的石柱就在此地的正南方。
text.completion: <The corpse is badly burnt. There appear to be the remains of several powder kegs in the vicinity.>

english.title: The Fallen Pillar
english.objectives: Travel to the Lifeblood Pillar and look for clues to its destruction.
english.description: The titans shaped entire life forms here, fostering their unfettered growth.$B$BThe five crystal pillars that surround the basin emanate pure lifeforce.  The Scourge should've never been able to penetrate the basin, but one of the pillars was destroyed.$B$BGo to the Lifeblood Pillar and see if you can find out what happened.  No undead would've been able to approach the pillar, so keep your eyes out for living intruders.  You'll find what remains of the pillar directly south of here.
english.completion: <The corpse is badly burnt. There appear to be the remains of several powder kegs in the vicinity.>

text.title: 开启界门 - 造物者悬台
text.objectives: The Avatar of Freya wants you to head to the Makers' Overlook in eastern Sholazar Basin and use the Activation Switch Theta.
text.description: We cannot stop now, $r.  You've triggered the first switch, but one remains.$B$BThe titans constructed a second vantage point where they oversaw their creations.  You'll find it to the east, high in the mountains.$B$BPull the activation switch theta inside the overlook and the waygate will open.
text.completion: The waygate is active, $n.  It is time!
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Powering the Waygate - The Makers' Overlook
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya wants you to head to the Makers' Overlook in eastern Sholazar Basin and use the Activation Switch Theta.
english.description: We cannot stop now, $r.  You've triggered the first switch, but one remains.$B$BThe titans constructed a second vantage point where they oversaw their creations.  You'll find it to the east, high in the mountains.$B$BPull the activation switch theta inside the overlook and the waygate will open.
english.completion: The waygate is active, $n.  It is time!
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 母龙之怒
text.objectives: 杀死母龙斯利维娜，然后向多里安哨站的多里安·达克斯托克复命。
text.description: 母龙斯利维娜很难对付。她长着锋利的牙齿和巨爪，体表覆盖着坚硬的骨板和骨刺。你偷走了她心爱的孩子，作为母亲，她是不会善罢甘休的。$B$B斯利维娜已经陷入了绝望与愤怒的深渊，这就是赫米特心目中猎物的最佳状态。你和赫米特，再加上这头猛犸象，应该能与她一较高下。$B$B母龙斯利维娜就在蛮荒树林北部边缘的巢穴中，心中充满了复仇的怒火。
text.progress: Well, you're alive. How did you fare?
text.completion: Well, I had a whole speech prepared, but the old man himself has some words he wants to say to you.
text.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Post-partum Aggression
english.objectives: Kill Broodmother Slivina and return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: Broodmother Slivina's likely to be a snarling ball of teeth, spikes, and talons. You've gone and stolen her children away and no mother takes kindly to that.$B$B'Tis true they hatched from eggs, but she loves the little beasts no less than your mother loves you.$B$BShe'll be desperate and fierce in equal measures, everything Hemet loves in a target. You and he, along with that mammoth, should be a match for her.$B$BShe's on her perch at the northern edge of the Savage Thicket and hungers for revenge.
english.progress: Well, you're alive. How did you fare?
english.completion: Well, I had a whole speech prepared, but the old man himself has some words he wants to say to you.
english.completed: Return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 希姆托加的祝福
text.objectives: 巫医库弗要求你在希姆托加的雕像前奉上10份达卡莱供品。
text.description: 妖术师乌布戈或许曾告诉过你有关如何向祖达克的诸神献上供品的事。希姆埃巴并不是唯一被达卡莱巨魔们所遗忘的神。$B$B我们逃到了这里，在繁荣之母希姆托加的身边寻求庇佑。与希姆埃巴一样，如果你愿意向她献上供品的话，她也将很乐意祝福你。
text.progress: <You can feel the eyes of the Mother of Prosperity upon you. She is wondering what a $r such as yourself is doing standing before her.>
text.completion: <Zim'Torga's thoughts pervade your own. She senses the offerings you are about give to her and is pleased.>$B$B<She conveys that you will be appropriately rewarded.>
text.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Torga at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Blessing of Zim'Torga
english.objectives: Witch Doctor Khufu wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Torga.
english.description: Hexxer Ubungo probably told you about making offerings to the gods of Zul'Drak. Zim'Abwa is not the only god that stands forgotten by the Drakkari.$B$BWe have taken refuge within the presence of Zim'Torga, the Mother of Prosperity. As with Zim'Abwa, if you were to give offerings of the Drakkari to her, she is sure to give you her blessing.
english.progress: <You can feel the eyes of the Mother of Prosperity upon you. She is wondering what a $r such as yourself is doing standing before her.>
english.completion: <Zim'Torga's thoughts pervade your own. She senses the offerings you are about give to her and is pleased.>$B$B<She conveys that you will be appropriately rewarded.>
english.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Torga at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 卡拉赞的密室
text.objectives: 银色特使要你进入卡拉赞的仆役宿舍，在特里斯·黯血王子的房间中寻找线索。
text.description: 啧啧，一位经验丰富的探险者。你正是我们需要的人才啊。$B$B近来，守护麦迪文之塔的肯瑞托成员一直在谈论卡拉赞的异常氛围。卡拉赞中似乎滋生了一股新的力量，它既不同于守护者使用的魔法，也不同于燃烧军团的邪恶法术。从侦测结果来看，这股力量源于一位名叫特里斯·黯血的精灵族王子。而且，我们有理由相信，他是天灾军团的仆从。$B$B朋友，我要你调查黯血王子的房间，看看有没有相关的文件资料。
text.progress: What have you discovered?
text.completion: The information you report is dire indeed if the orders you saw are legitimate. We can only hope that his mission was stopped early enough to prevent the enemy from knowing too much about our strengths.$b$bThank you, $n. May you remain safe in these dark times.
text.completed: Return to Argent Emissary.

english.title: Chamber of Secrets
english.objectives: The Argent Dawn Emissary wants you to search the chamber of Tenris Mirkblood within the Servant's Quarters of Karazhan.
english.description: Excellent, an experienced adventurer. Precisely what we need.$b$bThere has been talk from the Kirin Tor guarding Medivh's tower that something is amiss with Karazhan. There is a new power lurking within, one that answers neither to the Guardian's magic nor the Legion. From what they've scouted, it appears it is an elven prince called Tenris Mirkblood, and there is reason to believe he serves the Scourge.$b$bGo, my friend, investigate Mirkblood's chamber, and return with any information you might find.
english.progress: What have you discovered?
english.completion: The information you report is dire indeed if the orders you saw are legitimate. We can only hope that his mission was stopped early enough to prevent the enemy from knowing too much about our strengths.$b$bThank you, $n. May you remain safe in these dark times.
english.completed: Return to Argent Emissary.

text.title: 消灭入侵者
text.objectives: 雨声河的弗蕾亚的化身要求你前往西北方的死亡之手营地，消灭8名诅咒教派入侵者。
text.description: 我是泰坦之女弗蕾亚的化身之一。作为生命的守护者，我肩负着保卫这片土地的重任，要确保它不被天灾军团染指。$B$B我未曾料到巫妖王竟然派遣生者破坏了水晶柱的防御结界。$B$B虽然我轻易就能捏碎那些教徒，但是我必须留在这里维持结界，阻止天灾军团的势力继续侵入索拉查盆地。去吧，$N。让那些傲慢的入侵者感受到我的愤怒。
text.progress: Have you destroyed the trespassers, $N?
text.completion: You speak the truth.  The intruders at the camp were dealt with... but I'm afraid it might have been too late.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Exterminate the Intruders
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to go to the Death's Hand Encampment to the northwest and slay 8 Cultist Infiltrators.
english.description: I am an embodiment of but one aspect of Freya, daughter of the titans.  I am the Lifewarden -- I was left here to protect this land against the threat of the Scourge.$B$BI never anticipated the Lich King would send willing living servants to do his work.$B$BI could easily crush these cultists myself, but I am all that stands between the undead armies and the rest of the basin.  Go, $N.  Deliver my wrath to these insolent trespassers.
english.progress: Have you destroyed the trespassers, $N?
english.completion: You speak the truth.  The intruders at the camp were dealt with... but I'm afraid it might have been too late.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 希姆托加的祝福
text.completed: Return to Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Blessing of Zim'Torga
english.completed: Return to Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 符文之剑
text.objectives: 在黑锋要塞内的武器架上找一把破旧的长剑，并以它为基础，在符文熔炉内锻造出一把符文之剑。$B$B带着你的符文之剑去向黑锋要塞的教官拉苏维奥斯报告。
text.description: 对于一名死亡骑士来说，最重要的装备无疑就是他的符文之剑。只有通过符文之剑，死亡骑士才能号令冰霜、鲜血与邪恶之力为他战斗。而且，符文之剑也像一尊水瓶一样为死亡骑士储存着他的符文之力。$B$B现在是时候让你去铸造属于自己的第一把符文之剑了。去周围的武器架上找一把破旧的长剑来。找到以后马上拿去符文熔炉旁，将它在熔炉里重新锻造成一把符文之剑。
text.progress: The runeblade is an extension of your being. A $c cannot battle without a runeblade.
text.completion: Well done, $n. You have successfully created your first runebladed weapon. With it you will sow the seeds of chaos and destruction! In your wake will be a bloodied field of battle, littered with the corpses of all that would dare oppose the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Razuvious at the Heart of Acherus in Ebon Hold.

english.title: The Emblazoned Runeblade
english.objectives: Search the weapon racks in Ebon Hold for a Battle-worn Sword and then use it on a runeforge to craft a Runebladed Sword.$B$BReturn the Runebladed Sword to Instructor Razuvious in Ebon Hold.
english.description: The single most important piece of equipment to a death knight is the runeblade. It is through the runeblade that a death knight commands the powers of frost, blood and the unholy. The runeblade also acts as a vessel to store the death knight's runic power.$B$BThe time has come to create your first runeblade. Search the weapon racks on this floor and locate a battle-worn sword. Once found, take the sword to a nearby runeforge and use it to create a runeblade.
english.progress: The runeblade is an extension of your being. A $c cannot battle without a runeblade.
english.completion: Well done, $n. You have successfully created your first runebladed weapon. With it you will sow the seeds of chaos and destruction! In your wake will be a bloodied field of battle, littered with the corpses of all that would dare oppose the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Razuvious at the Heart of Acherus in Ebon Hold.

text.title: 生命守卫者之怒
text.objectives: 雨声河的弗蕾亚的化身要求你登上光芒之柱的顶端，吹响弗蕾亚的号角。
text.description: $N，我们还是晚了一步。那些肮脏的教徒已经抵达光芒之柱，正在为摧毁这根水晶柱做准备。我可以感觉到空气中涌动的异样。$B$B我们的时间不多了。我要你登上光芒之柱的顶端，吹响这只号角，将我的力量导入水晶。$B$B让这帮渣滓尝尝玷污泰坦造物的后果吧。
text.progress: Have you taken care of the cultists, $N?
text.completion: Impressive.  I wasn't expecting a mere mortal to prove as worthy an ally as you. I fear our efforts have not been sufficient, however.  The Scourge shows no signs of stopping.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Lifewarden's Wrath
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to use Freya's Horn atop of the Glimmering Pillar.
english.description: We were not quick enough, $N.  The cultist scum have arrived at the Glimmering Pillar and are making preparations to destroy it, I can sense them.$B$BWe don't have much time.  Blow upon this horn atop the Glimmering Pillar to channel my power through the crystal.$B$BWe shall show this scum to not trifle with the titans' creations.
english.progress: Have you taken care of the cultists, $N?
english.completion: Impressive.  I wasn't expecting a mere mortal to prove as worthy an ally as you. I fear our efforts have not been sufficient, however.  The Scourge shows no signs of stopping.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 弗蕾亚的契约
text.objectives: 聆听弗蕾亚的化身的话语。
text.description: 虽然你消灭了那些教徒，但天灾军团并未停下入侵的脚步。$N，局势愈发严峻了。$B$B我不得不使出最后的绝招。在我向你透露更多秘密之前，你必须博得我毫无保留的信任。
text.progress: We have little time. The Scourge is preparing for a final push.
text.completion: There is no turning back now.  If you agree to help me, you will do so without hesitation.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Freya's Pact
english.objectives: Listen to what the Avatar of Freya has to say.
english.description: The cultists have been taken care of, but the Scourge's invasion has not slowed down.  The situation is becoming desperate, $N.$B$BThere exists a last resort.  Before I reveal any more, however, I must be sure I have your absolute trust.
english.progress: We have little time. The Scourge is preparing for a final push.
english.completion: There is no turning back now.  If you agree to help me, you will do so without hesitation.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 金亚莱的领袖
text.objectives: 希姆托加的剥皮师埃霍奈要求你收集库图比萨的宝藏、疯子克乌罗的宝藏和加瓦尼尔的宝藏。
text.description: 不知道你的想法跟埃霍奈的想法是否一致，伙计？$B$B有些一些达卡莱巨魔聚集在西南方的金亚莱。我们必须揪出他们的头头，干掉这几个混蛋。埃霍奈知道你最适合去干这个啦！$B$B立刻出发吧！你可以先拿他们的小喽罗下手，只要杀得他们鸡飞狗跳，那几个头目是一定会出现的。$B$B等他们出现之后，你得记得把他们的宝藏给拿到手……库图比萨，加瓦尼尔，还有疯子克乌罗，不要忘记哦。
text.progress: The $c must be back talkin' to Ahunae because the $c has all that treasure.
text.completion: The scalper thinkin' that you be his kind of $r! What's these candybars doin' in here? What we do with this, mon? Ahunae say that you can have them back!
text.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Leaders at Jin'Alai
english.objectives: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga has asked you to retrieve the Treasure of Kutube'sa, the Treasure of Gawanil, and the Treasure of Chulo the Mad.
english.description: You thinkin' what Ahunae thinkin', mon?$B$BSome of the Drakkari trolls have gathered at the Pools of Jin'Alai to the southwest. We be needin' to draw out their leaders, and Ahunae knows just how you be doin' it, too!$B$BGo in there and kill those trolls. When you kill enough, their leaders show up.$B$BWhen they show up next to their totems, you make sure to be gettin' the treasure of Kutube'sa, Gawanil, and Chulo the Mad, mon.
english.progress: The $c must be back talkin' to Ahunae because the $c has all that treasure.
english.completion: The scalper thinkin' that you be his kind of $r! What's these candybars doin' in here? What we do with this, mon? Ahunae say that you can have them back!
english.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 巫医库弗
text.objectives: 与希姆托加的巫医库弗谈一谈。
text.description: 我们赞达拉部族需要你的帮助，$N。我们必须阻止达卡莱巨魔对他们的神灵犯下的恶行！$B$B到东北方去，步上那宏伟的阶梯，进入祖达克的第二层，你会找到一处名叫希姆托加的地方。那里有另一尊神祗的雕像，并且，还有一座小小的避难所，我的族人正在绝望地守卫着它。$B$B我真心希望你能去那里伸出援手。去与巫医库弗谈谈吧，不过路上千万要小心，那个地方一直在被达卡莱巨魔围攻。
text.completion: Greetings to you, $c. I am glad to hear that Ubungo found someone that he could trust. Welcome to Zim'Torga.

english.title: To the Witch Doctor
english.objectives: Speak with Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.
english.description: We Zandalari could use your help, $N. We must put an end to what the Drakkari are doing to their gods!$B$BTo the northeast, up the great steps that lead to the next tier of Zul'Drak, lies Zim'Torga. It is the home to another of the god statues and a refuge that my people are desparately attempting to defend.$B$BI would like for you to travel there and speak to Witch Doctor Khufu. Be warned though, the place is under constant attack from the Drakkari.
english.completion: Greetings to you, $c. I am glad to hear that Ubungo found someone that he could trust. Welcome to Zim'Torga.

text.title: 不知所踪！
text.objectives: 在索拉查盆地的生物身上寻找金色订婚戒指。
text.description: 当我得知波利安小姐打算随奈辛瓦里的探险队前往索拉查盆地时，二话不说就去报了名，甘愿成为一名飞艇船员。我追求她好几个月啦，做梦都想娶她！$B$B我早已计划好了一切。飞艇坠毁那晚，我本来要向她求婚的……可现在戒指搞丢了。我到处都找遍了，却一无所获！$B$B你可以不相信我的直觉，但是我知道那枚戒指就在盆地的某处。如果不是被风险投资公司的雇员给偷去了，就是被野兽什么的给吞下了肚。肯定是这样……我知道的！
text.progress: The ring, $n!  Please... tell me you've found it!
text.completion: You did it!  You actually found it! I don't know... I don't know how to thank you!
text.completed: Return to Chad at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: It Could Be Anywhere!
english.objectives: Look for a Golden Engagement Ring on the various creatures in Sholazar Basin.
english.description: When I found out that Miss Boulian was helping Nesingwary with his expedition, I signed up as a deckhand immediately.  You see, I'd been meaning to marry her for months!$B$BI had it all planned out.  I was going to propose the very night of the shipwreck... but now the ring is gone.  I've searched everywhere!$B$BI know it might sound crazy, but I know the engagement ring is in the Basin.  If some Venture Company didn't steal it, maybe a wild creature ate it.  But it's here somewhere... I just know it!
english.progress: The ring, $n!  Please... tell me you've found it!
english.completion: You did it!  You actually found it! I don't know... I don't know how to thank you!
english.completed: Return to Chad at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: Dominion Over Acherus
text.objectives: Report to Master Siegesmith Corvus on the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
text.description: Behold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold.$B$BThough your thoughts may still be hazy, we haven't a moment to spare. You must claim dominion over Acherus and your mind! The horns of war surge!$B$BTake the stairs on this floor - located north, south, east and west - to the garrison floor above us. Seek out Master Siegesmith Corvus and acquire his status report. It must be delivered to Thalanor.

english.title: Dominion Over Acherus
english.objectives: Report to Master Siegesmith Corvus on the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
english.description: Behold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold.$B$BThough your thoughts may still be hazy, we haven't a moment to spare. You must claim dominion over Acherus and your mind! The horns of war surge!$B$BTake the stairs on this floor - located north, south, east and west - to the garrison floor above us. Seek out Master Siegesmith Corvus and acquire his status report. It must be delivered to Thalanor.

text.title: Company of the Damned
text.objectives: Deliver Corvus' Report to Scourge Commander Thalanor at the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
text.description: <Corvus salutes.>$B$BOur stockpiles of weapons, armor and munitions are nearly at maximum capacity. We are ready for war!$B$B<Corvus rolls up a fleshy piece of vellum.>$B$BOn the other side of this garrison floor, southwest of here, you will find the officers' quarters. Take this status report there and deliver it to Scourge Commander Thalanor, battalion commander of the Company of the Damned.
text.completed: Return to Scourge Commander Thalanor in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Company of the Damned
english.objectives: Deliver Corvus' Report to Scourge Commander Thalanor at the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
english.description: <Corvus salutes.>$B$BOur stockpiles of weapons, armor and munitions are nearly at maximum capacity. We are ready for war!$B$B<Corvus rolls up a fleshy piece of vellum.>$B$BOn the other side of this garrison floor, southwest of here, you will find the officers' quarters. Take this status report there and deliver it to Scourge Commander Thalanor, battalion commander of the Company of the Damned.
english.completed: Return to Scourge Commander Thalanor in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 横扫金亚莱
text.objectives: 希姆托加的巫医库弗要求你破坏蓝色大锅、绿色大锅、紫色大锅和红色大锅。
text.description: 我一直在想办法与众神取得直接的沟通。但是，金亚莱之池周围那些正在举行某种仪式的巫医给我造成了很大的麻烦。$B$B看来，排除他们的阻挠已经是迫在眉睫了。如果你能进入西南方的沼泽地域，你一定可以把他们那些不知熬着什么的锅全部掀翻。$B$B总之，把那些锅都处理掉，阻断他们那些仪式，为我扫清障碍。
text.progress: I am still unable to make contact. The ritual of the medicine men is still intact.$B$BPlease go back there and disturb each of their cauldrons.
text.completion: Yes, I can already feel the difference. Thank you. Let us see if we can make contact with the gods now.
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Breaking Through Jin'Alai
english.objectives: Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga has asked you to disturb the Blue Cauldron, Green Cauldron, Purple Cauldron, and Red Cauldron.
english.description: I have been trying to commune with the gods. However, the medicine men at the Pools of Jin'Alai are performing rituals that are interfering with my attempts.$B$BIt is imperative that we break through their obtrusion. If you were to head southwest into the pools area, I am certain that you would come across the cauldrons they are using for their magic.$B$BDisturb each of the cauldrons to bring down their ritual that is blocking me.
english.progress: I am still unable to make contact. The ritual of the medicine men is still intact.$B$BPlease go back there and disturb each of their cauldrons.
english.completion: Yes, I can already feel the difference. Thank you. Let us see if we can make contact with the gods now.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 与哈克娅交谈
text.objectives: 与哈克娅祭坛的哈克娅谈一谈。
text.description: 我们都已经听到了众神的指示，$N，现在你要做的事已经很清楚了。$B$B你必须立刻前往东南边的哈克娅祭坛，并与猎豹女神交谈。
text.completion: Listen closely, little $r. Time is of the essence.

english.title: To Speak With Har'koa
english.objectives: Speak with Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa.
english.description: The gods have spoken, $N. We now know what you must do.$B$BYou must now go to the Altar of Har'koa to the southeast and speak with the leopard goddess.
english.completion: Listen closely, little $r. Time is of the essence.

text.title: 无处可藏
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你到折磨之匣下面去，从腐烂憎恶身上收集5份腐烂憎恶之物，并收集5份黏稠的食尸鬼口水。
text.description: 一旦天灾军团看上某个目标，他们就会不惜一切代价去得到他。$B$B你注定要成为一具没有思考能力的行尸……$B$B<斯特凡残忍地一笑。>$B$B……除非我们可以利用他们对你的渴望来反制他们。$B$B关于这点，我以后会解释的。现在我要准备一个复杂的魔法，需要一些特殊的材料。$B$B到正东边的痛苦之匣去，杀死那里的憎恶以收集它们的“材料”，并收集地上的食尸鬼口水，把它们给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you brought me the components I asked for, $n?
text.completion: Well, it's far from perfect, but it'll have to do. Now brace yourself, $c. This is where it gets good....
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: You Can Run, But You Can't Hide
english.objectives: Stefan in Ebon Watch asked you to go to the Reliquary of Agony to collect 5 Putrid Abomination Guts from the Putrid Abominations and 5 Gooey Ghoul Drools.
english.description: Once the Scourge have a target in their sights, they'll stop at nothing to acquire it.$b$bYou're doomed to a mindless existence as a walking corpse....$b$b<Stefan's face twists into a cruel grin.>$b$b... unless we can use their desires against them.$b$bI'll explain later. I have complex magic to prepare which requires certain material components.$b$bTravel due east of here to the Reliquary of Agony. Slay abominations and gather the ghoul drool you'll find there then return to me with their remnants.
english.progress: Have you brought me the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: Well, it's far from perfect, but it'll have to do. Now brace yourself, $c. This is where it gets good....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 纳斯和巨魔的毛发
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要求你使用纳斯从干瘪的巨魔身上收集10份毛发样本。$B$B如果你把纳斯弄丢了，就回到斯特凡那里去找他。
text.description: 在你去见纳斯之前，有些事情我必须告诉你。$B$B纳斯曾经感染过一丁点瘟疫，所以他现在又聋又瞎，而且基本没有知觉。$B$B但这也不全是坏事。现在他已经对瘟疫之类的玩意完全免疫了，所以能够胜任某些特殊的任务——比如我将要交给你的这个任务。$B$B附近有一些刚刚感染天灾瘟疫的巨魔，我们需要研究一下瘟疫对他们造成的影响。带上纳斯和这只靴子。当你杀死一个巨魔后，就狠狠踢他一脚，这样他就会去收集毛发样本了。
text.progress: How's that boot holding up, $r?
text.completion: You know, you remind me an awful lot of my Nass. Maybe it's just the nose...
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Kickin' Nass and Takin' Manes
english.objectives: Stefan in Ebon Watch wants you to use Nass to collect 10 hair samples from Withered Trolls.$b$bIf you lose Nass, return to Stefan to recover him.
english.description: Before you meet Nass, there's something you should know.$b$bHe got a toxic dose of blight back in the day, and now he's deaf, blind, and mostly numb.$b$bIt's not all bad, though. He's virtually immune to the stuff now, which makes him perfect for certain tasks - like the one I'm about to give you.$b$bThere are many freshly scourged trolls nearby and we need to study the blight's effect on them. Take Nass, and this boot. When you've slain a troll, give him a good kick and he'll know to take a hair sample.
english.progress: How's that boot holding up, $r?
english.completion: You know, you remind me an awful lot of my Nass. Maybe it's just the nose...
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 某种邀请……
text.objectives: Take the Unliving Choker to Stefan at Ebon Watch.
text.description: 这条项圈的设计非常复杂。$B$B你盯着它的时候，脑中出现了一个危险的念头——这个念头企图迫使你戴上它。你抑制住了这种冲动，决定把它带回黑锋哨站去。$B$B那里的死亡骑士应该对这种东西有所了解……
text.completion: I am indeed familiar with items such as this. It would seem, $n, that you have been... chosen.

english.title: An Invitation, of Sorts...
english.objectives: Take the Unliving Choker to Stefan at Ebon Watch.
english.description: Crafted of bone and dripping with blood, this choker is of intricate and deliberate design.$b$bGazing upon it overwhelms you with an ominous presence - one that compels you to wear it. You fight the urge, and resolve to bring it back to Ebon Watch.$b$bIf anyone can explain this, a death knight can....
english.completion: I am indeed familiar with items such as this. It would seem, $n, that you have been... chosen.

text.title: 我的后裔
text.objectives: 哈克娅要求你对她的孩子们的尸体使用她的胡须，解放并复活它们。完成任务之后回到哈克娅祭坛去向她复命。
text.description: 我是所有神祗中最后一个被降伏的，因此我们得先让其他的神祗重获自由。但是，由于身上的魔法束缚，我无法亲自去探察他们的情况。$B$B首先，我需要你帮我一个忙。目前达卡莱巨魔已将我的力量转过来对付我，他们还将我的后裔全部变成了畸形的怪物。$B$B带上一根我的胡须，将我那些被折磨被虐待的孩子们杀死，然后利用胡须上的魔法解放它们的灵魂，并赐予它们新的生命。
text.progress: There are more of my offspring that you must free from their torment!
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I will never forget what you have done.
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: But First My Offspring
english.objectives: Har'koa has asked you to use her whisker on the corpses of her children to free and resurrect them. Return to her at the Altar of Har'koa when you are done.
english.description: I am the last of the gods to be subdued, so we must first attempt to free the others. Bound by the magics of my subduers, I am unable to discern their fates.$B$BBut first, I would ask that you do me a kindness. Already the Drakkari turn my magic against me. They have transformed my offspring into monstrosities.$B$BTake one of my whiskers. Slay my tortured children and use the magic of it to release them from their nightmare, and bring them back to life.
english.progress: There are more of my offspring that you must free from their torment!
english.completion: Thank you, $n. I will never forget what you have done.
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 黑暗的召唤
text.objectives: Take the Writhing Choker to Stefan in Ebon Watch.
text.description: 这条项圈的设计非常复杂。$B$B你盯着它的时候，脑中出现了一个危险的念头——这个念头企图迫使你戴上它。你抑制住了这种冲动，决定把它带回黑锋哨站去。$B$B那里的死亡骑士应该对这种东西有所了解……
text.completion: I am indeed familiar with items such as this. It would seem, $n, that you have been... chosen.

english.title: Darkness Calling
english.objectives: Take the Writhing Choker to Stefan in Ebon Watch.
english.description: Crafted of bone and dripping with blood, this choker is of intricate and deliberate design.$b$bGazing upon it overwhelms you with an ominous presence - one that compels you to wear it. You fight the urge, and resolve to bring it back to Ebon Watch.$b$bIf anyone can explain this, a death knight can....
english.completion: I am indeed familiar with items such as this. It would seem, $n, that you have been... chosen.

text.title: 酿酒的材料
text.objectives: 将1颗橙子、2串香蕉和1颗木瓜交给奈辛瓦里营地的葛瑞姆·雷酒。
text.description: 命运丢给我一颗宛如柠檬般酸涩的苦果！当我们的船横冲直撞地撞毁在这片丛林中时，酒桶全被震裂了，我辛辛苦苦酿出的美酒洒得一干二净！现在只剩下几瓶朗姆酒了，这些怎么能满足嗜酒如命的探险队呢！$B$B我必须尽快酿点什么来给他们喝！$B$B东边的蛮藤谷中生长着许多果树。如今正是果实成熟的季节，可惜我够不着高高的树干。不如你去跑一趟，从树上摇一些果子下来！有什么我就要什么。
text.progress: Did you have luck winning any of that fruit from those darn tall and stingy trees?
text.completion: Well, that's a better assortment than I would've expected from this place. Now, for the important question: can we distill it into anything drinkable? We'd better get started.
text.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Some Make Lemonade, Some Make Liquor
english.objectives: Bring 1 Orange, 2 Banana Bunches, and 1 Papaya to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: Life's tossed me a cartload of lemons this time! When the ship ran aground, the kegs carrying my best brew burst! All we have now are a few bottles of rum, and it won't sustain a thirsty expedition!$B$BWe need to get some booze cooking, and fast!!$B$BThe trees in the Wildgrowth Mangal, to the east, seem laden with fruit, but it's too high for me to reach. Look for good, strong vines, see if you can use it to shake some of that fruit out of the trees. Bring me whatever you can find.
english.progress: Did you have luck winning any of that fruit from those darn tall and stingy trees?
english.completion: Well, that's a better assortment than I would've expected from this place. Now, for the important question: can we distill it into anything drinkable? We'd better get started.
english.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 雪豹之神的圣物
text.objectives: 希姆托加的记载者图基尼要求你收集10件哈克娅圣物。
text.description: 我无意中听说你要前去为哈克娅的安宁而奋斗。祝你好运。$B$B不过，既然你要在那座祭坛周围活动的话，能不能顺便帮我收集几件他们的圣物回来呢？祭坛就在东南边不远的地方，我也不需要很多件圣物的。$B$B你看怎么样啊？
text.progress: The Drakkari are so busy destroying themselves, it would be a shame if the historical significance of their empire were to be likewise lost.
text.completion: Aw, prime specimens! You can see there the divergence from the root symbology. Quite extraordinary. What a pity that the ice trolls are determined to bring about their own demise. Did you know, for instance, that the Drakkari were exiled from the rest of the troll nations for their extremely violent ways? It's true! How did you think trolls ended up in such a harsh climate as this?
text.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Relics of the Snow Leopard Goddess
english.objectives: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to recover 10 Har'koan Relics.
english.description: I overheard that you are going to see to the well-being of Har'koa. Good luck to you.$B$BI am wondering if while you are in the vicinity of the altar, you would be willing to recover their relics? I do not require many, and it is only a short trip to the southeast.$B$BWhat do you say?
english.progress: The Drakkari are so busy destroying themselves, it would be a shame if the historical significance of their empire were to be likewise lost.
english.completion: Aw, prime specimens! You can see there the divergence from the root symbology. Quite extraordinary. What a pity that the ice trolls are determined to bring about their own demise. Did you know, for instance, that the Drakkari were exiled from the rest of the troll nations for their extremely violent ways? It's true! How did you think trolls ended up in such a harsh climate as this?
english.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 阿彻鲁斯之眼
text.objectives: Report to the Lich King in Ebon Hold.
text.description: Behold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold. Looming above the face of the necropolis is the all-seeing eye of Acherus. From it the master is able to see great distances into the territories held by our enemies. What the eye sees, the Lich King sees, and now the time has come for you to peer through the eye! The Lich King has called for you, $N.$B$BGo now! Suffer well, $g brother:sister;...$B$B
text.completion: The time to spill the blood of our enemies approaches. You must first learn what it is that you seek to destroy, before rushing headlong into battle. It is what separates a $c from a mindless ghoul. I will grant you sight beyond sight, my champion. You will use the eye of Acherus to steal our enemies' secrets.

english.title: The Eye Of Acherus
english.objectives: Report to the Lich King in Ebon Hold.
english.description: Behold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold. Looming above the face of the necropolis is the all-seeing eye of Acherus. From it the master is able to see great distances into the territories held by our enemies. What the eye sees, the Lich King sees, and now the time has come for you to peer through the eye! The Lich King has called for you, $N.$B$BGo now! Suffer well, $g brother:sister;...$B$B
english.completion: The time to spill the blood of our enemies approaches. You must first learn what it is that you seek to destroy, before rushing headlong into battle. It is what separates a $c from a mindless ghoul. I will grant you sight beyond sight, my champion. You will use the eye of Acherus to steal our enemies' secrets.

text.title: 幸免于难
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你将尸灵项圈交给血玫瑰达图拉。
text.description: 我不知道是智慧还是幸运阻止你戴上这条项圈，$R。$B$B无论如何，你找到它并不是偶然的。你已经被某个人，或者某些东西盯上了……$B$B把你的项圈交给旁边的血玫瑰达图拉。
text.progress: 怎麽了，$R?
text.completion: Now you've observed the fate that was meant to befall you. As I mentioned before, this was no coincidence. The creation of such a device is very involved, and the required resources would not be squandered on a random target. The simple truth of the matter is this; You're wanted by the Scourge....
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Near Miss
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to take the Unliving Choker to Bloodrose Datura.
english.description: It was either wisdom or luck that prevented you from wearing this choker, $r.$b$bEither way, your acquiring it was no random occurance. You've been targeted by someone, or something....$b$bTake your choker to Bloodrose, here. Let her demonstrate the fate that nearly befell you.
english.completion: Now you've observed the fate that was meant to befall you. As I mentioned before, this was no coincidence. The creation of such a device is very involved, and the required resources would not be squandered on a random target. The simple truth of the matter is this; You're wanted by the Scourge....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 侥幸逃脱
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你将扭曲项圈交给血玫瑰达图拉。
text.description: 我不知道是智慧还是幸运阻止你戴上这条项圈，$R。$B$B无论如何，你找到它并不是偶然的。你已经被某个人，或者某些东西盯上了……$B$B把你的项圈交给旁边的血玫瑰达图拉，让她为你演示一下差点就落在你头上的命运。
text.progress: 怎麽了，$R?
text.completion: Now you've observed the fate that was meant to befall you. As I mentioned before, this was no random act. The creation of such a device is very involved. You've somehow caught the attention of the Scourge leadership. The question is not how, why, or even who... but what will we do about it?
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Close Call
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to take the Writhing Choker to Bloodrose Datura.
english.description: It was either wisdom or luck that prevented you from wearing this choker, $r.$b$bEither way, your acquiring it was no random occurence. You've been targeted by someone, or something....$b$bTake your choker to Bloodrose, here. Let her demonstrate the fate that nearly befell you.
english.completion: Now you've observed the fate that was meant to befall you. As I mentioned before, this was no random act. The creation of such a device is very involved. You've somehow caught the attention of the Scourge leadership. The question is not how, why, or even who... but what will we do about it?
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 冻土精华
text.objectives: 希姆托加的元素驯服者德苟达要求你收集7块冻土精华。
text.description: 我们捕获了附近的许多元素生物，并将其驯化成了我的卫兵，这样才保证了这里拥有足够的守卫力量。但是，想要让它们保持足够的战力以应付强敌的话，则需要消耗许多能量。$B$B西北方达克玛瓦的冻土中有着大量我所需要的物质。要想让这些元素卫兵继续活动下去的话，我就需要更多的冻土精华。
text.progress: I hope that you've returned with enough. The attacks from the Pools of Jin'Alai have become more desperate after what you did to them.
text.completion: Thank you, $c. Those essences should be enough to fuel my casting for quite some time.
text.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Frozen Earth
english.objectives: Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga wants you to collect 7 Essence of the Frozen Earth.
english.description: We captured these elementals from nearby, and I have plenty of defenders now. But, it takes a great deal of power to make them strong enough to stand up to our enemies.$B$BThe frozen earth at Drak'Mabwa to the northwest have what I need to maintain our defenses. I'll need more of their essence if I'm to keep this up.
english.progress: I hope that you've returned with enough. The attacks from the Pools of Jin'Alai have become more desperate after what you did to them.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. Those essences should be enough to fuel my casting for quite some time.
english.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 封印裂隙
text.objectives: 希姆托加的剥皮师埃霍奈要求你封印7处元素裂隙。
text.description: 德苟达肯定还会派你去西北方的达克玛瓦，替她和她手下的卫兵拿回更多的东西。$B$B那么，埃霍奈希望你也能顺便帮忙摧毁那些不断有元素生物跑出来的空间裂隙。这可以让我们彻底避免继续遭受它们的攻击！$B$B总之，你千万要小心，冻土中的凶猛生物会在你尝试封印裂隙的时候突然出现并袭击你。
text.progress: You have a few more of those rifts to seal before we be talkin' again, $N.
text.completion: Ahunae hopin' that Dagoda got all of the defenders she wantin'. With those rifts sealed, it's not likely she'll be gettin' any more.
text.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Sealing the Rifts
english.objectives: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga has asked you to seal 7 Elemental Rifts.
english.description: Dagoda gonna be sendin' you northwest to Drak'Mabwa to get her more stuff for her defenders if she didn't already.$B$BWhile you up there, Ahunae be wantin' you to destroy the rifts those elementals pourin' out of. The last thing we needin' is for them to attack us!$B$BJust watch out, more of those frozen earth'll show up when you try to seal the rifts.
english.progress: You have a few more of those rifts to seal before we be talkin' again, $N.
english.completion: Ahunae hopin' that Dagoda got all of the defenders she wantin'. With those rifts sealed, it's not likely she'll be gettin' any more.
english.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 天降厄运
text.objectives: 巫妖王命令你使用阿彻鲁斯之眼，侦察并分析血色城堡、新阿瓦隆熔炉、新阿瓦隆市政厅和赤色烈焰礼拜堂的情况。$B$B使用阿彻鲁斯之眼的控制台来控制阿彻鲁斯之眼。
text.description: 阿彻鲁斯之眼就放在这个平台的正中央。你可以用它召唤出一只探测之眼，用以侦察分析新阿瓦隆内的血色十字军部署和动向。阿彻鲁斯之眼拥有一些独特的能力，可以让你的情报收集工作更轻松一些。$B$B好好利用它的虹吸技能，侦查敌人的熔炉、市政厅、城堡，以及礼拜堂。平台的周围有数个阿彻鲁斯之眼的控制台，不要浪费时间了，$N。$B$B天灾军团必将全面占领新阿瓦隆。这是巫妖王的命令！
text.progress: Our assault upon the Scarlet Crusade will become legend.
text.completion: They prepare for battle - as expected - but there is something else. I sense an old enemy. An enemy that I destroyed long ago... It matters not. We will send the full might of the Scourge against them before they have a chance to evacuate their homes and put in place their defenses.
text.completed: Return to The Lich King in Ebon Hold.
text.objective4: Chapel of the Crimson Flame Analyzed

english.title: Death Comes From On High
english.objectives: The Lich King commands you to use the Eye of Acherus to analyze the Scarlet Hold, New Avalon Forge, New Avalon Town Hall and the Chapel of the Crimson Flame.$B$BControl the Eye of Acherus by using the Eye of Acherus Control Mechanism.
english.description: Towering above this platform is the eye of Acherus. From it you will call forth a probe that you will then use to analyze Scarlet Crusade fortifications at New Avalon. The eye has a host of powers that should make the acquisition of this data simple.$B$BUse the eye's siphon to analyze the forge, town hall, hold, and chapel. The eye's control mechanisms are located on either side of this platform. Waste no more time, $N.$B$BThe Scourge will have this place. The Lich King commands it!
english.progress: Our assault upon the Scarlet Crusade will become legend.
english.completion: They prepare for battle - as expected - but there is something else. I sense an old enemy. An enemy that I destroyed long ago... It matters not. We will send the full might of the Scourge against them before they have a chance to evacuate their homes and put in place their defenses.
english.completed: Return to The Lich King in Ebon Hold.
english.objective4: Chapel of the Crimson Flame Analyzed

text.title: 伦诺克之魂
text.objectives: 与伦诺克祭坛的伦诺克之魂谈一谈。
text.description: 我可以清晰地感觉到，伦诺克的时间已经不多了。$B$B这位极地熊神的灵魂已经离开了他虚弱的身躯。你必须与他的灵魂沟通。$B$B他的祭坛就在西北方，达克玛瓦的另一端。
text.completion: I am barely hanging on. You must work quickly or all will be lost.

english.title: Spirit of Rhunok
english.objectives: Speak with the Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok.
english.description: My feelings tell me that Rhunok doesn't have much time.$B$BI can tell that the arctic bear god's spirit has already separated from his weakened body. It is his spirit with which you must commune.$B$BHis altar lies to the northwest beyond Drak'Mabwa.
english.completion: I am barely hanging on. You must work quickly or all will be lost.

text.title: 一线希望
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你到折磨之匣下面去，从腐烂憎恶身上收集5份腐烂憎恶之物，并收集5份黏稠的食尸鬼口水。
text.description: 一旦天灾军团看上某个目标，他们就会不惜一切代价去得到他。$B$B你注定要成为一具没有思考能力的行尸……$B$B<斯特凡残忍地一笑。>$B$B……除非我们可以利用他们对你的渴望来反制他们。$B$B关于这点，我以后会解释的。现在我要准备一个复杂的魔法，需要一些特殊的材料。$B$B到正东边的痛苦之匣一带去，杀死那里的食尸鬼和憎恶，把它们的“材料”给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you brought the components I asked for, $n?
text.completion: Well, it's far from perfect, but it'll have to do. Now brace yourself, $c. This is where it gets good....
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Silver Lining
english.objectives: Stefan in Ebon Watch asked you to go to the Reliquary of Agony to collect 5 Putrid Abomination Guts from the Putrid Abominations and 5 Gooey Ghoul Drools.
english.description: Once the Scourge have a target in their sights, they'll stop at nothing to acquire it.$b$bYou're doomed to a mindless existence as a walking corpse....$b$b<Stefan's face twists into a cruel grin.>$b$b... unless we can use their desires against them.$b$bI'll explain later. I have complex magic to prepare which requires certain material components.$b$bTravel due east of here to the land beneath the Reliquary of Agony. Slay the ghouls and abominations you'll find there and return to me with their remnants.
english.progress: Have you brought the components I asked for, $n?
english.completion: Well, it's far from perfect, but it'll have to do. Now brace yourself, $c. This is where it gets good....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 酒香犹存
text.objectives: 成功完成蒸馏作业，然后将雷酒的丛林佳酿交给奈辛瓦里营地的葛瑞姆·雷酒。
text.description: 原料搞齐啦，我的助手也准备好了蒸馏器。接下来由他监督整个酿造流程，你就负责处理所有的细节问题。你是不是想当然地认为，酿酒就是将原料一股脑儿地扔进蒸馏器，然后等它们自然发酵？你错啦。$B$B酿造过程绝没这么简单，我们必须在最适当的时候添加香料并逐步加温，同时还要控制气压。如果某个步骤慢上十来秒，那整桶酒就完蛋了。你准备就绪之后，就和“醉鬼”麦克马努斯谈谈吧。
text.progress: Well, how did it turn out?
text.completion: There's something in here, but the million gold question is, can you drink it? Don't you go anywhere; you'll be responsible for overseeing the sampling of the product, too.
text.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Still At It
english.objectives: Successfully complete the distillation process and bring the completed Thunderbrew's Jungle Punch to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: Now that we've got the raw materials, I've had my assistant ready the still. He'll oversee the process, but I want you to help keep everything under control. You might be tempted to think that we just throw everything into the still and let it sit, but you're wrong.$B$BIngredients and heat need to be added at certain times, and the pressure regulated at others. You'll have no more than 10 seconds to react to a situation. Speak with "Tipsy" McManus when you're ready to start distilling.
english.progress: Well, how did it turn out?
english.completion: There's something in here, but the million gold question is, can you drink it? Don't you go anywhere; you'll be responsible for overseeing the sampling of the product, too.
english.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 品酒
text.objectives: 将雷酒的丛林佳酿的酒样交给赫米特·奈辛瓦里、哈迪乌斯·哈洛维和塔玛拉·摇链品尝，然后向奈辛瓦里营地的葛瑞姆·雷酒复命。
text.description: 现在就来揭晓真相吧！$B$B<葛瑞姆轻声地笑了。>$B$B我总是很期待这样的时刻。通常我会举办宴会供大家试饮，但是我们身处丛林，就别那么讲究啦。$B$B一切从简吧，给几位好朋友尝尝就行。让我想想，我得听听赫米特·奈辛瓦里的意见。呃，给哈迪乌斯·哈洛维也送一份。他们俩就在这座营地里。对啦，你最好去跑一趟湖边着陆场，那地方就在索拉查盆地的中央，让塔玛拉也试试。
text.progress: Don't keep me waiting, $N. What are the results?
text.completion: Two out of three drinkers agree, eh? Not bad for a first try. Not bad at all. I suppose I'll have to whip up something else for Tamara by way of apology. Now... what should we call this creation?
text.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Taste Test
english.objectives: Offer a sample of Thunderbrew's Jungle Punch to Hemet Nesingwary, Hadrius Harlowe, and Tamara Wobblesprocket, then return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: And now for the moment of truth!$B$B<Grimbooze chuckles.>$B$BI've always wanted to say that. Normally, I'd debut a new drink at a banquet, but we can't have one in the middle of the jungle.$B$BInstead, just take samples to a few trusted friends and return with their comments. Let's see, we'll definitely want Hemet Nesingwary's opinion, and Hadrius Harlowe's, too. They're here in camp. You'll want to head over to Lakeside Landing, near the center of the Basin and offer Tamara Wobblesprocket a taste.
english.progress: Don't keep me waiting, $N. What are the results?
english.completion: Two out of three drinkers agree, eh? Not bad for a first try. Not bad at all. I suppose I'll have to whip up something else for Tamara by way of apology. Now... what should we call this creation?
english.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 我的先知，我的敌人
text.objectives: 伦诺克祭坛的伦诺克之魂要求你找回他的极地熊神魔精。
text.description: 我的先知当初从我身上吸取了太多的力量，而且过程也太快，结果把自己给毁灭了。现在在达克玛瓦南边留下的那处灌满雨水的巨坑就是当时爆炸产生的结果。$B$B在那以后，祭司们又将这位先知复活了，试图让他继续完成未尽的计划。他们将我的力量又重新导向了先知，很快，他就将再次醒来。$B$B趁一切还来得及，你必须去真正终结他的生命，并将我的魔精带回来。
text.progress: Quickly, $r, do you have my mojo?
text.completion: You did it. But now there is one other thing that I need you to do.
text.completed: Return to Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: My Prophet, My Enemy
english.objectives: The Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok has asked you to acquire his Arctic Bear God Mojo.
english.description: My prophet absorbed too much of my power too quickly, and subsequently killed himself. You can see the results at the water-filled crater to the south in Drak'Mabwa.$B$BMy former priests have already resurrected him so that he can finish the job. They're channeling my power back into him, and it will not be long now before he reawakens.$B$BYou must put an end to him and return with my mojo before it is too late.
english.progress: Quickly, $r, do you have my mojo?
english.completion: You did it. But now there is one other thing that I need you to do.
english.completed: Return to Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 结束痛苦
text.objectives: 伦诺克祭坛的伦诺克之魂要求你对他的身躯使用折磨者的薰香，使之被唤醒。然后，你要使用伦诺克灌注在你身体内的能量杀死他。$B$B如果你不小心失去了伦诺克魔精光环的影响，可以回到伦诺克之魂那里再次寻求帮助。
text.description: 我的身躯已经无法挽回了，$N。那些祭司迟早会再选出一个新的先知，很快他们又将重新开始执行罪恶的计划。$B$B我将把身上最后的一些力量赐予你。那个折磨我、囚禁我的人目前正躲在祭坛的内部，他身上有一坛薰香，可以唤醒我的身躯，并让它变得不再无懈可击。$B$B请你利用这坛薰香帮我一个忙，结束我痛苦的生命吧。$B$B我要为可能会出现的反抗道歉。即使只是没有灵魂的身躯，它依然留存着极强的生存欲望。
text.progress: If you do not put an end to my suffering soon, $N, all may be lost.
text.completion: You've done what had to be done and honored me in the process. I give you my deepest thanks, $n. I only hope that you and Har'koa will be able to help the others.
text.completed: Return to Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok in Zul'Drak.

english.title: An End to the Suffering
english.objectives: The Spirit of Rhunok has asked you to use the Tormentor's Incense to awaken his body. You are then to slay Rhunok using the power that his spirit has imbued you with.$B$BIf for some reason you lose the Mojo of Rhunok aura, you can return to the Spirit of Rhunok to have it reapplied.
english.description: My body is too far gone now, $N. It is only a matter of time before a new prophet is elevated and finishes what the other began.$B$BI am going to imbue you with the last of my power. The tormentor inside the altar building carries incense, which will awaken my body and make it vulnerable.$B$BUse the incense and do me the kindness of putting an end to my suffering.$B$BI apologize if I fight back. Even for me, the will to survive is strong.
english.progress: If you do not put an end to my suffering soon, $N, all may be lost.
english.completion: You've done what had to be done and honored me in the process. I give you my deepest thanks, $n. I only hope that you and Har'koa will be able to help the others.
english.completed: Return to Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 乔装打扮
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你使用迷惑项圈激活天灾伪装。$B$B在天灾形态下，到骨肠那里去购买苦痛浆液。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 好了……我制作了一种伪装，它可以把你变成天灾军团的成员，而且不易被发现。$B$B只要伪装还没有失效，你就可以在天灾军团中自由行动。只有荒芜卫士能看穿我制造的这种幻象，你要小心它们！$B$B你要注意的另一个问题就是，这个伪装不太稳定，随时可能失效，所以你一定要保持警惕。$B$B现在让我们来测试一下效果吧。你使用项圈激活伪装，到东边去找天灾军团的商人，给我买一瓶苦痛浆液回来。
text.progress: Well, $n? Did you purchase that flask?
text.completion: So? How are you enjoying scourge life? Believe me, it's not all it's cracked up to be....
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Dressing Down
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to use the Ensorceled Choker to apply the Scourge disguise.$b$bWhile in Scourge form, you are to purchase Bitter Plasma from Gristlegut.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: There... I've created a disguise that should make you indistinguishable from the Scourge.$b$bYou'll be free to walk among them as long as the disguise holds. Only the blightguards will be able to see through my illusion. Watch out for them!$b$bAnother thing you must know is that the disguise is unstable and may drop unexpectedly, so stay alert.$b$bLet's test it out. Use the choker and visit the Scourge merchant just east of here. Return to me with a bottle of bitter plasma.
english.progress: Well, $n? Did you purchase that flask?
english.completion: So? How are you enjoying scourge life? Believe me, it's not all it's cracked up to be....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你使用迷惑项圈激活天灾伪装。$B$B在天灾形态下，到骨肠那里去购买苦痛浆液。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。

text.completion: So? How are you enjoying Scourge life? Believe me, it's not all it's cracked up to be....

english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to use the Ensorcelled Choker to apply the Scourge disguise.$b$bWhile in Scourge form, you are to purchase Bitter Plasma from Gristlegut.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.

Only the blightguards will be able to see through my illusion. Watch out for them!$b$bAnother thing you must know is that the disguise is unstable and may drop unexpectedly, so stay alert.$b$bLet's test it out. Use the choker and visit the Scourge vendor just east of here. Return to me with a bottle of bitter plasma.
english.progress: Well, $n? Did you purchase that flask?
english.completion: So? How are you enjoying Scourge life? Believe me, it's not all it's cracked up to be....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 自毁家园
text.objectives: 希姆托加的记载者图基尼要求你收集7件伦诺克圣物。
text.description: 附近还有一处祭坛中放置有大量理应得到拯救与保护的圣物。$B$B西北边的达克玛瓦苔原另一边有一座伦诺克祭坛，据说那里的达卡莱巨魔发生了暴动，竟然毁灭了自己的圣地，将那里变成了一片焦土。$B$B$C，如果你能从那些卑贱而无知的巨魔手中救回那些圣物，我将感激不尽。
text.progress: There is no comprehending the Drakkari. They are brutal savages who have sunk to a new low.
text.completion: Let me look at those. Hmph, I'd say that we're lucky you liberated these when you did, $c. How very interesting. This artifact here depicts the events of the Sundering. There was a time when Northrend was the far northern portion of Kalimdor. But after the Sundering, the land broke off, eventually becoming Northrend. This, of course, is why we see Drakkari in the southern continents as well as here.
text.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Plundering Their Own
english.objectives: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to recover 7 Rhunokian Artifacts.
english.description: There is another altar nearby where there are artifacts to be saved.$B$BIt is said that the Drakkari at the Altar of Rhunok to the northwest, beyond the broken tundra of Drak'Mabwa, have already plundered their own holy site.$B$B$C, I would be appreciative if you could rescue those artifacts from their undeserving hands.
english.progress: There is no comprehending the Drakkari. They are brutal savages who have sunk to a new low.
english.completion: Let me look at those. Hmph, I'd say that we're lucky you liberated these when you did, $c. How very interesting. This artifact here depicts the events of the Sundering. There was a time when Northrend was the far northern portion of Kalimdor. But after the Sundering, the land broke off, eventually becoming Northrend. This, of course, is why we see Drakkari in the southern continents as well as here.
english.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 湖边着陆场
text.objectives: 与湖边着陆场的塔玛拉·摇链谈一谈。
text.description: 风险投资公司刚开始找我们的麻烦时，我就让玛尔文·摇链和他的老婆塔玛拉搭乘飞行器去了东边的河流之心。我让他在那里搭建一座小营地，作为补给中转站以及侦查该地区的前哨站。$B$B不出意外的话，他们现在应该已经开始修筑营地了吧。河流之心位于索拉查盆地的中央位置，顾名思义，就是数条河流的交汇点啦。沿着东北边的河岸搜寻湖边着陆场吧。玛尔文说他挑了一处地势最好的位置。
text.completion: So, Hemet sent you? We were just about to let him know that we've gotten things up and running here. Please forgive Marvin if he seems to be ignoring you, but he gets very absorbed in his work.

english.title: Lakeside Landing
english.objectives: Speak with Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing.
english.description: When the trouble with the Venture Company started, I asked Marvin Wobblesprocket and his wife, Tamara, to take their flying machines east to River's Heart. I asked them to setup a small camp there so that we could use them as a relay to fly in supplies and survey the area.$B$BThey should have arrived by now and started setting up. River's Heart is near the center of the basin where the rivers converge. Search for Lakeshore Landing on the northeast shore. Marvin mentioned it would be the best spot.
english.completion: So, Hemet sent you? We were just about to let him know that we've gotten things up and running here. Please forgive Marvin if he seems to be ignoring you, but he gets very absorbed in his work.

text.title: 喂饱食尸鬼
text.objectives: 折磨之匣的骨肠要求你在10只腐烂的食尸鬼附近使用杂碎大餐。
text.description: 嘿嘿嘿！你，食尸鬼！对！我是在跟你讲话。$B$B现在是开饭时间了。去把饭拿给那些食尸鬼！$B$B今天可是特别加大餐！看看，各种杂碎……嗯，嗯，真鲜美。$B$B去把这些装满了饭的碗丢到那些食尸鬼面前。喂饭是个交朋友的好办法。$B$B想交个食尸鬼朋友吗？啊哈哈哈哈！
text.progress: Yoo dun feed da goolz?
text.completion: 味道不错。
text.completed: Return to Gristlegut at the Reliquary of Agony in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Feedin' Da Goolz
english.objectives: Gristlegut at the Reliquary of Agony wants you to use Bowels and Brains Bowl next to 10 Decaying Ghouls.
english.description: Git o'er heer, gool! Yeh, I talkin' to yoo.$b$bIt feedin' time now. Gotta git da grub ta all da gools!$b$bSpeshal grub dis time! Bowels an' brainz bowl... num, num, num.$b$bJus drop da bowl nexta da gool. Gud way ta make frenz.$b$bYoo got goolfrenz? Ha, ha, hah!
english.progress: Yoo dun feed da goolz?
english.completion: Num num!
english.completed: Return to Gristlegut at the Reliquary of Agony in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 返回哈克娅身边
text.objectives: 与哈克娅祭坛的哈克娅谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候让你回到猎豹女神的身边了。我预计她还有许多计划要委派给你去执行。$B$B请转告她，无论这世界怎样变化，我们都是永恒不灭的。
text.completion: My spirit cries out in grief at the loss of another friend. But fear not, he will return and his spirit will live on forever.

english.title: Back to Har'koa
english.objectives: Speak with Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa.
english.description: And now it is time for you to return to the leopard goddess. Somehow I sense that she has other plans for you.$B$BTell her that no matter what, we are eternal.
english.completion: My spirit cries out in grief at the loss of another friend. But fear not, he will return and his spirit will live on forever.

text.title: 兼职猎人
text.objectives: 将匹奇的遗体交给湖边着陆场的塔玛拉·摇链。
text.description: 当赫米特让我陪同玛尔文来这里搭建营地时，我还以为能在修理飞行器或是修筑营地之余练习一下狩猎技巧呢，哪知道根本忙得脱不开身！$B$B我很想干掉那头名叫匹奇的狮子。据说它就生活在这里的南边，通天之柱北面和蛮藤谷交界的地方。如果你能找到它的话，不如把你干掉它的证据给我带回来？如果小道消息确凿的话，这件战利品肯定可以让赫米特瞠目结舌！
text.progress: Did you find Pitch?
text.completion: You got it! Now all I have to do is make a trophy out of it. That'll be the hard part -- finding a way to preserve it so that Hemet doesn't have a good laugh at my expense.
text.completed: Return to Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: The Part-time Hunter
english.objectives: Bring Pitch's Remains to Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing.
english.description: When Hemet asked me to accompany Marvin out here, I hoped that I might have the opportunity to work on my own hunting skills in between repairing the flying machines and setting up the camp.$B$BI wanted to take down a ferocious lion named Pitch. He's said to make his home south of here, near where the Wildgrowth Mangal meets the northern face of the Skyreach Pillar. If you can find the beast, would you bring back his remains? If the rumors are true, they'd make a trophy even Hemet will respect!
english.progress: Did you find Pitch?
english.completion: You got it! Now all I have to do is make a trophy out of it. That'll be the hard part -- finding a way to preserve it so that Hemet doesn't have a good laugh at my expense.
english.completed: Return to Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 希姆鲁克的祝福
text.objectives: 巫医库弗要求你在希姆鲁克的雕像前奉上10份达卡莱供品。
text.description: 还有一位祖达克的神祗一直被我们忽略了，那就是希姆鲁克。$B$B希姆鲁克的雕塑一直孤零零地矗立在正北边一处荒凉的地方。虽然希姆鲁克有着“智者”的称号，但他更是个吝啬和小气的神祗。他非常注重保护自己的领地，手下有着大批的护卫。这些护卫总是不停地在领地内巡逻，随时都会将擅自接近或进入的人干掉。$B$B你要小心地避开那些护卫，然后将达卡莱巨魔的供品献给希姆鲁克，这样，你将得到他的祝福。
text.progress: <You sense that Zim'Rhuk does not trust you. He is attempting to call out to one of his guardians.>
text.completion: <Zim'Rhuk acknowledges the offerings you intend to place before him, though he knows that you took them from the corpses of others.>$B$B<If you give the offerings to him, he reluctantly agrees to grant you his blessing.>
text.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Rhuk in Zim'Rhuk in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Blessing of Zim'Rhuk
english.objectives: Witch Doctor Khufu wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Rhuk.
english.description: There is another god of Zul'Drak that is being neglected.$B$BZim'Rhuk's statue lies directly to the north. Known as "The Wise One", Zim'Rhuk is also known to be very protective of his domain. He maintains guardians that deal harshly with anyone that does not have the wits to slip past them.$B$BAvoid the guardians and give the Drakkari offerings to Zim'Rhuk so that you will benefit from his blessing.
english.progress: <You sense that Zim'Rhuk does not trust you. He is attempting to call out to one of his guardians.>
english.completion: <Zim'Rhuk acknowledges the offerings you intend to place before him, though he knows that you took them from the corpses of others.>$B$B<If you give the offerings to him, he reluctantly agrees to grant you his blessing.>
english.completed: Deliver the Drakkari Offerings to Zim'Rhuk in Zim'Rhuk in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 希姆鲁克的祝福
text.completed: Return to Zim'Rhuk in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Blessing of Zim'Rhuk
english.completed: Return to Zim'Rhuk in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 天灾的力量
text.objectives: 巫妖王要你带着他的命令去找黑锋要塞内的大领主达里安·莫格莱尼。$B$B使用巫妖王身后的传送器，前往大领主达里安·莫格莱尼所在的命令大厅。
text.description: Listen well, death knight, for I give to you the words that will start a war. My final judgment has been passed: Death. To. All. None shall stand so boldly against the might of the Scourge without reprisal!$B$BAs you have served me well in your first task, so too shall you serve me in your next task. Take my judgment to Highlord Mograine at the command post of Acherus, found on the first floor. Tell him to begin the assault.$B$BAnd when the Crusade has been dealt with, we will finish off the Argent Dawn.$B$B
text.completion: The horns of war will soon echo across this land, waking the dead and calling forth the Scourge war machine. Woe unto those that would stand in our way! You and your brethren will lead the charge, $n. When next I look upon the Scarlet lands, my sight will be obscured by the legions of Acherus. The march upon New Avalon begins now.

english.title: The Might Of The Scourge
english.objectives: The Lich King commands you to carry his orders to Highlord Darion Mograine at Ebon Hold.$B$BUse the glowing transporter behind the Lich King to reach Highlord Darion Mograine in the Hall of Command.
english.description: Listen well, death knight, for I give to you the words that will start a war. My final judgment has been passed: Death. To. All. None shall stand so boldly against the might of the Scourge without reprisal!$B$BAs you have served me well in your first task, so too shall you serve me in your next task. Take my judgment to Highlord Mograine at the command post of Acherus, found on the first floor. Tell him to begin the assault.$B$BAnd when the Crusade has been dealt with, we will finish off the Argent Dawn.$B$B
english.completion: The horns of war will soon echo across this land, waking the dead and calling forth the Scourge war machine. Woe unto those that would stand in our way! You and your brethren will lead the charge, $n. When next I look upon the Scarlet lands, my sight will be obscured by the legions of Acherus. The march upon New Avalon begins now.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 我的宠物大鹏
text.objectives: 将7枚大鹏卵交给多里安哨站的苏特菲兹。
text.description: 多里安将抓来的始祖幼龙交给我训练和喂养，这让我有了新的想法。嗯，我要拥有自己的宠物！$B$B不，我当然不要龙崽子。它们能一口咬断我的胳膊，才不要这样的宠物！$B$B往东北方走，穿过始祖龙的栖息地就是埋骨地了，那里生活着大群的血爪大鹏。我可不指望能驯化成年的大鹏，所以我要你从血爪大鹏的巢穴中偷些蛋回来，等这些小家伙破壳而出时，我就开始调教它们。
text.progress: Do you have those eggs?
text.completion: Oh, these are very nice! I've gotten so tired of robotic squirrels and chickens for company. It'll be wonderful to have a pet whose joints won't require oiling!
text.completed: Return to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: My Pet Roc
english.objectives: Bring 7 Roc Eggs to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: Dorian's had me training and feeding the baby drakes he captures, and it has gotten me thinking. I want a pet of my own!$B$BNo, not a juvenile drake. I don't want a pet capable of biting my hand off!$B$BHowever, in the Bonefields to the northeast of the camp, beyond the area dominated by the drakes, there's a large population of goretalon rocs. The grown ones are beyond hope of domesticating, but if you bring me the eggs from their nests, I can raise them from the time they hatch.
english.progress: Do you have those eggs?
english.completion: Oh, these are very nice! I've gotten so tired of robotic squirrels and chickens for company. It'll be wonderful to have a pet whose joints won't require oiling!
english.completed: Return to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 巫毒头饰！
text.objectives: 希姆托加的剥皮师埃霍奈要求你使用埃霍奈的小刀拆下10名赫布达卡巨魔的巫毒头饰。$B$B他还提醒你，要先搜索过他们的 躯体之后再拆卸巫毒头饰。
text.description: 行动现在开始，伙计！$B$B东北边赫布达卡的那帮巨魔就是不错的目标。他们养的破蝙蝠每天晚上都要骚扰我们，这下他们该尝尝报应啦！$B$B拿着，埃霍奈把他的宝贝小刀也借给你，千万要好好干哟。
text.progress: Ahunae know there be no way that $N scalp that many of the Heb'Drakkar so quickly.
text.completion: Aw, me thinkin' that too funny. $n is my kind of $r! You still got my knife?
text.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Scalps!
english.objectives: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga wants you to use Ahunae's Knife to scalp 10 Heb'Drakkar trolls.$B$BThe scalper reminds you that you should loot them first.
english.description: I thinkin' it be time to do some scalpin', mon!$B$BThe trolls at Heb'Drakkar to the northeast should do nicely. With their fancy bats and attackin' us, they got it comin'!$B$BAhunae even give you his own knife so that you do the job right.
english.progress: Ahunae know there be no way that $N scalp that many of the Heb'Drakkar so quickly.
english.completion: Aw, me thinkin' that too funny. $n is my kind of $r! You still got my knife?
english.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 毁灭性的武器
text.objectives: 弗蕾亚的化身要求你前往西北方的死亡之手营地，销毁4车不稳定的炸药。
text.description: 巫妖王的爪牙竟敢将毁灭性的武器带进我的领地，我绝不能容忍这样的行径。$B$B我要你立即前往北方的天灾军团据点，摧毁他们带来的武器。我们不能让天灾军团在这片神圣的土地上再前进哪怕一步！
text.progress: Is it done, $N?
text.completion: I thank you, $r.  You're proving to be a worthy ally.
text.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Weapons of Destruction
english.objectives: The Avatar of Freya wants you to go to the Death's Hand Encampment to the northwest and destroy 4 Unstable Explosives.
english.description: The Lich King's lackeys have dared to bring weapons of destruction into my domain.  I will not stand for this.$B$BGo to their outpost to the north and destroy the weapons they would use against the land.  We cannot let the Scourge taint another inch of these sacred lands.
english.progress: Is it done, $N?
english.completion: I thank you, $r.  You're proving to be a worthy ally.
english.completed: Return to Avatar of Freya at Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 潜入沃尔塔鲁斯
text.objectives: 斯特凡你要你使用迷惑项圈进入沃尔塔鲁斯，并按照天灾军团指挥官的命令行动。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 现在你可能已经猜出我的计划了。$B$B我们要利用天灾军团对你的兴趣来反制他们，也就是说，你要去潜伏在天灾军团中。我知道这和判你死刑没什么差别，但如果我们不采取行动，你就真的死定了。$B$B到东北方的痛苦之匣去，使用伪装后站到那个平台上去。进入沃尔塔鲁斯之后，你必须设法取得天灾军团指挥官的信任。$B$B完成任务之后，吹响这只号角，我会飞到你那里去和你碰头。
text.progress: Have you earned their commander's trust, $N?
text.completion: Well, now... I must admit I'm more than a little surprised to see you, $n. Tell me what you've learned.
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Infiltrating Voltarus
english.objectives: Stefan wants you to use your Ensorcelled Choker to get into Voltarus and do whatever the Scourge leader there asks of you.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: By now you've probably guessed the details of my plan.$b$bWe're using the Scourge's interest in you against them. You're going undercover. I know it's likely a death sentence, but if we do nothing your death is a certainty.$b$bTravel northeast to Reliquary of Pain and stand on the platform while wearing your disguise. Once inside Voltarus, you must earn the trust of the Scourge commander.$b$bWhen you've completed your mission, blow this horn and I'll fly to your location to receive your report.
english.progress: Have you earned their commander's trust, $N?
english.completion: Well, now... I must admit I'm more than a little surprised to see you, $n. Tell me what you've learned.
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 击落赫布金
text.objectives: 希姆托加的元素驯服者德苟达要求你去杀死赫布金。
text.description: <Dagoda looks at Ahunae and sighs.>$B$BYou want to really deal with Heb'Drakkar? Collecting scalps isn't going to get the job done. You have to take out their leader, Heb'Jin.$B$BThe problem is, he's up on the bat rookery goading his forces on.$B$BBang his drum and I guarantee that he'll fly down. That's when you kill him.$B$BYou can take this net we got from one of his headhunters. Use it to trap his bat when he lands. That way you won't have to fight both of them.$B$B
text.progress: He's not dead. I can still hear him yelling from here!
