text.completion: You did it! You have no idea how much of a relief that is to me! Defending against trolls on all sides is really putting a strain on us. Not to mention his incessant yelling. Please, $n, take your pick of what we have to offer.
text.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Bringing Down Heb'Jin
english.objectives: Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga wants you to kill Heb'Jin.
english.description: <Dagoda looks at Ahunae and sighs.>$B$BYou want to really deal with Heb'Drakkar? Collecting scalps isn't going to get the job done. You have to take out their leader, Heb'Jin.$B$BThe problem is, he's up on the bat rookery goading his forces on.$B$BBang his drum and I guarantee that he'll fly down. That's when you kill him.$B$BYou can take this net we got from one of his headhunters. Use it to trap his bat when he lands. That way you won't have to fight both of them.$B$B
english.progress: He's not dead. I can still hear him yelling from here!
english.completion: You did it! You have no idea how much of a relief that is to me! Defending against trolls on all sides is really putting a strain on us. Not to mention his incessant yelling. Please, $n, take your pick of what we have to offer.
english.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 久别重逢
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你与高尔巴格交谈，并游览祖达克。
text.description: $N！$B$B你一定是收到我的礼物了吧！转个身，让我好好看看，伙计，让我仔细看看你……啊，你真令我自豪。$B$B我们历经千辛万苦才走到这一步，现在，你和我，都已经是巫妖王麾下最优秀的仆从了。$B$B你一定要紧跟着我的脚步，还有无数伟大的计划在前面等着我们呢，伙计。嗯，伟大的计划……但首先，我得给你好好补些课，对，补些课。要知道，自我们上次一别之后，发生了许多变故。$B$B去找高尔巴格，让他先带你在祖达克好好逛一圈吧。等你逛完回来之后，我就会把你该知道的所有事情都告诉你的。
text.progress: You an' me gunna take Gundrak, mon.
text.completion: So, now ya be seein' what we be up against, mon. Go down, take some time ta learn da land, prepare some strategy. I'll be havin' some tasks for ya soon.
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Reunited
english.objectives: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to speak to Gorebag and take the tour of Zul'Drak.
english.description: $n!$b$bYa musta received mah gift! Turn around, mon, lemme get a good look at ya... Ahh, ya make me proud.$b$bWe come such a long way, you and I, and now we be servin' da Lich King together.$b$bStick with me and big things be comin, mon. Big things... but first, we need to be gettin' ya caught up. So much been happenin' since I saw ya last.$b$bGo speak ta Gorebag for a tour of Zul'Drak. Listen for me and I'll tell ya all ya be needin' ta know.
english.progress: You an' me gunna take Gundrak, mon.
english.completion: So, now ya be seein' what we be up against, mon. Go down, take some time ta learn da land, prepare some strategy. I'll be havin' some tasks for ya soon.
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 黑暗的地平线
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你与高尔巴格交谈，并游览祖达克。
text.description: 啊，又一位志愿者回应了巫妖王的召唤。$B$B<达库鲁用不屑一顾的眼神扫了扫你。>$B$B天灾军团的新兵，是不是？你身上还满是活人的气味儿！$B$B希望获得巫妖王陛下亲自祝福的人，可是能排出几里长的队伍。你要想要从这么一大群家伙当中脱颖而出，就必须展现出真正的实力，证明你的价值。$B$B好好游览一下祖达克吧。我早就感觉到你的潜力了，所以，我才亲自下令要你来协助我。$B$B剩下的事情就取决于你了……$B$B去找高尔巴格，让他带你在祖达克里走一圈吧。如果你的确对我有些价值，那么恐怕你以后会很忙。
text.progress: Have ya taken in da battlefield yet, mon?
text.completion: So, now ya be seein' what we be up against, mon. I want ya ta go down, learn da land, mingle with yer bretheren. Prepare yourself... Soon, dere be much for ya to do. Don't ya be disappointin' me!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Dark Horizon
english.objectives: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to speak to Gorebag and take the tour of Zul'Drak.
english.description: Ahh, another supplicant answerin' da Lich King's call.$b$b<Drakuru sniffs you.>$b$bFreshly scourged, eh? Ya still be reekin' of da living!$b$bLong be da line of dem who seek da Lich King's blessings. Ya must rise above da masses and prove yerself worthy of wieldin' true power.$b$bLookin' down over Zul'Drak, I sensed potential in ya. I ordered your - invitation.$b$bDa rest be up ta you....$b$bGo an' speak ta Gorebag for a tour of Zul'Drak. Dere be much ta do if you're to be of any worth to me.
english.progress: Have ya taken in da battlefield yet, mon?
english.completion: So, now ya be seein' what we be up against, mon. I want ya ta go down, learn da land, mingle with yer bretheren. Prepare yourself... Soon, dere be much for ya to do. Don't ya be disappointin' me!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 不祥的扰动
text.objectives: 哈克娅要求你去查明奎丝鲁恩的状况。你可以与哈克娅交谈，乘在她孩子的背上悄悄潜入奎丝鲁恩祭坛。$B$B完成侦察任务之后，回到哈克娅祭坛向她报告。
text.description: 风蛇女神奎丝鲁恩一定也遭遇到了某种不幸。具体情况我无法清晰感知，但是我敢肯定，她的祭坛目前正在被许多强大的生物践踏。$B$B还记得你为我救出来的孩子们吗？我要派你骑着其中之一去侦察风蛇祭坛的情形。有我孩子的帮助，你们两个可以既快速又隐秘地潜行进入那一地区。$B$B侦察结束之后，我的孩子还可以保证你安全地回到这里。但是，你仍然要随时保持警惕，不可大意。$B$B准备好了就告诉我，我随时可以为你召唤孩子们。
text.progress: What seems to be the delay, $N?
text.completion: Thank you for bringing my kitten back safely. Deep down I knew it. I wanted to deny it, but your eyes have revealed the truth. Nevertheless, I sense something else. All is not as it seems.
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: I Sense a Disturbance
english.objectives: Har'koa has asked you to determine what has happened to Quetz'lun. Speak to her to be able to ride one of her children stealthily into the Altar of Quetz'lun.$B$BReturn to her at the Altar of Har'koa once you have done so.
english.description: There's something wrong with Quetz'lun, the wind serpent goddess. What it is exactly I cannot sense, but I do know that her altar has been overrun with powerful creatures.$B$BI'm going to send you there on the back of one of my children, which you saved. The two of you will move swiftly and with great stealth to uncover what has become of Quetz'lun.$B$BMy child will see you safely back to me. Just keep your eyes open.$B$BWhen you are ready, ask and I will call one of my kittens for you.
english.progress: What seems to be the delay, $N?
english.completion: Thank you for bringing my kitten back safely. Deep down I knew it. I wanted to deny it, but your eyes have revealed the truth. Nevertheless, I sense something else. All is not as it seems.
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 进入灵界的准备
text.objectives: 哈克娅要求你收集8枚神圣符印，并把它们带回哈克娅祭坛交给她。
text.description: 奎丝鲁恩恐怕已经死了，不过我可以感觉到，她的灵魂仍在祭坛周围的灵界中游荡着。我们必须找到一个可以让你和她直接沟通的办法。$B$B幸运的是，那些曾经负责供奉我的祭司身上带有一些神圣符印，这些符印可以帮助我们做到这一点。当然，事到如今，那些家伙已经不再崇拜我，即使你去把他们全都干掉，我也不会有丝毫的怜悯。$B$B将他们身上的神圣符印抢回来给我，我可以抽出其中的能量，协助你进入奎丝鲁恩那梦魇般的灵界。
text.progress: I never imagined that it would come to this. The Drakkari are truly lost.
text.completion: There was a time when these meant something. Let's see if we can put them to better use.
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Preparations for the Underworld
english.objectives: Har'koa wants you to collect 8 Sacred Adornments. Deliver them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.
english.description: Quetz'lun may be dead, but I can still feel her spirit lingering in the underworld at the altar. We have to find a way to get you to her.$B$BLuckily for us, I just happen to have a supply of former supplicants at hand who are no longer in need of their sacred adornments. Both my subduers and claws are likely to still be wearing them.$B$BBring the adornments to me and I'll draw upon their energy to enable you to cross over into Quetz'lun's underworld nightmare.
english.progress: I never imagined that it would come to this. The Drakkari are truly lost.
english.completion: There was a time when these meant something. Let's see if we can put them to better use.
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 寻找风蛇女神
text.objectives: 前往奎丝鲁恩祭坛，寻找奎丝鲁恩之魂。
text.description: 看来你已经准备好了，但我还不清楚你是否真的知道自己将会面对什么。$B$B一旦你进入奎丝鲁恩的祭坛周围，就等于跨入了亡者的领域。根据我的经验，进入灵界绝对不是一种令人愉悦的感觉。$B$B千万记住你去那里的目的，不要为了灵界中的任何事物分心。你要径直走向祭坛，找到奎丝鲁恩的灵魂，并与之沟通。
text.completion: $r worm. Tell me why I should not annihilate you where you stand?

english.title: Seek the Wind Serpent Goddess
english.objectives: Seek Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun.
english.description: You are prepared, but I'm not certain that you're ready for what is to come.$B$BWhen you cross back over into Quetz'lun's altar area, you will enter the realm of the dead. From what I can feel of it, it's not going to be pleasant.$B$BTry not to be distracted by what you see in there. Simply head for the altar building and seek out Quetz'lun's Spirit.
english.completion: $r worm. Tell me why I should not annihilate you where you stand?

text.title: 复仇的基础
text.objectives: 奎丝鲁恩之魂要你在她的灵魂之泉附近杀死12个巨魔，奎丝鲁恩崇拜者或蛇灵狂暴者都可以。$B$B完成任务之后回到奎丝鲁恩祭坛向她复命。
text.description: 我已经为我亲爱的高阶祭司们准备了特别的惊喜。但首先你要证明一下自己，为我的复仇打好基础。$B$B你还是想活命的，对不对？$B$B如你所见，我的信徒们非常喜欢待在这里，但现在他们该做出最后的补偿了。$B$B如果你愿意的话，请帮我一个小小的忙，$N。把他们引诱到我的灵魂之泉附近来，然后结果他们的性命。$B$B他们是如此美味，而且我向你保证，他们不会白白牺牲的。
text.progress: Why do you return when your task is not yet complete? Do you not realize that I can destroy you with but a thought?$B$BGo now, little $r. Complete that which I commanded of you!
text.completion: Exquisite. Perhaps you will be of some use after all.
text.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.
text.objective1: Trolls killed near a Soul Font

english.title: Foundation for Revenge
english.objectives: Quetz'lun's Spirit has tasked you with the destruction of 12 trolls, either Quetz'lun Worshippers or Serpent-Touched Berserkers, near her Soul Fonts.$B$BOnly after you have accomplished this should you return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun.
english.description: I have something special planned for my favorite high priests. But first you get to prove yourself in laying the foundation for my revenge.$B$BYou do still want to live, yes?$B$BAs you have seen, my devotees are enjoying their stay here, but now it's time for them to make final restitution.$B$BDo me the smallest of favors if you would, $N. Lure them near my soul fonts and then put an end to their existences.$B$BThey taste so delicious, and their sacrifice will not go in vain, I can assure you.
english.progress: Why do you return when your task is not yet complete? Do you not realize that I can destroy you with but a thought?$B$BGo now, little $r. Complete that which I commanded of you!
english.completion: Exquisite. Perhaps you will be of some use after all.
english.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.
english.objective1: Trolls killed near a Soul Font

text.title: 目前为止，一切很糟
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你回到达库鲁身边并听从他的指挥。$B$B在痛苦之匣一带对5只天灾之锅使用稀释药剂。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 你报告的一切情况都和我们已知的情报符合。从达库鲁那里刺探情报并取得他的信任是一个非常重大的进展，可以为你的进一步任务打下基础。$B$B现在，你必须回去，听从他的指挥。你要尽可能地展现你的忠诚，$N。你的表现将产生重大的影响。$B$B这次我还要给你一个新任务：当你走到荒野上的时候，把这瓶药剂倒进他们的天灾之锅里去。它可以中和天灾军团的瘟疫，让锅里的病毒报废。
text.progress: Please, $N, tell me you haven't blown your cover....
text.completion: Nice work, $n! Diluting those cauldrons will not only save lives, it will slow the growth of the Scourge in this region. Now come, tell me what you've learned of Drakuru's strategy in Zul'Drak.
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: So Far, So Bad
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to return to Drakuru and complete any tasks he has for you.$b$bWhile at the Reliquary of Pain, you are to use the Diluting Additive on 5 Blight Cauldrons.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: Everything you've reported is consistent with what we know. Learning of Drakuru and earning his trust will lay the groundwork for your future missions.$b$bReturn to him and do as he says. Do whatever you must to appear sincere, $n. A great deal is riding upon your performance.$b$bThis time I'm adding an additional assignment: While you're in the field, pour this additive into their blight cauldrons. It should neutralize the scourging agent and render the batch useless.
english.progress: Please, $N, tell me you haven't blown your cover....
english.completion: Nice work, $n! Diluting those cauldrons will not only save lives, it will slow the growth of the Scourge in this region. Now come, tell me what you've learned of Drakuru's strategy in Zul'Drak.
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 血色收割
text.objectives: 前往死亡裂口，向瓦拉纳王子报到。
text.description: 阿彻鲁斯的下方就是死亡裂口，我们对血色十字军作战的前沿基地。在这个平台上随便找一头天灾狮鹫，骑着它去向瓦拉纳王子报到。听从他的指挥，这样你或许能活着看到我们征服这片土地。
text.completion: Do you smell it? Fresh meat... The scent of Scarlet Crusader wafts through the air. Apologies, $c, I'm sure you're not interested in my choice of fine cuisine. You are here to work! To lead the charge! Yes... I know. The Lich King has told me all that I need to know about you, $n. The time for bloodshed is now.

english.title: The Scarlet Harvest
english.objectives: Report to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach.
english.description: Below Acherus stands Death's Breach, the staging point for our assault upon the Scarlet Crusade. You are to ride one of my Scourge gryphons, located on either side of this platform, and report to Prince Valanar. Do as he says and you may live to see these lands fall before us.
english.completion: Do you smell it? Fresh meat... The scent of Scarlet Crusader wafts through the air. Apologies, $c, I'm sure you're not interested in my choice of fine cuisine. You are here to work! To lead the charge! Yes... I know. The Lich King has told me all that I need to know about you, $n. The time for bloodshed is now.

text.title: 侦察飞行
text.objectives: 帮助飞行员维克完成侦察飞行。
text.description: 接下来我们要在这一地区进行试飞。教授一直想让我去看看东北边的奇怪气候。$B$B问题是，我需要副驾驶员的协助才能进入未知的领空。我才不要独自去冒险呢。$B$B怎么样？你说不定还能学到点驾驶飞行器的技巧哩。一旦学会应付极地的寒风……你就可以在任何领空飞翔啦。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: You saved my life up there, buddy.  Nice flying!
text.completed: Speak to Pilot Vic at Lakside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Reconnaissance Flight
english.objectives: Help Pilot Vic complete the Reconnaissance Flight.
english.description: It's about time we had planes up and running in this place.  The professor's been asking me to check out a strange weather pattern coming from the northeast.$B$BThing is, I'm going to need a co-pilot if we're going into uncharted territory.  No way in hell I'm heading out there alone.$B$BWhat do you say, $g tough-guy : hotshot;?  You might learn a thing or two.  And once you learn to deal with the northern winds... you can pretty much fly anywhere.
english.completion: You saved my life up there, buddy.  Nice flying!
english.completed: Speak to Pilot Vic at Lakside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 创造条件
text.objectives: 奎丝鲁恩之魂要你收集10块灵界能量碎片。完成任务后返回奎丝鲁恩祭坛向她复命。
text.description: 我可以给你一个活命的机会。$B$B祭坛周围的地上散落着许多能量碎片，它们是用来支撑我身上的诅咒的。我要你帮我去收集一些碎片来。不需要太多，否则我身上的诅咒就会消散了。只要正好让我可以向我的先知复仇就行了。$B$B去吧，爬虫。在我改变主意前，马上去执行我的命令。
text.progress: What a shame that Har'koa didn't send you along sooner. Then again, she and I never did get along. She probably held back your help just long enough for this to happen.
text.completion: They'll do. Likely I won't even need them. But it was fun watching you run around at my command.
text.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Setting the Stage
english.objectives: Quetz'lun's Spirit has demanded that you collect 10 Underworld Power Fragments. Return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun only when you have done so.
english.description: I will give you a chance at continued existence.$B$BThere are fragments of the power that fueled my curse scattered about the altar grounds. It is my desire that you collect some of them for me. Not so many that the curse will be lifted, but enough that I will be able to eventually make use of them to exact revenge upon my prophet.$B$BGo, insect. Run and do my bidding before I change my mind about letting you live.
english.progress: What a shame that Har'koa didn't send you along sooner. Then again, she and I never did get along. She probably held back your help just long enough for this to happen.
english.completion: They'll do. Likely I won't even need them. But it was fun watching you run around at my command.
english.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 官大一级压死人
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的指挥官达库鲁要你对荒芜恶鬼使用暗示节杖，并指挥它们采集7颗荒芜水晶。
text.description: 如果你真的认为自己有资格接受巫妖王的赐福，就必须学会成为一名伟大的领袖——被属下敬畏的领袖！$B$B现在我要交给你一项任务，训练你的指挥技巧，伙计……$B$B去召集我的手下，训练它们采集下面的荒芜水晶，但那些家伙又懒又迟钝，所以你要指挥它们，伙计。$B$B拿上这根节杖，教它们怎样完成任务。一旦它们开始听从你的指挥，就让它们去采集水晶！
text.progress: Ya got my underlings whipped into shape, $n?
text.completion: Da crystals be pilin' up like never before! You keep up da good work, $n. I got more tasks for ya real soon.
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: It Rolls Downhill
english.objectives: Overlord Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Suggestion on the Blight Geists and then order them to harvest 7 Blight Crystals.
english.description: If ya ever gonna be worthy of da Lich King's gifts, ya must learn ta be a great leader - one who be commandin' respect!$b$bI got a task dat gonna refine your command skills, mon....$b$bSumma my minions be trained ta harvest blight crystals from da land below, but dey be lazy and slow. You gonna be in charge o' dem, mon.$b$bTake dis scepter and teach 'em how to get da job done. When dey be under your control, make 'em harvest dem crystals!
english.progress: Ya got my underlings whipped into shape, $n?
english.completion: Da crystals be pilin' up like never before! You keep up da good work, $n. I got more tasks for ya real soon.
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 地狱的复仇
text.objectives: 奎丝鲁恩祭坛的奎丝鲁恩之魂要你对高阶祭司穆弗努、高阶祭司图亚图亚和高阶祭司哈文尼使用奎丝鲁恩的妖术棒，然后杀死他们。
text.description: 现在你该去惩罚我那三个高阶祭司了，他们分别是穆弗努、图亚图亚和哈文尼。你可以在祭坛周围找到他们。$B$B带上这根妖术棒。我已经在里面灌注了我的怒火，它肯定会非常有用的。$B$B你只要使用它，然后去毁灭他们就行了。妖术会处理剩下的事。$B$B<奎丝鲁恩露齿一笑。>$B$B成功以后，我或许会放你走。如果你失败了，那就去死吧。
text.progress: DO YOU THINK THAT I'M A FOOL?$B$BTHEY'RE NOT DEAD!
text.completion: They had it coming. And I'll give them more of the same again and again and again....
text.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.
text.objective1: High Priest Mu'funu hexed at death
text.objective2: High Priestess Tua-Tua hexed at death
text.objective3: High Priest Hawinni hexed at death

english.title: Hell Hath a Fury
english.objectives: Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun wants you to use Quetz'lun's Hexxing Stick upon High Priest Mu'funu, High Priestess Tua-Tua, and High Priest Hawinni. Once you have done this, slay them.
english.description: It is now time for you to punish my three high priests: Mu'funu, Tua-Tua, and Hawinni. You'll find them spread around the altar grounds.$B$BTake this hexxing stick. I've empowered it with my rage and indignation. I'm sure that it will prove potent.$B$BJust use it and proceed to destroy them. The hex will take care of the rest.$B$B<Quetz'lun displays a toothy grin.>$B$BSucceed and I may let you go. Fail and die.
english.progress: DO YOU THINK THAT I'M A FOOL?$B$BTHEY'RE NOT DEAD!
english.completion: They had it coming. And I'll give them more of the same again and again and again....
english.completed: Return to Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun in Zul'Drak.
english.objective1: High Priest Mu'funu hexed at death
english.objective2: High Priestess Tua-Tua hexed at death
english.objective3: High Priest Hawinni hexed at death

text.title: 最后一步
text.objectives: 前往哈克娅祭坛，请求哈克娅在灵界能量碎片中注入一丝她的精魄。
text.description: 还差最后一步，就可以实施我的复仇大计了。你必须为这些能量碎片注入某位仍然健在的神灵的精魄，才能令它们发挥威力。我建议你请求哈克娅的帮助。$B$B如果你能成功的话，那么当你返回这里时，就不会再进入灵界，而是返回我的祭坛所在的物质世界。我的子嗣和守卫者不会再攻击你，这样你就可以轻而易举地接近我的先知。
text.progress: You've returned, $n.
text.completion: A portion of my spirit? That's quite an expensive gift considering that this is for revenge and I'm already greatly weakened by the actions of my subduers. Still, I may know a way.
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: One Last Thing
english.objectives: Deliver the Underworld Power Fragments to Har'koa and beseech her for a portion of her spirit. You will still find her at the Altar of Har'koa.
english.description: There is one last thing that is needed to enact the final revenge against my prophet. The power fragments you collected must be imbued with a portion of a living gods' spirit. You're going to need to beseech Har'koa for some of hers.$B$BOnce you've done that, when you return here, you will not come to the underworld. Instead, you will return to the physical world of my altar. My children and guardians will no longer attack you, and you'll be able to get to my prophet without having to worry about them.
english.progress: You've returned, $n.
english.completion: A portion of my spirit? That's quite an expensive gift considering that this is for revenge and I'm already greatly weakened by the actions of my subduers. Still, I may know a way.
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 破坏
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要求你再去为达库鲁执行一项任务。$B$B除此之外，他还要你前往痛苦之匣，使用炸药束摧毁5辆天灾车。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 我们一直在尝试解开水晶之谜，因此你必须返回沃尔塔鲁斯，执行达库鲁的命令。$B$B每当你成功地完成一项使命，他对你的信任就增加一分，我们也就更容易揣摩他的心思。$B$B呃，我还有一项任务要交给你。达库鲁的天灾车给我们造成了不小的威胁，我要你炸毁它们。$B$B你要设法靠近那些天灾车，然后引爆炸弹。记得迅速撤离！不然很可能伤到你自己。
text.progress: Were you successful in clearing those scourgewagons, $N?
text.completion: Excellent! Your undercover work has truly paid off, $n. Now let's have a look at that scepter....
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Sabotage
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to perform another task for Drakuru.$b$bAdditionally, you are to use the Explosive Charges on 5 Scourgewagons at the  Reliquary of Pain.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: While we're working to discover the purpose of these crystals, we need you back in Voltarus doing Drakuru's bidding.$b$bEvery task you perform successfully gets you closer to him, and brings us that much nearer to knowing his mind.$b$bWhile you're there, I have another mission for you. Drakuru's Scourgewagons pose a significant threat. We need them destroyed. $b$bMake your way to the wagons and activate these charges. Once they're set, get clear! The explosion will expose you if you're too close.
english.progress: Were you successful in clearing those scourgewagons, $N?
english.completion: Excellent! Your undercover work has truly paid off, $n. Now let's have a look at that scepter....
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 危险的材料
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你前往沃尔塔鲁斯,并完成达库鲁给予的任务。你还要从那里偷取5块采集到的荒芜水晶。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 浓缩荒芜水晶？！达库鲁到底想干什么？$B$B显然他在做一件重要的事。你要继续听从他的指挥，或许等他更熟悉你以后，会把这个秘密告诉你的。$B$B同时，我们需要看一看这些水晶。$B$B你到了沃尔塔鲁斯以后，设法悄悄弄一些水晶样品回来。$B$B哦，对了，你要小心一点！携带那些水晶会让你的伪装失效。
text.progress: Welcome back, $n. Were you able to steal any samples of Drakuru's crystals?
text.completion: Fascinating! We'll look into the properties of these crystals right away. Now tell me, $n, what is the latest with this Drakuru fellow?

english.title: Hazardous Materials
english.objectives: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to go to Voltarus and complete any tasks Drakuru has for you. While there, you are to steal 5 Harvested Blight Crystals.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: Blight crystals?! What could this scumbag Drakuru be up to? Clearly, he's working on something significant.$b$bContinue to do his bidding and perhaps once he's more familiar with you he'll reveal his plans. In the meantime, we need to have a look at these crystals.$b$bWhile you're in Voltarus, try to get some samples of the harvested crystals when no one's looking.$b$bBe alert! Handling those crystals can trigger your disguise to fail.
english.progress: Welcome back, $n. Were you able to steal any samples of Drakuru's crystals?
english.completion: Fascinating! We'll look into the properties of these crystals right away. Now tell me, $n, what is the latest with this Drakuru fellow?

text.title: 混乱战车，苦痛驭之
text.objectives: 死亡裂口的瓦拉纳王子命令你击败10个血色十字军战士或血色农夫，以及10个海文郡预备兵。
text.description: 现在他们准备在死亡裂口外面背水一战，徒劳地想要挽救他们的马匹、矿洞、木材和平民。$B$B你将在天灾军团中学到第一堂军事课：恐惧！$B$B到南方的前线去，击败那些血色十字军。我们可以在死亡远征时用到他们。$B$B但最重要的是：要击败那些胆小如鼠的、假扮成普通人和农夫的预备兵，他们伪装成平民来偷取我们的萨隆邪铁箭矢。在他们弄坏这些宝贵的箭矢之前击败他们，并把恐惧深深埋入那些人的心底。
text.progress: This is the opening sonata, $c. The Scourge death march begins with the eradication of the front lines.
text.completion: Do you feel it, $n? That sensation is raw power coursing through your body. Such a thing cannot exist for mortals. The front lines are now dismantled. The geist will finish the job and prepare the grounds for Razuvious. We turn our attention now to more tactical targets.
text.completed: Return to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: If Chaos Drives, Let Suffering Hold The Reins
english.objectives: Prince Valanar at Death's Breach commands you to slay 10 Scarlet Crusaders or Scarlet Peasants and 10 Citizens of Havenshire.
english.description: They make their stand now, outside of Death's Breach, futilely attempting to push us back in hopes of saving their horses, mines, lumber and citizens.$B$BThis will be your first lesson in Scourge warfare: TERROR!$B$BGo to the front lines, south of here, and destroy Scarlet Crusaders. Leave their corpses so that we may utilize them for the death march.$B$BBut most importantly: kill the fleeing villagers. Soldiers dying are an affordance, but villagers? That is what strikes fear into the hearts of man.
english.progress: This is the opening sonata, $c. The Scourge death march begins with the eradication of the front lines.
english.completion: Do you feel it, $n? That sensation is raw power coursing through your body. Such a thing cannot exist for mortals. The front lines are now dismantled. The geist will finish the job and prepare the grounds for Razuvious. We turn our attention now to more tactical targets.
english.completed: Return to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 今夜，我们在海文郡欢宴！
text.objectives: 死亡裂口的遮天者奥里索斯要你去回收15支萨隆邪铁箭矢。
text.description: 遮天者都是无意识的构造体，它们唯一的用途就是：战斗！$B$B不过眼下有一个小问题……它们使用的是射程极远杀伤力极大的萨隆邪铁箭矢。但萨隆矿石只有诺森德才出产，而且产量非常有限！去帮我回收一些箭矢，我会好好奖赏你的。
text.progress: The trajectories they are firing at would have most of the arrows land at or near the Havenshire Farm, south of us.
text.completion: Well done, $c! You feed the Scourge war machine with your deeds! Ah yes, your reward - as promised.
text.completed: Return to Orithos the Sky Darkener at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Tonight We Dine In Havenshire
english.objectives: Orithos the Sky Darkener at Death's Breach wants you to recover 15 Saronite Arrows.
english.description: The Sky Darkeners are mindless constructs with one purpose: KILL! Specifically, they are aiming to kill any man or woman that they see fleeing Havenshire for the safety of New Avalon. We certainly can't allow those cowards to make it to safety and then take up arms against us!$B$BThere is one slight problem. They use saronite arrows for maximum range and damage. Saronite, however, is a metal only found in Northrend, so supplies are limited! Retrieve those arrows for me and I will reward you handsomely.
english.progress: The trajectories they are firing at would have most of the arrows land at or near the Havenshire Farm, south of us.
english.completion: Well done, $c! You feed the Scourge war machine with your deeds! Ah yes, your reward - as promised.
english.completed: Return to Orithos the Sky Darkener at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 阿彻鲁斯战马
text.objectives: 骑手萨拉纳尔要你从海文郡马厩中骑上一匹血色战马，然后回到死亡裂口，把马交给他。
text.description: 真是巧，离这处岗哨仅一箭之遥的地方就有一座十字军的马厩，里面有许多马匹。虽然他们守卫严密，但一个年轻勇敢的死亡骑士完全可以突破他们的防线，带走自己想要的东西！$B$B你从海文郡马厩选到一匹好马后就骑上它回来找我，我会想办法把它转化成死亡战马的。$B$B记住，$N，如果你被制伏了，就要想办法再回去弄一匹。记得当心那个管理员，基特里克！
text.progress: You don't want to walk forever, do you?
text.completion: Now for the true test. Can you show mastery over an unbound charger and brutally overtake the thing that you desire most?
text.completed: Return to Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Grand Theft Palomino
english.objectives: Salanar the Horseman asks that you steal a horse from the Havenshire Stables and return it to him at Death's Breach.
english.description: How fortuitous it is that the Crusade has a stable full of horses a mere stone's throw from this post. Though they guard it tenaciously, an enterprising young death knight could break through their defenses and take what is rightfully $g his:hers;!$B$BOnce you acquire a horse from the Havenshire Stables, return it to me and I will see what can be done about transforming it into a proper deathcharger.$B$BRemember, $N, it's only stealing if you're caught. Watch out for that deranged stable master, Kitrik!
english.progress: You don't want to walk forever, do you?
english.completion: Now for the true test. Can you show mastery over an unbound charger and brutally overtake the thing that you desire most?
english.completed: Return to Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 猎取材料
text.objectives: 将5只扭曲的大鹏爪交给多里安哨站的考尔文·诺灵顿。
text.description: 达拉然的大法师伯塔鲁斯希望我们给他带回各种材料和辟邪物。索拉查盆地的原住民似乎特别迷信动物的肢体，取自血爪大鹏的扭曲的大鹏爪是他们的最爱。$B$B我没有资格评论关于这件辟邪物的传言是否属实，不过这里头总归是有些缘由的。$B$B血爪大鹏生活在东北方的埋骨地，以猛犸象的尸体为食。你能帮我收集一些爪子供大法师研究吗？
text.progress: Were you able to find any of the twisted talons?
text.completion: These will more than suffice. The gorlocs have a saying that the more gnarled the talon, the more power it holds. I'm sure the archmage will get his money's worth from this expedition.
text.completed: Return to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Reagent Agent
english.objectives: Bring 5 Twisted Roc Claws to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost.
english.description: That Archmage Pentarus, back in Dalaran, will be expecting us to return with all kinds of reagents and talismans. It seems the locals are fond of animal parts. Twisted claws from the goretalon rocs are among their favorite.$B$BIt's not my place to say whether the rumors are true or not, but I've a feeling there's something here.$B$BThe rocs live in the Bonefields off to the northeast, where they feed on the corpses of old mammoths. Will you help me gather talons for the archmage's research?
english.progress: Were you able to find any of the twisted talons?
english.completion: These will more than suffice. The gorlocs have a saying that the more gnarled the talon, the more power it holds. I'm sure the archmage will get his money's worth from this expedition.
english.completed: Return to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: Uncharted Territory (DEPRECATED)
text.description: 并非所有的远征队成员都是来狩猎取乐的，我们中的一部分人还肩负着重要的研究工作。$B$B冰封的诺森德中心竟然存在这样一片热带天堂——索拉查盆地真是不可思议的存在。如果我不能搞清楚这片土地的奥秘，就不配做个学者。$B$B这张地图给你吧。

english.title: Uncharted Territory (DEPRECATED)
english.description: Not all of us in this expedition are here to hunt the biggest and rarest game.  Some of us actually have serious work to do.$B$BThe mere existence of this place boggles the mind -- a tropical paradise in the middle of Northrend.  I wouldn't be a scholar worthy of the name if I didn't put some effort into trying to understand this place.$B$BTake these

text.title: 燃烧的唾液
text.objectives: 多里安哨站的考尔文·诺灵顿要你收集5份多头蛇唾液样本并杀死5只苦潮多头蛇。
text.description: 苦潮多头蛇的唾液是索拉查盆地中腐蚀性最强的物质。我打算用特制的容器收集一些，供大法师伯塔鲁斯进行研究。现在嘛，我需要一位勇敢的，呃……收集者。$B$B你看上去就很有冒险家的气质！怎么样，你愿意支援达拉然的研究事业吗？还能顺便赚一笔小钱哟。$B$B前往西南方的苦潮湖，挑逗那些多头蛇，用这个容器将它们向你喷射的毒液装起来就行啦。
text.progress: Did you get those samples?
text.completion: Wonderful! Here's your payment, as agreed. And, uh, a bit of advice: you might want to enjoy long, hot baths the next few days if that 'burning sensation' persists.
text.completed: Return to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Burning to Help
english.objectives: Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost wants you to take 5 Hydra Sputum Samples and kill 5 Bittertide Hydra.
english.description: There's no more caustic material in all of the basin than bittertide hydra sputum. I've got special containers to collect just such a thing for Archmage Pentarus' studies. Now all I need is a brave, um... collector.$B$BYou look like a hardy, adventurous $c. How'd you like to make a bit of money and aid Dalaran's cause at the same time?$B$BAll you need to do is take this container with you to Bittertide Lake, to the southwest. Engage the hydra and use the container to sample the sputum they shower you with.
english.progress: Did you get those samples?
english.completion: Wonderful! Here's your payment, as agreed. And, uh, a bit of advice: you might want to enjoy long, hot baths the next few days if that 'burning sensation' persists.
english.completed: Return to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 死去神灵的血液
text.objectives: 哈克娅要求你收集7份犸托斯之血，并把它们带回哈克娅祭坛交给她。
text.description: 猛犸之神犸托斯前些日子亲手毁灭了自己，并将他那伟大的神殿也摧毁了。他宁可死，也不愿意让达卡莱巨魔窃取他一丝一毫的力量。$B$B现在我需要牺牲自己的一部分灵魂，因此需要一些外来的能量以支撑自身的延续。$B$B犸托斯自我毁灭的地方就在东北方，奎丝鲁恩祭坛的正北边不远。他的自爆在那里留下了一个巨大的坑洞，里面满是他的血液。$B$B给我带一些他的血液回来。
text.progress: I wish that there were something that we could do to bring Mam'toth back to life, but there isn't. We can honor him and his sacrifice by continuing the fight against the Drakkari.
text.completion: Very well. Let us see if this works....
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Blood of a Dead God
english.objectives: Har'koa has asked you to collect 7 Blood of Mam'toth. Return them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.
english.description: Mam'toth, the god of the mammoths, destroyed himself, and took much of his temple with him, rather than allowing his trolls to gain his power.$B$BIf I'm to sacrifice a portion of my spirit, I will need something with which to bolster myself.$B$BMam'toth left behind an enormous crater to the northeast, just north of the Altar of Quetz'lun. Within the crater his blood yet lives.$B$BBring it to me.
english.progress: I wish that there were something that we could do to bring Mam'toth back to life, but there isn't. We can honor him and his sacrifice by continuing the fight against the Drakkari.
english.completion: Very well. Let us see if this works....
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 种瓜得瓜种豆得豆
text.objectives: 杀死虚弱的奎丝鲁恩先知，然后通知希姆托加的巫医库弗。
text.description: 复仇……复仇的时候终于到来了。$B$B<哈克娅低沉地叹了一口气。>$B$B把这只包裹里的东西带到奎丝鲁恩的尸体旁去，在她的祭坛上打开包裹，启动仪式。如果一切正常，她的灵魂将被重新拉回物质界，这样一来，她就可以从那个卑贱的先知手中夺回自己的力量。$B$B之后的一切就都指望你了，$N。你一定要在先知失去力量之后立刻杀死他，结束风蛇女神的梦魇。
text.progress: What brings you back to me, $N?
text.completion: It sounds like you barely escaped Quetz'lun's underworld alive. I'm glad that it's you out there. I don't know if I would have had the courage to deal with that situation!
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: You Reap What You Sow
english.objectives: Slay the Drained Prophet of Quetz'lun and then inform Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.
english.description: This is what it has come down to... revenge.$B$B<Har'koa sighs.>$B$BTake this ritual kit and enact it near Quetz'lun's corpse upon her altar. If everything works properly, her spirit should be drawn into the material world where she will be able to reclaim her power from the prophet.$B$BThe rest will be up to you, $N. You must slay the prophet in his drained state.
english.progress: What brings you back to me, $N?
english.completion: It sounds like you barely escaped Quetz'lun's underworld alive. I'm glad that it's you out there. I don't know if I would have had the courage to deal with that situation!
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 无法容忍
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你前往痛苦之匣，对一名达库鲁的仆从使用强化节杖，然后使用它的技能击败达穆克。
text.description: 白痴！蠢货！这是不能容忍的！整整一批的瘟疫菌株居然都变成了废物！$B$B达穆克那个混帐！饭桶！他本应负责保养好那些瘟疫菌株的，太令我失望了！$B$B这对你来说也是个不错的教训，$N。失败往往会像传染病一样迅速传播。发生第一次失败之后，你必须立刻抓住它，消灭它，否则，它就会反过来使得你被别人消灭！$B$B拿上这根能使我们天灾巨魔更加强大的节杖。你要用它杀死达穆克。那混蛋应该就躲在南边的什么地方。$B$B就让那条败狗用自己的性命给所有人提个醒吧。让达库鲁失望，就等于死！
text.progress: Has Darmuk paid for his failure, $n?
text.completion: Ya done good, $n. You be learnin' faster than I had hoped. Go now, get ya some rest. Soon I be givin' ya an even greater test!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Zero Tolerance
english.objectives: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to go to the Reliquary of Pain and use the Scepter of Empowerment on a Servant of Drakuru. You are then to use its abilities to defeat Darmuk.
english.description: Ignorance! Dis be intolerable, mon! My entire batch of blight be useless!$b$bDat mongrel, Darmuk! He be responsible for watchin over da blight. He failed me, mon!$b$bDis be a good lesson for ya, $n. Failure be like a disease dat spreads. Ya gotta catch it and kill it early, before it be killin' you!$b$bTake dis scepter. It make my scourged trolls stronger. Use dem ta kill Darmuk. He be lurkin' down below just to da south.$b$bLet dat be an example to all, mon. Don't be failin' Drakuru!
english.progress: Has Darmuk paid for his failure, $n?
english.completion: Ya done good, $n. You be learnin' faster than I had hoped. Go now, get ya some rest. Soon I be givin' ya an even greater test!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 进入暗影界
text.objectives: 死亡裂口的骑手萨拉纳尔要求你去消灭阿彻鲁斯黑暗骑士，并夺走他的阿彻鲁斯死亡战马。$B$B如果你成功地将阿彻鲁斯死亡战马带回死亡裂口，就使用“骑手的召唤”技能召唤萨拉纳尔。
text.description: 你送来的战马已经被送往暗影界。我的黑暗骑士将在那里训练它，然后把它强化成为一匹死亡战马。你觉得自己有足够的勇气进入暗影界去夺取亡灵战马吗？$B$B如果你愿意的话，我可以把你传送到暗影界，等你到了那里之后，去我们南面的空地上寻找黑暗骑士。为了得到你自己的死亡战马，你必须击败他，夺取他的死亡战马，然后回到死亡裂口来。成功之后，就使用骑手的召唤。
text.progress: You must take the deathcharger by force, $c!
text.completion: You have succeeded where most initiates fail, $n. For that you will be rewarded handsomely.
text.completed: Return to Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Into the Realm of Shadows
english.objectives: Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach has challenged you to slay the Dark Rider of Acherus and take his Acherus Deathcharger.$B$BShould you succeed, return the Acherus Deathcharger to Death's Breach and use the Horseman's Call to summon Salanar.
english.description: The horse you stole has been taken to the Realm of Shadows. It is there that my dark rider will slay the beast and raise it as a deathcharger. Do you think yourself brave enough to enter the Realm of Shadows in pursuit of the deathcharger?$B$BIf you accept, I will transport you to the shadow world. Once there, seek out a dark rider in the open fields south of us. To emerge victorious you must slay him, overtake his deathcharger and return it to Death's Breach. Issue the Horseman's Call should you succeed.
english.progress: You must take the deathcharger by force, $c!
english.completion: You have succeeded where most initiates fail, $n. For that you will be rewarded handsomely.
english.completed: Return to Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 工程师的逃亡
text.objectives: 护送工程师赫莉丝逃离斯温迪格林挖掘场，然后与奈辛瓦里营地的赫米特·奈辛瓦里谈一谈。
text.description: 这群愚蠢的地精和他们的狗奴才竟然将这根水晶柱视为已有。我原本是来勘探水晶的，可就在我采集样本时，他们冲出来打倒了我，并拒绝让我返回营地。$B$B带我逃离这里吧，我们还可以顺路好好收拾一下这些暴徒！
text.completion: Thank you for freeing Helice and seeing to her safe return. We all started to get worried when she didn't return from her crystal hunting trip.
text.end: Escort Engineer Helice out of Swindlegrin's Dig
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Engineering a Disaster
english.objectives: Help Engineer Helice escape from Swindlegrin's Dig, then speak with Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
english.description: These goblin goons and their minions have decided that they own this pillar and its crystals. I came here to explore the crystals and take samples, but they overpowered me and won't let me return to the camp.$B$BIf you'll help me fight our way out of here, we can teach these thugs a lesson they'll never forget!
english.completion: Thank you for freeing Helice and seeing to her safe return. We all started to get worried when she didn't return from her crystal hunting trip.
english.end: Escort Engineer Helice out of Swindlegrin's Dig
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 火上浇油
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你对浮肿的憎恶使用命令节杖，然后利用它们的能力在冰冷裂口击败60名达卡莱裂颅者，并将3名达卡莱酋长引诱出来。$B$B只要击败足够数量的达卡莱裂颅者，酋长们就会出现。
text.description: 是时候进军古达克了，朋友。是时候让你去教训教训那些不知好歹的巨魔了！$B$B那群混蛋前几天攻破了我们的城墙，还将一整支军队驻扎在了北面。$B$B哈哈哈哈！$B$B简直是给天灾之火上面浇了一把油！我要把他们的酋长都抓起来，至于其他的蝼蚁……都无关紧要了！这将是我的宏伟计划中最重要的一环……$B$B拿着这根节杖，用它来号令我的憎恶。嗯，你可以带上所有的憎恶前往那群达卡莱巨魔的营地，把他们全部击败！等他们的酋长出现以后，我的宠物岩翼会把他们全部抓回来。
text.progress: Did ya smash da trolls, $n?
text.completion: We done it, mon! I got da chieftains all caged up and you led my abominations to victory over their armies. It be time ta celebrate, mon!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Fuel for the Fire
english.objectives: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Command on Bloated Abominations and then use their abilities at the Frigid Breach to kill 60 Drakkari Skullcrushers and lure out 3 Drakkari Chieftains.$b$bChieftains will appear when enough Skullcrushers have been slain.
english.description: It be time we start our march to Gundrak, mon. It be time for me ta turn ya loose on dem trolls!$b$bDey breached our wall and put a whole army just north of us.$b$bHahaha!$b$bDey be fuel for da fire, mon! We gunna take da chieftiains an' kill da rest! It all be part of my master plan....$b$bYou take dis scepter and go command my abominations. Bring 'em to da Drakkari army and kill em all! When da chieftains come, my pet Shalewing gunna snatch 'em up and bring 'em here to me.
english.progress: Did ya smash da trolls, $n?
english.completion: We done it, mon! I got da chieftains all caged up and you led my abominations to victory over their armies. It be time ta celebrate, mon!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 古旧的石箱
text.objectives: 从索拉查卫士身上取得巨型石钥匙，用它打开造物者悬台上的古旧石箱。
text.description: 这个石箱似乎被锁住了，看来要在锁眼中插入相配的钥匙才能打开它。$B$B那些石头卫士身上或许带有这把钥匙。
text.progress: The stone coffer does not budge.
text.completion: The huge stone key turns with a deep grunt as the coffer lid opens up to reveal hidden treasure inside.
text.completed: Return to Timeworn Coffer on the Maker's Overlook in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: A Timeworn Coffer
english.objectives: Obtain a Huge Stone Key from the nearby Sholazar Guardians and bring it to the Timeworn Coffer at the Maker's Overlook.
english.description: The stone coffer appears to be locked.  It appears that a key fits inside a large stone keyhole.$B$BPerhaps one of the guardians in the vicinity has this key in its possession.
english.progress: The stone coffer does not budge.
english.completion: The huge stone key turns with a deep grunt as the coffer lid opens up to reveal hidden treasure inside.
english.completed: Return to Timeworn Coffer on the Maker's Overlook in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 巫妖猎手归来
text.objectives: 返回狂心岭，与长者哈尔卡克谈一谈。
text.description: 好啦，我要返回狂心岭，告诉大家你为狼獾人氏族还有瑟匹克所做的一切。你是个伟大的猎手，他们却不相信你，真是太愚蠢啦。$B$B你也回去吧，和长者哈尔卡克谈一谈……他知道你不是什么叛徒。$B$B谢谢你，巫妖猎手。
text.completion: It good to see you again. I knew you not a traitor, I glad Zepik prove me right. I hear you Lich Hunter now - that pretty good! You make Harkek proud.

english.title: Return of the Lich Hunter
english.objectives: Return to Frenzyheart Hill and speak to Elder Harkek.
english.description: Okay, I going back to Frenzyheart Hill to make sure all Frenzyheart know what you done for wolvar and for Zepik. You great hunter and they dumb to think you not.$B$BGo back to hill and talk to Elder Harkek... I make sure he knows you not traitor before any other Frenzyheart.$B$BThank you, Lich Hunter.
english.completion: It good to see you again. I knew you not a traitor, I glad Zepik prove me right. I hear you Lich Hunter now - that pretty good! You make Harkek proud.

text.title: 友善的干燥皮肤朋友
text.objectives: 返回雨声树屋，与高阶神谕者索乌塞谈一谈。
text.description: 啊呀！索乌塞很可能在担心我们！你应该回去向他报个平安，好吗？嗯，告诉索乌塞所有的事情。$B$B我要在巫妖的尸体上找个东西——咱们回去再碰面吧！去吧去吧！回去再和你碰面！
text.completion: Good to see you again! We worried when you not come back right away. Jaloot beat you back - lot of energy in Jaloot, he pretty fast. He told me how you save him from lich thing. Moodle told me how you save mosswalkers too. You really nice. I hope you stay with us for while. Always something need doing.

english.title: Return of the Friendly Dryskin
english.objectives: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy and speak to High-Oracle Soo-say.
english.description: Yay! Soo-say probably worrying about us! Maybe you go back to town and tell him everything okay? Yeah, go tell Soo-say.$B$BI going grab shiny ball thing from dead lich guy - I meet you there! Go go! I meet you there!
english.completion: Good to see you again! We worried when you not come back right away. Jaloot beat you back - lot of energy in Jaloot, he pretty fast. He told me how you save him from lich thing. Moodle told me how you save mosswalkers too. You really nice. I hope you stay with us for while. Always something need doing.

text.title: 空中侦察
text.objectives: 卡尔维特教授要你飞往湖边着陆场，与飞行员维克谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你帮维斯雷修好了那架飞行器。$B$B你愿意再帮我们一个忙吗？西北方有一股不寻常的气流袭来。我已经指派了飞行员维克去侦察情况，不过他恐怕还需要一名副驾驶员。$B$B如果你觉得自己能胜任的话，就飞往湖边着陆场去找他吧。哦，记得告诉他，是我派你去的。
text.completion: The professor sent you my way?  All right.

english.title: Aerial Surveillance
english.objectives: Professor Calvert wants you to take the flight to Lakeside Landing and speak with Pilot Vic there.
english.description: You did a good job helping Wes with getting that flying machine back up and running.$B$BIf you'd like to help us further, there is an unusual weather pattern coming in from the northeast.  I have a pilot ready to work for me, but I'm afraid he needs a copilot.$B$BIf you think you're up to it, you can take the flight to Lakeside Landing.  Tell Vic I sent you.
english.completion: The professor sent you my way?  All right.

text.title: 收割者戈提克
text.objectives: 与死亡裂口的收割者戈提克谈一谈。
text.description: 一片混乱，$N！血色十字军陷入了疯狂。他们调动了新阿瓦隆外围的所有部队，在东面的圣光哨站设置了封锁。他们正不顾一切地掠夺海文郡矿洞中的所有资源，并把它们运送到停泊在海岸旁的护卫舰上。$B$B我们也去凑凑热闹如何？收割者戈提克——巫妖王的首席通灵师——已经来到了我们中间。他有一件礼物想要送给血色十字军，你去找他吧。
text.completion: You have fought hard to invade the realm of the harvester... Wait. My apologies, $r. Old habits die hard. Valanar sent you, then? I trust you are somewhat competent. I do have a gift for the Scarlet dogs. One that is sure to speed up their work in the mines.

english.title: Gothik the Harvester
english.objectives: Speak with Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach.
english.description: CHAOS, $N! The Crusade is in a frenzy. They have diverted all forces outside of New Avalon to set up a blockade at Light's Point, east of here. They are desperately trying to strip the Havenshire Mine of all resources and load the cargo aboard the frigates they have docked on the coast.$B$BLet's stir things up a bit, shall we? Gothik the Harvester, grand necromancer of the Lich King, has graced us with his presence. He has a gift he'd like to bestow upon the Scarlet Crusade. Seek him out.
english.completion: You have fought hard to invade the realm of the harvester... Wait. My apologies, $r. Old habits die hard. Valanar sent you, then? I trust you are somewhat competent. I do have a gift for the Scarlet dogs. One that is sure to speed up their work in the mines.

text.title: 收割者的礼物
text.objectives: 死亡裂口的收割者戈提克让你对血色矿工使用收割者的礼物，制造出5个被控制的血色矿工之后向戈提克复命。
text.description: 我从冰冷的纳克萨玛斯来到这里，以享受灵魂的盛宴，给我们的仇敌带来痛苦的打击——不过我的灵魂储备已经耗尽了。$B$B来，带上我给你的见面礼，把它带到东面的海文郡矿洞去，放在血色矿工干活的地方。用它将矿工变成被控制的矿工，等你手里有了一支小军队后回到我这里来。我给他们在灵魂容器里留了一块特别的地方！
text.progress: One small note: miners don't always become ghouls. Sometimes they turn into enraged spirits, hell-bent on killing you.
text.completion: They now know that the mines are no longer safe. They will double their efforts in retreating, leaving their backs open to us!
text.completed: Return to Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: The Gift That Keeps On Giving
english.objectives: Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach has given you the Gift of the Harvester to use on Scarlet Miners. Create 5 Scarlet Ghouls with the device and return the ghouls to Gothik.
english.description: I have come from the frozen heart of Naxxramas to feast on souls and deliver a vicious thrashing upon our sworn enemies - and I'm all out of souls.$B$BThis device I am about to give to you is a portable plague spreader. Take it east, to the Havenshire Mines, and unleash it near the Scarlet miners working inside. Use it to turn the miners into ghouls and return to me when you have a small army at your side. I have saved a special place for them in the vacuum cleaner of souls!
english.progress: One small note: miners don't always become ghouls. Sometimes they turn into enraged spirits, hell-bent on killing you.
english.completion: They now know that the mines are no longer safe. They will double their efforts in retreating, leaving their backs open to us!
english.completed: Return to Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 尴尬的事件
text.objectives: Look for Vic's Keys inside the lake at River's Heart.
text.description: There's one little problem we have to solve before we head out.  You see, I can't seem to find the keys to my flying machine.$B$BI've looked pretty much everywhere for them... maybe you can give me a hand.  Only place I haven't looked yet is inside the lake.$B$BI'll even give you my very own air tank.  It's almost empty, but it's got a couple of hits left.
text.progress: You find anything yet, $n?
text.completion: 好极了！
text.completed: Return to Pilot Vic at Lakeside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: An Embarassing Incident
english.objectives: Look for Vic's Keys inside the lake at River's Heart.
english.description: There's one little problem we have to solve before we head out.  You see, I can't seem to find the keys to my flying machine.$B$BI've looked pretty much everywhere for them... maybe you can give me a hand.  Only place I haven't looked yet is inside the lake.$B$BI'll even give you my very own air tank.  It's almost empty, but it's got a couple of hits left.
english.progress: You find anything yet, $n?
english.completion: Excellent!
english.completed: Return to Pilot Vic at Lakeside Landing in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 伺机待发
text.objectives: 与死亡裂口的瓦拉纳王子谈一谈。
text.description: 看样子只有新阿瓦隆和圣光哨站的十字军部队能够算得上是威胁了！进攻圣光哨站的血色舰队的时机已经成熟。$B$B矿洞那边发生的事情使得他们的士兵乱作一团。他们正在疯狂般清理那个地方，并撤回他们的战舰上。$B$B时机成熟了！瓦拉纳王子正想利用这次机会一举干掉血色舰队。马上去向他报到！
text.completion: You have served us well, $c. Few of your brethren have survived our initial attack upon the Scarlet interlopers. You remain as one of the strongest. East of us, past the Havenshire Mine, is the coast - called Light's Point by the Scarlet Crusade. A thousand soldiers stand between us and their ships. Insurmountable? Hardly the point...

english.title: An Attack Of Opportunity
english.objectives: Speak with Prince Valanar at Death's Breach.
english.description: Only the Scarlet forces at New Avalon and Light's Point challenge us! The time to attack the Scarlet fleet at Light's Point has come.$B$BThe diversion at the mine has caused chaos amidst their ranks. They are frantically working to clear the area and return to their ships.$B$BThe time is ripe! Prince Valanar is seizing this opportunity to finish off the Scarlet fleet. Report to him at once!
english.completion: You have served us well, $c. Few of your brethren have survived our initial attack upon the Scarlet interlopers. You remain as one of the strongest. East of us, past the Havenshire Mine, is the coast - called Light's Point by the Scarlet Crusade. A thousand soldiers stand between us and their ships. Insurmountable? Hardly the point...

text.title: 炮轰圣光哨站
text.objectives: 死亡裂口的瓦拉纳王子命令你去打倒100个血色防御者。
text.description: 十字军如此手忙脚乱，一定会犯一个致命的错误：忘记检查矿车。$B$B你要做的就是回到东面的海文郡矿洞，找到我的手下放在厕所附近的矿车。爬进矿车中，那些血色矿工肯定是不会发现你的，这样你就可以安全地深入敌后了。$B$B登上他们的战舰之后，用火炮攻击他们！把他们都震晕！一旦他们失去行动能力，我们就可以顺利部署作战了。$B$B等你准备回来的时候，只需在大炮那里召唤天灾狮鹫就行了。
text.progress: Death knights know no fear!
text.completion: The entire Scarlet fleet wiped out in a matter of minutes! I will receive a commendation from the Lich King for this! All that remains of the Scarlet Crusade now are the denizens of New Avalon. I'll set the fire starters and necromancers upon Havenshire immediately. You will carry my report to the Highlord!
text.completed: Return to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Massacre At Light's Point
english.objectives: Prince Valanar at Death's Breach has commanded you to slaughter 100 Scarlet Defenders.
english.description: In their haste the Crusade will make one fatal error: forgetting to check the mine cars.$B$BYou are to return to Havenshire Mine, east of here, and locate the mine car that my minions have planted near the outhouse. Climb inside the mine car and a Scarlet miner will unwittingly see to it that you are placed safely behind enemy lines.$B$BOnce aboard one of their ships, use the cannons against them! SLAUGHTER THEM ALL!$B$BCall the Scourge gryphon from the cannon when you are ready to return.
english.progress: Death knights know no fear!
english.completion: The entire Scarlet fleet wiped out in a matter of minutes! I will receive a commendation from the Lich King for this! All that remains of the Scarlet Crusade now are the denizens of New Avalon. I'll set the fire starters and necromancers upon Havenshire immediately. You will carry my report to the Highlord!
english.completed: Return to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 抓鸡狂欢节！
text.objectives: 狂心岭的长者哈尔卡克要你去捕捉12只逃走的小鸡。
text.description: 我打赌你猜不到又出了什么状况。$B$B错啦，和格利基克无关，也不是鸡舍的事。$B$B好吧，我骗你的。就是格利基克！鸡们又被他吓得跑掉了。愚蠢的格利基克！我的肚子已经饿得咕咕叫了。$B$B如果你需要其他猎手的帮助，告诉我一声就是了……鸡们就躲在附近。
text.progress: Chickens not get far usually... if wasps not eat them, maybe we just let them stay on field next time.
text.completion: You good at this. Maybe someday we just dump Goregek in river so you not have to do this no more.
text.completed: Return to Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Chicken Party!
english.objectives: Capture 12 Chicken Escapees for Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill.
english.description: I bet you not guess what happen again.$B$BNope, not Goregek or chickens.$B$BOkay, I lie. Goregek let chickens out again. Dumb Goregek and rumbly belly.$B$BLet me know if you need help from any of the hunters... they around here somewhere.
english.progress: Chickens not get far usually... if wasps not eat them, maybe we just let them stay on field next time.
english.completion: You good at this. Maybe someday we just dump Goregek in river so you not have to do this no more.
english.completed: Return to Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 卡塔克的愤怒
text.objectives: Bring a pure sample of Oracle Blood to the Altar of Kartak to summon Kartak. With the aid of Kartak's shared powers, slaughter 50 of the nearby Sparktouched Gorlocs for Shaman Jakjek in Kartak's Hold.
text.description: You the great Lich Hunter, eh? Good to have such strong Frenzyheart ally for battle. Maybe you strong enough to call Kartak even.$B$BBig battle at Kartak's Hold to southwest.  Go kill spark big-tongues until you get good bit of Oracle Blood. Bring blood to altar in Kartak's Hold to call Kartak for delicious feast of big-tongue.$B$BKartak take your body if you worthy... with Kartak's powers, you slaughter more big-tongues than even best dreams.$B$BGo kill lots, hunter!
text.progress: So many big-tongues to kill! So fun, eh?
text.completion: Ritual went so easy for you! You come back later for more killing someday, okay?
text.completed: Return to Shaman Jakjek at Kartak's Hold in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Kartak's Rampage
english.objectives: Bring a pure sample of Oracle Blood to the Altar of Kartak to summon Kartak. With the aid of Kartak's shared powers, slaughter 50 of the nearby Sparktouched Gorlocs for Shaman Jakjek in Kartak's Hold.
english.description: You the great Lich Hunter, eh? Good to have such strong Frenzyheart ally for battle. Maybe you strong enough to call Kartak even.$B$BBig battle at Kartak's Hold to southwest.  Go kill spark big-tongues until you get good bit of Oracle Blood. Bring blood to altar in Kartak's Hold to call Kartak for delicious feast of big-tongue.$B$BKartak take your body if you worthy... with Kartak's powers, you slaughter more big-tongues than even best dreams.$B$BGo kill lots, hunter!
english.progress: So many big-tongues to kill! So fun, eh?
english.completion: Ritual went so easy for you! You come back later for more killing someday, okay?
english.completed: Return to Shaman Jakjek at Kartak's Hold in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 取悦雨水巨石
text.objectives: 雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞要你带上一名同伴，挖掘并收集6份闪闪发亮的宝贝。$B$B记得与雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞谈谈关于帮手的事。
text.description: 苔行村遭到攻击，我担心这是我们对雨水巨石不够好的缘故……或许是我们太贪心了吧。我们要向祭坛供奉更多的祭品！$B$B你还记得吗，就是上次要你找的那些闪闪发亮的宝贝……你能再帮我们弄些回来吗？如果你需要某个鳄鱼人帮忙的话，告诉我一声就是了。
text.progress: Never enough shinies... Great Rain Stone good to us, we need be good to Great Rain Stone.
text.completion: So many good shinies! You good at this. Come back for more again later, yes?
text.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Appeasing the Great Rain Stone
english.objectives: High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to take a companion to dig up and collect 6 Shiny Treasures.$B$BBe sure to speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy about securing the aid of one of your previous companions.
english.description: Since mosswalker been attacked I worried maybe we not good to Great Rain Stone... we maybe too greedy. We need more treasures to offer!$B$BYou good at finding shinies last time... maybe you go look more around village for shinies? You maybe need one of good Rainspeakers for help. Just tell us who.
english.progress: Never enough shinies... Great Rain Stone good to us, we need be good to Great Rain Stone.
english.completion: So many good shinies! You good at this. Come back for more again later, yes?
english.completed: Return to High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 泰坦的意志
text.objectives: 从灵鳍湾附近的狼獾人身上取得1块被污染的水晶，将它带去闪电巨石处，召唤出索乌霍鲁。借助他的力量在神祠附近杀死50个狂心狼獾人，然后向灵鳍湾的唤雷者索乌米特复命。
text.description: 狗狗人一直在攻击灵鳍湾……我们必须反击，否则他们会越来越有恃无恐。$B$B你是我们的好朋友，所以我们让你享受这份殊荣。很久以前，造物主指派一名守护者留下来保卫祭坛……如今他依然在这里。但是除非祭坛陷入混乱，不然他是不会显身的。$B$B那些狗狗人手里就有坏水晶，他们想用坏水晶来祭坛捣乱……我要你带上一块坏水晶去闪电祭坛，这样索乌霍鲁就会出来帮你。$B$B要是他占据了你的躯壳，你可不要惊慌……他很厉害的，肯定可以保证你的安全。
text.progress: Thank you for help dryskin. You very good to us.
text.completion: Soo-holu strong, huh? I very glad he accept you to share his body for fight. He more trusting of people he met before, so maybe come back another time to help more, yes?
text.completed: Speak to Lightningcaller Soo-met at Sparktouched Haven in Sholazar Basin.

english.title: Will of the Titans
english.objectives: Obtain a Tainted Crystal from the wolvar near Sparktouched Haven and bring it to the Great Lightning Stone to call Soo-holu. With the aid of Soo-holu's shared powers, kill 50 of the nearby Frenzyheart wolvar, then return to Lightningcaller Soo-met near the Great Lightning Stone.
english.description: Puppy-men been attacking Sparktouched... we need fight or they just attack other Oracles too.$B$BYou been good friend to us, so maybe we allow you special honor. Great Ones left protector long time ago for shrines... it here still, but it not know something wrong til shrines messed with.$B$BPuppy-men down there have bad crystals for making trouble... bring a bad crystal to Lightning Shrine so Soo-holu know to help.$B$BDon't be scared if Soo-holu take your body... he very powerful, so he keep you safe.
english.progress: Thank you for help dryskin. You very good to us.
english.completion: Soo-holu strong, huh? I very glad he accept you to share his body for fight. He more trusting of people he met before, so maybe come back another time to help more, yes?
english.completed: Speak to Lightningcaller Soo-met at Sparktouched Haven in Sholazar Basin.

text.title: 死亡裂口大捷！
text.objectives: 将瓦拉纳王子的报告交给黑锋要塞阿彻鲁斯的大领主达里安·莫格莱尼。
text.description: <瓦拉纳王子交给你一份封起来的卷轴。>$B$B这是我们在死亡裂口获胜的全面报告。你去把这份报告交给莫格莱尼大人——他就在阿彻鲁斯里面。我已经把你的英雄事迹也写在了报告中。莫格莱尼肯定会好好奖励你的，$N。$B$B现在，出发吧！
text.progress: I was certain you wouldn't make it back here in one piece, $c. Perhaps there is more to you than I first surmised.
text.completion: The ENTIRE Scarlet fleet? Such power, $n... I have not seen such a display of domination in years... Since my father wielded... It's not important... Yes, your commendation, lest I forget.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Ebon Hold.

english.title: Victory At Death's Breach!
english.objectives: Deliver Prince Valanar's Report to Highlord Darion Mograine in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
english.description: <Prince Valanar hands you a sealed scroll.>$B$BThis is the full report of our victory at Death's Breach. You are to deliver this to Highlord Mograine - inside Acherus. I have made sure to include your heroics in the report. Mograine will undoubtedly reward you greatly for this victory, $N.$B$BGo now!
english.progress: I was certain you wouldn't make it back here in one piece, $c. Perhaps there is more to you than I first surmised.
english.completion: The ENTIRE Scarlet fleet? Such power, $n... I have not seen such a display of domination in years... Since my father wielded... It's not important... Yes, your commendation, lest I forget.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine in Ebon Hold.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 猛犸的复仇
text.objectives: 希姆托加的剥皮师埃霍奈希望你使用犸托斯勋章让被激怒的猛犸象冷静下来，然后骑乘它去消灭12个犸托斯信徒。
text.description: 埃霍奈听说你已经去过犸托斯巨坑了，朋友。犸托斯的子嗣们被激怒了，迫切地想要讨回公道！$B$B沿着东北这条路往上走到祖达克的更高一层，你可以在右边找到犸托斯祭坛的残余部分。$B$B等你到了那里之后，在一头狂暴的猛犸象眼前晃一晃这枚犸托斯勋章，它就会冷静一段时间，这样你就可以骑到它的背上了。$B$B骑上它，用它去践踏那些犸托斯信徒吧！
text.progress: What? You done already?$B$BDid you enact wooly justice upon those sorry ice trolls?
text.completion: Score one for the victims, mon!
text.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Wooly Justice
english.objectives: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga wants you to use the Medallion of Mam'toth to calm and ride an Enraged Mammoth. You are then to trample 12 Mam'toth Disciples to death.
english.description: Ahunae hear about your trip to Mam'toth Crater, mon. The children of Mam'toth are enraged and cry out for justice!$B$BFollow the avenue northeast up the steps to the next tier of Zul'Drak. On your right you will find what's left of the Altar of Mam'toth.$B$BWhen you get there, flash this Medallion of Mam'toth in front of the eyes of one of the enraged mammoths. It'll calm down for a little while, letting you hop on its back.$B$BRide it around, trampling all of the Mam'toth disciples that you can find!
english.progress: What? You done already?$B$BDid you enact wooly justice upon those sorry ice trolls?
english.completion: Score one for the victims, mon!
english.completed: Return to Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 魔化蒂基面具战士
text.objectives: 希姆托加的元素驯服者德苟达要求你消灭12名魔化蒂基面具战士。
text.description: 我知道你正要前往东北方的佐尔玛兹要塞，$C。你到了那边以后，顺便帮我个忙，干掉督军手下的那些特殊守卫。$B$B那些被称为魔化蒂基面具战士的家伙，正如其名，具备强大的实力，对我们构成了显著的威胁。如果达卡莱巨魔能够大量生产出这种战士，恐怕我们很快就只能举白旗投降了。$B$B让我们来共同证明这种战士不堪一击，根本不值得大批量生产吧，怎么样？
text.progress: Surely you couldn't have dealt with all of the enchanted tiki warriors so quickly?
text.completion: That should make them think twice about making more of those things. I shudder to think what it would be like to have to fight an army of those things. I guess it would be just like fighting the endless waves of the Scourge.
text.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Enchanted Tiki Warriors
english.objectives: Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga has asked you to destroy 12 Enchanted Tiki Warriors.
english.description: I know that you're headed up to the Zol'Maz Stronghold to the northeast, $c. While you're there, I need you to deal with the warlord's special guardians.$B$BThe enchanted tiki warriors, as they're called, represent a very real threat. If the Drakkari were to mass produce them, we'd quickly be overrun.$B$BLet's you and I demonstrate that they're not worth the effort to create, shall we?
english.progress: Surely you couldn't have dealt with all of the enchanted tiki warriors so quickly?
english.completion: That should make them think twice about making more of those things. I shudder to think what it would be like to have to fight an army of those things. I guess it would be just like fighting the endless waves of the Scourge.
english.completed: Return to Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 妖术宝箱
text.objectives: 希姆托加的记载者图基尼要求你为他夺取12只佐尔玛兹要塞宝箱。
text.description: 很抱歉打扰你，$N。我听说你可能会前往东北边的佐尔玛兹要塞。对我们来说，你的这趟冒险也许是一个收集达卡莱巨魔文物的大好机会。$B$B据我所知，那个达卡莱督军十分多疑，因此，他用妖术保护着要塞里面所有保存着重要东西的箱子。不过，据说他手下的那些蒂基面具战士身上带有可以解除妖术的物品，但我也不太确定这一点。$B$B如果你有时间帮我弄几只箱子回来，我一定会好好酬谢你的。
text.progress: Perhaps you carry the caches within your pack even as we speak?
text.completion: Just look at all of that! See here, $n. This piece you recovered vividly illustrates that the Drakkari became aware of the weakening of the land that the Scourge caused by their presence. The warlord felt compelled to take the opportunity this presented. He pushed the prophets to kill their gods in an effort to control the power and fight back against the Lich King's forces. Either way they were doomed. They inadvertently chose to be the instrument of their own destruction!
text.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Hexed Caches
english.objectives: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire 12 Zol'Maz Stronghold Caches.
english.description: Pardon me, $N. I'm given to understand that you might be heading northeast up to the Zol'Maz Stronghold. Such a trip presents a great opportunity for us to conclude our Drakkari goods gathering.$B$BAs I have come to know, the Drakkari warlord is extremely paranoid. He's had all of his caches at the stronghold hexed with dire magic. Rumor has it that his tiki warriors carry the cure, but who can say?$B$BIf you could find the time to acquire some of those goods, I would be most appreciative.
english.progress: Perhaps you carry the caches within your pack even as we speak?
english.completion: Just look at all of that! See here, $n. This piece you recovered vividly illustrates that the Drakkari became aware of the weakening of the land that the Scourge caused by their presence. The warlord felt compelled to take the opportunity this presented. He pushed the prophets to kill their gods in an effort to control the power and fight back against the Lich King's forces. Either way they were doomed. They inadvertently chose to be the instrument of their own destruction!
english.completed: Return to Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 真相大白
text.objectives: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你通过传送器前往他的上层密室。
text.description: 干得很不错，$N。$B$B你再次证明了我没有看走眼！现在，你也明白为什么我能获得巫妖王陛下的祝福了，因为我很少看走眼……$B$B现在，是时候把主人的计划全盘告诉你啦，朋友。$B$B你将看着我们是如何一步步将蝗虫一般的达卡莱巨魔扫出这一地区，并在古达克内获取属于我们自己的地位。$B$B带上这根权杖，它代表着我对你的信任。有了它，你就可以不受任何限制地进入上面的密室，哦……对了，别忘了好好观赏一下我们的秘密武器。
text.progress: Have ya gone ta witness my creations, $N?
text.completion: So, there ya have it, mon. We be makin' da ultimate scourge army ta serve da Lich King. He gunna be most pleased! You keep da scepter, $n. You gunna be needin' it ta command my army in battle.... Soon!
text.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Disclosure
english.objectives: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to take the teleporter to his upper chamber.
english.description: Ya doin' well, $n.$b$bYou be provin' dat I got an eye for talent! Now ya see why da Lich King gave me his blessing....$b$bDa time has come for me to reveal my master plan to ya, mon.$b$bNow you be seein' how we gunna sweep through da swarms of Drakkari trolls to take our rightful place in da great palace of Gundrak.$b$bTake dis scepter, mon. It be a token of my trust in ya. With it, you be able ta access my upper chamber and witness for yourself our secret weapons.
english.progress: Have ya gone ta witness my creations, $N?
english.completion: So, there ya have it, mon. We be makin' da ultimate scourge army ta serve da Lich King. He gunna be most pleased! You keep da scepter, $n. You gunna be needin' it ta command my army in battle.... Soon!
english.completed: Return to Overlord Drakuru at Voltarus in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 被丢弃的信件
text.completion: Atop the mailbox are several illegible letters and scrolls. Useless...$B$BPerhaps you should check inside?

english.title: Abandoned Mail
english.completion: Atop the mailbox are several illegible letters and scrolls. Useless...$B$BPerhaps you should check inside?

text.title: 督军佐尔玛兹的钥匙
text.objectives: 希姆托加的哈克娅要求你去夺取督军佐尔玛兹的钥匙。
text.description: $N，现在我们需要找到那把钥匙，才能解开束缚着犀牛之神阿卡里的锁链。他现在状况非常危险，随时都有可能被巨魔们击败并夺走全身的神力。$B$B那把钥匙，应该就在达卡莱巨魔的督军佐尔玛兹手中。他听说了你的事情之后，已经和他的手下躲进了东北方阶梯之上的要塞里。$B$B这名督军非常强大，你或许需要一些协助才能将其击败。若你能先击败他的手下，并将他们的蒂基面具、剑和巫术这三者融合起来的话，就可以在挑战他本人时召唤到所需的助力。
text.progress: I cannot stress how important it is that you acquire the warlord's key no matter the cost.
text.completion: It might have been better if I hadn't asked you to bring it back here instead of heading directly to Gundrak. However, I think that it's best that you hear what else I have to say first.
text.completed: Return to Har'koa at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

english.title: The Key of Warlord Zol'Maz
english.objectives: Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire the Key of Warlord Zol'Maz.
english.description: $N, we need a key to unlock the chains of the rhino god, Akali. Even now he is being prepared for the slaughter.$B$BThe Drakkari warlord, Zol'Maz, carries the key. Hearing of your exploits, he has secluded himself and his family at their stronghold up the steps to the northeast.$B$BThe warlord is strong and you will need help. If you were to combine the tiki, sword and incantation of his family members, you would be able to summon such help as you challenge him before his home's gate.
english.progress: I cannot stress how important it is that you acquire the warlord's key no matter the cost.
english.completion: It might have been better if I hadn't asked you to bring it back here instead of heading directly to Gundrak. However, I think that it's best that you hear what else I have to say first.
english.completed: Return to Har'koa at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 背叛
text.objectives: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要求你击败达库鲁。$B$B如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
text.description: 好了，间谍游戏也该到此结束了，$N。$B$B你带来的情报具备非常重要的价值，现在，我们必须趁达库鲁全面展开计划之前阻止他，并将他杀死，以绝后患。$B$B你手里的这根节杖已经被我们全面改造过了。等到时机合适的时候，你就对达库鲁的瘟血巨魔释放出这根节杖中的能量。这也是你可以击败他的唯一方式。$B$B祝你好运。
text.progress: Have you faced Drakuru in battle, $n?
text.completion: So, it is done. We still have much to do, but our work here will be much more manageable thanks to your efforts. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

english.title: Betrayal
english.objectives: Stefan in Ebon Watch wants you to defeat Drakuru.$b$bIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
english.description: The time has come to end this charade, $n.$b$bAs valuable as your information has been, we must bring Drakuru down and bring his project to an end before his freaks are unleashed.$b$bWe've modified your scepter for the job. When the time is right, you will be able to use it on Drakuru's Blightbloods and turn them against him. It's your only hope of defeating him.$b$bFight well.
english.progress: Have you faced Drakuru in battle, $n?
english.completion: So, it is done. We still have much to do, but our work here will be much more manageable thanks to your efforts. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

text.title: 巫妖王的意志
text.objectives: 回到死亡裂口，向瓦拉纳王子报到。
text.description: 是巫妖王的意志在驱使我们前进，$N。没有谁比死亡骑士更清楚这一点了。本质上，我们是依靠他的意志而存在的。你肯定听到过他对你说话，侵入你的思想……$B$B你现在能听到吗？也许对你来说还为时过早。$B$B<莫格莱尼闭上了双眼，对某个你看不见的人点了点头。>$B$B遵命，我的主人。$B$B$N，你现在必须回到死亡裂口，向瓦拉纳王子报到。这是巫妖王的命令！
text.completion: Havenshire is ours! A thousand corpses litter the ground, patiently awaiting rebirth. We strike now at our enemy with the awakened strength of the Scourge! The ghouls have already begun their assault upon New Avalon. Our forces have moved in behind them and taken the Crypt of Remembrance.

english.title: The Will Of The Lich King
english.objectives: Return to Death's Breach and report to Prince Valanar.
english.description: It is the will of the Lich King that drives us onward, $N. None are more aware of this than death knights. Our very existence is intrinsically tied to his consciousness. Surely you have heard him speak to you - invading your thoughts...$B$BCan you hear him now? Perhaps it is too early for you.$B$B<Mograine closes his eyes and nods to an unseen host.>$B$BYes, my lord. It will be done.$B$B$N, you are to return to Death's Breach and report to Prince Valanar. The Lich King commands it!
english.completion: Havenshire is ours! A thousand corpses litter the ground, patiently awaiting rebirth. We strike now at our enemy with the awakened strength of the Scourge! The ghouls have already begun their assault upon New Avalon. Our forces have moved in behind them and taken the Crypt of Remembrance.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 追忆墓穴
text.objectives: 向追忆墓穴的凯雷塞斯王子报到。
text.description: 我们已经开始向血色十字军的最后堡垒发动了进攻。在我们努力加固新的前线基地——追忆墓穴的同时，我们的食尸鬼正在消耗着十字军的外围防线。$B$B勇敢地向南面进发，在新阿瓦隆附近找到那座墓穴，然后向我亲爱的兄弟凯雷塞斯王子报到吧。$B$B他对你的到来充满着期待。$B$B做好准备，$N，也许你即将目睹天灾军团下一阶段的攻势：征服！$B$B出发吧，死亡骑士！
text.completion: Hail, $c. I am the blood lord, Keleseth, ruler of the southeastern reaches of Northrend. The Lich King has sought to utilize my talents in ending this mortal affront to the Scourge. As with all things the Lich King asks of me, I am happy to oblige. Of course, a sea of endless souls to sate my thirst certainly sweetened the deal, don't you think?

english.title: The Crypt of Remembrance
english.objectives: Report to Prince Keleseth at the Crypt of Remembrance.
english.description: The attacks upon the gates of the last Scarlet bastion have begun. Our ghouls are wearing the Crusade's front lines down while we labor to fortify our new forward base, the Crypt of Remembrance.$B$BVenture south to the crypt, which borders New Avalon, and report to my dear brother, Prince Keleseth.$B$BHe will be expecting you.$B$BPrepare yourself, $N, for you are about to witness the next stage of Scourge warfare: DOMINATION!$B$BRide now, death knight!
english.completion: Hail, $c. I am the blood lord, Keleseth, ruler of the southeastern reaches of Northrend. The Lich King has sought to utilize my talents in ending this mortal affront to the Scourge. As with all things the Lich King asks of me, I am happy to oblige. Of course, a sea of endless souls to sate my thirst certainly sweetened the deal, don't you think?

text.title: 药剂师的要求
text.objectives: 药剂师诺斯要求你交给他一口空锅、一条铁链和10块十字军徽记。
text.description: 看这片南瓜田！你有没有发现少了什么东西？显然没有，因为你是个白痴！你的脑子可能是最先死掉的那部分。$B$B<诺斯叹了口气。>$B$B我收到命令，要部署一口天灾之锅。你要负责帮我完成任务。$B$B穿过新阿瓦隆的正门之后，你就可以看到一座旅店，进去给我弄一口锅出来。然后到城门附近的熔炉那里去，给我再弄一些铁链子。另外给我带10块十字军士兵的徽记回来——需不需要我告诉你去哪里弄这些玩意？
text.progress: Have you gathered the materials I requested?
text.completion: Perfect! Now give me a moment to get things set up.
text.completed: Return to Noth the Plaguebringer at Havenshire Lumber Mill in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: The Plaguebringer's Request
english.objectives: Noth the Plaguebringer has requested that you bring him 1 Empty Cauldron, 1 Iron Chain and 10 Crusader Skulls.
english.description: Look at this pumpkin patch! Notice anything missing? Of course you don't, because you're a moron! Your brain was probably the first thing to die.$B$B<Noth sighs.>$B$BI have been commanded to put together a plague cauldron. You will help me.$B$BDirectly inside the gate of New Avalon is the inn. Enter the inn and steal an empty cauldron. Then go to the forge, also near the gate, and steal some iron chains. Bring those back to me along with 10 Crusader skulls. Do I need to tell you where to get those too?
english.progress: Have you gathered the materials I requested?
english.completion: Perfect! Now give me a moment to get things set up.
english.completed: Return to Noth the Plaguebringer at Havenshire Lumber Mill in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 诺斯的特殊药剂
text.objectives: 将一堆十字军徽记放入天灾之锅。
text.description: 天灾之锅已经准备就绪，随时都可以使用！$B$B死亡骑士，现在让我简短地介绍一下天灾之锅。锅中散发出的气体对于活人来说是致命的，不过对于天灾来说正好相反：他们从死亡中获取力量，因此浸染在天灾之锅中的时间越长，就会变得越强大。$B$B拿上这些十字军徽记，把它们扔进锅里。你会对它的结果感到满意的。
text.progress: The plague cauldron stands idle.
text.completion: The plague cauldron jumps to life when the skulls are placed inside. After a few seconds some vials of dark liquid float to the top.
text.completed: Seek out the Plague Cauldron at Havenshire Farms in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: Noth's Special Brew
english.objectives: Place the Pile of Crusader Skulls inside the Plague Cauldron.
english.description: The cauldron is ready to begin spewing its foul corruption across the land!$B$BNow, death knight, a brief lesson in plague cauldrons. The gas that the cauldron emits is deadly to the living, but empowers Scourge. As with all Scourge creations, it feeds off of death and grows stronger the longer it feeds.$B$BTake these Crusader skulls and drop them in the cauldron. You will be quite happy with the results.
english.progress: The plague cauldron stands idle.
english.completion: The plague cauldron jumps to life when the skulls are placed inside. After a few seconds some vials of dark liquid float to the top.
english.completed: Seek out the Plague Cauldron at Havenshire Farms in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 更多的徽记
text.progress: The plague cauldron bubbles and churns its toxic brew, spewing a thick gas all around.$B$BDo you have more Crusader skulls to place inside?
text.completion: The plague cauldron jumps to life when the skulls are placed inside.$B$BAfter a few seconds, the plague cauldron grants you the dark and frothy splendor of Noth's Special Brew.
text.completed: Return to Plague Cauldron in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: More Skulls For Brew
english.progress: The plague cauldron bubbles and churns its toxic brew, spewing a thick gas all around.$B$BDo you have more Crusader skulls to place inside?
english.completion: The plague cauldron jumps to life when the skulls are placed inside.$B$BAfter a few seconds, the plague cauldron grants you the dark and frothy splendor of Noth's Special Brew.
english.completed: Return to Plague Cauldron in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

text.title: 无路可逃，无处可藏
text.objectives: 追忆墓穴的凯雷塞斯王子命令你去击败奎比镇长，并找到新阿瓦隆户籍册。
text.description: 没有什么能比完全歼灭敌人更令人满足的了，$N。不过想要做到这点，只靠几百个无脑怪物进攻新阿瓦隆的前门是远远不够的。我们必须渗入内部，除掉他们的官员。必须得让他们知道：没人可以逃出天灾的掌心！$B$B前往西南面的新阿瓦隆市政厅，击败在那里发号施令的家伙。在市政厅里找到户籍册，把它带回来交给我。
text.progress: There is nowhere to run!
